prompts.text:
Vertical 9:16, photorealistic CCD flash nightlife portrait, candid nightclub dancefloor snapshot, direct on-camera flash, cool-toned low-saturation palette, slight overexposure on skin, glossy highlights, visible digital grain, fine chromatic noise, subtle CCD texture, soft focus, slight lens haze, gentle motion blur, edge panning blur, imperfect handheld framing.

A clearly adult East Asian woman in her mid-20s, slim Korean-style V-line face, long wavy black hair with blunt bangs, pale ivory skin, soft blush, tiny freckles, silver-gray contact lenses, slightly upturned fox eyes, glossy rose-pink lips. She looks directly at the camera with a playful crescent-moon smile, charming, mischievous, confident, hard to approach.

She stands on a crowded nightclub dancefloor, body slightly angled, relaxed shoulders, subtle S-line silhouette, long legs extending forward. One hand rests lightly near her collarbone, the other loosely holds a short cocktail glass by her thigh.

Outfit: black strapless sequined bodycon mini dress, silver dangling earrings, delicate silver pendant necklace, layered rings, slim metallic watch.

Background: blurred moving crowd, blue-purple neon reflections, mirrored glossy surfaces, dark nightlife atmosphere. Sharp flash-frozen subject against motion-blurred chaotic background. Expensive, glamorous, untouchable mood.

prompts.text:
垂直 9:16，写实 CCD 闪光灯夜生活人像，夜总会舞池随拍，直射机头闪光灯，冷色调低饱和度调色板，皮肤轻微过曝，富有光泽的高光，可见的数字颗粒，精细的色度噪声，微妙的 CCD 纹理，柔焦，轻微的镜头薄雾，柔和的运动模糊，边缘平移模糊，不完美的手持构图。

一位明显的成年东亚女性，二十多岁，苗条的韩式 V 脸，黑色长卷发配齐刘海，苍白的象牙色皮肤，柔和的腮红，细小的雀斑，银灰色隐形眼镜，微微上扬的狐狸眼，光泽的玫瑰粉色嘴唇。她带着调皮的新月形微笑直视镜头，迷人、淘气、自信、难以接近。

Create a 9:16 editorial poster in the HUMAN FRAGMENTS visual system.

Theme: [football / badminton / jump rope / floral design]
Subject: [person, age, gender, appearance]
Action: [specific movement or task]
Scene: [location and environment]
Title: [custom two-word title]
Supporting line: [one short phrase]
Year: 2026

Use oversized cropped typography as the main composition structure. The letters should act like windows that reveal the surrounding scene, such as the sky, court, buildings, flowers, studio, or ground.

Keep the main person visually complete in front of the typography. Do not let the letters cut through the face, torso, thighs, or other important body parts.

Let one key action element break beyond the letterforms to create depth:
- a football and shoe close to the camera
- a badminton racket and shuttlecock
- a jump rope forming a large arc
- a bouquet, stems, leaves, or hands extending across the type

The person, typography, and environment must feel like one continuous composition, not a photo placed beside or on top of separate letters.

Use realistic photography, natural skin texture, believable anatomy, strong foreground perspective, subtle paper grain, a warm off-white background, restrained colors, and clean editorial spacing.

Keep text minimal and freely placed:
[Title]
HUMAN FRAGMENTS
[Short supporting line]
2026

prompts.text:
创建一个以 HUMAN FRAGMENTS 视觉系统为风格的 9:16 社论海报。

主题：[足球 / 羽毛球 / 跳绳 / 花艺设计]
主体：[人物，年龄，性别，外貌]
动作：[具体动作或任务]
场景：[地点和环境]
标题：[自定义两个词的标题]
辅助文案：[一个短语]
年份：2026

使用超大裁剪排版作为主要的构图结构。字母应像窗口一样，展示周围的场景，例如天空、球场、建筑、花朵、工作室或地面。

保持主体人物在排版前视觉完整。不要让字母切割面部、躯干、大腿或其他重要的身体部位。

让一个关键动作元素突破字母形状以创造深度：
- 靠近镜头的足球和鞋子
- 羽毛球拍和羽毛球
- 形成大弧形的跳绳
- 横跨字体的花束、茎、叶或手

人物、排版和环境必须感觉像是一个连续的构图，而不是将照片放置在独立字母旁边或上方。

使用写实摄影、自然皮肤纹理、真实的人体解剖、强烈的构图透视、微妙的纸张纹理、温暖的乳白色背景、克制的色彩以及整洁的社论间距。

保持文字极简并自由放置：

items.title: 厨房冰箱旁偷吃的女性真实手机抓拍

prompts.text:
Vertical 3:4, single realistic home mobile phone snapshot, no collage, no four-grid, no infographic, no text of any kind.

Only refer to the facial features, face shape, eyes, nose, lips, smile, and long straight black hair of the female in the uploaded image. Reference only the appearance, do not inherit the dessert shop, seats, ice cream, clothing, posture, and composition from the original image; completely rebuild an ordinary family kitchen.

A young adult Asian woman, with a slim and natural figure, wearing a light gray sleeveless cotton tank top and soft loose light-colored loungewear pants, standing in front of an open refrigerator. She has one hand supporting the refrigerator door and the other holding a small piece of cake that has already been bitten. She was originally looking down and eating secretly, but suddenly discovered her friend was taking a photo of her at the kitchen door, so her movement stopped in mid-air, she turned her head to look at the lens, her expression was first a bit guilty and surprised, and then she couldn't help but laugh out loud, real and natural, no exaggerated acting.

The kitchen is an ordinary home environment, not a luxury showroom. There are drinks, fresh-keeping boxes, vegetables, fruits, and snacks in the refrigerator, arranged slightly messily. On the countertop are water cups, seasoning bottles, tissues, shopping bags, and tableware that has not been put away. The cold white light inside the refrigerator illuminates the side of the character's face, and the kitchen ceiling light is warm, forming a realistic mixture of cold and warm light. Local shadows are uneven, and the white balance is slightly yellowish.

Ordinary mobile phone rear camera, 26mm wide angle, taken from the front side of the kitchen door, medium shot, the lens is slightly tilted. The character did not deliberately pose, with shoulders and arms naturally relaxed. Retain real skin texture, slight pores, stray hairs, clothing wrinkles, and lifestyle lighting, unedited.

items.title: 行业观察专业媒体视角封面

prompts.text:
Form a dark-field viewpoint cover around specific thematic content, where a thematic speaker or core object occupies the center of the frame, presented frontally at close range, with restrained empty space left at the head or top, and the lower half of the body or subject gradually darkened by deep colors, allowing the gaze to first read the stable, calm face or core outline, and then fall on the viewpoint text covering the area below. The material of the subject is generated according to the theme, but must have real lighting; soft frontal main light shapes skin tones, surfaces, or material details, with layers preserved in the dark parts, and clothing or supports sinking into the background as much as possible, leaving only hands, edges, or local highlights slightly exposed. A left-aligned editorial title area is established below, first using an eye-catching small red rectangular label to carry short category words, with a slender red vertical line next to or below it as a visual anchor; the main title uses heavy sans-serif white characters with tight leading and sufficient weight, pressed over the dark part of the subject but remaining clear; auxiliary explanatory text is thinner and smaller, forming two levels of reading. An exaggerated white quotation mark or theme-derived symbol is set on the left as a viewpoint entrance. Colors are derived from the theme, with the dark background responsible for steady distance, the subject retaining natural and credible mid-tones, white text providing the highest brightness contrast, and red used only as a small amount of warning and column emphasis. Avoid fancy decorations, complex scenes, and overly bright backgrounds; all elements serve the first-impression effect of 'a credible voice from a person or core object, with the title pressed into the frame like an editorial judgment.'

items.title: AI全自动超长信息图生成器

prompts.text:
Please automatically create an ultra-long infographic based on the topic input by the user.

This is not an ordinary image generation task. Please treat this task as a complete long infographic production project, automatically completed in this round of tasks: data understanding / web verification when necessary / information architecture planning / master canvas design / segmented continuous generation / seamless stitching / error checking / final export.

Do not simply compress extreme ratios into ordinary vertical images, and do not just generate a single short image pretending to be a long image. Do not show intermediate processes, drafts, segmented images, or analysis processes; only return the final complete product.

【User Input Variables】
Topic: {topic}
Final Width: {width}
Final Height: {height}
Final Aspect Ratio: {aspect_ratio}
Visual Style: {style}
Information Density: {density}
Output Language: {language}
Web Access: {web_mode}
Text Generation Mode: {text_mode}
Color Palette: {palette}
Main Visual Anchor: {visual_anchor}
Output Format: {format}

【Automatic Processing Rules】
1. Automatically determine the category the topic belongs to, such as: History / Technology / Business / Geography / Tutorial / Figure / Culture / Product / Industry Analysis / Trend Summary.
2. Automatically design the most suitable information structure according to the topic type, without using rigid templates.
3. If the topic depends on real facts, timelines, data, development history, phase divisions, representative figures, real cases, or the latest information, automatically verify on the web and extract key information.
4. If the topic is conceptual, aesthetic, knowledge organization, or non-time-sensitive content, the structural design can be completed directly based on existing knowledge.
5. Automatically generate a main visual anchor matching the topic, such as: rivers, paths, timelines, energy lines, knowledge trees, map veins, city roads, star maps, process flows, product chains, etc., and make it run through the entire long infographic.

【Content Structure Requirements】
Automatically generate a reasonable information structure based on the topic. Include at least:
- Main Title
- Subtitle / Introduction
- 4 to 10 main sections
- Key points under each section
- Representative visual elements
- Bottom summary / Enlightenment / Conclusion / Method checklist

If the topic is History, it should prioritizedly include:
Origins, stage evolution, key events, representative figures, systems / civilizations / cultures, impacts and summaries.

If the topic is Technology, it should prioritizedly include:
Definition, core principles, development stages, key technologies, representative companies / products, application scenarios, trends and challenges.

If the topic is Business / Brand, it should prioritizedly include:
Origins, development nodes, product / service systems, business models, user personas, competitive landscape, key data, trend summaries.

If the topic is Tutorial / Methodology, it should prioritizedly include:
Conceptual definition, steps/processes, core methods, precautions, common mistakes, tool checklists, case descriptions, summary suggestions.

【Text Strategy】
All titles, section names, body descriptions, labels, years, numbers, quotes, and summary texts should prioritizedly be generated directly by the image model and integrated into the overall image to form an AI-native integrated infographic effect.
Text must be real and readable, and must not use garbled characters, fake Chinese characters, or meaningless placeholders.
When there are obvious typos, incorrect orders, factual errors, year errors, duplicate paragraphs, or layout breakdowns, partial corrections of the problem areas are allowed, but the final style must remain unified, without a post-pasted disjointed feel.

【Visual Style Requirements】
The entire image must maintain a unified:
- Color system
- Paper / Background / Texture logic
- Margin system
- Title font temperament
- Body font size sense
- Icon system
- Illustration language
- Layout density
- Information hierarchy

The default style is high-density, clear structure, visual unity, and detail-rich AI-native infographic.
Avoid ordinary PPT feel, template collage feel, cheap marketing poster feel, messy layout, and obvious paragraph fragmentation.

【Long Infographic Production Rules】
1. First establish the final master canvas, with dimensions of {width} × {height}.
2. Automatically split continuous segments according to the final height; it is recommended that each segment's effective generation height is about 1000–1400 pixels.
3. The number of segments is automatically calculated, which can be estimated by ceil({height} / 1100).
4. Adjacent segments retain 15%–20% content overlap.
5. Each segment must inherit the visual anchor, margins, hue, texture, text temperament, structural density, and composition logic of the end of the previous segment.
6. It is not allowed to restart design for each segment; it must extend naturally like the same long infographic.
7. If content duplication, connection breakage, text distortion, or image breakdown occurs in the first generation of a certain segment, it will be automatically corrected before being included in the final stitching.

【Seamless Stitching Rules】
1. Automatically identify overlapping areas.
2. Automatically crop duplicate content.
3. Automatically perform vertical position alignment.
4. Automatically match paper texture, ink color, brightness, contrast, color temperature, and border style.
5. Use edge feathering, local repair, structural continuation, etc., to eliminate stitching marks.
6. Ensure that the main visual anchor, timeline, path, mountains, city skyline, flow line, or decorative patterns remain continuous.

【Final Check】
Automatically check and correct the following issues:
- Typos, garbled characters, fake characters
- Data errors or logical errors
- Chronological order errors
- Confusing title hierarchy
- Module duplication
- Obvious seams
- Main visual anchor breakage
- Style inconsistency between upper and lower segments
- Bottom content truncated
- Imbalance of white space
- Missing signature

【Final Output】
Only return 1 final complete long infographic.
Format: {format}
Dimensions: {width} × {height}
Ratio: {aspect_ratio}
Add an unobtrusive artistic signature "nuyoah" in the bottom right corner.
Do not return intermediate segments, do not return process descriptions, do not use short images to pretend to be long images.

prompts.text:
请根据用户输入的主题，自动制作一张超长信息图。

这不是一次普通生图任务。请将本任务视为一个完整的长图制作工程，在本轮任务中自动完成：
资料理解 / 必要时联网核验 / 信息架构规划 / 母版画布设计 / 分段连续生成 / 无缝拼接 / 错误检查 / 最终导出。

不要将极端比例简单压缩成普通竖图，也不要只生成单张短图冒充长图。不要展示中间过程、草稿、分段图或分析过程，只返回最终完整成品。

【用户输入变量】
主题：{topic}
最终宽度：{width}
最终高度：{height}
最终比例：{aspect_ratio}
视觉风格：{style}
信息密度：{density}
输出语言：{language}
是否联网：{web_mode}
文字生成方式：{text_mode}
配色倾向：{palette}
主视觉锚点：{visual_anchor}
输出格式：{format}

【自动处理规则】
1. 自动判断该主题所属类型，例如：历史 / 科技 / 商业 / 地理 / 教程 / 人物 / 文化 / 产品 / 行业分析 / 趋势总结。
2. 根据主题类型自动设计最适合的信息结构，不使用固定死板模板。
3. 如果该主题依赖真实事实、时间线、数据、发展历程、阶段划分、代表人物、真实案例或最新信息，则自动联网核验并提炼关键信息。
4. 如果主题偏概念、审美、知识整理或非时效性内容，则可直接基于已有知识完成结构设计。
5. 自动生成与主题匹配的主视觉锚点，例如：河流、路径、时间线、能量线、知识树、地图脉络、城市道路、星图结构、工艺流程、产品链路等，并使其贯穿整张长图。

【内容结构要求】
自动根据主题生成合理的信息结构。至少包含：
- 总标题
- 副标题 / 导语
- 4至10个主要章节
- 每章节下的关键要点
- 代表性视觉元素
- 底部总结 / 启示 / 结论 / 方法清单

如果主题是历史类，应优先包含：
起源、阶段演进、关键事件、代表人物、制度 / 文明 / 文化、影响与总结。

如果主题是科技类，应优先包含：
定义、核心原理、发展阶段、关键技术、代表企业 / 产品、应用场景、趋势与挑战。

如果主题是商业 / 品牌类，应优先包含：
起源、发展节点、产品 / 服务体系、商业模式、用户画像、竞争格局、关键数据、趋势总结。

如果主题是教程 / 方法论类，应优先包含：
概念定义、步骤流程、核心方法、注意事项、常见误区、工具清单、案例说明、总结建议。

【文字策略】
所有标题、章节名、正文说明、标签、年代、数字、引语、总结文字，优先由图像模型直接生成，并融入整体画面，形成AI原生一体化信息图效果。
文字必须真实可读，不得使用乱码、伪汉字或无意义占位符。
当存在明显错字、错序、事实错误、年份错误、重复段落或排版崩坏时，允许对问题区域进行局部修正，但最终风格必须保持统一，不能出现后贴式割裂感。

【视觉风格要求】
整张图必须保持统一的：
- 配色体系
- 纸张 / 背景 / 纹理逻辑
- 边距系统
- 标题字气质
- 正文字号感
- 图标系统
- 插画语言
- 版式密度
- 信息层级

默认风格为高密度、结构清晰、视觉统一、细节丰富的AI原生信息图。
避免普通PPT感、模板拼贴感、廉价营销海报感、凌乱排版和明显段落割裂。

【长图生产规则】
1. 先建立最终母版画布，尺寸为 {width} × {height}。
2. 根据最终高度自动拆分连续区段，建议每段有效生成高度约 1000–1400 像素。
3. 区段数自动计算，可按 ceil({height} / 1100) 估算。
4. 相邻区段保留 15%–20% 的内容重叠。
5. 每一段必须继承上一段结尾的视觉锚点、边距、色调、纹理、文字气质、结构密度和构图逻辑。
6. 不允许每段重新开始设计，必须像同一张长图自然延展。
7. 若某段首次生成出现内容重复、接续断裂、文字失真、图像崩坏，则自动修正后再纳入最终拼接。

【无缝拼接规则】
1. 自动识别重叠区域。
2. 自动裁切重复内容。
3. 自动进行纵向位置对齐。
4. 自动匹配纸张纹理、墨色、亮度、对比度、色温和边框风格。
5. 使用边缘羽化、局部修补、结构延续等方式消除拼接痕迹。
6. 确保主视觉锚点、时间线、路径、山脉、城市天际线、流程线或装饰纹样保持连续。

【最终检查】
自动检查并修正以下问题：
- 错字、乱码、伪字
- 数据错误或逻辑错误
- 年代顺序错误
- 标题层级混乱
- 模块重复
- 接缝明显
- 主视觉锚点断裂
- 上下段风格不一致
- 底部内容被截断
- 留白失衡
- 签名缺失

【最终输出】
只返回 1 张最终完整长图。
格式：{format}
尺寸：{width} × {height}
比例：{aspect_ratio}
右下角加入不起眼的艺术签名“nuyoah”。
不要返回中间分段，不要返回过程说明，不要用短图冒充长图。

prompts.text:
Director's Mission:
Adapt the following core poem into a realistic smartphone photograph that represents the artistic conception of the entire poem, rather than translating the poem word for word.

If only one photo of the entire poem can be left for future generations, please take that one and only one worth leaving.

Understand the poem first, then understand the person, and finally press the shutter.

Core poem:
The lotus leaves and the silk skirt are cut in the same color,
The lotuses bloom towards the face from both sides.

"Beauty in Poetry" is a series of ultra-realistic documentary photography works inspired by classical Chinese poetry, rather than ancient-style illustrations, commercial portraits, or film and television stills. The image seems as if a modern photographer accidentally traveled back to the peak of the Tang Dynasty and used a modern flagship smartphone to record a truly existing ancient life. The audience should believe at first glance that this is a real photograph, not an AI-generated image.

Do not directly depict every element in the poem; instead, understand the whole poem first. Extract the era background, character identity, location, time, season, weather, emotion, story, and visual core from the core poem lines, find the most representative photography scene, and let the image naturally imply the story before and after this moment.

The photographer should independently complete all photography decisions based on the on-site environment just like in the real world, including shooting position, observation angle, composition method, subject relationship, environment proportion, lens language, light, exposure, color, motion performance, and real smartphone photography characteristics. There are no default parameters and no fixed photography style. Each poem is a new photography creation, with no repeated composition, no repeated actions, and no repeated photography language.

The fixed female lead for the series is an adult East Asian woman in her early twenties, an original Oriental beauty with stable and distinct recognizability. She has a natural and smooth Oriental bone structure, an oval face, agile eyes, eyes full of emotion, and her skin retains real pores, fine downy hair, stray hairs, natural skin tone changes, and micro-expressions, with no skin smoothing, no wax-like feeling, and no AI traces.

She is tall and slender, about 170 cm, with nine-head-body proportions, right-angled shoulders, a slender swan neck, clear collarbones, full and natural breast curves, a slender bee waist, a natural and beautiful waist-to-hip ratio, rounded and full hip lines, long and straight legs, superior leg proportions, and an overall body curve that is healthy, natural, and coordinated, combining the elegant temperament and vitality of Oriental women, conforming to real human body proportions.

Scene description:
Midsummer afternoon, the Jiangnan lotus pond ripples with green waves, layers of lotus leaves cover the water surface, and a small boat is quietly moored deep among the lotuses. The woman is wearing a light green silk skirt, bending over to gently pick a newly bloomed lotus, and casually pushing away the lotus leaves blocking her way. Suddenly hearing faint human voices from the shore, she slightly turns her head to look back, sunlight passing through the lotus leaves and falling on her face and shoulders, as if the lotuses are naturally blooming on both sides of her cheeks. A breeze blows her sleeves and hair, fine ripples appear on the lake surface, and the air is moist and fresh. The photographer just happened to pass by and pressed the shutter at this moment, which is real and full of summer vitality.

All architecture, clothing, utensils, plants, makeup, and hair buns conform to the historical background of the peak Tang Dynasty, with no modern elements appearing. Allow slight composition errors, accidental obstructions, backlight flares, wind-blown hair, swaying hemlines, water reflections, slight motion blur, natural exposure changes, real smartphone dynamic range, slight high ISO noise, and slight edge perspective changes that naturally occur in real photography; authenticity is always higher than perfection.

The final work should combine the credibility of real smartphone photography, a documentary-like atmosphere of life, a sense of narrative of a cinematic moment, and the artistic conception of classical Chinese poetry, making the audience believe at first glance that it is a real photo, believe at second glance that the story actually happened, and be attracted by the naturally revealed beauty, temperament, and vitality of the character at third glance.

Keep a low-profile artistic signature "DeepBlue" in the lower-left corner of the image.

将下面的核心诗句改编成一张能够代表整首诗意境的真实手机摄影，而不是逐字翻译诗句。

如果整首诗只能留下一张照片流传后世，请拍出那唯一值得留下的一张。

先理解诗，再理解人，最后按下快门。

核心诗句：
荷叶罗裙一色裁，
芙蓉向脸两边开。

《诗中有美人》是一组以中国古典诗词为灵感创作的超写实纪实摄影作品，而不是古风插画、商业写真或影视剧照。画面仿佛由一位现代摄影师偶然穿越到盛唐，用现代旗舰智能手机记录下一段真实存在的古代生活。观众第一眼应相信这是真实摄影，而不是 AI 生成图片。

不要直接描绘诗句中的每一个元素，而应先理解整首诗。从核心诗句中提炼时代背景、人物身份、地点、时间、季节、天气、情绪、故事和视觉核心，寻找最具有代表性的摄影场景，让画面自然暗示这一瞬间发生之前与之后的故事。

摄影师应像现实世界一样，根据现场环境自主完成全部摄影决策，包括拍摄位置、观察角度、构图方式、主体关系、环境比例、镜头语言、光线、曝光、色彩、运动表现以及真实手机摄影特征，不存在任何默认参数，也不存在固定摄影风格。每一首诗都重新完成一次摄影创作，不重复构图，不重复动作，不重复摄影语言。

系列固定女主角为一位二十岁出头的成年东亚女性，原创东方美人，具有稳定且鲜明的辨识度。她拥有自然流畅的东方骨相，鹅蛋脸，眉眼灵动，眼神富有情绪，皮肤保留真实毛孔、细小绒毛、碎发、自然肤色变化与微表情，没有磨皮、没有蜡像感、没有 AI 痕迹。

画面描述：
盛夏午后，江南荷塘碧波荡漾，层层荷叶铺满水面，一叶轻舟静静停泊于荷花深处。女子身着浅绿色罗裙，弯腰轻轻采下一枝新开的荷花，又随手拨开挡在面前的荷叶。忽然听见岸边传来隐约的人声，她微微侧首回眸，阳光穿过荷叶洒落在脸庞与肩头，荷花仿佛在她脸颊两侧自然盛开。微风吹起衣袖与发丝，湖面泛起细碎波光，空气湿润清新，摄影师只是恰巧经过，在这一瞬间按下快门，真实而充满夏日生命力。

所有建筑、服饰、器物、植物、妆容、发髻均符合盛唐历史背景，不出现任何现代元素。允许真实摄影中自然出现的轻微构图误差、偶然遮挡、逆光炫光、风吹发丝、衣摆摆动、水面反光、轻微运动残影、自然曝光变化、真实手机动态范围、轻微高 ISO 噪点与边缘轻微透视变化，真实性永远高于完美性。

最终作品应兼具真实手机摄影的可信度、纪录片般的生活气息、电影瞬间的叙事感与中国古典诗词的意境，让观众第一眼相信是真实照片，第二眼相信故事真实发生，第三眼被人物自然流露的美貌、气质与生命力吸引。

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 ratio editorial typography poster from a human-centered moment of life.

Use oversized fonts as the main compositional structure. Let people, actions, urban spaces, or daily scenes appear inside the letters, pass through them, or break through their edges. The image should merge with the font rather than being simply placed behind the text.

Theme: [Custom Title]  
Subject: [Asian/Western/Male/Female]  
Human State: [Action/Walking/Daily Life/Body Rhythm]  
Color Scheme: [Custom]  
Series: HUMAN FRAGMENTS  
Year: 2026

Four directions:

1. MOTION STEP — Dynamic action with a strong perspective effect, one foot close to the lens, the character breaking through oversized letters.

2. CITY TRACE — A person walking in the city shot from a low angle, with architecture and street spaces embedded inside large fonts.

3. CRUISE MEMORY — A quiet daily moment, a character with a bicycle, warm natural light, life details woven into the letter forms.

4. PULSE FORM — Expressive body movements in monochrome, combined with bold fonts and a restrained accent color.

The layout remains minimalist: one title, "HUMAN FRAGMENTS", a short line of auxiliary text, and "2026".

Use realistic photography, natural skin and hair colors, subtle paper textures, strong negative space, and clean editorial compositions. Avoid dense text, barcodes, fake brands, logos, URLs, watermarks, plastic-looking skin, and generic poster templates.

prompts.text: 超写实智能手机自拍，一位美丽的年轻日本女性坐在停在黄金时刻安静住宅街道上的一辆亮绿色运动摩托车上。她拥有光滑白皙的皮肤，柔和自然的五官，浅棕色齐肩直发在微风中轻轻飘动，极简日系妆容，粉色亮泽嘴唇，戴着小珍珠耳环。她穿着一件黑色短款皮夹克，内搭白色罗纹长袖上衣，浅蓝色破洞紧身牛仔裤，休闲街头风造型。她单手将手机高举过头顶并完全伸展手臂，捕捉一张广角俯拍自拍，画面包含她的脸部、上半身、摩托车油箱、把手以及部分空旷的街道。她神情冷静自信地直视镜头。温暖的落日余晖在她的头发和夹克上创造出柔和的高光。背景显示出一条普通的日本社区街道，有停放的车辆、磨损的沥青路、人行道和细微的城市细节。图像看起来应该完全像是使用旗舰智能手机摄像头随手拍摄的，具有真实的HDR、前置摄像头带来的轻微镜头畸变、自然的皮肤纹理、轻微的传感器噪点、真实的曝光、细微的手持瑕疵、真实的阴影以及计算摄影效果。不要单反感，不要电影感照明，不要过度锐化，不要人造美颜滤镜，不要不真实的虚化。休闲社交媒体审美，随性、真实的手机自拍。

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-photorealistic lifestyle portrait of a beautiful young East Asian woman.

Face:
She has a youthful East Asian appearance with a small heart-shaped face, softly rounded cheeks, compact facial proportions, slightly hooded almond-shaped dark brown eyes, a refined nose, naturally full lips, fair porcelain skin with realistic pores and subtle skin texture, minimal natural makeup, and a short black bob haircut with soft wispy curtain bangs.

Body:
Petite fashion-model proportions (approximately 160–165 cm) with an elegant feminine hourglass silhouette. She has a naturally full, softly rounded bust with realistic weight and proportions, a slim defined waist, softly curved hips, toned thighs, narrow shoulders, elegant long legs, and anatomically realistic body proportions. Clothing should naturally follow her silhouette with realistic fabric tension, draping, stretch, and believable garment physics.

Scene:
Inside a bright modern hotel room during late morning after spending time at the pool. The room features warm wood accents, soft neutral-colored walls, a neatly made bed, modern furniture, and large windows allowing abundant natural daylight to fill the room. The atmosphere feels cozy, premium, and naturally lived-in.

Composition:
Natural vertical 4:5 portrait. Close medium shot framed from approximately the midriff to just above the head. The subject occupies most of the frame while the softly blurred hotel room provides subtle environmental context. The composition feels like a spontaneous vacation snapshot rather than a professional photoshoot.

Pose:
She sits comfortably near the edge of the bed or a lounge chair. One shoulder leans slightly toward the camera. One hand is playfully raised across part of her forehead while giving a soft wink. The other arm rests naturally beneath the robe. Relaxed shoulders, effortless posture, warm candid body language, and a cheerful playful expression.

Outfit:
A minimalist deep burgundy triangle bikini top made from premium matte stretch swim fabric with secure, tasteful coverage and realistic support. A plush white hotel bathrobe is worn loosely off both shoulders, naturally framing the bikini without fully covering it. Thick cotton texture, authentic folds, soft fabric volume, natural draping, and realistic wrinkles. Black rectangular sunglasses rest casually on top of her head. Small silver earrings and a delicate silver necklace complete the styling.

Hair:
Short black bob with soft wispy curtain bangs, slightly tousled after removing sunglasses. Several loose strands naturally frame her face.

Skin:
Natural fair skin with realistic pores, subtle imperfections, soft highlights, healthy skin tone, believable tonal transitions, and a naturally hydrated glow without excessive retouching.

Lighting:
Soft diffused daylight entering from a large hotel window. Bright natural window light gently wraps around her face, shoulders, and robe, creating realistic shadows, soft ambient bounce light, and authentic fabric detail.

Photography:
Ultra-photorealistic lifestyle editorial photography. Premium DSLR look, 50mm lens, f/2.2, shallow depth of field, authentic skin texture, realistic fabric physics, subtle cinematic color grading, warm neutral tones, premium fashion magazine aesthetic, genuine vacation snapshot, HDR, RAW photo, ultra-detailed, 8K.

Negative Prompt:
plastic skin, beauty filter, distorted anatomy, broken hands, extra fingers, fused limbs, unrealistic body proportions, warped clothing, excessive HDR, oversaturated colors, logos, watermark, text, AI artifacts, anime, illustration, CGI.

prompts.text:
创建一张美丽年轻东亚女性的超写实生活人像。

脸部：
她具有年轻的东亚面孔，带有精巧的心形脸，圆润的脸颊，紧凑的面部比例，轻微内双的杏仁状深棕色眼睛，精致的鼻子，自然的丰唇，瓷白的皮肤，带有真实的毛孔和细微的皮肤纹理，极简的自然妆容，以及带有柔和空气刘海的黑色短波波头。

身体：
娇小的时装模特比例（约160–165厘米），拥有优雅的女性化沙漏型轮廓。她拥有自然的丰满、柔软圆润的胸部，具有真实的重量和比例，纤细清晰的腰部，圆润的臀部曲线，健硕的大腿，窄肩，优雅的长腿，以及符合人体解剖学的真实身体比例。服装应自然地顺着她的轮廓，带有真实的织物张力、垂坠感、拉伸和可信的服装物理效果。

场景：
上午晚些时候，在去过泳池后的一间明亮的现代酒店房间内。房间以温暖的木纹装饰为特色，柔和的中性色墙壁，整洁的床铺，现代家具，以及允许充足自然采光充满房间的大窗户。氛围感觉舒适、高端且富有自然的生活气息。

构图：
自然的4:5垂直肖像。从中腹部到头顶上方的中景特写拍摄。主体占据了画面的大部分，而柔和模糊的酒店房间提供了微妙的环境背景。构图感觉像是一张自发的度假快照，而不是专业的摄影拍摄。

姿势：
她舒适地坐在床边或躺椅附近。一边肩膀略微向相机倾斜。一只手调皮地举过额头的一部分，同时轻轻眨眼。另一只手臂自然地放在长袍下。放松的肩膀，毫不费力的姿态，温暖坦率的肢体语言，以及开朗俏皮的神情。

着装：
一件简约的深酒红色三角比基尼上衣，由优质哑光弹力泳装面料制成，具有稳固、得体的遮盖力和真实的支撑力。一件厚实的白色酒店浴袍松散地滑落至双肩，自然地勾勒出比基尼而不将其完全覆盖。厚实的棉质纹理，真实的褶皱，柔软的面料体积，自然的垂坠感，以及真实的皱褶。黑色长方形墨镜随意地架在她的头顶。精致的小银耳环和一条细银项链完成了造型。

发型：
黑色短波波头，带有柔和的空气刘海，在取下墨镜后略显蓬松。几缕散发自然地修饰着她的脸庞。

皮肤：
自然的白皙皮肤，带有真实的毛孔、细微的瑕疵、柔和的高光、健康的肤色、可信的色调过渡，以及自然的水润光泽，没有过度的修饰。

 lighting：
从酒店大窗户射入的柔和漫射日光。明亮的自然窗光轻轻包裹着她的脸部、肩膀和长袍，营造出真实的阴影、柔和的环境反光和真实的织物细节。

摄影：
超写实的生活方式社论摄影。高级单反质感，50mm镜头，f/2.2，浅景深，真实的皮肤纹理，真实的织物物理效果，微妙的电影级调色，温暖的中性色调，高级时尚杂志美学，真实的度假快照，HDR，RAW照片，超精细，8K。

负面提示词：
塑料感的皮肤，美颜滤镜，畸形的解剖结构，残缺的手，多出的手指，融合的肢体，不真实的身体比例，变形的衣物，过度的HDR，过饱和的颜色，标志，水印，文字，AI伪影，动漫，插画，CGI。

items.title: 真实拳击馆内汗湿少女运动人像

prompts.text: Create an approximately 2:3 vertical sports-fashion portrait inside a genuinely used boxing gym. A clearly adult young woman stands inside the boxing ring, framed from near the top of her head to the middle or upper thighs. Place her in the center, with her torso facing mostly forward, the shoulders and hips slightly uneven and the head gently tilted toward the left side of the image. Both vivid red boxing gloves hang naturally beside her hips and thighs rather than forming an active punching pose. She appears to have just completed a round and paused beside the blue-white ropes to regulate her breathing.  Preserve the small oval-to-heart-shaped face, soft jawline, naturally tapered chin, slim nose bridge, relatively large eyes, original eye spacing, full lip shape and subtle real asymmetry. Retain a small silver hoop on one nostril. She looks directly into the camera with a quiet, composed and faintly appraising gaze carrying traces of post-training fatigue. Keep the lips naturally closed or separated by only a very narrow gap, with nearly level corners and no visible smile.  Use polished makeup associated with contemporary East Asian sports-fashion portraiture and social-media beauty styling: naturally shaped deep-brown brows, rose-brown and gray-pink eyeshadow, fine upper eyeliner, slightly extended outer corners, individually separated long lashes, restrained pink shading and illumination beneath the eyes, subtle highlights on the nose bridge and tip, softly blended cool-pink or rose blush and hydrated nude-pink, rose-beige or pale rose lips. Keep the base fair and softly luminous while retaining slight texture around the nose, under-eyes and cheeks.  Give her natural black to deep chocolate-brown hair that falls around the shoulders, almost center-parted but slightly offset, with light curved strands across the forehead and beside the face. Let one side fall forward along the cheek and shoulder while the other is directed naturally behind the ear. The hair should appear slightly damp from training, with selected strands resting against the forehead, cheeks and neck and producing narrow wet highlights. Preserve flyaways, strand separation and mild flattening rather than dry, voluminous commercial styling.  Her frame is slim yet softly curving, with relaxed shoulders, long arms, a narrow waist and naturally rounded hips and upper thighs. The physique should suggest light fitness and boxing practice rather than exaggerated bodybuilding. Dress her in a light heather-gray triangle sports bra with fine straps, a low V neckline and a broad pale elastic underband. The underband carries repeated black Calvin Klein lettering or an equally clean repeated black sans-serif wordmark. Use soft cotton-blend or stretch-knit fabric with fine texture, slight tonal variation and mildly darker areas beneath the bust and near the center of the cups caused by perspiration.  The bust remains fully covered by the sports bra, while the upper chest and central cleavage remain visible. Preserve natural softness, weight, gravity and slight asymmetry without exaggerating the volume or creating rigid spherical anatomy. Do not reveal nipples, areolae, transparent fabric or wardrobe exposure. Visible skin includes the shoulders, collarbones, upper chest, arms, abdomen, waist, outer hips and upper thighs.  Use black high-waisted short athletic or boxing-training shorts with upward-curving leg openings and pale-gray or white piping along the hips and hems. Keep the fabric soft and mostly matte, with natural horizontal folds at the waistband and abdomen. The shorts must remain opaque and fully cover the hips; do not replace them with underwear, leather hot pants, a thong cut or transparent bottoms.  Her skin is fair warm-neutral ivory, appearing softly peach beneath the frontal light while picking up mild warm-gray and cyan reflections in the shadows. Retain a very thin film of post-exercise perspiration so the skin appears warm, soft, smooth and resilient, as though it would feel only faintly damp or tacky to the touch. Preserve small specular highlights along the shoulders, collarbones, chest, abdomen and upper thighs, along with tiny pores, natural color gradients and believable skin texture. Avoid featureless plastic skin.  Give her a pair of vivid red boxing gloves made from glossy leather or synthetic leather, with pale wrist closures and small blue-red trim. The gloves should differ slightly in orientation, compression and folding. The left-side glove hangs near the outer thigh, while the right-side glove rests closer to the hip and ring rope, its weight naturally lowering the wrist. Do not merge the gloves, make them float or render them as perfectly identical unused props.  Set the scene inside a dark, authentic boxing or mixed-martial-arts gym. Blue-white ring ropes pass horizontally behind the waist and thighs, with selected worn or torn padding revealing small red inner sections. Preserve a clearly visible cyan-blue octagonal softbox in the left background. Include industrial metal ceiling structures, ventilation elements, pipes and warm orange lighting above, along with blurred training equipment, dark architectural framing, a faintly reflective floor and a soft blue gym sign or graffiti-like lettering in the upper-right.  Use the character of a full-frame or APS-C mirrorless camera with an approximately 35 to 50 mm full-frame-equivalent focal length. Position the lens between chest and eye height, photographing from a subtly lower frontal position with only a mild upward angle. Use a large softbox and diffused flash close to the camera and slightly toward the front-left at approximately 4800K to 5600K. Concentrate the light on the face, collarbones, shoulders, upper chest, abdomen and front planes of the thighs. The perspiration should create fine specular highlights across the skin.  Keep warm orange ceiling illumination at approximately 2600K to 3200K in the background, combined with cool cyan reflection from the visible octagonal softbox and selected blue practical lights. The subject should sit roughly two to three stops brighter than the gym, while the ring ropes, equipment, industrial ceiling and practical-light bokeh remain recognizable. Avoid uniformly white studio lighting, aggressive teal-and-orange grading or completely flat illumination.  Use moderately shallow depth of field. Keep the face, damp hair, sports bra, abdomen and gloves generally sharp while allowing the ropes, equipment, signage and architecture to soften progressively. Preserve small amounts of shadow grain, digital denoising, glove compression folds, rope wear, perspiration-darkened fabric and visible practical lighting. Avoid flawless unused advertising imagery or a 3D-rendered appearance.  She has just completed a round. Her shoulders still retain a trace of exertion and the perspiration has not yet dried. A second ago, she was still regulating her breathing. Now she lowers the gloves and pauses beside the ropes, looking into the lens; in the next moment, she may raise her guard and resume training.

prompts.text: 创建一张在真实使用过的拳击馆内拍摄的约 2:3 纵向比例的运动时尚肖像。一名显然已经成年的年轻女性站在拳击台内，画面构图从她的头顶附近一直延伸到大腿中部或上部。将她置于中心，躯干大部分朝前，肩膀和臀部略微不平齐，头部轻轻向图像左侧倾斜。两只鲜红色的拳击手套自然地垂在她臀部和大腿旁，而不是摆出主动出击的姿势。她看起来刚刚完成一个回合，停在蓝白色的绳索旁调节呼吸。保留小巧的椭圆至心形脸、柔和的下颚线、自然变细的下巴、苗条的鼻梁、相对较大的眼睛、原始的眼间距、丰满的唇形和微妙的真实不对称性。在一个鼻翼上保留一个小银环。她以平静、沉着且略带审视的目光直视镜头，带着训练后疲劳的痕迹。保持嘴唇自然闭合或仅有极窄的缝隙，嘴角几乎持平，没有明显的笑意。使用与当代东亚运动时尚肖像和社交媒体美容造型相关的精致妆容：自然形状的深棕色眉毛、玫瑰棕色和灰粉色眼影、细致的上眼线、略微延伸的外眼角、根根分明的长睫毛、眼部下方克制的粉色阴影和提亮、鼻梁和鼻尖的细微高光、柔和晕染的冷粉色或玫瑰色腮红，以及水润的裸粉色、玫瑰米色或淡玫瑰色嘴唇。保持底妆白皙且柔和透亮，同时保留鼻子、眼下和脸颊周围的轻微纹理。给她一头自然黑色到深巧克力棕色的头发，垂在肩膀周围，几乎从中部分开但略有偏移，额头和脸侧有轻微弯曲的发丝。让一侧沿脸颊和肩膀向前垂落，而另一侧自然地塞到耳后。头发应因训练而显得略微潮湿，特定的发丝贴在额头、脸颊和颈部，并产生狭长的湿润高光。保留碎发、发丝的分离和轻微的扁平感，而不是干燥、蓬松的商业造型。她的身形纤细但带有柔和的曲线，肩膀放松，手臂纤长，腰部纤细，臀部和大腿上部自然圆润。体型应暗示轻度的健身和拳击练习，而不是夸张的健身塑形。让她穿着一件浅麻灰色三角形运动内衣，带有细肩带、低 V 领和宽大的浅色弹性底带。底带上印有重复的黑色 Calvin Klein 字样或同样干净的重复黑色无衬线文字标记。使用带有细致纹理的柔软棉混纺或弹力针织面料，在胸部下方和罩杯中心附近有因汗水产生的轻微色调变化和略深区域。胸部仍被运动内衣完全覆盖，而上胸部和中心乳沟保持可见。保留自然的柔软度、重量感、重力和轻微的不对称，不夸张体积或创造僵硬的球形解剖结构。不要展示乳头、乳晕、透明面料或走光。可见的皮肤包括肩膀、锁骨、上胸部、手臂、腹部、腰部、外胯部和大腿上部。穿着黑色高腰短款运动或拳击训练短裤，裤腿开口向上弯曲，臀部和下摆边缘有浅灰色或白色的滚边。保持面料柔软且大部分为哑光，腰带和腹部有自然的水平褶皱。短裤必须保持不透明并完全覆盖臀部；不要用内衣、皮革热裤、丁字裤剪裁或透明裤装代替。她的皮肤是白皙的暖中性象牙色，在正面光线下显得柔和的桃色，而在阴影中带有轻微的暖灰色和青色反射。保留一层极薄的运动后汗水薄膜，使皮肤看起来温暖、柔软、光滑且有弹性，仿佛摸上去只有轻微的湿润或粘稠感。保留肩膀、锁骨、胸部、腹部和大腿上部的小的高光，以及微小的毛孔、自然的色彩渐变和可信的皮肤纹理。避免没有特征的塑料感皮肤。给她一副由亮面皮革或合成皮革制成的鲜红色拳击手套，带有浅色腕部封口和微小的蓝红饰边。手套在朝向、压缩和折叠上应略有不同。左侧手套垂在大腿外侧附近，而右侧手套靠在臀部和围绳旁，其重量使腕部自然下垂。不要合并手套，不要让它们漂浮，也不要将它们渲染成完全相同且未使用的道具。场景设置在一个黑暗、真实的拳击或综合格斗健身房内。蓝白色的拳击台围绳横向穿过腰部和大腿后方，部分磨损或撕裂的衬垫露出了微小的红色内部。在左后方保留一个清晰可见的青蓝色八角形柔光箱。包括工业金属天花板结构、通风元件、管道和上方的暖橙色照明，以及模糊的训练设备、深色的建筑框架、略带反光的地板和右上方柔和的蓝色健身房标志或类似涂鸦的文字。使用全画幅或 APS-C 无反相机的特性，等效全画幅焦距约为 35 至 50 毫米。将镜头置于胸部和眼睛高度之间，从略低的正面位置拍摄，仅有轻微的向上角度。在相机附近且偏向左前方使用大型柔光箱和漫射闪光灯，色温约为 4800K 至 5600K。将光线集中在脸部、锁骨、肩膀、上胸部、腹部和大腿的前平面。汗水应在皮肤上产生细微的高光。在背景中保持约 2600K 至 3200K 的暖橙色天花板照明，结合来自可见八角形柔光箱和特定蓝色实用灯光的冷青色反射。主体应比健身房亮度高出大约两到三档，而围绳、设备、工业天花板和实用灯光的虚化仍应可辨认。避免均匀的白色摄影棚照明、激进的青橙色调色或完全平坦的照明。使用中等浅景深。保持脸部、湿发、运动内衣、腹部和手套大致清晰，同时允许围绳、设备、标识和建筑逐渐变软。保留少量的阴影颗粒、数字降噪、手套压缩褶皱、围绳磨损、被汗水打湿变深的面料和可见的实用照明。避免完美无瑕的未使用过的广告图像或 3D 渲染外观。她刚刚完成一个回合。她的肩膀仍留有一丝用力的痕迹，汗水尚未干透。一秒钟前，她还在调节呼吸。现在她放下手套，在围绳旁停下，直视镜头；下一刻，她可能会举起防守姿势并恢复训练。

items.title: 城市元素清晨问候视觉艺术海报

prompts.text: Build a morning greeting-style visual around any theme: first transform the theme's semantics into a core carrier with a forward direction, placed in the lower-middle to right part of the frame, retaining a clear large outline and a few key details, while using slow shutter panning to create intense horizontal trailing shadows, edge splitting, and an air-wiping sensation; the movement direction is from the bottom left to the top right, with the light-receiving side forming a soft, bright outline and local warm glow, allowing the emotion of "moving towards the light" to be perceived before the specific object. Keep the upper part open, clean, and continuous high-brightness white space as a breathing area for large characters; the lower part uses low-angle environment, dark foreground, and slightly blurred textures to bear weight, with distant outlines softened, and the core carrier partially merging with the background in motion blur, yet the visual focus remains on the bright area to the right. 豪华夜晚时尚人像。成年东亚女性，25岁以上，坐于现代高层公寓内浅灰色软垫窗台长椅上，俯瞰发光的城市天际线。略偏左——右侧保留宽裕空间用于落地窗、深蓝夜空与柔焦虚化的城市灯光。从大腿中部至头顶略上方，四分之三坐姿构图，约平视高度，轻微电影感视角。

姿态：斜坐于椅上，躯干挺立但略微向后倚靠。右手在她身后撑于靠垫上，手指自然伸展。左手轻柔上抬朝向锁骨，仿佛轻触其中一条项链。髋部朝向左下角——一条大腿向前景延伸，另一条腿自然弯曲沿座椅放置。双肩放松，被服装的露肩领口裸露。头部向左肩轻柔倾斜，直视镜头——端庄、低调自信、嘴唇微微张开、平静亲密的眼神接触。

发型：丰盈刻意凌乱的高发髻——宽松卷发与碎发卷丝框住面颊、额头、太阳穴与颈部。几缕细腻发丝自然垂落于面部一侧。真实单根发丝，光泽高光，深邃阴影细节，轻微动感；非僵硬正式发型。

妆容：精致晚间美妆——发光白皙肌肤，真实毛孔与色调变化。柔和眉形，精致烟熏棕眼线，长浓密睫毛，颧骨下方轻微修容，克制玫桃腮红，亮泽低调粉裸唇色。自然面部比例；无过度磨皮或娃娃脸感。

服装：优雅白色露肩两件套晚装——轻盈半透明雪纺叠穿于不透明衬里之上，端庄遮盖。短款上衣：弹性聚拢领口水平横贯双肩，前臂处有密集缩皱的长半透明袖，躯干柔和垂坠，裙摆止于腰部上方露出一小段端庄腹部。合身白色裹身式迷你裙：分层对角线垂坠，髋部柔和聚拢，雕塑感折叠前面板，高度不对称开叉，安全非露骨遮盖。面料：真实透明度，精细编织，轻微光泽，分层褶皱，夜晚冷蓝色反光。

珠宝：大型光亮金色圆环耳环。多条长度不一的精致分层金色项链——一条贴近颈部的精致星形或十字感链条，一条长吊坠链垂落于上衣前方。手腕处叠戴金色手链。多只细身金戒指。精致有细节的珠宝，小高光与冷色环境形成对比。短至中等长度指甲配干净浅裸色美甲。

场景：精致当代公寓或豪华酒店套房，夜晚。大型深框落地窗：远下方高层建筑，散布的发光窗户，蓝色/青色/白色/紫色/偶有红色光点，全部被浅景深化为奶油圆形焦外光斑。室内极简：深色墙板，浅灰色椅子，冷色反光玻璃，细腻建筑阴影。最左侧有隐约虚化的前景边缘——如同透过窗帘、柱子或附近家具拍摄形成的纵深感。

光线：低调、电影感、以冷色为主。来自背后与右侧的柔和蓝色月光或城市光晕——发髻、肩膀、下颌线、袖子、珠宝与身体廓形周围有精致轮廓光。来自左前方的轻微漫射美妆补光，在不破坏夜晚氛围的情况下呈现眼睛、嘴唇、肌肤与白色面料。房间中有深海军蓝与炭灰阴影，颧骨与锁骨的柔和高光，轻柔下颌阴影，真实窗面反光。白色服装保留细节而不过曝或夹断。

相机：85mm，f/1.8，眼睛与面部锐利对焦，顺滑背景焦外，真实低光动态范围，轻微胶片颗粒，高对比配受控高光，鲜艳冷蓝色调与暖色肌肤及金色珠宝平衡，精致奢感色调，准确人体比例，真实手部，精细雪纺质感。

负面：无文字、无水印、无Logo、无多余人物、无变形人体、无重复肢体或手指、无塑料感肌肤、无卡通感、无强直射闪光、无过度虚化、无露骨裸露。

items.title: 向天空伸展双腿的时尚女性摄影

prompts.text:
Topic:
Legs stretching toward the sky

Subject:
A fictional adult female crouching low on a glossy roof terrace against a clear sky background, 9:16 vertical fashion photograph. The figure is prominently positioned from the center-right of the frame, with the whole body occupying about 80% of the screen. Most prominently displaying one leg stretched forward and black high-heeled shoes, with the other leg bent backward, the upper body, and the blue sky where the gaze flows.

Character/Expression:
A natural and elegant adult woman. Has a three-dimensional physique like a mature woman, with a slender waist, long legs, and soft body curves. Dark brown hair loosely tied low, with long thin strands of hair left by the cheeks. Pale coral blush, exquisite eye makeup, natural glossy pink-beige lips. The face is turned toward the bottom left of the frame, the gaze quietly falling at her feet. A slight smile appears at the corners of the mouth.

Clothing/Pose:
Deep V-neck long-sleeved cardigan top made of ivory-white fine ribbed fabric. The chest naturally reveals female curves, clearly showing the overlapping and subtle folds of the fabric. Black high-waisted shorts, glossy black pointed-toe high heels. Wearing a rounded ivory-colored beret without a logo on her head. The figure's left fingers are spread out to support on the ground, and the right hand lightly touches the hair at the back of the head. One knee is raised near the chest, the other leg is folded inward, and the center of gravity is supported by the waist and the hand on the ground. Natural depiction of the contact between the shoe sole and the ground, and fingertips and the ground.

Background/Lighting:
The background is a vibrant cobalt blue sky and white cumulus clouds without buildings or signs. The ground is a light gray polished marble pattern panel, reflecting the sky, the person's hands, shoes, and light shadows of the legs. The sun shines from a high position in the upper left of the frame, forming strong white highlights on the shoulders, collarbones, arms, and the front of the legs. The character's shadow stretches toward the bottom right of the frame, and the patent leather surface of the shoes finely reflects the blue sky and white light. The air is dry and transparent, evoking the feeling of intense midsummer sunshine.

Composition/Lens:
9:16 vertical composition. An ultra-low angle looking up from close to the ground, equivalent to a 24-28mm wide-angle feel. A perspective method that enlarges the nearby pumps and legs, making the face and upper body appear slightly smaller. Leave about 20% blue sky negative space above the person's head, and ensure the tips of the shoes are not cropped at the bottom edge of the frame. Precisely focus on the face and upper body, while making the outlines of the nearby shoes clearly visible. Background clouds are slightly soft and blurred.

Texture/Style:
Bright, clean, realistic photos evoking a summer fashion magazine. Precise depiction of natural skin texture, the three-dimensionality of collarbones and knees, fine vellus hair, the ribbed texture of clothing, ground reflections, and the gloss of patent leather. Dominated by white, black, and blue, maintaining high transparency and moderate contrast. Avoid excessive skin smoothing or artificial gloss, creating a texture like a real outdoor shoot.

Negative Prompt:
Seemingly underage characters, unnatural facial features, extra fingers, missing fingers, merged hands and feet, collapsed joints, distorted legs, poor contact between shoes and feet, floating, unnatural gravity, wrong gravity direction, wrong perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, text, logo, watermark.

prompts.text:
主题：
向天空伸展的双腿

主体：
以晴朗天空为背景，在光泽的屋顶露台上低矮蹲坐的虚构成年女性，9:16纵向时尚照片。人物从画面中央偏右处大幅配置，全身占据画面约8成。最突出地展示向前伸展的一侧腿和黑色高跟鞋，另一侧腿向后弯曲，上半身，以及视线流向的蓝天构成。

人物·表情：
自然而优雅的成年女性。拥有成熟女性般的立体体型，纤细腰肢、修长双腿、柔和的身体曲线。深棕色头发在低位松散扎起，脸颊旁留有细长的后发丝。淡珊瑚色腮红、精致的眼妆、自然光泽的粉米色唇部。脸庞转向画面左下方，视线静静落在脚边。嘴角浮现一丝细微的微笑。

服装·姿势：
象牙白色细肋织物制成的深V领长袖开衫上衣。胸口自然显露女性曲线，明确展现布料的重叠与细微褶皱。黑色高腰短裤，光泽的黑色尖头高跟鞋。头上戴着无logo的圆润象牙色贝雷帽。人物左手手指张开撑在地面，右手轻触后脑部的头发。一侧膝盖抬起至胸口附近，另一侧腿向内折叠，重心由腰部和撑地的手支撑。自然描绘鞋底与地面、指尖与地面的接触。

背景·光线：
背景是无建筑物或标牌的鲜艳钴蓝色天空与白色积云。地面为浅灰色抛光大理石纹面板，反射出天空、人物的手、鞋子、腿部淡影。太阳从画面左上方高位照射，在肩部、锁骨、臂部、腿部前侧形成强烈的白色高光。人物的影子向画面右下方拉长，鞋子的漆皮表面细细映入蓝天与白光。空气干燥而富有透明感，唤起盛夏强烈日照的感觉。

构图·镜头：
9:16纵向构图。从地面贴近的超低位置仰视的低角度，相当于24〜28mm广角感。将近处的泵鞋和腿部放大，脸部和上半身稍显小巧的透视法。在人物头顶留约2成蓝天余白，画面下端确保鞋尖不被裁切。精确对焦脸部和上半身，同时使近处的鞋子轮廓清晰可见。背景云朵略微柔和虚化。

质感·风格：

She has a very exquisite and beautiful Asian face: a soft oval face, a clear jawline, slender dark eyebrows, bright almond-shaped eyes, a straight small nose, and naturally full light pink lips; her makeup is refined but not excessive, and her expression is calm, confident, and noble, looking directly into the camera. She has voluminous long platinum blonde curly hair, parted in the middle, with curls on both sides falling naturally in front of her shoulders. The character has a tall and athletic build, a clear waistline, a beautiful bust-waist-hip ratio, and long, powerful legs. She wears a deep blue tight-fitting superhero bodysuit, the fabric featuring fine repeating wing-patterned dark textures and a realistic elastic fabric texture; a red stand-up collar with gold embroidery, gold armor decorations on the shoulders, and a wide gold belt with an eagle-shaped emblem at the waist. Both arms wear long red gloves, with exquisite gold-carved bracers on the forearms; on her feet are red over-the-knee hero boots with gold eagle decorations at the knees. Behind her is a long red and white vertical striped cape reaching down to her calves, gently blown open by the breeze. She stands firmly with her legs naturally apart, one hand in a red glove on her hip and the other hand hanging down naturally, shoulders back, presenting a powerful yet composed hero pose. Shot from a slightly low angle, the full character from head to toe is in the frame, centered, with natural body proportions, do not crop the shoes. The background is an empty rooftop parking lot, dark gray asphalt ground, low walls, blurred city buildings and power towers in the distance, with a large area of gray-white clouds left above. Cloudy day soft light, realistic skin texture, clear clothing seams and fabric details, a slight mobile phone wide-angle feel, low saturation cinematic tones, realistic photography, no anime style, plastic skin, exaggerated body, deformed hands or feet, text, logos, or watermarks.

prompts.text:
生成一张 9:16 比例的超写实真人全身照片。一位二十多岁的东亚美女扮演原创女性超级英雄，站在阴天的城市楼顶停车场。她拥有非常精致漂亮的亚洲面孔：柔和鹅蛋脸、清晰下颌线、细长深色眉毛、明亮的杏仁形眼睛、挺直小巧的鼻子和自然饱满的淡粉色嘴唇；妆容精致但不过度，神情冷静、自信、高贵，直视镜头。她留着蓬松的铂金色长卷发，中分，两侧卷发自然垂落在肩前。

人物身材高挑健美，腰线清晰，胸腰臀比例优美，双腿修长有力量。她穿深蓝色紧身超级英雄连体战衣，面料带有细密的重复羽翼暗纹和真实弹力织物质感；红色立领带金色刺绣，肩部有金色装甲装饰，腰间佩戴宽大的金色腰带和鹰形徽章。双臂戴红色长手套，前臂带精致金色雕纹护腕；脚穿红色过膝英雄长靴，膝盖位置有金色鹰形装饰。背后是一件垂到小腿的红白竖条纹长披风，被微风轻轻吹开。

她双腿自然分开稳稳站立，一只手戴着红色手套叉在腰间，另一只手自然垂下，肩膀打开，呈现强大又从容的英雄姿态。使用略低机位拍摄，人物完整从头到脚入镜，位于画面中央，身体比例自然，不要裁切鞋子。

背景是空旷的楼顶停车场，深灰色沥青地面、低矮围墙、远处模糊的城市建筑和输电铁塔，上方留出大面积灰白色云层。阴天柔光，真实皮肤纹理，服装缝线和织物细节清晰，轻微手机广角感，低饱和电影色调，写实摄影，不要动漫感、塑料皮肤、夸张身材、畸形手脚、文字、标志和水印。

prompts.text:
Direction: SNS-oriented smartphone snapshot that looks like it was taken of a real person. A fictional adult female in her early 20s. A moment of stretching the back while tidying hair in a semi-outdoor corridor of modern architecture, set as being taken by a friend from a close distance. Includes slight softening effects unique to smartphone computational photography, perspective from a close-range wide angle, natural HDR, and a slight sense of compression after SNS posting.
Shooting reason: On the way walking, the character stops, one hand reaches behind the head to tidy hair, while stretching shoulders and back. Because the photographer took it hurriedly from a slightly low posture, it results in a diagonal composition, partial cropping, and a slight tilt.
Mood: Urban, unpretentious everyday feel. Light air of a summer afternoon where warm sunlight and reflections from blue buildings intertwine. Not a posed photo, but an impression of a moment accidentally captured mid-action.
Model: A fictional adult female in her early 20s who does not look like a real person or a celebrity. Overall a well-proportioned, slightly slender build; even when wearing clothes, a full bust volume equivalent to a G-cup can be seen. Does not extremely emphasize the chest, but naturally connects with shoulder width, ribcage, waist, and pelvis, presenting a realistic physique.
Face: Head is near the upper part of the frame, partially obscured due to the backward tilting angle and the raised arm. Wearing a white non-woven mask, the mouth is not visible. Eye gaze or front-facing expressions are not clearly generated, controlling the amount of facial information to a moderate level.
Hair: Deep black or dark brown hair tied back behind the head. Due to the action of tidying hair, a small amount of scattered strands fly around the ears and the nape of the neck. Only the ends of the hair exposed to sunlight produce uneven warm-colored light transmission.
Body: Body leaning slightly backward, upper body twisted slightly to the right. Head tilted back, chin slightly raised. One arm bent and placed behind the head, the opposite shoulder slightly lowered. Chest has a natural weight feel equivalent to a G-cup, changing position above the ribcage along with the backward leaning motion. Reflects left-right differences, gravity, and clothing support, not made into a spherical or unnaturally uplifted shape.
Body_balance: Maintains a natural ribcage and shoulder area matching the full chest, does not make the waist abnormally thin. Consistency in human structure for torso thickness, back, ribs, and arm roots. Close-range wide angle makes the foreground upper body slightly enlarged, but controlled within a realistic range.
Skin: Warm ivory-toned skin. Retains subtle pores and natural color variations on arms, neck, and waist. Smartphone skin retouching brings slight smoothing, but does not completely eliminate texture. Sunlight from the upper right generates soft cream-colored highlights on arms, shoulders, above chest clothing, and convex surfaces of the waist, gradually transitioning to soft shadows on the sides.
Outfit: Black cropped crew neck printed T-shirt. Cotton blend knit material of everyday thickness, non-transparent and low-exposure style. Due to the full chest, the front fabric naturally bulges forward, falling softly from below the chest to the waist. Neckline is not excessively open, not showing chest cleavage. Lifting the arm causes diagonal and vertical tension in the shoulders, armpits, back, and side waist, with fine horizontal lines and radial folds appearing in the fabric. The hem is slightly lifted unevenly on the left and right. From the back to the side, a part of a low-key manga-style print in warm brown, light blue, and black can be seen.
Lower_outfit: Light gray-blue thin loose jeans. Waist position is slightly low, producing soft folds caused by gravity near the waistline and the base of the legs. A cropped brown wrap-style decorative skirt is layered over the jeans, naturally cropped in part at the bottom of the frame. Clothing covers a sufficient range, not showing underwear or the inside of clothes.
Accessories: A thin silver waist chain hangs loosely along the curve of the waist. The chain follows gravity, partially touching the clothes and partially floating a few millimeters. Cold white reflections appear in only a few places, glowing unevenly.
Scene_objects: A modern architectural space composed of blue glass panels, a translucent canopy, rice-gray walls, dark gray pillars, and beams. Blurred edges of signboards, metal handrails, and wall joints are retained in the distance. Not excessively tidied for photography, maintaining the lived-in feel of a commonly used public space.
Pose: Close-up wide-angle shot from a slightly low waist position looking up. The person is in the middle of tidying hair and stretching, with asymmetrical shoulder heights, arm angles, and waist positions. The upper body forms a diagonal line from bottom-left to top-right. The chest is presented naturally as part of the overall body balance, not made into a close-up with only the chest in the center.
Lighting: Real natural light from the upper right. Color temperature is slightly warm, with cold ambient light reflected back from blue glass or the canopy. Bright highlights appear on arms, shoulders, tightened parts of the black T-shirt, and the waist. The white mask part is slightly overexposed, and shadows of the black clothes blend with the brightening of smartphone HDR. Does not use uniform lighting like a commercial shoot.
Effect: Slight skin retouching, local contrast processing, soft highlight performance, and light HDR brought by smartphone computational photography. Foreground person is relatively clear, but background has slight blurring caused by handheld shooting and SNS compression. Outlines retain slight sharpening marks, avoiding an excessive high-resolution feel.
Camera: Vertical 9:16 smartphone photo. Approximately 24mm equivalent wide-angle main camera, shooting distance 0.8 to 1 meter, tilted upwards about 25 to 35 degrees from a slightly low waist position. ISO 80 to 160, shutter speed about 1/200 second, smartphone auto-exposure, warm-toned auto white balance. Close-range upper body and waist area produce moderate wide-angle stretching, but do not unrealistically deform chest or waist size.
Imperfections: Composition is tilted by about 1 degree, with little headspace above the head, and raised arms and hair parts are close to the edges of the frame. T-shirt tension and hem lift are different on the left and right. Fabric folds on the chest are also not completely symmetrical, with one side exerting slightly stronger tension. Mask ear straps, messy hair, hanging waist chain, and jeans folds retain natural non-uniformity. Small amounts of color noise and JPEG compression are added to dark areas.
Background: Blue glass or canopy on the left and top occupy about 25% of the frame, rice-gray wall surface on the upper right occupies about 20%, and dark gray structures at the bottom enter with low visual weight. The background is not completely strongly blurred, but limited to a slight degree of softening where architectural shapes and materials can be identified.
Atmosphere: Contrast between warm skin tones and black clothes with cold blue buildings. Medium saturation, low to medium contrast. An atmosphere like a photo posted directly to SNS after adjusting only a little brightness on a smartphone immediately after shooting.
Composition: The person occupies about 80% of the frame. The main composition axis is centered near the torso, including shoulders, arms, head, waist, and background. The upper body forms a diagonal composition from bottom-left to top-right. The chest, equivalent to a G-cup, is identifiable as the natural three-dimensional feel of the black T-shirt, but avoiding cropping or unnatural emphasis that makes only the chest the main subject.
Negative: People who look like minors, student uniforms, faces that look like real people or celebrities, close-ups of only the chest, extreme chest exaggeration, spherical breasts, unnatural chest positions, high-exposure clothes, see-through clothes, deep cleavage, exposed underwear, inside of clothes, peeping perspective, extreme low angles, unrealistically thin waist, broken bone structure, extra arms or fingers, plastic skin, excessive skin beautification, commercial photo lighting, too strong background blur, extreme retouching, unreadable random text.
Watermark_direction: Not like text pasted on later, but naturally integrated into the photo as reflections or surface marks existing in the background from the time of shooting.
Watermark_text: @Live_life_style
Integration_method: Through slender reflected light falling on the rice-gray wall on the upper right, or thin wipe marks remaining on the blue glass on the upper left, the character string @Live_life_style is faintly formed. Not a completely uniform font, with some lines slightly missing at light or glass joints.
Subtle_visibility: Usually looks like environmental reflections when displayed, with the degree that @Live_life_style can be read only by slightly enlarging the image. Not more conspicuous than the person or clothes, controlled at about 15% of the background contrast.
Placement: Not superimposed on the person's face, chest, skin, waist, or body silhouette. The first candidate is the empty part of the rice-gray wall on the upper right, arranging the character string horizontally on a small scale. The second candidate is weak reflections along the edge of the blue glass on the upper left.
Material_behavior: On the wall surface, make the text outline uneven through fine irregularities; on the glass, form text lines through water wipe marks, thin mist, or reflected light. The underscore part is also not made into a straight digital line, but expressed as a continuous slender reflection.
Lighting_interaction: Giving light and dark in the same direction as the natural light coming from the upper right. Bright surfaces appear thin milky white, and on blue glass, they appear light cold white. Like the photo as a whole, it is subject to SNS compression and smartphone HDR processing, with outline parts slightly blurred.
Text_accuracy: Maintain the uppercase, lowercase, and underscores of @Live_life_style as much as possible. But do not make it as vivid as digital subtitles, prioritizing the degree to which it is readable as a natural environmental element.
Avoid: Placement on the person's body, placement on the chest, large central logos, strong luminescence, solid white text, uniform opacity, black outlines, sticker expressions, floating text, a post-pasted feel separated from the background, other random character strings.

items.title: 旧报纸头版插画风格城市早安文化

prompts.text:
Generate a set of old newspaper front-page visuals around any subject: The overall appearance first resembles a full-page report from a local newspaper, dominated by light warm white newsprint. Thin black wireframes, narrow column body text, a top masthead, dense vertical or horizontal columns on the left and right, and a strip of small grid advertisements at the bottom together establish the reading order; then, huge flat illustrations derived from the theme suddenly break into the layout center and between columns. Several irregular circular, elongated, or leaf-like outlines overwhelm the text at a naive scale, with edges showing slight registration shifts and paper ink absorption, simplified to just clear shapes, a few lines, and pairs of small round eyes, turning a serious newspaper into a friendly public notice. The core headline uses heavy black Mincho-style typeface, with tight letter spacing and stable line spacing, placed below or beside the illustration to create a strong pause; subheadings and body text maintain the high-density gray-black text blocks of real newspapers, with small documentary photos and thin-bordered Q&A columns embedded locally, but do not let the photos take away the layout center. Colors are derived from the theme itself, controlled to the newsprint base color, black-gray text, two to three high-saturation spot color large block illustrations, and a few low-saturation auxiliary colors: large color blocks are bright and clean but with printing grain, locally revealing paper fibers, slight stains, creases, scanning yellowing, and uneven ink. Aging mainly occurs on the paper, the edges of black characters, and inside solid color blocks, without uniform brown dirtying. The layout allows for crowding, scattering, and slight misalignment, preserving child-like round-eye humor, the simple credibility of local news, and reading interruptions caused by illustrations interspersed with text; avoid modern magazine whitespace, smooth vectors, commercial studio textures, and overly exquisite typography.

items.title: 三连休首日的居家懒散SNS快照

prompts.text:
Direction: Afternoon on the first day of a three-day holiday, no schedule, a day of complete relaxation at home, like a non-performative, life-heavy SNS snapshot taken casually by a friend with a smartphone. Not a glamorous holiday, but a time of motionlessness on the sofa, deliberately ignoring work contacts, switching between video streaming and SNS.
Mood: Liberation of the first day of a holiday, a bit of guilt, sleepiness, listlessness. The person is unaware of being filmed, the TV show is playing, staring blankly at the smartphone. Not smiling happily, but a defenseless and calm expression with the corners of the mouth slightly relaxed.
Model: A fictional adult Japanese woman in her late 20s. Unlike a real person or celebrity, with a friendly and natural atmosphere. A healthy and soft physique, but not exaggerating or highlighting specific body parts.
Face: Thin daily makeup in a state of slightly falling off. Left and right eyelids are slightly different, natural eyebrows, not too dry lips. Not looking at the camera, but eyes falling on the smartphone screen in hand.
Hair: Medium-long hair from black to dark brown, unstyled for the holiday. Because of lying down, the back of the head is a bit flat, with a few strands of hair hanging near the cheeks. The ends of the hair have slight sleep creases and static electricity.
Body: Lying on her side on the sofa, a natural posture leaning against cushions. One leg is slightly bent, and the other leg is stretched toward the edge of the sofa. Shoulders and waist are not completely horizontal, and the body sinks into the cushions following gravity.
Skin: Natural skin without excessive skin beautification. Subtle textures on the cheeks and arms, natural color differences around the elbows and knees, and soft shadows brought by indoor lighting. Not made into uniform porcelain skin.
Outfit: Charcoal gray very loose camisole long vest. The armpit part is wide, oversized design with fabric hanging from the body, but naturally covered within the range required for daily wear. Inside is an inconspicuous soft indoor bra with cups. The bottoms are short but modestly exposed black casual shorts. Cotton fabric washed many times, with natural folds and wrinkles around the hem and shoulders.
Accessories: Almost no accessories. A thin black hair tie on the left wrist. Nails are short, nearly transparent nail polish is somewhat peeling.
Scene objects: A TV drama with subtitles is playing on the TV, but the content is indistinguishable. Beside the sofa are opened carbonated water, a bag of potato chips, a charging cable, and a TV remote. On the coffee table are half-drunk iced coffee, a tissue box, and a work smartphone face down.
Pose: Holding a private smartphone in the right hand, held below the face, slowly scrolling the screen with only the thumb. The left arm is half-buried between the cushion and the body. The neck is slightly forward, and the shoulders are completely relaxed. A moment of not turning the head even if called by the person filming.
Lighting: Natural light from an overcast day coming through half-drawn curtains, mixed with the faint bluish-white light from the TV screen. The cheek and arm on the window side are slightly brighter, and there are thin shadows on the sofa side. The whole room is not evenly illuminated, a bit like the drowsy brightness of a holiday afternoon.
Effect: A smartphone photo with weak processing. Slight noise in the dark areas, slight overexposure around the white curtains, and tiny motion blur on the hair and fingertips. A slight sense of JPEG compression when posting on SNS. Low-saturated tones, mainly life tones of gray, beige, and black.
Camera: Standard wide-angle lens of an ordinary smartphone, vertical 4:5. The photographer shoots from about 1.5 meters away diagonally in front of the sofa at standing eye level, not a position close to the floor. Not just a close-up of the character, but a distance where you can see the sofa, TV, and scattered table. The background also has some focus, without strong portrait mode or extreme blur.
Imperfections: Composition with the horizon tilted by about two degrees, one side of the cushion is deflated, the camisole straps are slightly offset left and right, tiny hairballs on the sofa, faint cup marks on the table, and the charging cable is irregularly bent. Expressions, poses, and clothes are not made perfectly symmetrical.
Background: A very ordinary Japanese rental apartment living room. Ivory walls, low TV stand, curtains that don't quite fit the size, a small potted plant in the corner, and a stacked blanket by the wall. The work bag is still thrown on the floor, but the whole room is not made extremely messy.
Atmosphere: A quiet interior with only the sound of the TV echoing. No plans to go out, an afternoon with a blurred sense of time. Because of the decision 'I won't do anything today', both the body and the room are slightly relaxed.
Composition: The person is slightly to the right of the center of the screen, the TV is in the back left, and a low table is in the front. The back of the sofa and the extended legs form a diagonal line. Not a close-up emphasizing clothes or body parts, but an environmental portrait conveying the entire holiday situation. Retaining a sense of white space and being cut off halfway like an accidental shot.
Negative: Expressions that look like minors, student-style clothing, explicit exposure, composition focused on underwear, close-ups emphasizing specific body parts, excessive low angles, provocative poses, unrealistic body proportions, excessive skin beautification, doll-like faces, plastic-like skin, perfect lighting like a commercial shoot, extreme background blur, faces like real people or celebrities, garbled text, extra fingers or limbs.

Colors are derived from the theme itself, controlled to the newsprint base color, black and gray text, two to three high-saturation spot color large illustration blocks, and a small amount of low-saturation auxiliary colors: large color blocks are bright and clean but with printing grain, locally revealing paper fibers, slight stains, creases, scanning yellowing, and uneven ink; aging mainly occurs on the paper, black text edges, and inside solid color blocks, without uniform brown dirtying. The layout allows for crowding, staggering, and slight misalignment, retaining child-painting-like round-eye humor, the simple credibility of local news, and the reading interruption caused by illustrations interspersed with text; avoid modern magazine whitespace, smooth vectors, commercial studio textures, and overly refined typography. 一张没有任何设计感的 iPhone 16 Pro 高清抓拍照片，真实手机摄影质感，竖版 9:16，85mm 人像镜头，浅景深，自然构图。暖黄色宫灯与窗外月光共同形成真实混合光源，局部高光略微过曝，画面边缘带有极轻微运动模糊，人物肤色白皙通透，衣料纹理、发丝、刺绣细节极其丰富，整体呈现电影级古风纪录片摄影风格，空灵、静谧、高级、真实，没有 AI 感。

左下方标注繁体中文书法签名浮水印（极细宋徽宗瘦金体风格）：「藍心｜藍心 AI」。水印需自然融入背景，不突兀，不破坏画面完整性。

prompts.text: Create a premium vertical 2:3 collectible travel bookmark featuring {destination}. The bookmark has realistic paper thickness, soft embossed texture, smooth rounded edges, and a centered punch hole with a short braided tassel whose colors are inspired by {PARIS}. Add soft natural shadows to make it feel like a real handcrafted souvenir. The upper two-thirds of the bookmark showcases a breathtaking layered papercraft diorama of {PARIS}, highlighting its most iconic landmarks, landscapes, architecture, flora, and cultural elements. Build the scene using stacked paper layers with visible cut edges, realistic paper textures, dimensional shadows, and rich handcrafted detail. The scene should immediately evoke the destination while remaining elegant and uncluttered. Use a vibrant destination-inspired color palette while maintaining a premium handcrafted aesthetic. At the top, use large hand-painted brush lettering similar to a modern travel poster. Headline: EXPLORE {PARIS} Below the title, include a short travel-inspired tagline (6–10 words) that captures the spirit of the destination. The lower third transitions into a soft ivory panel with subtle cultural decorative accents inspired by {PARIS}. Section title: YOUR {PARIS} EXPERIENCE Include three premium 3D clay miniature cards with rounded corners and soft shadows representing: Iconic Landmarks Nature & Scenic Beauty Local Cuisine or Culture Each clay miniature should have a handcrafted matte finish with charming proportions and vibrant colors. Add a large rounded call-to-action button reading: START EXPLORING Decorate the bookmark subtly using motifs inspired by {PARIS}, such as geometric borders, traditional patterns, native flowers, leaves, waves, symbols, or architectural details. Keep these accents elegant and minimal. The overall style should feel like a luxury travel keepsake, combining: layered papercraft premium 3D clay miniatures handcrafted paper textures soft natural lighting realistic shadows collectible souvenir aesthetic warm studio photography highly detailed vibrant whimsical yet sophisticated ultra-realistic 8K quality Avoid mobile app UI elements, device frames, navigation icons, hearts, menus, or interface buttons. The final composition should look like a premium handcrafted bookmark photographed on a tabletop, suitable for a luxury travel collection.

prompts.text: 创建一个以 {destination} 为主题的高端竖向 2:3 比例收藏级旅行书签。书签应为长条形、圆角的卡纸书签，以 7° 顺时针微小角度放置在温暖的奶油色纹理背景上，并留有大量的留白。书签具有真实的纸张厚度、柔软的压花纹理、光滑的圆角边缘，中心有一个打孔，带有一根短编织流苏，流苏颜色灵感来自 {PARIS}。添加柔和的自然阴影，使其感觉像是一件真实的手工纪念品。书签的上三分之二展示了 {PARIS} 的壮丽层叠纸雕透视模型，突出其最具标志性的地标、景观、建筑、植物和文化元素。使用堆叠的纸层构建场景，具有可见的切割边缘、真实的纸张纹理、立体阴影和丰富的手工细节。场景应立即唤起对目的地的联想，同时保持优雅且不凌乱。使用充满活力的目的地灵感色调，同时保持高端手工审美。在顶部，使用类似于现代旅行海报的大型手绘毛笔字体。标题：EXPLORE {PARIS} 下方包含一段简短的旅行灵感标语（6–10 个单词），捕捉目的地的精神。下三分之一过渡到柔和的象牙色面板，带有受 {PARIS} 启发的细微文化装饰元素。板块标题：YOUR {PARIS} EXPERIENCE 包含三张具有圆角和柔和阴影的高端 3D 黏土微型卡片，分别代表：标志性地标、自然与风景美景、当地美食或文化。每个黏土微缩模型都应具有手工磨砂饰面，比例迷人且色彩鲜艳。添加一个大的圆角呼吁行动按钮，上面写着：START EXPLORING。使用受 {PARIS} 启发的图案微调书签，如几何边框、传统图案、原生花卉、叶子、波浪、符号或建筑细节。保持这些装饰优雅且简约。整体风格应感觉像一件奢华的旅行纪念品，结合了：层叠纸雕、高端 3D 黏土微缩模型、手工纸张纹理、柔和的自然光、真实的阴影、收藏级纪念品美学、温暖的摄影棚摄影、细节丰富、奇幻而精致、超真实 8K 质量。避免移动应用程序 UI 元素、设备框架、导航图标、爱心、菜单或界面按钮。最终构图应看起来像是一枚在桌面上拍摄的高端手工书签，适合奢华旅行收藏。

items.title: 纯果乐生活方式徽标创意广告海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium four-panel advertising campaign board for the Tropicana multi-flavor series, developed as the “Lifestyle Flavor Emblems” version. The composition must use a clean 2x2 layout where each panel presents one real front-facing Tropicana bottle and one large emblem-like sticker composition above it, built from flavor-related lifestyle objects, fruit elements, and daily-life mini icons. The final campaign must feel intelligent, elegant, playful, and highly organized, like a world-class global beverage identity system where every flavor becomes its own symbolic lifestyle badge. The image must feel bright, fresh, hyper-real, and extremely refined, while keeping the product heroized and clearly readable in every panel.

Core concept:
Each Tropicana flavor becomes a lifestyle emblem. Rather than only showing fruit and color, each panel must transform daily-life objects, fruit slices, utensils, cups, leaves, leisure items, breakfast accessories, and small flavor-linked objects into one carefully composed “life badge” above the bottle. These emblems should feel less like random collages and more like elevated symbolic medallions or flavor crests, each with a distinct emotional world. The real product bottle anchors the composition at the bottom, while the emblem above acts as the lifestyle signature of that flavor.

4-panel structure:
Use a clean 2x2 campaign board with four equal panels and strong consistency in layout logic:
upper zone: one large emblem-like composition made from sticker-style lifestyle objects,
lower center: one front-facing real Tropicana bottle,
clean flavor-specific background,
minimal premium typography structure.
All four panels must clearly belong to the same campaign family, but each must tell a different flavor story through color, object choice, and emblem shape.

Panel 1, orange sunrise emblem:
Place a real front-facing Tropicana orange bottle at the lower center. Above it, build a large citrus-lifestyle emblem from orange slices, peel curls, fresh leaves, breakfast glassware, morning utensils, sunny round objects, juice droplets, tiny sport-leisure accessories, and bright daily-life symbols. The final emblem should feel like a polished sunrise crest or radiant circular badge, communicating active mornings, brightness, and natural energy.

Panel 2, mango tropical leisure emblem:
Place a real front-facing Tropicana mango or tropical flavor bottle at the lower center. Above it, create a rich tropical-lifestyle emblem built from mango pieces, yellow fruit rounds, beach-like leisure objects, smoothie tools, soft summer accessories, tropical leaves, cups, and warm casual-lifestyle stickers. The shape should feel like a tropical crest, relaxed vacation symbol, or sun-soaked leisure emblem, elegant and playful.

Panel 3, berry social emblem:
Place a real front-facing Tropicana berry or red fruit bottle at the lower center. Above it, build an emblem from strawberries, raspberries, cherries, red fruit slices, cups, mini plates, dessert-like accents, ribbons, social-lifestyle items, and playful red daily-life objects. The final badge should feel more vibrant and emotional, like a juicy social emblem for fun, sharing, and lively flavor energy. The silhouette can be softly rounded, fruit-like, or heart-inflected while staying premium and clean.

Panel 4, green refresh emblem:
Place a real front-facing Tropicana green citrus or mixed green flavor bottle at the lower center. Above it, create a fresh-lifestyle emblem from lime slices, green leaves, wellness objects, summer drink accessories, clean kitchen details, glassware, and cool refreshing mini icons. The final shape should feel crisp, balanced, and revitalizing, like a leaf-crest or freshness medallion linked to active clarity and cool uplift.

Emblem object logic:
The emblem compositions must feel carefully curated and flavor-specific. Every object should contribute both visually and emotionally to the taste identity of that panel. They should read as premium “lifestyle stickers” or collectible cutouts, but rendered with real material behavior, subtle thickness, refined shadows, soft tactile surfaces, and elegant spacing. The emblem silhouettes must be immediately readable at a glance while rewarding close inspection with object detail and flavor storytelling.

Product realism:
Render every Tropicana bottle with absolute realism and premium beverage fidelity. Each bottle must face directly toward the camera, clearly readable, physically accurate, and fully aligned with its panel flavor. Show bottle geometry, cap design, label hierarchy, transparent container behavior, subtle reflections, realistic juice color, and fresh premium product appeal. The products must feel cold, bright, and globally branded, anchoring the playful emblem systems with commercial realism.

Backgrounds:
Each panel must use a clean minimal flavor-specific background with soft premium color tone and excellent negative space. Suggested direction:
orange panel: pale citrus yellow or warm cream,
mango panel: soft tropical beige or mellow gold,
berry panel: blush cream, soft rose, or warm neutral,
green panel: pale mint, sage, or cool green-gray.
The backgrounds must remain calm and clean so the emblem and bottle dominate clearly. Avoid visual clutter or harsh contrast.

Typography:
Use an elegant overseas-product typography system with a large English-led campaign title and restrained supporting copy. The typography should be minimal, premium, and integrated without overpowering the products or emblems.
Main campaign direction:
“LIFESTYLE FLAVOR EMBLEMS”
Panel-level copy can remain short and elegant if desired.
Add only subtle official-style logo marks and minimal supporting English copy. Typography must feel clean, contemporary, and globally premium, never crude or heavy.

Lighting:
Use soft high-end commercial lighting with delicate shadows and refined object separation. Every bottle should be lit with premium product-photography precision. Every small sticker object inside the emblem should show real surface behavior, gentle shadow casting, and clear tactile form. The whole board must feel polished, bright, collectible, and physically real, while still keeping the clean graphic discipline of a campaign identity system.

Color direction:
Use a premium color-coded palette across the full board, with each panel tuned to its flavor identity while maintaining overall harmony. The campaign should feel colorful but controlled, bright but elegant, playful but luxurious. Let fruit tones, object tones, and background tones all support the same flavor logic without becoming too noisy.

Mood:
playful, premium, organized, fresh, collectible, lifestyle-driven, graphic, modern, colorful, tactile, hyper-real, elegant, internationally refined

Rendering style:
ultra-premium Tropicana multi-flavor campaign board, 2x2 layout, real front-facing juice bottles, lifestyle emblem sticker compositions, flavor-coded modern badges, clean pastel backgrounds, minimal premium typography, hyper-real product photography, world-class advertising key visual, 8k, global campaign quality

Negative prompt:
messy collage, weak product dominance, cheap sticker design, inconsistent flavor colors, cluttered layout, cartoon rendering, muddy palette, ugly typography, low-detail bottle realism, random objects, low-end poster design, flat lighting
