prompts.text:
主题：
在草坪上舒展的裙摆

主体：
纵向构图的照片。一位女性坐在郁郁葱葱的公园草坪上，位置在画面中央略偏右。人物全身入镜，占据画面约七成。左腿向前长长伸展，右膝高高抬起，双臂叠放在膝上，头部轻轻靠在手臂上。右手向身体后方伸展，支撑在画面右侧的草坪上承受体重。展开的裙摆向画面右下方流动，在草坪上形成柔和的圆弧。

人物·表情：
自然而富有现实感的日本女性。散发着沉稳的成熟气质，以及优雅而细腻的氛围。头发是光泽的深棕色。后脑勺低调地盘成略显凌乱的发髻式高髻，保留了薄薄透出的刘海，以及沿脸颊垂落的细碎发丝。脸庞微微向下，视线落在抬起膝盖附近。眉眼和嘴角放松，呈现出宁静的表情。妆容以粉米色为主，自然的泪袋、细长的睫毛、淡玫瑰色的腮红，以及透出感的珊瑚粉唇。

服装·姿势：
以象牙白为主调，点缀着极淡的蓝灰色小花图案，宛如日系品牌风格的无袖长连衣裙。领口是小立领搭配细密褶边，胸前有低调的竖向开衩。肩部饰以双层迷你荷叶边，腰部采用宽幅抽褶设计，收紧成纤细轮廓。裙身从腰部开始融入细密褶皱和斜向垂褶，向下裙摆微微展开，形成不对称设计。薄而轻盈的雪纺面料，却不过度透明，内衬自然可见。脚上穿着白色细带粗跟凉鞋。抬起右腿靠近身体中心，伸展的左腿向画面左下方斜向流动。膝盖、手部、脚踝和鞋子的接触自然流畅，衣物褶皱顺应坐姿的重量和腿部弯曲。

背景·光线：
夏日午后的宁静都市公园。近景是细碎的草坪和少许落叶。中景左侧是高挑细叶的绿色植物，右侧是缓和的草坪斜坡。远景模糊处理大树和带有白色装饰面板的低矮围栏。天空仅部分显露蓝色。强烈的日光从画面左上方洒入，在脸部额头、鼻梁、肩部、手臂、膝盖和小腿上投下明亮光影。树荫形成的柔和斑驳图案洒落在草坪和背景上，人物的影子向画面右下方延伸。肌肤上添加草坪反射的淡绿色光线，白色连衣裙上融入蓝天微弱的冷色反射。

构图·镜头：
纵向4:5比例。镜头从人物坐姿位置略高处，以轻微俯视角度拍摄。约85mm的中远摄镜头。人物头顶保留适度空白，可见树木和蓝天，左侧配置伸展的腿部和植物，右侧配置展开的裙摆。以脸部和近处的膝盖为焦点，背景平滑虚化。人物头部、抬起膝盖、伸展腿部和展开裙摆形成稳定的三角形构图。脚尖不被画面裁切，左右凉鞋自然纳入。

质感·风格：
优雅的日系时尚肖像。捕捉盛夏透明空气，以及自然光强弱变化的摄影表现。肌肤明亮顺滑，却保留毛孔和细微阴影。连衣裙的薄雪纺、细密荷叶边、抽褶和褶皱的立体感细致描绘。背景的绿色深邃，与人物和衣物的明亮象牙白形成分离。高对比度，饱和度适中。透明感十足的锐利描绘，辅以极淡的胶片颗粒。

负面提示：
不自然的五官、不自然的视线、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手足融合、关节崩坏、膝盖或脚踝变形、左右腿混淆、鞋与脚接触不良、浮空的身体、不自然的重量感、崩坏的衣物褶皱、过度透明、与光源矛盾的影子、错误的透视、文字乱码、标志、水印、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤。

prompts.text: A photorealistic 3:4 vertical seated portrait photographed indoors in low light with direct on-camera flash. An adult woman, approximately 24 to 32 years old, sits diagonally on a carved black wooden chair. Her body turns toward the right side of the frame while her face rotates back toward the camera. Both arms rise high and fold behind her head, with the elbows pointing separately toward the upper-left and upper-right corners, creating a wide, imperfect triangular frame. Her spine extends slightly, the chest lifts and the head tilts backward with the chin elevated. Despite the backward tilt, her slightly lowered eyelids look toward the camera positioned below her face. Her lips remain gently parted. The expression is calm, languid and self-assured, suspended between a deliberate pose and an incidental nighttime snapshot.  Preserve her elongated facial proportions, subtly lifted eye shape and clearly defined lips. Use a makeup direction combining vintage Shanghai-inspired cinema, contemporary evening beauty and East Asian fashion portrait styling: a softly matte complexion, refined brows, elongated upward black eyeliner, muted gray-brown eyeshadow, restrained contouring and low-saturation rose-bean or brick-rose lipstick. Avoid severe Western-style contouring, oversized false lashes and highly reflective glass lips.  Her hair is natural black or extremely deep cool brown-black. It is brushed away from the face and remains relatively smooth at the crown, then falls heavily from the back of the head and shoulders along the left side of the chair. The long hair should feel sleek and weighty, absorbing most of the surrounding light like black satin. Only narrow highlights appear where the flash strikes. Keep slight natural curvature at the ends and avoid large, voluminous curls.  The figure is long, supple and naturally slim, with an elongated neck and shoulder line, slender but believable arms and a gently defined waist. One leg bends horizontally across the front of the chair, exposing a long lower leg, ankle and silver strappy heel. The other leg bends toward the right side of the frame, revealing the knee and part of the thigh. Preserve believable leg overlap and perspective compression. Most of the weight rests on one hip and the upholstered cushion. The raised arms must show realistic shoulder tension, joint angles and muscle stretch. Do not add extra arms, hands or fingers.  She wears a fitted sleeveless top in champagne gray, gray-pink beige or pale cool mauve. Fine silver metallic fibers are woven through the knit or mesh, while small irregular sequins or metallic points are scattered across the chest. Direct flash breaks these embellishments into fragmented gold-and-silver reflections. The remaining fabric combines a delicate matte surface with restrained shimmer. The top fully covers the chest, with relatively deep armholes and only a faint translucent impression around the fabric edges. Do not introduce a plunging neckline, exaggerated cleavage or a wardrobe malfunction.  The skirt is a high-waisted satin midi skirt in dusty blush, muted gray rose or champagne pink. It fits smoothly around the waist and hips, then gathers into rich, irregular folds across the thighs, knees and chair. Loose front draping and hanging fabric should fall below the seat. The satin should visually suggest a cool, smooth and finely woven touch. Raised folds reflect silver-pink highlights, while recessed creases shift into muted gray-violet shadow.  Visible skin includes the full face and ears, neck, collarbones, a small area of the upper chest, shoulders, both underarm areas, inner upper arms, forearms, one knee, part of a thigh, a lower leg, ankle and top of the foot. The complexion is light and fair with neutral beige and subtle peach-pink undertones. Under direct flash, the skin appears creamy and bright, while shadowed areas shift toward warm gray. The surface should look fine and clean, visually suggesting a soft, slightly cool and naturally elastic touch. Preserve faint pores, natural joint color variation and believable contours around the shoulders, arms and knees. Avoid a completely textureless porcelain or wax surface.  Add long, fine silver or crystal drop earrings and an extremely delicate metallic necklace with a tiny pendant. She wears silver strappy high-heeled sandals with narrow ankle straps and reflective metal heels. The seat is a heavy carved black wooden chair or bench with a dark floral textile cushion.  The background is a dim, enclosed private dining room, vintage lounge or restaurant chamber using East Asian-inspired decorative language. Behind the subject is an aged parchment-brown mural or textile screen depicting white cranes, bamboo branches or reeds. Heavy glossy black wooden borders and dark wall panels surround it. A deep vermilion or wine-red wall section appears on the right, along with the partial curved outline of dark furniture. The room should feel like the remains of an old nighttime banquet: quiet, glamorous, faintly mysterious and slightly dangerous.  Photograph the scene like an early-2000s compact digital camera nightlife image, using an approximately 28–40mm equivalent focal length and an aperture impression around f/2.8 to f/4. Position the camera slightly below the subject’s face, roughly around chest or waist height. The mild low angle emphasizes the raised arms, long neck and backward head tilt. Use a vertical seated three-quarter-to-full-body composition, including everything from the lifted elbows to the silver heels. Let the subject fill almost the entire vertical frame, with the right knee approaching the edge and the crop retaining a slightly hurried, imperfect offset.  The main physical light source is a hard direct flash positioned close to the lens axis and slightly left. The light falls off rapidly, making the face, shoulders, arms, shimmering top and satin skirt visibly bright while the mural, black wooden structures and distant room become underexposed. The raised arms cast relatively hard-edged shadows around the face, neck and wall. Deep occlusion appears beneath the arms, beside the waist and where the body meets the chair. Preserve only a weak warm-red ambient glow on the right. Do not add softboxes, even fill light, blue rim light or bright daylight windows.  Retain low-light digital grain, mild JPEG compression, background noise, uneven local sharpness, slightly bright flash-rendered skin and an imperfect nightlife crop. Do not polish the image into a noise-free, evenly lit, ultra-clean commercial studio editorial.  She had just turned and settled into the dim room, and the satin skirt had already gathered between her knees. She now lifts both hands behind her head and looks beyond the flash toward the lens. A moment later, she may lower her arms and disappear back into the unfinished night. The image should blend vintage Shanghai-inspired diva energy, East Asian decorative art, old-film banquet atmosphere and early-2000s direct-flash fashion photography. Mature, cool and languid, with authenticity taking priority over perfection.  Negative prompt: underage appearance, phone selfie, mirror reflection, extra arms, extra fingers, deformed hands, broken joints, arm intersection, hair intersection, exaggerated bust, extreme tiny waist, explicit exposure, wardrobe malfunction, miniskirt, plastic skin, waxy face, bright white studio, even soft lighting, blue rim light, heavy HDR, oversharpening, noise-free commercial editorial, anime, obvious 3D render.

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium advertising poster for Budweiser 330ml, combining hyper-real product photography with a sensual luxury beach-club moment. The image must center on multiple ice-cold Budweiser 330ml cans and a real adult Western female model positioned beside an open ice chest at a glamorous seaside location. The final result should feel bold, fresh, clean, sun-drenched, and commercially irresistible, with the cans remaining the visual hero and the woman amplifying the summer heat-versus-cold contrast.

Core concept:
The hero concept is a Riviera-style beach scene where an adult Western female model leans or reclines beside an open ice chest filled with Budweiser 330ml cans and crushed ice. The model should feel confident, sensual, and high-end, but the composition must always prioritize the product. The cold metallic cans, frost, ice cubes, mist, and chest interior should create a refreshing counterpoint to the warm golden light, sunlit skin, and coastal summer atmosphere. The image should feel like the perfect luxury summer beer moment.

Composition:
Use a vertical premium poster layout with the open ice chest positioned in the lower-middle or side foreground, clearly filled with Budweiser 330ml cans, crushed ice, and visible cold vapor. The female model should be placed beside or partly leaning against the cooler in a relaxed but visually striking pose, with one arm near the chest or one hand lightly interacting with a can. The product cluster must sit at the center of the eye path. Keep the beach, sky, and sea secondary and softly framed in the background. The composition should feel balanced, clean, and strongly commercial.

Product realism:
Render the Budweiser 330ml cans with absolute flagship realism:
accurate 330ml can proportions,
clear Budweiser branding,
precise red-white-silver design,
cold metallic reflections,
beads of condensation,
frosty aluminum surfaces,
crushed ice interaction,
and highly tactile chilled realism.
The cans must be the sharpest and most desirable object cluster in the scene.

Female model:
Use a healthy fit adult Western female model with fair or sun-kissed skin, elegant athletic proportions, and a premium lifestyle presence. Her styling should feel Riviera-luxury:
minimal white, cream, or pale neutral swimwear,
slightly wet skin,
refined natural glamour,
and confident relaxed body language.
She should feel sensual in an editorial, premium, globally branded sense, not vulgar or explicit.

Ice chest scene:
The open cooler or ice chest must feel luxurious and real:
metallic or premium hard-shell construction,
clean white or brushed silver interior,
filled with cracked ice, mist, and several Budweiser 330ml cans.
The lid may be partially open, catching sunlight. Ice should glisten with crisp highlights, and subtle cold vapor may drift upward. The chest should enhance product desirability and reinforce cold refreshment.

Environment:
Place the scene at a beautiful seaside Riviera-style beach setting:
bright sunlight,
soft sand or elegant boardwalk surface,
blue ocean,
clean sky,
minimal upscale beach atmosphere.
The environment should remain secondary and uncluttered, like a premium lifestyle backdrop.

Cold-vs-heat contrast:
The image must be driven by the contrast between hot summer atmosphere and intensely cold Budweiser cans. Use:
sun-warmed skin,
bright golden light,
cold metallic can surfaces,
ice cubes,
water droplets,
subtle cold mist,
and sparkling reflections.
This contrast should create immediate sensory craving.

Color direction:
Use a premium summer palette of Budweiser red, white, and silver against golden skin tones, icy whites, ocean blue, soft sand beige, and bright sunlit highlights. Keep the colors clean, vibrant, and aspirational.

Typography:
Use a minimal English-led typography system with a Chinese subtitle.
Suggested text direction:
Main English title:
“BUDWEISER 330ML”
Secondary title:
“ICE CHEST RIVIERA”
Chinese subtitle:
“海岸冰爽时刻”
Supporting English copy:
“Sun on skin. Ice in hand.”
Typography should be sparse, premium, and modern, with clear hierarchy and minimal intrusion.

Brand coding:
Preserve Budweiser identity through:
clear can visibility,
accurate red-white branding,
premium cold-beer realism,
confident summer lifestyle tone,
and polished international campaign quality.
The final result must feel unmistakably Budweiser and highly desirable.

Lighting:
Use high-end natural sunlight with refined commercial control. The cans and ice chest should have crisp cold highlights, the model’s skin should glow with warm golden light, and the ocean background should feel bright and elegant. The overall light must feel luxurious, fresh, and premium.

Mood:
fresh, sensual, summery, premium, cold, luxurious, desirable, clean, high-impact, globally branded

Rendering style:
hyper-real Budweiser 330ml advertising poster, luxury beach-club lifestyle scene, open ice chest full of cans and crushed ice, healthy adult Western female model, cold vapor and condensation, minimal premium typography, world-class commercial image quality, 8k

Negative prompt:
cheap alcohol ad, vulgar erotic pose, crowded party scene, weak Budweiser branding, low-detail cans, messy cooler, dirty beach, plastic-looking skin, low-end commercial style, excessive props, rough typography

Theme:
Fingertips reaching out to the sea

Subject:
On a high seaside terrace with an unobstructed view overlooking the summer sea, a mature female model with an adult figure stands alone slightly to the right of the center of the frame. The full body is in the shot, occupying about 60% of the frame. She supports her body with one foot while gently lifting the other foot backward, with both arms stretching diagonally toward the upper right.

Person · Expression:
An adult woman exuding a natural and elegant atmosphere. Long dark brown hair in loose waves, blown backward by the sea breeze. The bangs are thin, with thin strands of hair remaining around the face. The face is slightly turned toward the upper right, and the gaze is also directed ahead of the outstretched fingertips. The corners of the mouth are slightly open, showing an open and serene expression. The skin tone is a bright ivory beige, retaining natural color and texture. Makeup includes rose beige blush, detailed eyelashes, soft brown eyebrows, and pink-beige lip gloss with a natural feel.

Clothing · Pose:
A set of light white summer clothing. The upper body is a spaghetti strap V-neck crop top, embellished with understated pleats and lace stitching at the chest and hem. The back features a thin ribbon tie design. The bottom is a high-waisted short layered mini skirt made of thin cotton material. The hem of the skirt naturally flutters toward the left side of the frame due to the wind, with small hem ruffles swaying softly. She stands on her right leg, with her left leg bent at the knee and raised backward. Both arms stretch smoothly forward from the shoulders, wrists slightly tilted back, and fingertips relaxed and open. She wears slender ivory lace-up sandals on her feet.

Background · Lighting:
In front of her is a vivid turquoise sea and a sharply curved coastline, with the distant view extending to lush green hills, white buildings, and a small seaside town. Beneath the figure is not a driveway, but a safe stone-paved viewing terrace. A white wall and wooden handrails below waist height form the boundary with the sea, with a few tropical plants dotting the foreground edge. Clear weather around noon in summer. The main light source is strong natural light entering from the upper left of the frame, illuminating the front of the face, shoulders, arms, and legs. Shadows fall toward the lower right, and the white walls and ground reflect a soft light. The sea surface is scattered with fine, sparkling glimmers.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical composition 4:5. Full-body portrait, with the person located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, leaving a vast expanse of blue sky above the head. Ample space is left at the bottom of the frame under the feet, and the raised leg extends to the left, creating lateral movement. The camera position is at a slightly low angle from waist height. Natural compression from a mid-telephoto lens makes the person sharp and clear, while the distant coastline is softly blurred. Focus is placed on the eyes and face, with a shallow depth of field, but the silhouette of the background coastline is still recognizable.

Bright and transparent realistic summer fashion photography. Delicate expression of the sheer feel of white fabric, fine wrinkles, the movement of the skirt in the wind, every strand of hair, and the natural texture of the skin. Using the color contrast of blue sky, sea, and white clothing as the protagonist, the saturation is fresh without being exaggerated or flashy. A transparent Ramune bottle with a blue cap is placed at the bottom left of the tatami. Create an ultra-premium editorial advertising poster for Dulux, centered on a hyper-real female tango dancer whose dress and sweeping motion trails are formed entirely from sculptural liquid paint rising directly from a Dulux paint can below. The image must feel bold, elegant, dramatic, fashion-forward, and globally premium, with a strong high-contrast pure-color background and a powerful sense of rhythm, tension, and movement. The final result should look like a world-class Dulux campaign poster where color becomes passion, paint becomes couture, and dance becomes visual impact.

Core concept:
The hero visual is a refined young Western female dancer captured in a rhythmic tango pose full of control, confidence, and mature dramatic energy. Her liquid-paint costume rises directly from a Dulux paint can below and forms both the sculptural body of the dress and the sharp sweeping skirt extensions associated with tango motion. The visual language should feel more sensual, grounded, and directional than ballet: stronger hip line, firmer posture, sharper turning energy, and a more theatrical silhouette. The image must feel iconic, modern, and unforgettable.

Composition:
Use a vertical luxury poster layout with the dancer placed centrally and slightly above the lower third, creating a commanding, highly readable silhouette. The Dulux paint can should sit near the lower center or slightly offset near the grounded foot, clearly visible as the source of the paint. The liquid paint must rise from the can in a continuous elegant stream, forming the fitted upper dress and dramatic tango-like skirt sweeps around the legs. The composition should feel clean, graphic, and intense, with strong negative space so the gesture and color contrast dominate.

Female dancer:
Use a refined young Western female model with fair skin, elegant facial structure, healthy graceful physique, and a poised fashion-editorial presence. Her pose should suggest tango rhythm and emotional charge:
strong grounded supporting leg,
one leg extending or crossing with precision,
twisted torso,
sharp arm line or lifted hand,
elongated neck,
and a confident, composed expression.
She must feel powerful, feminine, premium, and visually magnetic.

Liquid paint tango dress:
The dress must be formed entirely from hyper-real liquid paint. The paint should create a fitted bodice and a dramatic, asymmetrical tango skirt, with sweeping arcs and directional trails that feel like fabric in motion but remain unmistakably liquid. The paint must be glossy, rich, thick, and physically convincing, with refined edges, controlled splash tension, and elegant sculptural weight. The movement should feel passionate and rhythmic, not chaotic.

Paint source logic:
The Dulux paint can must clearly act as the source of the entire liquid construction. The viewer should instantly understand that the paint rises from the can and transforms into the tango dress and dynamic motion trails. This physical connection is essential.

Background:
Use a bold high-saturation pure-color background with no clutter and no scenery. For the strongest tango tension, use a vivid deep teal or saturated emerald-teal background contrasted against a rich crimson-red or lacquered scarlet paint dress. The background should feel flat, clean, modern, and poster-like, intensifying the silhouette and making the liquid dress feel more explosive and luxurious.

Color strategy:
The paint dress should feel jewel-like, deep, and sensual, using crimson red, lacquer red, or deep vermilion as the main liquid color. The background should contrast strongly through a cool saturated tone such as deep teal or peacock green. Keep the dancer’s skin tones natural and refined so the main chromatic energy comes from the red-versus-teal contrast. The final image should feel bold, artistic, expensive, and globally branded.

Product integration:
Include a hyper-real Dulux paint can or bucket with clear logo visibility in the lower area of the composition. The can should be sharply rendered, premium, and proportionally balanced within the overall poster.

Typography:
Use an elegant minimal English-led typography system with a refined Chinese subtitle.

or

or

“Dulux turns rhythm into colour.”
Typography should remain minimal, modern, artistic, and beautifully spaced, allowing the figure, paint, and contrast to dominate.

Preserve Dulux identity through:
premium paint can visibility,
confident use of bold color,
clean international advertising polish,
minimal composition,
and the direct transformation of paint into fashion and movement.
The overall result must feel like a refined same-series Dulux luxury campaign with stronger drama and emotional punch.

Use soft premium studio lighting with refined highlights on the dancer’s skin, hair, and liquid paint dress. The red paint must show glossy reflections, sculptural depth, and elegant contour shaping. The figure should remain dimensional and luxuriously lit against the saturated teal background, with no harsh shadow clutter.

prompts.text:
Subject:
Stretching in the sea breeze

Main Body:
A vertical 3:4 realistic fashion photograph. An adult female leaning her upper body out of the open window of a deep blue car, positioned slightly to the right of the center of the frame. Captured from the waist to the head, with the person occupying about 60% of the frame. Both hands are placed on the window frame at the moment she looks up at the bright sky while bathed in the sea breeze.

Character/Expression:
A young and natural woman. A bright and friendly face, clear eyes, soft eyebrows, and light coral pink lips. Her chin is slightly raised, but she maintains an angle where the eyes, nose, and mouth are fully visible, with her gaze directed toward the sky in the upper left of the frame. A natural and refreshing smile is on the corners of her mouth. Deep brown medium-length hair with light layers and thin bangs, the ends of which flutter backward with the wind.

Clothing/Pose:
An ecru-colored exquisite crochet knit top. Elegant deep V-neck with a thin ribbon tied in the center, long bell sleeves, and a shorter hem. Clearly reveals the white glossy neck and collarbones, and a slender waistline. A curvy body typical of a mature woman, along with naturally three-dimensional breast curves. The bottom is ivory high-waist pants paired with a thin brown belt. Both arms are extended diagonally downward, with the left and right palms gently supporting the window frame. Fingers are naturally spread, with no unnecessary force applied to the shoulders and wrists.

Background/Lighting:
A driveway on a high plateau by the seaside in summer. The mid-ground features a deep blue sea, a green cape, and a wooden guardrail. The background consists of elegant mountains and the horizon. The upper part of the frame widely includes a vast blue sky and slender flowing white clouds. Intense and clear midday sunlight pours down from the upper right, creating highly transparent highlights on the forehead, cheeks, bridge of the nose, neck, collarbones, shoulders, and chest. The skin is fair and bright but avoids overexposure, preserving delicate skin texture and a natural moist feel. Soft shadows are cast under the chin and in the hollows of the collarbones, and the car body reflects the blue light of the sky and sea.

Composition/Lens:
A medium shot from the waist up. Taken from a slightly low position, the person's face is near the center of the frame, with a wide sky space left above the head. The upper edge of the car door serves as a horizontal line at the bottom of the frame, utilizing the coastline extending into the distance. Equivalent to a 35mm focal length, focusing on the face and upper body, with the background slightly blurred. The head is not tilted back excessively, maintaining an angle where both the facial profile and collarbones can be presented beautifully.

Texture/Style:
A bright and fresh live-action photograph like a summer fashion magazine. Delicately depicts natural skin luster, soft shadows around the collarbones, fine hair strands, the three-dimensional feel of the crochet knit, and the gloss of the deep blue car body. A refreshing color palette based on blue sky, sea, ecru, and deep blue. Avoids excessive skin beautification while balancing transparency and realistic skin texture.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, unnatural body shape, extra fingers, missing fingers, flaws in wrists or joints, poor contact with the window frame, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, overexposure, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
在海风中舒展

主体：
纵向3:4的写实时尚照片。将一位从深蓝色的车打开的窗户探出上半身的成年女性，放置在画面中央稍偏右的位置。从腰部到头部入镜，人物占据画面的约6成。双手置于窗框上，全身沐浴海风的同时抬头仰望明亮的天空那一刻。

人物・表情：
年轻而自然的女性。明亮亲切的面容，清澈的眼眸，柔和的眉毛，淡珊瑚粉色的嘴唇。微微抬起下巴，但保持眼睛、鼻子和嘴部充分可见的角度，视线投向画面左上方的天空。嘴角带着自然清爽的微笑。深棕色的半长发加入轻盈的层次感和薄薄的刘海，发梢随风向后飘扬。

服装・姿势：
生成り色的精致钩针编织上衣。优雅深度的V领，中央系着细丝带，长款喇叭袖，较短的下摆。清晰展现白色光泽的颈部和锁骨，纤细的腰线。成熟女性般的曲线分明的体型，以及自然立体的胸部曲线。下装为象牙白的 high-waist 裤子搭配细棕色腰带。双臂斜向下伸展，左右手掌轻轻支撑窗框。手指自然张开，肩膀和手腕不施加多余的力道。

背景・光线：
夏季海边高台上的驾驶道。中景为蔚蓝的大海、绿色的岬角、木质护栏。远景为淡雅的山峦与地平线。画面上部广泛纳入广阔的蓝天和细长流动的白云。从右上方倾泻而下强烈而清澈的午间阳光，在额头、脸颊、鼻梁、颈部、锁骨、肩膀和胸口营造出透明感十足的高光。肌肤白皙明亮但避免过曝，保留细腻的皮肤纹理和自然的湿润感。下巴下方和锁骨凹陷处投下柔和的阴影，车身反射出天空和大海的蓝色光芒。

构图・镜头：
腰部以上的中景镜头。从稍低的位置拍摄，人物的脸部位于画面中央附近，头部上方留出广阔的天空空白。将车门上端作为画面下部的水平线，利用海岸线向深处延伸。相当于35mm焦段，对脸部和上半身对焦，背景轻微虚化。头部不过度后仰，保持脸部轮廓和锁骨都能美丽呈现的角度。

质感・风格：
如同夏季时尚杂志般明亮而清新的实拍照片。细腻描绘自然的肌肤光泽、锁骨周边的柔和阴影、头发细密的发束、钩针编织的立体感，以及深蓝色车身的光泽。以蓝天、大海、生成り色、深蓝为基调的清爽色调。避免过度美肌处理，同时兼顾透明感和现实的皮肤质感。

负面提示：
不自然的五官、不自然的视线、不自然的体型、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手腕或关节的破绽、与窗框接触不良、错误的透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、过曝、塑料般的肌肤、文字乱码、标志、水印。

淡象牙粉色的薄纱材质衬衫。带有细致的纵向线条和柔和的光泽，领口处点缀着一个小巧的黑色蝴蝶结。炭灰色的的高腰短裤、光脚、黑色漆皮的厚底高跟鞋。双腿向画面左下方斜长伸展，自然地将脚踝靠近。画面右侧的手臂从身体侧面自然向后垂下，肘部微微弯曲。手掌根部置于黄色的横管上方，手掌向下。四根手指并拢，沿着管子的圆弧贴合，指尖轻轻弯曲触碰表面。拇指绕到管子的对侧，不用力握紧，仅轻轻支撑身体的重量。另一只手隐藏在身体后方，看不见。

背景·光线：
夜晚的立体停车场。近景为黑色柏油路和白色停车线，中景为黄黑相间的护栏，右端有带有警告色斜线的混凝土柱子。远景包括梁柱、空置的停车区、模糊的路灯和城市灯光。从画面左上方投射下暖色照明，温柔地照亮脸庞、头发、肩膀、手臂和双腿的轮廓。右远方加入淡冷的外部光线，为背景营造纵深感。阴影柔和地投射到人物的左下方。

构图·镜头：
纵向4:5。全身肖像。人物头部位于画面上部中央偏左的位置，鞋尖靠近左下方。利用右端的柱子作为纵向框架，护栏的曲线引导视线流向人物的腰部和手部。镜头位置略低于腰部，几乎平视。相当于85mm焦段，浅景深。精确对焦脸部和手部，背景柔和虚化。

质感·风格：
优雅的日系时尚肖像。细致描绘自然肌肤、纤细的发丝、衬衫的透视感、高跟鞋的光泽、金属管的划痕和涂装质感等。基调为暖色与炭灰色，营造沉稳的色调。细腻的胶片颗粒、低饱和度、柔和的对比度。

负面提示：
不自然的手、不自然的指头、多余的指头、缺失的指头、手腕的破损、用力紧握的手、手与护栏的接触不良、手脚融合、不自然的腿、关节破损、漂浮、错误的透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、文字乱码、标志、水印、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的皮肤。

items.title: 红色气球与夏日河川敷的优雅女性

prompts.text:
Theme:
Whereabouts of the Red Balloon

Main Subject:
Vertical composition. A woman sits on low stone steps next to a summer riverbank walkway. The figure is positioned on the right side of the screen, occupying about 75% of the frame. A large red balloon floats in the upper left, connected to the figure's right hand by a thin white line. The blue sky and the balloon create a wide negative space, evoking a sense of summer-like openness.

Character·Expression:
An adult woman with natural Japanese beauty. Longish dark brown hair flutters in the wind, showing light movement. Elegant Japanese makeup with a high sense of transparency. Soft ivory-toned pale skin, delicate eyelashes, and cheeks and lips with a slight flush. Her gaze is directed toward the red balloon in the upper left, with a quiet expression and a slightly open mouth. Natural light and shadow from the neck to the collarbone create a mature and steady atmosphere.

Clothing·Pose:
A model-like physique showing beautiful body lines. Long straight legs, a tightened waist, and a naturally voluminous silhouette. Wearing an ivory ribbed material V-neck top with understated button details at the chest. A light mini skirt with a delicate floral pattern sways slightly in the wind. The right hand holds the balloon string, while the left hand is placed behind to support her on the stone steps. The right leg is naturally extended, and the left leg is slightly bent, forming a three-dimensional pose. Wearing thin strap sandals on her feet.

Background·Light:
A summer Japanese riverbank walkway. On the left is a calm river surface, with a bridge and a distant city skyline faintly visible behind it. On the right, a large tree-lined path extends, with dappled tree shadows scattered on the ground. Huge cumulonimbus clouds unique to summer float in the sky. Sunlight enters obliquely from the upper left of the screen, forming soft highlights on the figure's cheeks, shoulders, and legs. Light reflected from the trees softens the shadows, expressing a refreshing summer air.

Composition·Lens:
A low-angle wide-angle shot. A composition that emphasizes the figure's legs in the foreground with the gaze extending into the distance. The red balloon is placed in the upper left of the screen, forming a diagonal composition with the figure. The background uses a shallow depth of field for soft blurring, highlighting the figure and the balloon as the main subjects. An exquisite balance like a magazine photoshoot.

Texture·Style:
A realistic photographic style like an outdoor location shoot for a high-end fashion magazine. Skin retains a natural texture while being given a sense of transparency. Every strand of hair, clothing fibers, the rough surface of the stone steps, and the light passing through the leaves are all meticulously depicted. Slightly high saturation, but maintains soft tones like a film photograph. The color contrast between the summer blue sky and the red balloon is impressive.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, deformed joints, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

prompts.text:
主题：
红色气球的去向

主体：
纵向构图。夏日的河川敷游步道旁，低矮的石阶上，一位女性坐着。人物配置在画面右侧偏位，全身占据画面约75%。左上方飘着一个大大的红色气球，细细的白线连接到人物的右手。蓝天与气球营造出宽广的留白，演出夏日般的开阔感。

人物·表情：
拥有自然日系美感的成年女性。稍长的深棕色头发随风飘动，展现轻盈的动态。透明感十足的优雅日系妆容。柔和的象牙色偏白的肌肤，纤细的睫毛，微微透出血色的脸颊与嘴唇。视线投向左上方的红色气球，微微张口的宁静表情。从颈部到锁骨处自然的光影，营造出成熟而沉稳的氛围。

服装·姿势：
体型如模特般展现优美的身体线条。修长笔直的双腿，收紧的腰部，自然丰盈的轮廓感。身着象牙色的罗纹材质V领上衣，胸口处点缀着低调的纽扣细节。淡雅花卉图案的轻盈迷你裙随风微微摇曳。右手握着气球的线，左手置于身后支撑石阶。右腿自然伸展，左腿微微弯曲，形成富有立体感的姿势。脚上穿着细肩带凉鞋。

背景·光线：
夏日日本的河川敷游步道。左侧是平静的河面，其后方隐约可见桥梁与远景的城市轮廓。右侧延伸着巨大的林荫道，树影斑驳洒落在地面。天空飘浮着夏日特有的巨大积雨云。阳光从画面左上方斜射而入，在人物的脸颊、肩膀和双腿上形成柔和的高光。树木反射的光线缓和了阴影，表现出现爽快的夏日空气感。

构图·镜头：
较低的低角度广角拍摄。将人物的双腿置于前景突出，视线向深处延伸的构图。将红色气球置于画面左上方，形成与人物的对角线构图。背景采用较浅的景深柔和虚化，将人物与气球作为主角突出。宛如杂志写真般的精致平衡。

质感·风格：
如同高级时尚杂志的外景拍摄般的真实摄影风格。肌肤保留自然质感的同时赋予透明感。发丝一根根、衣物纤维、石阶粗糙表面、叶片透光等皆细致描绘。饱和度稍高，却保有胶片照片般的柔和色调。夏日蓝天与红色气球的色彩对比，令人印象深刻。

负面提示：
不自然的五官、不自然的视线、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手脚融合、关节变形、不自然的引力、错误的透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、文字乱码、标志、水印、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤。

items.title: 虎牌啤酒温馨海港模块化海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium editorial advertising poster for Tiger Beer, designed as a warm and heartwarming harbor-world system board while preserving a strong modular archive composition. The layout must keep one dominant central hero product panel surrounded by smaller supporting panels, but the overall emotional direction should shift into a cozy, healing, cinematic animated-feature atmosphere. The final image should feel like a collectible Tiger Beer campaign poster where the product becomes the glowing lighthouse-heart of a tiny harbor world filled with warmth, gentle wonder, and premium storytelling.

Core concept:
The hero product is a hyper-real Tiger Beer bottle or can presented as the radiant centerpiece of a cozy miniature harbor universe. The product should feel like a golden harbor beacon or treasured dockside light source. Around it, smaller modular panels reveal a loving world of warm piers, tiny boats, glowing warehouse interiors, barley gardens, hop storage houses, soft foam-cloud stations, and amber liquid studies. The image must feel emotionally welcoming, magical, and refined, while always keeping Tiger Beer as the dominant focus.

Composition:
Use a vertical premium poster layout divided into elegant modular panels. The central panel must dominate and contain the main Tiger Beer product as the hero object, presented prominently and with strong visual gravity. Around it, build secondary panels showing different harbor-world modules:
a dockside amber glow panel,
a foam-cloud texture panel,
a condensation sparkle panel,
a hops-and-barley garden panel,
a warm warehouse materials panel,
a tiny supply boat scene,
and a clean bottle silhouette or product structure panel.
The overall layout must feel highly organized, balanced, and architectural, while emotionally soft and inviting.

Product realism:
Render Tiger Beer with absolute realism and premium fidelity:
crisp bottle glass or metallic can structure,
clearly visible Tiger Beer branding,
rich golden amber beer tone,
cold condensation droplets,
lively foam texture,
clean highlights,
premium label details,
and tactile packaging realism.
The hero product must remain the sharpest, coldest, and most desirable element in the entire poster, even within the whimsical harbor setting.

Cozy harbor world:
Transform the supporting system into a miniature warm harbor environment. Use tiny dock platforms, soft-lit piers, glowing storage huts, elegant cargo ropes, floating supply boats, hop gardens, barley drying racks, little lanterns, and foam-like cloud stations. Everything should feel handcrafted, cozy, and story-rich, as if the Tiger Beer product powers a charming living port. The harbor should feel intimate and warm rather than busy or cartoonish.

Supporting detail panels:
Design each surrounding module as a premium harbor-themed study related to the product:
a close-up of glowing amber liquid like harbor sunset water,
a foam texture panel interpreted like soft cloud surf,
a condensation droplet panel with sparkling freshness,
a barley and hops ingredient dock-garden,
a small warm warehouse materials panel,
a floating supply-boat panel carrying ingredients,
and a minimal structural panel showing the product form like a port beacon schematic.
All panels must feel directly connected to Tiger Beer and the harbor-world concept.

Color direction:
Use a warm premium palette of honey gold, amber, soft cream, weathered wood brown, toasted brass, warm ivory, muted sea teal, dusk blue, and gentle lantern orange. Keep the colors rich and cozy with soft cinematic gradients, avoiding harsh darkness or loud cartoon saturation.

Typography:
Use a minimal elegant English-led typography system with warm editorial spacing.
Suggested text direction:
Main title:
“TIGER BEER”
Secondary title:
“COZY HARBOR SYSTEM”
Supporting English microcopy:
“GLOW / GATHER / POUR”
“HARBOR 03 / AMBER LIGHT”
“BREWED FOR WARM NIGHTS”
If Chinese support text is included, keep it very restrained, small, and design-led. Typography should feel warm, premium, and beautifully integrated into the panel structure.

Brand coding:
Preserve Tiger Beer identity through:
clear product visibility,
golden beer tonality,
premium packaging fidelity,
and an elevated social warmth.
Preserve the modular system-board structure through:
central hero panel,
surrounding supportive modules,
clear hierarchy,
and elegant visual organization.
The emotional style should feel healing, cozy, cinematic, and premium.

Lighting:
Use soft cinematic golden lighting with warm lantern-like highlights, subtle ambient bloom, and gentle reflections across the product and harbor modules. Let the beer glow like a treasured beacon while the surrounding harbor world receives soft comforting illumination. Condensation, foam, metal, and glass must remain tactile and luxurious.

Mood:
warm, healing, cinematic, premium, cozy, magical, inviting, story-rich, collectible, luxurious, uplifting

Rendering style:
hyper-real Tiger Beer product poster, modular system-board layout, cozy harbor miniature world, premium animated-feature atmosphere, warm amber lighting, soft mist and glow, elegant editorial composition, 8k, world-class commercial image quality

Negative prompt:
dark aggressive lab mood, horror tone, literal cartoon characters, cheap toy-like harbor, cluttered composition, weak product visibility, rough typography, low-detail bottle, oversaturated childish palette, low-end animation look

prompts.text:
为虎牌啤酒（Tiger Beer）创作一张超高级的社论广告海报，设计为一个温暖且贴心的海港世界系统板，同时保留强大的模块化档案构图。布局必须保持一个主导的中央英雄产品面板，周围环绕着较小的支撑面板，但整体情感方向应转向一种温馨、治愈、电影般的动画长片氛围。最终图像应该感觉像是一张具有收藏价值的虎牌啤酒活动海报，产品成为一个充满温暖、温柔奇迹和高级叙事的小型海港世界的发光灯塔之心。

核心概念：
英雄产品是一个超真实的虎牌啤酒瓶或罐，作为温馨微型海港宇宙的辐射中心。产品应该感觉像是一个金色的海港信标或珍贵的码头光源。在它周围，较小的模块化面板展示了一个充满爱意的世界，包括温暖的码头、小船、发光的仓库内部、大麦花园、啤酒花储存屋、柔软的泡沫云站和琥珀色液体研究。图像必须在情感上令人感到受欢迎、神奇且精致，同时始终保持虎牌啤酒作为主导焦点。

构图：
使用垂直的高级海报布局，分为优雅的模块化面板。中央面板必须占据主导地位，并包含作为英雄物体的虎牌啤酒主要产品，突出显示并具有强大的视觉引力。在它周围，构建显示不同海港世界模块的次要面板：
一个码头琥珀色光芒面板，
一个泡沫云纹理面板，
一个冷凝水闪烁面板，
一个啤酒花和大麦花园面板，
一个温暖的仓库材料面板，
一个小型的补给船场景，
以及一个干净的酒瓶剪影或产品结构面板。
整体布局必须感觉高度有序、平衡且具有建筑感，同时在情感上柔软且诱人。

产品真实感：
以绝对的真实感和高级保真度渲染虎牌啤酒：
清晰的玻璃瓶或金属罐结构，
清晰可见的虎牌啤酒品牌标识，
浓郁的金琥珀色啤酒色调，
冷凝水滴，
活泼的泡沫纹理，
干净的高光，
高级标签细节，
以及触感真实的包装真实感。
即使在奇幻的海港设置中，英雄产品也必须保持是整张海报中最清晰、最冰冷、最令人向往的元素。

温馨海港世界：
将支持系统转化为一个微型的温暖海港环境。使用微型码头平台、柔光码头、发光的储存小屋、优雅的货物绳索、漂浮的补给船、啤酒花花园、大麦烘干架、小灯笼和泡沫状的云站。一切都应该感觉是手工制作的、温馨的且故事丰富的，仿佛虎牌啤酒产品为一个迷人的生活港口提供动力。海港应该感觉亲密而温暖，而不是繁忙或卡通化。

支持细节面板：
将每个周围的模块设计为与产品相关的超高级海港主题研究：
像海港落日余晖般的发光琥珀色液体的特写，
像柔软云浪般解读的泡沫纹理面板，
带有闪烁新鲜感的冷凝水滴面板，
大麦和啤酒花原料码头花园，
一个小型的温暖仓库材料面板，
一个运送原料的漂浮补给船面板，
以及一个像港口信标示意图一样展示产品形态的极简结构面板。
所有面板必须感觉与虎牌啤酒和海港世界概念直接相关。

颜色方向：
使用蜂蜜金、琥珀色、柔和奶油色、饱经风霜的木纹褐、烤黄铜色、暖象牙色、柔和的海青色、黄昏蓝和温柔的灯笼橙组成的温暖高级调色板。保持色彩浓郁且温馨，带有柔和的电影渐变，避免生硬的黑暗或高饱和度的卡通感。

排版：
使用极简优雅的英文主导排版系统，带有温暖的社论间距。
建议的文本方向：
主标题：
“TIGER BEER”
副标题：
“COZY HARBOR SYSTEM”
支持性英文微缩文案：
“GLOW / GATHER / POUR”
“HARBOR 03 / AMBER LIGHT”
“BREWED FOR WARM NIGHTS”
如果包含中文支持文本，请保持非常克制、微小且以设计为导向。排版应感觉温暖、高级，并完美融入面板结构。

品牌编码：
通过以下方式保留虎牌啤酒的身份：
清晰的产品能见度，
金色的啤酒色调，
高级包装保真度，
以及提升的社交温暖。
通过以下方式保留模块化系统板结构：
中央英雄面板，
周围的支持模块，
清晰的层级结构，
以及优雅的视觉组织。
情感风格应感觉治愈、温馨、电影化且高级。

灯光：

Vertical 4:5. An infinity pool on a high platform by the seaside in midsummer, at the moment an adult woman with a mature atmosphere is swinging her wet long black hair back in a large motion. The character is placed in the center-right lower part of the frame, with the head to waist occupying about half of the frame. Character · Expression:
An adult woman with a natural, well-proportioned bone structure. Model-like exquisite proportions and a calm adult temperament. The skin is bright and fair, delicate and smooth, with natural moisture and luster on the wet skin surface. The wet black hair reaches the waist, spreading widely to the right rear accompanied by water droplets. The face is tilted slightly upward, eyes closed, lips slightly parted, showing a serene expression. The neck is elongated, shoulders are relaxed, exuding an easy and comfortable atmosphere.

Clothing · Pose:
A simple ivory-colored halter bikini close to white. An elegant design that discards redundant decorations, tied with thin straps at the back and waist. Knees are immersed in shallow water, the waist is stretched back, and the upper body arches back gracefully. A natural and smooth contour from the chest to the waist and hips. Both arms hang naturally in front of the body, with fingertips about to touch the water surface. Due to the momentum of the hair swing, a huge arch of water is drawn towards the left side above the head.

Background · Lighting:
Evokes the scenery of a high-platform seaside hot spring resort. To the left of the background is the azure sea and a small bay, with low-rise residential buildings and inns lined up along the coast, and rolling green hills in the distance. To the right of the frame is a modern building dominated by white with large glass windows, and sheer curtains swaying slightly in the wind. Midsummer clear sky, deep blue sky with a few thin clouds. The main light source is strong natural light pouring down from the upper left. Bright highlights are dotted on the shoulders, cheeks, neck, chest, hair, and water droplets, while soft shadows fall on the right side. The blue light reflected from the pool surface gently shines on the skin and the building.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical composition 4:5, medium-long shot. An eye-level perspective slightly higher than the water surface. The person is placed in the lower half, and the hair and water splashes occupy most of the upper half. A vast empty space of sky is left in the upper left, while the building on the right tightens the overall composition. The focus falls on the face, wet hair, and water droplets. The background seaside street scene is slightly blurred to highlight the character and the water ring. A natural perspective equivalent to 35mm, with a 1/2000 second high-speed shutter to clearly freeze the water droplets.

Texture · Style:
Realistic fashion photography like a magazine resort special feature. High-definition depiction of transparent turquoise pool water, fine water droplets, the texture of wet hair strands, and natural skin shadows. A refreshing and clean color design based on white, blue, and deep green. Although the contrast is slightly high, it does not damage the premium texture of skin softness and water transparency. A photographic expression that conveys both the heat of the summer sun and the comfort of the sea breeze.

Negative:
Unnatural face, unnatural body shape, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, broken joints, unnatural gravity, poor contact between water and hair, overlapping hair strands, wrong perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
水环的对面

主体：
纵向 4:5。盛夏海边高台上的无边泳池，一位散发成熟氛围的成年女性正大幅向后甩起湿润的长黑发的那一刻。人物配置在画面中央稍偏右下方，从头部到腰部占据画面约一半。头发和水花划出巨大的弧线，向着蓝天扩散，画面上部布满透明的水滴。

人物·表情：
拥有自然匀称骨骼的成年女性。模特般的精致比例与沉稳的成人气质。肌肤明亮白皙，细腻光滑，湿润的皮肤表面带有自然的润泽与光泽。湿黑发长及腰际，裹挟水滴大幅向右后方展开。脸庞微微向上倾斜，闭上双眼，嘴唇略微张开，呈现宁静的表情。脖颈拉长，肩膀放松，流露轻松自在的氛围。

服装·姿势：
接近白色的象牙色简约露背比基尼。摒弃多余装饰的优雅设计，以细肩带在背部和腰间系结。膝盖浸在浅水中，腰部向后拉伸，上半身优美后仰。从胸口到腰部、臀部的自然流畅轮廓。双臂自然垂于身前，指尖即将触及水面。因甩发而生的冲力，在头顶向左侧绘出巨大的水之拱门。

背景·光线：
唤起海边温泉度假村的高台景色。背景左侧是蔚蓝大海与小湾，海滨沿线排列的低层住宅与旅馆，远处绵延的绿色山峦。画面右侧是以白色为主的现代建筑与大片玻璃窗，薄纱窗帘在风中微微摇曳。盛夏晴空，深邃蓝天与少许薄云。主要光源从左上方倾泻而下的强烈自然光。肩部、脸颊、脖颈、胸口、头发、水滴上点缀明亮高光，右侧则落以柔和阴影。泳池水面反射的蓝色光芒温柔地映照在肌肤与建筑上。

构图·镜头：
纵构 4:5，中长镜头。镜头从水面稍高位置的平视视角。人物置于下半部，头发与水花占据上半部大部分。左上方留出广阔天空的空白，右侧建筑收紧整体画面。焦点落在脸庞、湿发、水滴上。背景海滨街景略微虚化，突出人物与水环。相当于 35mm 的自然透视感，以 1/2000 秒高速快门将水滴清晰定格。

质感·风格：
宛如杂志度假特辑的真实时尚摄影。高清描绘透明的碧蓝色池水、细密水滴、湿发束感、自然肌肤阴影。以白、蓝、深绿为主调的清爽洁净色彩设计。虽对比度略高，却不损肌肤柔软与水之透明的上乘质感。夏日阳光的热烈与海风的舒适同时传达的摄影表达。

负面：
不自然的脸部、不自然的体型、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手足融合、关节崩坏、不自然的引力、水与发接触不良、发丝重叠、错误的透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤、文字、标志、水印。

Hero traveler (35–40% of frame): Young female traveler seated on a stone wall/culturally fitting ledge, facing viewer, warm smile. Face/hands: matte plasticine clay with fingerprints and handcrafted imperfections. Outfit: entirely crochet/yarn in [LOCATION]'s textile palette — crochet shoes, woven bag, one accessory only. Contemporary traveler, not costume caricature.
Landscape (secondary focal point): One single most-iconic [LOCATION] papercraft view — 2–3 elements max, torn/cut paper terrain, paper architecture and vegetation, visible fiber texture, layered shadow. (Single-landmark simplicity has outperformed busier multi-landmark composites.)
Sky: Sumi-e/shan-shui style ink-wash and watercolor on handmade paper — soft brush clouds, muted light, minimal birds, generous negative space.
Right-side Polaroids (≤18–20% of frame): Exactly 3, vertical: landmark, natural landscape, local food — all in the same handcrafted materials (never photographic), cream frames, deckled edges, minimal washi tape.
Bottom info strip: Torn cream paper strip with only: hand-drawn outline map + heart marker, coordinates, capital, language, time zone. Compact hand-inked icons, editorial type — no paragraphs or slogans.

Flow: Traveler → landscape → Polaroids → info strip.
Palette: One tight story — cream, kraft brown, one dominant location-accent hue, muted green, sun-faded earth tone. Max 2 accent colors.
Lighting: Warm golden-hour diorama light; shadows revealing paper thickness, yarn loops, clay fingerprints, torn fiber.

Theme:
Melting light on the water surface

Subject:
Depict a Japanese woman in her early 20s sitting on the stone edge of a bright outdoor pool. The character is positioned slightly to the right of the center, a full-body close-up portrait from head to toe. The character occupies about 70% of the frame, with a wide expanse of turquoise blue water and open negative space on the left.

Character/Expression:
Bright ivory beige-toned fair skin. Slightly pinkish healthy complexion, delicately smooth texture naturally retaining skin grain. Add soft highlights to the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones. Deep brown hair tied high and loosely in a bun, with thin see-through bangs and strands around the face. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long slender eyelashes, natural tear bags, light brown soft eyebrows, translucent pink-beige lip gloss. Small clear catchlights in the pupils. The face is slightly tilted toward the left side of the frame, lips slightly parted, gazing at the camera with a calm gaze.

Clothing/Pose:
Pale ivory bandeau-style bikini. The top has fine vertical pleats and soft three-dimensional volume, and the bottom is an elegant design with thin strings tied at the sides. The body is a well-proportioned model physique like a mature woman, with natural curves at the waist and chest, and long, slender thighs with overall balanced proportions. Sitting shallowly on the stone edge, knees bent and stretching toward the front left of the frame. The character's own left arm is bent over her head, fingertips lightly touching the bun. The right hand is placed on the stone surface beside the body, quietly supporting the weight. Shoulders and waist are slightly twisted, back leaning against a pillar.

Background/Lighting:
Outdoor pool of a Japanese modern private villa. On the right is a pale beige stone pillar, and on the left is highly transparent turquoise blue water. The middle ground features low-rise buildings combining white walls and wood, and the background has small potted trees and deep green scenery. Unobtrusive summer sunlight shines in from the upper left of the frame, illuminating the face, shoulders, chest, and upper parts of the legs. Soft shadows are retained on the stone pillar side, and blue-white light reflected from the water surface is thinly cast on the lower parts of the legs and waist.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 3:4. A full-body portrait taken from a slightly low eye level. Position the character on the right side of the frame, with the pool on the left creating a sense of depth. Equivalent to a natural compression of 70–85mm. The face and upper body are sharpest, with the background softly blurred. Toes are naturally placed at the bottom of the frame, with a small amount of white space left above the head.

Texture/Style:
High-definition realistic portrait. Bright and fresh summer vacation photo. Skin is not overly homogenized, retaining subtle texture and natural color. Water reflections, fine unevenness of the stone, bikini pleats, and individual strands of hair are all delicately depicted. Soft contrast, transparent tones dominated by pale ivory and turquoise.

Negative:
Unnatural face, juvenile body, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands/feet, broken joints, poor contact between hands and hair, floating, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, excessive skin smoothing, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:

纵向 3:4。从视线略低位置拍摄的全身肖像。将人物置于画面右侧，左侧泳池营造纵深感。相当于 70〜85mm 的自然压缩感。脸部与上半身最为锐利，背景柔和虚化。脚尖自然置于画面下部，头顶上方保留少量留白。

高精致写实肖像。明亮清新的夏日度假照片。肌肤不过度均匀化，保留细微肌理与自然血色。水面反射、石材细腻凹凸、比基尼褶皱、头发一根根皆细腻描绘。柔和对比，以淡象牙色与碧 turquoise 为主调的透明感色调。

prompts.text:
Theme:
A cat walking under the summer sky

Main Subject:
A vertical 4:5 photographic work. Set against a quiet Japanese slope leading to the sea, a woman stands slightly to the right of the center of the frame, with a huge white cumulonimbus cloud forming the shape of a cat in the sky above. The woman occupies about 40% of the lower half of the frame, and the cat in the clouds covers a wide area of the sky, presenting an overwhelming size. Emphasizing the scale difference between humans and clouds, a summer scene where reality and fantasy naturally blend.

Character · Expression:
A natural and realistic adult woman. Tall with long limbs, a well-proportioned figure like a sophisticated fashion model. Long dark brown hair with slight waves, gently blowing backward in the summer breeze. High-end Japanese-style makeup, translucent skin, soft eyebrows, and clear eyes. Her face is turned to the upper left, gazing up at the giant cat cloud. Her lips are slightly parted, with an expression mixed with surprise and quiet longing.

Clothing · Pose:
A summer maxi dress primarily in light ivory tones. Thin spaghetti straps, a not-too-deep clear V-neck, and a three-dimensional tailored fit from the chest to the waist. Detailed blue-gray botanical patterns, with a thin tie made of the same fabric at the waist. The hem is made of lightweight fabric with a discreet slit on one side, and the corners of the skirt sway slightly in the wind. A small rattan bag hangs from her right hand, while her left arm hangs naturally at her side. Her weight is placed on one leg, with the other knee slightly relaxed, presenting a composed model standing pose.

Background · Lighting:
A Japanese seaside residential area. Stone walls, low fences, old wooden houses with tiled roofs, slender utility poles and wires, and hydrangeas beside the slope. The deep blue sea and a distant peninsula are visible at the end of the slope. The sky is a rich summer blue. The giant cloud takes the form of a long-haired cat stretching its front paws, with the ears, nose, cheeks, chest, and rounded front paws naturally forming the lumps of the cumulus cloud. The cloud surface has subtle bulges and soft shadows, emphasizing its texture as a cloud rather than animal fur. Intense daytime sunlight pours down from the upper left. Bright highlights are cast on the character's shoulders, cheeks, collarbones, and the edges of her hair strands. Shadows extend toward the bottom right of the frame, with the sea surface and white walls reflecting a delicate bluish-white light.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 4:5, a medium-full shot from a slightly low angle. The woman is presented in a large proportion from above the knees to the head, while retaining enough of the slope and seaside background. The character is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, the cat cloud's face is in the upper left, and its stretched front paws point toward the upper right. About half of the upper part is used for the blue sky and clouds, with the character's line of sight and the cat cloud's face connected on a diagonal line. Equivalent to the natural compression of an 85mm lens, the character is in sharp focus, and the background is slightly blurred, but the street scene and seaside are still recognizable.

Texture · Style:
High-precision realistic photographic expression. Clear midsummer air, bright blue and white contrast, soft skin texture, natural hair strands, the translucent feel of thin fabric, and the dense texture of the rattan weave are all carefully depicted. A steady color tone like an outdoor shoot for a fashion magazine. Avoid excessive HDR or artificial skin retouching, add a small amount of film grain and natural light bloom.

Unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, over-emphasized chest, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, deformed joints, poor contact with the rattan bag, unnatural marks from fabric, unnatural sense of weight, cloud expression that looks like a plush toy, expression where the cat's outline is too hard, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

items.title: 极简工作室暗黑忍者持剑侧影

prompts.text:
[Character] Reference image 1 [Signature] There is a small Meta-operated Threads logo in the bottom right corner, with "CHAse" written in small white handwritten font, like a signature.

[Character Pose and Expression]
A dynamic and charming side-profile full-body pose kneeling on one knee on a minimalist studio floor, holding a long sword (katana) vertically. One hand holds the upper end of the hilt, and the other hand tightly grips near the handguard, gazing directly into the camera with intense tension. Like the portrayal of an assassin character in a game, the cold and indifferent eyes and tightly closed lips exude a quiet charisma.

[Character Clothing]
Overall unified in black, a modern reinterpretation of a dark ninja concept outfit. The arms and upper chest wear a sophisticated and vintage black tight bodysuit woven with vine and floral patterns, with a see-through design for the sleeve lines. The lower body is paired with a minimalist black short skirt that exposes the hip and leg lines and spreads softly to the floor, with bare feet adding a sense of narrative.

[Character Hairstyle and Makeup Details]
A waist-length, extremely long, straight dark grey-brown natural straight hairstyle, parted in the middle and falling calmly towards the back and shoulders. The makeup emphasizes the character's sharp and clear features, based on a clean matte skin expression, with delicate gradient eyeshadow and detailed cat eyeliner, and the lips are paired with a calm dried rose (MLBB) tone to complete a cold and glamorous mask.

[Lighting and Light Direction]
Soft silver studio diffused light (scattered light) seeps in from the front right side of the character (left side of the frame) as the main light source. It simultaneously three-dimensionally illuminates the character's highlighted skin surface and the yarn-woven texture of the lace fabric, while the opposite side casts soft, non-intense shadows, profoundly emphasizing the aesthetic curves of the human body and the depth of the sharp long sword's silhouette.

[Texture and Tonal Atmosphere]
The cold metallic texture of the black clothing and long sword, and the flat light grey tone of the background, blend in a minimalist way with a monochrome-centered high fashion editorial vibe. The decorative texture of the lace fabric and the perfect harmony of soft skin texture add elegance, like a page from a modern martial arts poster or art book, creating a sophisticated and restrained atmosphere.

[Film and Camera Lens Depth of Field, Angle]
Shot using an f/3.2 aperture, 1/250 second shutter speed, ISO 100, and a 50mm standard prime lens. To clearly capture the overall beauty of the seated pose on the floor and the long silhouette of the katana without distortion, it is shot as a medium-range shot from an angle slightly lower than eye-level. Maximum detail is achieved with needle-sharp focus on the subject's entire body and props.

[Background Elements (Optional)]
A minimalist matte light grey studio wall and floor without any artificial structures serve as the background. The blank space at the top right of the frame is decorated with a deep navy blue, heavy and strong oriental-style California font "katarina" title logo, below which the English typography "BLANC" and a small placeholder text are neatly overlaid, showing a level of completion like a design nameplate or a fashion magazine cover.

prompts.text:
[人物] 参考图像 1 [签名] 右下角位置有一个小型的由 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志，上面以白色手写体小字写着“CHAse”，如同签名般。  

[人物的姿势及表情]  
在极简工作室地板上单膝跪坐，将长剑（武士刀）垂直直立握住的动态而迷人的侧面全身姿势。一只手握住剑柄（hilt）上端，另一只手紧握护手附近，目光直视前方镜头，充满强烈张力。仿佛游戏中暗杀者角色的演绎，冷峻而无动于衷的眼神与紧闭的嘴唇散发着静谧的领袖魅力。  

[人物服装]  
整体以黑色统一，现代重新诠释的黑暗忍者概念服装。双臂和胸部上半部分穿着精致而复古的藤蔓及花卉图案编织的黑色紧身连体服，袖线采用透视设计。下身为暴露髋部和腿部线条、柔和褶皱散开至地面的极简黑色短裙搭配，赤足增添叙事感。  

[人物发型及妆容细节]  
以中分梳理，向后背及肩侧平静垂落的及腰极长笔直深灰棕色自然直发造型。妆容为强调人物锐利清晰五官，在干净哑光肌肤表现基础上，绘制精致渐层眼影和细致猫眼眼线，唇部搭配沉稳的干玫瑰（MLBB）色调，完成冷艳面具。  

[照明及光线方向]  
人物右侧正面（画面基准左侧）渗入柔和的银色工作室漫射光（分散光）作为主光源。同时立体照亮人物高光肌肤表面与蕾丝面料的纱线编织纹理，反向侧则投下不强烈的柔和阴影，深刻强调人体造型曲线美与锐利长剑的剪影深度感。  

[质感与色调氛围]  
黑色服装与长剑的冷峻金属质感，以及背景的扁平浅灰色调，以极简方式融合的单色调中心高时尚编辑氛围。蕾丝面料的装饰性纹理与柔和肌肤质感的完美和谐增添优雅，仿佛现代武侠海报或艺术书的一页，营造精致而克制的氛围。  

[胶片及相机镜头景深、角度]  
使用光圈 f/3.2、快门速度 1/250 秒、ISO 100、焦距 50mm 标准定焦镜头拍摄。为了清晰捕捉无失真地呈现坐于地面的整体造型美与武士刀的长剪影，以略低于眼平线（Eye-level）的角度拍摄中景。对被摄体全身与道具以刀刃般锐利清晰的焦点最大化细节。  

[背景元素（可选）]  
无任何人工结构物的极简哑光浅灰（Light Grey）调工作室墙壁与地板作为背景。画面右侧上方空白空间配以深海军蓝厚重而强烈的东方风加利福尼亚字体“katarina”标题标志，其下方以英文排版“BLANC”及小型占位符文本整齐叠加，展现如设计铭牌或时尚杂志封面般的完成度。

prompts.text: Create a vertical 9:16 modern-office group portrait containing exactly seven clearly adult women, approximately 23 to 30 years old. Two women stand in the back row and lean subtly toward the center, while five women sit closely together on pale office chairs or a bench in the foreground. Every subject looks naturally toward a camera positioned low and directly in front of them. Preserve seven distinct faces with believable facial variation, slight asymmetry, subtly different smiles and individual head angles. Do not create repeated faces or a single cloned beauty template.  Their outfits are coordinated without being perfectly identical: warm-white, ivory or neutral-white collared button-up shirts, fitted but not tight, tucked into charcoal, dark-gray or black high-waisted short pencil skirts. Some sleeves are rolled to the forearms, collars open naturally by one or two buttons, and the shirts remain fully opaque with realistic folds around the shoulders, elbows and waist. Every leg is fully covered by thin smoke-black sheer tights. Believable knee, thigh and calf contours remain visible beneath the hosiery, but the legs must never become bare, thigh-high stockings or over-the-knee socks. Add pointed patent-leather stiletto pumps, mostly glossy black, with two or three vivid red patent heels or red soles creating a restrained red-and-black visual rhythm across the lower frame.  The five seated women form the dominant foreground with crossed, parallel or diagonally extended legs. The central woman sits most upright with her hands resting naturally together near her lap. A woman with airy straight bangs rests one cheek on her hand. A long-haired woman on the right lightly supports her chin. The far-right subject leans inward with one or both hands close to her chin. The back-left woman has long deep-chestnut waves and raises one hand toward her hair. Preserve uneven seat heights, slightly offset shoulder lines, natural body occlusion, overlapping legs and partial cropping of the edge subjects. Every arm, hand, finger, knee, leg and shoe must remain clearly connected and anatomically plausible.  Hair colors include natural black, black-brown and deep chestnut. Use varied hairstyles such as side-parted waves, long center-parted straight hair, shoulder-length straight hair, neat airy bangs, long middle-parted S-waves and a loose half-up hairstyle with face-framing strands. Hair should feel smooth yet weighted, with visible part lines, fine flyaways and slightly separated ends. Avoid identical plastic gloss. Makeup follows contemporary East Asian urban-office and soft Korean beauty styling: lightweight semi-matte foundation, gently straight brows, thin brown-black eyeliner, clean separated lashes, muted peach or rose blush, and coral, dusty-rose or soft-pink lips. Avoid oversized eyes, heavy contouring and dramatic glam makeup.  Clearly visible skin is limited to faces, ears, necks, small areas of collarbone and upper chest inside the shirt collars, wrists, forearms and hands. Chests, waists, hips, buttocks and legs remain covered by clothing or tights. Use naturally varied fair-to-light warm skin tones with neutral, peach or faint rosy undertones. The skin should appear and feel soft, fine-grained, clean and semi-matte, like lightly moisturized skin beneath a thin foundation layer. Retain faint pores, subtle under-eye texture and hand-joint detail rather than waxy or plastic skin.  Place the camera near floor or lower-shin height and tilt it upward by approximately 5 to 10 degrees from directly in front. Use a close shooting distance and a 20 to 26 mm full-frame equivalent wide-angle lens, making the foreground legs and shoes visibly larger than the upper bodies while avoiding fisheye distortion or severe stretching at the edges. The image should resemble a rear-smartphone-camera group photo with mild computational HDR and restrained beauty processing, or a full-frame wide-angle photograph with similar rendering. Keep the image clean and sharp while retaining extremely fine sensor grain, uneven highlights, fabric creases and small human imperfections. Use moderately deep focus so all seven faces, the tights-covered legs and the foreground shoes remain substantially sharp, with focus biased slightly toward the central woman and no heavy background blur.  Set the scene in a bright, orderly modern office lounge or meeting area. Include a white suspended ceiling with several circular recessed downlights, pale cabinetry or office partitions on the left, a bright window or glass opening on the right, light-beige chairs, and a polished dark floor with pale abstract stone or marble-like patterns. Broad white ceiling illumination combines with slightly cooler daylight entering from the right, producing a mixed color temperature around 4300 to 5000K. Create gentle physical highlights on foreheads, noses, cheeks and forearms, with shallow gray shadows beneath jaws and around eye sockets. Sheer tights and patent shoes should carry controlled linear and point-like reflections without clipping, while soft shadows and blurred reflections appear under the chairs and across the polished floor.  The scene should feel like seven familiar coworkers who had just gathered for an impromptu office portrait. The shutter has already been pressed, yet they are still holding their chin-resting gestures, crossed legs and subtle inward leans. In the next moment, their hands may lower and the overlapping legs may shift. Keep the atmosphere bright, friendly, quietly confident and moderately polished, while preserving the accidental irregularity and emotional residue of a real human photograph.

prompts.text: 创建一个垂直 9:16 的现代办公室团体肖像，其中包含正好七名清晰的成年女性，年龄约 23 至 30 岁。两名女性站在后排并微妙地向中心倾斜，而五名女性在前景紧凑地坐在浅色办公椅或长凳上。每个主体都自然地望向位于正前方低处的相机。保持七张不同的面孔，具有可信的面部变化、轻微的不对称、微妙不同的笑容和各异的头部角度。不要创建重复的面孔或单一的克隆选美模板。她们的服装相互协调但并非完全相同：暖白色、象牙色或中性白色的翻领纽扣衬衫，合身但不紧身，塞进木炭色、深灰色或黑色高腰短铅笔裙中。一些袖子卷到前臂，衣领自然解开一两颗纽扣，衬衫保持完全不透明，肩膀、肘部和腰部周围有真实的褶皱。每条腿都完全被薄薄的烟黑色透明连裤袜覆盖。在袜类下仍能看到可信的膝盖、大腿和小腿轮廓，但腿部绝对不能变成裸露、大腿袜或过膝袜。添加尖头漆皮细高跟鞋，主要是光亮的黑色，带有两到三个鲜艳的红色漆皮鞋跟或红色鞋底，在画面下方营造出克制且红黑相间的视觉节奏。坐在前面的五名女性构成了主要的前景，腿部交叉、平行或对角延伸。中间的女性坐得最直，双手自然地合拢在膝盖附近。一名留着轻薄平刘海的女性单手托腮。右侧一名长发女性轻扶下巴。最右侧的主体向内倾斜，一只手或双手靠近下巴。左后方的女性留着深栗色长波浪发，一只手举向头发。保留不均匀的座位高度、略微错开的肩线、自然的身体遮挡、重叠的腿部以及边缘主体的部分裁剪。每只手臂、手、手指、膝盖、腿和鞋子都必须保持清晰连接且符合解剖学原理。发色包括自然黑、黑褐色和深栗色。使用多样的发型，如侧分波浪发、长中分直发、齐肩直发、整洁的轻薄刘海、长中分 S 型波浪发和带有修饰脸型发丝的蓬松半扎发。头发应该感觉光滑但有重量感，有可见的分缝线、细微的碎发和略微散开的发尾。避免千篇一律的塑料光泽。妆容遵循当代东亚都市办公室和柔和韩系审美风格：轻盈的半哑光底妆、平缓的直眉、细细的棕黑色眼线、干净分明的睫毛、柔和的蜜桃色或玫瑰色腮红，以及珊瑚色、枯玫瑰色或软粉色的嘴唇。避免过大的眼睛、浓重的修容和戏剧性的华丽妆容。清晰可见的皮肤仅限于脸部、耳朵、脖子、衬衫领口内小面积的锁骨和上胸部、手腕、前臂和手。胸部、腰部、臀部、臀部和腿部都被衣服或连裤袜覆盖。使用自然多样的白皙至浅色暖色调皮肤，带有中性、蜜桃或淡淡的玫瑰色底色。皮肤应该看起来和感觉到柔软、纹理细腻、干净且呈半哑光状态，就像在薄薄的底妆层下轻微滋润过的皮肤。保留淡淡的毛孔、微妙的眼下纹理和手部关节细节，而不是蜡质或塑料感的皮肤。将相机放置在靠近地板或小腿下部的高度，并从正前方向上倾斜约 5 到 10 度。使用近距离拍摄距离和 20 至 26 毫米全画幅等效广角镜头，使前景的腿和鞋子看起来明显比上半身大，同时避免鱼眼畸变或边缘处的严重拉伸。图像应类似于带有轻微计算 HDR 和克制美颜处理的智能手机后置摄像头团体照，或具有类似渲染效果的全画幅广角照片。保持图像干净锐利，同时保留极细微的传感器噪点、不均匀的高光、织物褶皱和微小的人类瑕疵。使用中等深景深，使所有七张脸、穿着连裤袜的腿和前景的鞋子都保持基本清晰，焦点略微偏向中间的女性，没有沉重的背景虚化。场景设置在明亮、整洁的现代办公室休息区或会议区。包括带有几个圆形嵌入式筒灯的白色吊顶、左侧的浅色橱柜或办公隔断、右侧明亮的窗户或玻璃开口、浅米色椅子，以及带有浅色抽象石材或大理石纹理的抛光深色地板。宽大的白色天花板照明与从右侧进入的略冷的日光相结合，产生约 4300 到 5000K 的混合色温。在额头、鼻子、脸颊和前臂上营造柔和的物理高光，在下颌下方和眼窝周围形成浅灰色的阴影。透明连裤袜和漆皮鞋应带有受控的线状和点状反射而无过曝，同时椅子下方和抛光地板上会出现柔和的阴影和模糊的反射。场景感觉应该像是七位刚聚在一起拍摄临时办公室肖像的熟识同事。快门已经按下，但她们仍然保持着托腮的手势、交叉的双腿和微妙的向内倾斜。在下一刻，她们的手可能会放下，重叠的双腿可能会移动。保持氛围明亮、友好、沉稳自信且适度精致，同时保留真实人类照片的偶然不规则感和情感余韵。

Create an ultra-premium editorial advertising poster for Dulux, centered on one oversized hyper-real paintbrush as the absolute hero object, combined with a real animal interacting playfully and naturally with the brush. The image must feel minimalist, witty, visually striking, and highly premium, with a pure-color background, refined typography, and strong product-led composition. The final result should look like a world-class Dulux campaign poster where the animal and paint become one elegant visual idea.

Core concept:
The hero composition features a giant realistic paintbrush standing vertically in the center of the frame. A hyper-real chameleon clings naturally around the brush handle and bristle area, using its body to create the central visual metaphor of color transformation. The animal must feel completely real and tactile, while its body color transitions smoothly from its natural vivid green tones near the top into rich Dulux blue tones near the lower body and tail, as if the paint has transformed or inspired its coloration. The image should feel intelligent, playful, clean, and premium.

Composition:
Use a vertical luxury poster layout with a pure light neutral background. Place one oversized paintbrush centrally with strong clean negative space around it. The chameleon should wrap itself around the brush in a graceful, believable pose, with its claws gripping the handle and ferrule, and its tail curling elegantly around the lower section. The lower bristles should be dipped into glossy rich paint, with a few perfectly controlled drips falling downward. The overall composition must be calm, graphic, iconic, and immediately readable.

Product realism:
Render the paintbrush with absolute realism:
natural wood handle,
premium metallic ferrule,
fine realistic bristle texture,
glossy wet paint coating,
clean paint weight and viscosity,
and believable paint drips.
The brush must feel like a premium painter’s tool, tactile and physically grounded.

Animal realism:
Render the chameleon with extreme realism and fine biological detail:
sharp textured scales,
subtle skin translucency,
clear eye structure,
natural grip tension in the claws,
realistic musculature,
and elegant tail curvature.
The animal must feel alive and captivating, not cartoonish. Its pose should be calm and confident, as if it belongs on the brush.

Color transformation logic:
The color change across the animal must be the key visual story. Preserve realistic chameleon patterning while allowing a graceful transition from natural greens and warm accents into Dulux-inspired blue paint tones. The transition should feel smooth and intelligent, not artificial. The lower body and tail may reflect stronger paint influence, visually tying the animal to the dipped brush and the paint below.

Paint treatment:
Use extremely clean, premium paint behavior. The paint should be rich, glossy, and thick, coating the lower bristles with luxurious realism. Add only a few perfectly shaped drips to keep the composition elegant. The paint must connect visually with the animal’s color transformation, suggesting creativity, reinvention, and joy in color.

Background:
Use a clean pure-color or soft warm-neutral background with no clutter. The background should feel premium and spacious, allowing the brush, animal, and paint to dominate fully. Keep the field minimal and smooth, with subtle tonal refinement only.

Typography:
Use an elegant minimal English-led typography system with a refined Chinese subtitle.
Suggested text direction:
Main English title:
“COLOR, NATURALLY.”
Chinese subtitle:
“色彩，自然发生”
Supporting English copy:
“Real color changes everything.”
Typography should be sparse, modern, and premium, placed with generous spacing and never competing with the central image.

Brand coding:
Preserve Dulux identity through:
premium paint-tool realism,
confident use of color,
clean global advertising polish,
minimal composition,
and a clear branded product packshot in the lower corner.
Include a hyper-real Dulux paint can or bucket in a restrained lower corner placement, with clean logo visibility and balanced scale.

Lighting:
Use soft studio-quality lighting with refined highlights on the chameleon scales, brush ferrule, paint gloss, and wood texture. The lighting must feel clean, controlled, and luxurious, with no harsh shadows and no visual mess.

playful, premium, clean, intelligent, striking, elegant, tactile, globally branded, minimalist, fresh

She had originally picked up the phone to check a notification. After seeing herself in the front camera, she impulsively opens Instagram and takes one photo. Her eyes are looking at her own image on the screen rather than perfectly into the lens, then shifting slightly upward toward the camera. The strongest Instagram-worthy visual hook is the last warm coral-orange summer sunset entering from a balcony window outside the selfie frame. The low side light falls across only one side of her cheek and shoulder, creating a soft warm gradient on her realistic skin. A small glass of iced barley tea catches the sunset and throws a faint amber reflection onto the pale wall behind her. The dusty-rose shirt, pale green blanket, warm wood table, and amber evening light create an accidental but extremely pleasing muted summer color palette. The phone is a little farther to her left than ideal, producing mild ordinary smartphone perspective and a slightly imperfect crop. Her face sits in the upper-left third rather than exactly centered. Part of her raised forearm enters awkwardly from the lower corner. The bed, drink, and warm wall reflection remain visible behind her, giving the selfie visual depth and an Instagram-worthy composition without looking professionally planned.

Photorealistic natural iPhone selfie, casual front-camera image, subtle front-camera detail processing, realistic skin texture, mild smartphone sharpening around eyelashes and hair, slight noise in the darker background, subtle compression, minor exposure inconsistency between the bright sunset side of her face and the room, slightly clipped highlight on the glass rim, tiny missed focus on a loose strand of hair. prompts.text:

她侧坐在低矮床铺的边缘，一条腿随意地弯曲在床垫上，另一条腿则靠近地板。由于她刚刚拿起手机准备快拍一张自拍，她的躯干略微扭转。一只肩膀随着握着iPhone的手臂自然抬起，而另一只肩膀保持放松。她的姿势并非精心安排；她的体重略微压入床垫，产生了可信的不对称感。

縦長9:16の室内ポートレート。画面中央に20代の自然で現実感のある女性が大きく写り、上半身から太もも上までを低い位置から見上げる構図。人物は画面の約8割を占め、左側に大きな窓、右奥にベッドと小さな壁飾りが入る。白とアイボリーを基調にした、やわらかな朝の空気が漂う一枚。

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだなめらかな肌質。頬、鼻先、肩、鎖骨に柔らかなハイライトが入り、過度な美肌補正ではなく自然な肌理を残す。淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの柔らかい眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロスリップ。瞳に小さく澄んだキャッチライト。視線は画面右上の窓外へ向け、唇は少しだけ開き、眠気が残るような静かな表情。髪は明るいミルクティーアッシュブラウン。薄めのシースルーバング、顔まわりに沿うレイヤーカット、肩下までのミディアムロング。毛先は内側にゆるくカールし、ふんわりした空気感と自然な束感がある。細いハイライト、柔らかなツヤ、少量の自然な後れ毛を丁寧に描写する。

服装・ポーズ：
アイボリーのリブ素材クロップドキャミソール。胸元に小さなボタンと控えめなレース縁があり、柔らかい布地が身体に沿って自然な丸みと立体感を作る。裾はバスト下あたりで止まり、鎖骨、肩、上腹部、ウエストラインが朝光でなめらかに見える。下は同系色の居家用ショートパンツ。ウエストはゴム仕様で、中央に細い紐のリボン結び。裾に小さなフリルがあり、布地には細かな凹凸と柔らかなシワがある。アクセサリーは目立たせず、全体を清潔で日系の部屋着スタイルにまとめる。
左腕は頭上へ伸ばし、肘が画面右上に大きく入る。右腕も上げて後頭部付近に回し、首から肩、脇、腰にかけてゆるやかなS字のラインを作る。腰はわずかに画面左へ反らせ、上半身は窓側へひねる。腹部は自然に引き締まり、過度な筋肉表現ではなく柔らかく健康的な体型。

背景・光：
明るい朝の寝室。画面左に白い木枠の大きな窓と薄いシアーカーテンがあり、窓外には青空が淡く見える。後景には白い壁、木製の小さな棚、観葉植物、ぼかされたポストカード、ぬいぐるみ、ベッドリネンが配置される。文字は読めない程度にぼかす。主光源は左上の窓から入る暖かい自然光。人物の左肩、髪、頬、胸元、腹部、ショートパンツの紐に明るいハイライトが入り、右側へ柔らかな影が落ちる。カーテン越しの拡散光と直射光が混ざり、白い布や肌に淡い反射光が回る。

構図・カメラ：
縦構図、スマートフォン写真のような自然な近距離感。カメラは腰より少し低い位置から軽く見上げる。人物の顔は画面上部右寄り、ウエストとショートパンツは画面下部中央。左側の窓で縦の奥行きを作り、右奥の壁飾りとベッドは浅い被写界深度で柔らかくぼかす。焦点は顔、髪、胸元の服地、腹部の肌質、パンツのリボンに自然に合う。背景は明るく溶け、人物だけが立体的に浮かぶ。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな写真表現。日系ポートレート、朝の自然光、柔らかいコントラスト、透明感のある肌、布地のリブ感、細かな髪の流れ、淡いフィルムライクな粒子。色調はアイボリー、クリーム、淡いベージュ、ミルクティーブラウン、窓の薄いブルーを中心にまとめる。過度に派手な加工ではなく、雑誌の朝時間特集のような落ち着いた仕上がり。

ネガティブ：
未成年に見える人物、不自然な顔、不自然な視線、過度な性的表現、露骨な裸、下着だけの表現、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、脇や首の不自然な変形、衣服と身体の接触不良、布の浮遊、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。
