prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium editorial campaign board for Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 in a “Miele Red Signature” direction, designed as a luxury four-panel horizontal home-lifestyle poster system. The image must feel hyper-real, architectural, refined, and unmistakably premium, combining four distinct domestic cleaning scenarios into one cohesive branded campaign layout. The final result should look like a world-class Miele advertising master visual, not a generic appliance catalog or e-commerce collage.

Core concept:
The hero is the Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 cordless vacuum system, presented across four different real home environments and usage situations, with the iconic Miele red acting as the subtle visual signature unifying the entire campaign. Each panel should communicate a different cleaning function, lifestyle need, and product benefit, while the product remains the dominant visual focus. The overall board should express German precision, quiet luxury, modular intelligence, and beautifully controlled modern living.

Composition:
Use a premium four-panel campaign board made of four stacked horizontal scenes. Each panel must feel clearly different in environment, action, and function, yet all four should belong to one consistent luxury design language. Use elegant spacing, clean negative space, disciplined typography placement, and strong product hierarchy.
The four panels should be:
1. extreme close-up floor pickup action,
2. refined real living-room lifestyle scene,
3. premium modular product display still life,
4. close-up handheld or detail-cleaning function scene.
Across all four panels, integrate restrained red accents that echo Miele’s identity, such as a red chair, a red throw, a red book spine, a fine red line graphic, a red object in the background, or a controlled red surface detail. These red elements must feel deliberate, sparse, and luxurious.

Panel 1 – Fine Dust Precision:
Show a hyper-real close-up of the Miele Triflex floorhead vacuuming fine dust, crumbs, and powder across a dark premium hard floor. The suction path should feel crisp and highly believable, with elegant debris flow and exceptional floorhead detail. Use a dramatic close angle and subtle directional light to emphasize engineering precision.
Introduce one restrained Miele red accent in the environment or in a precision graphic line, keeping the product as the main focus.

Panel 2 – Real Living Space:
Show a luxurious modern living room with a healthy athletic Western female model using the Miele Triflex in a believable premium lifestyle moment. The room should feel warm, calm, and architecturally clean, with refined furniture, soft textiles, and spacious composition. The vacuum should be actively used on a rug or floor area, with realistic posture and natural movement.
Integrate a Miele red signature through one elegant object such as a cushion, chair detail, throw blanket, or art accent. The red must act as a visual anchor, not a distraction.

Panel 3 – Modular Design Display:
Create a sculptural product-led still-life panel that showcases the Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 system, attachments, and modular flexibility in a luxury interior setting. The arrangement should feel like a premium industrial design presentation: clean, balanced, and highly intentional. Emphasize form, engineering, and component elegance.
Use a very controlled red signature element, such as a red platform edge, red spine book, red accessory cue, or minimal red graphic line to reinforce brand recall.

Panel 4 – Handheld Precision Detail:
Show a close-up functional use scene in handheld mode cleaning upholstery, sofa creases, stairs, or tight interior corners. Focus on tactile realism: fabric texture, dust pickup, transparent dust canister detail, and the refined ergonomics of the product in use. The framing should feel intimate, precise, and elegant.
Place one small but sharp Miele red detail in the scene, such as a nearby design object or a clean linear graphic marker.

Product realism:
Render the Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 with absolute realism and exact premium-brand fidelity:
accurate cordless vacuum proportions,
refined body geometry,
authentic floorhead engineering,
true dust canister transparency,
premium matte and satin surface transitions,
accurate handle and wand construction,
realistic attachments,
subtle metallic detailing,
and unmistakable Miele design language.
The product must feel engineered, luxurious, durable, and physically real, with perfect industrial-design clarity.

Environment styling:
Use four different but visually related premium home environments:
dark charcoal flooring,
warm taupe walls,
soft stone-grey textiles,
modern architectural furniture,
clean shelving,
minimal clutter,
and sophisticated spatial composition.
All interiors should feel global, high-end, and calm. Every scene must be elegant enough to support the product and brand without becoming sterile.

People direction:
If people appear, use healthy athletic Western adult models with natural editorial beauty, non-influencer faces, and believable body language. Their role is to support the product story, not overpower it. Styling should be luxurious minimal homewear: knitwear, lounge tailoring, soft contemporary basics, neutral tones, and refined domestic elegance.

Typography:
Use only elegant English typography with strong premium campaign hierarchy.
Possible title directions:
“MIELE TRIFLEX HX1 / HX2”
“THE RED SIGNATURE OF PRECISION”
“ONE SYSTEM. FOUR MOMENTS.”
“CLEANING, REFINED.”
“ENGINEERED FOR EVERYDAY LUXURY”
Use one strong clean master title and then smaller feature labels across the four panels, such as:
“Fine Dust Pickup”
“Living Room Reach”
“Modular Freedom”
“Handheld Precision”
Typography should be modern, minimal, and beautifully spaced, with subtle red graphic punctuation lines or dividers to strengthen the brand system.

Graphic accents:
Add extremely restrained premium graphic marks only where useful:
fine red divider lines,
small callout marks,
minimal arrows,
subtle feature indicators,
clean modular labels.
These accents must feel intelligent and technical, never noisy or gimmicky.

Brand coding:
Preserve Miele identity through:
German precision,
quiet luxury,
timeless engineering,
high-performance domestic care,
modular intelligence,
and refined premium living.
The campaign should communicate that Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 is a beautifully engineered design object integrated into elevated modern life.

Lighting:
Use exquisitely soft high-end interior lighting with delicate shadow transitions and controlled highlights. Each panel should have slightly different lighting behavior according to the environment, but all must feel unified by premium realism and tactile calm. The vacuum body, floor textures, rug fibers, upholstery, and dust details should all be rendered with exceptional softness and clarity.

Color direction:
Use a restrained Miele luxury palette built around:
graphite black,
deep charcoal,
warm greige,
soft taupe,
stone grey,
clean ivory,
and precisely controlled Miele red accents.
The red should never dominate the full scene; it should function as a premium signature cue that creates brand memory and visual rhythm across the board.

Mood:
premium, precise, architectural, intelligent, hyper-real, calm, luxurious, product-led, tactile, modern, editorial, refined, distinctly branded.

Rendering style:
hyper-real Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 luxury campaign board, four stacked horizontal home-environment panels, refined modern interiors, real product usage, modular product display, elegant English typography, restrained Miele red signature accents, soft premium interior lighting, world-class appliance advertising realism, 8k.

Negative prompt:
generic appliance catalog, cheap retail flyer, cluttered home scene, wrong vacuum proportions, plastic-looking materials, exaggerated mess, cartoon dust, low-detail floorhead, weak product focus, messy typography, influencer lifestyle aesthetic, bad anatomy, bright cheap red overload, overdecorated layout, low-end e-commerce collage

为 Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 创建一个超高端的编辑级活动看板，采用“Miele Red Signature（美诺红签名）”方向，设计为豪华的四面板横向家居生活方式海报系统。图像必须具有超写实感、建筑感、精致且无可置疑的高端感，将四个不同的家庭清洁场景组合成一个统一的品牌活动布局。最终结果应该看起来像世界一流的美诺广告主视觉，而不是普通的家电目录或电子商务拼贴。

核心概念：
主角是 Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 无绳吸尘器系统，展示在四种不同的真实家庭环境和使用情况下，标志性的美诺红作为细微的视觉签名统一整个活动。每个面板应传达不同的清洁功能、生活方式需求和产品优势，同时产品保持核心视觉焦点。整个看板应表达德国精密、静谧奢华、模块化智能和优美受控的现代生活。

构图：
使用由四个堆叠的横向场景组成的优质四面板活动看板。每个面板的环境、动作和功能必须明显不同，但四个面板都应属于一种一致的奢华设计语言。使用优雅的间距、干净的负空间、严谨的排版布局和强大的产品层次结构。
四个面板应为：
1. 极端特写的地面吸尘动作，
2. 精致的真实客厅生活场景，
3. 高端模块化产品展示静物，
4. 手持或细节清洁功能的特写场景。
在所有四个面板中，融入克制的红色点缀，呼应美诺的身份，例如红色椅子、红色披肩、红色书脊、精细的红色线条图形、背景中的红色物品或受控的红色表面细节。这些红色元素必须感觉是刻意的、稀疏的且奢华的。

面板 1 – 微尘精准：
展示 Miele Triflex 地刷在深色高端硬质地板上吸走微尘、碎屑和粉末的超写实特写。吸尘路径应感觉清晰且高度可信，具有优雅的碎片流动和卓越的地刷细节。使用戏剧性的特写角度和微妙的方向性光线来强调工程精度。
在环境或精密图形线条中引入一种克制的美诺红点缀，保持产品为主要焦点。

面板 2 – 真实生活空间：
展示一个豪华的现代客厅，一位健康运动型的西方女性模特在可信的高端生活瞬间使用 Miele Triflex。房间应感觉温暖、平静且建筑风格整洁，配有精致的家具、柔软的纺织品和宽敞的构图。吸尘器应主动在小地毯或地板区域使用，具有逼真的姿势和自然的动作。
通过靠垫、椅子细节、毯子或艺术装饰等一个优雅的物体整合美诺红签名。红色必须作为视觉锚点，而不是干扰。

面板 3 – 模块化设计展示：
创建一个以产品为主导的雕塑感静物面板，在豪华室内环境中展示 Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 系统、附件和模块化灵活性。排列应感觉像高端工业设计演示：干净、平衡且高度有意图。强调形式、工程和组件的优雅。
使用非常受控的红色签名元素，例如红色平台边缘、红色书脊、红色配件提示或极简红色图形线条来加强品牌记忆。

面板 4 – 手持精准细节：
展示手持模式下清洁室内装潢、沙发褶皱、楼梯或狭窄室内角落的功能使用特写场景。专注于触觉真实感：织物纹理、吸尘情况、透明集尘桶细节以及产品使用中的精致人体工程学。取景应感觉亲密、精确且优雅。
在场景中放置一个微小但尖锐的美诺红细节，例如附近的装饰品或干净的线性图形标记。

产品真实感：
以绝对的真实感和精确的高端品牌忠诚度渲染 Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2：
准确的无绳吸尘器比例、
精致的机身几何形状、
真实的底刷工程、
真实的集尘桶透明度、
高端哑光和缎面表面过渡、
准确的手柄和长杆结构、
真实的附件、
细微的金属细节、

产品必须让人感到经过工程设计、奢华、耐用且物理真实，具有完美的工业设计清晰度。

环境造型：
使用四种不同但视觉相关的优质家居环境：
深炭灰色地板、
温暖的灰褐色墙壁、
柔软的石灰色纺织品、
现代建筑风格家具、
整洁的置物架、

所有室内设计都应感觉国际化、高端且平静。每个场景都必须足够优雅，以支持产品和品牌，而不会变得冷淡。

排版：

德国精密、
静谧奢华、
永恒工程、

光照：
使用极其柔和的高端室内光照，具有微妙的阴影过渡和受控的高光。每个面板应根据环境有稍微不同的光照表现，但所有面板都必须通过高端真实感和触觉平静统一起来。吸尘器机身、地板纹理、地毯纤维、装饰织物和灰尘细节都应以卓越的柔软度和清晰度渲染。

Adopting a medium-shot composition from the upper body to the thighs, the character is located center-left of the frame, and the lens is slightly higher than the sofa cushion but maintains a nearly eye-level view, using a 50mm to 85mm portrait lens feel. The frame retains the subject's upper body, waist/hips, and overlapping legs, avoiding wide-angle perspective and exaggerated body proportions. The dark sofa forms a stable horizontal composition, and the subject's body forms a soft diagonal line, giving the image a natural cinematic storyboard feel.

The scene is located in a low-light modern living room, with a dark gray-black wall and minimalist furnishings in the background. A small warm-toned wall lamp or floor lamp is set at the back right or back left, forming only a small, restrained amber halo; the lamp itself is not overly bright. Most of the background area sinks into delicate shadows, retaining the faint texture of the wall, the leather texture of the sofa, and realistic spatial depth, without cluttered furniture or bright home displays.

Using a realistic low-key cinematic lighting system. The main light comes from a beam of soft, directionally clear cool neutral weak light from the front-side or top-side of the frame, focusing on illuminating the subject's face, collarbones, chest-waist silhouette, hands, and the front of the thighs; the rear-side warm lamp only serves as ambient light and background layering, not directly illuminating the whole body. The side of the character closer to the main light has soft highlights, while the other side naturally enters deep gray shadows, forming a clear but not harsh chiaroscuro relationship.

In the overall low-light environment, extremely weak and restrained facial reflection fill light is added to keep the eyes, bridge of the nose, mid-face, lips, and jawline contour clear. The eyes retain tiny natural catchlights but do not use large-area circular catchlights typical of commercial studio photography. The facial brightness is slightly higher than the clothes and background; there is no dead black under the eyes, the mid-face does not appear gray, and the features are not swallowed by shadows.

The overall grading uses a low-saturation cinematic style with dark gray tones and subtle cool-warm contrast. The character and the sofa are dominated by cool gray, charcoal black, and dark gray; the background lighting retains a small amount of low-saturation amber warmth, forming a restrained cool-warm relationship, but the whole image cannot be overall yellow. The skin tone is naturally neutral, retaining realistic blood color, not pale, not orange-yellow, and not oily.

Realistic photography lens rendering, natural depth of field, the focus falls on the character's face and upper body; the hands and thighs remain sufficiently clear, and the background lamps and walls are slightly softened but still recognizable. The bokeh is natural, the edges have slight optical fall-off and restrained vignetting, and excessive creamy blur is not used.

The character's skin retains natural pores, subtle skin undulations, slight lip lines, realistic eye area textures, and soft skin highlights. The arms, knees, and thighs retain realistic joint structures and natural skin textures; there is no plasticized skin smoothing or wax figure feel. The knit fabric needs to present fine fibers and natural wrinkles, and the sofa retains the leather texture and slight wear feel under low light.

Adding delicate film grain, natural photographic noise, soft micro-contrast, slight color shift, deep but layered shadows, and real optical texture. The overall atmosphere is quiet, mature, restrained, private, and high-end, with a slight sense of loneliness and narrative blank space, like an indoor still frame from an independent movie or an urban emotional film, rather than a commercial portrait studio shot, fashion e-commerce image, or a deliberately sexy photoshoot.

prompts.text: Create a realistic late-night social-media portrait of an adult woman seated on a low, soft, deep-charcoal velvet sofa. Her body faces mostly forward, her upper torso remains upright without becoming rigid, her shoulders are relaxed, and her head is gently tilted to one side. She looks directly into the lens with bright, calm, steady eyes. Her lips remain naturally closed with only the faintest upward curve, as though she had just relaxed a moment before the shutter was pressed.  Preserve a soft oval face, a narrow refined jawline, large clear eyes, a small delicate nose, and naturally full lips. Use Korean idol-inspired evening glamour only as a makeup and styling language, not as a claim of identity: fine dark brows, softly blended taupe-brown eyeshadow, delicate lifted eyeliner, long separated lashes, subtle under-eye brightness, and pink-peach blush extending across the cheeks and slightly beneath the eyes. Add controlled highlights to the nose bridge, nose tip, cheekbones, and cupid's bow. Use glossy rose-nude lips. The complexion should be bright and softly luminous with a mild beauty-filter effect, but retain faint pores, real tonal variation, and the warmth of living skin rather than a waxy or porcelain finish.  Give her extremely long, dense natural-black hair with cool blue-black reflections under the flash. The hair is center-parted or slightly off-center, naturally lifted at the crown, and shaped into loose broad waves through the lengths. The heaviest section of hair falls on the left side of the frame, covering part of the shoulder and chest. Preserve a few stray strands touching the arms and dress instead of arranging every hair perfectly. Place one clearly visible oversized gold quatrefoil-shaped drop earring on the right side of the frame, finished with a thin hanging chain. Add several slim silver rings, a delicate crystal bracelet on one wrist, and a fine metal chain bracelet on the other. Do not add a necklace, headwear, handbag, drink, or an invented fully visible second earring.  Dress her in a deep forest-green or muted dark-emerald asymmetric halter bodycon mini dress. The dress has a high halter neckline, a diagonal front panel, a clearly defined geometric central cutout, two narrow crossed straps beneath the bust, and smaller side-waist openings. Preserve the exact neckline height, panel placement, cutout geometry, crossed straps, and original garment coverage without increasing exposure. The material should look like soft low-sheen stretch jersey or matte elastic fabric, never latex. Show natural tension across the torso, slight pulling around the bust and waist, and small wrinkles or gathered areas where the seated body compresses the fabric. The fitted hem sits high on the thighs and gathers slightly around the hips and sofa cushion.  Her adult figure combines slender shoulders, a defined waist, and naturally fuller curves. One thigh and knee extend toward the camera, occupying the lower-right foreground and appearing larger because of close-range perspective. The other leg folds back or overlaps behind it. Her hands rest naturally near the hem, thigh, and knee; one forearm crosses diagonally toward the knee while the other hand stays near the skirt. Retain believable body weight, small asymmetries, subtle abdominal compression, fabric pressure marks, and the natural settling of the hips into the cushion. Do not reshape the body into an extreme or anatomically implausible hourglass.  Visible skin includes the face, neck, shoulders, collarbones, upper chest, the chest area framed by the dress opening, central upper abdomen, small side-waist sections, both arms, hands, fingers, and a large area of the forward thigh and knee. Use a fair neutral-to-cool complexion that appears ivory with pale peach undertones under flash, with stronger pink coloration on the cheeks. The skin should look as though it would feel soft, warm, lightly hydrated, and satin-smooth rather than plastic. Preserve faint tonal differences across the arms and thighs, subtle joint texture, tiny natural irregularities, and extremely light marks on the thigh.  Photograph the scene with a small, hard frontal flash positioned close to the lens axis, recreating the look of a smartphone rear camera, compact digital camera, or small mirrorless camera with direct on-camera flash. Use an estimated 28–35mm full-frame-equivalent perspective. Position the camera near eye level or slightly above it, almost straight-on with a very mild downward angle. The close shooting distance must naturally enlarge the foreground knee. The flash should create concentrated highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, nose tip, cheekbones, lips, collarbones, upper chest, forearms, and thigh, with short defined shadows beneath the chin, between overlapping arms, along the dress edges, and under the knee. Allow the light to fall off rapidly behind the subject so that she remains bright while the room becomes dark. Do not use a studio softbox, balanced fill light, sunset illumination, or strong rim lighting.  Use a 3:4 vertical composition framed from the top of the head to the knees and a small section of the lower legs. Keep the subject broadly centered, but allow the heavy hair on the left and enlarged knee on the lower right to create slight natural imbalance. Use moderate-to-deep depth of field so the face, torso, and foreground knee remain readable. The sofa and curtains may soften slightly, but avoid exaggerated creamy bokeh.  Set the scene in a quiet, enclosed, subtly luxurious nightclub lounge, private hotel seating area, or after-hours room. Behind her are a deep-charcoal velvet banquette, heavy dark cushions with visible directional velvet texture, casually arranged pillows, and floor-to-ceiling dark curtains with pronounced vertical folds. Keep the environment underexposed, preserving only a faint cool blue-violet glow at the far-right edge and small flash reflections on the velvet. Retain slight digital noise, compression texture, and minor color blocking in the shadows.  The final mood is quiet, intimate, soft, and self-assured. The party had just become quieter; she is already settled into the dark sofa and is still holding the camera's gaze. The shutter captures this brief pause, while the rest of the night is about to continue. Preserve direct-flash highlights, mild beauty filtering, foreground-knee perspective, flyaway hair, fabric wrinkles, shadow noise, and slightly imperfect framing so the photograph feels like a spontaneous image taken by someone seated across from her, not an overly polished commercial advertisement.

prompts.text: 创建一个真实的深夜社交媒体人像，主角是一位成年女性，坐在低矮、柔软、深木炭色的天鹅绒沙发上。她的身体大部分朝向前方，上身保持挺拔但不僵硬，肩膀放松，头部轻轻向一侧倾斜。她用明亮、冷静、坚定的目光直视镜头。她的双唇自然闭合，只带着极其细微的上扬曲线，仿佛在快门按下前的一刻刚刚放松下来。保留柔和的椭圆形脸庞、窄而精致的下颚线、大而清澈的眼睛、小巧精致的鼻子和自然丰满的嘴唇。仅将韩系爱豆灵感的晚间魅力作为妆容和造型语言，而非身份声明：纤细的深色眉毛、柔和晕染的灰褐色眼影、精致的上扬眼线、长而根根分明的睫毛、微妙的卧蚕提亮，以及延伸至脸颊并略微位于眼下的粉橙色腮红。在鼻梁、鼻尖、颧骨和唇峰添加受控的高光。使用亮面玫瑰裸色唇釉。肤色应明亮且柔和发光，带有轻微的美颜滤镜效果，但保留微小的毛孔、真实的色调变化和活生生皮肤的温度，而非蜡质或陶瓷质感。给她极其长且浓密的自然黑发，在闪光灯下带有冷色调的蓝黑反光。头发中分或稍微偏离中心，发顶自然蓬松，长度呈松散的宽波浪状。头发最厚重的部分落在画面左侧，覆盖了部分肩膀和胸部。保留几根触及手臂和裙子的乱发，而不是将每根头发都整理得完美无缺。在画面右侧放置一只清晰可见的大号金色四叶草造型垂坠耳环，末端带有一条细吊链。添加几枚纤细的银色戒指，一只手腕戴着精致的水晶手链，另一只手腕戴着细金属链条手链。不要添加项链、头饰、手提包、饮料或虚构的完全可见的第二只耳环。让她穿着一件深森林绿或暗淡深翡翠色的不对称挂脖紧身迷你裙。裙子有高挂脖领口、对角线前片、清晰定义的几何形状中心镂空、胸部下方两条狭窄的交叉带以及较小的侧腰开口。保留准确的领口高度、前片位置、镂空几何形状、交叉带和原始服装覆盖范围，不要增加暴露感。材质看起来应像柔软的低光泽弹力针织衫或哑光弹性面料，绝不是乳胶。在躯干部位显示出自然张力，胸部和腰部周围有轻微的拉扯感，以及坐姿压缩面料处产生的小皱褶或聚集区域。贴身的裙摆位于大腿高处，并略微聚集在臀部和沙发垫周围。她的成年体型结合了纤细的肩膀、清晰的腰部和自然的丰满曲线。一条大腿和膝盖向相机延伸，占据右下角前景，并因近距离透视而显得更大。另一条腿向后折叠或重叠在其后。她的双手自然地放在裙摆、大腿和膝盖附近；一只前臂斜跨向膝盖，另一只手停留在裙子附近。保留可信的体重感、细小的身体不对称性、微妙的腹部压缩感、面料压力痕迹，以及臀部自然沉入坐垫的深度。不要将身体重塑为极端或解剖学上不合理的沙漏型。可见的皮肤包括面部、颈部、肩膀、锁骨、上胸部、裙子开口框架内的胸部区域、上腹部中心、侧腰的小部分、双臂、双手、手指，以及前伸大腿和膝盖的大面积区域。使用中性至冷色的白皙肤色，在闪光灯下显得像带有淡粉橙底色的象牙色，脸颊上有更强的粉色感。皮肤看起来应该感觉柔软、温暖、轻度水润且缎面般光滑，而不是塑料感。保留手臂和大腿上细微的色调差异、微妙的关节纹理、微小的自然不规则感，以及大腿上极轻的痕迹。拍摄场景使用放置在靠近镜头轴线的小型硬质正面闪光灯，重现智能手机后置摄像头、便携式数字相机或带有直接机载闪光灯的小型无反相机的观感。使用估计为28–35mm全画幅等效透视。将相机放置在眼睛高度或略高于眼睛的高度，几乎正对着且带有非常轻微的向下角度。近距离拍摄必须自然地放大前景膝盖。闪光灯应在额头、鼻梁、鼻尖、颧骨、嘴唇、锁骨、上胸部、前臂和大腿上产生集中的高光，在下巴下方、重叠的手臂之间、裙子边缘沿线和膝盖下方产生短促清晰的阴影。让光线在主体后方迅速衰减，使她保持明亮而房间变暗。不要使用影棚柔光箱、平衡补光、日落照明或强烈的轮廓光。使用3:4纵向构图，画幅从头顶到膝盖及小腿的一小部分。保持主体大致居中，但允许左侧厚重的头发和右下角放大的膝盖创造轻微的自然不平衡感。使用中等至较深的景深，使面部、躯干和前景膝盖保持清晰可读。沙发和窗帘可能会略微软化，但要避免夸张的奶油色虚化。场景设定在一个安静、封闭、微妙豪华的夜总会休息室、私人酒店休息区或营业结束后的房间。她身后是深木炭色天鹅绒长椅、带有明显方向性天鹅绒纹理的沉重深色靠垫、随心摆放的枕头，以及带有显著垂直褶皱的落地深色窗帘。保持环境曝光不足，仅在右远边缘保留淡淡的冷蓝紫色光晕，并在天鹅绒上保留微小的闪光灯反射。保留轻微的数字噪点、压缩纹理和阴影中的少量色块现象。最终氛围是安静、私密、柔和且自信的。派对刚刚变得安静下来；她已经安顿在深色沙发上，仍然注视着相机的目光。快门捕捉到了这一简短的停顿，而夜晚的其余部分即将继续。保留直闪高光、轻微的美颜滤镜、前景膝盖透视、乱发、面料皱褶、阴影噪点和略微不完美的构图，使照片感觉像是坐在她对面的人拍摄的自发影像，而不是过度修饰的商业广告。

Subject:

Main Subject:
Vertical aspect ratio 4:5. On a breakwater overlooking the deep blue sea, a woman pulling a cream-colored suitcase with one leg extended forward is positioned at the bottom center-left of the frame. The person and the suitcase together occupy about 35% of the frame height. The top 65% is used for the sky and a massive city of clouds, maintaining a strong sense of openness.

Character and Expression:
A natural and realistic woman. Soft brown hair tied in a low ponytail, with forehead bangs and loose strands fluttering to the right in the sea breeze. Her face is turned slightly toward the camera, with a gentle and subtle smile. Her gaze is directed between the distant sky and the sea.

Clothing and Pose:
An ecru-colored short-sleeved sailor-collar dress. The collar and hem are decorated with detailed dark blue piping, with a slim waist and a knee-length flared skirt slightly unfurled by the wind. White boat socks paired with white low-top sneakers. The character's left hand pulls the retractable handle of a small cream-colored suitcase behind her, with the case tilted and two wheels off the ground. The right leg stands firmly on the breakwater, while the left leg is extended straight forward. The right arm naturally swings backward, and the body's center of gravity is placed directly above the right leg.

Background and Lighting:
A calm blue sea with a low horizon. The distant view is only dotted with the silhouettes of a few small boats. The sky is filled with massive cumulonimbus clouds, the upper parts of which naturally transition into the form of an original castle in the sky. The castle is an asymmetrical composition of slender towers, round towers, cloud corridors, bridges, and translucent spires. A fairytale-like but original design that does not evoke any specific existing work. It is not a solid structure, but rather the silhouette of a castle emerging through the density and shadows of white clouds. Strong noon sunlight shines diagonally from the top left of the frame, illuminating the character's left shoulder, cheek, hem of the skirt, and the top surface of the suitcase. Short shadows are cast towards the bottom right, and the sea surface reflects pale blue light, complementing the lower half of the character's body.

Composition and Lens:
A low-angle full-body shot. A slight compression feel equivalent to 85mm. The character is placed in the bottom 1/3 of the frame, while the cloud city occupies a large area of the upper central part. Sufficient space is reserved from the top of the character's head to the castle, and a small amount of negative space is left between the very top of the castle and the upper edge of the frame. The breakwater is depicted as a horizontal line running across the very bottom, and the boundary between the sea and the sky is slightly lower than the character's waist. The character and the suitcase are in sharp focus, with only the distant boats slightly blurred.

Texture and Style:
A summer photography style full of transparency. Clear azure sky, nearly pure white clouds, and ecru-colored clothing and suitcase create a unified color tone. Skin retains natural texture, avoiding excessive beautification. The cloud city has a soft three-dimensionality and light transparency, like a real object that accidentally appeared in the photograph. A refreshing and bright high-key tone, delicate sense of wind movement, and slight film grain.

items.title: 美诺 Triflex HX2 实验室级透明结构深紫压力图海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium flagship campaign poster for Miele Triflex HX2, designed as Poster 3 in a cohesive series, combining a laboratory-grade transparent cutaway housing with a deep-violet pressure-map visualization system. The image must feel hyper-real, scientifically precise, visually striking, and exceptionally refined, showing the internal engineering truth of the product through a clean experimental-display aesthetic. The final result should look like a world-class German engineering poster, not a generic tech ad or fantasy CGI render.

Core concept:
The hero is the Miele Triflex HX2 shown in an extreme macro close-up with an ultra-clean transparent outer shell, revealing the internal airflow logic, brush interaction, particle routing, suction pressure zones, and internal engineering architecture. The image should feel like a premium laboratory demonstration model fused with a luxury advertising visual. The transparent shell must be crystal-clear, disciplined, and elegant, while the internal airflow system is visualized as a deep-violet pressure map with luminous gradients and technically believable flow behavior.

Composition:
Use a strong vertical poster layout with one enlarged close-up of the Miele Triflex HX2 floorhead or lower cleaning assembly dominating the frame. Show the product in a side or three-quarter cutaway view, with the housing partially transparent and precisely sectioned to expose internal systems. The product should fill most of the image and feel sculptural, premium, and technically exact.
Inside the product, organize the visible internal zones clearly:
intake edge,
brush-roll interaction area,
pressure-compression regions,
particle transport channels,
dust-routing pathway,
and chamber transition logic.
Leave controlled negative space for title placement and refined technical annotation.

Product realism:
Render the Miele Triflex HX2 with absolute realism and exact premium-brand fidelity:
accurate floorhead geometry,
true shell thickness,
precise transparent material behavior,
realistic internal partitions,
authentic brush-roll structure,
engineered airflow channel routing,
subtle metallic components,
premium matte and satin outer-surface transitions,
and unmistakable Miele industrial design language.
The product must feel physically exact, luxurious, and mechanically credible in every detail.

Transparent shell design:
Make the transparent housing exceptionally clean, laboratory-grade, and premium. The shell should feel like polished scientific demonstration material:
crystal-clear transparency,
minimal distortion,
precise edge definition,
clean sectional boundaries,
subtle reflection control,
and elegant material depth.
The transparency should reveal the internal structure without visual clutter. It must feel more like a high-end engineering prototype or museum-grade lab display than a consumer cutaway graphic.

Deep violet pressure-map system:
Visualize the internal performance using a refined pressure-map language built around deep violet, electric indigo, and controlled blue-violet gradients. Show different airflow and pressure regions through:
luminous pressure bands,
flow-density gradients,
velocity-transition ribbons,
micro turbulence zones,
fine-particle lift behavior,
and directional suction streams.
The violet-map visualization should feel scientifically grounded and product-specific, not decorative. Pressure intensity should shift naturally across internal zones, from concentrated intake regions to routed channel flow and separation logic. Keep the system elegant, readable, and visually powerful.

Airflow and particle simulation:
Use highly realistic internal physics visualization:
fine dust suspension,
micro-debris acceleration,
brush agitation behavior,
channel-guided suction flow,
pressure compression around the intake path,
and smooth routing toward the inner collection zone.
Particles must move according to believable suction mechanics and internal geometry. The interaction between structure and effect must feel rigorous and physically justified.

Environment:
Use a minimal premium technical-lab environment with a refined neutral platform or floor. The background should be clean, quiet, and controlled, supporting the product without distraction. A subtle studio-lab gradient or pale neutral technical backdrop is preferred, helping the transparent shell and violet pressure-map effects stand out with maximum clarity.

Typography:
Use only elegant English typography with strong premium technical hierarchy.
Possible title directions:
“MIELE TRIFLEX HX2”
“DEEP VIOLET PRESSURE MAP”
“ENGINEERED FROM WITHIN”
“VISIBLE FLOW LOGIC”
“LAB-GRADE PRECISION”
Use refined supporting text such as:
“Transparent Structural Reveal”
“Pressure-Zone Visualization”
“Internal Particle Routing”
Typography should feel clean, modern, and luxurious, with restrained technical callouts and minimal annotation lines.

Graphic accents:
Add only subtle engineering-style graphic marks:
fine callout lines,
pressure-zone indicators,
cutaway boundary labels,
micro arrows,
transparent structure markers,
and minimal calibration-style notation.
Everything must remain premium, sparse, and precise.

Brand coding:
Preserve Miele identity through:
German precision,
quiet luxury,
timeless engineering,
technical intelligence,
premium material discipline,
and refined industrial design clarity.
The poster should communicate that Miele Triflex HX2 is engineered beautifully both outside and inside.

Lighting:
Use exquisitely controlled studio-lab lighting with scientific precision. The lighting should define the transparent shell, internal structures, and pressure-map glow with exceptional clarity. Transparent surfaces should show subtle controlled reflections, never messy glare. Internal violet illumination should appear embedded and physically integrated, while the product exterior remains solid, premium, and realistic.
Shadows should be soft, smooth, and elegant.

Color direction:
Use a premium precision-tech palette built around:
deep violet,
electric indigo,
cool ultraviolet blue,
ice silver,
smoked titanium,
and restrained white highlights.
The internal pressure-map system should lead with violet and indigo gradients, while the outer housing remains neutral, clean, and laboratory-premium. The final palette should feel colder, sharper, and more advanced than earlier posters.

technical, hyper-real, premium, laboratory-grade, precise, engineered, controlled, luxurious, visually striking, intelligent, futuristic but believable.

prompts.text:
为美诺 Triflex HX2 创作一张超高端旗舰级活动海报，设计为协调系列中的海报 3，将实验室级的透明剖面外壳与深紫色压力图可视化系统相结合。图像必须具有超写实感、科学精确、视觉冲击力强且异常精致，通过简洁的实验展示美学展示产品的内部工程真相。最终结果应看起来像世界级的德国工程海报，而不是通用的科技广告或幻想的 CGI 渲染。

核心概念：
主角是美诺 Triflex HX2，以超宏观特写镜头显示，带有超干净的透明外壳，揭示内部气流逻辑、滚刷交互、颗粒路由、吸力压力区和内部工程架构。图像应该感觉像是高端实验室演示模型与奢侈品广告视觉效果的融合。透明外壳必须晶莹剔透、严谨且优雅，而内部气流系统被可视化为具有发光梯度和技术上可信的流动行为的深紫色压力图。

构图：
使用强烈的纵向海报布局，美诺 Triflex HX2 吸头或下部清洁组件的一个放大特写占据画面。以侧面或四分之三剖视图展示产品，外壳部分透明并精确分割以暴露内部系统。产品应占据图像的大部分，并具有雕塑感、高端感和技术精确性。
在产品内部，清晰地组织可见的内部区域：
进气边缘、
滚刷交互区域、
压力压缩区域、
颗粒运输通道、
灰尘路由路径、
以及腔室转换逻辑。
为标题放置和精细的技术注释留出受控的负空间。

产品真实感：
以绝对的真实感和精确的高端品牌忠实度渲染美诺 Triflex HX2：
准确的吸头几何形状、
真实的外壳厚度、
精确的透明材料行为、
真实的内部隔板、
真实的滚刷结构、
工程化的气流通道路由、
微妙的金属组件、
高端哑光和缎面外表面过渡、
以及标志性的美诺工业设计语言。
产品的每个细节都必须感觉物理精确、豪华且机械可靠。

透明外壳设计：
使透明外壳极其干净、实验室级且高端。外壳应该感觉像抛光的科学演示材料：
晶莹剔透的透明度、
极小的畸变、
精确的边缘定义、
干净的剖面边界、
微妙的反射控制、
以及优雅的材料深度。
透明度应揭示内部结构而不产生视觉混乱。它必须感觉更像是高端工程原型或博物馆级的实验室展示，而不是消费级剖面图。

深紫色压力图系统：
使用基于深紫色、电感靛蓝和受控蓝紫色梯度的精细压力图语言可视化内部性能。通过以下方式展示不同的气流和压力区域：
发光压力带、
流密度梯度、
速度转换带、
微湍流区、
细微颗粒提升行为、
以及定向吸力流。
紫色地图可视化应具有科学依据并针对特定产品，而不是装饰性的。压力强度应在内部区域自然移动，从集中的进气区域到路由通道流和分离逻辑。保持系统优雅、清晰且视觉强大。

气流和颗粒模拟：
使用高度真实的内部物理可视化：
细尘悬浮、
微小碎片加速、
滚刷搅拌行为、
通道引导的吸力流、
进气路径周围的压力压缩、
以及朝向内部收集区的平滑路由。
颗粒必须根据可信的吸力力学和内部几何形状移动。结构与效果之间的相互作用必须感觉严谨且在物理上是合理的。

环境：
使用简约的高端技术实验室环境，配有精美的中性平台或地板。背景应干净、安静且受控，在不分散注意力的情况下支持产品。首选微妙的工作室实验室梯度或淡中性技术背景，有助于透明外壳和紫色压力图效果以最大的清晰度脱颖而出。

排版：
仅使用具有强大高端技术层级的优雅英文排版。
可能的标题方向：
“MIELE TRIFLEX HX2”
“DEEP VIOLET PRESSURE MAP”
“ENGINEERED FROM WITHIN”
“VISIBLE FLOW LOGIC”
“LAB-GRADE PRECISION”
使用精美的辅助文本，例如：
“Transparent Structural Reveal”
“Pressure-Zone Visualization”
“Internal Particle Routing”
排版应感觉简洁、现代且奢华，带有克制的技术标注和极简的注释线。

图形点缀：
仅添加微妙的工程风格图形标记：
细标注线、
压力区指示器、
剖面边界标签、
微型箭头、
透明结构标记、
以及极简的校准风格符号。
一切都必须保持高端、稀疏且精确。

品牌编码：
通过以下方式保留美诺身份：
德国精密、
低调奢华、
永恒工程、
技术智能、
高端材料纪律、
以及精细的工业设计清晰度。
海报应传达出美诺 Triflex HX2 无论内外都经过精美工程设计。

照明：
使用具有科学精确性的精心控制的工作室实验室照明。照明应以异常清晰度定义透明外壳、内部结构和压力图发光。透明表面应显示微妙受控的反射，绝不杂乱。内部紫色照明应看起来是嵌入式的并与物理集成，而产品外观保持坚实、高端且真实。
阴影应柔软、平滑且优雅。

颜色方向：
使用围绕以下内容构建的高端精密科技调色板：
深紫色、
电感靛蓝、
冷紫外蓝、
冰银、
烟熏钛、
以及克制的白色高光。
内部压力图系统应以紫色和靛蓝梯度为主导，而外部外壳保持中性、干净且实验室高端感。最终的调色板应比之前的海报感觉更冷、更锐利、更高级。

情绪：
技术、超写实、高端、实验室级、精确、工程化、受控、豪华、视觉冲击力强、智能、未来感但可信。

渲染风格：
超写实美诺 Triflex HX2 工程海报，实验室级透明剖面外壳，深紫色压力图可视化，真实气流和内部颗粒模拟，高端技术工作室环境，优雅英文排版，德国工业设计精度，世界级家电真实感，8k。

items.title: 3D微缩极简红白国庆建筑海报

prompts.text:
Generate a 3D miniature diorama rendering based on a specific thematic building or structure. Use an isometric view, placing the main building in the center of the frame, with ample negative space around it. The background uses a seamless pure off-white/light warm gray backdrop to create a clean studio-grade display space. The visual core lies in a strict red-and-white dual-color scheme and deconstructive mapping: extract all load-bearing skeletons, edge frames, and structural lines of the thematic building (such as columns, beams, door and window frames, railings, outline edges, etc.) and transform them into highly visually impactful high-saturation Chinese Red (vermilion); meanwhile, transform all closed blocks, walls, roofs, bases, and other large-area solid regions of the building into pure, flawless plain white. Reject any extra variegated colors, relying solely on the interplay and contrast between the red frames and white blocks to convey the building's complex structure. In terms of material, the overall look presents a matte texture similar to blind box trendy toys or high-end 3D clay models, with absolutely smooth surfaces, discarding all real wood grain, stone texture, or distressed flaws. Combined with soft global illumination, cast clean, soft-edged shadows and ambient occlusion on the pure white walls and base plate, giving the entire miniature scene a minimalist, modern, and highly purified structural aesthetic atmosphere.

围绕具体主题建筑或结构生成一张3D微缩模型（Miniature diorama）效果图。采用等距视角（Isometric view），将建筑主体居中放置于画面正中央，四周留出宽裕的负空间，背景使用无缝的纯净米白/浅暖灰背景板，营造出干净的影棚级展示空间。视觉核心在于严格的红白双色拼色与解构映射：将主题建筑的所有承重骨架、边缘框架和结构线条（如立柱、横梁、门窗框架、栏杆、轮廓收边等）全部提取，并转化为极具视觉冲击力的高饱和度中国红（朱红色）；同时，将建筑的所有封闭块面、墙体、屋顶、台基等大面积实体区域，统一转化为纯净无暇的素白色。拒绝任何多余杂色介入，仅依靠红色框架与白色体块的穿插对比来交代建筑的复杂结构。材质上，整体呈现出盲盒潮玩或高级3D素模的哑光质感（Matte texture），表面绝对平滑，摒弃一切真实的木纹、石材肌理或做旧瑕疵。配合柔和的全局漫反射光照（Global illumination），在纯白墙面和底板上投射出干净、边缘柔化的阴影与环境光遮蔽（Ambient occlusion），使整个微缩场景呈现出极简、现代且高度提纯的结构美学氛围。

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium editorial campaign poster for New Balance 2002R in a “Desert Trail Journal” direction, blending hyper-real outdoor travel photography with expressive hand-drawn exploration notes. The image must feel bold, adventurous, sun-washed, emotionally free, and intelligently designed, transforming a female backpacker journey across desert trails into a premium visual field journal centered on the New Balance 2002R. The final result should look like a world-class New Balance campaign poster, not a generic hiking ad or scrapbook collage.

Core concept:
The hero concept is a real female backpacker crossing a vast desert trail landscape, wearing authentic New Balance 2002R as the key product focus, while the image is layered with elegant hand-drawn journey records, route notes, symbols, and field-journal annotations. The scene should communicate freedom, endurance, discovery, and long-distance movement. The shoe must remain clearly visible, tactile, and important, while the illustrated note system expands the emotional narrative of the journey.

Composition:
Use a vertical poster layout with a strong central or slightly off-center composition. Place a healthy athletic Western female backpacker standing or walking on a desert trail, canyon edge, dry ridge path, or open sandy route, creating a strong feeling of distance and exploration. Her posture should feel natural, self-possessed, and quietly determined, as if she has paused during a long journey to scan the horizon.
The New Balance 2002R must be clearly visible on her feet, rendered with strong product realism and enough presence to remain the visual anchor. Surround the scene with clean white or sun-faded chalk-like hand-drawn journal graphics across the sky, side margins, and open ground areas: route arrows, mileage counts, elevation notes, mini map fragments, desert symbols, camp icons, weather marks, handwritten observations, coordinates, and trail marks. The composition should feel rich and immersive, but still premium and beautifully controlled.

Product realism:
Render the New Balance 2002R with absolute realism and exact brand fidelity:
premium suede overlays,
technical mesh underlays,
layered retro-running structure,
iconic oversized N logo,
precise heel support geometry,
refined stitching,
segmented cushioning language,
real outsole depth,
and authentic New Balance 2002R proportions.
The shoe must feel tactile, expensive, and physically real, with believable suede nap, breathable mesh texture, subtle desert dust traces, and natural tonal separation. It must remain unmistakably New Balance 2002R, never generic trail footwear.

Backpacker direction:
Use a healthy athletic Western female model with natural editorial beauty, strong posture, and a non-influencer face. She should feel capable, independent, and sun-weathered in a refined way. Style her in premium lightweight travel gear: a technical backpack, fitted performance layers, breathable trail pants or shorts, a minimal utility jacket or shirt, and clean functional accessories.
Her expression should feel thoughtful, calm, and driven by curiosity. She should look like a real long-distance traveler elevated into a premium campaign image.

Hand-drawn record language:
Integrate expressive, clean, spontaneous hand-drawn field-journal graphics as if documenting the journey across the desert in real time. Include:
mileage counts,
route lines,
mini maps,
elevation notes,
sun icons,
wind symbols,
tent sketches,
distance marks,
handwritten observations,
coordinate notations,
and directional arrows.
The linework should feel fast, intelligent, natural, and premium, like a travel notebook mixed with design sketches. Keep the marks clean and stylish, never childish or chaotic.

Environment:
Set the scene in a real desert-trail environment with open sky, weathered rock, dry ridges, sand-toned earth, canyon edges, dusty trails, and distant layered landforms. The environment should feel expansive, cinematic, and physically believable, with enough negative space to support the hand-drawn record system. Avoid clutter. The landscape should communicate openness, heat, resilience, and long-distance movement.

Typography:
Use only elegant English typography with a strong premium editorial hierarchy.
Possible title directions:
“NEW BALANCE 2002R”
“DESERT TRAIL JOURNAL”
“RECORDED IN MOTION”
“DISTANCE / DUST / DIRECTION”
“WORN ACROSS THE HORIZON”
Typography should be minimal, official, and intelligently placed, working together with the hand-drawn note system. The main title should feel clean and modern, while supporting lines remain restrained and editorial.

Brand coding:
Preserve New Balance identity through:
authentic movement heritage,
quiet performance,
material honesty,
all-day comfort,
outdoor adaptability,
and understated confidence.
The poster should communicate that New Balance 2002R is a trusted companion for meaningful travel and real-world exploration.

Lighting:
Use exquisitely soft natural desert light with refined cinematic polish. The light should feel warm but controlled, with delicate highlights on the shoe, skin, backpack, and dry landscape surfaces. Shadows should remain smooth, soft, and elegant. The overall image should feel breathable, tactile, and emotionally expansive, with the product remaining the sharpest and most desirable object.

Color direction:
Use a premium desert-travel palette built around:
sand beige,
sun-bleached ivory,
clay brown,
faded sky blue,
weathered stone grey,
and muted silver-grey.
Allow the hand-drawn notes to appear in crisp white or chalk-white so they float clearly over the warm environment. The final palette should feel sun-washed, exploratory, elevated, and globally premium.

Mood:
free, adventurous, documentary, premium, open, tactile, exploratory, emotionally grounded, sun-washed, intelligent, quietly bold, long-distance, travel-driven.

Rendering style:
hyper-real New Balance 2002R campaign poster, female backpacker in a real desert trail environment, premium field-journal hand-drawn overlays, clean English editorial typography, soft sun-washed natural lighting, authentic exploration energy, world-class product realism, 8k.

Negative prompt:
generic hiking ad, messy scrapbook look, cartoon doodles, fake New Balance silhouette, weak shoe detail, low-detail suede, plastic materials, influencer aesthetic, cluttered desert scene, childish handwriting, poor anatomy, random props, cheap travel poster, low-end typography, toy-like backpack gear, oversaturated colors

prompts.text:
为 New Balance 2002R 创建一个以“沙漠徒步日志”为方向的超高级编辑活动海报，将超写实的户外旅行摄影与富有表现力的手绘探险笔记相结合。图像必须感觉大胆、冒险、阳光照耀、情感自由且设计精巧，将女性背包客穿越沙漠小径的旅程转化为一个以 New Balance 2002R 为中心的优质视觉现场日志。最终结果应该看起来像世界级的 New Balance 活动海报，而不是普通的徒步广告或剪贴簿拼贴。

核心概念：
核心概念是一位真实的女性背包客穿越广阔的沙漠小径景观，穿着真实的 New Balance 2002R 作为关键产品焦点，同时图像叠层了优雅的手绘旅程记录、路线笔记、符号和现场日志注释。场景应传达自由、耐力、发现和长距离移动。鞋子必须保持清晰可见、触感真实且重要，而插图笔记系统则扩展了旅程的情感叙事。

构图：
使用垂直海报布局，采用强有力的中心或略微偏离中心的构图。放置一位健康的运动型西方女性背包客站在或走在沙漠小径、峡谷边缘、干燥的山脊路径或开阔的沙路上，营造出强烈的距离感和探索感。她的姿势应该感觉自然、沉稳且沉着冷静，仿佛她在漫长的旅程中停下来扫描地平线。
New Balance 2002R 必须在她脚上清晰可见，以极强的产品写实感呈现，并有足够的地位作为视觉锚点。在天空、侧边缘和开阔地面区域周围环绕着干净的白色或阳光褪色的粉笔感手绘日志图形：路线箭头、里程数、海拔说明、微型地图碎片、沙漠符号、营地图标、天气标记、手写观察、坐标和轨迹标记。构图应感觉丰富且身临其境，但依然优质且控制精美。

产品写实感：
以绝对的写实感和准确的品牌忠实度渲染 New Balance 2002R：
优质麂皮覆盖层，
技术网眼基层，
层叠的复古跑步结构，
标志性的大号 N 标志，
精确的后跟支撑几何结构，
精致的缝线，
分段式缓震语言，
真实的鞋底深度，
以及真实的 New Balance 2002R 比例。
鞋子必须感觉有触感、昂贵且物理真实，具有可信的麂皮绒毛、透气的网眼纹理、微妙的沙漠灰尘痕迹和自然的色调分离。它必须保持明显的 New Balance 2002R 特征，绝不是普通的越野鞋。

背包客方向：
使用一位具有自然编辑美感、强健姿态和非网红脸的健康运动型西方女性模特。她应该感觉干练、独立，并以一种精致的方式呈现出风吹日晒后的样子。为她搭配优质轻便的旅行装备：技术背包、修身的性能层叠衣物、透气的徒步裤或短裤、简约的功能性夹克或衬衫以及干净的功能性配件。
她的表情应该感觉深思熟虑、冷静并受好奇心驱动。她应该看起来像是一个被提升为优质广告图像的真实长途旅行者。

手绘记录语言：
整合富有表现力、干净、自发的现场日志图形，就像实时记录穿越沙漠的旅程一样。包括：
里程计数、
路线线段、
微型地图、
海拔笔记、
太阳图标、
风力符号、
帐篷素描、
距离标记、
手写观察、
坐标标注、
以及方向箭头。
线条感应该感觉快速、聪明、自然且高级，就像旅行笔记本与设计草图的混合。保持标记干净且时尚，绝不幼稚或混乱。

环境：
将场景设定在真实的沙漠徒步环境中，拥有开阔的天空、风化的岩石、干燥的山脊、沙色的土地、峡谷边缘、尘土飞扬的小径和远处的层叠地貌。环境应该感觉广阔、电影感且物理上可信，有足够的负空间来支持手绘记录系统。避免杂乱。景观应传达开放、炎热、韧性和远距离移动。

排版：
仅使用具有强大高级编辑层级的优雅英语排版。
可能的标题方向：
“NEW BALANCE 2002R”
“DESERT TRAIL JOURNAL”
“RECORDED IN MOTION”
“DISTANCE / DUST / DIRECTION”
“WORN ACROSS THE HORIZON”
排版应简约、正式且巧妙放置，与手绘笔记系统协同工作。主标题应感觉干净且现代，而支撑行则保持克制和编辑感。

品牌编码：
通过以下方式保留 New Balance 的身份：
真实的运动传承，
低调的性能，
材质的诚实，
全天候的舒适，
户外适应性，
以及含蓄的自信。
海报应传达出 New Balance 2002R 是有意义的旅行和现实世界探索的可靠伙伴。

光影：
使用精致柔和的自然沙漠光线，并带有精致的电影级润饰。光线应感觉温暖但受控，在鞋子、皮肤、背包和干燥的景观表面上有细腻的高光。阴影应保持平滑、柔软且优雅。整体图像应感觉透气、有触感且情感宽广，产品依然是最清晰、最令人向往的物体。

颜色方向：
使用围绕以下色彩构建的高级沙漠旅行调色板：
沙杏色、
阳光漂白的象牙色、
粘土褐色、
褪色的天蓝色、
风化的石灰色、
以及柔和的银灰色。
让手绘笔记以脆白色或粉笔白出现，使其清晰地漂浮在温暖的环境之上。最终的调色板应该感觉像阳光洗过一般、具有探索性、高级感且全球顶尖。

情绪：
自由、冒险、纪录片感、高级、开阔、有触感、探索性、情感落地、阳光洗礼、聪明、低调的大胆、长途、旅行驱动。

渲染风格：
超写实 New Balance 2002R 宣传海报，真实沙漠徒步环境中的女性背包客，优质现场日志手绘叠加层，干净的英文编辑排版，柔和的阳光洗礼自然光，真实的探索能量，世界级产品写实感，8k。

负面提示词：
通用的徒步广告，混乱的剪贴簿外观，卡通涂鸦，假的 New Balance 轮廓，虚弱的鞋子细节，低细节的麂皮，塑料材质，网红审美，杂乱的沙漠场景，幼稚的手写，糟糕的人体解剖，随机的道具，廉价的旅行海报，低端排版，玩具般的背包装备，过度饱和的颜色。

A deep purple obi is tied around the waist, tightening the overall look. The neckline is naturally V-shaped, loose enough to see the neck and collarbones. Avoids an excessively messy impression, wearing it with a slightly relaxed feel. The woman sits on the edge of the veranda, leaning her upper body slightly back. Her right hand is placed on the floor behind her waist, and her left hand is lightly pressed against the side of her body. Her knees are together and stretched forward diagonally, with her calves to toes submerged in the water. Small ripples rise around the ankles, and the wet toes reflect the swaying reflections of the water surface. On the right side of the figure, a pair of light-colored wood-grained geta with patterned straps are placed naturally side by side.

Background/Lighting:
On the right are the wooden veranda of the house, vertical lattice sliding doors, and dark wood-grained pillars. On the left, a shallow and clear waterway extends into the distance, with large and small rounded stones visible at the bottom. In the distance, the garden is configured with large stepping stones, mossy garden stones, low shrubs, ferns, and bright green leaves, creating the moisture and tranquility of a summer Japanese garden. The main light source is natural morning light pouring down from the top left of the frame. Dappled sunlight through the leaves casts irregular spots of light on the person's hair, right shoulder, chest, thighs, veranda, and water surface. A wide empty space for the waterway is left on the left, with the line of sight extending diagonally to the stepping stones in the distance. The background is not excessively darkened, and the spatial relationship between the wooden house, waterway, and stepping stones is discernible under a medium depth of field.

High-precision realistic photograph. A Japanese summer portrait taken with natural light. The skin is smooth but retains fine texture, avoiding a plastic-like quality. The thin cotton fabric of the yukata, the texture of the obi, the water-wet feet, the aged marks of the wood, the touch of the rounded stones, and the refraction and reflection of the water surface are all vividly depicted. prompts.text:
Generated around any theme object or specific content, the image centers on modern Oriental aesthetics with strong visual impact, presenting a minimalist yet ritualistic spatial tension.

**Composition and Subject Position**: Abandon traditional centered and filled compositions, using large areas of solid color white space (negative space) to create visual breathing room and spatial suspense. The theme object is not treated as an element that fills the frame, but as a refined visual focal point, potentially edge-cut, partially enlarged, or placed off-center in a highly sculptural form. The background is absolutely clean with no redundant scene layout, contrasting the subject's morphological tension through extreme white space. Subject edges are clear and sharp, forming an absolute sense of separation from the background.

**Color System and Emotion (Color Derivation Logic)**: Colors present a paradoxical unity of "high purity and extreme restraint," with an emotional tone of strong "modern ritual, solemnity, and minimalist tension."
- **Base**: The image is covered by a large area of a strong, high-purity, and pure theme color (such as intense Chinese red), forming visual dominance. The base color must be flat, even, or have very faint premium textures, remaining clean and rejecting muddiness.
- **Subject Color**: The subject's color is extracted from its own material, forming a very high contrast with the base color (such as black, white, or a high-purity color complementary to the base), maintaining a clear span of brightness.
- **Accent Color**: Retain a very small amount of metallic-textured color (such as matte gold) or high-brightness colors as accents, with a very small but extremely sharp area. The color system must remain clear, sharp, and modern, not gray or old.

**Graphic Mechanism and Material Texture**: No matter what the original material of the theme object is, it must exhibit a texture of carefully refined "readymade art" or "premium design product." Surface light and shadow are treated cleanly, firmly, or with a delicate matte texture. Extremely fine, precise geometric lines or abstract segmented structures can be integrated into the image as a skeleton carrying the visual center of gravity, enhancing the modern design context of the image.

**Typography and Information Layering**: Text is regarded as an important graphic component. The layout presents a typical modernist poster style: information is precisely aligned along the edges of the frame or based on hidden grid lines, with restrained letter spacing. - **主体色（Subject）**：主体的色彩从其自身材质提取，与底色形成极高对比（如黑、白或与底色互补的高纯度色），保持明度的清晰跨度。

主题对象无论原本是何种物质，均需表现出一种被精心提炼过的“现成品艺术”或“高级设计品”质感。表面光影处理干净、硬朗或带有细腻的哑光质感。画面中可融入极为纤细、精确的几何线条或抽象的切分结构，作为承载视觉重心的骨架，增强画面的现代设计语境。

**排版与信息层叠**：
文字被视为重要的图形构成要素。排版呈现典型的现代主义海报风格：信息沿着画面边缘或依托隐藏的网格线进行精确对齐，字间距克制。文字作为精密的结构线，与大面积留白形成极强的疏密对比，提供一种冷静、精确的信息感，绝不掩盖主体的光芒。

prompts.text:
Subject:
Fingertips catching the blue sky

Main Subject:
In a midsummer Japanese residential area, an adult woman in her 20s crouches near the ground, with both hands reaching broadly towards the camera. The character is positioned slightly to the right of the center of the frame, with the upper body occupying about 40% of the screen. A bent knee is placed in the bottom left, and an extremely magnified hand is placed in the top left to widely reveal the clear blue sky.

Character · Expression:
Natural Japanese features. Black hair tied high in a small bun, retaining thin see-through bangs and stray hairs fitting the cheeks. Pale pink blush, delicate brown eye makeup, natural tear bags, translucent coral pink lip gloss. The face is slightly tilted downward, with one eye closed in a wink and the other looking at the lens. The corners of the mouth are relaxed into a serene expression.

Clothing · Pose:
A white fine-ribbed cropped camisole, with a thin white lace cardigan loosely draped over the shoulders. The bottom is light blue high-waisted denim shorts. The character's own right arm reaches towards the top left of the frame, the palm close to the lens within inches, with the thumb and index finger wide open. The character's own left hand extends from the bottom right of the frame, palm facing up, fingers naturally spread. Both knees are bent in a low posture, with the body weight shifted backward.

Background · Lighting:
A quiet Japanese residential street on a summer afternoon. Low-rise detached houses, concrete walls, roadside trees, utility poles, and thin wires extending into the distance. Signage text is small and blurry, unreadable. More than half of the background is occupied by a vivid blue sky and a small amount of white clouds. Strong sunlight shines diagonally from the top left of the frame, illuminating the upper surfaces of the face, shoulders, arms, and knees. Shadows are cast towards the bottom right, and the ground and white clothing reflect the cold reflected light of the blue sky.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 4:5. An ultra-low-angle ultra-wide-angle photograph skimming the ground. The right hand closest to the lens is magnified hugely in the top left of the frame, boldly exaggerating the sense of perspective. The other hand is placed in the bottom right of the frame, the face is in the center-right, and the left knee is in the bottom left. A wide blank space of blue sky is left at the top. The face and hands are in focus, while the depth of the residential street is slightly blurred.

Texture · Style:
A realistic snapshot that feels the summer sunlight. Retains natural skin texture, fine peach fuzz, fabric weave patterns, and denim fibers. Bright and refreshing colors, slightly high contrast, with the blue sky appearing as a deep cobalt blue. Avoid over-beautifying skin modification, incorporating the exaggerated perspective unique to wide-angle lenses, and a sense of movement as if captured by chance.

Negative:

人物：年轻成年新娘，纤细优雅体型，白皙柔和发光肌肤。精致四分之三侧面——躯干朝镜头右侧转开，头部轻柔从肩膀回望直视镜头。双肩放松略微倾斜，在颈部、腰部与髋部形成优雅S曲线。头部微微朝向抬高的肩膀倾斜。平静、温暖、低调浪漫的表情——淡淡的闭嘴微笑，柔和专注的眼神。亲密、端庄、恬静的氛围；不夸张不商业。

发型：深浓咖啡棕色长发，宽松自然波浪垂落于肩后并延伸至背部。丝滑质感，几缕精致飞散发丝被窗光照亮。额头上有细腻分离的轻薄碎刘海，较长发丝框住太阳穴与面颊。精致而柔软，非僵硬或大量定型剂感。婚纱头纱固定于头部后冠，被发丝部分遮盖。

面部与妆容：精致均衡五官——柔和拱形眉毛，杏仁形棕色眼睛，纤细鼻梁，轻柔圆润面颊，自然玫米唇色。精致婚纱妆容：发光自然肌肤，淡桃腮红，柔和定义睫毛，细腻低调眼线，低调棕灰眼影，轻盈光泽粉裸唇色，颧骨与鼻梁处克制高光。真实毛孔，轻柔色调变化。无塑料感肌肤或过度美颜处理。

礼服：优雅象牙白抹胸婚纱。上半身：干净结构感紧身胸衣式上衣——顺滑缎面或米卡多真丝质感，轻柔雕刻感心形领口，细腻内部鱼骨，贴合腰身。极简、现代、建筑感。腰部以下：浅象牙色薄纱与精致蕾丝柔和A字裙——精致刺绣花卉与藤蔓图案尤其在髋部与大腿上方，蕾丝逐渐融入面料。刺绣精致、同色调、繁复，而非厚重或闪亮。

头纱：长款透明大教堂级象牙薄纱头纱，从头部后方开始，斜向垂落横过整个画面右侧，从肩后经过并延伸至画面下边缘。多层半透明质感——可见细密网眼，细腻褶皱，精致叠层边缘，被阳光照透的柔和发光边缘。宽阔三角形外形作为主要构图元素。轻盈通透，而非不透明或僵硬。

珠宝：精致银色或白金婚纱耳环——小型花卉水晶簇与单颗发光珍珠垂坠。垂下手臂腕部配窄型光亮金色手链。一只手指上有细腻小宝石戒指。所有珠宝精致、小巧、真实反光。不戴项链——裸露领口与肩膀保持干净优雅。

姿态：近侧手臂自然垂落于身侧——肘部略微弯曲，放松手指靠近外侧髋部与大腿上方。手部清晰可见，人体解剖学准确比例，自然指节，分开手指，戒指可见。远侧手臂大部分隐于躯干后方。胸部微微提起，腰线轻柔分明。

场景：豪华婚纱沙龙、婚礼场所或古典公寓室内。画面最左侧：高挑落地法式窗户配奶油色细窗格——强烈漫射日光射入，在画面边缘形成明亮竖向光带。窗户旁有浅米色窗帘垂挂成长褶皱。背景墙面：传统欧式护墙板线脚，高挑矩形凹嵌板，克制古典装饰线条，色调为温暖象牙色、香槟米色与浅棕灰色。环境柔焦虚化。左下背景：虚化的奶油白花卉与低调绿植（玫瑰、绣球花或牡丹），低放于地面附近或小桌上。右上背景：模糊为浅色有机形状的隐约花卉布置。

光线：来自镜头左侧略偏新娘身后的温暖漫射自然窗光。最亮照明沿发顶、面部外缘、裸露肩膀与头纱各层延伸。缎面胸衣上有柔和高光，远侧面部与躯干有轻柔阴影塑形。头纱捕捉并散射光线形成灿烂象牙色光晕而不夹断质感。米色房间的细腻暖色反光柔化阴影。

色调：近乎单色——象牙色、奶油色、香槟色、暖米色、浅裸粉、柔和棕灰、珍珠白、深巧克力棕发色。克制饱和度，暖色高光，奶油肌肤色，略微低调阴影。无纯蓝白面料、冷灰肌肤、强黄色或橙色调。

构图：高挑窗户在左侧形成发光竖向线条。新娘面部靠近左上三分之一交叉点。头纱流入右侧开放空间。眼睛是最锐利焦点，其次是睫毛、嘴唇、耳环、发丝、胸衣边缘与附近头纱质感。远处墙板、花卉与窗户细节化为奶油感焦外光斑。

相机与风格：高端韩系婚纱写真、豪华婚礼大片、纯艺术时尚摄影。全画幅85mm或105mm，f/1.8–f/2.5，低ISO，柔和自然曝光。轻柔镜头压缩，极顺滑背景分离，明亮高光处细腻光晕，真实面料渲染，细腻电影感颗粒。高动态范围：阳光照射头纱保留网眼细节，阴影部分发丝保持立体感。

负面限制：无文字、无水印、无多余人物、无重复珠宝、无变形手部、无不对称眼睛、无变形肩膀、无扭曲头纱、无强闪光、无重度晕影、无过度肌肤磨皮、无面部过曝、无人工塑料感面料、无杂乱背景。

一张极其真实的热带海岛度假随手拍照片，竖版 9:16 构图，使用手机后置摄像头或便携数码相机拍摄。画面位于马尔代夫风格的水上度假村，一辆正在木质栈道上行驶或停靠的开放式高尔夫球车内部。镜头从车辆后排座位略低的位置向前拍摄，视角贴近座椅靠背，具有明显的第一人称旅拍感和未经刻意摆拍的生活气息。

画面主体是一位年轻成年东亚女性，坐在高尔夫球车中间偏右的位置，身体侧面对着镜头，面朝画面左侧。人物从大腿到头顶完整入镜，身体呈优雅自然的侧坐姿态，双腿弯曲并拢，膝盖位于画面下方偏左。腰部轻微后仰，背部和腰线自然拉长，躯干纤细但不过度夸张，肩颈修长，手臂纤细，身体比例真实自然。

人物双臂举过头顶，双手正在整理或扎起头发。一只手从头顶上方抓住头发，另一只手扶在后脑附近，肘部向两侧自然展开，形成清晰的三角形手臂轮廓。动作像是坐车途中随手扎马尾，被同行者偶然拍下的一瞬间，不要僵硬摆拍，不要标准模特姿势。

人物拥有精致但自然的东亚面孔，偏窄的鹅蛋脸，立体侧脸，清晰鼻梁，小巧鼻尖，柔和下颌线，略微饱满的自然嘴唇。她微微低头并从侧面望向画面左前方，不直视镜头，神情安静、冷淡、略带若有所思的感觉。眼妆细致但不过分浓重，细长眼线，睫毛自然，眉形干净，肤色为健康的暖调浅棕色，带有海岛日晒后的轻微小麦色，不要冷白皮，不要过度磨皮。

头发为中长款浅棕色或焦糖棕色染发，发根略深，扎成较高的马尾。马尾垂落至肩胛骨附近，发丝蓬松自然，带有轻微凌乱和海风吹动感。额前和脸颊附近有几缕碎发被风吹起，部分发丝横过面部，增强真实抓拍感。佩戴小型银色耳环或金属耳饰。

人物穿一套带复古条纹图案的连体泳衣或露背泳装，颜色包括棕色、米色、黑色、灰蓝色、暗红色和少量青绿色。泳装为细肩带设计，侧面开口较大，露出肩背、腰侧和大部分背部。布料贴合身体但保持自然，不透明，不要乳胶感。腰部和髋部可见同系列条纹泳装面料，整体具有 1970 年代复古海岛度假风格。

构图必须高度还原真实高尔夫球车内部的遮挡关系。画面最上方约四分之一到三分之一被深色车顶遮挡，车顶底面呈黑褐色或暗灰色，光线不足，能看到金属支架、黑色固定带、安全扶手以及车顶边缘的浅色软质包覆物。顶部区域明显偏暗，形成强烈的框景效果。

画面下方约四分之一被高尔夫球车前排或后排座椅靠背遮挡，座椅为黑色与米灰色拼接的皮革或塑料材质，边缘呈平滑波浪形弧线。左下角和右下角均有大面积深色遮挡，使人物像是从车辆座椅之间被拍摄。人物身体位于上下两块暗色遮挡之间，形成狭窄而自然的视觉窗口。

人物左侧能看到高尔夫球车的黑色弧形扶手，扶手从画面中下部向上弯曲。人物背后有白色或浅灰色的车体立柱和金属支撑结构。车辆结构必须真实可信，不能像室内椅子，也不能变成敞篷汽车。

背景是一条延伸至远方的浅灰褐色木质水上栈道。栈道从画面中央下方开始，向左上方和远处延伸，具有明显透视纵深。木板排列整齐但有自然磨损、盐渍和少量白色痕迹。栈道两侧是清澈的浅蓝绿色热带海水，近处水面呈青绿色，远处逐渐变成浅蓝灰色，能隐约看到水下结构和自然波纹。

画面左侧背景有一条狭长的水上码头向海中延伸，码头带有规律排列的立柱和栏杆，远处停着一艘小型接驳船或遮阳顶游艇。画面右侧背景可见水上建筑、木质平台、浅色墙面和竖向木条装饰，局部有热带绿色植被。远处天空为阴天或薄云天气，颜色浅灰蓝，光线柔和，没有强烈阳光和灿烂晚霞。

光线为真实阴天自然光。人物位于高尔夫球车车顶阴影下，因此面部、躯干和手臂整体偏暗，仅从车辆侧面进入的海面反射光轻柔照亮侧脸、手臂外缘、肩部和腰线。人物不能被补光灯直接照亮，不要闪光灯，不要棚拍光，不要轮廓光。背景海水和栈道比人物略亮，形成轻微逆光和高动态范围场景。

整体曝光略偏暗，保留真实手机拍摄中主体欠曝、背景较亮的感觉。人物暗部仍能看见自然皮肤细节，但不要强行提亮阴影。高光不过曝，天空和海水保留层次。画面色调偏自然冷灰与青绿色，人物肤色偏暖，形成柔和的冷暖对比。降低整体饱和度，避免过度鲜艳的旅游宣传片色彩。

照片必须具有高度写实的手机旅拍质感：真实皮肤纹理、细微毛孔、自然汗意、少量肤色不均、真实发丝、轻微运动模糊、有限动态范围、局部噪点、轻微压缩痕迹、细微锐化、真实 JPEG 质感。画面边缘略暗，顶部和底部暗部有轻微黑位压缩。不要商业修图，不要影棚质感，不要时尚大片式精修，不要过度光滑皮肤。

镜头约为手机等效 24—28mm 广角，但不要明显鱼眼畸变。拍摄距离约 1.5—2 米，镜头高度略低于人物肩膀，画面略微向上拍摄。景深较深，人物和背景栈道都保持较清晰，仅远处码头和船只轻微柔化。保持真实手机照片的空间关系。

画面氛围安静、私密、松弛，像是在海岛度假期间乘坐高尔夫球车时，由坐在后排的朋友随手拍下。人物没有意识到镜头，整个瞬间自然、偶然、克制，兼具轻微时尚感和真实生活感。

Shot from a high angle. The character is placed near the bottom center of the frame, with the upper part retaining wide blue negative space and branch/leaf shadows. prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium editorial advertising poster for Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin, designed as a museum-masterpiece surreal scene in which the Mona Lisa remains seated in her original classical pose inside her legendary oil painting, while only one hand elegantly extends out of the frame to clink a champagne glass with a modern fashionable woman standing beside the artwork in a real exhibition hall. The image must feel cultured, luxurious, witty, cinematic, and visually unforgettable, as if art history and contemporary elegance briefly touched through one refined celebratory gesture.

Use a tall vertical composition set inside a grand European museum gallery with deep muted green or dark moss walls, soft architectural depth, and a refined exhibition atmosphere. A monumental gilded Renaissance frame containing the Mona Lisa-inspired portrait must dominate the upper-middle portion of the composition. The frame should feel authentic, ornate, and museum-grade, like the focal treasure of a world-famous gallery room.

The key visual concept is a cross-century toast with minimal impossible movement.
The Mona Lisa must remain unmistakably rooted in the visual language and body posture of the original High Renaissance masterpiece:
seated composition,
calm frontal stillness,
subtle enigmatic smile,
soft sfumato transitions,
dark classical garments,
and museum-level oil painting realism.
Her body must not step out of the painting.
Her shoulders, torso, posture, and seated structure must remain faithful to the original composition.
Only one arm and hand extend naturally beyond the frame, holding a refined crystal champagne coupe outward into real space.

The hand extension must feel like a miraculous but delicate breach of reality:
graceful wrist angle,
elegant finger positioning,
painterly-to-real transition,
and believable continuity from the painted figure.
The effect must feel subtle, sacred, and refined, not theatrical.

Standing in the real gallery space beside the painting, place a modern fashionable woman:
European/American healthy-fit woman with model-like beauty,
natural luxury presence,
clean anatomy,
realistic proportions,
and elegant posture.
She must look contemporary, refined, and high-end, wearing a chic museum-appropriate fashion look such as:
a black tailored dress,
minimalist eveningwear,
a couture coat,
or a polished editorial ensemble with understated jewelry.
She should hold only a champagne coupe in her hand and gently raise it toward Mona Lisa’s extended glass in a poised, delighted toast.
She must not hold the bottle.
Her expression should show warm surprise, cultured delight, and elegant disbelief.

The Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin bottle must still appear in the real gallery world and be rendered with absolute product fidelity:
authentic green champagne bottle,
correct Veuve Clicquot yellow label,
legible branding,
accurate foil and neck wrapping,
premium glass reflections,
and unmistakable luxury champagne identity.
The bottle must not be in the modern woman’s hand.
Instead, place it elegantly in the lower foreground, on a pedestal, on a refined side table, or as part of a curated display near the bottom of the composition.
It must remain clearly visible and product-dominant without distracting from the toast.

The champagne glasses must be exquisitely realistic:
thin crystal coupes,
golden champagne tone,
subtle bubbles,
clean glass reflections,
and a graceful point of contact.
The clink moment should feel delicate and ceremonial, not exaggerated.
No messy splash.
No comedic spill.
At most, allow a tiny restrained shimmer or tremor of liquid at the rim from the impact.

Render the Mona Lisa and the painting with museum-grade fidelity:
authentic oil-paint texture,
subtle craquelure,
aged varnish glow,
fine tonal glazing,
Renaissance softness,
and true old-master gravitas.
The painting must still feel like a genuine masterpiece, not a parody or costume recreation.

The emotional contrast is essential:
Mona Lisa remains composed and timeless inside the painting,
yet one small gesture connects her to the modern world.
The modern woman responds with joy and reverence.
The scene should feel impossible, cultured, elegant, and quietly magical.

Lighting:
use soft cinematic museum lighting with painterly richness and restrained golden highlights.
The gilded frame should glow warmly,
the Veuve Clicquot bottle should catch crisp premium reflections,

items.title: 咖啡馆露台二十多岁女性写实人像

prompts.text:
Photorealistic everyday café scene featuring an adult woman in her twenties.

Background identity: a sidewalk café terrace in soft afternoon light, with small round café tables, metal chairs, striped awning shadows, glass storefront reflections, potted greenery, a few layered tables behind, and a softly blurred city sidewalk. The setting should feel airy, urban, and naturally social.

Depth lock: in the foreground, a blurred table rim, chair back, or plant leaf enters close to the lens. In the middle ground, the subject sits at an outdoor café table. In the background, storefront reflections, neighboring tables, and street depth recede diagonally.

Composition lock: vertical 4:5 lifestyle crop from around seat height, framed from waist or mid-thigh to head. The subject fills about 65–75% of the frame. Keep the table, cup and saucer, a little storefront glass, and some street depth visible. The framing should feel natural and unforced.

Action lock: the subject sits naturally on the chair with both feet on the ground. She has just finished a sip and is lowering the coffee cup back toward the saucer, stopping just above it in a believable placement motion. One hand holds the cup by the handle; the other hand rests lightly near the table edge or lap. Her shoulders stay soft, posture casual, and the body angle slightly turned toward the table.

Gaze design: while placing the cup down, she turns only her eyes and a small amount of her face toward the camera, creating a brief natural glance without fully stopping the action. The direct eye contact should feel incidental and candid, as if she noticed the camera for a second.

Avoid: strong perch pose, raised knee, dramatic lean, both elbows on the table, frozen cup placement, exaggerated twisting, staged arm lines, full-body terrace overview, prop-like cup handling.

prompts.text:
Create a realistic fashion street portrait in a busy city, vertical 9:16.

A young woman is captured in a candid editorial-style street moment. Her face and eyes remain sharp and expressive, with a quiet emotional gaze, while the surrounding city moves around her.

Use a panning motion-blur photography effect: blurred pedestrians, passing traffic, soft light streaks, and slightly distorted urban architecture in the background. The motion blur should feel natural and photographic, not like a filter.

Her hair is a key visual element: natural wind-blown hair, layered strands, flyaway hairs, soft movement, and glowing backlit edges. The hair should feel real, loose, and slightly messy, not like perfect studio hair.

The image should feel like a real fashion street snap, not a studio portrait and not an obvious AI beauty image. Keep the skin realistic with natural texture, subtle imperfections, and a living human presence.

Wardrobe should feel elegant, urban, and editorial, such as a black coat, camel trench, plaid coat, light summer shirt, sleeveless top, or refined city outfit. The styling should feel natural and believable, not like a staged fashion catalog.

Lighting: soft golden-hour backlight, diffused urban light, or cinematic street light. Low-saturation color grading, subtle film grain, long-lens street photography feel, atmospheric depth, premium editorial mood.

prompts.text: Create a realistic 3:4 vertical environmental portrait with the feeling of an intimate everyday snapshot. An adult woman around 20 to 26 years old is lying on her stomach across a bed layered with rumpled sheets, a red-and-green plaid covering and several brown and charcoal pillows. Both elbows press into the pillows to support her upper body. Her hands meet naturally beneath her chin, fingers overlapping with small irregularities as she holds a plain transparent cylindrical glass containing a little water or a pale drink. Her head is lifted and turned gently toward frame left, while her eyes look past the camera toward the upper-left corner as though she is quietly listening to someone nearby. Her lips are naturally closed or only barely parted. The expression is soft, alert, thoughtful and slightly absent-minded, without direct eye contact or an obvious smile.  Her body extends diagonally toward the upper-right side of the frame. Both knees are bent and her socked feet lift behind her at unequal heights and slightly different angles, preserving the relaxed asymmetry of a real resting pose. She has a small oval face, a soft jawline, large clear eyes, a refined short nose and naturally full lips. Use a restrained doll-inspired makeup direction commonly found in East Asian fashion editorials: a thin fair-toned base with subtle natural texture, muted pink color through the cheeks and central face, narrow brown-black eyeliner, naturally lengthened lashes, softly defined lower-eye fullness, straight relaxed brows and glossy coral-pink or peach-pink lips. Preserve the original facial proportions and avoid a generic influencer face, celebrity replacement or exaggerated youthful appearance.  Her hair is long, deep chocolate brown and nearly black in shadow, styled in broad loose waves with a fragmented straight fringe across the forehead. Keep believable volume at the crown, a few irregular strands and areas compressed against the pillows and body. Direct sunlight should reveal warm chestnut and reddish-brown highlights without making the hair look uniformly curled or wig-like.  She wears an oversized deep-navy vintage Fair Isle knit top with cream, blue-gray, brick-red and pale-purple snowflake, diamond and zigzag motifs. The material is thick, soft and faintly fuzzy, with loose cuffs, a dropped shoulder line and natural compression folds around the elbows. The lower garment is a warm cream openwork crochet mini skirt or skort with handmade floral openings, a scalloped edge and a small dark tie detail, paired with ivory-white ribbed mid-calf socks featuring ruffled cuffs and relaxed wear creases. The visible skin is limited to the face, a small area of the neck, both hands, fingers and wrists, and a small section of leg between the garment and the socks. Keep the shoulders, chest, waist, abdomen, back, hips and buttocks covered. Her skin is fair with a neutral peach undertone and faint natural pinkness in the cheeks and fingertips. It should appear soft, finely textured and lightly hydrated, with the tactile quality of warm smooth satin while retaining tiny realistic details around the knuckles, palms, nose and facial planes.  Photograph the scene with the casual realism of a high-end smartphone or compact digital camera using an approximately 26 to 35 mm full-frame equivalent focal length. Place the camera slightly above and in front of the subject at a gentle downward oblique angle, with a small tilt so the body, pillows and lifted feet form a diagonal from lower left to upper right. Keep the face and hands most sharply defined, while the socks, foreground tomatoes and background furniture remain recognizable. Use moderate depth of field rather than aggressive portrait-mode blur. Add a faint retro digital texture, restrained grain, gentle sharpness, small warm color shifts, subtle JPEG character and slight highlight bloom.  Strong warm afternoon sunlight enters directly from a window near the upper-right or front side of the scene. The light strikes her cheek, nose bridge, lips, hands, fingers, socks, small portions of the legs and the bedding, producing clear hard-edged physical shadows. Allow slight translucency along the sunlit edges of the fingers and reflected highlights from the drinking glass near the hands and chin. Do not use an obvious softbox, rim light or evenly balanced fill. Let the dark wooden cabinet and curtain remain in deep shadow, while selected highlights on the pale socks and skin approach mild overexposure.  The background is a warm, visually rich and slightly cluttered vintage bedroom or sitting space. Include a dark walnut cabinet or shelving unit, worn books, a black round vintage alarm clock, several glass storage jars, a small woven-grille speaker or radio, a wooden bowl of green grapes, a partially visible leafy plant, a retro printed cover featuring red tulips, dark curtains, layered pillows and plaid bedding. In the foreground, place a white plate filled with vivid red cherry tomatoes in direct sunlight, with a cropped green book or magazine entering from the lower edge. Keep the objects unevenly arranged, partially obscured and naturally cropped. Preserve tilted framing, fabric wrinkles, deep shadows, small overexposed patches and the accumulated feeling of a room that has been lived in for years.  The final image should feel quiet, warm, nostalgic and private, as though someone familiar standing beside the bed captured the moment without preparation. The afternoon light had already crossed the window frame; she had paused while drinking and was still holding the glass when she looked toward someone outside the frame. Avoid an underage appearance, sexualized posing, extra exposed skin, exaggerated body curves, plastic skin, deformed hands or feet, perfectly symmetrical limbs, commercial studio lighting, a minimalist showroom background, excessive blur, text, watermarks and platform logos.

prompts.text: 创建一张写实的3:4纵向环境人像，具有亲密的日常抓拍感。一名大约20到26岁的成年女性俯卧在铺着褶皱床单、红绿格子覆盖物以及几个棕色和木炭色枕头的床上。双肘压在枕头上以支撑她的上半身。她的双手自然地在下巴下方相遇，手指以微小的不规则感重叠，她握着一个装有少量水或浅色饮料的透明圆柱形玻璃杯。她的头抬起并轻轻转向画面左侧，而她的眼睛看向相机之外的左上角，仿佛她正在静静地倾听旁边的某人。她的嘴唇自然闭合或仅微张。表情柔和、警觉、沉思且略显心不在焉，没有直接的目光接触或明显的微笑。她的身体向画面的右上侧对角线延伸。双膝弯曲，穿着袜子的双脚在身后以不等的高度和略微不同的角度抬起，保持了真实休息姿势的放松不对称性。她有一张小小的鹅蛋脸，柔和的下颌线，大而清澈的眼睛，精致的短鼻子和自然丰满的嘴唇。使用东亚时尚社论中常见的克制的玩偶风妆容方向：薄且色调白皙的基础底妆，带有细微的自然纹理，脸颊和面部中央呈现淡粉色，窄窄的棕黑色眼线，自然延长的睫毛，柔和定义的下眼睑丰满度，平直放松的眉毛以及光泽的珊瑚粉或桃粉色嘴唇。保留原始面部比例，避免大众网红脸、明星替代或夸张的年轻外观。她的头发很长，呈深巧克力棕色，在阴影中近乎黑色，造型为宽大的松散波浪，额头上有细碎的直刘海。保持头顶可信的蓬松度，有一些不规则的发丝以及压在枕头和身体上的区域。直射阳光应显露出温暖的栗色和红棕色高光，而不会让头发看起来像统一卷曲或像假发。她穿着一件大号深蓝色复古费尔岛针织上衣，带有奶油色、蓝灰色、砖红色和淡紫色雪花、菱形和锯齿图案。材质厚实、柔软且略带绒毛感，有宽松的袖口、落肩线和手肘周围的自然压缩褶皱。下半身穿着一件温暖的奶油色镂空钩编迷你裙或裙裤，带有手工花卉开口、扇形边缘和一个小深色系带细节，搭配象牙白罗纹中筒袜，带有荷叶边袖口和放松的穿着褶皱。可见的皮肤仅限于面部、颈部的一小部分、双手、手指和手腕，以及衣物和袜子之间的一小段腿部。保持肩膀、胸部、腰部、腹部、背部、臀部被遮盖。她的皮肤白皙，带有中性的桃色底色，脸颊和指尖有淡淡的自然粉色。它应该看起来柔软、纹理细腻且轻微水润，具有温暖光滑缎面的触感，同时保留指关节、手掌、鼻子和面部平面的微小真实细节。使用约26至35毫米全画幅等效焦距，以高端智能手机或紧凑型数码相机的随性写实感拍摄场景。将相机放置在被摄主体上方稍靠前的位置，呈轻微向下的斜角，并带有微小的倾斜，使身体、枕头和抬起的脚从左下到右上形成对角线。保持面部和手部清晰度最高，而袜子、前景西红柿和背景家具保持可辨认。使用适度的景深，而不是激进的人像模式虚化。添加淡淡的复古数字纹理、克制的颗粒感、柔和的锐度、细微的暖色偏移、微妙的JPEG特征和轻微的高光溢出。强烈的温暖午后阳光直接从场景右上角或前方的窗户射入。光线照射在她的脸颊、鼻亮、嘴唇、手、手指、袜子、腿部的一小部分和床上用品上，产生清晰、轮廓分明的物理阴影。允许手指在阳光照射的边缘出现轻微的透光感，以及手和下巴附近玻璃杯的反射高光。不要使用明显的柔光箱、轮廓光或均衡的补光。让深色木柜和窗帘保持在深邃的阴影中，而浅色袜子和皮肤上的特定高光则接近轻度过曝。背景是一个温暖、视觉丰富且略显凌乱的复古卧室或起居空间。包括一个深色胡桃木柜子或架子单元、磨损的书籍、一个黑色圆形复古闹钟、几个玻璃储物罐、一个小型编织网格扬声器或收音机、一碗木制的绿葡萄、一盆部分可见的叶片植物、一张印有红色郁金香的复古封面、深色窗帘、分层枕头和格子床上用品。在前景中，放置一个装满鲜红圣女果的白盘子，处于直射阳光下，边缘处有一本裁剪过的绿色书籍或杂志。保持物品摆放不均匀、部分被遮挡并自然裁剪。保留倾斜的构图、织物皱褶、深邃阴影、小块过曝区域以及在这个房间生活多年的累积感。最终画面应该感觉安静、温暖、怀旧和私密，仿佛站在床边的熟人在没有准备的情况下捕捉到了这一刻。午后的光线已经穿过窗框；她在喝水时停了下来，当她看向画框外的某人时，手里还拿着杯子。避免未成年外观、性暗示姿势、额外暴露的皮肤、夸张的身体曲线、塑料感皮肤、畸形的手或脚、完美对称的肢体、商业摄影棚灯光、极简主义陈列室背景、过度虚化、文字、水印和平台标志。

prompts.text:
Task: Design a high-end fruit e-commerce packaging proposal board for "Kirin Watermelon," with the theme "Qi Xia Li Jing" (Summer Realm of Kirin Gifts), targeting urban mid-to-high-end family gifting, corporate group buying, and fresh e-commerce boutique gift box scenarios. The output should be a professional, restrained, realistic, and executable packaging design proposal board, rather than a generic advertising poster.

Brand Positioning and Audience: premium fresh fruit ecommerce gift packaging for Kirin watermelon, restrained luxury agricultural gifting, trustworthy, fresh, premium, modern Chinese aesthetic, audience includes urban families, summer seasonal gifting buyers, enterprise welfare procurement, boutique fresh-food ecommerce consumers.

Hero Packaging Structure: The center of the frame features an oversized 45-degree hero package, occupying about 50% of the screen. The packaging adopts the structural logic of an "integrated book-style flip-top gift box + external shipping protective case." The gift box is a horizontal rectangular parallelepiped with stable proportions and sharp corners; when the lid is fully unfolded, the inner tray and dual fruit positions are visible. The shipping protective case appears on the side as a secondary module, showing its compression resistance, protection, and shipping label area in a concise manner. The gift box handle should not be fragile cutouts but replaced with reinforced webbing handles or a hidden side-lift structure. The bottom structure must be thick, with a lock-bottom or tray-style load-bearing logic. The entire package must not look thin or cheap and must have realistic rigid board and corrugated structure thickness.

Fruit and Inner Tray Logic: Kirin watermelons are large and heavy; the proposal uses a 2-fruit pack. The interior is a dual independent fruit position array, using molded pulp insert / paper-pulp tray with contour support, each watermelon seated into a shaped cradle, with honeycomb-paper bottom cushion, top stabilizing ring, side anti-roll ribs, clear lid clearance, visible ventilation path. Fruits must not be suspended, must not squeeze each other, and must not bear weight or collide directly on the skin. The unboxing module should clearly show two fruit positions, limiting rings, bottom cushioning, lifting hand positions, and ventilation paths. A single sliced watermelon can be included as a small-area auxiliary item to emphasize category identification, but it should not overwhelm the main subject.

Visual Identity System: The overall style is high-end Oriental agricultural gift packaging, clean premium packaging board, modern Chinese typography mood, restrained composition. The main colors are deep dark green and jade white, with pale vine yellow as an auxiliary, and small accents of watermelon pulp red and low-saturation gold foil. The graphic language comes from "abstracted Kirin patterns + watermelon vine curves + summer wind field textures," but it must be minimalist and orderly, suitable for large-area packaging, avoiding traditional complex "Guochao" stacking. Surface materials are represented as specialty paper mounted on grey board, partial gold foil logo, partial UV product name, and fine embossing. The number of processes should be restrained, with no more than three key effects. Paper texture, corrugated edge thickness, and molded pulp tray fiber texture should all be clearly visible.

Proposal Board Composition: Use a clean studio presentation board with a light warm white background and a slight jade-colored gradient. In addition to the central hero package, 7 to 8 auxiliary modules are arranged in a modular grid around it:
1. Unboxing view: showing the dual-fruit inner tray structure after the flip-top is opened.
2. Three-view drawing: small images of the front, side, and top packaging exterior.
3. Inner tray structure enlargement: showing the pulp tray, honeycomb bottom cushion, top limiting ring, and lifting hand positions.
4. Shipping protective case module: showing the outer protective box, shipping label area, barcode area, and QR code placeholder area.
5. Die-line structure diagram: production-intent dieline visualization, not disguised as a fully production-ready file.
6. Material and process swatches: specialty paper, pulp tray, gold foil, partial UV, embossing.
7. Key dimension annotations: outer dimensions of the gift box, net space for a single fruit, handle position, and ventilation hole avoidance logic.
8. Brand story small module: small-area display of the "Summer Boutique Melon Gift" positioning phrase and origin emblem.

Dieline and Production Annotations: Arrange a readable but non-distracting dieline module in the lower right or bottom. Use standard legends: red solid line for cutting, blue dashed line for creasing, green for bleed, purple for safety line, light green for ventilation holes, light brown for inner tray cushioning area, and yellow for adhesive positions. Annotations should be clean modular annotations, unit mm, bleed 3 mm, safety margin 5 mm, finished-size tolerance +-1 mm, die-cut tolerance +-0.5 mm, print registration tolerance +-0.3 mm, logistics label zone, barcode placeholder, QR placeholder, traceability code placeholder, batch/date placeholder. Note that all code areas must be clearly labeled placeholder zones, not fake readable codes.

Lighting and Lens: soft studio lighting, premium commercial packaging photography, realistic shadows, subtle reflections, balanced white background, sharp focus, high resolution, professional industrial design board, clean alignment, generous negative space, realistic scale, luxury ecommerce proposal board, landscape composition, 16:9 ratio. The hero package is the most prominent, and auxiliary modules are clear but smaller; the whole thing looks like a real packaging concept board presented to a client.

Packaging Copy Blocks: Try to render short and clear text on the packaging within the scene, avoiding dense long paragraphs. Visible text is controlled to a few short words:
Brand main title: Kirin Watermelon
English subtitle: KIRIN WATERMELON
Proposal title: Summer Boutique Gift Box
Auxiliary phrases: Sweet and Crisp / Selected Origin / Dual Fruit Gift
Corner labels placeholders: Origin emblem / Variable info zone / Logistics label zone / Barcode zone / QR code zone
Please treat all text as short label-style typography, maintaining a sense of high quality and white space, and do not generate large blocks of hard-to-read text.

Final Effect Requirements: professional premium fruit ecommerce packaging proposal board, one oversized 45-degree hero package, photorealistic paper and corrugated texture, heavy-fruit protective insert, coherent opening structure, realistic rigid gift box plus shipping sleeve logic, production-intent dieline visualization, restrained luxury agricultural brand identity, clean technical annotations, physically plausible structure, elegant high-end Chinese packaging presentation.
