品牌定位与受众：premium fresh fruit ecommerce gift packaging for Kirin watermelon, restrained luxury agricultural gifting, trustworthy, fresh, premium, modern Chinese aesthetic, audience includes urban families, summer seasonal gifting buyers, enterprise welfare procurement, boutique fresh-food ecommerce consumers.

英雄包装结构：画面中心为一个超大 45-degree hero package，占画面 50% 左右。包装采用“一体式书型翻盖礼盒 + 外部运输护箱”的结构逻辑。礼盒为横向长方体，比例稳重，边角挺括，盖面完整展开后能看到内托与双果位；运输护箱作为次级模块出现在侧边，以较简洁方式展示其抗压、防护与面单区。礼盒提手不要做脆弱挖孔，改为加固织带提手或隐藏式侧提结构。底部结构必须厚实，有锁底或托盘式承重逻辑。整个包装不能显得轻薄廉价，必须有 realistic rigid board and corrugated structure thickness.

水果与内托逻辑：麒麟西瓜为大果重果，方案采用 2果装。内部为双独立果位阵列，使用 molded pulp insert / paper-pulp tray with contour support, each watermelon seated into a shaped cradle, with honeycomb-paper bottom cushion, top stabilizing ring, side anti-roll ribs, clear lid clearance, visible ventilation path. 果实不得悬空，不得互相挤压，不得靠果皮直接承重碰撞。开箱模块中应清楚看到两个果位、限位环、底部缓冲、提取手位和透气孔路径。可以加入单个切面西瓜作为小面积辅助物，强调品类识别，但不能喧宾夺主。

视觉识别系统：整体风格为高端东方农业礼品包装，clean premium packaging board, modern Chinese typography mood, restrained composition. 主色为深墨绿色、玉白色，辅助为淡藤黄色，点缀少量西瓜瓤红与低饱和烫金。图形语言来自“麒麟纹样抽象化 + 西瓜藤蔓曲线 + 夏季风场纹理”，但必须极简、规整、可用于大面积包装，不要传统复杂国潮堆砌。表面材质表现为特种纸裱灰板、局部烫金 logo、局部 UV 产品名、细腻压纹。工艺数量要克制，不超过三种重点效果。纸张纹理、瓦楞边厚度、模塑纸托纤维感都应清晰可见。

提案板构成：使用 clean studio presentation board，浅暖白背景带轻微玉色渐层。除中央英雄包装外，周围以模块化网格排布 7 到 8 个辅助模块：
1. 开箱视图：展示翻盖打开后的双果位内托结构

8. 品牌故事小模块：小面积展示“夏季精品瓜礼”的定位语和产地徽记

刀模与生产标注：在右下或下方安排一个可读但不抢戏的 dieline module。使用标准图例表达：红色实线裁切线、蓝色虚线压痕线、绿色出血线、紫色安全线、浅绿色透气孔、浅棕色内托缓冲区域、黄色粘胶位。标注内容要是 clean modular annotations, unit mm, bleed 3 mm, safety margin 5 mm, finished-size tolerance +-1 mm, die-cut tolerance +-0.5 mm, print registration tolerance +-0.3 mm, logistics label zone, barcode placeholder, QR placeholder, traceability code placeholder, batch/date placeholder。注意所有码区都必须是 clearly labeled placeholder zones, not fake readable codes.

items.title: 午后和风咖啡厅阅读的优雅女性

prompts.text:
Theme:
Afternoon reading seat

Subject:
Vertical photo style portrait. In a quiet Japanese modern cafe lounge, an adult woman sits on a beige fabric bench, positioned towards the left side of the frame and occupying a large space. Right hand holds a book bound like a literary novel, facing the side where the cover can be seen, left hand lightly placed on the seat surface to support the body.

Character·Expression:
Adult woman with a natural face. Radiates a mature and calm atmosphere, body is not excessively thin, showing healthy proportions. Dark brown hair loosely styled into long waves, strands slightly falling around the face. Elegant rose-toned makeup, natural tear bags, light reddish lip color. Head tilted slightly towards the left of the frame, eyes quietly cast towards the camera. Expression not too intense, as if suddenly looking up in the middle of reading, leaving a trace of lingering charm.

Clothing·Pose:
Black V-neck camisole dress. Has a satin-like subtle luster, decorated with fine black lace at the chest and hem, with casual patchwork lines on the waist side, simple design but with a sense of Japanese fashion sophistication. The skirt length is short, but the overall balance appears elegant. No jacket. Right hand lightly grips the spine of the book, turning the cover towards the camera. Left hand placed on the bench, weight naturally carried from shoulder to arm. Legs extended diagonally towards the bottom right of the frame, knees slightly together, wearing black patent leather high heels.

Background·Light:
Wooden bookshelves, round wooden table, black mug, large green plants, and soft pendant lights reminiscent of shoji, forming a quiet cafe space. The window is located at the back right of the frame, afternoon natural light shines in diagonally, forming soft highlights on the cheeks, shoulders, legs, and the edges of the black dress. There is faint reflected light on the floor and thin shadows on the back wall. Plant leaves and wood grain are naturally blurred, creating a sense of depth in the space. The book cover is in grey-beige tones, incorporating small plant illustrations and a layout design rich in white space. No real book titles or logos are used, text is processed to a natural degree that looks readable yet blurred and indistinct.

Composition·Lens:
Vertical composition, nearly full-body sitting pose. The figure is located in the center-left of the frame, legs extending long towards the bottom right. Blank space with pendant lights and plants is left above, while the right side retains a sense of transparency from the round table and window side. The lens uses a slightly low eye level, equivalent to the natural compression of a 50mm lens. The background is softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, focusing on the character's face, the book, and the texture of the black dress.

Texture·Style:
Realistic photo expression captured with a professional camera. Skin is not over-retouched, retaining natural texture and glow. The subtle reflections of the black satin, the delicate details of the lace, the matte texture of the paper cover, and the warmth of the wood and fabric bench are all meticulously depicted. Colors are mainly beige, brown, and black, with the overall presentation having a texture like a calm literary magazine insert.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, deformed joints, poor contact with the book, floating, unnatural sense of weight, wrong perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, garbled text, reproduction of real book covers, logos, watermarks, character toys, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

prompts.text:

主体：
纵向的照片风格肖像。在宁静的和风现代咖啡厅休息室中，一位成年女性坐在米色布艺长椅上，位置偏向画面左侧并占据较大空间。右手拿着装帧似文艺小说的书，朝向能看到封面的一侧，左手轻放在坐面上支撑身体。

人物·表情：
面容自然的成年女性。散发成熟而沉稳的气息，身材不过分纤细，呈现健康比例。深棕色头发松散地做成长波浪，发丝微微垂落在脸庞周围。优雅的玫瑰色妆容，自然的泪袋，淡雅带红的唇色。头部微微向画面左侧倾斜，视线静静地投向镜头。表情不过分强烈，仿佛在阅读中途忽然抬头，留下一丝余韵。

服装·姿势：
黑色V领吊带连衣裙。带有缎面般的低调光泽，胸口和裙摆处饰以细黑蕾丝，腰侧有不经意的拼接线条，设计简约却带有日系时尚的精致感。裙长较短，但整体平衡显得优雅。不穿外套。右手轻握书的背部，将封面向镜头一侧。左手置于长椅上，肩部至手臂自然地承载重心。双腿向画面右下方斜伸，膝盖微微并拢，脚上穿着黑色漆皮高跟鞋。

背景·光线：
木质书架、圆形木桌、黑色马克杯、大型绿植，以及让人联想到障子的柔和吊灯，构成安静的咖啡空间。窗户位于画面右后方，午后的自然光斜射进来，在脸颊、肩膀、腿部以及黑色衣裙的边缘形成柔和的高光。地板上有淡淡的反射光，后墙上有薄薄的阴影。植物叶片和木纹自然虚化，营造出空间的深度感。书封面为灰米色调，融入小型植物画和留白丰富的排版设计。不使用真实书名或标志，文字处理成看似可读却又模糊不清的自然程度。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图，接近全身的坐姿。人物位于画面左侧中央，双腿向右下方延伸较长。上方留有吊灯和植物的空白空间，右侧保留圆桌和窗边的通透感。镜头采用稍低的视线，相当于50mm的自然压缩感。背景以浅景深柔和虚化，对焦于人物的脸部、书本以及黑色连衣裙的质感。

质感·风格：
以专业相机拍摄的真实照片表现。肌肤不过度修饰，保留自然的肌理和光晕。黑色缎面的低调反射、蕾丝的细腻细节、纸质封面的哑光质感，以及木材和布艺长椅的温暖感，都被细致描绘。色调以米色、棕色、黑色为主，整体呈现如沉稳文艺杂志插页般的质感。

负面提示：

items.title: 凯歌香槟蒙娜丽莎超现实博物馆广告海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium editorial advertising poster for Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin, designed as a museum-masterpiece surreal scene in which the Mona Lisa, still inside her legendary oil painting, gracefully reaches out with one hand to hold a crystal coupe glass, while an elegant real woman’s hand from outside the painting pours champagne into the glass. The image must feel cultured, witty, luxurious, and visually unforgettable, like a world-class campaign where art history and real life meet for one impossible, refined moment.

Use a tall vertical composition set inside a grand European museum gallery with deep muted green or dark moss walls, soft architectural depth, and a quiet exhibition atmosphere. A monumental gilded Renaissance frame containing the Mona Lisa-inspired portrait must dominate the upper-middle portion of the scene. The frame should feel authentic, ornate, and museum-grade, like the focal treasure of a famous gallery room.

The key visual concept is the meeting of two worlds.
The Mona Lisa must remain inside the painting, visually faithful to the spirit of a High Renaissance masterpiece:
serene expression,
subtle half-smile,
soft sfumato transitions,
dark classical garments,
and calm old-master presence.
She should not step out of the painting completely.
Instead, one of her hands extends naturally toward the lower edge of the frame, holding a refined crystal coupe glass just outside or at the threshold of the frame, as if receiving an offering from the real world.

From outside the painting, introduce only the hand and partial forearm of a real elegant woman, entering the composition from the side or lower side of the frame. This hand must feel modern, refined, and physically real:
beautiful anatomy,
slender fingers,
graceful grip,
clean skin realism,
and controlled posture.
She is holding a real Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin bottle and pouring champagne toward the coupe in Mona Lisa’s hand.
The outside woman herself must remain unseen; only the hand and bottle should appear, making the gesture feel intimate, mysterious, and sophisticated.

Render the Mona Lisa and the painting with museum-grade fidelity:
authentic oil-paint texture,
subtle craquelure,
aged varnish glow,
fine tonal glazing,
Renaissance softness,
and historical gravitas.
The painting must still feel like a true masterpiece, not a parody or costume recreation.

The Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin bottle must be rendered with absolute product fidelity:
authentic green champagne bottle,
correct Veuve Clicquot yellow label,
legible branding,
accurate foil and neck wrapping,
premium glass reflections,
and unmistakable luxury champagne identity.
The bottle must feel like the sharpest and most tangible object in the scene, clearly visible and product-dominant without disrupting the artistic harmony.

The champagne pour must be exquisitely realistic and elegant:
a fine golden stream,
subtle sparkling bubbles,
clean transparent liquid flow,
minimal foam at the bottle mouth,
and physically believable motion.
The liquid should feel ceremonial, graceful, and elevated.
No messy splash.
No comic spill.
No chaotic droplets.
The pour must land cleanly into the coupe glass in Mona Lisa’s hand, creating a miraculous yet believable moment of exchange between painting and reality.

The emotional contrast is essential:
Mona Lisa should retain her famous calm, enigmatic serenity,
while the surreal act of receiving champagne from the real world creates the shock and sophistication of the image.
The scene should feel impossible, elegant, and quietly humorous, never slapstick.

Lighting:
use soft cinematic museum lighting with painterly richness and restrained golden highlights.
The gilded frame should glow warmly,
the bottle should catch crisp premium reflections,
the champagne stream should shimmer with delicate clarity,
and the painted face should preserve Renaissance softness and mystery.
All shadows must remain breathable and clean, with no muddy blacks, dirty blotches, or noisy shadow contamination.

Background:
keep the museum environment elegant and minimal,
with only subtle gallery depth, possibly blurred sculptures or distant visitors far in the background if needed for atmosphere.
No clutter, no busy crowd, no excessive props.
The focus must remain on the frame, Mona Lisa’s receiving gesture, the outside hand, the bottle, and the champagne stream.

Color palette:
Veuve Clicquot yellow,
museum gold,
dark green gallery walls,
aged brown-black oil-paint shadows,
warm skin ivory,
old varnish amber,
antique wood tones,
and soft champagne-gold highlights.
The palette should feel aristocratic, cultured, and unmistakably premium.

Typography must follow a refined luxury museum-poster layout.
Use a sophisticated English title such as:
“VEUVE CLICQUOT”
Below it, in smaller elegant uppercase text:
“PONSARDIN”
Optionally add a supporting line such as:
“WHEN ART RECEIVES CLICQUOT”
or
“A MASTERPIECE, SERVED”
Typography must feel artistic, luxurious, and exhibition-worthy, never loud or cheap.

Mood:
museum surrealism, cultured wit, masterpiece realism, aristocratic elegance, intimate impossibility, luxury champagne ritual, cinematic sophistication.

Rendering style:
hyper-real luxury advertising, museum-grade old-master realism, Mona Lisa receiving champagne from a real outside hand, premium product photography, elegant pouring liquid dynamics, cinematic gallery lighting, refined exhibition typography, 8k, world-class campaign quality.

Negative prompt:
cartoon Mona Lisa, parody meme style, crude comedy, messy spill, wrong yellow label, fake champagne bottle, chaotic museum crowd, low-detail painting texture, cheap costume reenactment, exaggerated facial expression, cluttered background, muddy shadows, black blotches, noisy dark areas, rough typography, low-end viral content aesthetic

prompts.text:
为凯歌香槟（Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin）创作一张超高端的社论式广告海报，设计为一个博物馆杰作般的超现实场景，其中蒙娜丽莎仍在她传奇的油画内，优雅地伸出一只手握住一个水晶浅碟香槟杯，而画作外一只优雅的真实女性手正向杯中倒入香槟。图像必须具有文化底蕴、诙谐、奢华且视觉上令人难忘，就像一场艺术史与现实生活在某个不可能而精致的时刻相遇的世界级营销活动。

采用竖长构图，背景设在宏伟的欧洲博物馆画廊内，拥有深沉的柔和绿色或深苔藓色墙壁、柔和的建筑深度和安静的展览氛围。一个装有受蒙娜丽莎启发的人像的大型金色文艺复兴风格画框必须占据画面的中上部分。画框应显得真实、华丽且具有博物馆水准，如同著名画廊展厅中的核心珍宝。

核心视觉理念是两个世界的交汇。
蒙娜丽莎必须留在画作内部，视觉上忠于盛期文艺复兴杰作的神韵：
安详的表情、
微妙的半微笑、
柔和的晕涂法过渡、
深色的古典服装、
以及沉稳的大师风范。
她不应完全走出画作。
相反，她的一只手自然地伸向画框的下边缘，在画框外或边缘处握住一个精致的水晶浅碟杯，仿佛在接受来自现实世界的馈赠。

从画作外部，仅引入一位真实的优雅女性的手和部分前臂，从画框的侧面或下方进入构图。这只手必须感觉现代、精致且具有生理真实感：
美丽的解剖结构、
纤细的手指、
优雅的抓握、
洁净的皮肤质感、
和受控的姿态。
她拿着一瓶真实的凯歌香槟（Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin）瓶子，正向蒙娜丽莎手中的浅碟杯倒入香槟。
画外的女性本人必须保持不可见；仅出现手和酒瓶，使这一动作显得亲密、神秘且考究。

以博物馆级的忠实度渲染蒙娜丽莎和画作：
真实的油画纹理、
微妙的裂纹、
陈年清漆的光泽、
细腻的色调上色、
文艺复兴的柔和感、
和历史的厚重感。
画作必须感觉像一件真正的杰作，而不是恶搞或古装重现。

凯歌香槟瓶的渲染必须绝对忠于产品：
真实的绿色香槟瓶、
正确的凯歌黄色标签、
清晰可辨的品牌标识、
准确的锡箔和瓶颈包装、
高端玻璃反光、
和不容错过的奢华香槟身份。
酒瓶必须感觉是场景中最锐利、最具体的物体，清晰可见且产品突出，同时不破坏艺术和谐。

香槟的倾倒必须极尽逼真且优雅：
细细的金黄色流体、
微妙的闪烁气泡、
洁净透明的液体流动、
瓶口处极少的泡沫、
和符合物理逻辑的动态感。
液体应感觉具有仪式感、优雅且高级。
没有杂乱的飞溅。
没有滑稽的溢出。
没有混乱的液滴。
倾倒出的液体必须干净地落入蒙娜丽莎手中的浅碟杯中，创造出一个奇迹般却又可信的绘画与现实交流的瞬间。

情感对比至关重要：
蒙娜丽莎应保持她著名的冷静、神秘的安详，
而从现实世界接受香槟的超现实行为则创造出图像的震撼力与精致感。
场景应感觉不可能、优雅且带有冷幽默，绝非闹剧。

光影：
使用柔和的电影级博物馆照明，具有绘画般的丰富性和克制的金色高光。
金色画框应散发出温暖的光芒、
酒瓶应捕捉到清脆的高端反射、
香槟流应闪烁着细腻的透明感、
而画中的面孔应保持文艺复兴时期的柔和与神秘。
所有阴影必须保持透气和洁净，没有浑浊的黑色、肮脏的斑块或噪点污染。

背景：
保持博物馆环境优雅极简、
仅有微妙的画廊深度，如果为了营造氛围，背景深处可以有模糊的雕塑或远处的游客。
不杂乱，没有拥挤的人群，没有过多的道具。
重心必须保持在画框、蒙娜丽莎的接收手势、画外的手、酒瓶和香槟流上。

调色板：
凯歌黄、
博物馆金、
深绿色画廊墙壁、
陈年棕黑色油画阴影、
温暖的象牙色皮肤、
老清漆琥珀色、
古董木色调、
和柔和的香槟金高光。
该色调应感觉高贵、有文化底蕴且显而易见的奢华。

排版必须遵循考究的奢华博物馆海报布局。
使用精致的英文标题，如：
“VEUVE CLICQUOT”
在其下方，使用较小的优雅大写文字：
“PONSARDIN”
可选地添加一行辅助文字，如：
“WHEN ART RECEIVES CLICQUOT”
或
“A MASTERPIECE, SERVED”
排版必须感觉具有艺术感、奢华且具有展览水准，绝不喧宾夺主或显廉价。

氛围：

prompts.text: Use case: product-mockup Asset type: professional electronics packaging proposal board Create an unofficial concept design for an “Apple MacBook High-end E-commerce Packaging Proposal Board”, the product is a thin silver high-end laptop. The brand temperament is minimalist, precise, quiet, and modern, targeting professional creators, business people, and high-end tech consumers. Do not imply that this is an official Apple release or a real mass-production scheme. The canvas uses a 16:9 horizontal composition, a clean warm white professional design proposal board background. An oversized main packaging display image is placed in the center of the screen, occupying about 50%–55% of the overall screen, as the absolute primary visual focus. The main packaging is shown in a 45° 3D perspective: a pearl white lid-and-base rigid retail gift box is slightly open, inside is a thin silver laptop, the box lid surface has only a restrained laptop outline and simple product name; real high-white paper, gray board thickness, precise box corners, and delicate matte touch are clearly visible. A small number of silver laptops, power adapters, and braided charging cables are placed next to the main packaging, all objects are grounded with contact shadows and do not float. The internal structure must comply with real electronic product packaging logic: a one-piece molded environmentally friendly pulp tray, with four-corner suspended limiters and a buffer zone, the bottom of the computer does not directly contact the rigid box bottom; a thin protective lining paper is set between the screen and the keyboard; finger-pull gaps are set on the left and right; the power adapter and charging cable are placed in independent paper sub-compartments, not in contact with the computer surface; headspace is reserved for opening the lid to avoid the lid pressing on the device; the paper tray has clear reinforcing ribs, rounded corners, and reasonable wall thickness. Outside the retail gift box, another natural color B-flute high-strength corrugated shipping outer box is shown, with four-corner buffering, sealing structure, anti-tamper seals, logistics label placeholders, barcode placeholders, and battery transport sign placeholders. Around the main packaging, 7–9 small auxiliary modules are used, arranged in a strict grid, and must not compete with the main visual: 1. Front, back, top, and side orthographic projection views of the retail gift box; 2. Unboxing effect diagram; 3. Exploded structural diagram of the pulp inner tray; 4. Placement diagram of the laptop, power adapter, and cable; 5. Double-layer protection relationship between the retail gift box and the shipping outer box; 6. production-intent dieline visualization, to be reviewed by structural engineers; 7. Material cross-section and thickness diagram; 8. Color samples of pearl white, fog silver gray, graphite black, and cold gray blue; 9. Matte film, embossing, and spot UV process samples with short production notes. Dielines and engineering legends use: solid red lines represent cut lines, blue dashed lines represent crease lines, green lines represent bleed lines, purple lines represent safety lines, gray lines represent reference lines, yellow areas represent glue positions, light brown areas represent pulp inner trays and buffer structures, bright white areas represent spot UV, and embossed shadow areas represent embossing. Labeled units in mm, 3 mm bleed on each side, 5 mm safety margin, finished size tolerance ±1 mm, die-cutting tolerance ±0.5 mm, printing registration tolerance ±0.3 mm, all data labeled as “Suggested values, to be confirmed by sampling”. Placeholder areas are reserved for logistics labels, barcodes, serial numbers, QR codes, compliance information, and battery transport signs, without generating scannable real codes. The visual design maintains an Apple-inspired minimal technology aesthetic, but do not copy existing official packaging layouts. Pearl white is the main color, fog silver gray and graphite black are auxiliary colors, with a very small amount of cold gray blue accents. The font is a restrained modern sans-serif font, with sufficient white space and clear information hierarchy. The box surface process uses only delicate matte film, slight embossing, and restrained spot UV, without using gold foil, complex patterns, or cheap promotional elements. Photography and rendering: photorealistic premium electronics packaging, oversized 45-degree hero box, realistic rigid paperboard and molded pulp texture, precise industrial packaging structure, soft diffused studio lighting, subtle contact shadows, realistic scale, clean modular technical annotations, award-winning packaging presentation, high-resolution commercial product visualization, crisp edges, restrained luxury, sophisticated negative space. Short text on the screen only uses: “MACBOOK” “PACKAGING CONCEPT” “RETAIL BOX” “SHIPPING BOX” “MOLDED PULP TRAY” “PROTECTION SYSTEM” “SUGGESTED DIMENSIONS” Remaining dense descriptions are expressed with short dashes and standardized placeholder blocks to avoid garbled long paragraphs. 场景可以是【场景】，例如荒野花田、湖边草地、雾气森林、金色麦田、海岸山路、暮色花园、山坡草原、河岸芦苇地。

1. 人物轮廓柔和但可识别，不要变形。
2. 白裙要轻薄、飘动、有纱感和层次。
3. 长发被风吹起，形成自然飞散感。
4. 背景有横向或旋转式运动模糊。
5. 色彩低饱和，带复古胶片颗粒。
6. 光线柔和，可以是清晨、黄昏、阴天、逆光或雾光。
7. 画面有诗意、孤独感、自由感、流动感。

慢门摄影、长曝光残影、柔焦、胶片颗粒、低饱和色彩、自然光、梦境人像、动态模糊、风感摄影、复古艺术照片、诗意电影感。

micro moisture on produce,

Every course should feel intelligent, seasonal, and Michelin-calibrated, never rustic, heavy, or casual.

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 ratio high-end color reveal editorial poster, including a blurred fashion portrait, a sharp reveal area, cinematic typography, and the 2026 visual system.

Theme: [Color Veil / Curated Self / Bloom Signal / Pale Trace]

Reveal Area: [Vertical Color Window / Blue Selection Box / Horizontal Eye Band / Profile Focus Box]  
Main Title: [Custom Original Title]  
Auxiliary Text: [Short Original Phrase + 2026]

The poster should be built around contrast:  
Outside the reveal area is a blurred portrait, while inside the frame is a clear, sharp, and memorable fragment.

Use soft focus, grain, soft shadows, editorial lighting, thin frame lines, clean typography, and a strong visual hierarchy.  
The image should give the feeling of a fashion editorial cover, visual album poster, or experimental beauty advertisement.

A grayscale blurred female portrait with a tall vertical red-orange reveal window.

Use warm red-orange lighting, red lips, realistic skin texture, soft hair, and a cinematic beauty atmosphere.

A black and white blurred fashion portrait with a strong electric blue selection box.  
Inside the frame reveals sharp color details of the face, cheeks, ears, hair strands, or eye area.  
Use blue and white typography, technical editorial markings, and a more graphic digital fashion layout.  
The frame should feel bold, clean, and intentional.

3. Bloom Signal  
A soft, muted blurred portrait with a dreamy color haze.  
Use soft mint green, dusty pink, pale lavender, warm beige, and soft orange.

prompts.text:
Generate a clear and light drink visual centered on a specific drink theme. The core frame is supported by a large area of high-brightness clean air field carrying a single cup product. The cup is located below the visual center of gravity, as if gently held up by soft clouds, ice crystals, water vapor, or theme materials, with a layer of transparent reflection at the bottom, making the product look both real and floating with a cool sensation. The background remains bright, clean, airy, and with transparent layers. In the distance, only low-contrast soft volumes and faint environmental hints are retained, without stacking complex scenes. The main packaging information is clear. The cup surface has the color, texture, and grain details of the themed drink. Icy sensations and moist highlights should be delicately visible. Colors are extracted from the drink's own flavor, material, and emotion, maintaining the relationship between large areas of light base colors, a small amount of saturated clear theme accent colors, clean color scales, and low-noise shadows, making the overall look bright, refreshing, transparent, and clean. Accent colors mainly serve titles, illustration icons, packaging labels, and a few structural lines. The background and mist provide breathability, while the text serves as memory points. The title uses slender, restrained Chinese characters with breathing space to form a striking vertical reading rhythm, supplemented by small font size English or short sentence information, distributed near the edges with plenty of white space between them and the product. The text color is derived from the theme accent color, with sharp edges and no heavy shadows. The overall texture is like a fresh drink advertisement: wrapped in mist, icy and transparent, light information, ample white space, products, text, and airiness together create an instant feeling of "cooling down with one sip."

Replace with: Lime Coconut Cloud Ice Drink, a cool coconut drink in light blue-green tones.
Use for social media: As a summer drink recommendation image, the picture is still dominated by a single cup product and a large area of white space.
Must include: Clear cup label, with ice crystals, water vapor, and a sense of lightness supported by clouds.
Size requirements: Vertical 9:10

prompts.text:
[Replaceable Information]

Shop Category: [Sport Energy Bowl / Children's Reassurance Meal / Colorful Fruit and Vegetable Noodles / After-school Sports Supplement / Other Healthy Meal Category]

Generate a 9:16 vertical high-definition commercial design image, the theme is "[Shop Category] Takeaway Shop Decoration Effect Case Display Board".

The overall design is not an offline store space design, nor a regular brand opening proposal, but a complete visual system display image for a takeaway shop decoration. The outer layer of the screen uses a black matte texture background or a black cloth case baseplate, and the interior displays a complete set of fictional takeaway shop decoration visuals, including store banner head images, in-store posters, mobile takeaway shop pages, product entry images, dish cards, product poster matrices, and a bottom standard color palette.

The overall should conform to real takeaway platform shop decoration logic, like Meituan takeaway shop decoration effect images, but do not show real Meituan logos, real platform names, real brands, QR codes, watermarks, or real merchant information. The mobile page can use yellow buttons, white-background product cards, ratings, monthly sales, delivery time, full discount labels, prices, and add-to-cart buttons to simulate a real takeaway platform feel.

The layout structure is as follows:

1. Top Case Title Area
Write "Takeaway Shop Design Case" or "Takeaway Design Effect Drawing", paired with brand name [Brand Name] and English name [English Name]. The overall title should have a case presentation feel, like a takeaway decoration case published by a designer.

2. Upper-Middle Extra Large Main Visual Banner
Display a large close-up of the core products from [Main Products], food should be realistic and tempting, with vivid colors and strong commercial photography texture. The main title must be very prominent, using large, bold fonts and high-impact typography, copy can write [Core Selling Point]. The Banner should be like a takeaway platform store banner or in-store poster, with high conversion, strong appetite, and a strong click feel.

3. Middle Horizontal Sub-Banner
Continue to display product combinations and selling points, such as high protein, light burden, less oil and salt, balanced nutrition, child-friendly, freshly made daily, after-school supplement, fruit and vegetable noodles, etc. The sub-banner should be like activity posters or in-store posters uploaded in real takeaway shop decorations.

4. Bottom Left Mobile Takeaway Shop Page Mockup
Display a fictional takeaway shop homepage, including shop head image, rating, monthly sales, delivery time, full discount labels, product categories, boss recommendations, product list, price, add-to-cart button, and checkout button. The page should be realistic, clear, and have a platform landing feel, but do not show real platform logos, QR codes, or watermarks.

5. Right Side and Bottom Product Entry Image / Dish Card Matrix
Arrange 6-8 product entry images, dish cards, or product posters, content from [Main Products]. Each card should have a clear product image, short title, price, or recommendation label, like real takeaway shop entry images, five-link images, or dish beautification images, which can be directly used for shop decoration.

6. Bottom STANDARD COLOR Palette
Add 4-5 "STANDARD COLOR" blocks to display [Main Color Palette], enhancing the sense of brand system and design case.

The overall visual style uses [Visual Style], [Auxiliary Elements] can be added, but all decorations must serve the takeaway shop decoration effect. 【可替换信息】

生成一张 9:16 竖版高清商业设计图，主题是“【店铺品类】外卖店铺装修效果图案例展示板”。

店铺品牌名为【品牌名】，英文名为【英文名】。

整体不是线下门店空间设计，也不是普通品牌开店提案，而是一张完整的外卖店铺装修视觉系统展示图。画面外层使用黑色磨砂质感背景或黑色布纹案例底板，内部展示一整套虚构外卖店铺装修视觉，包括店招头图、店内海报、手机端外卖店铺页面、商品入口图、菜品卡、产品海报矩阵和底部标准色板。

整体要符合真实外卖平台店铺装修逻辑，像美团外卖店铺装修效果图，但不要出现真实美团 logo、真实平台名称、真实品牌、二维码、水印或真实商家信息。手机页面可以使用黄色按钮、白底商品卡、评分、月售、配送时间、满减标签、价格和加购按钮来模拟真实外卖平台感。

版式结构如下：

1、顶部案例标题区  
写“外卖店铺设计案例”或“外卖设计效果图”，搭配品牌名【品牌名】和英文名【英文名】。整体标题要有案例展示感，像设计师发布的外卖装修案例。

2、中上部超大主视觉 Banner  
展示【主打产品】中的核心产品大特写，食物要真实诱人、色彩鲜明、商业摄影质感强。主标题必须非常醒目，使用大字、粗字、强冲击排版，文案可写【核心卖点】。Banner 要像外卖平台店招头图或店内海报，具备高转化、强食欲、强点击感。

3、中部横向副 Banner  
继续展示产品组合和卖点，比如高蛋白、轻负担、少油少盐、营养均衡、亲子友好、每日现做、课后补给、蔬果入面等。副 Banner 要像真实外卖店铺装修里会上传的活动海报或店内海报。

4、左下角手机端外卖店铺页面 mockup  
展示虚构外卖店铺首页，包括店铺头图、评分、月售、配送时间、满减标签、商品分类、老板推荐、商品列表、价格、加购按钮和结算按钮。页面要真实、清晰、有平台落地感，但不要出现真实平台 logo、二维码或水印。

5、右侧和下方商品入口图 / 菜品卡矩阵  
排布 6-8 张商品入口图、菜品卡或产品海报，内容来自【主打产品】。每张卡片要有清晰商品图、短标题、价格或推荐标签，像真实外卖店铺入口图、五连图、菜品美化图，可以直接用于店铺装修。

6、底部 STANDARD COLOR 标准色板  
加入 4-5 个“STANDARD COLOR”标准色块，展示【主色调】，增强品牌系统感和设计案例感。

整体视觉风格使用【视觉风格】，可以加入【辅助元素】，但所有装饰都必须服务于外卖店铺装修效果。统一的是外卖店铺装修案例骨架，变化的是配色、字体、标签、插画、3D 元素、商品卡风格和品牌视觉语言。

要求：食物高清写实，产品图真实诱人；标题清晰可读；排版信息丰富但层级明确；整体像一套专业外卖店铺装修案例展示图。

prompts.text: Create a bright and clear flat poster-style image centered around specific theme content. First, transform the core keywords of the theme into a line of extremely thick sans-serif large characters, let the letterforms form a huge structural background at the top of the image. The surfaces of the characters feature subtle paper textures and semi-transparent printed grains, with portions naturally cropped by the boundaries of the image, serving only as a clear visual wall without excessively overshadowing the main subject. Place the main subject near the central axis of the frame, use a line-drawn container resembling a childhood handmade cutout to support the theme's symbolic objects: the container is represented by a single-line outline, the rim and bottom use elliptical lines to form a transparent space, and inside, several slender straight stems, rounded blunt leaves, and simplified block-shaped flower forms emerge, shapes look like layered paper cutouts, with edges that are clean, geometric, and carry slight handmade imperfections. The information layer remains sparse, scatter small-sized months, numbers, or theme node text on both sides of the main subject using rounded bold fonts, colors correspond and echo with the small graphics; at the bottom, keep two sets of short paragraphs and a tiny signature-style footer, letter spacing and line spacing are tight but still clear, creating the reading rhythm of a childlike infographic. Colors are extracted from the theme's own season, material, and emotion: the background takes up a large area of high-brightness clean ground, the main title uses bright structural colors that can vary between warm and cool, the main subject's stems or framework use clear, high-saturation support colors, flowers or symbolic blocks use a small amount of bright accent colors, and small text is assigned from these accent colors; overall maintaining a bright and light feel, strong airiness, clear color levels, saturated but not muddy, paper texture only provides a soft tactile feel without creating a sense of age. items.title: 乐事薯片巨型视角冬日滑雪奇幻海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium cinematic advertising poster for **Lay’s potato chips**, designed as a hyper-real giant-perspective winter fantasy where a colossal **Lay’s chip canister** becomes part of a snowy alpine ski landscape. The image must feel playful, epic, and visually irresistible, while still maintaining high-end commercial realism. The Lay’s canister should be enormous compared to the human figures, lying on its side in a snow-covered mountain setting like a giant architectural object or mountain tunnel, with golden potato chips spilling out and blending into the snowy slope. Tiny realistic skiers or snowboarders should ride down the snow around it, creating a dramatic and delightful scale contrast. Small chip crumbs and broken chip fragments scattered across the snow should visually echo the product and tie the whole environment together.

Main composition:
Use a strong vertical poster composition with the **giant Lay’s canister** positioned prominently in the lower or mid-left area, partially embedded in snow like a monumental structure in a ski resort landscape. The open end of the canister should face outward, releasing several oversized chips into the snow. A curving ski path or snowboard track should flow from near the canister into the lower foreground or sweep across the frame, creating motion and visual rhythm. Tiny human skiers should be placed strategically along the slope, emphasizing the dramatic scale difference between people and the chip canister.

Core visual concept:
The Lay’s canister must feel like a **snow mountain landmark**:
its cylindrical body partially buried in snow,
its opening acting like a tunnel or chute,
golden chips spilling out like sculptural rock or avalanche fragments,
the surrounding slope shaped like a mini ski resort built around the product.
The image should communicate that the canister is so large it transforms into terrain. The product must remain clearly recognizable as Lay’s while also functioning as a landscape object.

Human skiing realism:
The skiers or snowboarders must be tiny but realistic:
authentic winter gear,
real alpine skiing or snowboarding posture,
proper slope interaction,
natural track lines in the snow,
small-scale movement with believable shadow and perspective.
They must feel like real people enjoying the terrain, not toy figures.

Snow and chip integration:
The snowy landscape must feel highly realistic:
soft powder snow,
crisp packed tracks,
small ridges and drifts,
cold sparkling texture,
alpine depth and clarity.
The **chip crumbs and broken chip flakes** should be lightly scattered across the snow, acting as visual accents and narrative echoes of the product. These fragments must feel carefully art-directed, not messy. The chips spilling from the canister should feel fresh, crisp, golden, and appetizing, contrasting beautifully against the icy white snow.

Product realism:
Render the **Lay’s canister** with strong commercial fidelity:
accurate packaging shape,
clean branded label,
recognizable Lay’s logo,
realistic glossy or printed surface texture,
convincing cylindrical proportions,
premium packaging reflections and shadow behavior.
The canister must stay unmistakably branded while functioning as the giant landscape object.

Lighting:
Use **extremely delicate soft alpine lighting**:
bright cold daylight,
soft snow reflections,
gentle highlights on the package surface,
subtle sparkle in the snow,
clean definition on the chips,
smooth shadow transitions.
The light must feel luxurious, crisp, and airy, never harsh or cheap.

Background:
Build a real **snowy mountain environment**:
distant alpine peaks,
soft blue sky,
clean snowfield expanses,
subtle atmospheric haze,
minimal winter landscape detail.
Keep it elegant and uncluttered so the giant canister and skiers remain the focus.

Typography and branding:
Include a refined **official Lay’s logo** and a premium title or slogan integrated into the poster layout. Typography should feel playful yet polished, suitable for a global snack campaign. A short line such as:
“CRUNCH THE SLOPE”
or
“RIDE THE FLAVOR”
can be used if desired, but the layout must remain clean and high-end.

Color palette:
clean snow white,
sky blue,
golden chip yellow,
warm snack amber,
bright Lay’s brand colors,
cool alpine shadows.
The palette should feel fresh, fun, premium, and highly photogenic.

Mood:
playful, epic, premium, giant-scale fantasy, alpine adventure, joyful, highly visual, world-class food advertising.

Rendering:
hyper-realistic cinematic food-and-landscape advertising, giant product perspective, Lay’s canister as snowy ski terrain, realistic tiny skiers, ultra-detailed snow texture, premium package rendering, soft alpine lighting, 8k, world-class commercial campaign quality

Negative prompt:
toy-like skiers, cartoon snow, plastic-looking chips, weak scale contrast, cluttered winter scene, cheap snack ad, flat lighting, low-detail package, messy chip scatter, e-commerce packshot, childish fantasy look

prompts.text:
为乐事薯片创作一张超高端电影感广告海报，设计成一个超现实的巨型视角冬日幻想，其中一个巨大的乐事薯片桶变成了雪山阿尔卑斯滑雪景观的一部分。画面必须让人感到俏皮、宏大且视觉上不可抗拒，同时保持高端商业写实主义。与人物相比，乐事桶应该是巨大的，横卧在被雪覆盖的山景中，像一个巨型建筑物体或山间隧道，金黄色的薯片洒出并融入雪坡。微小而真实的滑雪者或单板滑雪者应该在它周围的雪地上滑行，创造出戏剧性且令人愉悦的比例对比。散落在雪地上的细小薯片碎屑和破碎的薯片碎片应在视觉上与产品呼应，并将整个环境联系在一起。

主要构图：
使用强有力的纵向海报构图，巨大的乐事桶显著地位于中下或左中区域，部分嵌入雪中，就像滑雪场景观中的纪念性结构。桶的开口端应朝外，向雪中释放出几片超大号薯片。一条弯曲的滑雪道或单板滑雪轨迹应从桶附近流向前景下方或横扫画面，营造出动感和视觉韵律。微小的人类滑雪者应策略性地放置在坡道上，强调人与薯片桶之间戏剧性的比例差异。

核心视觉概念：
乐事桶必须感觉像是一个雪山地标：
它的圆柱体部分埋在雪中，
它的开口像隧道或滑槽，
金黄色的薯片像雕塑般的岩石或雪崩碎片一样流出，
周围的坡道形状像一个围绕产品建造的微型滑雪度假村。
图像应传达出桶是如此巨大，以至于变成了地形。产品必须保持清晰可辨的乐事品牌，同时兼具景观物体的功能。

人类滑雪真实感：
滑雪者或单板滑雪者必须微小但真实：
真实的冬装，
真实的阿尔卑斯滑雪或单板滑雪姿势，
适当的坡道互动，
雪地中自然的轨迹线，
具有可信阴影和透视的小比例运动。
他们必须感觉像是享受地形的真人，而不是玩具模型。

雪与薯片的融合：
雪景必须感觉高度真实：
柔软的粉雪，
清晰的压雪轨迹，
微小的山脊和积雪，
寒冷闪烁的纹理，
阿尔卑斯山的深度和清晰度。
薯片碎屑和破碎的薯片薄片应轻微散落在雪地上，作为视觉亮点和产品的叙事呼应。这些碎片必须感觉经过精心的艺术指导，而不是杂乱无章。从桶中洒出的薯片应感觉新鲜、酥脆、金黄且诱人，与冰冷的白雪形成美丽的对比。

产品真实感：
以强大的商业保真度渲染乐事桶：
准确的包装形状，
干净的品牌标签，
可辨认的乐事标志，
真实的亮面或印刷表面纹理，
令人信服的圆柱体比例，
高端包装的反射和阴影表现。
桶在作为巨型景观物体的同时，必须保持清晰无误的品牌特征。

光影：
使用极其细腻柔和的阿尔卑斯光影：
明亮的冷色日光，
柔和的雪地反射，
包装表面的温和高光，
雪中微妙的闪烁，
薯片清晰的轮廓，
平滑的阴影过渡。
光线必须感觉奢华、清爽且通透，绝不能刺眼或廉价。

背景：
构建一个真实的雪山环境：
遥远的阿尔卑斯峰峦，
柔和的蓝天，
干净开阔的雪原，
微妙的大气薄雾，
简约的冬日景观细节。保持优雅且整洁，使巨型桶和滑雪者保持为焦点。

排版与品牌：
在海报布局中包含精致的官方乐事标志和高端标题或标语。字体应感觉俏皮且精致，适合全球零食活动。如果需要，可以使用一短行文字，如：

或

但布局必须保持干净高端。

天空蓝，

温暖的零食琥珀色，
鲜亮的乐事品牌色，
清冷的阿尔卑斯阴影。
色调应感觉清新、有趣、高端且非常上镜。

氛围：
俏皮、宏大、高端、巨型比例幻想、阿尔卑斯冒险、快乐、极具视觉冲击力、世界级食品广告。

[Person's Pose and Expression] In an outdoor space at twilight as the night deepens, the upper body pose is hands carefully cupping a lit classic vintage oil lamp (horong-bul). A white veil is pressed deep onto the head, mysteriously obscuring the eyes and upper part of the face, while slightly parted lips and a downward-tilted head create a pious and mysterious gothic fantasy scene-like atmosphere. 

[Person's Clothing] Wearing a pure creamy white long dress with a deep V-neckline. Over the dress is a large white veil (hodo) of translucent gauzy fabric that softly wraps around the head and shoulders, hanging down long, with the veil edges highlighting naturally frayed vintage linen textures.

[Person's Hairstyle and Makeup Details] Beneath the white veil is naturally cascading, dark-toned messy wavy hair. The makeup is presented in a natural style, adapted to the dim environment relying on the oil lamp's glow; under the warm light source, the moistly shimmering lip line and jawline are clearly and three-dimensionally highlighted.

[Lighting and Light Direction] The flame of the oil lamp in the person's hands serves as the sole primary light source, creating a dramatic candlelight/chiaroscuro effect. The intense, warm golden-orange fire rising from the lamp strongly illuminates the person's arms, chest, and the inside of the veil, while the external space behind the person is immersed in deep darkness, forming an extreme light-dark contrast.

[Texture and Tonal Atmosphere] The cold deep navy blue and black tones of the surrounding background collide with the warm golden firelight ($2000K$) emitted by the oil lamp, creating a low-key and emotional tonal atmosphere. The unique coarse transparent yarn texture of the veil fabric, the smooth luster of the oil lamp glass, and the volume of the fabric faintly glowing in the dark intertwine to convey a scene like a religious painting or a cruel fairy tale, a grand yet lonely narrative.

[Film and Camera Lens Depth of Field, Angle] Shot with an aperture of f/1.8, shutter speed of 1/125s, ISO 800, and a 50mm standard prime lens. The heavy and coarse grain (Film Grain) characteristic of high-sensitivity low-light film covers the entire frame. Using an eye-level medium shot composition that neatly captures the person's chest and the position of the lamp, applying an extremely shallow depth of field, with sharp focus on the center of the flame and the folds of the person's clothing, while the foreground and background softly blend into darkness with bokeh processing.

[Background Elements (Optional)] This is an outdoor dark forest or field border where light has completely vanished. Behind the person, except for the outlines of branches and the earth recognizable in the blurry darkness, any visual distractions are excluded, perfectly concentrating the gaze on a single flame illuminating the darkness and the mysterious silhouette of the person, creating a minimalist directorial approach.

[人物的姿势及表情]在暮色渐沉的夜晚户外空间，上半身姿势是双手小心翼翼地捧着一个点亮的经典复古油灯（호롱불）。白色面纱深深地压在头顶，将眼睛及脸部上半部分神秘地遮挡住，微微张开的嘴唇和向下倾斜的头部营造出一种虔诚而神秘的哥特幻想场景般的氛围。[人物服装]穿着胸前线条深V领的清纯奶油白色长裙。裙子上方披着一条柔软地包裹头部和肩膀、向下长长垂落的半透明纱质面料的大型白色面纱（호도），面纱边缘突出自然散开的复古亚麻纹理。[人物发型及妆容细节]白色面纱下是自然垂落的深色调凌乱波浪发型。妆容适应依赖油灯光芒的昏暗环境，以自然风格呈现，温暖光源照耀下，湿润闪耀的唇线和下巴轮廓清晰立体地凸显出来。[照明及光线方向]人物手中油灯的火焰作为唯一主光源，营造出戏剧性的烛光照明（Candlelight/Chiaroscuro）效果。灯中升腾的强烈温暖金色橙色火光强烈照亮人物的手臂、胸膛以及面纱内侧，而人物背后的外部空间则沉浸在深沉的黑暗中，形成极端的明暗对比。[质感与色调氛围]周围背景的冷峻深海军蓝、黑色调与油灯散发的温暖金色火光（$2000K$）碰撞，营造出低调（Low-key）感性的色调氛围。面纱面料特有的粗糙透明纱线织纹、油灯玻璃的光滑光泽，以及黑暗中隐约发光的织物体积感交织在一起，传达出宗教绘画或残酷童话般的一幕，宏大而孤独的叙事。[胶片及相机镜头景深、角度]使用光圈 f/1.8、快门速度 1/125 秒、ISO 800、焦距 50mm 标准单镜头拍摄。高感度低光胶片特有的厚重粗糙颗粒感（Film Grain）覆盖整个画面。采用正面整齐捕捉人物胸部和灯的位置的眼平（Eye-level）中景构图，并应用极浅的景深，将火焰中心和人物衣褶锐利对焦，前景与远景则柔和地融入黑暗中进行散景处理。[背景元素（可选）]这是光线完全消逝的户外黑暗森林或田野边界。人物身后除了模糊黑暗中可辨识的树枝和大地的轮廓外，排除了任何视觉干扰元素，仅以一盏照亮黑暗的灯火和人物的神秘轮廓完美集中视线，营造出极简的导演手法。

prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
为【品牌名】设计一套**高端水果电商包装盒设计方案**，产品为【产品名称】，品牌定位为【高端鲜果 / 产地直供 / 自然有机 / 轻奢礼赠】，目标人群为【家庭用户 / 礼赠客户 / 企业客户 / 年轻健康消费群体】。    

包装类型为【电商运输盒 / 水果礼盒 / 天地盖礼盒 / 抽屉盒 / 手提礼盒 / 开窗盒 / 瓦楞彩盒】。包装尺寸、盒型结构、内托形式、果位数量、缓冲距离、透气孔位置、承重结构和材料厚度，必须根据【水果种类】本身的大小、重量、外形、果皮硬度、易损程度、保鲜需求、单果 / 串果 / 粒果特征自动合理设计，符合真实电商运输、冷链配送、礼盒赠送和厂家批量生产逻辑。

整体风格为【极简高级 / 东方新奢 / 自然有机 / 清新治愈 / 高端礼盒风】。画面干净、高级、有食欲、有品牌识别度，不要廉价促销风。色彩采用【主色调】为主，搭配【辅助色】和【点缀色】，并结合水果本身的果皮色、果肉色、叶片色和产地气质进行高级化表达。   

请输出一张**专业水果电商包装设计提案板**。画面中心必须放置一个**大尺寸主包装展示图**，占整体画面 45%–60%，作为第一视觉焦点。主包装以 45° 立体透视展示，盒体质感真实，品牌 Logo、产品名和核心图形清晰醒目，可搭配少量真实水果、叶片、产地元素和礼赠卡片作为高级场景点缀。

主包装周围用小尺寸辅助模块展示：包装正面、背面、左右侧面、顶部、底部、开箱效果图、内托结构图、水果摆放示意图、展开刀模图、尺寸标注、材料说明、印刷工艺说明、色彩方案、字体方案和厂家生产说明。辅助模块需清晰有序，不能抢占主包装视觉焦点。

内部结构必须根据水果特性设计：

苹果、梨、橙子、桃子、芒果：独立果位内托，贴合果形，防滚动、防碰撞。
草莓、蓝莓、车厘子：小果分仓浅托，防挤压，保留上盖净空和透气孔。
葡萄、阳光玫瑰：整串托撑结构，防脱粒、防滚动、防压伤。
猕猴桃、柑橘：规则阵列果位，增强堆叠稳定性。
榴莲、大型重果：加强型瓦楞结构，承重加固，强化提手和底部支撑。
混合水果礼盒：分区式组合内托，不同水果独立分仓，视觉整齐，避免互相挤压。

刀模图需清晰标注：

红色实线 = 裁切线 / 刀线；
蓝色虚线 = 压痕线 / 折线；
绿色线 = 出血线；
紫色线 = 安全线；
灰色线 = 参考线；
黄色区域 = 粘胶位；
半透明浅蓝区域 = 开窗 PET；
浅绿色区域 = 透气孔；
浅棕色区域 = 内托 / 缓冲结构；
金色区域 = 烫金版；
亮白区域 = 局部 UV；
浮雕阴影区域 = 击凸 / 击凹。

生产要求：所有单位为 mm，出血每边 3 mm，安全边距 5 mm，尺寸公差 ±1 mm，模切公差 ±0.5 mm，印刷套位公差 ±0.3 mm。需预留物流面单区、条码区、二维码区、溯源码区、食品安全标识区和开窗 PET 粘贴边。

材料建议根据水果重量和易损程度自动匹配：【E 楞瓦楞纸 / B 楞瓦楞纸 / BE 双瓦楞纸 / 350g 白卡纸 / 400g 白卡纸 / 特种纸 / 灰板裱纸 / 食品级环保纸板】。
内托建议：【纸浆模塑内托 / 蜂窝纸内托 / 瓦楞隔板 / 食品级 PET 托 / 可降解环保纸托】。

印刷工艺：CMYK 四色印刷，可加入 Pantone 专色、烫金、局部 UV、击凸、击凹、压纹、触感膜、哑膜、水性光油、防潮涂层和环保大豆油墨。工艺应克制高级，重点用于品牌 Logo、产品名、产地纹样、封签和核心视觉符号。

画面风格关键词：

large hero packaging mockup, oversized main fruit box display, premium fresh fruit ecommerce packaging, luxury fruit gift box, award-winning packaging design, production-ready packaging design, fruit-specific internal tray structure, custom fruit insert design, realistic corrugated box structure, ecommerce shipping box, dieline layout, structural packaging engineering drawing, CMYK print-ready layout, premium agricultural brand identity, elegant fresh color palette, realistic paper texture, refined typography, food-safe packaging design, ventilation holes, traceability QR code, logistics label area, photorealistic 3D mockup, clean white studio background, manufacturer-ready technical notes, ultra detailed, high resolution.

禁止：

low quality, blurry, messy layout, unreadable text, small main package, weak visual focus, generic inner tray, same insert for all fruits, wrong dieline, unrealistic box structure, unstable packaging, missing dimensions, missing bleed line, missing material notes, cheap template look, overdecorated design, incorrect barcode, spelling errors, unrealistic fruit placement, floating fruit, no protective tray, no ventilation holes, no shipping label area, fragile structure, wrong scale, cluttered composition.

prompts.text: Generate a graphic-text integrated conceptual image around any theme: first, let an extremely thick and large core theme word occupy the center, the font shape pressing down on the image like a heavy structural wall. Then, use a horizontal environmental field derived from the theme to cut across the lower half of the word, covering part of the strokes, making the text remain readable while appearing as if swallowed by real space. Place a low, horizontal theme carrier and a tiny action symbol in front of the environmental field, creating a strong scale contrast with the giant word. The action is quiet, slow, like being paused outside of work; thin directional lines or tool lines pass through the white space, creating diagonal tension. Keep a large area of ventilated white space at the top, only arranging a small amount of small-sized information lines, numbers, and short titles. Use a combination of heavy compressed sans-serif and typewriter-style tiny text, with tight letter spacing, hard edges, and slight overprint deviation. Colors are extracted from the theme's own material, emotion, and semantics, mapped to a large area of bright and clean base color, clear horizontal field color, a small amount of high-saturation emphasis colors, deep structural shadows, and low-presence information text, maintaining bright and light, clear color levels, slight warm-cold contrast, and clean white space; paper texture, dots, and scratches are only used as vintage printing touch, not making the image gray, dirty, or lose the sense of ventilation. The overall look is like a slow-paced moment pressed by a giant title, the theme action is very small, the information layer is very large, humorous, relaxed, quiet, but the structure must be precise. Theme: Returning the Jade Intact to Zhao. Color palette: Japanese fresh + candy colors matching the theme. Aspect ratio 16:9.

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium cinematic advertising poster for **Oakley Line Miner ski goggles**, designed as an extreme close-up winter portrait where the **goggle lens becomes a panoramic window into a distant alpine world**. The image must feel hyper-real, luxurious, and editorial, with a powerful contrast between **real human skin** and the **high-precision material quality of the ski goggles**. The subject should be a **mature Japanese/Korean East Asian woman**, naturally beautiful, refined, and realistic, not influencer-like, wearing the Oakley Line Miner goggles in a freezing high-altitude environment. The lens must reveal a breathtaking snow-mountain landscape in the reflection or through the visual read of the curved lens, while the outer surface of the goggles is covered with **extremely fine ice crystals, frost fragments, frozen snow dust, and tiny shattered ice particles**. Every detail must feel tactile, cold, and premium.

Main composition:
Use an **extreme macro close-up portrait composition**, tightly framing the upper cheek, nose bridge, lips, and the ski goggles so the lens dominates the image. The goggles should occupy most of the frame, with the face cropped elegantly to create intimacy and scale. The mountain panorama visible in or through the lens must feel expansive and cinematic, contrasting with the extreme closeness of the portrait. The composition should be clean, elegant, and visually intense, with the goggles serving as both product hero and landscape frame.

Core visual concept:
The **Oakley Line Miner lens** should function like a frozen viewing portal:
inside or across the curved lens surface, the viewer sees a vast snow-covered mountain range,
the curvature of the lens slightly bends the alpine horizon in a realistic optical way,
the goggle surface is layered with micro frost, snow powder, and tiny ice shards,
the skin and lips remain organic, soft, and warm compared to the cold engineered surface of the goggles.
The contrast between human realism and technical winter gear must be striking and luxurious.

Human realism:
The woman must feel hyper-real and premium:
mature East Asian facial structure,
natural skin texture,
soft lips,
refined nose bridge,
calm, focused, cold-weather expression,
subtle winter dryness and snow dust on the skin.
She must feel like a real high-altitude skier or alpine explorer, not a fashion doll.

Goggle material realism:
Render the **Oakley Line Miner goggles** with exceptional product fidelity:
accurate frame shape,
premium lens curvature,
high-end reflective and transparent optical behavior,
clean gasket and edge construction,
precise strap and frame junctions,
subtle brand detailing.
The goggle surface must carry exquisite winter texture:
fine ice granules,
frost crystals,
snow dust,
micro shattered frozen particles,
cold condensation traces.
These details should feel physically attached to the goggle, not decorative overlays.

Mountain view and optical depth:
The snow-mountain view seen in the lens must be grand and believable:
distant alpine ridgelines,
bright snowfields,
cold sky tone,
subtle atmospheric depth,
real mountain light.
The lens should slightly distort and compress the landscape in a realistic way, reinforcing the premium optical quality of the goggle.

Lighting:
Use **extremely delicate cold alpine lighting**:
soft natural daylight,
subtle icy highlights across the lens,
clean specular glints on frost crystals,
gentle skin illumination,
smooth shadow transitions around the nose and cheek,
refined cold reflections in the goggle surface.
The light must feel crisp, soft, and luxurious, never harsh.

Texture contrast:
This is crucial:
the **skin must feel soft, organic, breathable, and real**,
the **goggles must feel engineered, cold, glossy, layered, and technical**,
the snow dust and frost must bridge the two surfaces naturally.
The contrast between human softness and technical winter performance gear should create the emotional and visual tension of the poster.

Background:
Keep the background minimal and soft, using pale alpine blur, cool sky tones, or shallow depth-of-field winter atmosphere. No clutter, no unnecessary props. The product and face must dominate.

Typography and branding:
Include a refined **Oakley logo** and an elegant title such as **LINE MINER**. Typography should feel modern, premium, and performance-oriented, integrated into clean negative space. Optional short line:
“SEE THE EXTREME”
or
“VISION IN THE COLD”
Keep the layout crisp and high-end.

Color palette:
ice white,
frost silver,
glacier blue,
soft skin beige,
cold gray,
deep alpine shadow,
clean reflective highlights.
The overall palette should feel cold, sharp, premium, and highly photogenic.

Mood:
cold, cinematic, technical, intimate, alpine, premium, hyper-real, tactile, high-performance winter advertising.

Rendering:
hyper-realistic cinematic product portrait, extreme macro close-up, premium ski goggle material rendering, realistic East Asian female face, alpine mountain view in lens, ultra-detailed frost and ice particle texture, soft cold natural light, 8k, world-class commercial advertising quality

Negative prompt:
cartoon portrait, low-detail goggles, fake frost overlay, plastic skin, messy background, weak mountain reflection, cheap winter ad, heavy fashion makeup, influencer look, blurry lens detail, exaggerated sci-fi visor

prompts.text:
为**奥克利 Line Miner 滑雪镜**创作一张超高端的电影感广告海报，设计为一张极限特写的冬季人像，其中**护目镜镜片成为通往遥远高山世界的全景窗口**。图像必须具有超现实感、奢华感和社论风格，在**真实的真人皮肤**与**滑雪镜的高精度材料质感**之间形成强烈的对比。主体应为一位**成熟的日韩东亚女性**，自然美丽、精致且写实，而非网红风格，在冰冷的高海拔环境中佩戴着奥克利 Line Miner 滑雪镜。镜片必须在反射中或通过弧形镜片的视觉呈现展示出令人惊叹的雪山景观，而护目镜的外表面则覆盖着**极细的冰晶、霜碎片、冻结的雪粉和微小的碎冰颗粒**。每一个细节都必须让人感到触手可及、寒冷且高端。

主要构图：
使用**极限宏观特写人像构图**，紧凑地框住上脸颊、鼻梁、嘴唇和滑雪镜，使镜片占据图像主导地位。护目镜应占据画面的大部分，脸部经过优雅的裁剪以营造亲密感和比例感。在镜片中或透过镜片可见的高山全景必须具有广阔感和电影感，与特写镜头的极端亲近感形成对比。构图应简洁、优雅且视觉强烈，护目镜既是产品主角也是景观框架。

核心视觉概念：
**奥克利 Line Miner 镜片**的功能应像一个冰冻的观察门户：
在弧形镜片表面内部或横跨其上，观众看到广阔的被雪覆盖的山脉，
镜片的曲率以写实的物理光学方式使高山地平线产生轻微弯曲，
护目镜表面层叠着微细的霜、雪粉和微小的冰碎片，
与护目镜冰冷的工程表面相比，皮肤和嘴唇保持有机、柔软且温暖。
人类现实主义与技术冬季装备之间的对比必须是惊人且奢华的。

人类现实主义：
女性必须给人以超现实和高端的感觉：
成熟的东亚面部结构，
自然的皮肤纹理，
柔软的嘴唇，
精致的鼻梁，
冷静、专注、寒冷天气的表情，
皮肤上微妙的冬季干燥感和雪粉。
她必须看起来像一个真正的高海拔滑雪者或高山探险家，而不是时尚玩偶。

护目镜材料现实主义：
以卓越的产品忠实度渲染**奥克利 Line Miner 滑雪镜**：
准确的框架形状，
高端的镜片曲率，
高端的反射和透明光学表现，
干净的垫圈和边缘结构，
精准的背带与框架连接处，
细微的品牌细节。
护目镜表面必须带有精致的冬季纹理：
细小的冰粒，
霜晶，
雪粉，
微小的破碎冻结颗粒，
冰冷的冷凝痕迹。
这些细节应该让人感觉到是物理连接在护目镜上的，而不是装饰性的叠加层。

山景与光学深度：
镜片中看到的雪山景观必须宏大且可信：
遥远的高山山脊线，
明亮的雪地，
冰冷的天空色调，
微妙的大气深度，
真实的山脉光影。
镜片应以写实的方式轻微扭曲和压缩景观，强化护目镜的高端光学品质。

灯光：
使用**极其细腻的寒冷高山灯光**：
柔和的自然日光，
横跨镜片的微妙冰冷高光，
霜晶上干净的镜面闪烁，
柔和的皮肤照明，
鼻子和脸颊周围平滑的阴影过渡，
护目镜表面精致的冷色反射。
光线必须感觉清爽、柔和且奢华，绝不刺眼。

纹理对比：
这是至关重要的：
**皮肤必须感觉柔软、有机、透气且真实**，
**护目镜必须感觉是工程化的、寒冷的、光滑的、有层次的且具有技术感**，
雪粉和霜必须自然地连接这两个表面。 
人类的柔软感与技术性冬季表现装备之间的对比应创造出海报的情感和视觉张力。

背景：
背景保持极简和柔和，使用浅色的高山模糊、冷色调的天空或浅景深的冬季氛围。没有杂乱，没有不必要的道具。产品和脸部必须占据主导地位。

排版与品牌推广：
包括一个精致的**奥克利 (Oakley) 徽标**和一个优雅的标题，如 **LINE MINER**。排版应感觉现代、高端且以性能为导向，融入干净的负空间中。可选短句：
“SEE THE EXTREME”
或
“VISION IN THE COLD”
保持布局清爽高端。

配色方案：
冰白色，
霜银色，
冰川蓝，
柔和的皮肤米色，
冷灰色，
深山阴影，
干净的反射高光。
整体配色方案应感觉寒冷、锐利、高端且极具上镜感。

氛围：
寒冷、电影感、技术性、亲密、高山、高端、超现实、触感、高性能冬季广告。

渲染：
超现实的电影感产品人像，极限宏观特写，高端滑雪镜材料渲染，真实的东亚女性面孔，镜片中的高山美景，超详细的霜和冰颗粒纹理，柔和的寒冷自然光，8k，世界级商业广告质量

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium commercial poster for **Salomon X Ultra Mid GTX**, redesigned as an **ultra-low-angle, outsole-charging-directly-at-the-camera flagship action shot**. The shoe must feel more aggressive, more invasive, and more explosive in perspective, as if the viewer is directly in the path of a powerful mountain stride. Change the shoe color from the previous neutral tone to a **high-impact premium colorway**: deep graphite black fused with **volcanic red-orange / burnt coral technical accents**, so the product stands out violently against the cold black-gray mountain environment. The human figure must now be a **mature Japanese/Korean East Asian woman**, athletic and premium-looking, wearing **outdoor shorts**, with the body secondary and the shoe absolutely dominant. The image should feel hyper-realistic, cold, sharp, cinematic, and full of forward attack energy.

Main composition:
Use an **extreme ultra-low camera position**, almost touching the wet rock and stream surface, looking slightly upward. The foreground shoe must be thrust directly toward the camera with a strong wide-lens distortion, and the **outsole / sole edge / toe-bottom structure** must become the most aggressive visual element in the whole frame. The shoe should feel like it is about to step over the lens. The near sole, tread geometry, toe protection, and sidewall structure must be huge, sharp, and physically imposing. The woman’s leg extends upward naturally from the hero shoe, while the rest of the body recedes into the midground to strengthen the perspective attack.

Female character direction:
The model must be a **mature Japanese/Korean East Asian woman**, naturally beautiful, athletic, confident, and premium, not influencer-like. She should wear:
technical outdoor shorts,
high-performance hiking or trail top,
clean mountain gear styling,
functional premium outdoor aesthetic.
Her role is to support the product’s action logic and energy, not to steal attention from the shoe. Her lower leg should remain visible to strengthen the perspective stretch and aggressive stride.

Colorway upgrade:
Change the shoe to a more striking and aggressive premium color:
deep graphite black base,
dark charcoal technical mesh,
volcanic red-orange overlays or lace accents,
burnt coral / ember highlights,
small dark metallic details.
The color should feel high-performance and fashion-forward, while still believable for a Salomon mountain shoe. It must pop against the cold mountain environment without looking cheap or overly saturated.

Outsole attack concept:
This is the key direction:
the **shoe sole must feel like it is attacking the lens**,
tread blocks and outsole geometry should become visually monumental,
the front-bottom structure should loom toward the viewer,
the sole edge should feel sharp, rugged, and powerful,
the entire shoe should communicate grip, impact, and mountain aggression.
The image should feel like a split second before the outsole lands over the camera.

Scene concept:
Place the action in a real **cold mountain stream crossing**:
dark wet rock,
fast-moving clear water,
black-gray cliff walls,
cold mist,
narrow alpine stream channel,
severe mountain terrain.
The hero shoe should be stepping forcefully onto a slick rock in shallow water, with the stream breaking around the sole and reinforcing the shoe’s waterproof all-terrain authority.

Water and terrain interaction:
Show premium realistic **涉水爆发感**:
sharp splashes near the outsole,
water peeling away from tread edges,
thin water trails running off the sole,
wet sheen across the rock surface,
cold droplets suspended near impact zones,
clear stream flow around stone contours.
The water action should feel physically convincing, explosive, and controlled, not chaotic.

Product realism:
Render the **Salomon X Ultra Mid GTX** with extreme accuracy:
correct hiking-shoe proportions,
technical upper panel structure,
precise lace routing,
mid-cut ankle support,
rugged outsole pattern,
protective overlays,
premium waterproof materials,
subtle wet sheen and droplets,
luxury outdoor-engineering finish.
The shoe must feel lightweight yet armored, modern yet brutal enough for alpine terrain.

Lighting:
Use refined **cold mountain natural lighting**:
overcast alpine daylight,
clean highlights on the wet shoe,
cold reflections on stream water,
subtle rim light along the outsole and toe,
gentle tonal separation from the dark background,
no harsh clipping.
The lighting should feel crisp, severe, and premium, revealing both texture and aggression.

Background:
Keep the background cinematic and real:
dark mountain walls,
cold sky or mist,
narrow stream corridor,
distant terrain softly receding.
Use moderate depth of field so the foreground outsole and shoe remain razor-sharp while the woman and background soften naturally with perspective depth.

Typography and branding:
Include a refined **official Salomon logo** and elegant title such as **X ULTRA MID GTX**. Typography should feel modern, technical, and premium, integrated into negative space like a flagship outdoor campaign. No heavy retail blocks, no cluttered specs.

Color palette:
graphite black,
charcoal gray,
cold slate,
wet mineral brown-black,
silver water highlights,
volcanic red-orange accents,
burnt coral technical glow.
The palette should feel cold, dangerous, modern, and premium.

Mood:
aggressive, outsole-first, ultra-low-angle attack, cold mountain power, waterproof authority, cinematic, premium outdoor flagship, high-performance feminine strength.

Rendering:
hyper-realistic outdoor product photography, extreme ultra-low-angle wide-lens hero shot, outsole-toward-camera perspective, mature East Asian female hiker in shorts, cold mountain stream action, ultra-detailed hiking shoe materials, realistic splash behavior, premium natural lighting, 8k, world-class commercial advertising quality.

Negative prompt:
male model, long pants, flat catalog angle, weak perspective, neutral boring shoe color, generic sneaker look, warm sunny hiking ad, cheap outdoor poster, cluttered background, muddy shoe detail, plastic-looking materials, chaotic splash explosion, low-detail outsole, e-commerce product page look

prompts.text:
Generate a visual theme poster with a strong graphic sense around any subject: Let the subject content first be refined into a large single symbol or geometric main shape that occupies visual dominance; the main shape lifts slightly from the flat background like thick cardboard or flexible 3D sheets, with edges kept sharp and clean; an extremely thin high-brightness outline appears on one side, and a clear negative space hole or turning gap is left inside, making the first glance perceive huge physical pressure, and the second glance discover it is shaped by same-color layers, shadows, and edge highlights. The background uses an almost impurity-free full-surface theme base color; the main shape and background belong to the same theme color system, layered through differences in lightness, saturation, and shadow depth; colors are extracted from the material, emotion, and information attributes of the theme itself, retaining large areas of high-saturation or high-brightness emotional fields, deep structural shadows, a few clear bright edges, and small areas of information emphasis colors; the overall look should be bright, clean, direct, and ceremonial, avoiding grey/dirty, vintage/yellowed, or smoky treatments. The main shape casts a wide diagonal long shadow to one side, with edges that are soft yet hard, forming a strong sense of direction and presence tension. Text is embedded as information anchors in the whitespace pressure zones next to the main shape, using heavy, compact, and clear sans-serif characters; short sentences are arranged in lines, with font weight competing with the main shape but area restrained; a row of narrow, tall, and evenly spaced auxiliary English or slogans can be placed at the bottom to form a stable closure. Tiny handwritten-style symbols or annotations are allowed as slight contrasts, occupying only a very small area, like immediate marks left by a designer. The overall surface is smooth, the lighting is concentrated, and the boundaries are clean; the composition relies on the huge main shape, negative space holes, long shadows, and restrained text to establish memory points, rather than complex illustrations or decorative stacking.

The subject is a [Character Identity], with the theme [Theme]. The character should not be shown completely and clearly; the lower body or parts of the body should be blocked by [Clouds / Rock Dust / Water Mist / Stardust / Black Mist / Sword Qi] to avoid a doll-like, figurine-like, or ordinary character poster feel.

The character's temperament is [Core Temperament]. The face is identifiable but should not be idolized or overly exquisite. The face is in intense light and shadow cutting, with one side swallowed by environmental shadows and the other side illuminated by the main light source. Eyes are lowered, looking down, or gazing into the distance, reflecting inaccessible divine power and oppression. The skin retains real texture, not plastic, not overly airbrushed. Hair is driven by strong winds, energy flows, or environmental airflow, naturally merging with light fog, particles, and smoke dust.

Clothing and styling revolve around [Character Identity], potentially combining elements like [Heavy Robes / Dark Iron Armor / Imperial Robes / Official Robes / Scale Armor / Cloak / Metal Shoulder Pads], but do not make it an exquisite equipment display. Robes should be huge and heavy, extending outwards like cloud layers, mountain shadows, tide curtains, or night curtains. The character holds a [Magical Artifact / Weapon], which is not an ordinary prop but a divine weapon capable of suppressing heaven and earth and governing laws.

A giant [Celestial Structure] unfolds above the head. It is not a background decoration but a celestial vault structure pushed open by the character's dharma manifestation, composed of [Runes / Ancient Script / Geometric Rings / Energy Orbits / Cloud Layers / Lightning / Tides / Star Tracks], forming a strong association with the character. The celestial phenomena must have a clear sense of pressing down and resonate with the character's shoulders, back, head, and aura, creating a "Heaven Opens Above" visual effect.

Beneath the feet is not an ordinary platform but [Scene / Landform]. The overall color is based on [Main Color Tone], the environment is dimmed, and the main light sources are concentrated on celestial phenomena, magic circles, earth cracks, artifacts, and energy structures. The overall style is Oriental mythology, dark epic, cinematic conceptual visual, gigantic dharma manifestation, celestial anomalies, divine oppression. The focus is on expressing the feeling of "Human Body Concrete, Dharma Manifestation Supporting the Sky," letting the audience feel at once that this is not an ordinary character image, but that heaven and earth are responding to the presence of this character.

[Supplementary Settings]

prompts.text:
【主题】：
【人物身份】：
【核心气质】：

【天象结构】：
【法器 / 武器】：
【地面响应】：
【补充设定】：

生成一张【东方神话法天象地巨像主视觉】，9:16竖版，极低机位仰拍。画面不是普通角色立绘，不是完整全身展示，不是角色卡，而是“具象人物 + 巨像法相 + 天地响应”的压迫式主视觉。

主体是一位【人物身份】，主题为【主题】。人物仍然是具象可辨的东方人物，但整体尺度已经接近山岳、天象与大地，呈现“法天象地”的巨像法相感。人物不要完整清楚展示全身，下半身或部分身体要被【云雾 / 岩尘 / 水雾 / 星尘 / 黑雾 / 剑气】遮挡，避免人偶感、手办感、普通角色海报感。

人物气质为【核心气质】。面部可辨识，但不要偶像化、不要过度精致。脸部处在强烈明暗切割中，一侧被环境阴影吞没，一侧被主光源照亮，眼神低垂、俯视或望向远方，体现不可接近的神威与压迫感。皮肤保留真实质感，不要塑料感，不要过度磨皮。头发被狂风、能量流或环境气流带动，与光雾、粒子、烟尘自然融合。

服装与造型围绕【人物身份】展开，可结合【厚重长袍 / 玄铁甲胄 / 帝袍 / 官袍 / 鳞甲 / 披风 / 金属护肩】等元素，但不要做成精致装备展示。衣袍要巨大、厚重，像云层、山影、潮幕、夜幕一样向四周延展。人物手持【法器 / 武器】，它不是普通道具，而是能镇压天地、统御法则的神兵法器。

头顶上方展开巨大的【天象结构】。它不是背景装饰，而是被人物法相撑开的天穹结构，由【符文 / 古文字 / 几何圆环 / 能量轨道 / 云层 / 雷光 / 潮汐 / 星轨】构成，和人物形成强关联。天象要有明显压顶感，并与人物肩背、头顶、气场产生呼应，形成“天开其上”的视觉效果。

脚下不是普通平台，而是【场景 / 地貌】。地面从人物站立处向外崩裂、发光、升腾，形成【地面响应】，例如符文法阵、裂地神光、熔岩裂隙、海潮神台、星河祭坛、黄泉审判阵等。碎石、残碑、锁链、飞剑、水刃、星尘、光粒、烟雾等元素在人物周围漂浮或升起，形成前中后景层次，让整个天地像被这尊法相牵引。

整体色彩以【主色调】为主，大环境压暗，主光源集中在天象、法阵、裂地、法器和能量结构上。整体风格为东方神话、暗黑史诗、电影级概念视觉、巨像法相、天地异象、神威压迫。重点表现“人身具象，法相撑天”的感觉，让观众一眼感受到这不是普通角色图，而是天地都在回应这位角色的存在。

【补充设定】

避免：普通完整全身立绘、游戏角色卡、手办感、人偶感、偶像化五官、摆拍感、法阵只是背景灯牌、环境只是装饰、卡通感、二次元感、低幼感、廉价网游风、文字大标题、海报UI、乱码文字、武器弯曲、手部错误、人物比例异常、光效过曝、背景空洞、元素杂乱、塑料皮肤。

Place a low, horizontal theme carrier and a very small action symbol in front of the environmental field, the scale forming a strong contrast with the giant letters; the action is quiet, slow, and as if paused outside of work. Paper textures, dots, and scratches serve only as a retro printing tactile feel, without making the image gray, dirty, or lose its ventilated sense. The overall look is like a slow-paced moment pressed down by a huge title, where the theme's action is small, the information layer is large, humorous, relaxed, and quiet, yet the structure must be precise.

items.title: 精致手绘风格人物角色档案设定页

prompts.text:
Please generate a high-completion "Character Profile Card / Character Setting Page" based on the 3–5 character photos I uploaded.

Requirements:
1. Retain the person's real facial features and ensure recognizability
2. The overall look should be like an exquisite hand-drawn character setting card, rather than a common collage
3. The page should include the following content:
   - One main visual half-body or bust portrait
   - One full-body illustration
   - 3–5 small emoji avatars with different emotions
   - 1–2 small scene illustrations related to the character's daily traits
   - A set of character tag words
   - A handwritten-style personality short phrase
   - A brief description of character traits

Style directions: [Hand-drawn illustration / Japanese setting page / Watercolor feel / Flat vector / Retro manga / Fresh and artistic]

Character temperament keywords: [e.g., quiet, loves visiting exhibitions, coffee lover, relaxed feel, weekend hiking, light retro]

Layout requirements:
The overall look should be like a character manual that can be collected and shared, with complete but not crowded information, clear layers, and exquisite layout, suitable for social media publishing.

If you want the character to be more "like you", you can also add one more sentence:

Please first understand the character's physical features, temperament, and lifestyle based on the photos, and then output them uniformly into a complete character profile visual page.

Parameter Techniques / Key Control Points
1. Recommended number of photos: 3–5, which is the most stable range.
Try to include:
Front photo
3/4 profile
Natural smile
Half-body or full-body photo
One scene photo that reflects life status
Do not use all selfies from the same angle.

2. Fewer filters, keep real features
Excessive beautification, heavy filters, and heavy skin smoothing will affect character recognizability.
The closer to the real state, the easier it is for AI to extract stable character features.

3. The more specific the character setting description, the better:
Likes coffee and visiting exhibitions
Often goes hiking on weekends
Dressing style is light retro
Usually loves shooting street scenes and bookstores
A bit quiet but very assertive
This kind of information will directly affect the richness of the character card content.

4. Don't make tags too vague
For example:
Love life / Positive / Gentle and cute
Coffee addict / Weekend hiking maniac / Exhibition collector / Late-night writer
The more specific, the more memorable.

prompts.text:
请基于我上传的 3—5 张人物照片，生成一张高完成度的「角色档案卡 / 角色设定页」。

要求：
1. 保留人物真实相貌特征，保证可识别度
2. 整体像一张精致的手绘角色设定卡，而不是普通拼图
3. 页面包含以下内容：
   - 一张主视觉半身或胸像肖像
   - 一张全身立绘
   - 3—5 个不同情绪的小表情头像
   - 1—2 个与人物日常特征相关的小场景插图
   - 一组人物标签词
   - 一句手写感个性短句
   - 简短角色特质说明

风格方向：【手绘插画 / 日系设定页 / 水彩感 / 扁平矢量 / 复古漫画 / 清新文艺】

人物气质关键词：【如：安静、爱看展、咖啡控、松弛感、周末徒步、轻复古】

版式要求：
整体像一张可以收藏和分享的角色说明书，
信息完整但不拥挤，层次清晰，排版精致，适合社交媒体发布。

如果你想让人物更“像你”，还可以再补一句：

请先根据照片理解人物的外貌特征、气质和生活方式，再统一输出成一个完整的角色档案视觉页。

 参数技巧 / 关键控制点
1. 照片数量建议 3—5 张，这是最稳的范围。
尽量包括：
正面照
3/4 侧脸
自然笑容
半身或全身照
一张能体现生活状态的场景照
不要全是同角度自拍。

2. 少滤镜，保留真实特征
过度美颜、重滤镜、磨皮过狠，
都会影响人物识别度。
越接近真实状态，
AI越容易提炼出稳定的人物特征。

3. 人设描述越具体越好：

喜欢咖啡和看展
周末常去徒步
穿搭偏轻复古
平时爱拍街景和书店
有点安静，但很有主见

这种信息会直接影响角色卡的内容丰富度。

4. 标签不要太泛

比如：

 热爱生活 / 积极向上 / 温柔可爱
 咖啡成瘾者 / 周末徒步狂魔 / 展览收集者 / 深夜写作者

越具体，越有记忆点。

items.title: 雀巢牛奶纯白圣洁奢华海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium **pure white sacred luxury poster** for **Nestle Milk**, centered on the theme of **a mature East Asian girl ascending in flight and seamlessly fused with flowing milk**, as if she is being born from light, purity, and liquid softness itself. The entire image must feel holy, serene, weightless, and breathtakingly refined, like a fusion of high-end beauty photography, sacred sculptural art, and high-speed milk liquid capture. The woman must not appear to be wearing a costume made of milk; instead, her body and the milk must exist as one continuous living form. Her upper body, face, shoulders, and arms emerge gracefully from luminous milk, while the surrounding milk expands into vast, feather-light wing-like structures, flowing veils, liquid ribbons, and translucent trailing forms. The final image should express purity, nourishment, softness, grace, and spiritual elevation.

Main composition:
Use a clean, centered hero composition with one single female figure floating or ascending in the center of the frame. Her pose should feel balletic, weightless, and prayer-like in elegance, with the body rising upward in a soft vertical-diagonal motion. Her arms should open or lift with graceful extension, and the milk should spread behind and around her like sacred flowing wings made of liquid light. The silhouette must feel iconic, noble, and sculptural, with abundant negative space and perfect visual calm.

Character direction:
The female figure must be a **mature Japanese/Korean East Asian beauty**, elegant, refined, naturally beautiful, with soft bone structure, graceful neck and shoulders, and a calm, luminous, intelligent expression. She must not look like a fantasy angel or influencer model. Her beauty should feel elevated, poetic, and premium, with a serene inner stillness. Her movement should suggest flight, surrender, softness, and ascension.

Pure-white milk fusion concept:
The milk must behave like a sacred, silky, living material suspended between liquid, silk, mist, and light. The body must transition seamlessly into the milk:
milk blooming from the back into wing-like arcs,
milk wrapping the waist and lower torso into flowing sculptural motion,
milk extending from the arms into soft drag trails,
thin translucent milk membranes glowing like liquid silk,
small suspended droplets orbiting the figure like sacred particles.
The transformation must be completely natural, with no hard seams, no dress-like costume effect, and no pasted splash appearance. The girl should feel as though she is formed from milk and light in the same instant.

Liquid realism:
The milk must be hyper-realistic, luxurious, and radiant:
dense creamy white milk,
silky viscosity,
soft luminous translucency in thin areas,
smooth tension on the liquid edges,
velvety highlights,
fine suspended droplets,
mist-like liquid trails,
clean high-speed splash precision.
The milk should feel pure, nourishing, soft, and luxurious, never watery, never chalky, never plastic, never harsh.

Pure-white sacred styling:
Push the whole image toward an almost transcendent all-white visual world. The milk, light, background, and atmosphere should remain within a refined spectrum of white, pearl, ivory-white, silver-white, and barely-there cool gray. The scene should feel flooded with soft purity and silence, as if the figure is floating inside a luminous sacred space. The emotional effect should be clean, healing, angelic in mood but not literal in styling.

Motion and trailing effect:
The liquid drag-tail effect must be elegant and weightless. The milk should sweep outward and upward like soft wings caught in slow-motion lift, with long flowing arcs, gentle liquid ribbons, and airy suspended forms. The figure should feel frozen at the most beautiful microsecond of ascent, with motion that is fluid, graceful, and spiritually calm rather than explosive.

Brand presence:
Include a subtle and premium **Nestle Milk** brand presence. A clean product pack, bottle, or restrained official packaging element may appear near the lower composition with elegant balance. The official logo should be tasteful, small, and integrated naturally into the layout. Brand communication should feel premium, pure, trustworthy, and elevated, never retail-heavy.

Lighting:
Use extremely soft **pure white beauty lighting** with divine clarity:
soft frontal glow on the face and torso,
gentle halo-like rim lighting around the milk wings,
clean highlights on liquid edges,
subtle transmitted glow through thinner milk membranes,
delicate tonal layering with almost no harsh shadow,
micro-contrast only where needed to reveal liquid texture.
The lighting must feel heavenly, creamy, pure, and luxurious, as if the figure is illuminated from both outside and within.

Background:
Keep the background ultra-minimal and nearly all-white, with a soft gradient of pearl white, ivory white, mist white, and faint silver-gray. The space should feel limitless, silent, and luminous. No props, no scenery, no decorative objects, no clutter. Only sacred premium negative space.

Typography:
Use only minimal and elegant typography. Include a refined **Nestle Milk** title, small official logo, and at most one short poetic line. Typography must feel airy, gentle, and sacred-luxury in tone, with perfect spacing and art-directed placement. No bold heavy fonts, no retail poster feeling, no cluttered copy.

Color palette:
pure milk white,
pearl white,
ivory white,
soft silver-white,
mist gray,
barely-there cool light tones.

Mood:
pure, sacred, serene, uplifting, weightless, luminous, maternal, elegant, nourishing, spiritual, premium, poetic, unforgettable.

Rendering:
hyper-realistic high-speed milk liquid photography, sacred luxury beauty-commercial style, ultra-detailed milk splash simulation, elegant flying female silhouette, pure white minimal background, refined beauty lighting, 8k, world-class advertising campaign quality.

Negative prompt:
watery milk, gray dirty whites, messy splash chaos, fake wings, costume-like milk dress, cartoon liquid, plastic skin, influencer face, hard body-liquid seam, cluttered background, oversized packaging, cheap supermarket poster, heavy typography, fantasy angel costume, low-detail droplets, harsh lighting

prompts.text:
为雀巢牛奶创作一张超高级的纯白圣洁奢华海报，主题聚焦于一位成熟的东亚女孩在飞行中上升，并与流动的牛奶无缝融合，仿佛她是从光、纯净和液体本身的柔软中诞生的。整个画面必须感受到神圣、宁静、失重且令人叹为观止的精致，如同高端美容摄影、圣洁雕塑艺术与高速牛奶液体抓拍的融合。女子绝不能看起来像是穿着一件由牛奶制成的服装；相反，她的身体和牛奶必须作为一个连续的生命形式存在。她的上半身、脸部、肩膀和双臂优雅地从发光的牛奶中显现，而周围的牛奶扩展成巨大的、轻如羽毛的翅膀状结构、流动的面纱、液体丝带和半透明的拖尾形状。最终画面应表达出纯净、滋养、柔软、优雅和精神升华。

主要构图：
使用干净、居中的主体构图，单个女性形象在画框中心漂浮或上升。她的姿势应具有芭蕾般的感官、失重感和祈祷般的优雅，身体以柔和的垂直对角线动作向上升起。她的双臂应优雅地伸展打开或举起，牛奶应在她身后和周围像由液体光芒构成的神圣流动翅膀一样展开。轮廓必须具有标志性、高贵感和雕塑感，拥有丰富的负空间和完美的视觉平静。

角色指导：
女性形象必须是一位成熟的日韩东亚美女，优雅、精致、天生丽质，拥有柔和的骨骼结构、优雅的脖子和肩膀，以及冷静、明亮、聪慧的表情。她绝不能看起来像幻想中的天使或网红模特。她的美感应是升华的、诗意的、高级的，带有宁静的内在寂静。她的动作应暗示飞行、臣服、柔软和上升。

纯白牛奶融合概念：
牛奶的表现必须像一种悬浮在液体、丝绸、薄雾和光线之间的神圣、丝滑、有生命的物质。身体必须无缝过渡到牛奶中：牛奶从背部绽放成翅膀般的弧线，牛奶包裹腰部和下半身形成流动的雕塑动作，牛奶从手臂延伸成柔软的拖痕，薄薄的半透明牛奶膜像液体丝绸一样发光，微小的悬浮液滴像神圣粒子一样绕着人物运行。这种转变必须完全自然，没有生硬的接缝，没有像衣服一样的服装效果，也没有粘贴上去的喷溅外观。女孩应该感觉像是那一瞬间由牛奶和光线形成的。

液体写实度：
牛奶必须是超写实的、奢华的、光彩夺目的：浓郁的奶油白牛奶，丝滑的黏度，薄处有柔和的发光半透明感，液体边缘的平滑张力，天鹅绒般的亮部，精细的悬浮液滴，雾状的液体痕迹，干净的高速喷溅精度。牛奶应该让人感到纯净、滋养、柔软和奢华，绝不能像水、粉末、塑料或刺眼。

纯白神圣风格：
将整个画面推向一个几乎超然的全白视觉世界。牛奶、光线、背景和氛围应保持在精致的白色、珍珠色、象牙白、银白和几乎感觉不到的冷灰色光谱内。场景应该充满柔和的纯净和寂静，仿佛人物漂浮在一个发光的神圣空间里。情感效果应该是干净、疗愈、带有天使般的情绪，但在造型上不是写实的。

动态与拖尾效果：
液体拖尾效果必须优雅且轻盈。牛奶应像捕捉到慢动作升力中的柔软翅膀一样向外向上扫过，带有长长的流动弧线、温柔的液体丝带和轻盈的悬浮形态。人物应感觉像是被冻结在上升过程中最美丽的微秒，动作流畅、优雅且精神平静，而不是爆发性的。

品牌呈现：
包含一个微妙且高端的雀巢牛奶品牌呈现。一个干净的产品包装、瓶子或克制的官方包装元素可以以优雅的平衡出现在构图下方。官方 Logo 应雅致、小巧，并自然地融入布局中。品牌传播应让人感到高级、纯粹、值得信赖和升华，绝不是沉重的零售感。

灯光：
使用极其柔和的、具有神圣清晰度的纯白美妆灯光：面部和躯干有柔和的正面光辉，牛奶翅膀周围有柔和的哈洛式轮廓光，液体边缘有干净的亮部，透过较薄的牛奶膜有微妙的透射光，细腻的色调层次几乎没有生硬的阴影，仅在需要揭示液体纹理的地方使用微对比。灯光必须感觉像天堂般、奶油色、纯净且奢华，仿佛人物从外部和内部同时被照亮。

背景：
背景保持极简且几乎全白，带有珍珠白、象牙白、雾白和微弱银灰色的柔和渐变。空间应感觉无边无际、寂静且明亮。没有道具，没有布景，没有装饰物，没有杂乱。只有神圣的高级负空间。

排版：
仅使用极简且优雅的排版。包括一个精致的雀巢牛奶标题、小巧的官方 Logo，以及最多一行简短的诗意文案。排版必须感觉轻盈、温柔，在色调上具有神圣奢侈感，间距完美且经过艺术指导。没有粗重的字体，没有零售海报的感觉，没有杂乱的文案。

配色方案：
纯牛奶白、珍珠白、象牙白、柔和银白、雾灰、几乎感觉不到的冷亮色调。

氛围：
纯净、神圣、宁静、令人振奋、失重、明亮、母性、优雅、滋养、精神、高级、诗意、难忘。

渲染：
超写实高速牛奶液体摄影，神圣奢华美容商业风格，超细节牛奶喷溅模拟，优雅飞行的女性轮廓，纯白极简背景，精致的美妆灯光，8k，世界级广告大片质量。

负面提示词：
水状牛奶，灰色肮脏的白色，混乱的喷溅混乱，假翅膀，像服装一样的牛奶裙，卡通液体，塑料皮肤，网红脸，生硬的身体-液体接缝，杂乱的背景，过大的包装，廉价的超市海报，沉重的排版，幻想天使服装，低细节液滴，刺眼的灯光
