items.title: 高精度AI角色固定参考图表生成

prompts.text:
You will create a “High-Precision Reference Chart” based on the attached character image that can be used for AI image generation or character consistency.  

The purpose is not to create a character profile, but to produce visual material so that the same character can be stably reproduced in the future.  
Name, personality, hobbies, story setting, and long profiles are not needed.  
Text in the image is limited to short labels for each panel and the minimum necessary characteristic memos.  

────────────────────  
Most Important Rule  
────────────────────  

Treat the character in the attached image as the sole standard, ensuring that they appear as the same character in all panels.  

Particularly, do not change the following:  

・Face contour  
・Eye shape, impression around the eyes, atmosphere of the gaze  
・Eyebrow shape and thickness  
・Nose bridge, nostrils, profile nose shape  
・Lip shape, thickness, tone  
・Cheeks, chin, face lines  
・Skin color, skin texture, natural unevenness  
・Hairstyle, bangs, side hair, back hair, hair color, hair flow  
・Sense of age  
・Body type, skeleton, length of limbs, full-body balance  
・Clothing impression  
・Overall atmosphere, sense of air, photo texture  

Prohibit turning the character into someone else, changing the face, over-beautifying, changing the body type, changing the hairstyle, or changing the hair color.  
In each angle, each expression, and each part, prioritize ensuring the consistency of the face, hair, and body type above all else.  

────────────────────  
Art Style / Texture  
────────────────────  

If the attached image is realistic, create it as a natural realistic photo.  
If the attached image is an illustration, animation, manga, 3D, or stylized, maintain its art style, lines, coloring, shading, texture, and degree of stylization.  

Do not arbitrarily turn it into realism.  
Do not arbitrarily turn it into animation.  
Do not arbitrarily turn it into 3D.  
Please keep the expression form of the original image unchanged.  

In the case of realism, please adopt a realistic texture like a smartphone photo or a natural studio reference photo.  
Skin should not be over-processed; retain natural pores, fine hairs, skin unevenness, and a sense of complexion.  
Prohibit doll-like skin, plastic skin, CG feel, and over-retouching.  

────────────────────  
Image Format  
────────────────────  

A horizontally long single reference chart.  
The aspect ratio is 16:9 to 16:10.  
The background is white, light gray, or pale off-white.  
Use moderate white space, organized with light-colored lines and boxes into a reference-use layout.  
Do not adopt a magazine cover, resume, poster, or social media post style.  

The overall composition should be like a neat and easy-to-read character production reference.  
Each panel is aligned and arranged, with short and easy-to-read labels.  
Do not overlay text on the face or important parts.  

────────────────────  
Clothing Rules  
────────────────────  

If the clothing in the original image is clearly visible, maintain the impression of that clothing.  
In all panels such as front, side, back, diagonal, expression differences, and part close-ups, maintain the same clothing, the same hairstyle, and the same body type.  

If the clothing in the original image is unclear, cropped, out of frame, or blurry, supplement with natural, low-key clothing that fits the character's atmosphere.  

Examples of supplemental clothing:  
・Simple white or light gray top  
・Natural casual bottoms  
・Plain-colored clothing that is not overly conspicuous  
・Neat clothing for reference use with easy-to-identify shapes  

Clothing to avoid:  
・Underwear  
・Swimwear  
・Excessive exposure  
・Clothing that looks sexy  
・Overly flashy clothing  
・Different clothing in each panel  
・Large accessories not present in the original image  

────────────────────  
Included Panel Composition  
────────────────────  

Please organize and arrange the following content within one chart.  

【1. Full Body View】  
・Front full body  
・Side full body  
・Back full body  
・Front-diagonal full body  
・Back-diagonal full body  

Purpose:  
To make the body type, sense of height, length of limbs, shoulder width, posture, clothing silhouette, and full-body balance clearly visible.  

Posture:  
Natural standing.  
Avoid extreme poses.  
Do not over-exaggerate like a model shoot.  
Make both hands and both feet naturally visible.  

【2. Face Close-up】  
・Front face close-up  
・Profile  
・45-degree angle  
・Slightly from above  
・Slightly from below  

Purpose:  
To confirm the face's three-dimensionality, eye/nose/mouth positions, contour, chin, profile, and the way hair falls.  

【3. Expression Differences】  
While maintaining the same face shape, add the following expressions.  

・Normal  
・Natural smile  
・Grin  
・Serious  
・Surprised  
・Shy  
・Thinking  
・Troubled expression  
・Slightly sad expression  
・Calm expression  

Even when changing expressions, please do not make it look like someone else.  
Please do not change the eye size, contour, nose, lips, or hairstyle.  

【4. Face Part Magnification】  
Please display the following parts magnified in small boxes respectively.  

・Eyes  
・Eyebrows  
・Nose  
・Mouth  
・Lips  
・Ears  
・Contour  
・Cheeks  
 skins texture  
・Bangs  
・Side hair  
・Back hair  
・Hair flow  
・Hands  

Purpose:  
To fix details that should be reproduced in future image generation.  
Please depict each part naturally and realistically, avoiding distortions or glitches.  

【5. Hair Reference】  
To make the hair structure clear, please include the following.  

・Bangs seen from the front  
・Side hair seen from the side  
・Hair length and overall feel seen from the back  
・Flow of hair tips  
・Sense of hair bundles  
・The way hair color appears  
・Texture when light hits it  

Please unify the shape of the bangs, parting, side hair, and back hair in all panels.  

【6. Other Angles】  
Please include the following angles.  

・Diagonal left  
・Diagonal right  
・Profile left  
・Profile right  
・Back of the head  
・From above  
・From below  

Purpose:  
To fix the face and hairstyle three-dimensionally.  
Even if the angle changes, please maintain the same character, the same hairstyle, and the same atmosphere.  

【7. Characteristic Memo Column】  
Create a short characteristic memo column on the left side or at the bottom of the chart.  

Included items:  
・Age impression  
・Face  
・Hair  
・Eyes  
・Eyebrows  
・Nose  
・Mouth  
・Skin  
・Body type  
・Sense of height  
・Clothing  
・Atmosphere  
・Characteristics to be fixed  

Please do not use long text, but short bullet points.  
Only write visually observable characteristics or characteristics strongly inferred from the original image.  
Do not include fictional profiles.  

【8. Color Palette】  
Display the colors needed for character reproduction in 5 to 7 small color samples.  

Included colors:  
・Hair color  
・Eye color  
・Skin color  
・Lip color  
・Clothing color  
・Shadow color  
・Overall tone color  

Please attach a short label to each color.  

【9. Consistency Memo】  
Briefly summarize the points to be observed when regenerating in the future.  

Example:  
・Fix face contour  
・Fix the impression around the eyes  
・Fix bangs and hair color  
・Fix skin texture  
・Fix body type and full-body balance  
・Unify clothing  
・Prioritize ensuring it looks like the same character above all else  

────────────────────  
Labels and Language  
────────────────────  

Please use Chinese uniformly for the labels in the image.  
Do not use English labels.  

Label examples:  
・Full body Front (全身 正面)  
・Full body Side (全身 侧面)  
・Full body Back (全身 后方)  
・Face Front (脸部 正面)  
・Profile (侧脸)  
・45-degree angle (斜45度)  
・Normal (通常)  
・Smile (笑容)  
・Serious (认真)  
・Surprised (惊讶)  
・Shy (害羞)  
・Thinking (思考中)  
・Troubled expression (困扰表情)  
・Eyes (眼睛)  
・Eyebrows (眉毛)  
・Nose (鼻子)  
・Mouth (嘴巴)  
・Ears (耳朵)  
・Skin (皮肤)  
・Bangs (前发)  
・Side hair (侧发)  
・Back hair (后发)  
・Hair flow (发丝流动)  
・Hands (手)  
・Characteristic memo (特征备忘)  
・Color samples (色样)  
・Fixed points (固定要点)  

Please display the text short, easy to read, and correctly.  
Garbled text, broken characters, text with unclear meaning, and text that is too small to read are prohibited.  

────────────────────  
Layout Guidelines  
────────────────────  

Left side:  
Character characteristic memo, color samples, fixed points.  

Center:  
Large arrangement of full-body views and face close-ups.  

Right side:  
Organized arrangement of expression differences, other angles, and face part magnifications.  

Bottom:  
Horizontal arrangement of detailed parts such as eyes, nose, mouth, hair, skin, and hands.  

Overall:  
Organize each part with boxes to make it easy to read as reference material.  
Moderate white space, high density but not cluttered.  
Unify the character size in each panel for easy comparison.  

────────────────────  
Shooting / Depiction Atmosphere  
────────────────────  

Natural light, or soft indoor light.  
Shadows should not be too strong, ensuring brightness where the face and hairstyle are easy to identify.  
The background is a solid color to avoid distracting the gaze from the character.  
Postures are natural, prioritizing true front, side, back, and diagonal views to facilitate use as character reference material.  

Flashy productions, cinematic lighting, strong blurring, heavy makeup, and fashion magazine-style poses are prohibited.  
Please make it like a neat and objective reference photo.  

────────────────────  
Excluded Content  
────────────────────  

Please do not include the following.  

・Name  
・Age numbers  
・Personality descriptions  
・Hobbies  
・Story settings  
・Profile text  
・Long descriptions  
・Unnecessary backgrounds  
・Unnecessary small items  
・Food  
・Random objects  
・Large accessories not in the original image  
・Logos  
・Watermarks  
・Signatures  
・Flashy decorations  
・Social media post-style designs  

────────────────────  

Prohibited Matters  
────────────────────  

Do not turn into someone else.  
Do not change the face in each panel.  
Do not change the hairstyle.  
Do not change the hair color.  
Do not change the body type.  
Do not let the clothing be inconsistent.  
Do not change the sense of age.  
Do not make them younger than the original image.  
Do not over-beautify.  
Do not over-simplify.  
Do not give a sexy impression.  
Do not use underwear or swimwear.  
Do not let hands or fingers glitch.  
Do not distort the profile.  
Do not unnaturally enlarge the eyes.  
Do not break the positions of face parts.  
Do not break the text.  
Do not break the layout.  
Do not let the background be cluttered.  

────────────────────  
Negative Prompt  
────────────────────  

Someone else, other characters, face change, eye change, nose change, mouth change, contour change, hairstyle change, hair color change, bangs change, body type change, age sense change, clothing inconsistency, over-beautification, over-youthfulness, looking small, excessive exposure, underwear, swimwear, sexy clothing, gravure style, fashion magazine style, flashy poses, extra small items, food, random objects, cluttered background, low resolution, garbled text, unreadable text, English labels, long profiles, logos, watermarks, signatures, hand glitches, finger glitches, extra fingers, missing fingers, distorted face, distorted profile, overlapping faces, body distortion, unnatural joints, art style change, arbitrary realism, arbitrary animation, arbitrary 3D, CGI feel, plastic skin, over-retouching, layout destruction  

────────────────────  
Final Output  
────────────────────  

Create a horizontally long single reference chart based on the character in the attached image, with character consistency as the top priority.  
Organize full body, face close-ups, profile, diagonal, expression differences, face parts, hair details, other angles, color samples, and fixed points using light lines and boxes.  
The composition should be convenient for use as reference material, neat and easy to read, facilitating the reproduction of character characteristics in the future.

prompts.text:
你将基于附带的角色图像，创建一张可用于AI图像生成或角色固定的“高精度参考图表”。  

目的不是创建角色简介，而是制作视觉资料，以便今后稳定再现同一角色。  
姓名、性格、爱好、故事设定、长篇简介均不需要。  
图像中的文字仅限于各面板的简短标签，以及必要的最小限度特征备忘录。  

────────────────────  
最重要规则  
────────────────────  

将附带图像中的角色作为唯一标准处理，确保所有面板中看起来都是同一角色。  

特别不要改变以下内容：  

・脸部轮廓  
・眼睛形状、眼周印象、视线氛围  
・眉毛形状和浓淡  
・鼻梁、小鼻、侧脸鼻形  
・嘴唇形状、厚度、色调  
・脸颊、下巴、脸部线条  
・肤色、皮肤质感、自然凹凸  
・发型、前发、侧发、后发、发色、发丝流动  
・年龄感  
・体型、骨架、手脚长度、全身平衡  
・服装印象  
・整体氛围、空气感、照片质感  

禁止将角色变成他人、改换脸部、过度美化、改变体型、改变发型、改变发色。  
在各个角度・各个表情・各个部位中，最优先确保脸部、头发和体型的一致性。  

────────────────────  
画风・质感  
────────────────────  

如果附带图像是实写，则作为自然实写照片创建。  
如果附带图像是插画、动画、漫画、3D、变形风格，则保持其画风、线条、上色、阴影、质感、变形程度。  

请勿擅自实写化。  
请勿擅自动画化。  
请勿擅自3D化。  
请保持原图像的表现形式不变。  

实写的情况下，请采用智能手机照片或自然工作室资料照片般的真实质感。  
皮肤不要过度加工，保留自然的毛孔、汗毛、皮肤凹凸、血色感。  
禁止人偶般的皮肤、塑料皮肤、CG感、过度修图。  

────────────────────  
图像形式  
────────────────────  

横长的单张参考图表。  
比例为16:9〜16:10。  
背景为白色、浅灰色，或淡米白色。  
适度留白，以浅色线条和方框整理成资料用布局。  
请勿采用杂志封面、简历、海报、SNS投稿风格。  

整体构成应如整洁易读的角色制作资料。  
各面板对齐排列，标签简短易读地配置。  
文字请勿叠加在脸部或重要部位上。  

────────────────────  
服装规则  
────────────────────  

如果原图像的服装清晰可见，则保持该服装的印象。  
在正面、侧面、后方、斜面、表情差异、部位放大等所有面板中，保持相同的服装・相同的发型・相同的体型。  

如果原图像的服装不明、被裁剪、超出画面、模糊不清，则以符合角色氛围的自然、低调服装进行补充。  

补充服装示例：  
・简约的白色或浅灰色上衣  
・自然的休闲下装  
・不过度显眼的素色系服装  
・资料用、形状易辨的整洁服装  

避免的服装：  
・内衣  
・泳装  
・过度暴露  
・看起来性感的服装  
・过于华丽的服装  
・各面板中不同的服装  
・原图像中没有的大型配饰  

────────────────────  
包含的面板构成  
────────────────────  

请将以下内容整理配置在一张图表内。  

【1. 全身视图】  
・正面全身  
・侧面全身  
・后方全身  
・斜前方全身  
・斜后方全身  

目的：  
使体型、身高感、手脚长度、肩宽、姿势、服装轮廓、全身平衡清晰可见。  

姿势：  
自然站立。  
避免极端姿势。  
不要像模特拍摄般过度夸张。  
使双手双脚自然可见。  

【2. 脸部特写】  
・正面脸部特写  
・侧脸  
・斜45度  
・稍从上方  
・稍从下方  

目的：  
确认脸部立体感、眼鼻口位置、轮廓、下巴、侧脸、头发垂落方式。  

【3. 表情差异】  
在保持相同脸型的前提下，加入以下表情。  

・通常  
・自然笑容  
・微笑  
・认真  
・惊讶  
・害羞  
・思考中  
・困扰表情  
・稍带悲伤的表情  
・平静的表情  

即使改变表情，也请勿看起来像他人。  
请勿改变眼睛大小、轮廓、鼻子、嘴唇、发型。  

【4. 脸部部位放大】  
请将以下部位分别在小方框中放大显示。  

・眼睛  
・眉毛  
・鼻子  
・嘴巴  
・嘴唇  
・耳朵  
・轮廓  
・脸颊  
・皮肤质感  
・前发  
・侧发  
・后发  
・发丝流动  
・手  

目的：  
固定今后图像生成中应再现的细节。  
各部位请自然真实地描绘，避免扭曲或破绽。  

【5. 发型资料】  
为使头发结构清晰，请加入以下内容。  

・从正面看到的刘海  
・从侧面看到的侧发  
・从后方看到的头发长度和整体感  
・发梢流动  
・头发束感  
・发色显现方式  
・光线照射时的质感  

请在所有面板中统一前发、分线、侧发、后发的形状。  

【6. 其他角度】  
请加入以下角度。  

・斜左  
・斜右  
・侧脸左  
・侧脸右  
・后脑部  
・从上方  
・从下方  

目的：  
立体固定脸部和发型。  
即使角度改变，也请保持同一角色・相同发型・相同氛围。  

【7. 特征备忘栏】  
在图表的左侧或下方创建简短的特征备忘栏。  

包含项目：  
・年龄印象  
・脸部  
・头发  
・眼睛  
・眉毛  
・鼻子  
・嘴巴  
・皮肤  
・体型  
・身高感  
・服装  
・氛围  
・应固定的特征  

请勿使用长文，而是简短的条目式。  
仅写视觉可见的特征，或从原图像强烈推测到的特征。  
请勿加入虚构的简介。  

【8. 色板】  
以5〜7个小色样显示角色再现所需的颜色。  

包含颜色：  
・发色  
・瞳色  
・肤色  
・唇色  
・服装颜色  
・阴影色  
・整体基调色  

请为每个颜色附上简短标签。  

【9. 一致性备忘】  
简短总结今后再生成时应遵守的要点。  

示例：  
・固定脸部轮廓  
・固定眼周印象  
・固定刘海和发色  
・固定皮肤质感  
・固定体型和全身平衡  
・服装统一  
・最优先确保看起来是同一角色  

────────────────────  
标签和语言  
────────────────────  

图像中的标签请统一使用中文。  
请勿使用英文标签。  

标签示例：  
・全身 正面  
・全身 侧面  
・全身 后方  
・脸部 正面  
・侧脸  
・斜45度  
・通常  
・笑容  
・认真  
・惊讶  
・害羞  
・思考中  
・困扰表情

・前发

・后发  
・发丝流动  
・手  
・特征备忘  
・色样  
・固定要点  

文字请简短、易读、正确显示。  
禁止文字乱码、崩坏文字、含义不明文字、过小难读文字。  

────────────────────  
布局方针  
────────────────────  

左侧：  
角色特征备忘、色样、固定要点。  

中央：  
较大配置全身视图和脸部特写。  

右侧：  
整理配置表情差异、其他角度、脸部部位放大。  

下部：  
横排配置眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、头发、皮肤、手等详细部位。  

整体：  
以方框整理各部分，作为资料易读。  
留白适度，密度高但不杂乱。  
统一各面板的角色大小，便于比较。  

────────────────────  
拍摄・描绘氛围  
────────────────────  

自然光，或柔和室内光。  
阴影不要过强，确保脸部和发型易辨的亮度。  
背景为纯色，避免视线分散到角色以外。  
姿势自然，优先真正面・侧面・后方・斜面，便于作为角色资料使用。  

禁止华丽演出、电影式灯光、强烈虚化、过度化妆、时尚杂志式姿势。  
请像整洁客观的资料照片一样。  

────────────────────  
排除内容  
────────────────────  

请勿加入以下内容。  

・姓名  
・年龄数字  
・性格说明  
・爱好  
・故事设定  
・简介文  
・长篇说明  
・不必要的背景

・食物

・原图像中没有的大型配饰  
・标志  
・水印  
・签名  
・华丽装饰  
・SNS投稿式设计  

────────────────────  
禁止事项  
────────────────────  

不要变成他人。  
各面板中不要改变脸部。  
不要改变发型。  
不要改变发色。  
不要改变体型。  
不要让服装不统一。  
不要改变年龄感。  
不要比原图像更幼。  
不要过度美化。  
不要过度简化。  
不要带有性感印象。  
不要使用内衣或泳装。  
不要让手或手指破绽。  
不要扭曲侧脸。  
不要不自然地放大眼睛。  
不要崩坏脸部部位位置。  
不要崩坏文字。  
不要破坏布局。  
不要让背景杂乱。  

────────────────────  
负面提示  
────────────────────  

他人、其他角色、脸部改变、眼睛改变、鼻子改变、嘴巴改变、轮廓改变、发型变更、发色变更、前发变更、体型变更、年龄感变更、服装不一致、过度美化、过度年轻化、看起来幼小、过度暴露、内衣、泳装、性感服装、写真风、时尚杂志风、华丽姿势、多余小物件、食物、随机物体、杂乱背景、低分辨率、文字乱码、难读文字、英文标签、长篇简介、标志、水印、签名、手部破绽、指部破绽、多余手指、缺失手指、扭曲脸部、扭曲侧脸、重叠脸部、身体扭曲、不自然关节、画风变化、擅自实写化、擅自动画化、擅自3D化、CGI感、塑料皮肤、过度修图、破坏布局  

────────────────────  
最终输出  
────────────────────  

基于附带图像的角色，以同一角色性为最优先，创建横长单张参考图表。  
将全身、脸部特写、侧脸、斜面、表情差异、脸部部位、头发细节、其他角度、色样、固定要点，以浅色线条和方框整理。

items.title: Oran西班牙水果红酒极简植物酒瓶海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-high-end minimalist poster for Oran Spanish fruit red wine, inspired by an exquisite botanical silhouette bottle composition. Use a large area of clean white or soft ivory background, leaving ample white space. The central image must be a bottle shape naturally formed by real grapevines, tender stems, curling tendrils, and elegant vine leaves. The bottle silhouette should appear delicate, vertical, light, and perfectly balanced, as if nature itself has quietly outlined the shape of the bottle.

Main Composition:
Build the complete silhouette of an upright wine bottle using only realistic grapevine elements:
fine green stems,
natural branching nodes,
curling tendrils,
small fresh vine leaves,
subtle organic asymmetry,
clean bottle proportions.
The silhouette must be immediately recognizable as a wine bottle, yet should still maintain a botanical and naturally grown feel rather than a rigid graphic design.

Grape Details:
Add only a small number of grapes as precious accents, rather than heavy clusters. Use a few deep ruby red or wine purple grapes, naturally attached to the vine structure with believable stems and elegant spacing. The grapes must feel lightly placed and perfectly connected to the vine, as if they truly grew there. Their role is to accent the composition and hint at the richness of the fruit wine, not to dominate the bottle silhouette.

Branding/Product Integration:
In the lower middle position of the vine-formed bottle silhouette, place a delicate label area or an elegant bottle label insert referencing Oran fruit red wine. The label should feel high-end, small, and tasteful, with subtle Spanish wine elegance and an optional cryptic hint of a Little Red Riding Hood identity. Maintain restraint and a sense of luxury, never loud or overly commercial.

Light and Shadow:
Use extremely delicate, soft, high-end lighting. The light should feel natural and velvety smooth, revealing:
the tender translucency of fresh vine leaves,
the smooth surface of the grapes,
the organic texture of the stems,
the subtle relief-like feel of the paper-like background,
the soft shadows cast by the vine bottle silhouette.
Shadows must be soft, diffused, and elegant, giving the image a peaceful depth rather than drama.

Botanical Realism:
Push realism to the highest level:
fresh vine green tones,
subtle leaf veins,
natural stem nodes,
fine tendril curls,
the powdery bloom on grape skins,
slight translucency at the edges of the grapes,
soft natural imperfections.
Everything should feel tactile, vibrant, and exquisitely beautiful.

Background:
Keep the background extremely minimalist, clean, and matte, using soft white, warm ivory, or light parchment color. It should feel like fine art paper or a high-end gallery wall texture. No clutter, no extra props, no tabletop settings, no decorative noise.

Typography:
Keep the text extremely minimalist and elegant. If needed, only add a delicate title:
“ORAN”
Optional supporting line:
“Fruit Red Wine”
Typography should be small, luxurious, light, and artistically designed, leaving ample breathing space. Avoid long copy, avoid generic bold fonts.

Color Palette:
Soft ivory,
fresh vine green,
light botanical green,
deep ruby grape color,
wine purple accents,
soft neutral shadows.
The palette should feel restrained, botanical, luxurious, and poetic.

Atmosphere:
Minimalist, botanical, luxurious, poetic, elegant, gallery-like, exquisite, natural, high-end wine poster quality.

Rendering:
Hyper-realistic botanical photography, ultra-fine grapevine textures, elegant bottle silhouette formed by real vines, subtle ruby grape accents, soft high-end lighting, delicate shadows, clean art paper background, minimalist luxury typography, museum-grade wine promotional image, 8k, masterpiece.

Negative Prompt:
Heavy grape clusters, cluttered composition, dark dramatic background, messy stems, fake bottle silhouette, loud commercial labels, too much text, cartoonish leaves, plastic-looking grapes, harsh shadows, random props, low-end wine poster look

prompts.text:
为Oran西班牙水果红酒创作一张超高端极简海报，灵感来源于精致的植物轮廓瓶身构图。使用大面积干净的白色或柔和象牙白背景，留出充裕的留白空间。中央图像必须是由真实的葡萄藤、嫩茎、卷曲的藤须和优雅的藤叶自然形成的酒瓶形状。瓶身轮廓应显得精致、垂直、轻盈且完美平衡，仿佛大自然悄然勾勒出酒瓶的轮廓。

主要构图：
仅使用逼真的葡萄藤元素构建一瓶直立酒瓶的完整轮廓：
细绿茎，
自然分枝节点，
卷曲藤须，
小型新鲜藤叶，
微妙有机不对称，
干净的瓶身比例。
轮廓必须立即可辨识为酒瓶，但仍应保持植物感和自然生长感，而非僵硬的图形设计。

葡萄细节：
仅添加少量葡萄作为珍贵的点缀，而非沉重的葡萄串。使用几颗深红宝石红或酒紫色的葡萄，自然附着在藤蔓结构上，带有可信的茎秆和优雅的间距。葡萄必须感觉轻盈放置且完美连接到藤蔓，仿佛它们真正生长在那里。它们的作用是点缀构图并暗示水果酒的丰盈，而非主导瓶身轮廓。

品牌/产品整合：
在藤蔓形成的瓶身轮廓中下部位置，放置一个精致的标签区域或优雅的瓶标插入，引用Oran水果红酒。标签应感觉高端、小巧且雅致，带有微妙的西班牙葡萄酒优雅，以及可选的隐晦小红帽身份暗示。保持克制与奢华感，绝不喧闹或商业化过重。

光影：
使用极其精致、柔和、高端的光线照明。光线应感觉自然且天鹅绒般柔滑，揭示：
新鲜藤叶的嫩透感，
葡萄的光滑表面，
茎秆的有机纹理，
纸张般背景的微妙浮雕感，
藤蔓瓶身轮廓投下的柔和阴影。
阴影必须柔和、漫射且优雅，为图像赋予宁静的深度，而非戏剧性。

植物真实感：
将真实感推向最高水平：
新鲜藤蔓绿调，
细微叶脉，
自然茎节点，
精细藤须卷曲，
葡萄皮上的霜粉感，
葡萄边缘的轻微透感，
柔和的自然瑕疵。
一切都应感觉触感十足、生机勃勃且精美绝伦。

背景：
保持背景极其极简、干净且哑光，使用柔和白色、温暖象牙白或浅羊皮纸色。它应感觉像精美艺术纸或高端画廊墙面材质。无杂乱、无额外道具、无桌面设置、无装饰噪音。

排版：
保持文字极其极简且优雅。如有需要，仅添加一个精致的标题：
“ORAN”
可选支持行：
“Fruit Red Wine”
排版应小巧、奢华、轻盈且艺术化设计，留出充裕的呼吸空间。避免冗长文案，避免通用粗体字体。

色彩调色板：
柔和象牙白，
新鲜藤蔓绿，
浅植物绿，
深红宝石葡萄色，
酒紫色点缀，
柔和中性阴影。
调色板应感觉克制、植物感十足、奢华且诗意。

氛围：
极简、植物感、奢华、诗意、优雅、画廊般、精致、自然、高端葡萄酒海报品质。

渲染：
超现实植物摄影，葡萄藤纹理超精细，真实藤蔓形成的优雅瓶身轮廓，微妙红宝石葡萄点缀，柔和高端照明，精致阴影，干净艺术纸背景，极简奢华排版，博物馆级葡萄酒宣传图像，8k，杰作。

负面提示：
沉重葡萄串，杂乱构图，黑暗戏剧性背景，凌乱茎秆，假瓶身轮廓，喧闹商业标签，过多文字，卡通叶片，塑料感葡萄，刺眼阴影，随意道具，低端葡萄酒海报外观

items.title: 午后红影室内轻熟女性人像

prompts.text:
Theme:
Afternoon Red Afterglow

Subject:
A vertical indoor portrait featuring an adult woman sitting on a dark wood grain floor. The subject is positioned largely in the center-left of the frame, capturing from the upper body to the legs at a close distance. Wooden shutters are placed on the right, and a low shelf and houseplants are placed in the back-left, with the background moderately blurred.

Person · Expression:
A natural and realistic adult woman. Deep brown long hair is slightly messy, with fine strands of hair falling around the face. The head is slightly tilted to the left, the chin is slightly raised, quietly gazing at the camera. The expression is not deliberately sculpted; half-open lips and calm eyes create a lazy and elegant atmosphere. The body type gives a mature impression, not appearing slender, with natural roundness and a beauty of posture.

Clothing · Pose:
Wears a dark red ribbed knit material set. The top is a shorter cardigan-style top, with a natural three-dimensional effect at the chest, showing a part that is elegant and restrained. Ribbon knots and strings on the sides add a light embellishment to the clothing. The bottom is a tight miniskirt of the same color. The left leg is significantly bent with the knee raised, and the other leg is folded on the floor. The person's right hand is near the back of the body, supporting on the floor with weight on the fingertips. The left arm hangs naturally near the leg. Wearing black loafer-style high heels, exuding a steady adult temperament down to the feet.

Background · Lighting:
Warm afternoon interior. Sunlight from the low-lying sun filters through wooden shutters in the back right, casting long thin strips of light and shadow on the floor and walls. Light enters from the upper right of the frame, forming soft highlights on hair outlines, shoulders, and the front of the legs. Light reflected from the floor slightly illuminates the skin, with the background side slightly dim to create a sense of depth. Wooden shelves, stacked books, trays, and houseplants are placed in the back left, with a breath of life but not overly prominent.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical composition, 3:4 ratio. The lens starts from a low position near the floor, not a slightly downward angle, but from a natural eye-level height pointing from the character's chest to the face. Equivalent to a 35mm–50mm natural angle of view. Focus is on the character's face, with the background and deep floor softly blurred with a shallow depth of field. The large triangle formed by the knee, the hand propped on the floor, and the diagonally entering shutter light create a sense of rhythm in the frame. The character, clothing details, accurate pose, and arrangement of background small objects in the reference image are not directly copied, but redesigned while maintaining the same atmosphere.

Texture · Style:
Realistic photo expression. Skin is not over-edited, retaining natural texture and soft highlights. The fine texture of red ribbed knit, the luster of the wooden floor, the small bundles of hair strands, and the shadows of the shutters are all carefully depicted. Warm-toned film-like tones, slightly lower contrast, with a steady completion like a magazine photo.

Negative:
Unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, excessive exposure, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of hands and feet, damaged clothing, deformed shoes, floating, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
午后的红色余韵

主体：
以坐在深色木纹地板上的成年女性为主角的纵向室内肖像。人物较大地配置在画面中央稍偏左的位置，以较近的距离感拍摄上半身至双腿。右侧放置木质百叶窗，左后方放置低矮的架子和观叶植物，背景适度模糊。

人物·表情：
自然且具现实感的大人女性。深棕色的长发略显凌乱，细碎的发丝垂落在脸庞周围。头部微微向左倾斜，下巴稍稍抬起，静静凝视镜头。表情不刻意雕琢，半开的嘴唇和沉静的眼眸营造出慵懒而优雅的氛围。体型给人成熟的印象，不显纤细，带有自然的圆润感和姿态的美感。

服装·姿势：
采用深红色罗纹针织材质的套装。上身为较短的开衫式上衣，胸口自然呈现立体感，露出部分优雅而克制。侧面的缎带结和细绳为服装增添轻盈的点缀。下身为同色系的紧身迷你裙。左侧的腿大幅弯曲抬起膝盖，另一侧腿折叠置于地板上。人物自身的右手靠近身体后方支撑在地板上，用指尖承重。左臂自然垂放在腿部附近。穿着黑色的乐福鞋风格高跟鞋，直至足部都散发着沉稳的大人气质。

背景·光线：
温暖的午后室内。右侧后方的木质百叶窗透入低矮的阳光，在地板和墙壁上投下细长的条状光影。光线从画面右上方进入，在发丝轮廓、肩膀和腿部前侧形成柔和的高光。地板反射的光线微微照亮肌肤，背景侧稍显昏暗以营造深度感。左后方放置木制架子、叠放的书籍、浅盘和观叶植物，带有生活气息但不过分突出。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图，3:4比例。镜头从靠近地板的较低位置出发，不是稍稍俯视的角度，而是以自然视线高度从人物胸口指向脸部。相当于35mm〜50mm的自然画角。将焦点对准人物的脸部，背景和地板深处以浅景深柔和模糊。膝盖形成的巨大三角形、撑在地板上的手、斜入的百叶窗光线为画面营造节奏感。参考图中的人物、服装细节、准确姿势、背景小物件的配置不直接复制，仅保留相同氛围感进行重新设计。

质感·风格：
真实的照片表现。肌肤不过度修饰，保留自然的质感和柔和的高光。红色罗纹针织的细密纹理、木地板的光泽、发丝的细小束、百叶窗的阴影均仔细描绘。偏暖色的胶片般色调、稍低的对比度，如杂志照片般沉稳的完成度。

负面：
不自然的五官、不自然的视线、过度的露出、过度的美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手脚融合、服装破损、鞋子变形、漂浮、不自然的引力、错误的透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、文字乱码、标志、水印。

制作一张 2:3 竖版现代高级角色时装设定海报，整体气质为时装杂志编辑页、品牌 lookbook、角色服装开发板的结合体。画面呈现干净、克制、真实、柔和、精致的现代时尚视觉，具有奢侈品牌联名大片与高级服装设计档案页的质感。

主体为《海贼王》里的娜美真人 cosplay 高级时装重释版本。人物是一位 20 多岁的东亚成年女性，五官精致明亮，带有日韩高级 cosplay 写真感，融合日式角色写真集的活力清爽与韩式时尚大片的修长比例。她穿着基于娜美完整角色造型重新设计的全套服装：保留橙色长发、航海士身份、蓝橙配色、清爽上装、修身下装、贝壳或海洋符号、记录指针、航海图、天候棒与聪明灵动的角色气质。

服装设计以橙色、海蓝、白色、浅金与少量牛仔蓝为主。上身采用高级度假风短上装或修身背心结构，加入精致边线、海洋纹样和金属扣饰。下装结合高腰短裙、裙裤、轻盈开衩长裙或高级牛仔结构，搭配细带鞋履或时装靴。整体通过清爽剪裁、收束腰线、轻盈层次、腿部线条、海洋纹样和航海配饰，呈现聪明、自由、明亮、性感但不轻浮的角色气质。

人物为整张画面的主视觉核心，完整全身入镜，从头发到鞋尖清晰可见，人物高度占画面约 92% 到 96%。站姿为高级时装大片式自然站姿，单腿承重，轻微侧身，肩胯关系自然，身体线条流畅，神态自信灵动，带一点俏皮和掌控感，像品牌主视觉模特。

背景为真实现代高端时装展示空间，接近极简品牌秀场、时装陈列厅或现代展览式 showroom。空间明亮、干净、柔和，有浅色墙面、弧形建筑轮廓、细腻地面反射、轻微景深与真实空间纵深。光线为现代商业时装摄影灯光，柔和主光照亮人物面部、橙色发丝、服装层次和鞋履，轻微轮廓光分离身体边缘，整体呈现真实品牌大片质感。

版式采用“整幅人物主视觉 + 杂志编辑式环绕分块”。线稿模块围绕人物分布在画面四周，数量控制在 6 到 7 块，大小错落，排布均衡。线稿分块采用高级服装设计稿风格，以精细黑灰线稿、淡灰素描排线、局部极淡色块、纸面纹理、少量手写感注释为主。分块底色以高级米白、暖白纸色为主，局部加入浅海蓝、浅橙、柔白、淡金色，形成明亮统一的色彩节奏。

分块内容包括：主服装结构设计稿、上装与腰线设计稿、裙装或高腰下装结构稿、鞋履结构稿、记录指针与航海配饰草图、天候棒或海洋符号设计稿、牛仔、缎面或薄纱材质局部稿。局部加入极小号色板或配色小样，使页面更像真正的时装开发页。

左上区域加入品牌联名字样与标题排版：
“ONE PIECE”
“X”
“NAMI”
标题“NAMI”使用大号优雅衬线体，呈现时装品牌海报质感。加入小号文字水印“0xkyne”。副标题可使用：
“Navigator in Blue”

整张画面强调“真实时装成片 + 高级设计稿环绕 + 品牌专题排版”的统一效果。人物保持最强视觉焦点，线稿模块作为时尚化、设计化、编辑化的信息辅助层。

items.title: 超现实产品摄影与黑色手绘涂鸦创意广告

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded product image as the primary reference.

Preserve the original product exactly as shown, including its packaging design, logo placement, typography, branding elements, colors, proportions, materials, textures, reflections, shadows, product shape, food appearance, beverage appearance, ingredients, label details, and overall brand identity.

DO NOT redesign, simplify, reinterpret, replace, crop, distort, recolor, or modify any packaging, logos, branding, structural details, or label elements. The product must remain 100% photorealistic and completely unchanged.

Transform the product into the hero of a premium commercial advertising campaign while keeping the product itself entirely realistic.

Before generating the scene, intelligently analyze the product's category, purpose, flavor, ingredients, packaging style, brand personality, color palette, and emotional appeal.

Based on that analysis, automatically develop a fun, playful, visually engaging concept that feels naturally connected to the product.

Choose an activity that authentically reinforces the product's identity, usage occasion, lifestyle, season, flavor, or personality—never something random or disconnected.

Automatically generate matching doodle props that support the chosen activity and strengthen the visual storytelling.

Select a clean pastel studio background inspired by the dominant colors of the product packaging and branding, ensuring strong visual harmony while maintaining enough contrast for the product to remain the clear focal point.

Position the product in a dynamic tilted pose that conveys movement, energy, and personality.

Surround the product with playful hand-drawn doodle illustrations created using loose black marker lines.

Illustrate ONLY the following as doodles:
- Arms
- Hands
- Legs
- Shoes
- Facial expression (only if appropriate)
- Activity props
- Motion lines
- Speed lines
- Swirls
- Impact effects
- Decorative doodles

Keep the product itself completely photorealistic.

All doodles must share the same hand-drawn black marker style with consistent line weight, slightly imperfect strokes, expressive energy, and a fun mascot-like personality.

Generate additional decorative doodles that naturally complement the chosen concept, such as leaves, stars, bubbles, sparkles, confetti, splashes, crumbs, petals, clouds, geometric shapes, or other relevant elements.

Add realistic, soft floating shadows beneath the product to create convincing depth.

Use premium commercial product photography lighting with soft diffused studio illumination, realistic reflections, subtle shadows, shallow depth of field, premium retouching, and luxury advertising quality.

Leave generous negative space suitable for marketing headlines, branding, or promotional copy.

The final artwork should feel like a world-class advertising campaign that seamlessly combines ultra-realistic commercial product photography with playful hand-drawn doodle illustrations, contemporary graphic design, dynamic storytelling, premium branding, minimalist composition, and mascot-style personality.

Quality: Ultra-realistic, premium commercial photography, playful doodle illustration, modern advertising campaign, editorial quality, clean composition, crisp details, highly detailed, 8K.

Creative Direction:

Do NOT choose the first obvious idea.

Instead, approach the image as an award-winning commercial art director creating a premium social media campaign for the product.

Invent a unique, memorable, emotionally engaging concept that feels fresh and distinctive.

The activity, doodle props, and decorative elements should be clever, unexpected, and perfectly aligned with the product's branding, personality, and intended audience.

Every generated image should be visually unique while remaining fully consistent with the product's identity.

Avoid repeating the same poses, activities, props, layouts, or compositions across different products

prompts.text:
使用上传的产品图像作为主要参考。

完全按照原样保留原始产品，包括其包装设计、徽标位置、排版、品牌元素、颜色、比例、材料、纹理、反射、阴影、产品形状、食物外观、饮料外观、成分、标签细节和整体品牌标识。

请勿重新设计、简化、重新解释、替换、裁剪、变形、重新着色或修改任何包装、徽标、品牌、结构细节或标签元素。产品必须保持100%写实且完全不变。

将产品转化为高端商业广告活动的中心，同时保持产品本身完全真实。

在生成场景之前，智能分析产品的类别、用途、风味、成分、包装风格、品牌个性、调色板和情感吸引力。

基于该分析，自动开发一个有趣、俏皮、具有视觉吸引力且感觉与产品自然连接的概念。

选择一种能真实强化产品身份、使用场合、生活方式、季节、风味或个性的活动——绝不是随机或脱节的内容。

自动生成与所选活动匹配的涂鸦道具，以支持视觉叙事。

选择灵感源自产品包装和品牌主色的干净柔和色调影棚背景，确保强烈的视觉和谐，同时保持足够的对比度以使产品保持为清晰的焦点。

将产品置于传达运动、能量和个性的动态倾斜姿态中。

使用松散的黑色马克笔线条创作的俏皮手绘涂鸦插画包围产品。

仅将以下内容插画为涂鸦：
- 手臂
- 手
- 腿
- 鞋子
- 面部表情（仅在适当时）
- 活动道具
- 运动线
- 速度线
- 漩涡
- 冲击效果
- 装饰性涂鸦

保持产品本身完全写实。

所有涂鸦必须共享相同的手绘黑色马克笔风格，具有一致的线条粗细、略微不完美的笔触、富有表现力的活力和有趣的吉祥物般个性。

生成额外的装饰性涂鸦，自然地补充所选概念，例如叶子、星星、气泡、闪光、彩纸、溅沫、碎屑、花瓣、云朵、几何形状或其他相关元素。

在产品下方添加真实的软漂浮阴影，以创造令人信服的深度。

使用高端商业产品摄影照明，具有柔和的扩散影棚光照、真实的反射、细微的阴影、浅景深、高级修图和奢侈广告质量。

留出足够的负空间，适用于营销标题、品牌宣传或促销文案。

最终作品应感觉像是一个世界级的广告活动，将超写实的商业产品摄影与俏皮的手绘涂鸦插画、当代平面设计、动态叙事、高端品牌、极简构图和吉祥物风格个性无缝结合。

质量：超写实，高端商业摄影，俏皮涂鸦插画，现代广告活动，编辑质量，干净的构图，锐利的细节，高度详细，8K。

创意方向：

不要选择第一个明显的想法。

相反，以获奖商业艺术总监的角度为该产品创作一个高端社交媒体活动。

创造一个独特、难忘、具有情感吸引力且感觉新颖独特的情境。

活动、涂鸦道具和装饰元素应该是聪明、意想不到的，并与产品的品牌、个性和目标受众完美契合。

生成的每一张图像都应该是视觉上独特的，同时与产品的身份保持完全一致。

避免在不同产品中重复相同的姿势、活动、道具、布局或构图。

items.title: 鱼眼镜头下日本街头穿校服的年轻女性

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded reference face as the identity of the subject while preserving facial features consistently.

An ultra-realistic nighttime street portrait captured with an 8mm circular fisheye lens, creating an extreme 180-degree field of view with strong edge distortion and a perfectly circular black vignette framing the entire image.

A beautiful young East Asian woman wearing a Japanese school uniform consisting of a black blazer, white shirt, loose red necktie, brown plaid pleated skirt, white crew socks, and glossy black leather loafers. She is standing on the corner of a large zebra crossing in the middle of a vibrant modern Japanese city at night.

The camera is positioned approximately 1.2 meters (4 feet) above the ground, slightly above the subject's eye level, angled downward around 20 degrees, making the head appear naturally larger while the legs and surroundings stretch dramatically because of the ultra-wide fisheye perspective.

The subject stands near the bottom-center of the frame, body turned about 35 degrees away from the camera, with her head rotated back toward the lens, making direct eye contact with a calm, neutral expression. One hand is casually inside the blazer pocket while the other arm rests naturally by her side.

The entire body including shoes is fully visible. Behind her is a wide multi-directional pedestrian crossing filled with people walking in every direction. Tall commercial buildings covered with colorful illuminated Japanese signs, LED billboards, shop windows, restaurants, and glowing city lights surround the intersection.

Wet asphalt with realistic texture, bright white crosswalk markings, detailed sidewalk tiles, tactile yellow paving blocks, and authentic urban street details. The background remains sharp with deep depth of field, preserving architectural detail across the entire scene.

Soft cinematic nighttime lighting from neon signs, storefronts, traffic lights, and street lamps produces realistic reflections, subtle skin highlights, and balanced exposure with no blown highlights.

Hyper-realistic photography, Sony A7R V, 8mm f/3.5 circular fisheye lens, ISO 1250, f/5.6, 1/100 sec, HDR, ultra-sharp focus, natural skin texture, realistic hair strands, highly detailed clothing fabric, photorealistic, professional street photography, 8K, no text, no watermark, no logo, no motion blur, no extra limbs, no cropped feet, no duplicate people, no AI artifacts. Perfect circular fisheye frame, extreme optical barrel distortion, full-body centered composition, authentic Tokyo night street photography, premium editorial quality, extremely realistic, RAW photo.

items.title: OZOUO果饮品牌零售视觉应用板

prompts.text:
Create the fourth image of the unified brand visual system for “OZOUO” fruit drinks, keeping exactly the same brand identity, mascot illustration style, typography system, 225ml can proportion, lychee flavor hero design, and overall color DNA as the established OZOUO visual system. This image must serve a new responsibility: a retail touchpoint and brand-extension application board, not a packaging sheet, not a flavor lineup poster, and not a broad campaign collage.

Core role:
This image should show how the OZOUO brand system extends into real consumer touchpoints, including point-of-sale materials, retail-ready packaging extensions, fridge display, branded lifestyle accessories, and human interaction moments. It should feel like a polished brand application board for a modern beverage launch.

Overall composition:
Use a clean multi-panel layout on a soft warm beige or creamy neutral background, with 5 or 6 sections arranged in a tidy brand-presentation collage. Each panel should feel visually distinct but clearly belong to the same OZOUO world. The whole image must remain calm, premium, playful, and highly coherent.

Brand consistency:
Keep exactly the same OZOUO identity system:
same “OZOUO” wordmark,
same lychee hero flavor,
same adult-oriented cartoon lychee mascot,
same 225ml compact can design,
same creamy base + lychee pink + deep brown typography,
same “PEEL THE MOOD” tone of voice,
same balance between cute and grown-up.
Everything must clearly feel like one brand.

Suggested panel structure:

Panel 1:
Branded print materials such as postcards, flyers, mini posters, or brand cards laid flat in a neat presentation. Use the same OZOUO logo, lychee mascot, and creamy-pink color system. The style should feel simple, graphic, and collectible.

Panel 2:
A compact retail multipack or gift carton designed for the OZOUO 225ml cans. Show a realistic branded paper carrier or small boxed set using the same mascot and typography system. It should feel commercially believable and shelf-ready.

Panel 3:
A refrigerated retail shelf display with multiple OZOUO lychee cans lined up neatly inside a cooler. The cans should look cold, fresh, slightly condensed, and highly recognizable. This panel demonstrates shelf impact and retail visibility.

Panel 4:
A stylish young adult holding or presenting an OZOUO can in a natural lifestyle moment. Keep the person fashionable, modern, and brand-appropriate, with the can clearly visible. The mood should feel social, confident, and urban, not like a generic stock photo.

Panel 5:
A branded tote bag, shopping bag, or soft lifestyle accessory using the OZOUO visual system. The bag should feel trendy, useful, and premium, extending the brand into daily life. Use the logo and mascot in a more graphic, simplified way.

Optional Panel 6:
A small point-of-sale or countertop display, sticker sheet, shelf wobblers, or branded cooler decal system, proving the OZOUO design language works across retail details.

Visual tone:
The board should feel more practical and retail-facing than the previous campaign image. It must communicate how OZOUO appears in real purchase environments and branded consumer touchpoints. Each panel should be simple, strong, and brand-consistent.

Typography:

Main composition:
Place one realistic bottle of Yellow Tail Merlot exactly at the center as the absolute hero object. The bottle must be highly realistic and unmistakably Yellow Tail: deep merlot-red wine glow, crisp label, iconic yellow kangaroo mark clearly visible, elegant foil capsule, glossy glass reflections, realistic shadow, and premium wine-bottle rendering. The bottle must be the only fully realistic object in the image.

Background:
Use a very clean warm ivory or pale cream textured paper background with generous negative space. The paper should feel premium and lightly tactile, like an artist’s poster sheet. Keep the background open and uncluttered.

Core visual system:
Around the bottle, create a hand-drawn black-ink exploration route that wraps and travels around the bottle like a map-based adventure path. The line art should not behave like a decorative frame or random doodles. It must feel like a drawn route map unfolding around the bottle, with winding paths, directional arrows, signposts, handwritten labels, route marks, tiny icons, and small illustrated discoveries placed along the journey.

Exploration-route storytelling:
Make the bottle feel like the key landmark in the middle of an Australian wine adventure map. Along the route, integrate small hand-drawn symbols and discoveries related to Yellow Tail and Australian Merlot identity:
leaping kangaroo icon,
vineyard hills,
grape clusters,
eucalyptus sprigs,
sun symbols,
wine barrels,
harvest crate,
country road marks,
southern stars,
tiny birds,
wine glass icon,
open plains,
small cellar sketch,
route arrows,
distance marks,
handwritten place notes,
little exploration badges,
“stop here” or “discover this” style sign graphics.
The drawings should feel lively, curious, slightly playful, and full of discovery.

Layout behavior:
The route should move around the bottle in a dynamic way, as if circling and guiding the eye across the page. Some parts can curve behind the bottle, some can run beside it, some can create mini stops around top left, right side, lower side, and bottom areas. The composition should feel like a hand-drawn travel/adventure map centered on the bottle. Do not make the line art symmetrical or evenly distributed. Let it feel exploratory and organic.

Style:
The line art should be crisp black ink with a premium hand-drawn identity feel, combining route-map graphics, handwritten signage, and light illustrative storytelling. Add a subtle Art Nouveau influence only in the flowing vine curves and rhythmic line movement, but keep the overall feeling modern, clean, and brand-driven.

Color system:
warm ivory paper background,
deep merlot red bottle,
black ink route illustration,
small Yellow Tail signature yellow accents,
tiny touches of vineyard green only if necessary.
Keep the palette highly restrained so the bottle remains the most saturated and realistic focal point.

Integrate typography into the route-map world rather than using a standard ad layout. Use small elegant hand-drawn or poster-style phrases woven into the exploration route, such as:
“YELLOW TAIL”
“MERLOT”
“LEAP INTO RED”
“EXPLORE THE TASTE”
“AUSTRALIA IN A BOTTLE”
These text fragments should feel like route labels, signposts, or little discovery notes around the bottle.

Optional subtle Chinese text can be integrated in a similarly restrained way:

“澳洲风味探索”
“沿着果香一路前行”
Keep Chinese minimal, refined, and secondary.

clean, graphic, adventurous, Australian, lively, route-based, exploratory, premium, collectible, high-contrast, hand-drawn, fresh, intelligent, brand-driven.

hyper-detailed realistic wine bottle, crisp black ink route drawing, premium textured paper background, elegant negative space, subtle paper shadows, luxury campaign poster quality, 8k, visually unforgettable.

prompts.text:
Generate a high-contrast visual poster around any theme subject: the visual first perceives large blocks of dark negative space and an ultra-bold sans-serif title in the top left corner, with the title using tight line spacing and hard line breaks to form an oppressive first level; the main content is disassembled into a row of highlighted vertical light windows or partition compartments, each compartment carrying theme-derived characters, objects, or symbolic forms like stage backlighting, with only clear black silhouettes and edge outlines retained in the foreground, details hidden in backlighting, allowing identity, sense of order, and suspense to be conveyed through outlines rather than realistic expressions. Add a mirrored floor or dark reflection strip below, where reflections are elongated, darkened, and slightly blurred, giving the image a ritualized stage depth; the outer layer can have a restrained dark information box or boundary line, with a small amount of short labels in the top right corner, miniature descriptions on the side, and local name-style information layers inside, text using white or theme-derived light colors as high-readability information colors, and a small amount of emotional color used only for small-area emphasis. Colors are extracted from the theme's own material, emotion, or brand semantics, retaining a relationship of large-area clear dark backgrounds, clear high-saturation glowing primary colors, minimal light-colored text, and clean dark-to-light steps, forming a calm, sharp, and dramatic tech stage mood; primary colors are responsible for emotion and backlighting, dark colors for structure and negative space, and light colors only for reading, without using muddy gray-brown, distressed stains, or cluttered gradients. The overall texture has slight film grain, shadow noise, and sharp edges, with the composition leaving wide dark areas for the information layer to breathe, avoiding filling the compartments with details, the final effect should be like a precisely choreographed backlit launch event, with the theme disassembled into a rhythmic silhouette matrix and strong information hierarchy.

——————
Desired visual: Innovation project core team debut, several members sitting in front of red backlit windows, retaining only clear silhouettes.
Usage for launch event: Suitable as a new product launch or team introduction poster, title retains large-character sense of oppression.
Additional requirements: Add OUR TEAM short label in the top right corner, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.

Arrange the fragrance-note ingredients in a restrained, spread-out, flat-lay-inspired composition around the bottle, not as a wreath, not as a bouquet, and not as a dense decorative frame. prompts.text:

Wearing a white to ivory fine-ribbed knit cardigan, slightly open at the front. Underneath is a black simple camisole, and the bottom is gray high-waisted loose trousers. A small light gray shoulder bag is carried on one shoulder. The body is slightly tilted towards the left of the frame, with the back leaning gently against a dark stone wall. The character's own left hand is placed lightly on the back of the head, and the right hand is tucked into the trouser pocket. Fingertips are naturally curved, creating a relaxed difference in center of gravity between the shoulders and waist. An elegant and restrained adult street portrait.

Background / Lighting:
A backstreet in Tokyo at night. Dim building walls, narrow sidewalks, blurred taillights in the distance, sign lights, and circular halos from street lamps. Background text is blurred to the point of being unrecognizable. The road surface is slightly wet, with the reflection of streetlights extending long and thin. A faint white light similar to a flash shines from the front slightly above the left, highlighting the face, white cardigan, and shoulders. The background falls deep and dark, with only the distant halos appearing as warm-colored bokeh.

Composition / Lens:
Vertical composition 4:5. A medium shot from above the waist to above the thighs. The character is placed off-center to the right of the frame, with the left side reserved for the depth of the night road and dark negative space. The camera position is slightly higher than the chest, almost at eye level. The distance between the character and the camera is close, with shallow depth of field in the background. High-quality Japanese photo. Night flash photography style, with a slightly grainy film-like texture. Skin is not overly smoothed, naturally retaining pores and luster. prompts.text:
Afternoon Selfie

Subject:
Centered on an adult woman holding a smartphone taking a selfie in a bright bedroom, using a vertical realistic photo style portrait.

Person · Expression:
A natural and realistic adult woman. Slightly long black hair with a bit of a wet clumped feel, bangs gently resting on her forehead. Her face is slightly tilted toward the camera, and her pupils are looking this way through the phone. There is a sense of calmness between her brows and eyes, and her lips are relaxed into a natural posture. The skin is not over-retouched, with the cheeks and the area around her collarbones bathed in soft indoor light.

Clothing · Pose:
Wearing a white ribbed material cropped camisole, the silhouette naturally fits the body. The chest is not intentionally emphasized, maintaining a mature adult balance. The bottoms are deep indigo denim shorts, with a low-waist design resting at the hip position. The person holds the phone with her right hand, her fingertips naturally fitting the side of the device. Her left hand is placed on a wooden desk at the bottom left of the frame, and her upper body leans slightly forward. Her waist is slightly tilted to one side, with the center of gravity shifted toward one leg.

Background · Light:
A small bedroom with white and beige as the main tones. On the right side of the frame are white curtains and a bed; on the left are a wooden desk and storage shelves, potted plants, a desk lamp, candles, and a blurred seaside photo frame. The main light source comes from the window on the right side of the frame, with soft daylight naturally falling on the right side of her face, her shoulders, and her white top. The desk lamp on the left provides warm auxiliary light, adding a hint of orange temperature to the background. Shadows are soft, naturally extending into the depths of the bed and storage shelves.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical composition. A close-range indoor selfie from above the chest to above the thighs. The person is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, with the phone close to her face. A small amount of negative space is left above the head, and the waist is naturally included in the frame. The camera position is slightly higher than eye level, looking down slightly. The background uses a shallow depth of field for soft blurring, with the focus concentrated on the person's face, hair, phone, and upper body.

Texture · Style:
Realistic photographic expression. Skin retains natural pores and soft texture, and hair incorporates fine clumped details and luster. The white ribbed fabric, the thickness of the denim, the wooden desk, and the softness of the bed sheets are each clearly distinguishable. The color tone blends warm indoor light with elegant daylight, creating a natural atmosphere. Avoid excessive skin-beautifying retouching or a CG feel, retaining the intimacy and daily life atmosphere of a smartphone photo.

主体：
以一位在明亮卧室中手持智能手机自拍的成年女性为中心，采用纵向的真实照片风格肖像。

自然且富有现实感的大人女性。稍长的黑发带着些许湿润的束状感，刘海轻轻搭在额前。脸庞略微向镜头倾斜，瞳孔透过手机看向这边。眉眼间透着平静，嘴唇放松成自然的姿态。肌肤不过度修饰，脸颊和锁骨周围沐浴在柔和的室内光线中。

身穿白色罗纹材质的裁剪吊带背心，轮廓自然贴合身体。胸口不刻意强调，保持成熟大人的平衡感。下装是深靛蓝牛仔短裤，低腰设计停在臀部位置。人物用自己的右手握住手机，指尖自然贴合设备侧边。左手置于画面左下方的木质书桌上，上半身微微前倾。腰部略微斜向一侧，重心偏向单腿。

背景·光线：
以白色和米色为主调的小型卧室。画面右侧有白色窗帘和床铺，左侧有木质书桌和置物架、盆栽植物、台灯、蜡烛，以及一幅模糊的海边照片相框。主光源来自画面右侧的窗户，柔和的日光自然洒在脸庞右侧、肩膀和白色上衣上。画面左侧的台灯提供温暖的辅助光线，为背景增添一丝橙色温度。阴影柔和，向床铺和置物架深处自然延伸。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图。从胸部上方至大腿上方纳入的近距离室内自拍。人物位于画面中央略偏右，手机靠近脸庞。头顶上方留出少许余白，腰部自然纳入框架。镜头位置略高于视线，轻微俯视。背景采用浅景深柔和虚化，焦点集中在人物的脸庞、头发、手机和上半身上。

prompts.text:
Generate a calm, authoritative, and information-clear commemorative visual around any subject: The screen first reads the small and sparse identification and the eye-catching time span or theme title at the top, then the close-up main figure in the middle. The main figure is pressed to one side of the screen with a clean cutout or refined photographic texture, with clear edges and a stable expression or posture, forming a trustworthy public expression. The background uses a large area of clear color fields derived from the theme, retaining bright and clean high-brightness layers and slight gradients, letting the main color bear the order and emotion; the dark parts are only used to support the subject and the bottom information, keeping it optically clean, without old, ashy, or dirty treatment. Enlarge the most important keywords, commemorative numbers, or core concepts in the theme into semi-transparent giant word shadows, sinking into the background and partially blocked by the main figure. The font is heavy, the edges are hard, and the transparency is restrained, creating a sense of pressure and memory points where "text becomes a space wall." The information layout adopts a corporate annual report style order: small letter spacing or subtitles at the top to leave room for breathing, the largest title placed in the upper middle, a name/identity/description text group set next to the main figure with a narrow emphasis line as a visual anchor, and a longer statement text at the bottom with loose line spacing, distinct font weights, and mainly left-aligned. Colors are extracted from the material, industry attributes, and emotions of the theme itself, mapped into large areas of clear main colors, low-proportion dark structural layers, bright light-colored text, and a small amount of high-saturation emphasis lines, maintaining a calm, precise, clean, and solemn emotion; the overall texture is like high-end corporate commemorative communication, with fine grain and soft halos in the background, a real and sharp subject, and clear text hierarchy, avoiding cluttered decoration and excessive dramatization.

——————
Change the screen to: 10th anniversary commemorative poster of an auto brand merger, retaining executive portraits, year span, and giant commemorative word shadows.
Publishing scene: Corporate WeChat public account, official Weibo anniversary review images.
Necessary text: Highlight "2016-2026" and "Ten Years Together," size using horizontal 16:9.

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium commercial poster for Oreo, with a composition closely matching a classic central trophy-advertising layout. The image must be built around one dominant hero object: a modern FIFA World Cup trophy silhouette reimagined in Oreo material language. The overall poster should feel saturated, clean, explosive, luxurious, and immediately readable at first glance.

Main composition:
Use a strict vertical hero composition.
Top center: Oreo logo, small but clear.
Center: one large trophy occupying most of the poster height, clearly the absolute focal point.
Bottom center: one strong campaign slogan in bold clean typography.
The entire design must feel symmetrical, stable, and iconic, with the trophy as the visual core and all secondary elements orbiting around it.

Trophy scale and proportion:
The trophy must be tall, elegant, and dominant, taking about 60 to 70 percent of the full composition height. Its silhouette must follow the exact modern FIFA World Cup trophy form:
rounded globe top,
two upward flowing support forms,
narrow tapering lower body,
circular pedestal base.
The trophy silhouette must read instantly and cleanly from a distance.

Material logic:
The trophy is formed primarily from silky white Oreo cream fluid, wrapped tightly around the exact World Cup trophy form. The cream should feel smooth, glossy, thick, and luxurious, with high-end fluid tension and sculptural wrapping motion.
Oreo cookies appear as embedded accents and supportive fragments, not as the main body material.
Use:
whole Oreo cookies,
partial Oreo halves,
dark cocoa crumbs,
tiny cream bursts.
The cream is the main sculptural mass; the cookies are the identity accents.

Cookie size balance:
The Oreo cookies around the trophy must be carefully scaled and balanced.
Do not make the floating cookies too large.
Do not let foreground cookies overpower the trophy.
Use only a few medium and small Oreo cookies orbiting around the trophy, with restrained variation in size.
The largest cookie accent may appear near the base, but it must still remain secondary to the trophy.
The trophy should always feel visually larger, heavier, and more important than any cookie element.

Explosion logic:
The energy should erupt outward from the trophy itself, like a championship moment frozen in time.
Use a controlled burst of silky cream splashes, crumbs, and Oreo fragments around the center.
The splash must support the trophy silhouette, not destroy it.
The composition should feel explosive but still clean and highly readable.

Base:
The pedestal should be clean, centered, and premium, with Oreo blue, dark cocoa, and white cream details. It should anchor the trophy visually and strengthen the championship feeling without becoming overly complex.

Background:
Use a rich high-saturation Oreo championship blue background, clean and slightly luminous, with a subtle arena-light atmosphere if needed. Keep the background simple enough so the center trophy remains dominant. No cluttered stadium scene.

Lighting:
Use glossy premium commercial lighting.
Strong highlights on the cream,
rich shadows in the Oreo cookie texture,
clear rim light around the trophy silhouette,
clean separation from the blue background.
The fluid should look ultra-real, silky, and sculptural.

Typography:
Keep typography centered and clean.
Top:
“OREO”
Bottom:
“DUNK YOUR WAY TO GLORY”
Optional Chinese:
“奥利奥”
“冠军级夹心爆发”
Typography must feel bold, premium, and campaign-ready, without too much copy.

Mood:
iconic, victorious, saturated, clean, premium, balanced, explosive, luxurious, globally commercial, unforgettable.

Rendering:
hyper-detailed silky cream fluid simulation, exact modern FIFA World Cup trophy silhouette, realistic Oreo cookie texture, premium Oreo-blue background, balanced cookie scale, strong centered composition, luxury commercial lighting, 8k, world-class advertising quality.

Negative prompt:
oversized floating cookies, weak trophy dominance, messy composition, broken trophy readability, too many cookie fragments, off-center layout, thin watery cream, wrong trophy silhouette, Jules Rimet cup shape, cluttered stadium background, cartoon style, low realism, excessive props

items.title: 晨光之白木框大玻璃门背影肖像

prompts.text:
Theme:
White of Morning Light

Main Subject:
A vertical portrait of an adult female with her back to the camera, standing before a large wood-framed glass door, bathed in the morning light pouring in from the courtyard, gazing at the tranquility outside.

Figure/Expression:
A natural and realistic adult female. Hair in a low, casual bun with a few stray strands falling by the neck and ears. The face is hardly shown, retaining only a hint of the profile silhouette turned slightly to the right. Her gaze is directed towards the bright courtyard through the open glass door. Shoulders are relaxed, in a silent pose as if the moment before inhaling the morning air.

Clothing/Pose:
Wearing a pale ivory maxi dress with a sheer, lightweight gauzy shawl over the shoulders. The back design is wide open but with a natural skin-toned lining inside, creating an elegant and lifestyle visual effect. Thin straps meet loosely in the middle of the back, and the shawl cuffs are fluffy and spread out. The right hand is placed lightly on the open wooden frame, fingertips slightly curved. The left arm hangs naturally at her side, slightly pulling the thin fabric close. Weight is on the right foot, with the left foot half a step back, causing the body to turn slightly. The hem of the dress spreads softly on the wooden floor, with the morning breeze slightly swaying the edges of the fabric.

Background/Lighting:
A tranquil interior of an antique-style Japanese residence. Wooden floors, slim wood-framed glass doors, thin white curtains on the right, with a small courtyard, low walls, potted plants, and light green garden trees visible deep in the scene. The light is soft morning sunlight seeping in from the outdoors at the top left of the frame. It illuminates the back, shoulders, and the edges of the shawl, revealing the delicate texture of the fabric fibers. The interior is slightly dim, while the outer courtyard is bright but not overexposed. Shadows of the wooden frame and curtains fall obliquely on the floor, with faint reflections remaining on the glass.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical composition. The figure stands slightly to the right of the center, captured from head to hem. The horizontal and vertical lines of the glass door naturally divide the frame, guiding the eye to the back of the figure and the open doorway. Shot from nearly eye-level at a position slightly higher than the waist. Focus is placed on the upper body and the light-transmitting fabric, with the courtyard trees and walls softly blurred. Utilizes the contrast between the dim interior and the outdoor morning light to maintain a peaceful backlit atmosphere.

Texture/Style:
Photography style. Skin has a natural texture, avoiding excessive beautification. Delicately depicts the fibers of the sheer gauze, the glimmer of the wooden floor, the soft shadows of the curtains, and the mistiness and reflections of the glass. The main color palette consists of ivory white, light beige, woody brown, and soft garden green. The overall effect creates a calm morning atmosphere with plenty of negative space, similar to magazine photography.

Negative Prompt:
Nudity, explicit expressions, excessive transparency, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands/feet, deformed joints, distorted prop contact, floating, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

prompts.text:
主题：
晨光之白

主体：
以一位成年女性背对镜头，在木框大玻璃门前，沐浴庭院洒入的晨光，凝视外界的宁静纵向肖像。

人物·表情：
自然而富有真实感的成年女性。发型为低位的随意发髻，颈侧与耳边垂落几缕细碎发丝。脸部几乎不露，仅保留一丝向右侧微转的侧脸轮廓。视线投向敞开玻璃门外、庭院的明亮处。肩头放松，仿佛正于吸入晨间空气前一刻的静默姿态。

服饰·姿势：
身着淡象牙白的及长连衣裙，外披透视感轻薄纱质披肩。背部设计大开，但内搭接近肤色的自然内里，营造优雅且生活化的视觉效果。细肩带在背中松散交汇，披肩袖口蓬松舒展。人物右手轻置于敞开的木框上，指尖微微弯曲。左臂自然垂于身侧，略微拉近薄布。重心置于右足，左足半步后撤，令身体稍稍斜转。裙摆在木质地板上柔和铺展，晨风拂动布边微微摇曳。

背景·光线：
仿古日式住宅的宁静室内。木质地板、细木框玻璃门、右侧薄白窗帘，画面深处可见小庭院、低矮围墙、盆栽及浅绿庭木。光线为画面左上方户外渗入的柔和晨曦。照亮背部、肩头与披肩边缘，透出布料纤维的细腻纹理。室内略显昏暗，外侧庭院明亮却不过曝。地板上斜落木框与窗帘的影子，玻璃上残留极淡反射。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图。人物站于中央稍偏右位，自头部至裙摆全身入镜。玻璃门的纵横线条自然分割画面，引导视线汇聚于人物背影与敞开门扉。镜头自腰部稍高位置近乎平视拍摄。焦点置于人物上半身与透光布料，庭院树木与围墙柔和虚化。活用室内昏暗与户外晨光的对比，保留宁静的逆光氛围。

质感·风格：
摄影风格。肌肤呈自然质感，避免过度美肤修饰。细腻描绘薄纱纤维、木地板微光、窗帘柔影、玻璃的雾感和反射。以象牙白、浅米色、木质棕与庭院柔绿为主色调。整体营造沉静的晨间气息，如杂志摄影般留白十足。

负面提示：
裸露、露骨性表达、过度透视、不自然面部、不自然视线、多余手指、缺失手指、手足融合、关节变形、道具接触失真、漂浮、不自然重力、错误透视法、与光源矛盾的影子、文字乱码、标志、水印、过度美肤修饰、塑料般肌肤。

items.title: 阳光沐浴的午后室内女性肖像

prompts.text:
Theme:
Sun-bathed afternoon

Subject:
In an elegant interior, soft sunlight spills in diagonally. A woman in her 20s leans against a plush, long-pile beige sofa, with her as the center, presenting a vertical portrait. She lightly holds a small red fruit in one hand, and a small saucer sits by her feet, with several of the same red fruits on it.

Character and Expression:
The woman gives a calm and mature impression. Shoulder-length loose brown wavy hair with thin bangs softly hanging over her forehead. Her face is slightly turned toward the camera, her gaze looking directly into the center of the lens. Her eyes and brows are soft, her mouth slightly open, creating a quiet and intimate atmosphere. Her skin is smooth but not over-retouched, with natural rosy color retained on her cheeks and lips.

Clothing and Pose:
Wearing a light champagne-beige satin slip dress. The neckline is a shallow V-shape decorated with lace, revealing delicate luster and the natural drape of the fabric. Paired with white lace-trimmed knee-high socks. Body leaning against the sofa, using her right hand pressed on the sofa surface behind her to support her upper body, while her left hand gently pinches a small red fruit near her face. Her legs stretch forward with one knee slightly raised, creating a sense of depth. Hair strands naturally fall on her shoulders and chest, and the hem of the dress folds softly over her legs.

Background and Lighting:
The interior walls are cream to ivory tones, decorated with exquisite decorative moldings, creating a high-end sense of space. Warm afternoon natural light spills diagonally from a window in the upper left of the frame, casting bright highlights on the top of her hair, forehead, cheeks, chest, thighs, and the sofa fur. The light is slightly soft direct light, with shadows falling naturally toward the bottom right of the frame. The background is bright and melts into a soft blur, with the red fruits serving as small accent colors against the beige and ivory base.

Composition and Lens:
Vertical composition. A mid-close range portrait looking down from a slightly high angle, with the subject positioned center-right in the frame. The face is in the middle of the upper half, and the legs extend significantly forward, emphasizing the sense of distance. Captured from the upper body to near the tips of the feet, extensively showing the enveloping texture of the sofa. The small saucer at her feet is placed at the bottom of the frame, small in size. Focus is on the face and hands, with the background and surroundings softly blurred with a shallow depth of field.

Texture and Style:
Realistic photographic expression. Warm-toned natural light, low contrast, a sense of soft backlighting, and fine film grain. The silky reflection of satin, the fine weave of lace, the fluffy pile of the sofa, and the natural touch of skin should all be meticulously depicted. The overall design uses a gentle and elegant color palette of beige, cream, and honey tones. Completed as an indoor portrait conveying tranquility and warmth.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, deformed joints, distorted or broken clothing, poor contact with props, floating, unnatural gravity, shadows with contradictory light sources, excessive skin retouching, overly youthful face, too much background information, garbled text, logos, watermarks; characters, clothing, background, fruit placement, exact pose, or exact composition from reference images, do not copy directly.

prompts.text:
主题：
阳光沐浴的午后

主体：
在优雅的室内，柔和的阳光斜斜洒入，20多岁的女性倚靠在毛长绒软的米色沙发上，以她为中心，呈现一幅纵向肖像。她一只手中轻轻握着一颗小小的红色果实，脚边放着一只小碟子，上面摆放着几颗同样的红色果实。

人物·表情：
女性给人一种沉稳而成熟的印象。及肩的深棕色松散波浪发，前额轻柔地垂着薄薄的刘海。脸庞略微正面对准镜头，目光直视镜头的中央。眉眼柔和，嘴角微微张开，营造出宁静而亲密的氛围。肌肤光滑却不过分修饰，脸颊和唇部保留自然的红润血色。

服装·姿势：
身着浅香槟米色的缎面吊带裙。领口为浅V形，饰以蕾丝装饰，显露出细腻的光泽与布料的自然垂坠感。搭配白色蕾丝边的及膝长袜。身体倚靠在沙发上，用自己的右手撑在沙发后方座面上支撑上身，左手在脸庞附近轻捏一颗小小的红色果实。双腿向前伸展，一膝微抬，营造出纵深感。发丝自然垂落于肩头与胸前，衣裙下摆在腿部上方柔柔褶起。

背景·光线：
室内墙面为奶油色至象牙白调，饰以精致的装饰线条，营造出高雅的空间感。画面左上方的窗户斜斜洒入温暖的午后自然光，在发顶、前额、脸颊、胸前、大腿以及沙发绒毛上投下明亮的高光。光线为略带柔和的直射光，阴影向画面右下方自然落下。背景明亮而如融化般柔和模糊，在米色与象牙白的基调中，红色果实成为小小的点缀色彩。

纵向构图。从略微上方俯视的中近距离肖像，人物置于画面中央偏右的位置。脸部位于上半部中段，双腿向前方大幅延伸，强调远近感。从上半身至腿尖附近入镜，广泛展现沙发包裹般的质感。脚边的小碟子置于画面下部，尺寸较小。焦点对准脸部与手部，背景及周边以浅景深柔和模糊。

真实摄影表现。偏暖色调的自然光、低对比度、柔和的逆光感，以及细腻的胶片颗粒。缎面的丝滑反射、蕾丝的精细编织、沙发的蓬松绒毛、肌肤的自然触感，皆需细致描绘。整体以米色、奶油色、蜂蜜调为主的温和优雅色调设计。作为一幅感受宁静与温暖的室内肖像完成。

clean,

retail-ready,
brand-cohesive,
stylish,
fresh,
premium,
commercially believable.

prompts.text:
UNIVERSAL FMCG HERO AD PROMPT™ V2.0

Act as a world-class Creative Director, Luxury Product Photographer, Apple-level Design Director, Brand Strategist, Swiss Typography Expert, Unreal Engine 5 & V-Ray Rendering Artist.

INPUT
Upload one product image only. Automatically detect any product category (electronics, FMCG, cosmetics, food, furniture, appliances, fashion, household items, etc.). No questions or manual settings.

OBJECTIVE
Transform the uploaded product into a premium hero advertisement suitable for Amazon, catalogs, websites, social media, packaging, print, billboards, and product launches.

Preserve 100% of the original product:
- Shape
- Packaging
- Branding
- Logo
- Colors
- Labels
- Materials
- Texture
- Proportions

The product must remain the main hero.

BRANDING
Extract the original logo from the product packaging and recreate it cleanly at the top-left. Never replace or redesign the brand.

COLOR
Automatically derive the background, gradients, accents, and lighting from the product's brand colors for a cohesive premium look.

TEXT
Generate:
• Premium headline
• Short supporting sentence (max 2 lines)
• Four text-only product features placed on the left (no icons).

PRODUCT DISPLAY
Large hero product occupying about 70% of the layout with realistic shadows, subtle floor reflection, luxury perspective, and balanced composition.

BOTTOM GALLERY
Include 4–5 clean product angles (Front, 45°, Side, Back, Top/Close-up) with identical lighting.

BACKGROUND
Apple-inspired minimal luxury studio with soft gradients, natural window shadows, editorial daylight, elegant negative space, subtle reflections, and no clutter, props, patterns, or decorative graphics.

STYLE
Swiss typography (Helvetica Neue, SF Pro, Inter style), clean Apple-inspired layout, premium editorial spacing.

CAMERA & LIGHTING
ARRI Alexa Mini LF, 85mm hero shot, 35mm gallery shots, commercial studio lighting, HDR, ray tracing, global illumination, soft reflections.

QUALITY
Ultra-photorealistic 8K, V-Ray/Octane/Corona/UE5 quality, magazine-ready, catalog-ready, billboard-ready, luxury commercial product photography.

STRICT RULES
Never redesign or modify the product, packaging, branding, logo, labels, or colors. No humans, icons, unnecessary graphics, or fake environments. Keep the product as the absolute hero. Place the original logo at top-left, headline and four features on the left, gallery at the bottom. Use a 4:5 portrait composition with Apple-level minimalism.

担任世界级创意总监、奢侈品产品摄影师、苹果级设计总监、品牌战略师、瑞士排版专家、Unreal Engine 5 和 V-Ray 渲染艺术家。

- 质地

产品必须保持为主要核心。

品牌推广

颜色

• 放置在左侧的四个纯文本产品特性（无图标）。

产品展示

底部画廊
包括 4–5 个干净的产品角度（正面、45°、侧面、背面、顶部/特写），光照一致。

严格规则
切勿重新设计或修改产品、包装、品牌、徽标、标签或颜色。严禁人物、图标、不必要的图形或虚假环境。保持产品作为绝对的核心。将原始徽标放在左上角，标题和四个特性放在左侧，画廊放在底部。使用 4:5 的纵向构图，具备苹果级别的极简主义。

items.title: 极简留白长影构图平面视觉

prompts.text: Generate a minimalist graphic visual with a strong memory point around any theme: the image first reveals a large, bright, clean, almost textureless high-brightness color field. The thematic content is broken down into many very small-scale real silhouettes, symbols, or partial objects, sparsely scattered in the wide white space, maintaining a clear distance from each other to let the sense of vastness be the protagonist. Each small subject must cast an exaggeratedly elongated dark shadow, with the shadows crossing the image in a uniform diagonal direction, much longer than the subjects themselves, forming rhythmic lines more striking than the subjects; locally, a projection of a massive structure can cut in from the edge, showing only a heavy dark shape and a few regular light-transmitting slits, creating a scale contrast and an urban-like sense of oppression. Colors are extracted from the material, emotion, and cultural semantics of the future theme itself, maintaining the role relationship of 'large areas of clear and bright base color, minimal high-contrast dark structures, and tiny thematic color accents.' The overall image remains bright, clean, airy, with clear color gradations, avoiding grayish, dirty, retro yellowing, or muddy color mixing. If informational text appears, it should act as a calm visual weight: a group of bold, black, tightly arranged large characters placed near one edge to create firm vertical pressure, while a few small words are distributed in corners or at the bottom with thin spacing, as restrained, precise, and leaving large open spaces like public signage. The overall completion should look like a strictly composed commercial art image; although the subjects are small, the shadows are huge, creating a strong sense of sunlight, order, isolation, and redefinition between real objects and abstract color fields.

prompts.text: 围绕任意主题对象生成一张极简而有强烈图形记忆点的平面视觉：画面先读到一整片明亮、干净、近乎无纹理的高明度色场，主题内容被拆成许多尺度很小的真实剪影、符号或局部物件，稀疏散落在宽阔留白中，彼此保持明显距离，让空旷感成为主角。每个小主体都必须投下夸张拉长的深色影子，影子沿统一斜向穿越画面，长度远大于主体本身，形成比主体更醒目的节奏线；局部可让某个巨大结构的投影从边缘切入，只露出沉重暗形和少量规则透光缝，使画面出现尺度反差与城市般的压迫感。色彩从未来主题自身的材质、情绪和文化语义中提取，保留“大面积清透明亮底色、极少量高对比深色结构、微小主题色点缀”的角色关系，整体保持鲜亮、洁净、通风感和清晰色阶，避免灰脏、复古泛黄或泥状混色。信息文字若出现，应作为冷静的视觉重量：一组粗黑紧密排布的大字贴近一侧边缘形成硬朗竖向压力，少量小字以细字距分布在角落或底部，像公共标识一样克制、精确、留出大空场。整体完成度要像经过严密排版的商业艺术图像，主体虽小但影子巨大，真实物件与抽象色场之间产生强烈的日光、秩序、孤立与重新定义感。

items.title: 传统文化视觉气质项目宣传长图

prompts.text:
Generate a work with traditional cultural information and visual temperament around any subject: the screen first reads a set of huge and restrained main titles, the titles are pressed against an empty light-colored field along a stable axis, the font is heavy, with a calligraphic skeleton and Songti turns, interspersed with tiny phonetic-style auxiliary characters and a row of slender explanatory text, forming a rhythm of "large characters as monuments, small characters as guides." The subject object should not be displayed flatly, but should cut in from the middle of the screen as a real-life close-up partial or key action, the edges gently swallowed by soft light and a translucent atomized layer, overlapping with the text, making the information seem to float out from the scene. prompts.text:
Create a premium 2x2 grid advertising artwork for Lay’s potato chips, one single image divided into four equal panels, all in the same clean conceptual style. The overall poster should feel witty, fresh, playful, highly designed, and visually interactive, with strong art-direction and collectible ad-poster quality.

Core visual language:
minimal warm off-white paper-texture background, lots of clean negative space, refined black-and-white hand-drawn doodle illustration, combined with realistic colorful Lay’s potato chip packaging and golden chips as the only strong color highlights. The mood is smart, humorous, light, graphic, and premium.

Layout:
a clean 2x2 composition, four square panels, evenly aligned, thin subtle spacing between panels, unified visual rhythm, same art style across all four scenes, like a campaign series presented in one page. Keep the image neat, balanced, and high-end.

Product:
Use iconic realistic Lay’s potato chips bag packaging as the hero object in every panel. The bag should look authentic, glossy, premium, instantly recognizable, with strong realistic volume, shadows, highlights, and crisp brand identity. Prefer classic bright yellow Lay’s pack as the main hero, or use a harmonious family of Lay’s colors if needed, but keep the campaign unified and clean.

Each of the four panels should show a different playful interaction between the real Lay’s bag / chips and the black doodle world:

Panel 1:
The Lay’s chip bag acts as a hot air balloon basket, floating upward. Hand-drawn doodle balloon canopy above, clouds, tiny birds, airflow lines, cheerful adventure icons. Golden potato chips fly around like wind-blown leaves.

Panel 2:
The Lay’s bag becomes a skateboard or surf ramp. Black line doodle characters slide across curved chips as if they are skate ramps or waves. Motion lines, stars, mini flags, playful action symbols. Strong sense of movement and energy.

Panel 3:
The Lay’s bag works as a music speaker or party amplifier. Doodle sound waves, dancing lines, tiny music notes, happy mini figures, chips bouncing outward like rhythm beats. The composition feels lively and punchy but still visually clean.

Panel 4:
The Lay’s bag becomes a doorway or portal into a doodle snack universe. Hand-drawn swirls, stars, floating chips, tiny ladders, adventurous mini people, playful arrows, and whimsical snack symbols emerging from the bag opening. The scene should feel imaginative and delightful.

Art direction:
The hand-drawn doodles must be elegant, controlled, witty, and compositionally smart, not childish scribbles. Use clean black ink lines, refined cartoon minimalism, soft humor, and subtle visual storytelling. The real product should interact directly with the doodles so the scene feels cleverly integrated, not pasted on top. Every panel should have one clear visual joke or interaction.

Chips:
Golden Lay’s potato chips should appear in all four panels as supporting heroes, realistic, crisp, lightly salted, appetizing, floating or interacting with the doodle world. Some chips can act like suns, wheels, stepping stones, surfboards, or flying objects, but all ideas must remain clean and readable.

Typography:
Add minimal but artistic campaign typography, clean and modern, integrated into the overall layout, not large messy headlines. Use a stylish mix of English and Chinese, with refined spacing and ad-design elegance. Suggested text:
“Lay’s”
“Crunch Into Fun”
“One Bag, Four Adventures”
Chinese text:
“乐事薯片”
“一口开启趣味”
“四格同频快乐”
“脆趣正在发生”
Typography should feel editorial, light, premium, and balanced with the visuals. Avoid crude heavy fonts.

Overall feel:
clean commercial illustration poster, conceptual packaging ad, modern minimal layout, clever visual interaction, witty and bright, premium campaign board, playful but sophisticated, high-end brand presentation, warm paper background, realistic product photography mixed with black ink doodle art, strong negative space, strong composition, 8k, hyper-detailed, unique, memorable.

Negative prompt:
messy layout, cluttered background, low detail, childish doodles, cheap design, distorted packaging, blurry logo, too many objects, overdecorated poster, dark background, random colors, weak interaction, flat composition, generic snack ad, unreadable text, extra products, low-end illustration
