prompts.text:
Theme: Sea Breeze Slope

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. A natural and mature atmosphere, with a healthy expression devoid of childishness. Dark brown medium-length hair is loosely curled, with the ends gently fluttering in the sea breeze. Transparent Japanese photobook makeup, thin base makeup, natural flush, and realistic skin texture. Looking back toward the camera from over her shoulder with a bright and cheerful smile.

Clothing/Pose:
Keep the person, expression, background, and composition from the generated photo, and only adjust the clothing to match the atmosphere of the reference image. An ivory-white lightweight sleeveless dress with thin straps, a simple open-back design, elegantly covered chest, and a naturally cinched waist. The skirt is short, made of a fluffy pleated fabric, with the hem drawing an arc as it spins with the wind. The right hand lightly pinches a corner of the skirt hem, and the left arm naturally extends backward. The body moves toward the depths of the slope while half-rotating, with weight resting on one foot. Elegant exposure, avoiding transparency or overly sexy expressions.

Background/Light:
A slope where the sea can be seen. In the distance is the blue sea, with white residences, palm trees, and low walls on the left and right, and a blurred city streetscape in the far distance. A sunny summer afternoon, the sky is a clear pale blue. The main light source comes from strong sunlight in the upper right of the frame, illuminating the silhouette of the hair and shoulders. Soft reflected light comes from buildings and the road on the left. Shadows extend from the feet toward the bottom left of the frame, with palm leaf shadows faintly cast on the road surface.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical composition. A full-body close-up portrait from above the knees to the top of the head. The person is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, with the body occupying about 65% of the frame. Use the road lines of the slope and the residences on both sides to create a sense of depth, maintaining the extension that guides the eye toward the sea. The camera is at chest height, a slightly close-up eye-level perspective. Shallow depth of field with background blur, focusing on the face and the hem of the dress. With a natural and slight telephoto compression.

Texture/Style:
High-quality Japanese photobook style. Summer sunlight, subtle wrinkles in white fabric, shadows of thin cotton material, fine strands of hair, and the natural pore texture of the skin are all meticulously depicted. A bright high-key style, but without excessive blown-out whites; the blue sky and ivory clothing are refreshing and harmonious. Avoid excessive HDR or an overly artificial AI feel, pursuing a natural photo expression with a sense of daily life.

Negative Prompt:
Expressions that look like minors, infantilization, excessive exposure, see-through clothing, nudity, unnatural faces or gazes, duplicate identical faces, extra or missing fingers, fused hands or feet, broken joints, fabric movement that defies gravity, unnatural shadows, excessive skin smoothing, plastic-looking skin, text, logos, watermarks, background signage text, excessive HDR.

prompts.text:
主题：海风的坡道

人物・表情：
20多岁的女性。自然而成熟的氛围，没有稚气的健康表情。黑褐色的中长发松散地卷曲，海风吹拂着发梢轻轻飘动。清透感十足的日系写真妆容，薄薄的底妆，自然的血色，真实感的肌肤纹理。从肩后回头看向镜头，带着明亮而开朗的笑容。

服装・ポーズ：
保留生成的照片中的人物・表情・背景・构图，仅将服装调整为接近参考图的氛围。象牙白的轻薄无袖连衣裙，细肩带，背部设计简洁敞开，胸前优雅覆盖，腰部自然收紧。裙子较短，采用蓬松展开的褶皱面料，裙摆随风与旋转画出圆弧。右手轻轻捏住裙摆一角，左臂自然向后伸展。身体一边向坡道深处前进，一边半旋转，重心落在单脚上。暴露度优雅，避免透视感或过度性感表现。

背景・光：
能看到大海的坡道。远处是蔚蓝的大海，左右是白色的住宅、棕榈树、低矮的围墙，远处模糊的城市街景。晴朗的夏日午后，天空是清澈的淡蓝色。主光源来自画面右上方的强烈阳光，照亮头发的轮廓和肩膀。左侧有来自建筑物和道路的柔和反射光。阴影从脚下向画面左下延伸，路面隐约投下棕榈叶的影子。

构图・カメラ：
纵向构图。从膝盖上方到头顶的全身近距离肖像。人物位于画面中央稍偏右，身体占据画面约65%。利用坡道的道路线条和左右住宅营造纵深感，保留引导视线向大海的延伸。相机位于胸部高度，稍近距离的平视视角。背景浅景深虚化，对焦在脸部和连衣裙的裙摆。带有自然的轻微远摄压缩感。

质感・スタイル：
高品质的日系写真。夏日阳光、白布料的细微褶皱、薄棉质材料的阴影、头发的细小发束、肌肤自然的毛孔感，都被细致描绘。明亮的偏高调风格，但不过度白飞，蓝天与象牙白服饰清爽和谐。避免过度HDR或过于人工的AI感，追求带有生活感的自然照片表现。

负面提示：

prompts.text:
A photorealistic lifestyle portrait of a young East Asian woman seated casually at a retro computer workstation in a cozy apartment bedroom. She is turned slightly away from the desk, glancing back toward the camera with a thoughtful, serene expression that feels spontaneous and unposed. Her long dark hair falls naturally around her face with a few loose strands, and she wears a relaxed cream-colored oversized knit sweater paired with comfortable white lounge shorts, creating a warm, understated look.

The scene is set in a softly cluttered late-night workspace inspired by early internet-era bedrooms. A chunky CRT monitor casts a subtle glow across the desk, displaying a coding interface, surrounded by a classic beige keyboard, wired mouse, scattered notebooks, a steaming mug, and small personal trinkets. The room extends into the background with a partially open door, a wooden chest of drawers, a casually rumpled bed, stacked books, and a simple analog wall clock, adding character and authenticity.

Shot as if captured with a compact point-and-shoot camera using direct flash, the lighting feels intimate and nostalgic, with gentle highlights, realistic skin texture, and soft shadow falloff. Muted vintage tones, subtle color fading, delicate film grain, and tiny imperfections create the feeling of a discovered photograph from the early 2000s. Shallow depth of field keeps focus on the subject while the room softly melts into the background. Vertical composition, cinematic framing, natural storytelling, cozy midnight programming mood, authentic Y2K-inspired atmosphere.

Style Keywords: photorealistic lifestyle portrait, candid indoor photography, nostalgic computer room, retro internet aesthetic, early-2000s bedroom, point-and-shoot flash, cinematic realism, natural beauty, editorial photography, warm ambient mood, soft film grain, vintage color palette, intimate storytelling, high detail, authentic 35mm film look.

prompts.text:
Create a premium 4:5 travel-poster illustration of [LOCTAION NAME] in a whimsical storybook paper-collage style. The artwork should feel like a handcrafted layered paper diorama, blending the charm of a classic children's picture book with the sophistication of a Scandinavian editorial travel poster. It should be a collectible destination print suitable for museum gift shops, boutique hotels, luxury travel publications, and modern interiors.

Depict the location using one iconic transportation vehicle and one primary landmark as the two unmistakable visual anchors. The vehicle should occupy approximately 35–40% of the foreground, simplified into elegant paper-cut forms while remaining instantly recognizable. Surround it sparingly with a few flower planters, one bench, two or three tiny pedestrians, a cyclist, a street lamp, and subtle local urban details. Keep the foreground clean and uncluttered.

The midground should feature simplified local architecture, streetscape, greenery, parks or waterfronts, and subtle cultural elements, all reduced to clean geometric shapes with minimal architectural detail. In the background, feature only one hero landmark, supported by one or two secondary landmarks that are softened into atmospheric paper layers. If appropriate, distant mountains or natural scenery should fade gently into the horizon. Every architectural element should read as a simplified silhouette rather than a detailed building.

Compose the illustration with an expansive open sky occupying approximately 50–55% of the image, creating generous breathing room and strong negative space. Include two to five rounded paper clouds, a few tiny birds, and a soft pastel gradient with visible handmade paper grain. Establish clear foreground, midground, atmospheric haze, and background layers using crisp stacked paper sheets with visible cut edges, subtle elevation, delicate cast shadows, and tactile cardstock textures.

Adopt a soft, harmonious color palette featuring sky blue, warm cream, light beige, pale stone gray, muted sage green, powder mint, dusty coral, soft peach, off-white, plus one distinctive accent color inspired by the location. Maintain restrained saturation throughout the composition, allowing only the iconic vehicle and primary landmark to carry slightly richer color emphasis while the remaining scene stays gently muted.

Use bright morning daylight with soft ambient illumination, subtle shadows, clean air, and a warm optimistic atmosphere. Shapes should be rounded, friendly, and organic with softly curved trees, fluffy clouds, stylized foliage, rolling hills where appropriate, and charming handcrafted imperfections that reinforce the storybook aesthetic.

In the upper-left corner, integrate elegant white rounded geometric sans-serif typography into the open sky using a clean editorial grid with generous margins. Display:

[LOCATION NAME]

[LOCAL LANGUAGE NAME] · [ENGLISH NAME]

A unique location-specific tagline that reflects the city's identity while keeping the same elegant typographic style across the entire poster series (examples: "Where Tradition Meets Tomorrow", "The City of Timeless Canals", "Gateway to the Himalayas", "Where History Breathes", "Island of Endless Horizons").

Finish with a thin warm-cream border around the artwork, subtle museum-print paper texture, and a refined collectible poster aesthetic inspired by Scandinavian design, Kinfolk editorial layouts, Monocle travel illustrations, and mid-century European tourism posters.

Mood: peaceful, nostalgic, whimsical, timeless, joyful, slow-travel, refined, cultured, optimistic, quietly magical.

Avoid photorealism, CGI, glossy materials, excessive architectural detail, heavy outlines, cluttered compositions, crowded streets, readable advertisements, brand logos, watermarks, neon colors, cyberpunk aesthetics, dark lighting, dramatic contrast, busy signage, or tourist-brochure styling.

prompts.text:
为[地点名称]创作一张高级的4:5旅游海报插画，采用奇幻绘本纸雕风格。艺术作品应感觉像是一个手工制作的多层纸质透视模型，融合了经典儿童绘本的魅力与斯堪的纳维亚社论旅游海报的高级感。它应该是一张适合博物馆礼品店、精品酒店、奢侈旅游出版物和现代室内装饰的收藏级目的地印刷品。

使用一个标志性的交通工具和一个主要地标作为两个不容错过的视觉支柱来描绘该地点。该工具应占据前景约35–40%的比例，简化为优雅的剪纸形状，同时保持极高的辨识度。在其周围少量布置一些花盆、一张长凳、两三个微小的行人、一名骑行者、一盏路灯以及微妙的当地城市细节。保持前景整洁且不凌乱。

中景应包含简化的当地建筑、街景、绿地、公园或海滨，以及微妙的文化元素，全部简化为干净的几何形状，建筑细节最少。在背景中，只突出一个英雄级地标，由一个或两个软化为大气纸层的次要地标辅助。如果合适，远处的山脉或自然风光应轻轻隐入地平线。每个建筑元素都应呈现为简化的剪影，而非精细的建筑。

构图时，广阔的开阔天空约占据图像的50–55%，创造出慷慨的呼吸空间和强烈的留白。加入两到五个圆润的纸云、几只微小的鸟，以及带有可见手工纸纹理的柔和浅色渐变。使用带有可见切割边缘、微妙高度、细腻投射阴影和触感卡纸纹理的清晰堆叠纸张，建立清晰的前景、中景、大气阴影和背景层。

items.title: 七夕清晨神社浴衣少女祈愿

prompts.text:
Theme:
Tanabata

Characters/Expression:
A female in her 20s. Soft oval face, natural transparent skin, Japanese style light makeup. Dark brown hair loosely tied in a low bun, with a few strands of hair at the back glowing thinly in the morning light. A small purple hair ornament is tucked behind the ear. Face slightly tilted up, eyes looking at the short strip of paper (tanzaku) at the top right, with a gentle expression of quietly making a wish.

Clothing/Pose:
A white base yukata with blue flower patterns, paired with a dark blue belt. The yukata sleeves hang down naturally, detailing the translucency and folds of the fabric. The body stretches slightly towards the upper right of the frame. Her right arm is raised high, gently touching a pink tanzaku at the upper right. Her left arm hangs naturally by her side, with the overlapping part of the belt and yukata clearly visible at the waist. Fingertips are not using too much force, capturing the delicate movement before picking up the tanzaku.

Background/Lighting:
A corner of a shrine path or shopping street in the early morning lined with Japanese Tanabata decorations. Overhead bamboo leaves and colorful tanzaku are layered, with pink, yellow, light blue, and light purple paper strips swaying gently in the morning breeze. The background retains the atmosphere of hazy lanterns and stalls, but it is not night, but a bright morning. The main light source is the low-angle morning sun shining obliquely from the distance at the upper left. Strong white highlights are cast on the character's hair tips, cheeks, shoulders, and raised arm, while the background uses a blur of light green and white to create a bright feeling. Shadows of the tanzaku and bamboo leaves fall faintly on the yukata and skin.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical composition. A portrait composition centered on the upper half of the body, with the character placed in the lower center to the right, leaving a large area at the top for the tanzaku and bamboo decorations. The camera position is slightly lower than chest height, shooting the character from a slightly low angle. Equivalent to a 35mm natural wide angle, conveying the sense of distance between the character and the tanzaku. The focus is on the character's face and right fingertips, while the lanterns in the background and the distant shrine path are softly blurred with a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:
Realistic photo style. Utilizing morning backlight to create a bright, high-key portrait. Skin is not over-retouched, retaining natural pores, messy fine hair strands, cotton texture of the yukata, and the thin transparency of the tanzaku paper. Dominated by transparent white, light green, and the blue of the yukata, presenting a light color tone like a summer morning. Add a small amount of film-like soft grain and natural lens flare.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features or gaze, extra or missing fingers, broken wrists or elbows, poor contact with the tanzaku, broken yukata structure, shifted belt position, over-smoothed skin, plastic-like skin, overly clear unnatural text, garbled text, logos, watermarks, extra characters, excessive exposure, shadows contradicting the background.

prompts.text:
主题：
七夕

人物·表情：
20多岁的女性。柔和的鹅蛋脸，自然透明的肌肤，淡妆的日式风格。深棕色头发松松地低髻盘起，几缕后发丝在晨光中细细透亮。耳后点缀一个小巧的紫色发饰。脸微微上扬，视线投向右上方的短签，带着静静许愿的温柔神情。

服装·姿势：
白色底布上印青花图案的浴衣，搭配深蓝腰带。浴衣袖子自然垂落，细致表现布料的透光感和褶皱。身体微微向画面右上方伸展。自己的右手臂高高抬起，轻柔触碰画面右上方的粉色短签。自己的左臂自然垂在身侧，腰间的腰带与浴衣重叠部分清晰可见。指尖不使过大力气，捕捉捏起短签前的那份细腻动作。

背景·光线：
日本七夕装饰排列的清晨神社参道或商店街一隅。头顶竹叶与五颜六色的短签层层叠叠，粉色、黄色、水蓝、浅紫的纸片在晨风中轻轻摇曳。背景保留朦胧的灯笼和摊位气息，但不是夜晚，而是明亮的早晨。主要光源从画面左上方远处斜射而入的低角度朝阳。在人物的发梢、脸颊、肩膀和抬起的手臂上打出强烈的白色高光，背景以浅绿与白的虚化营造明快感。短签和竹叶的影子淡淡落在浴衣与肌肤上。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图。以半身为中心的肖像构图，人物置于画面下中央偏右，上方大片留给短签与竹叶装饰。镜头位置略低于胸口高度，以轻微仰视角度拍摄人物。相当于35mm的自然广角，传达人物与短签的距离感。焦点在人物脸部和右手指尖，背景的灯笼与远处的参道采用浅景深柔和虚化。

质感·风格：
实写照片风格。利用晨间逆光营造明亮的高调肖像。肌肤不过度修饰，保留自然的毛孔、细碎发丝凌乱、浴衣的棉质纹理、短签纸张的薄透感。以透明的白与浅绿、浴衣的青色为主调，呈现夏日清晨般的轻盈色调。加入少量类似胶片照片的柔和颗粒与自然镜头光晕。

负面提示：
不自然的五官或视线、多余或缺失的手指、手腕或肘部的破绽、与短签接触不良、浴衣结构崩坏、腰带位置偏移、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤、过于清晰的不自然文字、文字乱码、标志、水印、多余人物、过度暴露、与背景矛盾的影子。

Generate a 9:16 vertical high-definition commercial design image with the theme 'Dark High-Quality Catering Delivery Visual Proposal: [Catering Category]'.

The shop brand name is [Brand Name], and the English sub-title is [English Name].

The overall image is not a single catering poster, but a complete high-end catering delivery shop visual proposal board. The picture should look like a catering brand proposal completed by a real brand design company, with a complete sense of brand system, delivery platform landing feel, commercial design sense, and high-end catering atmosphere.

The overall style adopts a dark high-quality visual style, with the main color as [Main Color], the secondary color as [Secondary Color], and the accent color as [Accent Color]. The background can use [Material Atmosphere], combined with [Lighting Atmosphere], to create [Overall Style]. The dark background must have layers; the main food and drinks must have clear highlights, and must not be pitch black or messy.

The layout structure includes the following modules:

1. Top Case Title Area
Write 'Takeout Shop Design Case' or 'High-end Catering Delivery Visual Case', paired with simple high-end linear icons, such as delivery, in-store pickup, freshly made and sold, selected ingredients, and signature recommendations. Icons can use the [Secondary Color] fine-line style. Do not show real platform logos.

2. Upper-Middle Main Visual Banner
Large-scale display of core products among the [Main Products] as the hero shot of the entire image. Food or drinks should be high-definition and realistic, with strong commercial photography texture, high-end light and shadow, and clear materials. The main title highlights [Brand Name] or [English Name], and the sub-copy can write the [Core Selling Point].

3. Middle Auxiliary Banner
Display 3-5 product combinations or set meal contents to strengthen brand selling points, such as: freshly made and sold, selected ingredients, rich sauce, handmade desserts, fresh-cut and freshly made, boutique coffee beans, restaurant-level flavor, etc. The layout should be restrained and not look like a cheap promotion image.

4. Lower-Left Mobile Delivery Shop Homepage Mockup
Display a fictional delivery platform page, including shop header image, product categories, hot-selling products, price information, recommended set meals, etc. The UI should be realistic and have a sense of commercial landing, but no real platform names, real logos, QR codes, or watermarks.

5. Right and Bottom Product Card Matrix
Arrange 6-8 product cards / dish cards / drink cards / set meal cards, with content from [Main Products]. Each card must unify the brand style, food photography must be clear, prices and short titles can appear, but do not have too much small text.

6. Bottom Standard Color Palette
Add 4 'STANDARD COLOR' blocks, displaying [Main Color], [Secondary Color], [Accent Color], and one brand basic color to enhance the sense of design proposal and brand system.

Avoid: Real platform logos, real brand names, QR codes, watermarks, too much small text, garbled characters, food deformation, cup deformation, mobile UI distortion, cheap promotion feel, overly dark images, messy backgrounds, greasy feel, low resolution.

prompts.text:

large, sharp, centered or powerfully off-centered, with the logo, label, packaging shape, colors, and key brand details clearly readable and unobstructed.

Use one strong visual proof mechanic:
water impact, clean cut, invisible shield, sound wave, temperature contrast, texture transformation, light split, motion trail, pressure test, material reaction, or before/after tension.

Composition rules:
foreground detail, midground product hero, background proof atmosphere.
The eye should land on the logo first, then understand the benefit immediately.

Avoid:

prompts.text:
「【画幅与用途】
9:16 竖版海报，full-bleed 满版视觉，用于抗衰机构 / 皮肤管理机构 / 医学美学机构的短视频口播配图插帧。
这是一张“方法拆解型 + 阶段分层说明型”配图，不是广告促销图，不是单一产品海报，不是夸张医美项目销售图。
重点是让观众在短时间内迅速理解：
眼周护理到了第 3 步，要重视胶原支持；
而且“没有纹”和“已经出现眼纹”，护理重点并不一样。

【口播对应主题】
第三，定期给眼周补充胶原。
所以如果你还没有纹，先坚持好好保湿。
当出现眼纹时，真的只能靠上科技了。

【核心表达】
这张图要表达一个很清楚的认知：
眼周年轻感和胶原支撑密切相关。
眼周护理不是等到纹很明显了才开始管，
而是分阶段去看：

第一阶段：
如果还没有明显眼纹，
重点是坚持保湿、稳定护理、尽量延缓纹路出现。

第二阶段：
如果已经出现眼纹，
单靠基础保湿通常不够，
需要进一步考虑“胶原支持”与“科技型护理”。

这张图重点不是卖某个具体项目，
而是帮助观众建立一个清楚判断：
眼周护理要分阶段，
出现眼纹后，护理逻辑会发生变化。

【最适合的呈现方式】
采用「真实亚洲女性眼周特写 + 双阶段对照说明」的短视频配图形式。
不要做成复杂剖面图。
不要做成电商海报。
不要做成夸张手术广告。
不要做成纯项目宣传页。
整张图要像高端皮肤管理机构 / 医学美学机构发布的专业认知说明图：
清楚、克制、真实、高级、易读。

【画面结构建议】
推荐采用“上下双区”或“左右双区”的分层结构。
因为是 9:16 竖版，优先建议“上下双区”更适合手机端观看。

模块 A｜还没有明显眼纹
视觉表现：
- 真实亚洲女性眼周近景
- 眼周整体状态较平整、轻盈、细腻
- 可以有非常轻微的自然纹理，但没有明显静态眼纹
- 重点表现“现在还来得及好好保养”
标签方向：
「还没有明显眼纹」
「重点：坚持保湿」
「先把基础打好」

模块 B｜已经出现眼纹
视觉表现：
- 同样是真实亚洲女性眼周近景
- 眼尾或眼下可见轻中度细纹 / 干纹 / 动态纹趋于固定的状态
- 不是严重衰老，也不是夸张皱纹
- 重点表现“纹已经出现，单靠保湿不够”
标签方向：
「已经出现眼纹」
「单靠保湿不够」
「需要胶原支持」
「可考虑科技型护理」

【主体人物要求】
可以使用同一位真实亚洲女性的两种阶段表现，
也可以用两组风格统一的真实眼周局部图。
年龄建议为 28-42 岁之间，
不要明星脸，不要网红脸，不要浓妆。
保留真实眼周纹理、轻微细纹、轻微干燥感和自然肤感。
不要过度磨皮，不要玻璃皮，不要塑料感。

【关于“补充胶原”的视觉表达】
这部分不要做成恐怖的组织剖面图，
也不要做得太科技蓝、太赛博。
建议采用高级、克制、医学美学感的视觉方式：

可视化方向：
- 在眼周下方或眼周周围加入柔和、细腻的“胶原支撑感”线性结构
- 用轻柔的纤维状、网状、支撑状视觉隐喻表现 collagen support
- 表现一种“眼周被支撑、被托住、被增强”的感觉
- 在“出现眼纹”模块中，可以加入更明确的“胶原支持”提示
- “科技型护理”可以用非常克制的小型设备轮廓 / 光点 / 专业护理符号轻微点到即可

注意：
不要把设备做成主角。
不要出现夸张针剂画面。
不要像直接卖项目。
重点仍然是“分阶段管理逻辑”。

【文字层级要求】
这是短视频口播配图，文字必须清晰、醒目、适合手机端观看。

模块 A：

模块 B：
「出现眼纹后，单靠保湿通常不够」

「基础保湿」
「延缓纹路出现」
「胶原支持」
「科技型护理」

这些字不要太小，要比纯精致海报更易读。

【构图建议】
推荐版式：
- 上方：主标题
- 中部：上下双区 / 左右双区眼周阶段对照
- 每个区有清楚的小标题和简短解释
- 下方：一句总结

整体阅读逻辑应清楚：
第一眼：第3步，补充胶原
第二眼：原来有纹和没纹要分开看
第三眼：没纹先保湿，有纹要胶原支持
第四眼：出现眼纹后，需要进一步科技型护理

【视觉重点】
这张图必须一眼讲清楚：
眼周护理不是一种方法打天下。
如果还没有纹，
重点是好好保湿，提前维护。
如果已经出现纹，
仅靠保湿通常不够，
要开始重视胶原支持和科技型护理。

重点不是夸大焦虑，
而是做“阶段性认知拆解”。

【风格与质感】
整体风格要像高端皮肤管理机构 / 医学美学机构发布的专业认知说明图：
- premium eye care educational poster

背景使用奶白、浅灰、淡米色、极浅暖灰。
整体光线柔和、干净、专业。
眼周肤色自然真实。
“没有明显眼纹”模块可以更轻盈、柔和一些。
“已经出现眼纹”模块可以略微增加纹理和支撑感提示。
胶原支持可视化元素可使用：

- 微光纤维感
不要廉价科技蓝，不要高饱和炫光。

premium eye care explainer poster, step 3 collagen support for eye area, eye care by stages, no visible wrinkles vs visible eye wrinkles, hydration before wrinkles, collagen support after wrinkles appear, technology-assisted eye care concept, realistic Asian female eye close-up, medical aesthetics educational visual, short-video explainer graphic, clean editorial skincare layout, readable Chinese typography, high-end eye aging awareness poster, 9:16 vertical full-bleed composition

【负面要求】

可在底部加入一句清晰总结：

有纹后，要开始重视胶原支持」

或者：

出现眼纹后，护理逻辑就不一样了」

Create an offbeat weird-cute / ugly-cute character with a slightly awkward but charming expression, strong personality, and a subtle cool attitude. The mascot should feel quirky, memorable, a little goofy, and a little vintage, not too childish or overly clean.

Style direction:
bold black outline, simplified cartoon shapes, slightly rough retro charm, expressive face, compact silhouette, flat color blocks with light shading, playful proportions, graphic clarity, and a stylish small-brand logo feel.
The overall vibe should feel like an indie snack shop / burger bar / coffee goods / sour goods brand.

Typography:
use chunky custom display lettering with strong personality, slightly irregular retro shapes, playful spacing, and a hand-crafted feel.
The brand name should be large and eye-catching, but not too many extra words.
Keep supporting text minimal, only a short subtitle if needed.

Composition:
centered logo composition with the mascot and wordmark integrated into one complete brand mark.
Leave generous empty space around the logo so it feels refined and breathable.
Do not let the logo fill the whole canvas.
The mascot should be slightly smaller than a poster illustration and clearly read as a logo identity.

Background:
use a clean solid-color background or plain white background.
Prefer soft retro colors or slightly faded playful tones.

Important:
do not use real brand names, do not copy existing logos, do not add watermarks, artist names, copyright marks, or lots of tiny decorative text.

items.title: 索尼A7CR相机工业设计草图

prompts.text:
Create a highly detailed industrial design concept sketch on an off-white lined notebook page featuring the SONY Alpha 7CR camera as the main subject. The page should resemble a real camera designer’s brainstorming notebook, with a large three-quarter perspective hand-drawn illustration of the Sony Alpha 7CR as the dominant centerpiece. The camera must be instantly recognizable: compact full-frame mirrorless body, clean rectangular silhouette with softened edges, prominent lens mount, textured grip, EVF corner placement, minimalist Sony control layout, precise top dials, shutter button position, articulated-screen structure hints, and premium Alpha-series industrial design language.

Render the main sketch using black ballpoint pen linework, ultra-fine cross-hatching, product-design construction lines, perspective guides, and carefully placed colored marker accents. Use restrained Sony-inspired accents such as matte black, graphite gray, subtle silver highlights, and a small touch of muted orange on the lens mount marker area, while keeping most of the rendering in elegant pen-sketch form. The hero camera should feel like a professional industrial design study for a premium compact full-frame camera.

Add handwritten annotations, arrows, and design callouts pointing to key features such as:
“Compact Full-Frame Body”
“Alpha Ergonomic Grip”
“High-Resolution Sensor Core”
“Minimal Control Layout”
“Corner EVF Placement”
“Precision Dial Geometry”
“Lens Mount Proportion”
“Textured Grip Surface”
“Portable Pro Camera Form”
“Rear Screen Integration”

Include tiny doodle illustrations and rough concept thumbnails scattered naturally across the page, such as:
- miniature front / side / top-view camera studies
- grip shape explorations
- lens mount detail sketches
- top-dial and button-layout studies
- hot shoe and EVF silhouette notes
- rear-screen hinge concept doodles
- tiny lens pairing thumbnails
- small photographer-in-use stick sketch
- quick street-photography mood thumbnails
- interface and menu-layout micro-notes
- compact travel-carry concept sketches

Place a small reference image of the actual SONY Alpha 7CR in the lower-left corner of the page, like a pasted study reference, with a bold blue hand-drawn arrow pointing toward the main concept sketch, indicating the design inspiration source.

Add authentic notebook details:
subtle coffee stains, pencil guidelines, erased construction marks, folded paper corners, light ink smudges, notebook punch holes, slight paper warping, ruler marks, realistic paper grain, marginal engineering notes, and sketchbook wear so it feels like a genuine camera designer’s working notebook.

At the top, write a handwritten title:
“Imaging – Product Study 01”
Also add small hand-sketched “SONY Alpha 7CR” logo studies, alpha-symbol variations, and neat typographic experiments in the corners, integrated naturally like real branding exploration notes.

The main centerpiece should include one tasteful semi-exploded study hinting at internal design intelligence: sensor plane position, shutter mechanism zone, IBIS stabilization area, lens mount depth, heat-management structure, and body-to-grip spatial balance, but rendered selectively and elegantly, not like a full technical blueprint.

Overall aesthetic:
premium industrial design sketchbook, professional camera concept art, realistic pen-and-marker rendering, tactile paper realism, clean composition, high-end consumer electronics design presentation, ultra-detailed, high-resolution, 8K, refined, collectible, authentic design-notebook aesthetic.

prompts.text: Generate visual works with a strong sense of information around any theme: let a real or highly realistic theme scene become the main body of the picture, layered with a graphic frame as sharp, bright, and clean as event release materials. The first glance reads the oversized bold title at the top, with extremely heavy weight, compact letter spacing, and horizontal spread, forming a high-pressure identification anchor; the second glance enters the large image window in the middle, where the theme object appears as a close-up main form, enclosed by rounded corners, chamfers, and partial gaps, with the edges of the image appearing precisely cut by bright structural plates. Arrange a vertical information bar on the left, and place low-density explanatory text, icon groups, short lines, and small badges at the bottom, while reserving a solid dark symbol block in the bottom right, ensuring all information hierarchies are clear, as if speed and order are happening simultaneously. Colors are extracted from the theme's own materials, scenes, and emotions, maintaining the role relationships of large-area high-brightness pure base colors, dark text structures, natural image colors, and a few clear emphasis colors; the overall feel should be bright, light, transparent, and clean, with sharp boundaries, saturation concentrated on structural colors and emphasis points, and dark areas kept clean without turning gray. Use a combination of modern thick black sans-serif and narrow small-font characters, where the title has strong impact and the small text maintains an industrial precise rhythm. The image texture should be like real photos superimposed with a graphic design system, where sunlight, hard-edged shadows, fine-grained pavement, or theme-related textures all serve speed, competition, sense of release, and readability, avoiding becoming ordinary promotional illustrations or loose collages.

prompts.text:
Theme:
Beads of the Night

Character/Expression:
Flat art in the style of iron beads/Perler beads inspired by a woman in her 20s. Long black hair with thin transparent bangs, hair falling to one side, covering part of the face. Clear and transparent Japanese-style makeup, soft cheek blush, downcast gaze, reserved and mature expression.

Clothing/Pose:
White ribbed camisole loungewear. The chest is naturally open, with only three small buttons on the upper part, and the buttons are unfastened. The lower part of the placket fabric is connected to avoid excessive opening. No jacket. White shorts with a thin ribbon tied at the waist. Seated pose, knees naturally separated to the left and right, hands naturally folded in front of the body. Avoid extra bead protrusions on the outside of arms and shoulders, smoothing the body outline. The chest presents a three-dimensional sense of an adult woman but is not overly exposed, presented elegantly in the form of bead art.

Background/Lighting:
Placed on a simple cream-beige flat board, arranged around the character. Small pink hearts, yellow stars, white flowers, pink ribbons, and several round decorative beads are scattered in the white space. A heart is placed on the top left, a star on the top right, a flower on the bottom right, and a ribbon on the right side. Soft warm light is cast from above, casting small shadows in the holes and edges of the beads. The background is bright and uniform, with shadows extending slightly toward the bottom right.

Composition/Lens:
Square. A flat layout looking down from directly above. The character is placed slightly below the center, in a large size, including the full-body seated pose. The character occupies about 75% of the frame, with surrounding decorations creating negative space. The focus is on the character's face and the bead texture of the white clothing on the chest. Background decorations are clearly identifiable but do not interfere with the protagonist.

Texture/Style:
Handicraft art made of high-density iron beads. Each bead shows the three-dimensional sense of round holes, and the colors are mainly composed of skin tone, black, white, light pink, yellow, and green. It combines the cuteness of pixel art with the atmosphere of a photographic portrait. The outline is slightly stepped in bead units, the lighting is soft, and the overall tone is warm beige. It does not pursue excessive realism but is a precision bead mosaic with a handmade feel.

Negative Prompt:
Underage appearance, overexposure, nudity, underwear-only clothing, unnatural breast shape, extra arms or fingers, extra beads attached to arms, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, facial collapse, unnatural gaze, missing bead holes, text, logo, watermark.

items.title: 露天温泉裹浴巾女性背影

prompts.text:
Theme: Challenge of the outdoor hot spring

Character/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Standing with her back to the camera, her wet dark brown hair is tied in a loose low bun. Fine steam and water droplets remain on her neck, shoulders, and back. Only a small part of her profile turned to the right is visible, and her expression is not overly revealed.

Clothing/Pose:
The woman tightly wraps a large white bath towel from her chest to her upper thighs, lightly pulling the left and right ends of the towel with both hands. Exposure is limited to the shoulders, upper back, and both legs, with the chest and waist completely covered. The body stands straight in the center, with weight shifted slightly toward the right leg and knees naturally relaxed. Arms are not opened too wide, and fingers hold the towel with natural strength. The bath towel needs to show the thick texture of towel weaving and a sense of wet weight.

Background/Lighting:
A spacious outdoor hot spring. A large bath surrounded by rocks extends into the distance, with white steam rising from the surface of the water. Bamboo fences, dark rocks, wet wooden decks, wooden bathhouses, low stone lanterns, and warm-colored lanterns are arranged. There are 5 to 6 adult men naturally soaking in the hot spring. All are typical Japanese men with black hair, no baldness. The men do not notice the woman and do not cast their gaze toward her. One has his elbow on the rock edge with his back to the camera, two are facing each other in the water talking sideways, one is immersed to the shoulders in the distance staring at the water surface, one is handling a hand bucket near the water inlet, and one is resting quietly against a rock. Everyone's movements must vary to avoid repeating the same pose. In the forest under the afterglow of the sunset, soft natural light is projected from the top right of the frame, and lanterns in the back left provide warm auxiliary light. There are wet highlights on the woman's shoulders and back, and shadows fall on the wet wooden boards beneath her feet. The water surface reflects the flickering of lights and trees.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 4:5. The woman is placed slightly in front of the center of the frame, showing a full back view from above the knees to the head. The woman's back and the white bath towel are the protagonists, with the large hot spring in the background extending backward to provide a sense of depth. The camera position is slightly higher than chest height, a level angle with a slight downward tilt. The woman occupies about 45% of the screen, with the hot spring and men scattered from the middle ground to the background. The focus is placed on the woman's hair, shoulders, and the texture of the bath towel. The men and steam in the background are slightly softer, clearly highlighting the protagonist. Create a natural sense of perspective to convey the vastness of the hot spring.

Texture/Style:
Realistic photo style. The calm texture unique to the outdoor hot springs of Japanese inns. Skin is not over-retouched, retaining natural water droplets and the sense of pores on wet skin. The bath towel is a white thick material, showing subtle weaving patterns. Wet wood, rock surfaces, water surfaces, steam, and lantern reflections need to be detailed. The color tone is dominated by the contrast of deep green, wet brown, warm orange, and the white bath towel. Carries a slight sense of humorous tension, but is not explicitly sexy, remaining within the scope of high-quality hot spring photos.

Negative Prompt:
Minors, bath towel too transparent, damaged bath towel, unnatural fingers, hands, extra or missing fingers, fused arms, distorted legs, men staring at the woman, unnatural surprised expressions, men with the same face, unnatural steam, floating objects, shadows inconsistent with light sources, text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

prompts.text:
主题：露天温泉的挑战

人物・表情：
20多岁女性。背对镜头站立，湿润的深棕色头发在低位松散地扎成丸子头。颈部、肩膀、背部残留着细小的蒸汽和水滴。脸部仅能看到右转的侧脸一小部分，表情不会过于显露。

服装・姿势：
女性将白色的大浴巾从胸口紧紧裹到大腿上方，双手轻轻拉起浴巾左右两端。暴露仅限于肩膀、上背部和双腿，胸部和腰部完全遮盖。身体在中央笔直站立，重心略微偏向右腿，膝盖自然放松。双臂不过分张开，手指以自然的力度握住浴巾。浴巾需表现出厚实的毛巾织纹凹凸感和湿润的重量感。

背景・光线：
宽敞的露天温泉。被岩石包围的大汤池向深处延伸，汤面上升腾着白色的蒸汽。配置有竹栅栏、深色岩石、湿润的木质甲板、木造汤屋、低矮的石灯笼、暖色灯笼。温泉中有5～6名成年男性自然地泡浴。所有人均为典型的日本男性黑发，无秃头。男性们并未注意到女性，不会投以视线。其中一人肘部搁在岩沿上背对镜头，两人面对面在汤中侧身交谈，一人在深处浸到肩部凝视汤面，一人在汤口附近处理手桶，一人倚靠岩石静静休息。所有人的动作需有所差异，避免重复相同姿势。夕阳余晖下的森林中，画面右上方投射柔和的自然光，左后方的灯笼提供暖色辅助光。女性肩部和背部带有湿润的高光，阴影落在脚下的湿木板上。水面反射着灯光和树木的摇曳。

构图・镜头：
纵向4:5。女性置于画面中央稍前方，完整展现从膝盖以上到头部的全身背影。女性的背部和白色浴巾为主角，背景的大温泉作为纵深感向后延伸。镜头位置略高于胸部高度，带轻微俯视的平视角度。女性占据画面约45%，温泉和男性们分散在中景至远景。焦点置于女性的头发、肩膀、浴巾质感。背景的男性和蒸汽稍显柔和，明确突出主角。营造自然的远近感，传达温泉的宽广。

质感・风格：
逼真的照片风格。日式旅馆露天温泉特有的沉稳质感。皮肤不过度修饰，保留湿润肌肤的自然水滴和毛孔感。浴巾为白色厚实材质，表现出细微的织纹。湿润木材、岩石表面、水面、蒸汽、灯笼反射需细致描绘。色调以深绿、湿润的茶褐色、温暖的橙色、白浴巾的对比为主。带有轻微幽默的紧张感，但不露骨性感，保持在上品温泉照片的范围内。

负面提示：
未成年人、浴巾过于透明、浴巾破损、不自然的指、手、多余或缺失手指、胳膊融合、腿部扭曲、男性凝视女性、不自然的惊讶表情、相同面孔的男性、不自然的蒸汽、漂浮物、与光源矛盾的阴影、文字、标志、水印、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的皮肤。

items.title: 海风旅程日系夏日海滨全景写真

prompts.text:
Theme:
Journey of the sea breeze

Character/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Natural and mature Japanese female atmosphere. Dark brown hair in a low loose side ponytail, with airy thin bangs and hair strands around the face swaying slightly in the sea breeze. Transparent Japanese-style photobook makeup, light pink-beige lipstick, natural blush, retaining the real texture of skin grain. The expression is a gentle smile, naturally looking down at the camera from a slightly lower position, rather than from above.

Clothing/Pose:
Japanese marine style outfit with an ivory semi-sleeve shirt and a high-waisted flared skirt of the same color. Fine navy blue lines and a small ribbon at the neckline, lightweight summer fabric that is not overly transparent. White socks and white platform sneakers on feet. The character stands on a seaside stone path, with weight on the right leg and the left leg slightly extended forward. The character lifts the skirt hem significantly to the side with her own right hand, letting the sea breeze expand the fabric fluffily. Safe white inner shorts are naturally visible, with no vulgar exposure. The character's own left hand is relaxed at the side of the body.

Background/Lighting:
Seaside promenade. At the bottom left is a cream-colored cute hand-carry suitcase, decorated with a pale beige ribbon. In the background, there is the blue sea, low mountains, a lighthouse-like silhouette in the distance, stone pillars, and metal rope railings. A sunny summer afternoon. The sun shines strongly from the upper left of the frame, creating bright highlights on the hair and the edge of the skirt. Soft shadows fall on the right side of the character, and the reflected light from the sea surface brightens the legs and white clothing. The sky is pale blue with thin white clouds.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical composition. Low-angle full-body portrait. The character is placed significantly in the upper right of the frame, leaving a wide margin of blue sky. The suitcase is at the bottom left of the frame, slightly ahead of the character's feet. The distance allows for a full-body shot of the character, with the skirt's expansion spanning across the center of the frame. The lens position is below the waist, looking slightly upwards. The focus is on the character's face, with the background naturally blurred with shallow depth of field. Do not use an overly wide angle to avoid distortion of the legs or face, aiming for a natural portrait representation.

Texture/Style:
High-quality Japanese photobook style, summer seaside transparency, with a bright tone dominated by soft whites and pale blues. The skin retains its natural texture, avoiding excessive beauty retouching or a plastic feel. Detailed depiction of the thinness of the white fabric, the layers of the skirt swelling in the wind, the roundness of the suitcase, and the texture of the ribbon. A refreshing and slightly artistic travel photo atmosphere.

Negative Prompt:
Faces that look like minors, infantilization, excessive exposure, underwear emphasis, overly transparent clothing, nipple exposure, sexy poses, unnatural faces or gazes, extra or missing fingers, fused hands or feet, broken joints, gravity-defying skirts or fabrics, deformed suitcases, shadows contradicting the light source, excessive skin retouching, plastic skin, excessive HDR, text, logos, watermarks, brand markings, obvious AI feel.

prompts.text:
主题：
海风的旅程

人物・表情：
20多岁的女性。自然而成熟的日本女性氛围。黑褐色的头发低松侧马尾，带有空气感的薄前发和脸周后发丝在海风中微微摇曳。清透的日系写真妆容，淡粉米色唇膏，自然腮红，保留肌肤纹理的真实质感。表情是温和的微笑，从稍低的位置自然俯视镜头，而不是从上方。

服装・姿势：
象牙白半袖衬衫搭配同色高腰喇叭裙的日系海洋风搭配。领口有细海军蓝线条和小丝带，不过度透明的轻盈夏季面料。脚上是白色袜子和白色厚底运动鞋。人物站在海边石板路上，重心在右腿，左腿微微向前伸出。人物用自己的右手大幅向横提起裙摆，海风让布料蓬松展开。安全的白色内短裤自然可见程度，没有低俗暴露。人物自己的左手放松在身体侧边。

背景・光线：
海滨步道。左下方是奶油色可爱的手提行李箱，带有淡米色丝带装饰。后景有蓝色大海、低矮山峦、远处灯塔般的轮廓、石柱和金属绳栏杆。晴朗的夏日午后。太阳从画面左上方强烈照射，在头发和裙边制造明亮高光。人物右侧落下柔和阴影，海面反射光让腿部和白色衣物亮堂回光。天空是淡蓝色，云朵薄薄的白色。

构图・镜头：
纵向构图。低角度全身肖像。人物大幅置于画面右侧上方，留出广阔的蓝天余白。行李箱在画面左下方，比人物脚边稍前。人物全身入镜的距离，裙子的展开横跨画面中央。镜头位置在腰部以下，略微仰视。焦点在人物脸上，背景自然浅景深模糊。不用过广角，避免腿部或脸部变形，自然的肖像表现。

质感・风格：

items.title: 新媒体数字山水极简线性艺术海报

prompts.text: Generate a new media art poster based on any subject: the visual first reveals a set of large-scale, continuous colorful layered streamlines running through the scene, like landscape contours redrawn by digital signals, crossing, turning, and interspersing on a dark information background, creating a strong sense of speed and spatial traction; the subject content does not appear as realistic illustrations, but is dismantled into pixelated white main symbols, broken blocks, and a small amount of clear color dots, distributed at the nodes and turns of the streamlines, like totems briefly appearing in data noise. The background uses dense vertical thin lines, grids, square noise, and local black faults to constitute a structural base field, with the information layer having a calm, precise, electronic screen-like order; the foreground streamlines maintain multi-layered strokes, clear edges, local dislocations, and ribbon-style stacking, allowing the winding veins of traditional landscapes and the sliced feeling of digital glitches to coexist. Colors are extracted from the material, cultural signals, and emotional temperature of the subject itself, mapped into large areas of low-brightness structural base fields, small amounts of high-brightness text and subject symbols, continuous progressive warm and cold color layers, and very small areas of jumping accent colors; the overall effect remains high-contrast, saturated but clean, with clear boundaries, bright and energetic, avoiding grayness and retro aging. If text appears, it should serve as part of the visual structure: the top or edges use large geometric sans-serif fonts and Chinese titles to form strong rhythmic blocks, while the middle and lower parts use fine small text, dates, locations, and institutional information to form a rational information zone, with compact letter spacing, clear alignment, and restrained white space; text content is generated by the theme itself and does not follow the existing semantics of the image. The final effect should look like traditional imagery rearranged by algorithms, pixels, and exhibition information systems, possessing both the flowing skeleton of Han-style landscapes and the sharpness, density, and futurism of digital media posters. Font style for the title: Design a set of minimalist linear Chinese title fonts, character features: the font is not traditional strokes but a 'single-line skeleton Chinese character': all strokes consist of ultra-thin, uniform, black lines, resembling wire, architectural floor plans, and linear sculptures. Retain the recognizability of Chinese characters but perform advanced simplification of the structure, removing brush tips and calligraphic feel. Use restrained micro-rounded corners at turns, and some closed components intentionally leave small openings, making the character shape look like an incompletely closed linear building. Vertical strokes are slender and stable, horizontal strokes are light and short, internal white space is clean, and slender air gaps form between strokes. The overall tone is calm, detached, modern, poetic, and Eastern minimalist. Characters are arranged horizontally and compactly with thin lines. No brush strokes, no ordinary thin Gothic fonts, no illustration style, no glowing, no complex decorations. Titles are eye-catching and integrated into the overall design. Subject: Different city landmarks + Good morning greeting + 2026-07-06 weather + Inspirational golden sentences + Today's Dos and Taboos.

prompts.text:
围绕任意主题对象生成一张新媒体艺术海报：画面先读到一组大尺度、贯穿全场的连续彩层流线，像被数字信号重绘的山水等高线，在深色信息背景上交叉、转折、穿插，形成强烈的速度感和空间牵引；主题内容不以写实插图出现，而被拆解为像素化白色主符号、断裂块面和少量清晰色点，分布在流线的节点与转折处，像数据噪声中短暂显影的图腾。背景使用密集竖向细线、网格、方块噪点和局部黑色断层构成结构底场，信息层有冷静、精确、电子屏幕般的秩序；前景流线保持多层描边、清晰边缘、局部错位和丝带式叠压，让传统山水的曲折脉络与数码故障的切片感同时存在。色彩从主题自身的材质、文化信号和情绪温度中提取，映射为大面积低明度结构底场、少量高明度文字与主题符号、连续递进的暖冷彩层、极小面积的跳跃强调色；整体保持高对比、饱和但干净、边界清楚、明亮有能量，避免灰脏和复古旧化。文字若出现，应作为视觉结构的一部分：顶部或边缘采用大号几何无衬线与中文标题形成强节奏块面，中下部用细密小字、日期、地点、机构信息组成理性信息区，字距紧凑、对齐明确、留白克制；文字内容由主题自行生成，不沿用画面已有语义。最终效果应像传统意象被算法、像素和展览信息系统重新编排，既有汉风山水的流动骨架，又有数字媒体海报的锋利、密集和未来感。

标题的字体风格：设计一组极简线性中文标题字体，文字特征：字体不是传统笔画，而是“单线骨架式汉字”：所有笔画由极细、均匀、黑色线条构成，像金属丝、建筑平面图和线性雕塑。保留汉字识别度，但对结构进行高级简化，删除笔锋和书法感。转折处使用克制微圆角，部分封闭部件故意留出细小开口，使字形像未完全闭合的线性建筑。竖画修长稳定，横画轻而短，字内部留白干净，笔画之间形成细长空气缝。整体冷静、疏离、现代、诗性、东方极简。文字横向紧凑排列，字体细线。不要毛笔字，不要普通细黑体，不要插画化，不要发光，不要复杂装饰。

prompts.text:
Generate a 9:16 vertical high-definition realistic ancient-style POV toasting interactive portrait, the theme is [Scene + Action].

The image should look like a real moment captured by a friend with a mobile phone during an ancient-style night tour at close range, not a commercial blockbuster, not a studio shoot, and without a high-retouching feel. Use a first-person POV composition, with the lens having a slight downward tilt feeling. A wine cup or wine pot is held up in front of the lens, forming a "wine in front, person behind" on-the-spot interaction.

The person in the image is an adult East Asian young woman, 20-25 years old temperament, soft face shape, delicate and attractive features, overall appearance leaning towards pure and sweet-sexy, with a bit of natural female charm, but without a mature heavy-makeup look. When she looks at the camera, she has a hazy feeling after being tipsy, eyes are soft, mellow, and affectionate. The makeup should be light and natural, leaning towards ancient-style light makeup. Natural and soft eyebrow shapes, very light eye makeup, keeping only thin inner eyeliner and natural eyelashes.

The person is wearing [wine red / deep berry / dark purple-red / moon white mixed with dark red / smoky purple] ancient-style or New Chinese-style clothes, the fabric is silk satin, light gauze, fine embroidery, with real wrinkles and natural light reception, not exaggeratedly shiny. Showing elegant shoulders and neck, collarbone, and natural upper body curves. Ancient-style half-up or low bun hairstyle, long black hair falling naturally, with stray hairs, flying hairs, and a slight night breeze feeling, hair adorned with pearls, jade hairpins, or small dark flower ornaments.

The action is [Toasting / Pouring wine]:
If toasting, the person holds the wine cup in front of the camera, at a position close to the viewer's eye level, as if seriously toasting you.
If pouring wine, the person holds the wine pot in front of the camera with one hand and raises the wine cup to the camera foreground with the other hand, the wine liquid is being poured into the cup, forming a clear pouring moment.

The background is [Ancient-style night tour scene], which could be a waterfront tavern, flower boat night scene, lantern-lit long street, or rainy night long street. The image includes warm-colored lanterns, ancient town buildings, water surface reflections, wooden railings, bluestone paths, a few blurred pedestrians, and other real environmental details. items.title: 全自动快消品高端广告视觉生成器

prompts.text:
ROLE

Act as a World-Class FMCG Advertising Creative Director, Luxury Product Photographer, Brand Strategist, Swiss Typography Expert, Apple-Level Design Director, Visual Merchandising Expert, V-Ray Rendering Specialist, Unreal Engine 5 Artist, IMAX Cinematographer, Global Product Advertising Art Director, Packaging Designer, and Premium Commercial Retoucher operating in FULL AUTO DIRECTOR MODE.

---

INPUT

Upload ONLY ONE product image.

The uploaded image may contain ANY PRODUCT CATEGORY, including but not limited to:

Shampoo

Soap

Lotion

Cosmetic

Perfume

Beverage

Food Product

Plastic Furniture

Electronics

Kitchenware

Home Appliances

Fashion Accessories

Household Items

FMCG Products

Consumer Goods

Industrial Products

Lifestyle Products

NO QUESTIONS.

NO MANUAL SETTINGS.

NO ADDITIONAL INPUT REQUIRED.

---

OBJECTIVE

Transform the uploaded product into a PREMIUM FMCG HERO ADVERTISEMENT suitable for:

• Product Catalog
• Amazon Listing
• Brand Campaign
• Social Media
• Billboard
• Packaging Promotion
• Website Banner
• Product Launch
• Print Advertisement

Maintain 100% original product identity.

Never redesign the product.

Preserve:

Original shape

Original packaging

Original branding

Original logo

Original colors

Original label

Original proportions

Original materials

Original product details

Original texture

The uploaded product must remain the absolute HERO.

---

BRANDING

Top Left

Automatically detect and use the ORIGINAL BRAND LOGO from the uploaded product.

If the logo exists on the packaging, recreate it cleanly and place it as a premium brand logo on the top-left corner.

Do NOT replace the brand.

Do NOT invent another logo.

Logo should appear as if supplied by the official brand.

Premium clean presentation.

---

COLOR DIRECTION

Automatically analyze the uploaded product and extract its primary brand colors.

Use these colors throughout the design.

The background, typography accents, dividers, gradients, lighting reflections, and subtle design elements should harmonize with the product's color palette.

Examples:

Black Product → Black, Grey, White luxury palette

Blue Product → White + Blue premium palette

Green Product → Soft Sage + White

Gold Product → Ivory + Gold

Red Product → White + Deep Red

Orange Product → Warm Cream + Orange

Brown Product → Beige + Brown

Teal Product → White + Teal

Pink Product → Soft Pink + White

The overall scene should feel like an official campaign created specifically for that product.

---

HEADLINE SYSTEM

Generate a premium advertising headline based on the product category.

Examples:

PURE PERFORMANCE

BEAUTY REDEFINED

CARE THAT LASTS

SMOOTH EVERYDAY

POWER IN EVERY DROP

SIMPLICITY PERFECTED

DESIGNED TO PERFORM

ELEVATE YOUR DAILY ROUTINE

LUXURY YOU CAN FEEL

SMART DESIGN. EVERYDAY USE.

AUTO GENERATE.

Never repeat packaging text.

---

SUBHEADING

Generate one premium supporting sentence.

Example:

"Designed for modern lifestyles with uncompromising quality."

or

"Premium performance crafted for everyday excellence."

Maximum two lines.

---

FEATURE SECTION

Place on LEFT SIDE.

Generate four premium text-only product features based on the uploaded product.

Examples:

Advanced Formula

Premium Quality

Daily Essential

Long Lasting Performance

Skin Friendly

High Durability

Weather Resistant

Easy Maintenance

Lightweight

Powerful Cleaning

Smooth Finish

Superior Protection

Moisture Lock

Professional Grade

NO ICONS.

TEXT ONLY.

---

HERO PRODUCT DISPLAY

Main Product:

• Large hero composition

• Product occupies approximately 70% of layout

• Premium perspective

• Beautiful balance

• Ultra realistic contact shadow

• Soft floor reflection

• Luxury composition

The product is always the visual focus.

---

MINI PRODUCT GALLERY

---

Minimal composition

Apple-inspired layout

---

角色

担任世界级快消品（FMCG）广告创意总监、奢侈品产品摄影师、品牌战略家、瑞士排版专家、苹果级设计总监、视觉营销专家、V-Ray 渲染专家、Unreal Engine 5 艺术家、IMAX 摄影师、全球产品广告艺术总监、包装设计师以及在全自动导演模式下运行的优质商业修图师。

---

输入

仅上传一张产品图片。

上传的图片可能包含任何产品类别，包括但不限于：

洗发水

肥皂

乳液

化妆品

香水

饮料

食品

塑料家具

电子产品

厨具

家用电器

时尚配饰

家居用品

快消品

消费品

工业产品

生活方式产品

无提问。

无手动设置。

无需额外输入。

---

目标

将上传的产品转化为适用于以下场景的优质快消品英雄广告：

• 产品目录
• 亚马逊详情页
• 品牌活动
• 社交媒体
• 广告牌
• 包装推广
• 网站横幅
• 产品发布
• 印刷广告

保持 100% 的原始产品身份。

切勿重新设计产品。

保留：

原始形状

原始包装

原始品牌

原始标志

原始颜色

原始标签

原始比例

原始材料

原始产品细节

原始纹理

品牌推广

左上角

自动检测并使用上传产品中的原始品牌标志。

如果包装上存在标志，请干净地重塑它，并将其作为优质品牌标志放置在左上角。

不要更换品牌。

不要虚构另一个标志。

标志应看起来像是官方品牌提供的。

优质整洁的呈现。

---

色彩方向

自动分析上传的产品并提取其主要品牌颜色。

棕色产品 → 米色 + 棕色

粉色产品 → 柔和粉色 + 白色

整体场景应感觉像是专门为该产品创作的官方宣传活动。

---

标题系统

根据产品类别生成优质广告标题。

示例：

纯粹性能

美的重新定义

持久关怀

丝滑每一天

每一滴都有力量

完美的简约

为性能而设计

提升您的日常生活

您可以感受到的奢华

智能设计。日常使用。

自动生成。

切勿重复包装文字。

---

副标题

生成一句优质的辅助说明。

示例：

“为现代生活方式设计，品质毫不妥协。”

或

“为卓越日常打造的卓越性能。”

最多两行。

---

特性部分

放置在左侧。

根据上传的产品生成四个仅包含文本的优质产品特性。

示例：

先进配方

卓越品质

日常必备

持久表现

亲肤

高耐用性

耐候性

易于维护

轻便

强力清洁

光滑饰面

卓越保护

锁水滋润

专业级

无图标。

仅限文本。

---

主角产品展示

主产品：

• 大型主角构图

• 产品占据布局的约 70%

• 优质透视

• 优美的平衡

• 超写实接触阴影

• 柔和的地面反射

• 奢侈构图

产品始终是视觉焦点。

---

迷你产品展示廊

---

极简构图

苹果启发式布局

---

prompts.text:
9-grid storyboard prompts: 1 Chilled appearance → 2 Opening → 3 Pouring → 4 Happy toasting → 5 Product freeze frame → 6 Street sports → 7 Summer scene → 8 Burst of freshness → 9 Ending freeze frame. Generate a 3x3 nine-grid advertising storyboard, vertical 9:16, each grid is a cinematic advertisement keyframe, overall a visual storyboard for a 15-second soda commercial. The protagonist is a green glass bottle of sparkling mineral water, referring to the bottle shape, green bottle body, blue and white label, and red star logo in the image, but do not show incorrect text, do not generate messy small text, keep the product premium, refreshing, and realistic. Overall style: cheerful, cool, summer, Italian street, young, rhythmic, like a combination of high-end soda brand advertising and lifestyle short films. Realistic photographic texture, bright natural light, water droplets, bubbles, ice cubes, and sunlight reflections must all be clear.

The nine-grid content is as follows:

Grid 1: Early morning sunlight shines into a bright kitchen, a green glass soda bottle emerges from an ice bucket, the bottle body is covered with fine condensation droplets, the ice cubes are crystal clear, the image is refreshing and clean, serving as the commercial opening.

Grid 2: Close-up shot, the bottle cap is gently unscrewed, instantly small bubbles and cool water mist emerge from the bottle mouth, light passes through the green glass bottle, showing beautiful highlights, the image has a satisfying "pop" opening feel.

Grid 3: Slow-motion close-up, soda is poured into a transparent glass, bubbles rise rapidly, ice cubes collide, the water flow is crystal clear and bright, the background is blurred into a summer balcony or street cafe.

Grid 4: Young friends sitting at an outdoor dining table in the sun, with glasses, lemon slices, ice cubes, and light-colored tablecloths on the table, everyone naturally smiles and toasts, the atmosphere is relaxed and happy, the image is like a snapshot of a summer gathering.

Grid 5: The product bottle is placed in the center of the tabletop, with splashing water and bubble elements in the foreground, background characters laughing and blurred, the bottle is the visual center, the composition is clean, with a commercial advertisement freeze-frame feel.

Grid 6: A young person riding a vintage bicycle through bright Italian streets, with a green glass soda bottle and ice cubes in the bike basket, sunlight spilling onto the cobblestone road, the image is light and has a sense of movement.

Grid 7: By the seaside or a fountain, holding a glass of chilled soda, bubbles in the glass sparkling, friends running or laughing in the sun in the distance, the overall feeling is like a summer holiday.

Grid 8: A fast-paced product hero shot, the green bottle suspended between ice cubes, water splashes, lemon slices, and bubbles, the background is a bright blue-green gradient light, the image is high-end and impactful, but maintains a realistic photographic texture.

Grid 9: Final advertisement freeze frame, the green glass bottle and a glass of bubbling soda placed side-by-side on a clean tabletop, with soft sunlight and a blurred summer street scene in the background, leaving space for the brand title in the center of the image, do not generate specific text, do not include logo watermarks, overall refreshing, bright, cheerful, with the high-end feel of an ending shot.

Overall requirements: Each grid has clear cinematic language, like a real advertising storyboard, no comics, no illustrations, no 3D cartoons. The product bottle shape remains consistent, the green glass texture is realistic, water droplets are real, bubbles are abundant, lighting is bright, and the rhythm is cheerful. The images are clean, no messy backgrounds, no extra text, no wrong label text, no deformed fingers, no deformed bottle bodies, no multiple different brands, no low resolution, no watermarks.

生成一张 3x3 九宫格广告分镜图，竖版 9:16，每一格都是电影广告关键帧，整体是一支15秒汽水广告的视觉分镜。主角是一瓶绿色玻璃瓶装气泡矿泉水，参考图中的瓶型、绿色瓶身、蓝白标签、红色星形标识，但不要出现错误文字，不要生成乱码小字，保持产品高级、清爽、真实。整体风格：欢快、清凉、夏日、意式街头、年轻、有节奏感，像高端汽水品牌广告和生活方式短片结合。画面真实摄影质感，明亮自然光，水珠、气泡、冰块、阳光反射都要清晰。

九宫格内容如下：

第1格：清晨阳光照进一间明亮厨房，绿色玻璃汽水瓶从冰桶中露出，瓶身布满细密冷凝水珠，冰块晶莹，画面清爽干净，作为广告开场。

第2格：特写镜头，瓶盖被轻轻拧开，瞬间有细小气泡和清凉水雾从瓶口冒出，光线穿过绿色玻璃瓶，出现漂亮高光，画面有“啪”的开瓶爽感。

第3格：慢动作特写，汽水倒入透明玻璃杯，气泡快速上升，冰块碰撞，水流晶莹透亮，背景虚化成夏日阳台或街边咖啡馆。

第4格：年轻朋友们坐在阳光下的户外餐桌边，桌上有玻璃杯、柠檬片、冰块、浅色餐布，大家自然笑着碰杯，气氛轻松快乐，画面像夏日聚会抓拍。

第5格：产品瓶子放在桌面中央，前景有飞溅水花和气泡元素，背景人物虚化大笑，瓶子是视觉中心，构图干净，有商业广告定格感。

第6格：一个年轻人骑着复古自行车穿过明亮的意式街头，车篮里放着绿色玻璃汽水瓶和冰块，阳光洒在石板路上，画面轻快、有运动感。

第7格：海边或喷泉旁，手拿一杯冰镇汽水，杯中气泡闪闪发光，远处朋友在阳光下奔跑或笑闹，整体有夏日假日感。

第8格：快速节奏的产品英雄镜头，绿色瓶子悬浮在冰块、水花、柠檬片和气泡之间，背景是明亮蓝绿色渐变光，画面高级、有冲击力，但保持真实摄影质感。

第9格：最终广告定格，绿色玻璃瓶和一杯正在冒泡的汽水并排放在干净桌面上，背后是柔和阳光和夏日街景虚化，画面中央留出品牌标题空间，不要生成具体文字，不要Logo水印，整体清爽、明亮、欢快，有结束镜头的高级感。

整体要求：每格画面都有明确镜头语言，像真实广告分镜，不要漫画，不要插画，不要3D卡通。产品瓶型保持一致，绿色玻璃质感真实，水珠真实，气泡丰富，光线明亮，节奏欢快。画面干净，不要杂乱背景，不要多余文字，不要错误标签文字，不要畸形手指，不要变形瓶身，不要多个不同品牌，不要低清晰度，不要水印。

items.title: 超强空间透视感商业海报生成指南

prompts.text:
Generate a commercial poster with a super strong sense of spatial perspective.

Camera:
Use a wide-angle lens and extreme perspective, 
adopt a [low angle / eye level / high angle / side front] view, 
place the product extremely close to the lens to create a strong "breaking out of the frame" effect.

Product:
[Fill in product name] as the absolute visual subject, 
located at the very front of the image, 
significantly larger in size than the background characters and scene, 
but keep the product structure complete, with clear edges, and avoid over-cropping.

Characters and Actions:
[Fill in character features] interact with the product in a dynamic pose of [handing out / throwing out / sprinting / leaping / swinging / reaching out], 
the character is located in the middle-to-back ground, 
and the action has a clear sense of direction and tension.

Product Details:
Focus on expressing material characteristics such as [brushed metal / transparent glass / leather texture / water droplet condensation / velvet matte / ceramic luster / plastic frosting].

Background:
Use a simple gradient background from [Fill in primary color] to [Fill in secondary color], 
avoid complex environments, 
making product outlines and character movements stand out more.

Overall Style:
High-end commercial photography
Magazine-level advertising visuals
Minimalist composition
Strong perspective
Strong momentum
The image has a screen-breaking feel and high value sense

No ordinary eye-level product shots, 
do not let products and characters be in the same depth of field, 
no complex backgrounds, 
no cheap neon, 
no product deformation, 
no hand deformity, 
no excessive edge cropping.

The core formula for this type of prompt is:

Lens perspective + Product front-placement + Character back-placement + Action direction + Material emphasis + Simple background.

Advanced Play

You can split this set of prompts into five layers:

Subject definition → Attribute description → Action relationship → Environment construction → Technical parameters.

For example:

Subject: Smartwatch
Attributes: Titanium metal, orange strap
Action: A runner sends their wrist towards the camera while sprinting
Environment: Orange gradient background
Technology: Wide-angle, extreme perspective, cinematic commercial photography.

prompts.text:
生成一张具有超强空间透视感的商业海报。

镜头：
使用广角镜头和极端透视，
采用【低机位 / 平视 / 俯视 / 侧前方】视角，
让产品极度贴近镜头，形成强烈的“冲出画面”效果。

产品：
【填写产品名称】作为绝对视觉主体，
位于画面最前方，
体积明显大于背景人物与场景，
但保持产品结构完整，边缘清晰，不要被过度裁切。

人物与动作：
【填写人物特征】以【递出 / 抛出 / 冲刺 / 腾空 / 挥动 / 伸手】的动态姿势与产品发生互动，
人物位于中后景，
动作具有明显方向感和张力。

产品细节：
重点表现【金属拉丝 / 玻璃通透 / 皮革纹理 / 水珠冷凝 / 丝绒哑光 / 陶瓷光泽 / 塑料磨砂】等材质特征。

背景：
使用【填写主色】到【填写辅助色】的简洁渐变背景，
避免复杂环境，
让产品轮廓和人物动作更加突出。

整体风格：
高级商业摄影
杂志级广告视觉
极简构图
强透视
强动势
画面具有破屏感和高价值感

不要普通平视产品图，
不要让产品和人物处于同一景深，
不要复杂背景，
不要廉价霓虹，
不要产品变形，
不要手部畸形，
不要边缘裁切过度。

这类提示词的核心公式是：

镜头透视 + 产品前置 + 人物后置 + 动作方向 + 材质强调 + 简洁背景。

 进阶玩法

可以把这套提示词拆成五层：

主体定义 → 属性描述 → 动作关系 → 环境构建 → 技术参数。

例如：

主体：智能手表
属性：钛金属、橙色表带
动作：跑者冲刺时将手腕送向镜头
环境：橙色渐变背景
技术：广角、极端透视、电影级商业摄影

items.title: 自然纹理与巨型文字融合的摄影海报

prompts.text:
Generate a visual work based on any subject that features dense natural textures and a text integration mechanism: the material, environment, or cultural symbols of the subject fill the entire frame, forming a close-up, layered, and detail-rich continuous background. The subject does not appear as an isolated object, but as a texture field for the viewer to immerse in; the primary visual reading is carried by a giant bold title positioned slightly below the center, with heavy, rounded, and clean letterforms. White or high-brightness information colors derived from the theme create a clear contrast with the background, with the edges of the title allowing a small amount of background texture to intersperse, overlap, or cut into the strokes, so the text appears embedded in the theme field rather than pasted on. Three small all-caps informational tags are kept at the top, arranged dispersedly with slightly wide letter spacing; a small curved text rhythm is added above the central title, and two short sentences and a page-number-style micro-info are used below to create pauses, with a tiny signature at the bottom. The overall information hierarchy moves from sparse to heavy and back to quiet. Colors are extracted from the material, season, mood, and narrative of the subject, retaining a large area of low-brightness but optically clean base color field, while a medium-brightness detail layer handles the texture undulations, and a small amount of high-brightness information colors is used only for text and key highlights; saturation is restrained, light and dark levels are clear, and shadows are transparent and not muddy, keeping the mood clear, quiet, immersive, and breathable. The background requires realistic detail density, slight grain, and a softly darkened photographic texture, avoiding vague illustration, decorative borders, and over-nostalgic dirty colors.

—————— (The following are defined by you)
Center text: a four-character motto

Background environment: Environments favored by top-tier nature magazines

Continuously generate 10 images, each following a different variation logic for the above instruction themes (background environment + four characters), as well as background color schemes, hue logic, and color logic.

Note: do not use serial numbers.
Similar to PPT, generate 10 images, ensuring differences between each other.
Ratio 16:9

Special emphasis: The text and environment color schemes for each image must be different!!!

items.title: 写实成年女性角色设定资料页角色一致性

prompts.text:
Based on the reference image, generate a 16:10 horizontal single-page realistic character setting data page. The reference image is the sole source of identity; all panels must maintain the same adult female: the same face, hairstyle, bangs, eye shape, nose shape, lip shape, skin tone, perceived age, body proportions, temperament, and real photo texture. No identity drift, do not make her younger, no anime/illustration/3D.

Clothing rules: If the clothing in the reference image is clearly visible, maintain the same style; if the clothing is incomplete or unclear, uniformly use a light gray thin-strap tight camisole + light gray home shorts, barefoot. Do not add accessories not present in the reference image.

The overall layout should be a clean editorial character sheet: light beige/white background, thin-bordered columns, modern sans-serif English fonts, clear and readable text, no garbled code. On the left side, an approximately 18% information column, title:
NAME / CHARACTER SHEET

The left column includes short English items:
AGE IMPRESSION / HAIR / EYES / SKIN / BODY / PROPORTIONS / OUTFIT / MOOD / SIGNATURE FEATURES
Content is only abbreviated based on visible features in the reference image. Add COLOR PALETTE (REFERENCE) at the bottom, 5 color blocks: HAIR / EYES / SKIN / LIPS / OUTFIT.

The main area contains 6 photo panels, all of the same person:
1. Main Full-Body (Front): Frontal full body, head to toe, natural standing posture, arms relaxed.
2. Head & Shoulders (Front): Frontal head and shoulders close-up, natural expression.

prompts.text:
Subject:
Summer smile by the seaside

Character/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory beige pale skin with a faint pinkish healthy glow, skin texture is smooth and delicate. Soft highlights on cheeks, nose tip, shoulders, and collarbones, not over-beautified, but retaining natural skin texture. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown gradient eyeshadow, long and thick eyelashes, slender lower eyelashes, natural aegyo-sal (tear bags). Eyebrows are light brown soft arches. Lips are coated with translucent pink-beige lip gloss, naturally shimmering in the center. Small, clear catchlights in the pupils. With a bright smile, the face is turned slightly to the left of the frame.

Clothing/Pose:
Wearing a cream-beige crochet vacation dress. Thin shoulder straps, delicate woven patterns, lace-up cutouts from the underarm to the waist, and a drawstring pleat design on the right side. The fabric is light-transmitting semi-transparent knit, but with an elegant lining structure to avoid overexposure. On the feet are matching color-coordinated thin-strap sandals. The body is leaning slightly forward, with hands naturally folded on the knees. Knees are slightly bent, the waistline softly forming an S-curve. Natural movement of the hair and dress hem blown by the sea breeze.

Background/Light:
A Japanese seaside promenade like Shonan or Hayama. To the left of the frame is the blue sea and white railings, with green hills in the distance. To the right of the frame is a white building, an external staircase, and a row of potted plants. A bright sunny day around late morning. Sunlight spills from the upper left of the frame, forming soft highlights on the face, shoulders, collarbones, and legs. Shadows of the railings fall diagonally on the flagstone path, and reflected light from the sea illuminates the shadows of the skin and clothing. The background is bright but not over-exposed or blown out.

Composition/Camera:
Smartphone vertical screen, 9:16. Full-body Japanese-style photography. The person is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, leaving a spacious blue sky margin above the head. Including the feet, showing the sandals and the shadows on the flagstone road. The camera position is slightly low, close to eye-level, a natural portrait at close range. Approximately 35mm natural wide-angle, focusing on the character, with natural, not overly shallow bokeh on the sea and buildings.

Texture/Style:
High-quality Japanese realistic photography. Bright and fresh summer tones, a refreshing color scheme of white, beige, and blue. Skin is smooth but avoids a plastic feel, meticulously depicting every strand of hair, the unevenness of the lace weave, the thin straps of the sandals, and the texture of the flagstone path.

Negative:
Appearances that look like minors, infantilization, excessive exposure, clothing that is too transparent, vulgar sexual suggestions, nudity, exposed nipples, unnecessary characters, people in the background, facial collapse, unnatural smiles, broken teeth, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, joint breakdowns, inconsistency between left and right legs, poor contact between clothes and body, floating fabric, shadows contradicting the light source, excessive skin retouching, plastic skin, blown-out whites, excessive HDR, text, logos, watermarks, obvious AI feel.

prompts.text:
主題：  
海辺的夏日笑颜

人物・表情：  
20多岁的女性。明亮的象牙米色偏白的肌肤，带着淡淡粉红血色，肌质光滑细腻。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨处有柔和的高光，不是过度美肌修饰，而是保留自然的肌理。淡玫瑰粉腮红，香槟米色与粉棕渐变眼影，细长浓密的睫毛，纤细的下睫毛，自然的泪袋。眉毛是浅棕色的柔和拱形。嘴唇涂有透亮粉米色唇彩，中央自然闪耀。瞳孔中有细小清澈的捕捉光。带着明亮的笑容，脸微微转向画面左侧。

服装・ポーズ：  
穿着奶油米色的钩针编织度假连衣裙。细肩带，精致的编织花纹，从腋下到腰部的蕾丝绑带式镂空，右侧有抽绳褶皱设计。面料是透光的半透明编织，但有优雅的内衬结构，避免过度暴露。脚上是同色系的细带凉鞋。身体微微前倾，双手自然叠放在膝盖上。膝盖轻微弯曲，腰线柔和地形成S形。头发和连衣裙下摆有海风吹拂的自然动态。

背景・光：  
像湘南或叶山那样的日本海滨步道。画面左侧是蓝色的海和白色栏杆，远处是绿色的丘陵。画面右侧是白色建筑、外楼梯和一排盆栽。午前后的明亮晴天。阳光从画面左上方洒下，在脸部、肩膀、锁骨和腿部形成柔和的高光。栏杆的影子斜斜落在石板路上，海面的反射光照亮了肌肤和衣物的阴影。背景明亮但不过度白飞。

构图・カメラ：  
智能手机竖屏，9:16。全身入镜的日式摄影。人物位于画面中央稍偏右，头部上方留出宽敞的蓝天余白。包含脚部，展现凉鞋和石板路的影子。相机位置略低，接近眼线高度，近距离的自然肖像。约35mm的自然广角，对人物聚焦，海和建筑有不过度浅的自然虚化。

质感・スタイル：  
高质量的日式真实摄影。明亮清新的夏日色调，白色、米色和蓝色的爽快配色。肌肤光滑但避免塑料感，细致描绘每一根头发、蕾丝编织的凹凸、凉鞋的细带、石板路的质感。

ネガティブ：  
看起来像未成年人的表现，幼态化，过度暴露，衣服过于透明，低俗的性暗示，裸露，露点，不必要的角色，背景中的人物，脸部崩坏，不自然的笑容，牙齿破绽，多余的手指，缺失的手指，手脚融合，关节破绽，左右腿的不协调，衣服与身体接触不良，面料浮起，与光源矛盾的影子，过度美肌修饰，塑料肌，白飞，过度HDR，文字，标志，水印，明显的AI感。

prompts.text:
Upload a clear product image first.

Create a premium 16:9 advertising key visual using the uploaded product as the exact hero reference.

The product must be large, front-facing or best-selling angle, sharply focused, and occupy 35–50% of the frame.

Keep the logo, label, packaging shape, colors, proportions, typography, and recognizable brand details accurate, readable, and unobstructed.

Use the visual system: “Branded Proof”.

Do not just make a pretty scene.
Make the environment prove the product’s benefit.

The product stays clean, pristine, and dominant.
Everything around it becomes evidence of what the product does:
before/after contrast, texture change, temperature shift, freshness, speed, impact, comfort, flavor, protection, glow, silence, energy, or luxury.

Build a strong foreground, midground, and background.
The eye should land on the logo first, then understand the benefit in one second.

Style:
premium commercial photography, cinematic lighting, agency-grade campaign visual, high contrast, tactile realism, clean negative space, realistic shadows, polished reflections, scroll-stopping composition.

Avoid:
tiny people, micro worlds, UI overlays, holograms, fake floating logos, messy clutter, unreadable labels, hidden branding, random effects, extra text overlays.

Output: one hero ad image, 16:9.

prompts.text:
You are a minimalist imagery translator, capable of transforming text, images, or a combination of both into high-level visual expressions. You do not simply describe or superficially replicate; instead, you deeply understand the core spirit, emotions, metaphors, relationships, and spatial sense of the input, condensing it into a highly restrained, calm, and philosophically resonant line-based work.

For text input, you should extract from the deep layers the core imagery with the most emotional tension, symbolic meaning, and visual value, transforming abstract concepts into concise scenes, actions, spatial relationships, or relational metaphors. If multiple sections are input, automatically filter, compress, and reorganize, retaining only the most core visual proposition without presenting surface explanations or redundant details.

For image input, you must first understand the spiritual center and structural logic of the picture, identifying the most meaningful subjects, lines, forms, emotional tension, and spatial relationships, then reconstruct them in a minimalist way, removing redundancy, compressing information, and reorganizing relationships to make the image more refined, calm, and philosophically meaningful than the original. The key is not to copy, but to perform a higher-dimensional extraction, turning it into a completely new piece of imagery.

When text and images are input simultaneously, use the spiritual direction provided by the text as a guide and the visual clues provided by the image as a foundation, comprehensively extracting the core imagery and sublimating it into a complete and profound minimalist scene.

The image must use black continuous lines on a white background with a large amount of negative space. The lines should be concise, flowing, and filled with breath and rhythm. The negative space, line intervals, formal relationships, and spatial sense should occur naturally—not mechanical or regular, but ordered. Local accent colors must be extremely minimal, refined, elegant, and meaningful, like a well-considered and naturally placed emphasis that neither overpowers the subject nor serves as random decoration. The appearance of color is a natural extension of the internal relationships within the image, not a fixed rule or parametric operation.

The overall image must present collection-level quality and high-level design thinking: elements are concise yet powerful, the structure is balanced yet subtle, and the rhythm and pauses of the lines create a sense of breathing, while spatial sense and emotional tension coexist naturally. Every line, every piece of negative space, and every stroke of accent color carries meaning, serving the expression of the core spirit. The image presents a sense of calm, deep thought, implicitness, philosophy, meditation, or poetry, allowing the viewer to feel a complete internal logic and emotional flow in silence.

The final output work is not a repetition of the input, but a high-dimensional response and visual sublimation, an extraction and condensation of the input spirit, a piece of minimalist imagery art that can be repeatedly gazed upon, savored, and felt.

画面感：35mm日本电影摄影，柔焦边缘，精致颗粒，浅而自然的景深，漂浮的高光，亲密而转瞬即逝，像一段柔软的私人记忆。

整体氛围：一个安静、私密的喜悦时刻——日常生活化作诗篇，温柔、羞涩且充满情感生命力。

items.title: 午后阳光日系居家人像摄影

prompts.text:
Subject: Afternoon Sunlight

Character · Expression:
A woman in her 20s. A composed face without childishness, natural black-brown medium-length hair, light airy bangs. Clear and elegant Japanese photography makeup, skin not overly retouched, preserving natural texture. Quietly gazing at the camera, a peaceful expression with the corners of the mouth slightly relaxed.

Clothing · Pose:
Light pink-beige ribbed camisole and matching shorts-style loungewear. Edges decorated with fine lace, no transparency, revealing parts elegantly and healthily. Reclining on a low rattan leisure chair, head leaning towards the right cushion. The right arm extends naturally toward the foreground of the frame, fingertips relaxed and drooping. The left arm is slightly bent and placed above the head, with the wrist near the cushion. Both legs extend significantly into the left foreground of the frame, with one knee slightly bent to create a sense of depth. The overall body is relaxed, but the posture does not look sloppy.

Background · Light:
A quiet apartment room. Wooden floors, light beige cushions, rattan seating, a large window on the far right, and white sheer curtains. Background furniture and decor are minimalist, with a light atmosphere of daily life. Low-angle natural afternoon light pours in from the large window in the far right of the frame, softly illuminating the face, shoulders, arms, and upper sides of the legs. Shadows fall toward the bottom left of the frame, with warm light reflected from the wooden floor subtly bouncing back onto the skin. The background is bright, and the character is bathed in warm-toned light.

Composition · Lens:
Horizontal 4:3. Close-up portrait from a slightly low angle. The character's legs are placed significantly in the left foreground of the frame, with the face towards the upper right. A diagonal composition with body lines flowing from the bottom left to the top right. Focus on the face and upper body, with the foreground legs and background slightly and softly blurred. Natural perspective with a wide-angle bias, and an intimate sense of distance characteristic of indoor photography. Not excessively sexy, finished in a Japanese photography style of afternoon indoor leisure.

Texture · Style:
High-quality Japanese photography, natural light portrait, soft warm tones, light beige and pink tones. Skin retains some pores and subtle shadows, not a plastic texture. Detailed representation of the ribbed feel of the fabric, the delicacy of the lace, and the material feel of the rattan and cushions. Low contrast, no excessive white clipping, with a soft grain similar to film photography.

Negative Prompts:
Minors, childish faces, excessive sexual expression, nudity, exposure, showing private parts, see-through clothing, over-emphasizing chest or waist, vulgar poses, brand logos, text, watermarks, identical face duplication, unnatural face or gaze, broken fingers, extra fingers, fusion of hands and feet, broken joints, floating sensation, unnatural gravity, shadows with contradictory light sources, excessive skin retouching, plastic skin, excessive HDR, over-sharpening, obvious AI traces.

prompts.text:
主题：午后的阳光

人物·表情：
20多岁的女性。没有稚气的沉稳面容，自然的黑褐色中长发，轻盈空气感的刘海。清透优雅的日系摄影妆容，肌肤不过度修饰，保留自然的质感。静静地凝视镜头，嘴角微微放松的平和表情。

服装·姿势：
浅粉米色的罗纹材质吊带背心和同色系短裤风格家居服。边缘饰以细蕾丝，无透视感，露出部分优雅健康。斜倚在藤编材质的低矮休闲椅上，头部靠向右侧靠垫。右侧手臂自然伸向画面前景，指尖松弛下垂。左侧手臂轻弯置于头部上方，手腕靠近靠垫。双腿大幅伸入画面左侧前景，一膝微屈以营造远近感。整体身体放松，但姿态不显邋遢。

背景·光线：
安静的公寓一室。木质地板、浅米色靠垫、藤编座椅、右侧深处的大窗户和白色薄纱窗帘。背景家具与装饰简约，生活气息淡雅。午后的低角度自然光从画面右侧深处窗户洒入，柔和照亮面部、肩部、手臂与腿部的上侧。阴影落向画面左下方，木地板反射的温暖光线薄薄回馈到肌肤。背景明亮，人物沐浴在偏暖色调的光芒中。

构图·镜头：
横幅4:3。略带低角度的近距离肖像。人物双腿大幅置于画面左侧前景，面部偏向画面右上方。身体线条从左下方流向右上方的斜向构图。焦点对准面部与上半身，前景腿部与背景略微柔和虚化。广角偏向的自然远近感，室内摄影特有的亲密距离感。不显过度性感，以午后室内休闲的日系摄影风格完成。

质感·风格：
高品质日系摄影，自然光肖像，柔和暖色调，浅米色与粉色的色调。肌肤保留些许毛孔与细微阴影，不似塑料质感。布料的罗纹感、蕾丝的细腻、藤编与靠垫的材质感，细致表现。低对比度，不过度白飞，略带胶片摄影般的柔和颗粒感。

负面提示：
未成年人、幼稚面容、过度性感表达、裸露、暴露、私密部位显露、透视服装、过度强调胸部或腰部、低俗姿势、品牌标志、文字、浮水印、相同面容复制、不自然的面部或视线、手指崩坏、多余手指、手足融合、关节崩坏、漂浮感、不自然重力、光源矛盾的阴影、过度美肌修饰、塑料肌肤、过度HDR、过强锐化、明显的AI痕迹。
