items.title: 天马奶茶新中式品牌视觉提案四连图

prompts.text:
Please create a set of high-completion '4 brand visual proposal images' with a unified visual system based on the following brand information.

Note:
This is not a four-grid puzzle, nor is it a summary image merging 4 contents into one frame, but 4 independent images that need to be generated sequentially in order. The 4 images must belong to the same brand visual system, but each carries a different responsibility and cannot be just repeated variations.

[Brand Information]
Brand Name: Tianma Tea (天马奶茶)
English Auxiliary Name: TIANMA TEA
Brand Type: Youthful Oriental tea brand / New Chinese light milk tea brand
One-sentence Positioning: Making Oriental tea lighter, more refreshing, and more suitable for young people's daily check-ins and sharing.
Slogan: This cup is exactly the way I like it.

Core Keywords:
New Chinese, lightweight, refreshing, youthful, Oriental aesthetics, tea-sense, milky, fruity, daily healing, photo sharing, transparency, sense of vessel.

Target Audience:
18–35 year-old young people who like milk tea, taking photos for social media, exquisite takeout, light social interaction, visual aesthetics, and brand experience.

Overall Style Direction:
Youthful, refreshing, transparent, restrained, light Oriental, with white space, sense of vessel, and product layering. Not an old-fashioned traditional tea shop, nor a cheap internet-celebrity style milk tea shop, but a more youthful New Chinese tea brand.

Main Colors:
Rice white, tea green, cream white, misty cyan, oolong gray, amber brown.

Secondary Colors:
Light apricot, light wood brown, cold gray, pale bamboo green.

Accent Colors:
Small amounts of peach pink, lemon yellow, grapefruit orange, used only to brighten individual products.

Auxiliary Graphics:
Water ripples, tea outlines, seals, small tags, Oriental frames, cup outlines, tea soup curves, pearl/coconut/lemon slice/tea icons.

Container Styles:
Transparent takeout cups, frosted cups, cold brew bottles, white porcelain cups, glass cups, wooden trays, paper bags, seals, cup sleeves, coasters.

Core Products:
1. Signature Tianma Milk Green
2. Light Oolong Milk Tea
3. Jasmine Light Milk Tea
4. Lemon Ice Tea
5. Peach Oolong
6. Brown Sugar Pearl Fresh Milk

[Unified Requirements]
1. The four images must belong to the same brand system, keeping brand name, color scheme, font temperament, auxiliary graphics, packaging logic, and product logic consistent.
2. All images should uniformly use a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, suitable for social media display and brand proposal presentation.
3. Each image is generated independently; do not make a four-grid puzzle or merge them into one summary image.
4. Overall high completion, sufficient information, strong design sense, and strong brand proposal feel.
5. Don't be too ancient/traditional, don't be too old-fashioned, and don't look too much like a dessert shop. Highlight New Chinese, youthful, light tea-sense, refreshing milk tea brand.
6. Chinese titles should be clear, English text serves as auxiliary, and the layout should have a sense of design.
7. Products must look real and delicious, tea soup layers should be clear, cup shapes exquisite, and packaging unified.
8. Generate 4 images in order: Image 1 → Image 2 → Image 3 → Image 4.

[Image 1]
IMAGE 1 | BRAND HERO BOARD / Brand Visual Cover

Task:
Generate the cover image for the entire proposal. At first glance, make people feel: Youthful, New Chinese, refreshing, tea-sense, and brand-sense.

Screen Structure:
- Top: Brand name 'Tianma Tea', English auxiliary name 'TIANMA TEA', slogan 'This cup is exactly the way I like it.'
- Middle: A cup of 'Signature Tianma Milk Green' as the core visual, transparent or frosted cup, clearly seeing the milk green tea base, milk foam or light milk layer, water droplets on the cup wall, and transparent texture.
- Around: Appropriately place tea leaves, milky elements, lemon slices, oolong tea, wooden trays, small seals, Oriental light and shadow, etc.
- Bottom: Display 4 main product small cards: Signature Tianma Milk Green, Light Oolong Milk Tea, Jasmine Light Milk Tea, Peach Oolong; add selling point icons: refreshing tea-sense, real ingredients, Oriental light drink, suitable for check-ins.

Requirement:
The image should look like a high-completion brand cover, not a common milk tea poster. It should have a brand proposal feel, product appetite appeal, and a youthful Oriental feel.

[Image 2]
IMAGE 2 | VISUAL SYSTEM BOARD / Brand Visual System Archive

Task:
Generate the brand identification system diagram, showing how the brand visuals are constructed. More systematic than Image 1, but still maintaining a refreshing, youthful, New Chinese temperament.

Screen Structure:
- Top: Brand name, English auxiliary name, slogan; the right side can be paired with a representative milk tea image.
- Middle: Modular display of the following content:
  1) Brand Identity System: Chinese 'Tianma Tea', English 'TIANMA TEA', simplified brand seal or auxiliary graphics.
  2) Color System: Rice white, tea green, cream white, misty cyan, oolong gray, amber brown, light apricot.
  3) Font System: Chinese title font, body font, English auxiliary font.
  4) Icon System: Tea leaves, pearls, coconut jelly, milk foam, lemon slices, peaches, cup shapes, etc.
  5) Label System: Oriental light drink, refreshing milk tea, real ingredients, low-burden tea-sense, youthful check-in, one cup a day.
  6) Auxiliary Graphic System: Water ripples, tea soup curves, small tags, cup outlines, Oriental linear structures.
- Bottom: Display 6 product cards: Signature Tianma Milk Green, Light Oolong Milk Tea, Jasmine Light Milk Tea, Lemon Ice Tea, Peach Oolong, Brown Sugar Pearl Fresh Milk; each has a small image, icon, and short description.

Requirement:
Do not make it a common VI manual; it should look more like a 'Milk Tea Brand Visual System Archive Board', rich in information but orderly, suitable for proposal presentation.

[Image 3]
IMAGE 3 | PRODUCT & PACKAGING BOARD / Product & Packaging Application

Task:
Generate product and packaging application images, showing how this brand is implemented as a salable tea system.

Screen Structure:
- Top: Display 4 key products: Signature Tianma Milk Green, Light Oolong Milk Tea, Peach Oolong, Brown Sugar Pearl Fresh Milk; presented using different vessels like transparent cups, frosted cups, cold brew bottles, etc., with clear tea soup layers and a realistic, delicious appearance.
- Middle: Display packaging and material extensions, including takeout cups, cup sleeves, seals, paper bags, tote bags, menu cards, ordering stickers, takeout stickers, double-cup sharing sets, etc.; uniformly continuing the brand system.
- Bottom: Display 6 complete product cards: Signature Tianma Milk Green, Light Oolong Milk Tea, Jasmine Light Milk Tea, Lemon Ice Tea, Peach Oolong, Brown Sugar Pearl Fresh Milk; add selling points: refreshing tea-sense, real ingredients, low burden, daily recommendation, check-in friendly.

Requirement:
Must have a 'realistically salable' feel. It shouldn't just be a pile of products; it must reflect the sense of packaging, system, brand, and commercial implementation.

[Image 4]
IMAGE 4 | CAMPAIGN & SPACE BOARD / Communication & Scenario Application

Task:
Generate communication and scenario application images, showing the brand's communication effect and space experience after 'Tianma Tea' enters real scenes.

Screen Structure:
- Left Main Scene: Display a 'youthful New Chinese milk tea shop' storefront scene, with the sign saying 'Tianma Tea' and English 'TIANMA TEA'. The store should be clean, refreshing, with light Oriental elements, not old-fashioned.
- Top Right: Display a mall pop-up or small tea stall, including brand posters, product displays, small menus, and packaging displays.
- Middle Right: Display two promotional posters, one featuring Signature Tianma Milk Green and the other featuring Peach Oolong or Brown Sugar Pearl Fresh Milk; poster copy can use 'This cup is exactly the way I like it.' 'Take a sip, and just relax.'
- Bottom Left: Simulate 3–4 mobile vertical social media contents, including new product recommendations, store check-ins, today's recommendations, and real ingredient displays.
- Bottom Right: Display brand touchpoints like paper bags, tissues, coasters, seals, small cards, takeout stickers, etc.
- Bottom: Add application scenario labels: New Chinese tea, youthful check-in, Oriental light drink, daily healing, real ingredients; can add an emotional slogan: 'Today is also worth a cup.'

Requirement:
More scenario-oriented and narrative than Image 3. Not a cheap milk tea shop, nor a cold and aloof coffee shop, but a youthful, refreshing, and communicative New Chinese milk tea brand.

[Execution Method]
Please strictly follow this process:
1. Internally understand and unify the brand visual DNA first.
2. Then start generating Image 1: Brand Visual Cover.
3. While maintaining the same brand system, continue generating Image 2: Brand Visual System Archive.
4. While maintaining the same brand system, continue generating Image 3: Product & Packaging Application.
5. While maintaining the same brand system, continue generating Image 4: Communication & Scenario Application.
6. Do not merge the 4 images into one, do not make a four-grid, and do not let the content of the 4 images repeat.
7. This is a sequence of 4 proposal images for the same brand, not 4 different projects.

[Final Goal]
Output a set of 4 independent but highly unified 'Tianma Tea' brand visual proposal images:
- Image 1 is responsible for setting the tone.
- Image 2 is responsible for explaining the system.
- Image 3 is responsible for product implementation.
- Image 4 is responsible for communication and scenario implementation.

The entire set should possess: unified brand visual DNA, clear page division of labor, high-completion aesthetics, commercial proposal feel, presentation quality, portfolio quality, and effects that can be directly used for brand concept display.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请根据以下品牌信息，创作一套高完成度、具有统一视觉系统的「4张品牌视觉提案图」。

注意：
这不是四宫格拼图，也不是把4张内容合并在同一个画面里的总图，而是4张需要依次分别生成的独立图片。
4张图必须属于同一个品牌视觉系统，但每一张承担不同职责，不能只是重复变体。

【品牌信息】
品牌名：天马奶茶
英文辅助名：TIANMA TEA
品牌类型：年轻化东方茶饮品牌 / 新中式轻奶茶品牌
一句话定位：把东方茶饮做得更轻盈、更清爽、更适合年轻人日常打卡和分享。
Slogan：这一杯，刚好是喜欢的样子。

核心关键词：
新中式、轻盈、清爽、年轻化、东方审美、茶感、奶香、果香、日常治愈、拍照分享、通透感、器物感

目标人群：
18–35岁年轻人，喜欢奶茶、拍照打卡、精致外卖、轻社交、视觉审美和品牌体验感的人群。

整体风格方向：
年轻、清爽、通透、克制、轻东方、有留白、有器物感、有产品层次感。
不是传统老派茶铺，也不是廉价网红风奶茶店，而是更年轻的新中式茶饮品牌。

主色调：
米白、茶叶绿、奶油白、雾青色、乌龙灰、琥珀茶棕

辅助色：
浅杏色、木质浅棕、冷灰、淡竹青

点缀色：
少量蜜桃粉、柠檬黄、西柚橙，仅用于个别产品提亮

辅助图形：
水波纹、茶叶轮廓、印章、小签条、东方线框、杯型轮廓、茶汤弧线、珍珠 / 椰果 / 柠檬片 / 茶叶 icon

器皿风格：
透明外带杯、磨砂杯、冷泡瓶、白瓷杯、玻璃杯、木托盘、纸袋、封签、杯套、杯垫

核心产品：
1. 招牌天马奶绿
2. 轻乌龙奶茶
3. 茉莉轻乳茶
4. 柠檬冰茶
5. 桃桃乌龙
6. 黑糖珍珠鲜奶

【统一要求】
1. 四张图必须属于同一个品牌系统，品牌名、配色、字体气质、辅助图形、包装逻辑、产品逻辑保持统一。
2. 所有图片统一采用竖版 4:5，适合社交媒体展示和品牌提案展示。
3. 每张图独立生成，不要四宫格，不要拼成一张总图。
4. 整体要有高完成度、信息量足够、设计感强、品牌提案感强。
5. 不要太古风，不要太老字号，不要太像糖水铺。要突出新中式、年轻化、轻茶感、清爽奶茶品牌。
6. 中文标题要清晰，英文字样仅作辅助，版式要有设计感。
7. 产品必须真实可口，茶汤层次清晰，杯型精致，包装统一。
8. 4张图依次生成：第1张→第2张→第3张→第4张。

【第1张图】
IMAGE 1｜BRAND HERO BOARD / 品牌主视觉封面

任务：
生成整套提案的封面图。第一眼就让人感受到：年轻、新中式、清爽、有茶感、有品牌感。

画面结构：
- 顶部：品牌名“天马奶茶”、英文辅助名“TIANMA TEA”、slogan“这一杯，刚好是喜欢的样子。”
- 中部：以一杯“招牌天马奶绿”为核心主视觉，透明杯或磨砂杯，清晰看到奶绿茶底、奶盖或轻乳层、杯壁水珠与通透质感
- 周围：适量摆放茶叶、奶香元素、柠檬片、乌龙茶叶、木托盘、小印章、东方光影等
- 底部：展示4个主打产品小卡片：招牌天马奶绿、轻乌龙奶茶、茉莉轻乳茶、桃桃乌龙；加入卖点icon：茶感清爽、真材实料、东方轻饮、适合打卡

要求：
画面要像高完成度品牌封面，不要像普通奶茶海报。要有品牌提案感、产品食欲感、年轻东方感。

【第2张图】
IMAGE 2｜VISUAL SYSTEM BOARD / 品牌视觉系统档案

任务：
生成品牌识别系统图，展示品牌视觉是如何构成的。比第1张更系统化，但依然保持清爽、年轻、新中式气质。

画面结构：
- 顶部：品牌名、英文辅助名、slogan，右侧可搭配一杯代表性奶茶图像
- 中部模块化展示以下内容：
  1）品牌标识系统：中文“天马奶茶”、英文“TIANMA TEA”、简化品牌印章或辅助图形
  2）色彩系统：米白、茶叶绿、奶油白、雾青色、乌龙灰、琥珀茶棕、浅杏色
  3）字体系统：中文标题字体、正文字体、英文辅助字体
  4）图标系统：茶叶、珍珠、椰果、奶盖、柠檬片、桃子、杯型等
  5）标签系统：东方轻饮、清爽奶茶、真材实料、低负担茶感、年轻化打卡、每日一杯
  6）辅助图形系统：水波纹、茶汤弧线、小签条、杯型轮廓、东方线条结构
- 底部：展示6个产品小卡片：招牌天马奶绿、轻乌龙奶茶、茉莉轻乳茶、柠檬冰茶、桃桃乌龙、黑糖珍珠鲜奶；每个有小图、icon和简短说明

要求：
不要做成普通VI手册，要更像“奶茶品牌视觉系统档案板”，信息丰富但有秩序，适合提案展示。

【第3张图】
IMAGE 3｜PRODUCT & PACKAGING BOARD / 产品与包装应用图

任务：
生成产品与包装应用图，展示这个品牌如何落地为可售卖的茶饮系统。

画面结构：
- 顶部：陈列4个重点产品：招牌天马奶绿、轻乌龙奶茶、桃桃乌龙、黑糖珍珠鲜奶；使用透明杯、磨砂杯、冷泡瓶等不同器皿呈现，茶汤层次清晰，真实可口
- 中部：展示包装和物料延展，包括外带杯、杯套、封签、纸袋、手提袋、菜单卡、点单贴纸、外卖贴签、双杯分享装等；统一延续品牌系统
- 底部：展示6个完整产品卡片：招牌天马奶绿、轻乌龙奶茶、茉莉轻乳茶、柠檬冰茶、桃桃乌龙、黑糖珍珠鲜奶；加入卖点：清爽茶感、真材实料、低负担、每日推荐、打卡友好

要求：
必须有“真能卖”的感觉。不能只是堆产品，要体现包装感、系统感、品牌感和商业落地感。

【第4张图】
IMAGE 4｜CAMPAIGN & SPACE BOARD / 传播与场景应用图

任务：
生成传播与场景应用图，展示《天马奶茶》进入真实场景后的品牌传播效果和空间体验。

画面结构：

- 右下：展示品牌纸袋、纸巾、杯垫、封签、小卡片、外卖贴等品牌触点
- 底部：加入应用场景标签：新中式茶饮、年轻打卡、东方轻饮、日常治愈、真材实料；可加一句情绪化标语：“今天，也值得来一杯。”

【执行方式】
请严格按照以下流程执行：
1. 先内部理解并统一品牌视觉DNA。
2. 然后开始生成第1张图：品牌主视觉封面。
3. 在保持同一品牌系统的前提下，继续生成第2张图：品牌视觉系统档案。
4. 在保持同一品牌系统的前提下，继续生成第3张图：产品与包装应用图。
5. 在保持同一品牌系统的前提下，继续生成第4张图：传播与场景应用图。
6. 不要把4张图合并成一张，不要四宫格，不要让4张图内容重复。
7. 这是同一个品牌的连续4张提案图，不是4个不同项目。

【最终目标】
输出一套4张独立但高度统一的《天马奶茶》品牌视觉提案图：
- 第1张负责定调
- 第2张负责解释系统

items.title: 高级时装大片禅意环境人像静禅

prompts.text:
Positive prompt:
High fashion editorial Zen environment portrait, adult East Asian beautiful female, theme "Quiet · Zen". Real photographic subject + minimalist Zen interior space + large area of negative space (white space). The image does not rely on exaggerated expressions, but carries emotions of calm, letting go, introspection, and dwelling through quiet interior space, natural light, tea sets, window courtyards, and restrained white space. Overall presents a museum-grade fine art editorial photography texture, no text, no title, no logo, no watermark.

【Core Scene】
A minimalist Zen interior space. Wooden structure, plain gray-beige walls, low wooden tea table, tatami or natural floor material, open floor-to-ceiling windows or large window views. Outside the window is a quiet courtyard landscape: trees, light-colored walls, stones, a small amount of natural plants, overall minimalist, empty, clean, and peaceful. The scenery outside the window must quietly recede, not overwhelming the subject, only serving as an extension of "breath."

【Subject】
An adult East Asian female, 24–30 years old, quiet, restrained, gentle, and introverted. Possessing real and natural bone structure, elegant but mature, not juvenile, rejecting Internet celebrity faces, rejecting anime faces. Showing real skin texture, subtle pores, facial fuzz, natural skin tone, and the natural translucency of subcutaneous fat, retaining real facial volume and optical texture. Expression is calm and relaxed, eyes slightly lowered, breathing long, lips naturally closed, not sad, not cold, not fawning.

【Action】
The person is sitting quietly by the tea set, posture steady, center of gravity stable, movements extremely gentle and slow, quietly lifting a cup to taste tea. Not a performative tea art display, but a natural, relaxed, daily Zen moment of dwelling in the present. Movement is restrained, pace is slow, as if time is paused at this moment.

【Clothing and Styling】
Wearing plain off-white, oatmeal, or light gray-beige cotton/linen texture loose robes, belonging to modern minimalist Zen clothing. Fabric is natural and soft, with real fabric texture. Hairstyle is clean and quiet, a low bun or naturally tied hair, with a small amount of natural stray hairs but overall smooth and restrained. Makeup is extremely light, presenting a clean, pure natural original beauty.

【Space Props】
Only minimalist tea sets are placed on the low wooden tea table: a small teapot and a teacup, the quantity is extremely restrained. A bonsai is placed on one side of the room as one of the only Zen objects with a strong presence in the picture. The shape of the objects is minimalist, clean, and quiet, not piled up, not complex. The entire space only retains a few necessary elements, never cluttered.

【Light and Atmosphere】
Soft diffused natural light, a single natural light source softly entering from the side of a large window. Overall low contrast, bright areas are soft and transparent, dark parts are very light, shadow edges are softly feathered, and slight tree shadows can be vaguely seen projected on the wall. With a very slight environmental micro-mist feel, subtle edge highlight blooming, and organic film grain, the air is clean and transparent, with the atmosphere of quiet morning light. Never use strong dramatic lighting, never high contrast.

【Composition Aesthetics】
16:9 ultra-wide environmental editorial composition. The lens retreats significantly, the camera position maintains a respectful observation distance. The subject is located at the bottom right of the frame, the person occupies only about 15% to 20% of the area, and the environment and negative space dominate the entire frame. The left side is a large area of window scenery and negative space, the right side is the person and the bonsai, forming an asymmetrical but visually balanced Zen composition. The environment is much larger than the person, and the person only serves as an anchor for the emotional scale. Never shoot close-ups, never shoot half-body close-ups, never use tight cropping.

【Atmosphere】
Anxiety-free, empty, relieved, introspective, morning-like calm. The space and the person together constitute a quiet Zen home life philosophy: the interior is minimalist, there are trees, stones, and natural quiet scenes outside the window, the atmosphere inside and outside are connected, and the overall is like a livable Zen life picture. This is not a commercial home advertisement, nor a common posed photo shoot, but a high-end, quiet high fashion editorial Zen portrait.

【Image Quality and Texture】
High-resolution original editorial photography, with real perspective depth and natural optical lens rendering, showing a real sense of lens space. Face, eyes, tea sets, and bonsai are clear and real, the distant background and large areas of negative space are soft and clean, not broken, not messy, not fake. With slight film grain, restrained details, the overall presents a high-end, quiet, and transparent texture.

【Negative Constraints】
Reject computer graphics (CG), reject 3D rendering, reject Unreal Engine texture, reject anime faces, reject plastic-feeling skin, reject wax-like skin smoothing, reject over-sharpening, reject cluttered decorations, reject redundant props, reject crowded tea sets, reject exaggerated poses, reject dramatic expressions, reject strong contrast, reject messy backgrounds, no text, no watermark.

prompts.text:
正向提示词：
高级时装大片禅意环境人像，东亚成年美丽女性，主题「静·禅」。真实摄影主体 + 极简禅意室内空间 + 大面积负空间（留白）。画面不依靠夸张的表情，而是通过安静的室内空间、自然光线、茶席、窗外庭院与克制留白，来承载平静、放下、内观、安住的情绪。整体呈现美术馆级的精细艺术大片摄影质感，无文字，无标题，无标志，无水印。

【核心场景】
一间极简的禅意室内空间。木质结构、素色灰米色墙面、低矮的木质茶桌、榻榻米或自然地面材质、开阔的落地窗或大开口窗景。窗外是安静的庭院景观：树木、浅色围墙、石头、少量自然植物，整体极简、空寂、干净、平和。窗外景色必须安静地向后退去，不喧宾夺主，只作为“气息”的延伸。

【主体】
一位成年东亚女性，24–30 岁，安静、克制、温柔、内敛。拥有真实自然的骨相，清秀但成熟，不幼态，拒绝网红脸，拒绝动漫脸。展现真实的皮肤纹理、细微毛孔、面部绒毛、自然肤色，以及皮下脂肪的自然透光感，保留真实的面部体量与光学质感。神情平静放松，轻微垂眸，呼吸绵长，双唇自然微合，不悲伤、不冷漠、不谄媚。

【动作】
人物静坐于茶席旁，姿态沉稳、重心稳定，动作极其轻柔缓慢，正在安静地举杯品茶。并非带有表演感的茶艺展示，而是自然、放松、安住于当下的日常禅意瞬间。动势克制，节奏缓慢，仿佛时间在此刻暂停。

【服装与造型】
身着素色米白、燕麦色或浅灰米色的棉麻/亚麻质感宽松衣袍，属于现代极简禅意服饰。布料天然、柔软，具有真实的织物纹理。发型干净安静，低挽的发髻或自然束发，有少量自然碎发但整体柔顺克制。妆容极淡，呈现干净的纯天然原生美感。

【空间道具】
低矮的木质茶桌上仅摆放极简茶具：一只小茶壶与一只茶杯，数量极度克制。室内一侧放置一盆盆景，作为画面中唯一具有强存在感的禅意器物之一。器物造型极简、干净、安静，不堆砌，不繁复。整个空间只保留少量必要元素，绝不杂乱。

【光线氛围】
柔和漫反射自然光，单一自然光源从大窗侧面柔和地照入。整体呈现低对比度，明亮区域柔和而通透，暗部极淡，阴影边缘羽化柔和，墙面上隐约可见轻微的树影投射。带有非常轻微的环境微雾感、微妙的边缘高光晕染以及有机的胶片颗粒感，空气干净通透，具有清晨宁静光线的氛围感。绝不使用强烈的戏剧化光线，绝不高反差。

【构图美学】
16:9 超宽幅环境大片构图。镜头大幅度后退，机位保持带有敬意的观察距离。主体位于画面右侧偏下方，人物仅占画面约 15% 至 20% 的面积，环境与留白主导整个画面。左侧为大面积的窗景与留白空间，右侧为人物与盆景，形成不对称但视觉平衡的禅意构图。环境远大于人物，人物仅作为情绪尺度的锚点。绝不拍摄近景，绝不拍摄半身特写，绝不进行紧凑裁切。

【氛围】
安宁、空寂、释然、内观、清晨般的平静。空间与人共同构成一种安静的禅意居家生活哲学：室内极简，窗外有树、有石、有自然静景，室内外的气息相互连通，整体宛如一幅可居住的禅意生活画面。这不是商业家居广告，也不是普通的摆拍写真，而是高级、安静的时装大片禅意人像。

【画质与质感】
高分辨率原片大片摄影，具备真实的透视纵深感与自然的光学镜头渲染，展现真实的镜头空间感。脸部、眼睛、茶具与盆景清晰真实，远处的背景与大面积留白区域柔和干净，不破碎、不脏乱、不虚假。带有轻微的胶片颗粒，细节克制，整体呈现高级、安静、通透的质感。

【负面约束】
拒绝计算机图形（CG），拒绝3D渲染，拒绝虚幻引擎质感，拒绝动漫脸，拒绝塑料感皮肤，拒绝蜡感磨皮，拒绝过度锐化，拒绝杂乱的装饰，拒绝多余的道具，拒绝拥挤的茶具，拒绝夸张的姿势，拒绝戏剧化的表情，拒绝强烈的对比度，拒绝杂乱的背景，无文字，无水印。

prompts.text:
[人物] 图像 1 [签名] 右下角位置有一个小小的由 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志，在其上方用白色手写体小字写着像签名一样的“CHAse”。

[人物的姿势及表情]
在纯白的先锋新娘氛围中，微微低头、正面强烈凝视镜头的上半身半身像（Bust shot）姿势。仿佛能洞穿灵魂的清澈而深邃的眼神，以及无法解读情感的静止表情，散发着高级定制时装模特特有的神秘而朦胧的气场。

[人物服装]
身着经典却又充满魅惑魅力的白色蕾丝材质无肩带紧身胸衣（bustier）连衣裙。精致而立体的花卉刺绣蕾丝图案与透视轮廓重叠，展现出现代却又奢华的艺术服装造型美。

[人物发型及妆容细节]
如风中飘散般柔和触碰额头和脸颊的慵懒质感黑发短发波浪（湿润刘海风格）发型。头顶随意戴着与连衣裙相配的半透明白色蕾丝面纱（婚纱头纱），以最大化神秘感。妆容是在透明瓷器般的肌肤上，将双颊和鼻梁用粉色腮红大面积晕染的梦幻“宿醉妆”（이가리妆容）风格。湿润裸粉渐层唇妆与耳边的细小珍珠耳环相得益彰。左手戴着长款白色蕾丝歌剧手套（长手套），手腕上叠戴大胆的珍珠手链（手镯），增添华丽的亮点。

[照明及光线方向]
以高强度高调（High-key）漫射自然光照明，柔和而清澈地填充整个空间。没有尖锐阴影，将人物光滑的肌肤和蕾丝细节以极致透明度照亮，并在人物轮廓周围营造出梦幻的白色光芒仿佛柔和晕染开来的大气效果。

[质感与色调氛围]
纯白的白色（White）和人物的黑发（Black），以及脸颊羞涩的柔和粉色（Pink）调为主导的极简而纯净的色彩氛围。蕾丝面料的细腻且镂空的透视质感、珍珠光泽、湿润的发丝质地，以及柔软的皮肤纹理交织融合，唤起极度精炼的艺术时尚画报般的感性。

[胶片及相机镜头景深、角度]
使用光圈 f/2.0、快门速度 1/200 秒、ISO 100、焦距 85mm 长焦定焦镜头拍摄。为了如刀刃般精确捕捉人物强烈的眼神和服装的蕾丝细节，采用正面齐眼高度（Eye-level）构图。应用极浅的景深，将瞳孔和胸衣正面锐利地保留清晰，而后方的面纱和背景则如白色薄雾般柔和地融化般进行背景虚化处理。

[背景元素（可选）]
边界模糊且透明的白色工作室空间。除了人物身后柔和飘散的面纱轮廓外，完全排除所有人工元素，使视线完全沉浸于模特的迷人视觉和白色的造型美之中。

prompts.text:
Clean, modern typographic travel poster in a 3:2 landscape format. The words "NEW YORK" — seven large, bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif letters set on a single line (or "NEW" stacked above "YORK" if better balanced) — span the full width and ARE the entire composition. Every illustrated element lives strictly INSIDE the letterforms, as if each letter is a window cut out of white paper revealing a scene; nothing spills outside the letter silhouettes. Outside the letters: pure, empty, flat white background — no objects, no cast shadows, no decoration.

— WHAT FILLS EACH LETTER (NYC-accurate, clipped to the letter shape) —
N : the Statue of Liberty — standing torch raised, following one vertical of the N.
E : stacked Manhattan brownstone facades with fire escapes nested in the three horizontal bars.
W : the Brooklyn Bridge — its two Gothic stone arches and suspension cables spanning the W's zig-zag, a small boat on the East River below.
Y : the Empire State Building — the Art-Deco spire cradled in the fork of the Y.
O : the ring frames Times Square — glowing billboards, a yellow taxi cab, a scramble of tiny pedestrians.
R : the Flatiron Building's distinctive triangular wedge silhouette inside the R.
K : Central Park greenery and the One World Trade Center spire slicing along the K's diagonals; a subway car along the base.

Small city details (a yellow cab, a hot-dog cart with faint steam, a pigeon, a subway roundel, drifting clouds) appear ONLY where they fit within a letter's interior. Keep full legibility of "NEW YORK".

— STYLE —
Elegant flat vector illustration, crisp geometric shapes, minimal detail, clean outlines, subtle shadows contained inside the letters only. Limited palette: deep navy, warm cream, muted red, soft gray-blue — a restrained warm-yellow accent used ONLY on the taxis / Times Square glow. Optional minimal tagline beneath in wide-spaced small capitals: "THE CITY THAT NEVER SLEEPS", thin and understated. Perfectly balanced centered composition.

premium flat vector, minimalist travel poster, geometric illustration, editorial tourism branding, clean typography, high contrast, ultra-sharp lines, museum-quality print, scalable SVG aesthetic, 8K.

items.title: 狂野图形化漫画风格视觉导向

prompts.text:
You are a visual director for graphic feral manga stylization.

Apply this style to any subject the user provides. The subject may be a person, animal, object, plant, building, room, garment, creature, sculpture, machine, or abstract form. Do not reduce the style to generic anime, cute chibi design, or decorative manga imitation. Translate the deeper visual logic of the style into the subject: compressed proportions, dominant graphic shapes, confrontational framing, sharp ink control, selective texture, bold flat color, and a tense balance between cuteness, severity, and animal alertness.

The central idea is the transformation of a subject into a compact, high-impact manga image built from graphic contrast, oversized focal features, and compressed emotional force. The subject should feel immediate, iconic, mischievous, and physically present, as if it is pressing into the picture plane. The image should feel designed like a powerful illustration panel or cover image rather than a naturalistic scene.

The image should not feel soft, painterly, atmospheric, or ornamental. It should feel deliberate, sharp, compressed, and graphic. Every line, contour, shadow shape, hatch, texture cluster, and patch of color must serve form, attitude, and visual punch. Avoid excess rendering. Avoid decoration that does not strengthen silhouette, expression, or tactile emphasis.

Use a restricted, high-clarity palette. Favor deep black, off-white, pale skin tones, vivid cyan or turquoise, sharp red accents, warm amber or yellow accents, muted cream, and occasional cool grey. Most color should appear in bold flat zones. Black should function as a structural force, not just a shadow color. Small accent colors should strike hard against the black and white field. Keep the palette limited and intentional.

Treat the subject as a graphic object with tactile zones. Surfaces should be differentiated clearly through line behavior and texture strategy. Hair may appear as a glossy black mass cut by highlight bands and dense vertical ink marks. Fur may appear fluffy and sharp through clustered tuft lines. Fabric may appear soft, thick, and slightly bulky through contour rhythm and selective fold indication. Skin may remain relatively clean and pale, with minimal blush or fine line detail where needed. Do not over-model the form.

Linework is essential. Use clean, confident contour lines, fine interior marks, controlled thickness variation, sparse cross-contour hatching, and selective texture buildup. Do not use loose sketchiness. Do not use soft painterly blending. Do not use overly mechanical vector smoothness. The line should feel hand-drawn, precise, lively, and intentional. It should carry personality through pressure, taper, spacing, and rhythm.

Shading should be graphic and economical. Prefer flat shadow masses, selective hatching, and carefully placed tonal accents over smooth rendering. Use shadow to carve form, compress space, and strengthen impact. Preserve broad areas of open flat color and exposed paper-like brightness. The image should feel ink-driven first, color-supported second.

Framing should be intimate, aggressive, and compressed. Use close crops. Push important forms toward the viewer. Favor frontal confrontation, low spatial depth, and poses that thrust hands, paws, sleeves, faces, or other expressive forms into the foreground. Foreshortening may be exaggerated, but it must remain readable and forceful. The frame should feel like the subject is crowding the image.

Proportion should be stylized with care. Heads may be large relative to the body. Eyes may dominate the face. Hands, sleeves, ears, or key accessories may be enlarged by perspective. However, do not let the style become generic baby proportion, mascot design, or soft plush illustration. The distortion should produce impact, stubbornness, attitude, and graphic concentration.

Expression should be restrained but potent. Favor sullen stares, narrowed focus, stubborn challenge, quiet irritation, impish confidence, animal alertness, or deadpan intensity. The subject should not grin broadly or perform exaggerated cartoon comedy unless explicitly requested. The emotional effect should come from compression, gaze, pose, and line tension rather than theatrical acting.

Eyes are a primary anchor. They may be very large, very clear, and very graphic. Irises may use a vivid contrasting color. Lids, lashes, and line weight around the eye should intensify the stare. The eyes should feel watchful, confrontational, or emotionally sealed rather than soft, dreamy, or romantic.

Hair should be treated as a major graphic mass. Use blunt silhouette control, heavy dark fill, crisp strands at the fringe, and selective highlight bands. Avoid airy salon styling, excessive shine effects, rainbow color, or decorative hair rendering. Hair should strengthen the overall black shape design.

If animal traits or costume traits are present, integrate them structurally rather than decoratively. Ears, tails, collars, fur trims, claws, whiskers, or textured garments should contribute to silhouette, pose, and tactile contrast. They should not read as random cosplay decoration. The style works best when such features intensify the subject’s feral compactness and visual identity.

For clothing, prefer clear shapes and tactile simplicity. Thick knits, padded trims, plush textures, simple buttons, sleeves, cuffs, scarves, collars, and compact layered garments work well when rendered with clarity and graphic purpose. Avoid busy patterns, fashion clutter, ornamental jewelry overload, or highly realistic fabric rendering.

For non-human subjects, preserve the same grammar. Do not force human face conventions where they do not belong. Translate the style through graphic compression, dominant focal features, close confrontation, bold silhouette, selective line texture, and limited color impact. A plant, object, building, or machine should still feel iconically flattened, tightly framed, and structurally sharpened.

Backgrounds should be minimal or nearly absent unless the subject truly requires context. Favor solid black, stark empty space, or very limited graphic framing support. Negative space is important. It allows the subject to strike harder. If background information appears, it should remain subordinate and highly reduced.

Composition should feel poster-like, iconic, and immediate. Use asymmetry when useful, but preserve strong balance through shape placement and gaze direction. The strongest visual event is usually the interaction between oversized focal features, black mass, bright accent color, and a form thrust toward the viewer.

Do not make the image soft, pastel, dreamy, cinematic, painterly, glossy, ornamental, over-rendered, sentimental, or generically cute. Do not add decorative sparkles, trendy anime clichés, speed lines, random symbols, patterned backgrounds, excessive blush, glamour lighting, fantasy aura effects, or extra detail that weakens graphic force.

Do not use generic quality language. Do not use phrases such as masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, stunning, trending, 8k, perfect, cinematic, or beautiful. Describe only concrete visual decisions.

Always preserve the essence: a compact confrontational manga image built from oversized focal features, dominant black shape design, sharp controlled linework, selective texture, bold flat color, tight close framing, strong foreshortening, and feral deadpan intensity.

prompts.text:
你是一位图形化狂野漫画风格化（graphic feral manga stylization）的视觉导演。 

将此风格应用于用户提供的任何主体。主体可以是人、动物、物体、植物、建筑、房间、服装、生物、雕塑、机器或抽象形式。不要将风格简化为通用的动漫、可爱的 Q 版设计或装饰性的漫画模仿。将该风格深层的视觉逻辑转化为待表现的主体：压缩的比例、主导性的图形形状、对抗性的构图、锐利的墨迹控制、选择性的纹理、大胆的平涂色彩，以及在可爱、严峻和动物性警觉之间的紧张平衡。

核心理念是将主体转变为一张紧凑、高冲击力的漫画图像，这种图像由图形对比、夸大的焦点特征和压缩的情感力量构建而成。主体应该给人以即时感、标志性、淘气感和物理存在感，仿佛它正挤入画面平面。图像的感觉应该像是一个设计精良的强力插画版面或封面图像，而不是一个自然主义的场景。

图像不应感到柔软、有绘画感、有氛围感或装饰性。它应该感到刻意、锐利、压缩且具有图形感。每一根线条、轮廓、阴影形状、排线、纹理簇和色块都必须为形式、态度和视觉冲击力服务。避免过度渲染。避免不能强化剪影、表情或触觉重点的装饰。

使用受限的、高清晰度的色调。偏好深黑色、米白色、浅肤色、鲜艳的青色或绿松石色、锐利的红色点缀、温暖的琥珀色或黄色点缀、柔和的乳白色以及偶尔使用的冷灰色。大多数颜色应以大胆的平涂区域出现。黑色应作为一种结构性力量发挥作用，而不不仅仅是阴影颜色。小的点缀色应在黑白场中产生强烈的视觉撞击。保持色调受限且有目的性。

将主体视为具有触觉区域的图形对象。表面应通过线条表现和纹理策略进行清晰区分。头发可能表现为被高光带和密集的垂直墨迹切开的亮黑色块。皮毛可能通过成簇的簇状线条表现得蓬松而锐利。织物可能通过轮廓节奏和选择性的褶皱指示表现得柔软、厚实且略显臃肿。皮肤可能保持相对干净和苍白，在需要的地方辅以极少的红晕或细线细节。不要对形式进行过度建模。

线条工作至关重要。使用干净、自信的轮廓线，精细的内部标记，受控的粗细变化，稀疏的跨轮廓排线，以及选择性的纹理堆积。不要使用松散的草图感。不要使用柔软的绘画式混合。不要使用过度机械的矢量平滑感。线条应该感到是手绘的、精确的、活泼的且刻意的。它应通过压力、锥度、间距和节奏承载个性。

阴影应该是图形化且节省的。相比平滑渲染，更倾向于平涂的阴影块、选择性的排线和精心布置的色调重音。使用阴影来刻画形式、压缩空间并加强冲击力。保留大面积的开放式平涂颜色和暴露的类纸亮度。图像应感觉首先由墨迹驱动，其次由颜色支持。

构图应是亲密的、侵略性的且压缩的。使用特写裁剪。将重要的形式推向观众。偏好正面交锋、低空间深度，以及将手、爪、袖子、脸部或其他有表现力的形式推向前景的姿态。缩短透视法可以夸张，但必须保持可读性和力量感。画面框应该让人感觉到主体正挤满整个图像。

比例应经过精心风格化。头相对于身体可能很大。眼睛可能占据脸部主导地位。手、袖子、耳朵或关键配件可能因透视而放大。然而，不要让风格变成通用的婴儿比例、吉祥物设计或柔软的毛绒插画。这种畸变应该产生冲击力、顽固感、态度和图形集中感。

表情应克制但有力。偏好阴沉的凝视、缩小的焦点、顽固的挑战、安静的激怒、顽皮的自信、动物性的警觉或冷面强度。除非明确要求，否则主体不应大口而笑或表演夸张的卡通喜剧。情感效果应源于压缩感、眼神、姿态和线条张力，而非戏剧化的表演。

眼睛是主要的锚点。它们可能非常大、非常清晰且非常图形化。虹膜可能使用鲜艳的对比色。眼睑、睫毛和眼周的线重应增强凝视感。眼睛应感到是警觉的、对抗性的或情感封闭的，而不是柔软、梦幻或浪漫的。

头发应被视为主要的图形块。使用钝感的剪影控制、沉重的深色填充、边缘处清脆的发丝以及选择性的高光带。避免空灵的沙龙造型、过度的光泽效果、彩虹色或装饰性的头发渲染。头发应强化整体的黑色形状设计。

如果存在动物特征或服装特征，应从结构上而非装饰上进行整合。耳朵、尾巴、衣领、毛皮装饰、爪子、胡须或有纹理的服装应有助于剪影、姿态和触觉对比。它们不应被解读为随意的角色扮演装饰。当这些特征增强主体的野性紧凑感和视觉身份时，该风格效果最佳。

对于服装，偏好清晰的形状和触觉上的简单感。粗针织衫、填充装饰、毛绒纹理、简单的纽扣、袖子、袖口、围巾、衣领和紧凑的叠穿服装在以清晰和图形化目的呈现时效果很好。避免繁琐的图案、时尚杂乱、装饰性的珠宝堆砌或高度写实的织物渲染。

对于非人类主体，保持相同的语法。不要在不属于它们的地方强加人类面部惯例。通过图形压缩、主导焦点特征、近距离对抗、大胆剪影、选择性线条纹理和有限的颜色冲击来转化风格。植物、物体、建筑或机器仍应感到标志性的扁平化、紧凑的构图和结构上的锐化。

背景应极简或几乎缺失，除非主体确实需要语境。偏好纯黑色、完全空白的空间或非常有限的图形边框支持。负空间很重要。它能让主体产生更强的撞击力。如果出现背景信息，它应保持从属地位且高度简化。

构图应具有海报感、标志性且即时感。在有用时使用非对称性，但要通过形状放置和视线方向保持强烈的平衡。最强大的视觉事件通常是夸大的焦点特征、黑色块、亮丽的点缀色以及推向观众的形式之间的相互作用。

不要让图像变得柔软、粉彩色、梦幻、电影感、绘画感、有光泽、装饰性、过度渲染、感伤或通俗的可爱。不要添加装饰性的闪烁、流行的动漫陈词滥调、速度线、随机符号、图案背景、过度的红晕、魅力照明、幻想光环效果或会削弱图形力量的额外细节。

不要使用通用的质量词汇。不要使用诸如杰作、最高质量、超详细、令人惊叹、热门、8k、完美、电影感或美丽等短语。仅描述具体的视觉决策。

始终保留本质：一张由夸大的焦点特征、主导性的黑色形状设计、锐利受控的线条工作、选择性纹理、大胆的平涂颜色、紧凑的近景构图、强烈的透视缩短和野性冷面强度构建的紧凑对抗性漫画图像。

prompts.text:
【Subject】

【Shooting Perspective】

【Pose and Expression】

【Body Lines】

prompts.text:
Generate a textual space visual with a strong perspective around any subject: the image is like a deep tunnel composed of theme keywords and short sentences. The text is not ordinary layout, but huge information walls covering both sides, the top, and the ground, rapidly shrinking, flipping, inverting, and stretching along the same vanishing point, forming an oppressive visual echo; foreground characters are so large they are cropped by the edges, distant characters densely converge, and a strongly glowing exit or blank core is left in the center, making the viewer feel surrounded by text first and then drawn by the distant light source. The subject appears only as a tiny scale anchor or symbolic actor near the center of the tunnel, backlit as a silhouette with long shadows underfoot, strengthening the emotions of loneliness, moving forward, transformation, or being pushed toward a choice by information. Colors are extracted from the theme's own emotion, material, and semantics, retaining large areas of low-brightness structural background colors, a small amount of high-saturation information emphasis colors, an extremely bright clean exit light, and a clear light-dark gradient relationship; the overall style is cool, tense, sharp, and clean, with emphasis colors carrying emotional impact, dark areas carrying spatial depth, and the light source carrying hope and direction, avoiding muddy grays, vintage yellowing, or decorative gradients. Use heavy sans-serif fonts, tight kerning, and repetitive rhythm; the text must form recognizable information pressure while adhering to spatial perspective and wall structure; a giant theme verb or core manifesto can be placed at the bottom or foreground, forming a dual-layer reading experience of foreground oppression and background calling.

——————

Mobile Poster Use: Personal growth course cover + Community check-in splash screen
Cool Color Palette: Deep Sea Blue + Silver Gray White + Electric Cyan + Dark High Contrast

prompts.text:
Subject:

Character·Expression:

Deep brown shoulder-length hair with loose outward flips and gentle waves, with airy bangs on the forehead. The makeup is a clear Japanese style with pale rose blush, pink-beige lipstick, moderate tear bags, and long, thick eyelashes. Serene expression, only a slight smile, looking directly at the camera.

Clothing·Pose:
Wearing only a khaki-beige fine-ribbed knit camisole on the upper body. The lower body is a black high-waisted bodycon mini skirt, thin black stockings, and black ankle boots. Small stud earrings and a thin chain necklace. Right shoulder and back leaning lightly against the washing machine on the right side of the frame, with the waist slightly tilted to one side. The right hand pinches a laundry card, hanging naturally at the side of the skirt. The left hand hangs relaxed by the thigh. Legs are slightly crossed, with weight on the leg on the right side of the frame. Folds in clothing, shoulder straps, fingers, and the landing of the feet should be naturally depicted.

Background·Lighting:
A self-service laundromat at night. Drum-type washing machines arranged vertically on the right side of the frame, with a detergent vending machine and old signs in the distance, and laundry baskets on the floor. The foreground on the left and right is heavily blurred with black door frames or walls, creating a sense of space as if peeking through a gap. Fluorescent lights on the ceiling shine diagonally from the top left, softly illuminating the face, collarbones, shoulders, and the texture of the camisole. Shadows extend toward the bottom right and into the distance. The metallic surfaces of the washing machines have faint reflected light, and the distant vending machine emits a bluish-white glow. Japanese text in the background blends naturally as environmental text, with details not meant to be overly clear or readable.

Composition·Lens:
Vertical 3:4. Full-body portrait. The subject is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, occupying about 70% of the screen. Bold black vertical frames in the foreground obstruct the left and right, forming a narrow visual passage in the center. The lens position is slightly below chest height, at a slight eye level. A mid-telephoto-like sense of compression, with shallow depth-of-field blur in the background. Focus is on the pupils, with the feet and the distant washing machines slightly softened.

Texture·Style:
Realistic photo style. Night low-light snapshot, similar to 35mm film grain, slightly warm-colored fluorescent light, deep shadows, skin is not over-retouched and retains natural texture. The color tone is unified in beige, black, dark green, and blue-white metallic luster. Not magazine photography, but an accidentally captured quiet documentary feel.

prompts.text:
Create a high-end pop idol typography cover with strong interaction between the person and the words.

Theme: [music cover / idol visual / pop editorial / campaign concept]

Color palette: [red / white / black / deep red / soft white]
Aspect ratio: [9:16]

The image should feel like a premium pop editorial cover or music magazine poster.

Use oversized typography as part of the composition, not just as a title.
Make the person interact with the text through overlap, masking, perspective, cropping, blur, or spatial layering.
Keep the layout clean and striking.
Use only a small amount of supporting text.

Choose one direction:

1. Dynamic red typography cover
   Use a clean white or off-white background with huge red bold letters. Show a full-body adult female pop artist in a dynamic pose, with her body interacting with the oversized text.

2. Red focus portrait cover
   Use a rich red background and a close-up adult female portrait. Add elegant white serif typography, a subtle focus frame over the eyes, and a slightly soft or dreamy atmosphere while keeping the eyes clear.

3. Kinetic idol poster
   Use a strong performance pose with dramatic perspective, such as a leg or boot closer to the camera. Add huge bold typography that gets cut by the body. Make it feel like a stage visual or music performance poster.

4. Headphone pop editorial cover
   Use an adult young woman wearing headphones in a close or half-body portrait. Add tall vertical typography interacting with the figure, plus 1 or 2 small label-style text boxes only. Keep it stylish and not too busy.

Keep it bold, clean, modern and visually designed.

Avoid cheap template layouts, too much small text, messy composition, weak typography, fake brand logos, distorted anatomy, broken hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, or cluttered sticker effects.

Generate one finished poster only.

Theme:
Morning's hurried footsteps

Character/Expression:
A female in her 20s. Fair skin with bright ivory beige tones and a faint pinkish healthy texture. Holding toast in her mouth, with a slightly panicked yet bright expression, running down the stairs.

Clothing/Pose:
White short-sleeved sailor-style shirt with an elegant navy blue collar and cuff lines, and a large, beautifully shaped navy blue ribbon. High-waisted neat navy blue pleated skirt, white socks, and black loafers. The character's right foot steps onto the step below, while the left foot bounces lightly backward. The character's left hand holds the bag strap, and the right hand is slightly raised near the hair. The skirt and hair sway naturally with the momentum of running.

Background/Lighting:
Stairs of a pedestrian bridge in front of a station. Metal railings, a covered walkway, blurred station signs and street signs in the distance. Strong morning sunlight enters from the top right of the frame, illuminating the face, shirt, legs, and the edges of the stairs. The shadows of the railings on the stairs fall diagonally, sharply highlighting the contrast between bright and shadowed areas. Add a slight white bloom effect to the air.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 2:3 ratio, full body included in the composition. Place the character slightly to the right of the center, using the lines of the stairs and railings to create a sense of depth. The lens is slightly low, looking up slightly from the front. Focus on the character, with the background naturally blurred. A frozen snapshot capturing the moment of running.

Texture/Style:
Realistic Japanese street photography. Bright summer morning, soft highlights, natural skin texture, detailed depiction where every strand of hair's movement can be seen. Hair is bright milk tea ash brown, with thin see-through bangs, layered cut around the face, and medium-length hair reaching below the shoulders. The ends of the hair are loosely curled inward, fluffing out with the running motion. The bag is a dark brown Japanese-style school bag, hung with multiple accessories such as a teddy bear, a small white plush toy, ribbons, a fluffy keychain, and beaded charms.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features or gaze, extra or missing fingers, fused hands and feet, deformed joints, floating feet, hair or skirt that does not conform to gravity, corrupted bag accessories, poor contact with props, shadows inconsistent with the light source, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks, unnecessary people.

prompts.text:
主题：
早晨的匆忙脚步

20多岁的女性。明亮的象牙米色调的白皙肌肤，带着淡淡粉红血色的自然肌理。淡玫瑰粉色的腮红，香槟米色与粉棕色的眼影，细长浓密的睫毛，自然的泪袋，透出感的粉米色唇膏。瞳孔中有小小的捕捉光点。嘴里叼着吐司，略带慌张却又明亮的表情，跑下楼梯。

白色短袖水手风衬衫，优雅的海军蓝领子和袖口线条，大而形状优美的海军蓝丝带。高腰整齐的海军蓝百褶裙，白色袜子，黑色乐福鞋。人物右脚踏向下方的台阶，左脚向后轻盈地弹起。人物左手握住包的肩带，右手在头发附近微微抬起。裙子和头发随着奔跑的势头自然摇曳。

背景・光线：
位于车站前的步行桥楼梯。金属扶手，有顶棚的通道，远处模糊的车站指示牌和街头招牌。早晨的强烈阳光从画面右上方射入，照亮脸庞、衬衫、双腿和楼梯边缘。楼梯上扶手的影子斜向落下，鲜明地突出明亮部分与阴影部分的对比。在空气中稍稍加入白色光晕的晕染。

构图・镜头：
纵向2:3，全身纳入构图。将人物置于中央稍偏右的位置，用楼梯和扶手的线条营造纵深感。镜头稍低，从正面略微仰视的角度。焦点对准人物，背景自然模糊。捕捉奔跑瞬间的定格快照照片。

质感・风格：
真实的日系街头摄影。明亮的夏日早晨，柔和的高光，自然的肌肤质感，能看到每一根头发的流动的细腻描绘。头发是明亮的奶茶灰棕色，薄薄的透视刘海，围绕脸庞的层次剪裁，及肩下的中长发。发梢向内松散卷曲，随着奔跑动作蓬松展开。包是深棕色的日式校服包，挂着泰迪熊、小小的白色毛绒玩具、丝带、毛茸茸的钥匙扣、串珠挂饰等多个饰品。

负面提示：
不自然的五官或视线，多余或缺失的手指，手脚融合，关节变形，悬空的脚，不符合重力的头发或裙子，包饰品的崩坏，与道具接触不良，与光源矛盾的影子，过度美肌修饰，塑料般的肌肤，文字乱码，标志，水印，不必要的人物。

It should look like a high-end brand archive board, not a promotional flyer or an e-sports style control panel. [Image 3] IMAGE 3 | PRODUCT & PACKAGING BOARD Task: Generate product and packaging application images, showing how 'Suo Fen Ju' is implemented as a sellable product system. Make people feel at a glance that this brand can be dine-in, takeout, retail, and sold on shelves. Composition: Top displays 4 key finished products: 1. Signature Classic Snail Noodles 2. Super Spicy Red Oil Snail Noodles 3. Fried Egg Snail Noodles 4. Pork Intestine Snail Noodles. Finished products should be presented using high-end food photography, with red oil, rice noodles, fried egg, sour bamboo shoots, yuba, peanuts, wood ear, and green vegetables clearly visible. The food area should be bright, with steam, oil glisten, and layers. Middle displays the complete packaging system: Bagged home-version snail noodles, Tubed/Cup-packed instant version, Takeout bowls, Tote bags, Takeout bags, Seals, Chopstick sleeves, Menu cards, Brand stickers, Receipts, Ingredient pack breakdown: red oil pack, sour bamboo shoot pack, yuba pack, peanut pack, vinegar pack, soup base pack. Packaging style uses warm charcoal grey, bone soup cream white, chili oil orange-red, sour bamboo shoot yellow, yuba gold; do not make it look like traditional local specialty packaging. It should have modernity, youthfulness, texture, and SKU differentiation. Bottom displays 6 complete SKU product cards: 1. Signature Classic Snail Noodles 2. Super Spicy Red Oil Snail Noodles 3. Fried Egg Snail Noodles 4. Pork Intestine Snail Noodles 5. Double Yuba Snail Noodles 6. Deluxe Double-Mix Snail Noodles. Each product card includes a product image, name, number, and highlight labels. Selling points can be added: Hardcore Red Oil / Soulful Sour Bamboo Shoots / Fried Egg Must-Order / Midnight Life-Saver / Extra Spicy Warning. If space allows, add topping recommendations: Extra sour bamboo shoots / One more fried egg / Extra pork intestine / Double yuba. Requirements: Must have a 'truly sellable' feel. Not just a pile of products, but reflecting the product system, packaging system, takeout system, and retail system. The overall look should be like a high-end food retail brand proposal. [Image 4] IMAGE 4 | CAMPAIGN & SPACE BOARD Task: Generate communication and scene application images, showing the effect of 'Suo Fen Ju' in the real world. Focus on presenting a complete brand landing of 'Late-night Store + Night Snack Stall + Takeout Communication + Social Media Communication'. Composition: Large main scene on the left: Display a textured late-night store, street-side shop, or night snack stall. The storefront clearly says '嗦粉局', can carry the English 'SLURP CLUB', and displays the slogan 'Tonight, slurp first.' The scene should have warm light, smoky atmosphere, pickup window, counter, finished noodle display, ingredient area, takeout pickup area, a few young customers or staff. The overall atmosphere is midnight, warm, appetizing, making people want to go in and slurp a bowl; do not make it overly dark. Top right module: Display a small night snack pop-up stall or brand event stand, including light boxes, menu boards, product displays, packing bags, brand posters, etc. Middle right module: Display two brand promotion posters: One featuring Fried Egg Snail Noodles, One featuring Super Spicy Red Oil Snail Noodles. Poster copy can use: Tonight, slurp first. Slurp once obsessed, don't sleep tonight. Midnight life-saver, come for a hardcore bowl. Extra spicy warning. Bottom left module: Simulate 3–4 mobile vertical social media content cards: New product recommendations, Fried egg must-order, Extra spicy warning, Night snack recommendation. Each social media card maintains a unified brand style, but not all black/red; food images should stand out. Bottom right module: Display brand touchpoints: Takeout bags, receipts, chopstick sleeves, stickers, napkins, packaging seals, takeout packaging, brand small cards. Bottom info area: Display scene labels: Midnight Store / Night Snack Stall / Takeout Recommendation / Street Smoke & Fire / Youth Community. An emotional slogan can be added: It's late, time for a hardcore bowl. Requirements: This image should have more sense of scene, communication, and storytelling than Image 3. Not a common snack shop or a rustic night market stall, but a youthful, design-oriented night snack brand space with warm light texture. [Execution Method] Please strictly follow the process below: 1. Unify the brand visual DNA internally first. 2. Generate Image 1: Dark Red Oil Hero Board. 3. Under the same brand system, continue to generate Image 2: Midnight Visual System Board. 4. Under the same brand system, continue to generate Image 3: Product & Packaging Board. 5. Under the same brand system, continue to generate Image 4: Campaign & Space Board. 6. Do not merge the 4 images into one, do not make a four-grid, do not repeat the content of the 4 images. 7. Each image is an independent vertical 4:5 brand proposal image. [Final Goal] Output a set of 4 independent but highly unified '嗦粉局 SLURP CLUB' brand visual proposal images: Image 1 sets the tone. Image 2 explains the system. Image 3 handles product and packaging implementation. Image 4 handles communication and scene implementation. The entire result should possess: Unified brand visual DNA, clear page division, high-finish aesthetics, appetite impact, commercial proposal feel, packaging system feel, scene landing feel, and portfolio quality directly usable for brand concept presentation.

prompts.text:
请根据以下品牌信息，创作一套高完成度、具有统一视觉系统的「4张品牌视觉提案」。

注意：
这不是一张四宫格拼图，也不是把4张内容合并在同一个画面里的总图，而是一套需要“依次分别生成”的4张独立图片。请在同一个品牌视觉系统下，连续完成这4张图的生成。4张图必须明显属于同一个品牌，但每一张图承担不同职责，不能只是4张重复变体。

【品牌信息】

品牌名：嗦粉局
英文名：SLURP CLUB
品牌概念：深夜上头计划
品牌类型：年轻化新派螺蛳粉品牌 / 夜宵品牌
Slogan：今晚，先嗦为敬。

一句话定位：
把一碗够臭、够辣、够上头的螺蛳粉，做成年轻人更愿意买、更愿意拍、更愿意分享的夜宵品牌。

核心关键词：
螺蛳粉、夜宵、上头、红油、酸笋、炸蛋、腐竹、重口、烟火气、年轻潮流、深夜续命、食欲冲击、外卖友好、包装感、品牌提案感。

目标人群：
18–35岁年轻人，夜宵消费人群，重口味爱好者，喜欢拍照打卡、刷外卖、追求刺激口味和强记忆点美食的人群。

【整体视觉方向】

不要做成传统地方特产包装，也不要做成廉价网红小吃海报。
整体要像一个年轻化、有设计感、有质感、有商业落地感的夜宵餐饮品牌提案。

视觉关键词：
暖光夜宵、红油食欲、食材本色、金属质感、米白卡片、烟火气、年轻品牌、提案感、高级感。

配色方向：
不要使用过度黑红硬撞的配色，不要整张图黑底红字，也不要红色铺满全画面。

请使用更有层次的配色系统：

主背景色：
暖炭灰、深烟灰、深灰褐、黑色磨砂质感。

主强调色：
辣油橘红、红油红、砖红，而不是刺眼正红。

信息承载色：
骨汤米白、暖米白、浅米灰，用于菜单卡、小票、SKU卡、标签卡、说明模块。

辅助食材色：
酸笋黄、腐竹金、炸蛋金黄、卤蛋棕。

小面积点缀：
葱花绿、不锈钢灰、少量暖光橙。

材质语言：
不锈钢托盘、金属餐盘、暖光灯箱、哑光包装袋、纸质菜单、小票纸、封签贴纸、塑封膜反光、热气、红油高光。

辅助图形：
红油波纹、面条轨迹线、碗口圆形、小票撕边、筷子斜切线、辣椒icon、酸笋icon、腐竹icon、木耳icon、花生icon、炸蛋icon、标签贴纸、小票编号系统。

标签文案可使用：
上头警告、夜宵推荐、加辣必点、炸蛋加满、酸笋灵魂、深夜续命、一嗦上头、今晚先嗦、重口爱好者。

核心产品：

1. 招牌经典螺蛳粉
2. 爆辣红油螺蛳粉
3. 炸蛋螺蛳粉
4. 肥肠螺蛳粉
5. 腐竹双倍螺蛳粉
6. 豪华双拼螺蛳粉

【统一要求】

1. 四张图必须属于同一个品牌系统，品牌名、字体气质、配色、辅助图形、标签系统、产品逻辑保持统一。
2. 所有图片统一使用竖版4:5，适合社交媒体展示和品牌提案展示。
3. 每张图独立生成，不要四宫格，不要拼成一张总图。
4. 整体要高完成度、信息量足够、设计感强、品牌提案感强，不要太简陋，不要太空。
5. 画面要有食欲冲击，但不要过度暗黑，不要红黑过载。
6. 要突出暖光、食材本色、金属质感、米白信息卡和红油层次。
7. 产品必须真实诱人，红油、酸笋、腐竹、炸蛋、花生、木耳、青菜、米粉层次清晰。
8. 中文标题要清晰，英文字样作为辅助，整体排版要有商业提案感。

【第1张图】

IMAGE 1｜DARK RED OIL HERO BOARD / 暗夜红油主视觉

任务：
生成整套提案的品牌主视觉封面图。第一眼就让人感受到：夜宵、热辣、上头、螺蛳粉、年轻潮流、食欲冲击和品牌质感。

画面结构：
顶部展示品牌名“嗦粉局”、英文名“SLURP CLUB”、slogan“今晚，先嗦为敬。”，以及“深夜上头计划”等信息。

中部以一碗“炸蛋螺蛳粉”为绝对主视觉中心。
使用黑色陶瓷碗、深色餐具或不锈钢托盘，碗中必须清晰看到红油汤底、米粉、炸蛋、酸笋、腐竹、木耳、花生、青菜、葱花，可少量加入卤蛋或肉片。食物要有热气、油光和真实食材层次。

周围可摆放辣椒、酸笋小料碟、筷子、小票、调料碗等细节。
背景使用暖炭灰、深烟灰、金属灰，不要纯黑死黑。
标题和重点标签使用辣油橘红，信息卡片使用骨汤米白，提升层次和可读性。

底部展示4个主打产品小卡片：

1. 招牌经典螺蛳粉
2. 爆辣红油螺蛳粉
3. 炸蛋螺蛳粉
4. 肥肠螺蛳粉

加入卖点标签：
红油够狠 / 酸笋够灵魂 / 深夜续命 / 一嗦上头

要求：
不要做成普通餐饮海报，要像高完成度、年轻化、有质感的品牌主视觉封面。画面要冲击强，但不能黑红糊成一片。

【第2张图】

IMAGE 2｜MIDNIGHT VISUAL SYSTEM BOARD / 夜宵视觉系统档案

任务：
生成品牌识别系统图，展示《嗦粉局》的视觉系统构成。它不是普通VI手册，而要像“夜宵菜单档案板 + 品牌识别系统 + 小票标签体系”的高级提案板。

画面结构：
顶部展示品牌名“嗦粉局”、英文名“SLURP CLUB”、slogan“今晚，先嗦为敬。”，可加入一张小型螺蛳粉主碗图作为视觉锚点。

中部模块化展示以下内容：

1）品牌标识系统
中文字标“嗦粉局”、英文字标“SLURP CLUB”、印章版、横版、竖版、简化标识。

2）色彩系统
辣油橘红、暖炭灰、骨汤米白、酸笋黄、腐竹金、不锈钢灰、葱花绿。
色块要有命名和层次，不要全部使用黑红。

3）字体系统
中文主标题字体、中文辅助字体、英文辅助字体、标签字体。
示例词可包括：嗦粉局、今晚先嗦为敬、上头警告、夜宵推荐。

4）图标系统
辣椒、酸笋、腐竹、木耳、花生、卤蛋、炸蛋、筷子、米粉、红油。

5）标签贴纸系统
上头警告、加辣必点、炸蛋加满、夜宵推荐、酸笋灵魂、深夜续命、重口爱好者、越嗦越上头。
这些标签可以做成小票签条、贴纸、印章、菜单标签。

6）辅助图形系统
红油波纹、面条轨迹线、小票撕边、碗口圆形、筷子斜线、热气线条。

7）SKU编码系统
01 招牌经典
02 爆辣红油
03 炸蛋
04 肥肠
05 腐竹双倍
06 豪华双拼

底部展示6个SKU产品小卡片，每个卡片有小图、编号、名称、辣度或卖点标签。

要求：
整体要有设计感和系统感，使用骨汤米白卡片承载信息，避免整张图过度黑红。要像高级品牌档案板，不像促销单，也不像电竞风控制面板。

【第3张图】

IMAGE 3｜PRODUCT & PACKAGING BOARD / 夜宵产品矩阵与包装系统

任务：
生成产品与包装应用图，展示《嗦粉局》如何落地为可售卖的产品系统。让人一眼觉得这个品牌可以堂食、外卖、零售、上架售卖。

画面结构：
顶部展示4款重点成品：

1. 招牌经典螺蛳粉
2. 爆辣红油螺蛳粉
3. 炸蛋螺蛳粉
4. 肥肠螺蛳粉

成品要使用高级餐饮摄影方式呈现，红油、米粉、炸蛋、酸笋、腐竹、花生、木耳、青菜都要清晰可见，食物区域要明亮、有热气、有油光、有层次。

中部展示完整包装系统：

* 袋装家庭版螺蛳粉
* 桶装/杯装即食版
* 外卖碗
* 手提袋
* 外卖袋
* 封签
* 筷套
* 菜单小卡
* 品牌贴纸
* 小票
* 小料包拆解：红油包、酸笋包、腐竹包、花生包、醋包、汤底包

包装风格使用暖炭灰、骨汤米白、辣油橘红、酸笋黄、腐竹金，不要做成传统土特产包装。
要有现代感、年轻感、质感和SKU区分。

底部展示6个完整SKU产品卡片：

1. 招牌经典螺蛳粉
2. 爆辣红油螺蛳粉
3. 炸蛋螺蛳粉
4. 肥肠螺蛳粉
5. 腐竹双倍螺蛳粉
6. 豪华双拼螺蛳粉

每个产品卡片包含产品小图、名称、编号、亮点标签。
可加入卖点：
红油够狠 / 酸笋够灵魂 / 炸蛋必点 / 深夜续命 / 加辣警告

如空间允许，增加加料推荐：
酸笋加量 / 炸蛋加一 / 肥肠加料 / 腐竹双倍

要求：
必须有“真能卖”的感觉。不能只是堆产品，要体现产品系统、包装系统、外卖系统和零售系统。整体要像高级餐饮零售品牌提案。

【第4张图】

IMAGE 4｜CAMPAIGN & SPACE BOARD / 深夜门店与传播场景

任务：
生成传播与场景应用图，展示《嗦粉局》进入真实世界后的效果。重点呈现“深夜门店 + 夜宵档口 + 外卖传播 + 社媒传播”的完整品牌落地。

画面结构：
左侧大主场景：
展示一个有质感的深夜门店、街边小店或夜宵档口。
门头清晰写着“嗦粉局”，可带英文“SLURP CLUB”，展示slogan“今晚，先嗦为敬。”
场景要有暖光、烟火气、取餐口、柜台、成品粉展示、小料区、外卖取餐区、少量年轻顾客或店员。
整体是深夜、温暖、有食欲、想进去嗦一碗的氛围，不要过度暗黑。

右上模块：
展示小型夜宵快闪摊位或品牌活动摊，包含灯箱、菜单牌、产品展示、打包袋、品牌海报等。

右中模块：
展示两张品牌宣传海报：
一张主打炸蛋螺蛳粉
一张主打爆辣红油螺蛳粉

海报文案可使用：
今晚，先嗦为敬。
一嗦上头，今夜别睡。
深夜续命，来碗狠的。
加辣警告。

左下模块：
模拟3–4张手机竖图式社媒内容：
新品推荐、炸蛋必点、加辣警告、夜宵推荐。
每张社媒卡片保持统一品牌风格，但不要全黑全红，食物图要突出。

右下模块：
展示品牌触点：
外卖袋、小票、筷套、贴纸、纸巾、打包封签、外卖包装、品牌小卡。

底部信息区：
展示场景标签：
深夜门店 / 夜宵档口 / 外卖推荐 / 街边烟火 / 年轻社群

可加入一句情绪化标语：
夜深了，该来一碗狠的。

要求：
这张要比第3张更有场景感、传播感和故事感。
不是普通小吃店，也不是土味夜宵摊，而是年轻化、有设计感、有暖光质感的夜宵品牌空间。

【执行方式】

请严格按照以下流程执行：

1. 先内部统一品牌视觉DNA。
2. 生成第1张图：暗夜红油主视觉。
3. 在同一品牌系统下，继续生成第2张图：夜宵视觉系统档案。
4. 在同一品牌系统下，继续生成第3张图：夜宵产品矩阵与包装系统。
5. 在同一品牌系统下，继续生成第4张图：深夜门店与传播场景。
6. 不要把4张图合并成一张，不要做四宫格，不要让4张图内容重复。
7. 每张图都是独立的竖版4:5品牌提案图。

【最终目标】

输出一套4张独立但高度统一的《嗦粉局 SLURP CLUB》品牌视觉提案图：

第1张负责定调
第2张负责解释系统
第3张负责产品和包装落地
第4张负责传播和场景落地

整套结果应具备：
统一的品牌视觉DNA、清晰的页面分工、高完成度审美、食欲冲击、商业提案感、包装系统感、场景落地感，以及可直接用于品牌概念展示的作品集质量。

items.title: 奢华身体乳微缩景观产品广告

prompts.text:
Create a hyper-realistic miniature diorama product advertisement centered on an oversized luxury skincare pump bottle labeled "LUXEVEIL Skin Science – Radiance Nourishing Body Lotion". The bottle should be cream/beige with a polished gold pump, standing on a circular display platform.

Surround it with tiny construction-worker figurines in yellow coveralls and white hard hats. Show them climbing scaffolding, painting the bottle with rollers, operating a tower crane, working around industrial tanks and pipework, and unloading supplies from a miniature flatbed truck.

Add detailed metal scaffolds, industrial silos, orange traffic cones, wooden barricades, storage barrels, and small worksite props so the scene feels like the lotion is being carefully built or crafted. Keep the concept as a premium visual metaphor for creating the perfect lotion.

items.title: 沙漠白风西部时尚人像

prompts.text:
Subject:
Desert White Wind

Character ・ Expression:
Woman in her 20s. Bright ivory beige whitish skin tone with a natural texture and a faint pink flush. Soft highlights on cheeks, tip of nose, shoulders, and collarbones. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long and dense eyelashes, natural tear bags, light brown eyebrows, translucent pink-beige lip gloss. Small and clear pupils catching light. Calm and confident gaze, looking at the camera with a slight coolness.

Clothing ・ Pose:
Bright milk tea gray-brown medium-length hair. Thin see-through bangs, layers around the face, ends loosely curled inward, fine wisps of hair gently fluttering in the wind. Light brown cowboy hat. A white to ivory cropped western shirt knotted at the front, decorated with delicate stitching, small metal rivets, and decorative shoulder lines at the chest and hem. Black bikini top worn underneath. Blue denim shorts with fringe, moderate distressing, side rivets, a thick brown leather belt and a large carved buckle. Body slightly turned to the side, a cool standing pose with the hips shifted significantly. The character touches the brim of the hat with the right hand and places the left hand near the belt. Fingertips are naturally curved, in correct contact with clothing and skin.

Background ・ Lighting:
A path in a dry desert. Foreground is sandy ground and low bushes, midground is sparse cacti and shrubs, background is reddish-brown mesas and rocky mountains. Sky is vivid blue with white clouds drifting horizontally. Strong midday sunlight enters from the upper left of the frame, hat brim casts a thin shadow on the face. Bright light reflects off the shirt, skin, and denim. Shadows extend toward the lower right of the frame, background has a slightly bright and dry air feel.

Composition ・ Lens:
Vertical 3:4. A fashion portrait from above the thighs to the top of the head. Character is located slightly to the right of the center, with body lines forming a diagonal flowing composition. Small amount of empty space left at the top of the hat, waist and belt placed at the lower part of the frame. Shot slightly upwards from a position slightly below the chest. Background uses shallow depth of field for soft blurring, focus is concentrated on the face and clothing details.

Texture ・ Style:
Realistic photo style. Elegant and cool finish like an overseas location fashion magazine. Skin is not over-retouched, preserving natural pores and soft luster. Hair strands, shirt stitching, denim wear, belt leather and metal textures are all finely depicted. Emphasize the contrast between vivid blue sky, dry sand color, white shirt, black top, and milk tea brown hair.

Negative Prompt:
Expressions that look like a minor, unnatural facial features or gaze, excessive exposure, excessive skin retouching, plastic skin, extra or missing fingers, fused fingers, deformed joints, poor contact between hat or clothing, floating hands, distorted belt, broken denim, shadows contradicting the light source, unnatural perspective, extra characters, text, logos, watermarks.

主题：
沙漠的白风

20多岁的女性。明亮的象牙米色偏白肤色，带有淡淡粉红血色的自然肌理。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨处有柔和的高光。淡玫瑰粉色的腮红、香槟米色与粉棕色的眼影、细长浓密的睫毛、自然的泪袋、较亮的棕色眉毛、透亮感的粉米色唇彩。小而清澈的瞳孔带有捕捉光线。目光平静自信，略带凉意地注视着镜头。

服装・姿势：
明亮的奶茶灰棕色中长发。薄薄的透视刘海、脸部周围的层次感，发梢向内松散卷曲，被风吹起细细的碎发轻轻飘动。淡棕色的牛仔帽。白色至象牙色的裁剪西部衬衫在前方打结，胸口和下摆处饰以精致的缝线、小型金属铆钉、装饰性的肩线。内搭黑色比基尼上衣。蓝色牛仔短裤带有流苏、适度磨损处理、侧面铆钉、粗实的棕色皮革腰带和大型雕刻扣环。身体略微侧向，腰部大幅偏移的酷感站姿。人物用右手轻触帽檐，左手置于腰带旁。指尖自然弯曲，与衣物和皮肤正确接触。

背景・光线：
干燥沙漠的一条小路。近景为沙地和低矮草丛，中景为稀疏的仙人掌和灌木，远景为红褐色的台地和岩山。天空是鲜艳的蓝色，白云横向飘流。午间强烈的阳光从画面左上方射入，帽檐在脸上投下薄薄的阴影。衬衫、皮肤、牛仔布上反射出明亮的光芒。阴影向画面右下方延伸，背景带有略微明亮而干燥的空气感。

构图・镜头：
纵向3:4。从大腿上方至头顶的时尚肖像。人物位于画面中央稍偏右，身体线条呈斜向流动的构图。帽子顶部留出少许空白，腰部和腰带置于画面下部。镜头从胸部下方稍低的位置轻微仰拍。背景采用浅景深柔和虚化，焦点集中在脸部和服装细节。

质感・风格：
真实照片风格。如海外外景时尚杂志般优雅而酷感的成品。皮肤不过度修饰，保留自然的毛孔和柔和光泽。发丝一根根、衬衫的缝线、牛仔布的磨损、腰带的皮革与金属质感均细致描绘。强调鲜艳蓝天、干燥沙色、白衬衫、黑上衣、奶茶棕色头发的对比。

负面提示：
看起来像未成年人的表现、不自然的五官或视线、过度暴露、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的皮肤、多余或缺失的手指、手指融合、关节变形、帽子或衣物接触不良、悬浮的手、扭曲的腰带、破损的牛仔布、与光源矛盾的阴影、不自然的透视法、多余人物、文字、标志、水印。

prompts.text:
Generate a commemorative card-style visual with personal handwriting traces based on any subject: The visual first establishes emotion with an exaggerated and free handwritten main title at the top, the font looks like a thick marker or wet brush written directly on light-colored white space, with varying stroke sizes and slight jumping, and some characters pressing close to the edges of the central image, creating an intimate, improvised, and hand-marked first impression. The core content is placed in a clear rectangular image area in the center with soft corners, carrying the narrative with high-contrast monochrome imagery or a monochromatized main visual of the subject, preserving real light and shadow, textures, and clear subject outlines; loose breathing space is kept outside the image, allowing the handwritten text, image, and white space to form a reading rhythm that is heavy on top and stable at the bottom. A small number of hand-drawn symbols are placed close to the subject, like improvised stars, sparkles, curves, or indicative strokes, with restrained quantity, responsible only for creating a sense of celebration and visual focal points. The information text below is arranged in layers using thinner, more relaxed handwriting, with main information thicker and larger, and explanatory text thinner and lighter, overall resembling a private invitation, commemorative announcement, or handmade note rather than a neatly typeset commercial poster. Colors are extracted from the material, emotion, and scene semantics of the subject itself, maintaining the role relationship between a large area of bright and clean background color, the central monochrome image, a small amount of clear high-saturation emphasis colors, and text with distinct light and dark; emphasis colors are concentrated on the handwritten titles and graffiti, with a small area but strong presence, the mood is bright and brisk, clear and vivid, avoiding dirty gray, stale, smoky, or heavy filters. The overall sense of completion should be like a real photo re-endowed with a sense of ritual by someone using handwriting and graffiti, where the thick and thin strokes, white space distances, image boundaries, and information density must be visible yet orderly.

Character/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory beige whitish skin tone with a faint pinkish natural texture. Soft highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long and thick eyelashes, natural aegyo-sal (tear bags), light brown eyebrows, translucent pink-beige lip gloss. Small clear catchlights in the pupils. Looking at the camera with a soft smile.

Clothing/Pose:
White to ivory girly Japanese streetwear. Ruffled sleeve shirt, large satin ribbon tie, high-waist pleated mini skirt, lace hem, thin chain and small ribbon decorations. White ruffled socks, platform white lace-up shoes. The right arm is stretched out significantly toward the camera, making the palm and fingers appear large in the foreground. The left hand is slightly open near the cheek. Standing on one leg with the other leg bent backward. The thickness of the legs and thighs is natural, balanced on both sides.

Background/Lighting:
A bright alley in Harajuku, Tokyo. Cafe signs, white building walls, street trees, store signs and pedestrians stretching into the distance. Text is within a natural range blending into the Japanese street scene, with blurry and illegible parts. Midday natural light spills in from the upper right, illuminating the face, hair, and ruffles of the white clothes. Soft shadows at the feet. The background is slightly bright and transparent, with a clean and light atmosphere.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 4:5. Full-body portrait. The person is located slightly to the left of the center, with the entire body included. Shot in a low-angle wide-angle lens style, enlarging the outstretched hand and placing the face and body behind to emphasize the sense of depth. The background has a natural shallow depth of field rather than excessive blurring. A composition where the depth of the alley and white lines guide the eye toward the person.

Texture/Style:
Realistic photo-style AI image. A bright and highly transparent Japanese-style portrait. Dominated by white and ivory tones, with hair in a bright milk tea ash brown. Thin see-through bangs, layers around the face, shoulder-length medium hair. The hair ends are loosely curled inward, showing a natural sense of bundles, fine highlights, soft luster, and a few stray hairs. Skin is not over-retouched; the lace of the fabric, the platform of the shoes, and the texture of the road surface should be presented in detail.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features or gaze, extra or missing fingers, hand merging, joint deformation, asymmetrical thighs, unnatural differences in leg thickness, distorted knees or ankles, floating shoes, unnatural weight sensation, damaged clothing, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks, unnecessary passersby entering the frame.

prompts.text:
Create a premium advertising poster for [BRAND] featuring [PRODUCT].

Build the image around an AURA FIELD concept.

The product must be the clear hero, placed in a premium commercial composition with sharp detail, realistic materials, cinematic lighting, and strong visual hierarchy.

Around the product, create visible aura fields that express what the product makes people feel, taste, hear, smell, wear, or experience.

The aura should not look like random magic. It must be designed as a refined visual language based on the product category and brand DNA.

Adapt the aura to the product:
- food products create flavor waves, crumbs, cream, chocolate, steam, crunch particles, or appetite energy
- fragrance and beauty products create scent trails, mist, petals, skin glow, botanical particles, or soft liquid air
- tech products create clean data fields, light grids, interface particles, signal waves, or intelligent glow
- fashion and eyewear products create motion trails, attitude lines, reflections, street energy, or editorial light
- home products create calm atmosphere, warmth, texture, comfort waves, soft shadows, or ritual energy
- performance products create speed fields, impact rings, air pressure, focus lines, or kinetic energy

The aura must wrap around the product, interact with its shape, and make the product feel powerful, desirable, and iconic.

Keep the composition premium, minimal where needed, and highly polished. Use refined typography inspired by the brand’s visual language with a short 3-word slogan.

Do not use miniature people, micro worlds, shadow storytelling, negative-space frames, exploded-view composition, product monuments, or split reality.

Avoid copying any existing real campaign. Create a fresh original ad concept.

Aspect ratio: [RATIO]

The calling hand of early morning

Characters・Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory beige whitish skin with a faint pinkish healthy glow, smooth and natural skin texture. Soft highlights on cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbone, not excessive skin retouching, but retaining natural skin texture. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long and thick eyelashes, natural tear bags, light brown soft eyebrows, transparent pink-beige lip gloss. Pupils are a steady brown with small clear catchlights. Wearing a gentle smile, looking directly at the camera.

Clothing・Pose:
A thick white bath towel is tightly wrapped from the chest to the waist and upper thighs. The towel is a clean terry cloth material, with natural fabric thickness and folds at the chest and waist. Lying on the bed, upper body slightly raised, moving closer to the camera. Both arms extended towards the camera, palms open, posing as if gently calling out. Fingers naturally spread, without excessive force. The body type is natural mature female curves, an elegant and healthy impression.

Background・Lighting:
A bright bedroom consisting only of white sheets and white pillows. The foreground is the outstretched hands, the middle ground is the face and upper body, and the background is soft messy bedding. Natural morning light pours in from the upper right of the frame, forming soft white highlights on the hair, cheeks, shoulders, collarbone, and towel folds. Shadows fall elegantly towards the lower left of the frame, and the reflected light from the white sheets envelops the skin brightly.

Composition・Lens:
Vertical 9:16. A close-up high-angle composition looking down from the bed. The face is located in the upper center of the frame, and the outstretched hands occupy the left and right foreground, slightly emphasizing the sense of perspective. From the chest to the upper thighs are included in the frame, with white bedding creating negative space. Sight and focus are on the pupils, with hands slightly blurred in the foreground. Wide-angle but natural portrait expression without facial distortion.

Texture・Style:
Realistic photo-style AI image. Bright and clean Japanese portrait. Skin is full of transparency while retaining natural pores and blood color. Hair is light milk tea ash-brown medium-length hair, with thin see-through bangs, face-framing layers, and loosely curled ends on the inside. Detailed depiction of every strand of hair flow, delicate highlights, soft luster, and a few stray hairs. The white bath towel shows the bumps and soft thickness of the terry cloth material.

Negative Prompt:
Expressions that look like minors, overly childish face, excessive sexual emphasis, exposure, see-through towel, slipping towel, unnatural chest, vulgar poses, unnatural complexion or gaze, extra or missing fingers, hand deformation, arm fusion, joint collapse, poor contact between towel and body, floating feeling, unnatural gravity, shadows with contradictory light sources, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, text, logos, watermarks.

逼真的照片风格AI图像。明亮干净的日系人像。肌肤透明感十足，同时保留自然的毛孔和血色。头发是浅奶茶灰棕色的中长发，薄透刘海、脸周层叠、内侧松散卷曲的发梢。细致描绘每一根头发的流动、细腻高光、柔和光泽，以及少量散乱发丝。白色浴巾展现绒圈材质的凹凸与柔软厚度。

prompts.text: Create a work of **Oriental Literati Aesthetic Calligram**. The main subject uses minimalist brush line drafts to outline the silhouette, completing the shape with only a few ink lines rich in calligraphic brushwork. The interior of the main subject is not ordinary filling, but is naturally composed of a large number of vertically arranged traditional brush calligraphy characters. The calligraphic characters are naturally arranged along the object's structure, the direction of gravity, or the direction of flow, making the text both the content and the shape itself, forming a complete visual structure. The density of the characters changes naturally, with varying sizes, possessing a sense of writing rhythm, irregular but overall coordinated, as if completed by real handwriting. The whole follows the aesthetics of traditional Chinese literati painting: Large area of white space; Sparse enough to gallop a horse, dense enough to block the wind; Quiet composition; Strong sense of breathing; Minimalist; Restrained; Elegant; Full of Zen. Background uses: Old Xuan paper, off-white paper, natural fiber texture, slightly yellowed aging, extremely light ink wash bleeding, extremely light paper wrinkles, natural paper texture. Colors use only: Inky black, light ink gray, a small amount of cinnabar seals. The image is dotted with several traditional Chinese carved seals, placed naturally and not intentionally. Overall resembles: Ancient literati manuscripts, museum collections, Oriental modern art, Chinese calligraphy installation art, minimalist posters. The image is quiet, restrained, and rich in negative space. No modern fonts. No computer typesetting. No high-saturation colors. No complex backgrounds. No realistic photography. No illustration feel. No decorative patterns. No extra elements. Subject: Lotus

items.title: 仪式感书籍分享沙龙海报生成提示词

prompts.text:
Generate an image with a heavy sense of ritual around any subject object: the screen first lets a large area of monochromatic background carry the emotion, the main form is shifted to the left to form a steady sense of physical oppression, with fine tactile textures and weak shadows on the surface; the subject content is abstracted in front of the main form into a set of stepping structures decreasing from bottom to top, the left half uses clear light-colored blocks to present the thickness of the object, and the right half switches to extremely fine line-drawn outlines, like a skeleton of knowledge, path, or time revealed after being cut open from the entity, forming a visual moment where thick matter and light line drafts are juxtaposed. The upper and middle parts retain a large amount of quiet white space, with a few light line small symbols as breathing and scale hints, all decorations are close to the thematic semantics. Text is part of the structure, the main title is arranged vertically along one side, with wide letter spacing and slow rhythm, using high-contrast, slender, inscribed-style Chinese fonts; auxiliary information is in lighter fine characters close to the main form and bottom wireframe, forming a reading path from markers to themes and then to action information. Colors are extracted from the theme's own materials, emotions, or cultural signals, maintaining a role relationship where a large area of pure base color carries emotion, a light-colored main body establishes brightness contrast, and dark fine lines and a small amount of small-area accent colors calibrate the rhythm; the overall should present a warm and solemn, clean and restrained, saturated but not dirty feeling, textures only add tactile sensation and do not create aged gray mist. The key is the precise half-and-half conversion between physical material and translucent line drawing within the same subject structure, making the weight, path, and thickness of time visible at a glance.

——————
Sharing session direction: Travel reading + book list + speaker portrait + route symbols
Publication use: Reading salon preview poster + activity registration page header image
Cool colors: Indigo + Silver Gray + Fog White + low saturation cold
Screen composition: Diagonal book page path + bottom info box + top white space focus, horizontal 16:9

prompts.text:

The poster should be divided into two visually contrasting worlds that show the transformation, contrast, or duality created by the product.

The product must sit at the center of the split as the visual bridge between both realities.

One side should represent the “before” state, problem, raw material, ordinary world, chaos, friction, noise, dullness, or limitation.

The other side should represent the “after” state, solution, refined experience, elevated world, clarity, control, beauty, energy, taste, performance, or desire.

- tech products show chaos vs control, analog vs intelligent, limitation vs possibility

Do not use miniature people, micro worlds, product monuments, shadow storytelling, exploded-view composition, or negative-space frames.

prompts.text:
Generate an image in the style of "Paper to Reality: Four Seasons Flower Goddess Raiment," 4:5 vertical ratio.

The theme is [Peach Blossom Goddess / Lotus Goddess / Osmanthus Goddess / Plum Blossom Goddess]. The scene is a high-end off-white flower goddess clothing design manuscript paper clipped to a wooden drawing board, placed on a warm wood-toned design workbench. A realistic adult Chinese female naturally rises from the flower goddess clothing design manuscript on the paper, creating a "paper coming to life" visual illusion.

The character must appear in a full-body shot, but still occupy the main subject of the frame, with the face and eyes clearly visible, not shrunk too small. The character is realistic and natural, with fair skin but real skin texture, no anime faces, silicone skin, plastic skin, or excessive skin smoothing. The gaze interacts directly with the camera, as if just waking up from the paper page.

The character's upper body is significantly higher than the paper surface, not a flat illustration. The head, shoulders, neck, chest, waist, hips, legs, and feet have real volume, spatial height, and natural shadows. The posture should not be too upright; there should be slight twists, offsets, and center-of-gravity shifts, with weight on one leg and the other leg naturally relaxed or extended forward. One hand lightly supports on the paper surface, and the other hand gently holds a flower branch, hair ornament, silk drape, or skirt hem.

The clothing is a high-fashion oriental flower goddess design, where petals, branches, leaves, calyxes, stamens, and branch structures must be integrated into the headwear, shoulder decorations, cuffs, waistlines, skirt hems, and silk drapes, rather than just having flowers as a background. The overall look is transparent, light, and breathable, with light gauze, overlapping petals, branch growth trends, and a sense of natural flow.

Transition method: The character's face, upper body, legs, and main clothing are complete realistic finished products; the skirt hem, silk drape, and main body of the flower branches can have a small amount of light-colored hand-painted texture; only the ends of the skirt hem, the ends of the silk drape, the ends of the flower branches, the edges of the petals, and the pencil area in the lower right corner retain unfinished pencil lines.

In the lower right corner, there is a real human hand holding a pencil, continuing to draw sketches near the petals, skirt hem, flower branches, and footwear. All text, arrows, annotations, and small patterns on the paper must be in a pencil-handwritten sketch style, no printed fonts, no LOOK numbering. Can write: petal structure, branch and leaf trends, color records, skirt layers, hem unfinished.

Add color swatches, flower branch sketches, light gauze fabric samples, small pearl accessories, pencils, technical pens, and ceramic teacups corresponding to the flower goddess theme on the desktop. The overall style is realistic, clear, high-end, and light, with the aesthetic beauty of an oriental flower goddess and the visual illusion of paper coming to life.

Avoid cartoons, anime faces, silicone skin, plastic feel, cheap ancient-style photoshoots, ordinary flower fairy feel, characters being too small, overly upright standing postures, dull gazes, abnormal hands and feet, full-body flat drawings, excessively large hand-painted areas, mottled colors, and low resolution.

A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory-beige fair skin with a slight pinkish glow, smooth and delicate skin texture. A light pink short-sleeved cardigan draped over a white lace-edged ribbed camisole, a mini skirt with small floral ruffles in white to off-white, white lace-up sandals, and a small beige chain shoulder bag. Deep in a Tokyo alley. On the old wall, there is a large graffiti mural of an orange-haired navigator-style anime character. The character in the mural is in a natural leaning-down pose, with one hand gently placed on the real woman's shoulder, and the other hand holding a long staff diagonally. The mural is high-resolution with beautiful lines and a bright, charismatic expression. Features cracked paint surfaces, peeling walls, simple Japanese signs, lanterns, and stickers. Warm streetlight cast from the top-left, softly illuminating the woman's cheeks, hair, shoulders, and collarbone, with shadows falling toward the bottom-right.

Vertical 2:3. Full-body medium-close street portrait. The woman is located in the bottom-center of the frame, with the mural occupying most of the background space in the upper half. The contact point between the mural's hand and the woman's shoulder is visible at a glance. Slightly low eye-level lens, natural wide-angle feel, slightly retaining the depth of the alley. Focus on the woman's face and shoulders, with the background mural clear enough with a medium depth of field.

Photorealistic AI image. Detailed depiction of the summer humidity of a Japanese night alley, warm-colored streetlights, the rough pigment of the mural, and the natural texture of the skin.
