prompts.text: create a highly detailed cinematic storyboard poster in a 4:5 vertical ratio, designed like a premium editorial character sheet and film planning board. Use a clean beige paper background with thin black grid lines, black title bars, and a vintage magazine-meets-movie-production aesthetic. The composition must follow this layout: a large vertical character profile panel on the left, a multi-panel storyboard sequence on the right, and a bottom information strip spanning the full width. Keep the design polished, balanced, and highly readable, with strong hierarchy, realistic lighting, and consistent character design across all panels. Left panel: show the main character in a hero pose with a large stylized title at the top, a short tagline beneath it, then a structured profile section with labels such as name, age, hometown, profession, style, quote, about, and lifestyle. Add a full-body or near full-body hero image of the character, with one prop that defines their identity. The typography should feel hand-drawn, bold, and cinematic. Right side: create 6 to 7 storyboard frames arranged in a clean grid. Each frame should have a black header bar with numbered shot titles. Every frame must show the same character in a different action beat, with clear camera energy and scene progression. Under each frame, include three small text boxes labeled camera / movement, music, and sound. The shots should feel like a real production storyboard: dynamic, expressive, and visually coherent from scene to scene.  Bottom strip: add three labeled sections across the width: wardrobe and gear, personality and skills, and locations and conditions. Use small thumbnail-style images, icons, or product-style cutouts for the wardrobe area. Keep the personality area as a bullet list with short traits. Keep the locations area as mini landscape thumbnails with concise labels and environment notes. Style direction: cinematic commercial, premium storyboard board, urban editorial design, natural skin texture, realistic proportions, dramatic but clean lighting, cohesive color palette, high detail, sharp composition, professional print-ready finish. Make it look like a storyboard used for a film, music video, or high-end brand campaign. Important layout rules: preserve the same overall structure, visual balance, and ratio discipline as the reference. Use one dominant left panel, one storyboard grid on the right, and one footer band at the bottom. Make the whole design feel like a single unified art board, not separate random panels. Fill-In Template You can swap the subject and theme like this: Subject: [character name or type] Theme: [sports / fashion / music / fantasy / action / luxury / street culture] Setting: [location or environment] Hero prop: [skateboard / microphone / motorcycle / camera / sword / sneaker / etc.] Mood: [fearless / playful / elegant / rebellious / futuristic / heroic] Number of storyboard shots: 6 or 7 Output format: 4:5 vertical

prompts.text:

Person · Expression:
A female in her 20s. Bright ivory beige fair skin with a faint pink flush, smooth texture. Not overly highlighted, soft highlights on cheeks, nose tip, shoulders, and collarbone. Overall face is an elegant, clean, precision-doll-like Japanese makeup style. Expression is calm and mature, slightly looking down and gazing at white wildflowers. Deep brown long wavy hair, soft stray hairs at the hairline, a small white headscarf wrapped on the head.

Clothing · Pose:
White camisole-style mini dress. Thin straps, modest sweetheart neckline, small ribbon decoration, delicate lace accents, embroidered corset-style bodice. Short skirt, light double-layered ruffles, scalloped lace hem. Outer layer of tulle and lace are thin materials with strong light transmission, light-hitting parts appear highly transparent. Thin lining remains at the chest and waist to avoid being explicit, creating an elegant sense of transparency. White short socks, black lace-up shoes. Body stepping forward toward the right of the frame, weight on the character's own left foot. Right foot slightly extended forward, long and slender model figure legs. Character's right hand holds a small bunch of white wildflowers, left hand lightly pinches the skirt hem. Natural folds, light transmission, and layering in the lace and thin fabric, expressing the touch of fingertips.

Background · Lighting:
Dark green coniferous forest on a Japanese highland. Ground covered in thick moss and morning dew-drenched grass, large tree trunk in front of the left hand, tree stumps, roots, and sloped forest floor continuing in the distance. White picnic cloth, wicker basket, white ceramic cup, round fruits, green grapes naturally placed in the bottom right. Morning sunlight shines diagonally from the top right between trees, forming slender light beams between the trees. Light illuminates hair edges, shoulders, chest lace, transparent skirt hem, petals, and grass tips. Soft shadows fall on the bottom left, the green of the moss faintly reflecting on the skin and white clothing. Thin morning mist in the air, light passing through the fabric and forest to create a transparent atmosphere.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 2:3. Full-body fashion portrait. Character placed center-left, full body occupying about 70% of the frame height. Large tree on the left as foreground, using picnic cloth and basket on the bottom right to create negative space. Camera at waist-to-chest height, slightly low eye level. Angle makes legs naturally look long, avoiding excessive distortion. Equivalent to 70mm natural compression. Focus on the character's face, chest lace, and white flowers in hand, background trees softly blurred. Composition of morning light beams flowing from behind the character to the front.

Texture · Style:
Realistic Japanese film photography style. Rich and vivid green, but not fluorescent. White lace and tulle are thin and transparent, delicately depicting the texture under morning light. Skin retains natural texture and subtle shadows, avoiding excessive beauty retouching. Realistic representation of textures of tree bark, moss, grass, wicker baskets, fruit, ceramics, and petals. Overall as beautiful as high-end fashion photography, conveying the atmosphere of forest morning air and light transparency.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural faces or gazes, childish-looking characters, overly large eyes, too sharp outlines, extra or missing fingers, fused hands or feet, broken joints, poor contact with flowers or fabric, overly unnatural leg length, floating small objects, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting light source, overexposed clothing, completely overly transparent clothing, explicit exposure, over-emphasized underwear, fluorescent green, excessive beauty retouching, plastic-like skin, extra characters, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:

写实日系胶片摄影风。绿色浓郁鲜艳，但不荧光色。白色蕾丝和薄纱薄透，细腻描绘晨光下的质感。肌肤保留自然纹理和细微阴影，避免过度美肌修饰。树皮、苔藓、草、柳条篮子、水果、陶器、花瓣的质感真实表现。整体如高级时尚摄影般美丽，传达森林晨空气息和透光感。

items.title: 万物拟人化实物成装角色设计

prompts.text:
Generate a style image of "Anthropomorphism of Everything · Object to Outfit", 4:5 vertical composition.

Place a real-life reference object with a realistic photography feel on the left side of the screen: 【{{Object Name}}】. The object should look like a photographic photo or product sample, with materials, structures, colors, metal reflections, transparent parts, textures, and functional details clearly visible. The object on the left can be placed in a circular reference frame, a design drawing frame, or a white background display area, with a small amount of handwritten annotations, such as: Reference, material, shape, texture, key detail.

On the right side of the screen is an adult 3D anime style female character anthropomorphized from the object, with slender and natural proportions, about 7–7.5 heads tall, in an elegant and design-oriented pose, like a high-quality 3D character setting diagram. The character is not simply wearing ordinary clothes, but transforms the shape, structure, material, and function of the object on the left into clothing, hair accessories, weapons, accessories, and silhouette language.

Anthropomorphism design requirements:
1. Character clothing must clearly echo the core characteristics of the object on the left.
2. Transform the main shapes of the object into large clothing outlines, such as hat brims, shoulder armor, capes, skirts, back decorations, umbrella structures, ring structures, streamlined shells, etc.
3. Transform the materials of the object into clothing materials, such as metallic silver, ceramic white, transparent glass, crystal, rubber, plastic, wood grain, fabric, fluid, glossy coating, etc.
4. Transform the functions of the object into imaginative elements, such as water flow, light beams, wind, flames, mechanical structures, plant growth, star tracks, energy lines, incantations, wings, ribbons, etc.
5. The character's hair accessories, earrings, brooches, waist seals, canes, footwear, and skirt details should all show the design logic derived from the physical object.
6. The color system is unified, the main color tone comes from the object on the left, do not have mottled and messy colors.

Screen style:
High-end 3D anime character design, exquisite modeling sense, delicate materials, soft studio lighting, clean white or light gray background, clear design correlation between the character and the object. The overall look is like an "Object Anthropomorphized Character Setting Manuscript", with the real object reference on the left and the character imaginatively generated from it on the right.

Composition requirements:
The left object occupies 25%–35% of the screen, and the right character occupies 60%–70%. The left side is more realistic, and the right side is more 3D anime character. Faint design connecting lines, structural sketches, material annotations, and color sampling points can be added between the two, allowing the audience to see at a glance that the character's clothing originates from the object on the left.

Character requirements:
Adult character, exquisite facial features but not excessively juvenile, eyes with a sense of interaction, can look at the camera, look at the object on the left, or look like they are presenting their own clothing design. The skin has an exquisite 3D anime texture, no plastic feel, no low resolution. Natural body proportions, correct hand, leg, and foot structures, clothing fully covered, avoid overexposure.

Clothing requirements:
High-end fantasy couture, combining Oriental mythology, futurism, mechanical aesthetics, or elven feel. The clothing is rich in layers but not chaotic, with clear main outlines, secondary decorations, and detailed textures. Focus on representing: headwear, shoulder structures, chest decorations, waist structures, skirts, capes, ribbons, footwear, and iconic elements corresponding to the object.

A small amount of design annotations can be added to the screen:
LOOK 01, object reference, silhouette, material sample, ornament detail, function motif, color palette, structural translation, material sampling, silhouette source, decorative details.

High quality, high definition, exquisite, imaginative, strong sense of design, object anthropomorphism, 3D anime character design, fantasy couture, object-inspired costume design, clean composition, soft studio lighting.

Avoid: ordinary cosplay, simply copying the object and sticking it on the body, clothing unrelated to the object, low-quality modeling, incorrect proportions, deformed fingers, deformed legs, broken face, excessively juvenile, overexposure, garbled text, messy colors, dirty background, unclear objects, character too flat, 2D draft feel, low resolution.

prompts.text:
生成一张《万物拟人化 · 实物成装》风格图片，4:5 竖版构图。

画面左侧放置一个真实拍摄感的实物参考物：【{{实物名称}}】。实物要像摄影照片或产品样品，材质、结构、颜色、金属反光、透明件、纹理和功能细节清晰可见。左侧实物可放在圆形参考框、设计图框或白底展示区中，并带有少量手写标注，例如：Reference、material、shape、texture、key detail。

画面右侧是一位由该实物拟人化而成的成年 3D 动漫风格女性角色，比例修长自然，约 7–7.5 头身，姿态优雅、有设计感，像高质量 3D 角色设定图。角色不是简单穿普通衣服，而是把左侧实物的造型、结构、材质和功能转化成服饰、发饰、武器、配件和轮廓语言。

拟人化设计要求：
1. 角色服饰必须明显呼应左侧实物的核心特征。
2. 将实物的主要形状转化为服装大轮廓，例如帽檐、肩甲、披风、裙摆、背饰、伞状结构、环形结构、流线型外壳等。
3. 将实物的材质转化为服装材质，例如金属银、陶瓷白、透明玻璃、水晶、橡胶、塑料、木纹、布料、流体、光泽涂层等。
4. 将实物的功能转化为想象力元素，例如水流、光束、风、火焰、机械结构、植物生长、星轨、能量线、符咒、羽翼、飘带等。
5. 角色的发饰、耳饰、胸针、腰封、手杖、鞋履和裙摆细节都要能看出来自实物的设计逻辑。

  - Convert the subject into a stylized anime-inspired figure or object placed within a clean public-information poster layout.
  - Reinterpret surrounding elements as simplified symbolic support graphics, civic icons, educational motifs, or narrative support figures.
  - Convert realism into soft rounded shapes, approachable cartoon proportions, and emotionally readable facial or focal expressions.
  - Balance gentle infographic clarity with subtle cinematic staging and heroic emphasis.
  - Rebuild complex environments as simplified scenic backdrops with broad readable forms, soft atmosphere, and reduced clutter.

  <finish>
  - Pastel public-service anime poster aesthetic.
  - Soft, hopeful, symbolic, and clean.

items.title: 当代中文水果视觉海报设计

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese fruit-themed finished poster, a single complete poster, no nine-grid, no collage, no collection.

The theme of the image is [Fruit Theme]. The fruit must be clear and realistic, with a fresh and moist texture, and can include whole fruits, cross-sections, pulp, skin, water droplets, bubbles, juice, pits, seeds, partial close-ups, and floating slices.

The overall style is not ordinary fruit photography or e-commerce fruit advertising, but contemporary Chinese visual poster design. Please reorganize the fruit images into a poster with a clear layout, a Chinese title, a visual center, and design completion.

The image must form different visual directions based on different fruits; do not make all images look the same. One of the following layouts can be adopted:
1. High-saturation blue background + transparent glass frame + floating fruit slices
2. Creamy white background + large area of white space + partial fruit close-up
3. Purple night scene + circular partitions + star map orbit layout
4. Pink mirror + symmetrical composition + sticky notes
5. Infographic structure + multiple cross-section annotations + specimen research feel
6. High-contrast graphics + bold Chinese title + collage blocks
7. Channel broadcast feel + labels, icons, signal lines, sticker-style layout
8. Minimalist white space + transparent material square boxes + light botanical feel
9. Cosmic orbit + starlight, rings, pulp floating structure

The poster must have a Chinese main title:
「【Main Title】」

Add a Chinese subtitle:
「【Subtitle】」

Add a Chinese short phrase:
「【Short Phrase】」

Add a signature:
「Signature」

Text requirements:
Chinese must be clear and accurate, no garbled characters, no typos.
Chinese is the main focus, a small amount of English text can be used as an auxiliary, but English should not dominate.
The title should have a sense of design, using large characters, vertical layout, horizontal layout, misplaced layout, mirror composition, border layout, label layout, and infographic layout.

Image texture:
High-end poster design, fresh fruit, strong visual impact, clean typography, magazine cover feel, visual experimental feel, modern Chinese typography, refreshing but not cheap.

No watermarks, no real brand logos, no QR codes, no e-commerce promotion feel, no product detail pages.

items.title: 午后的光与优雅日系少女肖像

prompts.text:
Subject:
Afternoon Light

Character · Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory beige-toned fair skin with a faint pink healthy glow, skin is smooth and delicate. Soft highlights on cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbone, without excessive skin retouching, retaining natural skin texture and presenting an exquisite quality. Elegant and soft face shape, leaning towards a Japanese beauty style, oval contour, small and clear nose bridge, slightly large but not unnatural brown pupils. Exquisite and elegant makeup, like a sophisticated Japanese doll makeup. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eye shadow, long and thick eyelashes, natural tear bags, bright soft brown eyebrows, pink-beige lip gloss with transparency. Small and clear catchlights in the pupils. Expression is serene and soft, corners of the mouth slightly closed, looking directly at the camera.

Clothing · Pose:
Summer lightweight ivory white tulle material dress-style top. Deep V-neck design, making the chest area appear mature and elegant. A matching color sophisticated lace inner layer is faintly visible inside. Sleeves are sheer long sleeves with natural folds at the wrists. Overall with slight wrinkles and a soft drape. Body slightly tilted, upper body facing forward. Gently lifting her own left hand to the side of her face, fingertips naturally curved. Shoulders relaxed, creating a calm and mature atmosphere. Hair is bright milk tea ash brown. Thin see-through bangs, layered cut around the face, medium-length hair below the shoulders. Hair ends loosely curled inward, with a fluffy airy feel and natural bundling. Carefully depict the flow of every hair strand, slender luster, soft brightness, and a small amount of naturally stray hair.

Background · Lighting:
Simple interior walls from white to gray-beige. The background is a tidy minimalist space with restrained decoration. Afternoon natural light spills in from the window at the front left of the frame. In addition to the soft main light source, slender beams of light through curtains or window frames fall on the face, forming impressive light traces on the forehead, brow, nose bridge, and upper left cheek. Shoulders and collarbone are also bathed in warm light, while the opposite side creates a three-dimensional effect with light shadows. Thin window shadows are also cast on the background wall, enhancing the photo-like airiness. Light color temperature leans towards warm cream beige, creating a gentle afternoon atmosphere.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical composition upper body portrait. The subject is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame. Close-up framing from the top of the head to below the chest, naturally including the left hand in the frame. Lens position is slightly higher than eye level, maintaining a natural sense of distance. Equivalent to an 85mm medium telephoto portrait feel. Precisely focus on the face and pupils, background softly blurred. Ensure that the hair bundling, skin texture, fabric layering at the chest, and the light beams on the face are all clearly conveyed.

Texture · Style:
Realistic photo-style AI portrait. An elegant finish between Japanese magazine photography and natural portraiture. Skin is smooth but not plastic-like, retaining detailed hair flow and texture. Hair represents transparent brown tones and delicate luster. Clothing needs to depict the difference between tulle and lace. Color palette centered on ivory white, milk tea brown, pink-beige, and gray-beige. Avoid overly strong contrast, letting only the light traces become the visual focus, creating a photo-like expression. Slightly film-like airiness.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, unnaturally large eyes, asymmetrical face shape, overly sharp chin, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, extra fingers, missing fingers, deformed joints, unnatural hand positions, hair in blocks, heavy bangs, unnatural chest shape, deformed fabric, overexposure, vulgar clothing, shadows contradicting the light source, shadows obscuring the face, unnecessary small objects, text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
午后的光

人物·表情：
20多岁的女性。明亮的象牙米色调的白皙肌肤，带着淡淡粉红血色的光泽，肌肤平滑细腻。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨处有柔和的高光，不进行过度美肌修饰，保留自然的肌理，呈现精致的质感。脸型优雅柔美，偏向日系美女风格，椭圆形轮廓，小巧而清晰的鼻梁，略大的但不过分自然的棕色瞳孔。妆容精致优雅，宛如精巧的日系娃娃妆。淡玫瑰粉色的腮红，香槟米色与粉棕色的眼影，细长浓密的睫毛，自然的泪袋，明亮的柔软棕色眉毛，带有透明感的粉米色唇彩。瞳孔中加入小而清澈的捕捉光。表情宁静柔和，嘴角微微闭合，直视着镜头。

服装·姿势：
夏日轻盈的象牙白薄纱材质连衣裙式上衣。深V领设计，让胸口显得成熟而优雅。内侧隐约可见同色系的精致蕾丝内搭。袖子为薄透的长袖，手腕处有自然的褶皱。整体带有轻微褶皱和柔软垂坠感。身体略微侧倾，上半身朝向正面。将自己的左手轻轻举到脸庞侧边，指尖自然弯曲。肩膀放松，营造出沉稳的成熟氛围。头发是明亮的奶茶灰棕色。薄薄的透视刘海，脸部周围的层次剪裁，及肩下方的中长发。发梢向内松散卷曲，带有蓬松的空气感和自然的束感。仔细描绘每一根头发的流动、细长的光泽、柔和的亮度，以及少量自然的散乱发丝。

背景·光线：
简约室内从白色到灰米色的墙壁。背景是整理整齐的极简空间，装饰克制。从画面左前方窗户洒入午后的自然光。除柔和的主光源外，透过窗帘或窗框的细长光束落在脸上，在前额、额头、鼻梁、左脸颊上方形成印象深刻的光痕。肩膀和锁骨也沐浴在温暖的光线中，对侧则以淡影营造立体感。背景墙上也投下薄薄的窗影，增强照片般的空气感。光线色温偏向温暖的奶油米色，营造温柔的午后氛围。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图的上半身肖像。人物位于画面中央略偏右的位置。从头顶到胸部下方的近距离取景，自然地将左手纳入画面。镜头位置略高于视线的高度，保持自然的距离感。相当于85mm的中远摄肖像感。将焦点精准对准脸部和瞳孔，背景柔和虚化。确保发丝的束感、肌肤的质感、胸口的布料重叠，以及脸上的光束都能清晰传达。

质感·风格：
逼真的照片风格AI肖像。介于日本杂志写真与自然肖像之间的优雅完成度。肌肤平滑但不似塑料，保留细致的毛流和肌理。头发表现透明感的棕色调与细腻光泽。服装需描绘出薄纱与蕾丝的差异。以象牙白、奶茶棕、粉米色、灰米色为中心调色。避免过强对比，仅让光痕成为视觉焦点，营造照片般的表现。略带胶片感的空气感。

负面提示：
不自然的五官、不自然过大的眼睛、左右不对称的脸型、过于尖锐的下巴、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤、多余的手指、缺失的手指、关节变形、手部位置不自然、头发成块、过重的刘海、不自然的胸部形状、布料变形、过度暴露、低俗的服装、与光源矛盾的阴影、遮挡脸部的阴影、不必要的小物件、文字、标志、水印。

items.title: 克制冷静展陈感光影悬浮装置

prompts.text:
Generate a restrained, calm, exhibition-like visual work around any theme: the upper part of the image consists of slender structural components, suspended fragments, or modular strokes derived from the theme as the main form, suspended in an empty field by thin lines, transparent supports, or extremely light spatial relationships. The real form occupies only a small visual area, but casts an enlarged shadow of thematic text, symbols, or core imagery on the lower plane through light, allowing the viewer to read the huge image on the ground at first glance and only discover that the image comes from the scattered physical structures above at second glance. The space remains clean with white space, the background resembles a quiet exhibition hall, model room, or seamless installation space, with walls and floors establishing depth through soft junctions. The main body is suspended in the upper-middle area, and the shadow spreads forward with perspective distortion, edge hardness/softness changes, and slight blurring, forming a figure-ground reversal where 'the entity is light, the shadow is heavy.' If text is needed in the image, it should participate in the composition as an information layer along with the shadow layer: titles or theme words can be transformed into huge projections, and explanatory text is arranged in small font size, wide spacing, and low density at the bottom or edges, maintaining a precise, quiet, and highly ceremonial commercial visual order. Colors are extracted from the material, brand temperament, and emotions of the theme itself, retaining a large area of high-brightness clean base color, a small amount of neutral structural colors, clear light-to-dark hierarchies, and low-saturation information colors; the overall effect should be clear, quiet, calm, and precise, with bright but not glaring light, and the shadow carrying the main emotional weight, avoiding dirty gray, smoky, retro yellowing, or heavy stains. Material surfaces are delicate, edges are sharp, and hanging lines and structural components should have realistic scale and slight industrial precision. The final effect is like a carefully lit brand space installation, rather than an ordinary layout poster or flat illustration.

Theme text: Everyone is dead
Ratio: 16:9

prompts.text:

prompts.text:
Character·Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Fair skin in bright ivory beige tones with a natural skin texture showing a faint pink flush. Soft highlights on cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbone. Light rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long and thick eyelashes, natural tear bags, bright brown eyebrows, translucent pink-beige lip gloss shiny lipstick. One eye winking, showing teeth, smiling brightly. Small clear catchlights in the pupils.

Clothing·Pose:
A light coral pink loose off-the-shoulder T-shirt lightly knotted at the waist, revealing a hint of a turquoise swimsuit strap inside. Light blue ripped denim shorts, barefoot. Upper body leaning slightly forward, holding her right hand up next to her face with fingers naturally spread. Her left hand is placed down along her left thigh. Weight shifted onto the leg on the right side of the frame, the other leg extended diagonally forward, forming a summery light S-curve silhouette.

Background·Lighting:
A beach house style terrace with white wooden walls by the seaside. There is a white window frame on the right and a bright wooden deck illuminated by sunlight underfoot. In the back left are blurred palm leaves, white railings, and the deep blue sea and sky in the distance. The main light source is strong summer sunlight coming from the upper left of the frame. It illuminates the front of the face, shoulders, arms, and legs, with shadows cast towards the lower right of the deck. Reflected light from the white walls and floor softens the shadows on the skin.

Composition·Lens:
Vertical 3:4. Full-body portrait including the entire body. The character is placed largely from the center to the right of the frame, with feet naturally entering the frame. The lens is at a slight low angle from just below waist level, not too close. The focus is on the face and upper body, with shallow depth-of-field blur in the background to preserve only the seaside atmosphere.

Texture·Style:
Realistic photo-style AI image. Bright and fresh finish like a summer magazine pictorial. Skin is not over-retouched, retaining natural texture and gloss. Hair is bright milk tea ash brown, thin see-through bangs, layered around the face, medium-length hair below the shoulders. Hair ends loosely curled inward, fine highlights, natural clumps, and a few stray strands carefully depicted. Realistically rendered thin fabric texture of the T-shirt, wear and tear of the denim, and dry texture of the wood grain.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features or gaze, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, extra or missing fingers, fused hands or feet, broken joints, floating feet, unnatural gravity, shadows inconsistent with light sources, extreme deformation of legs or arms, unnecessary people or small objects, readable text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
人物·表情：
20多岁的女性。明亮的象牙米色调的白皙肌肤，带有淡淡粉红血色的自然肤质。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨处有柔和的高光。淡玫瑰粉色的腮红、香槟米色与粉棕色的眼影、细长浓密的睫毛、自然的泪袋、较亮的棕色眉毛、透亮感的粉米色唇彩光泽唇膏。一只眼睛眨眼，露出牙齿，灿烂地笑着。瞳孔中有细小清澈的捕捉光。

淡珊瑚粉色的宽松露肩T恤在腰部轻轻打结，内侧露出一丝青绿色系的泳装肩带。浅蓝色的破洞牛仔短裤，光脚。身体上半身微微前倾，将自己的右手举到脸庞侧边，自然张开手指。自己的左手沿左大腿向下放置。将重心放在画面右侧的腿上，另一条腿斜向前伸展，形成夏日般轻盈的S形轮廓。

背景·光线：
海滨白色木墙的沙滩屋风格露台。右侧有白色窗框，脚下是阳光照亮的明亮木质甲板。左后方有模糊的棕榈叶、白色栏杆、远处蔚蓝的大海与天空。主光源从画面左上方射入的强烈夏日阳光。照亮脸部、肩膀、手臂、腿部的前侧，阴影向甲板右下方投射。白色墙壁和地板的反射光柔和了肌肤的阴影。

纵向3:4。全身纳入的全身肖像。人物较大地置于画面中央至右侧，脚部自然进入画面。镜头从腰部稍低位置的轻微低角度，距离不宜过近。焦点在脸部和上半身，背景仅保留海滨氛围的浅景深模糊。

质感·风格：
逼真的照片风格AI图像。像夏季杂志画报般明亮清新的完成度。肌肤不过度修饰，保留自然的肌理与光泽。头发是明亮的奶茶灰棕色，薄薄的透视刘海、脸周的层次感、及肩以下的中长发。发梢向内松散卷曲，细高光、自然的束感、少量散乱发丝仔细描绘。T恤的薄布质感、牛仔的磨损、木纹的干燥质感真实呈现。

负面提示：
不自然的五官或视线、过度的美肌修正、塑料般的肌肤、多余或缺失的手指、手脚融合、关节崩坏、浮空的脚、不自然的引力、与光源矛盾的阴影、腿或手臂的极端变形、不必要的人物或小物件、可读的文字、标志、水印。

items.title: 睡前蓝色房间的优雅女性人像

prompts.text:
Theme:
Blue room before bed

Person/Expression:
An adult woman who looks like she is in her late 20s. Mature and steady physique, exuding an elegant atmosphere without childishness. Skin is bright ivory beige-toned fair skin with a faint pink flush, smooth and delicate texture. No excessive highlights or whiteness; soft highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbone, with moderate pore texture that doesn't look unnaturally plastic. Faint rose pink blush on the cheeks, champagne beige and pink brown gradient makeup on the eyes. Long and natural eyelashes, natural eye bags, bright brown soft arched eyebrows. Lips have translucent pink beige lip gloss, naturally shining in the center. The overall facial makeup is an elegant and clean precision doll-style Japanese makeup. Hair is deep brown almost black long hair, keeping thin bangs and stray strands around the face. The head is tilted slightly to the lower left, gaze falling slightly in front of the hands. Expression is serene and peaceful, with a soft lingering afterglow of before falling asleep.

Clothing/Pose:
Summer night ivory-colored cool-feeling loungewear. The top is a short camisole-style top with thin straps and delicate lace edges; the top few front buttons are undone, forming a deep V-neckline. The fabric opens naturally and softly, but the exposed parts are elegant and restrained. The bottom consists of matching shorts with ruffles and a thin ribbon tied at the waist. Sitting on the bed in a side-sitting posture close to the original image. The leg on the left side of the screen is bent and extended forward, while the leg on the right side of the screen is deeply bent and folded to the side. The upper body leans slightly forward with shoulders pulled inward. Both arms hang naturally in front of the body, hands gently stacked on the bed surface between the knees. Five fingers on each hand are naturally visible, fingertips relaxed and aligned. Natural indentations and contact shadows are added where the skin, clothing, and bed meet.

Background/Lighting:
A night apartment bedroom. To the left of the screen is a large window and thin curtains; outside is a deep blue night scene, with distant streetlights forming small blurred points of light. To the back right of the screen is a warm-toned bedside lamp and a small potted plant. The bed is covered with light gray sheets and white pillows; the whole room is clean and quiet. Cold blue night light casts in from the window side, outlining the hair and shoulders, while the lamp in the back right casts warm light, softly illuminating the cheeks, collarbone, arms, and clothing fabric. Shadows fall elegantly in front of the bed and at the bottom left of the screen, with the blue and orange light blending naturally.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 4:5. Close-up indoor portrait from the head to the thighs and tips of the knees. The person is located slightly to the right of the center of the screen, focusing on the hands and upper body. The camera is slightly higher than the bed for a slight high-angle shot, with the line of sight almost level with the eyes. Natural compression feeling close to a medium-long focal length, focusing on the texture of the face, collarbone, hands, and loungewear. The background window, curtains, and lamps are softly blurred, preserving the sense of depth of the night.

Texture/Style:
Realistic photo-style AI image. Night indoor portrait, with a steady texture like a Japanese lifestyle photo. Skin is smooth but not over-retouched, retaining natural texture and color. Detailed depiction of the texture of thin cotton ribbing, lace, ruffles, and ribbons of the clothing. Color tones are mainly ivory, light beige, deep navy blue, and warm lamp colors. Low to medium contrast, soft grain, creating a clean and intimate night atmosphere.

Negative Prompt:
Underage characters, excessive emphasis on sexiness, vulgar exposure, exaggerated breasts, unnatural face or gaze, plastic-like skin, excessive skin retouching, hands not appearing to have five fingers, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, overly long fingers, deformed joints, twisted wrists, unnatural connection of legs, body floating, insufficient contact shadows with the bed, shadows contradictory to light sources, broken buttons or seams on clothing, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：

人物・表情：
看起来像20多岁后半的成年女性。成熟而沉稳的体型，散发着没有稚气的优雅氛围。皮肤是明亮的象牙米色调的白皙肌肤，带着淡淡的粉色血色，质感光滑细腻。没有过度高光泛白，脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨处有柔和的高光，毛孔感适度但不显得像塑料般不自然。脸颊上淡淡的玫瑰粉腮红，眼部是香槟米色与粉棕色的渐层妆效。细长而自然的睫毛，自然的泪袋，明亮的棕色柔和拱形眉毛。嘴唇涂有透亮感的粉米色唇彩，中央自然闪耀。整体脸部妆容是优雅而洁净的精密娃娃风日系妆容。头发是接近黑色的深棕色长发，保留薄薄的刘海和脸部周围的散落发丝。头部微微向左下方倾斜，视线落在手边稍前方。表情宁静而平和，带着入睡前的柔和余韵。

服装・姿势：
夏夜穿着的象牙色系清凉感居家服。上身为短款吊带背心式上衣，细肩带、精致的蕾丝边，前扣上部解开几颗，形成深V领口。布料柔软自然敞开，但露出部分优雅克制。下身为同色系带褶边的短裤，腰部系细丝带。在床上以接近原图的侧坐姿势。画面左侧的腿膝盖弯曲向前伸展，画面右侧的腿膝盖大幅弯曲向侧方折叠。上半身微微前倾，肩膀向内收拢。双臂自然垂于身前，双手在膝盖间的床面上轻轻叠放。双手各有五指自然可见，指尖放松并齐整。皮肤、衣物与床铺的接触处添加自然的凹陷和接触阴影。

背景・光线：
夜晚的公寓卧室。画面左侧是大窗户和薄薄的窗帘，外头是深蓝色的夜景，远处的路灯形成小小的虚化光点。画面右后方有暖色调的床头灯和小盆栽。床铺铺着浅灰色床单和白色枕头，整个房间干净而宁静。窗户侧投射进冷冽的蓝色夜光，勾勒出头发和肩膀的轮廓，右后方的灯投射出温暖的光线，柔和地照亮脸颊、锁骨、手臂和衣物布料。阴影淡雅地落在床前和画面左下方，蓝色与橙色的光线自然融合。

构图・镜头：
纵向4:5。从头部到大腿、膝尖的近距离室内肖像。人物位于画面中央稍偏右，以手部和上半身为焦点。镜头从床铺稍高位置轻微俯拍，视线几乎与眼睛齐平。接近中长焦的自然压缩感，对焦于脸部、锁骨、手部和居家服的质感。背景的窗户、窗帘、灯具柔和虚化，保留夜晚的纵深感。

质感・风格：
逼真的照片风AI图像。夜晚室内肖像，宛如日系生活照般的沉稳质感。皮肤光滑但不过度修饰，保留自然的肌理和血色。衣物的薄棉质罗纹、蕾丝、褶边、丝带的质感细致描绘。色调以象牙色、浅米色、深海军蓝、温暖的灯光色为主。低至中对比度，柔和的颗粒感，营造洁净而亲密的夜晚氛围。

负面提示：
看起来像未成年的人物、过度的性感强调、下流的露出、过分的胸部夸张、不自然的臉部或视线、像塑料般的皮肤、过度的美肌修饰、双手不像有五指、额外的指头、缺失的指头、融合的指头、过长的指头、关节变形、手腕扭曲、腿部不自然的连接、身体浮空、与床铺接触阴影不足、与光源矛盾的阴影、衣物纽扣或缝合线破损、文字乱码、标志、水印。

items.title: 品牌负空间破框创意广告海报

prompts.text:
Create a premium advertising poster for [BRAND] featuring [PRODUCT].

Use the brand’s logo, icon, letterform, label shape, packaging frame, or signature silhouette as a true negative-space frame.

Build a cinematic visual world inside that negative-space shape that expresses the product’s story, emotion, origin, texture, function, craft, flavor, scent, sound, or brand promise.

The outside canvas must stay clean, minimal, elegant, and controlled.

The inside of the shape must feel rich, atmospheric, detailed, and visually immersive.

The hero product must not be trapped inside the frame.

Make the product break out of the negative-space boundary in a premium, intentional way:
part of the product stays inside the visual world, while part of it extends beyond the frame into the clean outer space.

This frame-breaking moment should create depth, tension, hierarchy, and a strong campaign-level visual hook.

The negative space must feel literal and professional — not just a simple image mask. The silhouette should clearly shape the composition, while the product interacts with it naturally and powerfully.

Adapt the execution to the brand DNA:
- tech should feel clean, precise, futuristic, and intelligent
- fragrance and beauty should feel elegant, sensual, refined, and atmospheric
- food should feel rich, appetizing, textured, and indulgent
- fashion should feel editorial, stylish, cultural, and dynamic
- audio should feel immersive, energetic, tactile, and cinematic
- luxury should feel restrained, polished, timeless, and expensive

Use premium commercial photography, cinematic lighting, refined typography, strong contrast, polished shadows, realistic materials, sharp product detail, high-end composition, and world-class ad finishing.

Add tasteful poster typography inspired by the brand’s visual language with a short 3-word slogan.

Do not use miniature people, tiny worlds, micro cities, product monuments, or exploded-view composition.

Avoid copying any existing real campaign. Create a fresh original negative-space advertisement.

Brand: [BRAND]
Product: [PRODUCT]
Aspect ratio: [RATIO]

prompts.text:
为 [BRAND] 创作一张展示 [PRODUCT] 的高级广告海报。

使用品牌的标志、图标、字形、标签形状、包装框或招牌剪影作为真实的负空间框架。

在该负空间形状内部构建一个电影级的视觉世界，表达产品的细节、情感、起源、质感、功能、工艺、风味、香味、声音或品牌承诺。

外部画布必须保持干净、极简、优雅且受控。

形状内部必须让人感到丰富、有氛围感、细节详尽且视觉沉浸。

核心产品绝不能被困在框架内。

让产品以一种高级且有意识的方式冲破负空间边界：产品的一部分留在视觉世界内，而另一部分则延伸出框架，进入干净的外部空间。

这种破框时刻应创造出深度、张力、层级感和强烈的广告级视觉钩子。

负空间必须感觉真实且专业——而不仅仅是一个简单的图像遮罩。剪影应清晰地塑造构图，同时产品与其自然且有力地互动。

根据品牌基因调整执行方式：
- 科技感应显得干净、精准、未来主义且智能
- 香水和美容应显得优雅、感性、精致且有氛围感
- 食物应显得丰饶、诱人、有质感且放纵
- 时尚应显得社论感、时髦、有文化底蕴且充满活力
- 音频应显得沉浸、充满能量、有触感且具电影感
- 奢侈品应显得克制、考究、永恒且昂贵

使用高级商业摄影、电影级光效、精致的排版、强对比、考究的阴影、真实的材质、锐利的产品细节、高端构图以及世界级的广告后期处理。

加入受品牌视觉语言启发、品味高雅的海报排版，以及一个简短的 3 词标语。

不要使用微缩人物、微观世界、微型城市、产品纪念碑或爆炸图构图。

避免复制任何现有的真实广告活动。创作一张全新的原创负空间广告。

prompts.text:
请生成一张竖版 3:4 的中文成品海报，主题为【填写主题】。

整体方向为“东方古代壁画气质 + 当代中文展览海报设计”。画面需要保留古代壁画的岁月痕迹、旧墙斑驳、矿物颜料感、低饱和东方配色、山水地貌、古建筑、人物活动、桥梁路径、树木、云纹、水纹和装饰边饰，但必须以全新的海报逻辑重新设计。

画面不是普通古风插画，也不是文物修复图，而是一张完成度很高的当代文化海报。请对原始灵感进行大幅度视觉重构：重新编排山体、洞窟、建筑、人物、路径、纹样、留白和标题位置，让画面有清晰的视觉中心、完整的信息层级和适合传播的海报感。

画面风格要求：
1. 东方古壁画遗韵。
2. 旧纸纹理、墙面剥落、斑驳颗粒。
3. 低饱和矿物色，可使用土黄、赭石、豆沙红、雾青、矿物绿、淡青灰、米白、灰粉。
4. 山水、建筑、人物叙事要有层次。
5. 可加入行旅、骆驼、飞天、古树、廊桥、洞窟、壁画残片、祥云、水纹、边饰纹样。
6. 构图可以采用大留白、拼贴分层、局部裁切、长卷式叙事、展览海报排版。
7. 整体要克制、高级、安静，有东方文化气质和当代设计感。

排版要求：
1. 必须有清晰中文主标题：【填写主标题】
2. 必须有中文副标题：【填写副标题】
3. 加入一小段中文说明文字：【填写说明文案】
4. 可加入展览信息、地点、策展信息、署名信息。
5. 如涉及日期，统一使用【当日日期】，不要出现旧年份或随机年份。
6. 署名可写：XXX。
7. 中文必须清晰准确，不要乱码，不要错字。
8. 可加入少量英文辅助小字，但不能英文主导。

画面要像真正可以发布的东方美学展览海报，而不是单纯的插画背景。不要水印，不要真实品牌 Logo，不要电商感，不要廉价国潮感，不要过度鲜艳，不要复杂杂乱。

items.title: 圆窗手绘感新生儿纪念相册卡片

prompts.text:
Generate a bright, clean, and commemorative image around any subject: The composition establishes a sense of breathing with a large area of quiet white space, with a circular real image window placed in the center, where the main subject is softly enveloped with clean but not harsh edges. Extremely thin hand-drawn line art extends from the top edge and sides of the circular window, allowing symbolic characters derived from the subject to peek out from behind the window, crawl on it, or gently embrace the main subject. The lines should remain relaxed, intermittent, and restrained like a children's drawing, without stealing the weight of the real image. A small number of hand-drawn small symbols stay nearby around the line art, forming an intimate, guarded emotion. Colors are extracted from the subject's own materials, seasons, and emotions, maintaining a relationship of large areas of high-brightness clear background colors, soft neutral main images, narrow dark information lines, and very small areas of bright accent colors. The overall feel should be bright, light, clean, and airy; the paper surface can have fine grains but must not look dirty. A light text information layer is arranged at the bottom, with the main title in a slender cursive script and secondary information in a small-size serif font, with wide line spacing and light font colors, like a whispered signature on a private commemorative card. Maintain clear spacing between layers, with the circular window, line art, and text forming a slow reading path along the same quiet central axis. The visual focus is the gentle imagination created by the circular real window and the surrounding line art; do not make the line art into a heavy illustration, and do not let the text or decorations overpower the central main subject.

——————
Newborn Commemoration Direction: Sleeping baby's face + birth information + guardian small animal + private commemorative card
Implementation Purpose: Front page of a newborn's one-month photo album
Soft and Bright Color Palette: Cold mist blue + silver gray white + light pink accents + high-brightness quiet background color
Main Visual Center of Gravity: Central circular window with baby sleeping posture + crawling line art bunny on the upper edge + small heart symbols nearby + vertical 9:16

主视觉重心: 中央圆窗宝宝睡姿+上缘趴伏线稿小兔+近处小爱心符号+竖版 9:16

prompts.text:
Extreme close-up vertical portrait, beautiful East Asian woman, early 20s. Soft oval face, faint freckles, small mole on right cheek, delicate jawline, thin nose. Long straight jet-black hair, thick blunt full bangs, glossy with cool-lit highlights. Large blue-toned eyes looking straight at camera, dreamy/melancholic expression, lips slightly parted with natural pink gloss.
Cinematic cool-toned lighting, teal-cyan color grading, soft volumetric light, subtle rim light on hair, gentle facial shadows. Background: vast blurred Japanese meadow, soft daylight, heavy bokeh, dreamlike. Subject slightly right of center, shoulders/hair cut off at frame bottom.
85mm lens, f/1.8, full-frame, cinematic film grain, ultra-high-res, sharp focus on eyes/face, realistic skin pores and peach fuzz, moist lips, detailed hair strands. Cool tones, skin still looks alive, soft contrast. Mood: melancholic, ethereal, introspective, high-budget film still.

prompts.text:
You are an image generation director.

Style name:
Civic Wax Realism

Style definition:
Create one photorealistic image of an original adult woman who looks like a real person, a wax figure, and a public statue at the same time. Core visual law:
The woman appears alive, but too still.
Her skin appears human, but sealed.
Her clothing appears normal, but institutional.
The location appears public, functional, and indifferent.
The photograph appears factual, not dramatic.

The image must feel like a municipal record, an identification photo taken outside its proper system, or a public archive snapshot of someone who should not move.

Subject:
The subject is an adult woman aged 30 or older.
She must look like a specific individual, not a model and not a fantasy character.
She may be a clerk, applicant, witness, inspector, archivist, nurse, registrar, translator, civil servant, court employee, records worker, public health officer, or silent visitor.

The face is the main design element.

The face should not look dead.
The face should not look animated.
It should occupy the narrow space between living person, wax figure, and civic monument.

The face must remain photorealistic.
Avoid cartoon exaggeration.
Avoid horror monster features.
Avoid gore.
Avoid glamour beauty.
Avoid influencer features.
Avoid polished fashion skin.

Body:
Use an adult female body with ordinary physical weight.
The posture should be upright, seated, waiting, standing in line, holding documents, leaning near a counter, sitting beneath fluorescent light, or facing the camera with bureaucratic stillness.
The body should feel constrained by the setting.
No fashion posing.
No heroic posing.
No sexualized posing.
No theatrical gesture.

Wardrobe:

Use plain blouses, cardigans, office jackets, municipal uniforms, pencil skirts, slacks, low heels, practical shoes, ID lanyards, name badges, cheap jewelry, tired formalwear, public service vests, hospital cardigans, file clerk clothing, or weathered coats.

creased, stiff, polyester, faded, slightly shiny, poorly fitted, overwashed, worn at cuffs, buttoned too tightly, or practical without style.

Use flat frontal light.
Use fluorescent spill from the room.
Use dull color.
Use mild lens distortion.
Use visible skin shine.
Use underexposed corners.
Use hard shadows behind the subject.
Use imperfect framing.
Use documentarian stillness.

Do not use dramatic horror lighting.
Do not use fashion editorial lighting.
Do not use soft beauty lighting.
Do not use painterly effects.
Do not use anime.
Do not use illustration.
Do not use CGI.

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium global motorcycle campaign titled:

THE WAY OF POWER

This is not a conventional motorcycle advertisement.

It should feel like a collector's edition fashion editorial, luxury automotive campaign, Japanese design exhibition, and modern samurai manifesto merged into one iconic image. Every detail should communicate timeless craftsmanship, restraint, precision, and engineering obsession.

---

SCENE

The composition is set during golden hour beneath the massive freeway overpasses of downtown Los Angeles.

The sun sits low on the horizon, flooding the concrete architecture with rich amber light. Long shadows stretch across rain-soaked asphalt while the last puddles from a recent shower reflect the motorcycle like polished bronze mirrors.

The concrete bridges glow with warm sunlight while distant glass skyscrapers shimmer softly against a clear sky.

The atmosphere feels calm after movement—not busy, but alive.

Small pockets of steam rise from drainage grates.

The wet pavement reflects warm sunlight, freeway columns, and the motorcycle with museum-quality realism.

---

THE MOTORCYCLE

At the center stands an original Japanese-inspired superbike—not a replica of any existing manufacturer.

It should embody the philosophy of Japanese engineering:

razor-sharp aerodynamic bodywork

exposed titanium hardware

forged aluminum frame

visible carbon fiber weave

CNC-machined rearsets

sculpted swingarm

premium Öhlins-style suspension

precision brake calipers

titanium exhaust

subtle aerodynamic winglets

intricate radiator fins

perfectly tensioned chain

realistic bolts, welds, fasteners and mechanical components

Every surface should contain tiny rain droplets illuminated by the warm sunset.

The motorcycle is angled slightly toward the viewer in a heroic three-quarter perspective.

The LED headlights remain on, creating a cool white contrast against the warm environment.

It should feel less like transportation and more like industrial sculpture.

---

THE RIDER

Standing beside the motorcycle is a confident rider wearing:

matte black premium riding suit

minimalist tailoring

subtle Japanese fashion influence

no oversized racing branding

premium leather gloves

modern riding boots

The rider removes one glove while the opposite hand gently rests on the fuel tank.

Expression:

calm

focused

disciplined

earned confidence

No aggressive stance.

No exaggerated posing.

The motorcycle should appear to be an extension of the rider rather than something they own.

---

ENVIRONMENT

Blend Los Angeles infrastructure with subtle Japanese philosophy.

Include:

towering freeway pillars

industrial steel

graffiti walls

weathered concrete

reflective puddles

golden sunlight

soft atmospheric haze

distant downtown skyline

Warm sunbeams pass between the overpasses creating cinematic shafts of light.

Japanese philosophy quietly emerges through graphic design.

Subtle sumi ink textures dissolve into drifting mist.

Engineering sketches fade into the air.

Brush calligraphy appears naturally integrated into walls and atmosphere.

Nothing should feel pasted on.

Everything should feel physically present.

---

TYPOGRAPHY

Typography is an architectural element.

Not an overlay.

Massive distressed condensed typography is integrated behind the motorcycle, partially hidden by architecture, reflections and light.

Hero headline:

MADE TO OUTLAST THE ROAD.

Secondary typography:

DISCIPLINE.

PRECISION.

NO COMPROMISE.

CRAFTED FOR THOSE WHO NEVER SETTLE.

ENGINEERED IN JAPAN.

CONQUERING AMERICA.

Typography materials:

weathered paint

aged steel

distressed ink

industrial wear

subtle embossing

soft transparency

sun-faded textures

warm metallic reflections

Letters interact naturally with sunlight, architecture and reflections.

prompts.text:
创建一场名为：

力量之道 (THE WAY OF POWER)

的全球超顶级摩托车广告活动。

这不只是一则常规的摩托车广告。

它应该感觉像是收藏版时尚社论、豪华汽车广告、日本设计展和现代武士宣言的合而为一，形成一个标志性的图像。每一个细节都应传达永恒的工艺、克制、精准和对工程的痴迷。

---

场景

构图设定在洛杉矶市中心宏伟的高速公路立交桥下的黄金时段。

太阳低挂在水平线上，浓郁的琥珀色光芒洒在混凝土建筑上。长长的影子延伸在被雨水浸湿的沥青路面上，而最近一场阵雨留下的最后几处积水像抛光的青铜镜一样反射着摩托车。

混凝土桥梁在温暖的阳光下闪耀，远处玻璃幕墙的摩天大楼在晴朗的天空下柔和地闪烁。

大气层感觉像是在运动后的宁静——并不繁忙，但充满生机。

排水格栅升起一缕缕细小的蒸汽。

湿滑的路面以博物馆级的写实感反射着温暖的阳光、高速公路立柱和摩托车。

---

摩托车

中心位置停放着一辆原创的日系风格超级跑车——并非任何现有制造商的复制品。

它应体现日本工程哲学：

锋利的空气动力学车身

外露的钛合金硬件

锻造铝合金车架

可见的碳纤维编织

CNC加工的后脚踏

雕刻感的摇臂

高级 Öhlins 风格悬挂

精密刹车卡钳

钛合金排气管

微妙的空气动力学小翼

复杂的散热片

张紧完美的链条

真实的螺栓、焊缝、紧固件和机械部件

每一个表面都应包含被温暖落日照亮的细小雨滴。

摩托车稍微朝向观众，呈英雄式的四分之三透视角度。

LED 大灯保持开启，在温暖的环境中创造出冷白色的对比。

它应该感觉不像交通工具，而更像工业雕塑。

---

骑手

站在摩托车旁的是一位自信的骑手，穿着：

哑光黑色高级骑行服

极简剪裁

微妙的日本时尚影响

没有夸张的赛车品牌标志

高级皮革手套

现代骑行靴

骑手摘下一只手套，另一只手轻轻搭在油箱上。

表情：

冷静

专注

自律

赢得的自信

没有挑衅姿态。

没有夸张的造型。

摩托车应当显得像是骑手的延伸，而不是他们拥有的某件物品。

---

环境

将洛杉矶的基础设施与微妙的日本哲学融合。

包括：

高耸的高速公路柱子

工业钢铁

涂鸦墙

饱经风霜的混凝土

反光的积水

金色的阳光

柔和的大气薄雾

远处的城市天际线

温暖的阳光穿过立交桥，营造出电影般的丁达尔光效应。

日本哲学通过平面设计静静呈现。

微妙的水墨纹理消融在飘动的薄雾中。

工程草图在空气中隐现。

毛笔书法自然地融入墙壁和大气中。

没有任何东西感觉是粘贴上去的。

一切都应感觉是真实存在的。

---

排版

排版是一个建筑元素。

不是覆盖层。

巨大的仿旧压缩字体集成在摩托车后方，部分被建筑、反射和光线遮挡。

主标题：

为超越道路而生 (MADE TO OUTLAST THE ROAD.)

副标题：

自律。

精准。

绝不妥协。

为永不满足者打造。

日本工程。

征服美国。

字体材质：

风化的油漆

老化的钢铁

仿旧油墨

工业磨损

微妙的浮雕

柔和的透明度

日晒褪色的纹理

温暖的金属反射

字母与阳光、建筑和反射自然互动。

[Background Elements (Optional)] The background consists of a grey stone pool deck with a delicate textured surface and an emerald pool water surface shimmering bright white in the sunlight. To match the magazine layout, a large red bold "BLANC" logo is placed at the top without obscuring the character's face, layered behind the face. prompts.text:
[人物] 图像 1 [签名] 右下角有 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志小巧地放置着，其上方以白色手写体小字写着像签名一样的“CHAse”。  

[人物的姿势及表情]  
在清凉的翡翠色泳池边缘双手撑着，仿佛要从水中浮起又犹豫不决，用手掌推着池底，大腿直到水面外露的状态，凝视着镜头的妖娆姿势。高头微微后仰，优雅地展现出下巴线条和颈部曲线，半张开的嘴唇以及高傲却又迷人的眼神，散发着高级时尚杂志封面特有的压倒性魅力。人物的上半身朝框架左侧90度方向。  

[人物服装]  
穿着经典却大胆的胸前深V开叉的炭黑色高级感礼服。上身饰有精致立体的银色珠绣细节，精细绣制而成，裙部则由略微湿润般丰盈厚重的黑色羽毛装饰构成，完美诠释奢华的夏日魅力造型。  

[人物发型及妆容细节]  
仿佛刚从泳池中出来般，水湿后整齐向后梳拢的顺滑湿发（湿发造型）。妆容以强调眼部深邃柔和的棕色烟熏眼妆为基础，嘴唇搭配沉稳哑光的裸色米色调唇膏。耳朵上戴着令人联想到蜥蜴或链条的华丽长款银色水滴耳坠，脖子上佩戴粗犷链式银色项链，增添闪耀的亮点。  

[照明及光线方向]  
如同专业画报拍摄般的人工柔和光线，人物左侧脸颊微微洒落光线，而右侧脸颊则相对形成强烈的阴影。泳池水面反射的粼光和阳光在人物右侧肩膀、锁骨以及脸颊上营造出平滑的高光，清晰凸显健康富有弹性的肌肤质感。  

[质感与色调氛围]  
泳池水色的清凉青绿色（Turquoise Blue）与礼服的厚重深色调，以及杂志标题的强烈红色（Red），在视觉上形成完美的对比。闪耀珠绣的金属质感、羽毛的柔软纹理，以及阳光下荡漾的水的透明质感交织融合，营造出精致高端的度假画报氛围。  

[胶片及镜头景深、角度]  
使用光圈 f/2.8、快门速度 1/1000 秒、ISO 100、焦距 50mm 标准定焦镜头拍摄。人物坐在泳池平台（Deck）上最具魅力的造型轮廓，为了最吸引人地捕捉，从眼平高度略微侧面拍摄的中景构图。人物的面部和服装正面锐利如刀刃般清晰对焦，而后方荡漾的水面涟漪则柔和地虚化处理，赋予人物完整的沉浸感。  

[背景元素（可选）]  
背景由带有细腻凹凸质感的灰色石质泳池平台，以及阳光下白亮闪烁的翡翠色泳池水面构成。为匹配杂志布局，上方以大型红色粗体字体放置“BLANC”标志，且不遮挡人物脸部，在脸部后方分层布置。左右侧空间感性地叠加了“CHASE”、“WHAT'S SEXY NOW”等希腊语与英文结合的精致白色及红色时尚排版文字。

逼真的照片风格。细致描绘夏日强烈的日照、白沙的细小颗粒、肌肤的自然光泽、比基尼布料的张力、头发的束感，以及落于沙上的影子。色彩采用明亮透明的南国调性。碧蓝海洋、白沙、浅粉色泳装清爽协调。不施加过度美肌修饰或AI式的均匀肌肤，保留自然的油光和柔和阴影。

负面提示：
不自然的五官或视线、多余或缺失的手指、手指融合、手腕或肘部的破损、身体过度扭曲、漂浮感不足、看起来像接触沙子的身体、无影子、影子方向与光源矛盾、腰间的丝巾或纱笼、多余布料、过度性感的姿势、不自然夸张的体型、塑料般的肌肤、过度过曝的肌肤、文字乱码、标志、水印。

prompts.text: Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese character collage concept poster, which must be a finished poster with completed Chinese typography. The overall style is: high-end character poster, paper collage, emotional reorganization, editorial design, Chinese typography, art poster, soft realistic portrait, material collage, quiet but with visual tension. The main subject of the image is a half-body portrait of a young woman with clear facial features and emotional eyes, avoiding a common photoshoot or influencer look. The portrait needs to be deconstructed and collaged: parts of the face, hair, shoulders, neck, or body covered, displaced, obscured, and overlapped by fragments of different materials, then reorganized into a complete but slightly fragmented portrait. Collage materials can include: torn paper, old photos, film negatives, transparent glass pieces, handwritten notes, letter paper, stamps, pressed flower specimens, botanical pressings, broken mirrors, blueprint paper, data glitch blocks, pages in the wind, old newspapers, tape, clips, needles and pins. The image is not a messy collage but has a clear design order: the main subject is centered or slightly off-center; the main Chinese title is clear and eye-catching; auxiliary text is restrained and distributed; paper and text naturally blend into the character's structure; the background is simple with white space; overall it looks like a high-end magazine cover or an art exhibition poster. Chinese typography requirements: Main title says "【主标题】"; Subtitle says "【副标题】"; Include 2-4 short Chinese copy sentences, which can look like handwritten notes, corner annotations, vertical small text, or poster descriptions. The text must be clear, no gibberish, no typos. If dates are involved, use "当日" or "【当日日期】", do not write old years. Atmosphere: fragmented, reorganized, quiet, emotional, memory, time, farewell, self-healing, soft but powerful. Do not: no cheap collage templates, no e-commerce posters, no excessive cyber elements, no exaggerated special effects, no watermarks, no real brand logos, no gibberish, no old dates.

prompts.text: Create a charming editorial travel illustration of {DESTINATION} in a simple hand-drawn doodled style, as if sketched by hand with a black felt-tip marker in a travel notebook. The illustration should feel personal, spontaneous, and imperfect rather than digitally designed. Think of the kind of drawing someone might casually create while sitting at a café after exploring the destination.** ## COLOR PALETTE Keep the illustration almost entirely black and white. Use **only one accent color: {ONE POINT COLOR}** ## STYLE Draw entirely with black felt-tip pen lines. Use slightly wobbly hand-drawn contours, natural line variation, loose marker strokes, sketch-like confidence, subtle imperfections, slightly open line endings, uneven hand pressure, and occasional overlapping strokes. Every line should clearly look handmade. Avoid perfectly smooth curves, mechanically precise outlines, polished vector graphics, or overly crisp digital rendering. ## SUBJECT Illustrate the unique atmosphere and instantly recognizable identity of **{DESTINATION}** rather than producing a realistic cityscape. Select the destination's most iconic landmarks, characteristic architecture, local transportation, famous scenery, native plants, local animals, regional food, and cultural objects. Focus on the spirit of the destination instead of literal accuracy. ## COMPOSITION Arrange the selected elements into a balanced editorial composition with generous white space. The layout should feel open, light, and effortless, similar to a designer's travel sketchbook. Allow objects to overlap naturally without becoming crowded. Every element should have room to breathe. Keep the composition visually relaxed and uncluttered. Apply the blue sparingly to selected details such as water, sky, windows, signs, clothing accents, decorative highlights, or small architectural features. Never introduce any additional colors. ## DRAWING STYLE Keep every object simple and intentionally simplified. Use flat shapes with minimal interior detail. Avoid realistic textures, gradients, shadows, painterly brushwork, glossy surfaces, or complex rendering. The illustration should remain clean, airy, understated, and highly graphic. ## LINE QUALITY The black marker lines are the main visual feature. Lines should feel confident, casual, lively, expressive, and naturally imperfect. Slightly uneven contours, open edges, variable line thickness, and small drawing inaccuracies are encouraged because they enhance the authentic hand-drawn feeling. ## MOOD Warm. Friendly. Relaxed. Playful. Minimal. Editorial. Contemporary. Elegant through simplicity. The finished artwork should resemble a beautifully designed travel notebook, boutique travel guide, editorial magazine illustration, or lifestyle sketchbook rather than a polished digital illustration. ## IMPORTANT No photorealism. No 3D rendering. No painterly effects. No gradients. No heavy shadows. No glossy lighting. No vector-clean artwork. No excessive detail. No busy composition. Preserve generous white space. Maintain a flat editorial doodle aesthetic with a distinctly handmade character. The final image should instantly evoke **{DESTINATION}** through simple, expressive black felt-tip sketches with subtle sky-blue accents.

prompts.text: 为{DESTINATION}创作一个迷人的编辑风格旅游插画，采用简约的手绘涂鸦风格，就像是在旅行笔记本中用黑色毡尖笔手绘而成的。插画应该感觉非常私人、自发且不完美，而不是数字设计的。想象一下，有人在游览完目的地后坐在咖啡馆里随手创作的那种绘画。## 色彩组合 保持插画几乎完全是黑白的。仅使用一种强调色：{ONE POINT COLOR} ## 风格 完全使用黑色毡尖笔线条绘制。使用略微摇晃的手绘轮廓、自然的线条变化、松散的马克笔笔触、素描般的自信、微妙的不完美、稍微开口的线条末端、不均匀的手部压力以及偶尔重叠的笔触。每一根线条都应该清晰地看起来是手工制作的。避免完美的平滑曲线、机械精确的轮廓、精致的矢量图形或过于清晰的数字渲染。 ## 主题 描绘{DESTINATION}独特的氛围和极具辨识度的身份，而不是制作逼真的城市景观。选择该目的地最具标志性的地标、特色建筑、当地交通、著名风景、原生植物、当地动物、地区美食和文化物品。专注于目的地的精神，而不是字面上的准确性。 ## 构图 将选定的元素排列成一个平衡的编辑构图，并留出大量的空白。布局应该感觉开放、轻盈且毫不费力，类似于设计师的旅行写生本。允许物体自然重叠而不会变得拥挤。每个元素都应该有呼吸的空间。保持构图在视觉上放松且不凌乱。将蓝色少量地应用于选定的细节，如水、天空、窗户、标志、服装点缀、装饰亮点或小型建筑特征。绝不要引入任何其他颜色。 ## 绘画风格 保持每个物体简单且刻意简化。使用内部细节极少的扁平形状。避免逼真的纹理、渐变、阴影、绘画般的画笔技巧、光泽表面或复杂的渲染。插画应保持干净、大气、低调且具有高度的平面感。 ## 线条质量 黑色马克笔线条是主要的视觉特征。线条应该感觉自信、随性、活泼、富有表现力且自然地不完美。鼓励略微不均匀的轮廓、开口的边缘、变化的线条厚度和微小的绘画误差，因为它们增强了真实的手绘感。 ## 氛围 温暖。友好。放松。俏皮。极简。编辑风格。当代感。通过简约体现优雅。成品艺术品应类似于设计精美的旅行笔记本、精品旅行指南、编辑杂志插画或生活方式速写本，而不是精致的数字插图。 ## 重要事项 不要摄影写实。不要3D渲染。不要绘画效果。不要渐变。不要重阴影。不要光泽照明。不要矢量般整洁的艺术品。不要过多的细节。不要拥挤的构图。保留大量的空白。保持具有明显手工特性的扁平编辑涂鸦美学。最终图像应通过简单、富有表现力的黑色毡尖笔草图和微妙的天蓝色点缀，瞬间唤起对{DESTINATION}的记忆。

prompts.text:
创建一个愉快且富有创意的构图，将逼真的主体与俏皮的手绘涂鸦和微妙的小故事融为一体。

主体：
[插入物体 / 人 / 产品 — 保持简单且易于识别]

布局：

涂鸦（重要）：
- 俏皮、富有表现力、略带夸张
- 包含：笑脸、星星、火花、箭头、运动线条、可爱的图标

微型故事：
- 添加一个微小、有趣的叙事（例如，涂鸦角色使用物体，对其做出反应）
- 保持微妙，在第二次看时才会被发现

排版：
- 友好的无衬线字体 + 手写笔记

items.title: Y2K原宿风品牌徽章矢量插画设计

prompts.text:
[BRAND NAME]

You are a senior vector designer specializing in Y2K Harajuku badge art. Your world: Tokyo bootleg culture, early 2000s Japanese brand remixes, retro-futuristic sticker aesthetics. Every output should look like a clean Illustrator vector file, flat and sticker-ready. The badge structure must be invented fresh for each brand, not templated.

BRAND ANALYSIS

Before designing, resolve all of the following: (1) PRIMARY COLOR — brand's main color softened into a pastel Y2K version, still recognizable but lighter and more kawaii; (2) ACCENT COLOR — brand's secondary color pushed to warm saturation for energetic pop; (3) DARK COLOR — deep brand palette (navy, dark brown, near-black) used for outlines and extrusions; (4) LETTER CONTENT — brand name in bold lowercase or most iconic abbreviation; (5) KATAKANA — correct Japanese transliteration as a secondary text element; (6) ORIGIN FLAG — brand's country of origin flag as a small flat element; (7) SHAPE LANGUAGE — iconic geometric forms from the brand's visual identity used as orbital and background elements, never generic ovals; (8) CULTURAL SYMBOLS — 1-2 small iconic objects from the brand's universe rendered as tiny flat illustrations; (9) COMPOSITION LOGIC — design the badge layout using everything above so it feels invented specifically for this brand.

CANVAS

1:1 square. Flat off-white or warm light grey background. Completely empty, no texture, no gradient.

BADGE STRUCTURE

Using the resolved shape language and composition logic, build the full badge. Fixed rules: central lettering element, surrounding brand-specific shapes with z-layer stacking, at least one element passing both behind and in front of the letters for depth, and a unified badge or patch silhouette. The shapes must feel inevitable, as if they could only belong to this brand. Everything else is determined by the brand's own visual DNA.

LETTERING

Brand name in large bold lowercase with a wide rounded display typeface. Flat PRIMARY COLOR fill. Thick DARK COLOR extrusion offset down-right at 8-12% of letter height. Bold DARK COLOR outline. No gradients, no rendering.

Y2K SIGNATURE ELEMENTS

Every badge must include: SPEED LINES or motion texture in ACCENT COLOR inside background shapes. SHARP 4-POINT STAR as a decorative accent near the lettering in DARK COLOR. KATAKANA transliteration tucked naturally into the composition. ORIGIN FLAG as a small accurate flat element. BRAND CULTURAL SYMBOL rendered as a tiny flat illustration integrated into the badge.

TECH SPECS

Flat vector only. Zero gradients, effects, blur, or rendering. Clean crisp edges throughout. Maximum 4 colors: PRIMARY pastel, ACCENT warm saturated, DARK outline, off-white. Must feel like a collectible sticker or embroidered patch. Every brand produces a structurally different badge because every brand has different shape language. The Y2K Japanese aesthetic is the constant, the structure is the variable.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
[品牌名称]

你是一位资深矢量设计师，擅长 Y2K 原宿徽章艺术。你的世界：东京靴子（bootleg）文化、21 世纪初日本品牌重混、复古未来主义贴纸美学。每一个输出都应该看起来像一个干净的 Illustrator 矢量文件，扁平且可直接作为贴纸使用。徽章结构必须为每个品牌重新发明，而不是使用模板。

品牌分析

在设计之前，解决以下所有问题：(1) 主色 —— 品牌的主色调软化为粉彩 Y2K 版本，保持识别度但更轻盈、更可爱；(2) 强调色 —— 品牌的次要颜色推向暖色饱和度，以获得充满活力的流行感；(3) 深色 —— 品牌深色调（海军蓝、深棕色、近黑色），用于轮廓和挤压效果；(4) 字母内容 —— 粗体小写字母或最具标志性的缩写形式的品牌名称；(5) 片假名 —— 正确的日语译音，作为次要文本元素；(6) 产地旗帜 —— 品牌原产国国旗，作为一个小的扁平元素；(7) 形状语言 —— 来自品牌视觉身份的标志性几何形状，用作轨道和背景元素，绝非通用的椭圆形；(8) 文化符号 —— 1-2 个来自品牌领域的标志性小物体，渲染为微小的扁平插画；(9) 构图逻辑 —— 使用上述所有元素设计徽章布局，使其感觉是专门为该品牌发明的。

画布

1:1 正方形。扁平的米白色或暖浅灰色背景。完全空白，无纹理，无渐变。

徽章结构

利用解析出的形状语言和构图逻辑，构建完整的徽章。固定规则：中央字母元素，周围环绕品牌特定形状并带有 z 轴图层堆叠，至少有一个元素穿过字母的后方和前方以增加深度，以及统一的徽章或补丁轮廓。这些形状必须感觉是必然的，仿佛它们只能属于这个品牌。其他一切都由品牌自身的视觉 DNA 决定。

字体设计

品牌名称采用大号粗体小写字母，使用宽大的圆角显示字体。扁平的主色填充。粗壮的深色挤压效果，在字母高度的 8-12% 处向右下方偏移。粗体深色轮廓。无渐变，无渲染。

Y2K 签名元素

每个徽章必须包含：背景形状内部的强调色速度线或运动纹理。字母附近的深色尖锐四角星作为装饰。自然融入构图的片假名译音。作为小型准确扁平元素的产地旗帜。品牌文化符号，渲染为集成到徽章中的微型扁平插画。

技术规格

仅限扁平矢量。零渐变、特效、模糊或渲染。全程保持干净利落的边缘。最多 4 种颜色：粉彩主色、暖饱和强调色、深色轮廓、米白色。必须感觉像是一张收藏级贴纸或刺绣补丁。每个品牌都会产生结构不同的徽章，因为每个品牌都有不同的形状语言。Y2K 日本美学是常量，结构是变量。

prompts.text:
Create a premium advertising poster for [BRAND] featuring [PRODUCT].

Build the poster as a cinematic exploded-view composition where the product appears suspended in space, separated into its essential layers, materials, ingredients, components, textures, or sensory elements.

The goal is not technical instruction. The goal is visual storytelling.

Every floating layer should reveal something meaningful about the product:
- tech products reveal precision, lenses, chips, screens, light, signals, glass, metal, and intelligence
- food products reveal flavor, texture, ingredients, crumbs, cream, steam, sauce, crunch, or freshness
- beverage products reveal liquid energy, bubbles, ice, fruit, condensation, motion, and refreshment
- fashion products reveal fabric, stitching, sole structure, leather, mesh, motion, identity, and lifestyle
- beauty products reveal scent, botanicals, liquid, glass, skin glow, mist, ritual, and refinement
- luxury products reveal craft, heritage, materials, polish, shadows, and timeless design

Keep the product accurate, recognizable, sharp, and visually dominant.

Arrange the exploded elements with premium art direction, cinematic lighting, clean depth, polished reflections, strong negative space, dramatic shadows, and a clear visual hierarchy.

The image should feel like a world-class campaign poster: iconic, expensive, scroll-stopping, and specifically designed for this exact brand and product.

Do not use miniature people, tiny worlds, product monuments, or city-scale scenes.

Add tasteful poster typography inspired by the brand’s visual language, with a short 3-word slogan.

Avoid copying any existing campaign. Create a fresh original visual system.

Aspect ratio: [RATIO]

prompts.text:
为[BRAND]品牌的产品[PRODUCT]制作一张高级广告海报。

将海报构建为电影感的爆炸视图构图，产品悬浮在空间中，被分解为基本层级、材料、成分、组件、纹理或感官元素。

目的不是技术说明。目的是视觉叙事。

每一个悬浮层都应揭示出关于产品的有意义的信息：
- 科技产品揭示精密性、镜头、芯片、屏幕、光线、信号、玻璃、金属和智能
- 食品揭示风味、纹理、成分、碎屑、奶油、蒸汽、酱汁、脆度或新鲜度
- 饮料产品揭示液体能量、气泡、冰、水果、冷凝、运动和清爽感
- 时尚产品揭示面料、缝线、鞋底结构、皮革、网眼、运动、身份和生活方式
- 美容产品揭示香气、植物成分、液体、玻璃、皮肤光泽、薄雾、仪式和精致感
- 奢侈品揭示工艺、传承、材料、抛光、阴影和永恒的设计

保持产品准确、可辨认、锐利且在视觉上占主导地位。

以高级艺术指导、电影感灯光、清晰的深度、抛光的反射、强烈的负空间、戏剧性的阴影和清晰的视觉层级来排列爆炸元素。

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium global Skittles campaign titled:

PAINT OUTSIDE THE FLAVOR.

This is not a candy advertisement.

It should feel like imagination escaping into the real world—where every Skittle unlocks a different burst of color, personality, and playful chaos.

The composition captures a stylish young creator skateboarding effortlessly through an old European-inspired city plaza immediately after a summer rain. The wet cobblestone streets act like giant mirrors, reflecting the vibrant architecture around them.

Instead of ordinary rain...

the sky is experiencing a "Flavor Storm."

Hundreds of glowing liquid droplets descend from the clouds—not water, but suspended streams of vibrant fruit-colored paint, sparkling candy dust, translucent syrup ribbons, floating fruit slices, tiny glowing stars, and shimmering sugar crystals.

Each droplet creates something extraordinary when it touches the ground.

Red drops bloom into swirling raspberry galaxies.

Yellow splashes become radiant citrus sunbursts.

Green impacts grow luminous lime vines made entirely from light.

Purple droplets unfold into miniature cosmic nebulas.

Orange impacts explode into energetic spirals of tropical fruit particles.

Every puddle becomes a living abstract artwork, transforming the entire street into an interactive rainbow masterpiece.

The subject glides confidently through this explosion of creativity, leaving glowing colorful wheel trails behind them while laughing naturally. Their white sneakers gradually collect splashes of every color, becoming wearable works of art.

Massive translucent candy ribbons float through the air, bending naturally around buildings, balconies, street lamps, cafés, and trees without ever feeling artificial.

---

TYPOGRAPHY

Typography behaves like part of the artwork itself.

Large expressive paint-brush lettering stretches across the skyline:

COLOR HAS NO RULES.

Supporting campaign copy:

One handful. Infinite imagination.

Life deserves louder colors.

Every flavor leaves a mark.

Turn ordinary into unforgettable.

Playful graphic elements include:

• fruit burst indicators

• flavor spectrum charts

• splash icons

• hand-painted arrows

• candy constellation graphics

• sketchbook doodles

• rainbow paint streaks

• playful editorial stamps

• premium packaging callouts

Typography should feel hand-crafted, energetic, and deeply integrated into the painted environment.

---

COLOR PALETTE

Explosive rainbow spectrum

Electric magenta

Lemon yellow

Lime green

Ocean cyan

Tangerine orange

Rich violet

Brilliant white highlights

Highly saturated cinematic contrast balanced by realistic lighting.

---

PHOTOGRAPHY & ART DIRECTION

Luxury FMCG advertising

Premium lifestyle editorial

Hyper-realistic liquid simulations

Ultra-detailed fruit textures

Photorealistic reflections

Dynamic environmental storytelling

Natural expressions

Award-winning commercial photography

Shallow cinematic depth of field

High dynamic range

Ultra-realistic lighting

Rich color grading

8K resolution

Every droplet should sparkle like liquid glass. Every splash should feel physically believable despite its surreal creativity. The image should balance realism with fantasy, creating the feeling that the entire city has become a living celebration of flavor.

The final campaign should resemble a Cannes Lions-winning global Skittles launch—playful yet sophisticated, artistically daring, instantly recognizable, and impossible to scroll past.

创作一个顶级全球彩虹糖广告活动，标题为：

prompts.text:
Subject:
Bear on the wall and summer alley

Character/Expression:
A female in her 20s. Bright and healthy atmosphere, with natural fair skin shining in the sunlight. Soft face, long straight black hair lightly tied in a half-ponytail, with fine bangs on the forehead and stray hairs gently swaying in the wind. The makeup is a translucent natural Japanese style, with slightly flushed cheeks and a natural lip color with suppressed gloss. Looking back at the camera with a bright smile full of openness. The expression is a mix of surprise and joy.

Clothing/Pose:
A light ice blue summer top. An asymmetric off-the-shoulder design with the right shoulder naturally exposed, and a lightweight style with one sleeve slightly baggy. The bottom is a white flowing long skirt, made of thin, lightweight fabric that flares out significantly while walking. On her feet are white sneakers. The woman is in the moment of running forward lightly, her upper body turned toward the direction of travel, with only her face looking back. One arm is slightly bent forward, and the back of the other sleeve is being pulled. The left leg is slightly raised backward, with the hem of the skirt swaying dynamically.

Background/Lighting:
A sunny afternoon alley. On the left side of the frame is a continuous concrete wall, covered with colorful graffiti. The main graffiti is a soft light blue bear character. It has large round eyes, pink cheeks, a pink bow on its head, and is wearing pink shorts, giving a gentle and cute impression overall. The character is drawn entirely as wall graffiti, not three-dimensional, and does not jump out from the wall. Only the bear's hand is in a trompe-l'oeil composition as if it is pulling the woman's clothing. Surrounded by pop decorations like hearts, stars, flowers, and paint splashes. The lighting is soft summer sunlight pouring from the upper right, illuminating the woman's face, shoulders, and the front of her skirt, casting natural shadows at her feet. The depth of the alley in the background is slightly blurred, moderately integrating the atmosphere of utility poles and buildings.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical composition. A full-body street portrait. The woman is positioned off-center to the right of the frame, while the graffiti bear is prominently placed on the wall on the left side, clearly showing the "clothes being pulled" relationship through the sense of distance between the two. A natural perspective close to waist height, shot from a slight angle along the alley. Captures the woman's body movements and the flow of the skirt from a medium distance. The face is clearly in focus, with the background slightly blurred.

Texture/Style:
Realistic Japanese street snap photo. Utilizes the bright and refreshing texture of summer using natural light. The skin is smooth but not over-edited, detailing the tension of the clothing fabric and the transparency of the skirt. The rough texture of the wall, the bleeding of the paint, and the overlapping of colors are all presented one by one. Overall clean and refreshing, with a high level of completion where pop and cute graffiti harmoniously coexist with lightweight portrait photography.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, overly childish face, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, extra or missing fingers, deformed hands and feet, unnatural joints, gravity distortion, unnatural way clothing is pulled, unnatural skirt flare, three-dimensional representation of wall characters, characters jumping out of the wall, scary-looking graffiti, excessively vibrant chromatic aberration, extra people, readable text, logos, watermarks.

纵向构图。全身入镜的街头肖像。女性位于画面右侧偏位，涂鸦熊则大面积配置在画面左侧的墙面上，通过两者距离感明确展现“衣物被拉扯”的关系。镜头接近腰部高度的自然视角，从略微斜角沿巷子拍摄。中距离捕捉女性的身体动作和裙摆流动。脸部清晰对焦，背景轻微虚化。

真实的日系街头抓拍照片。活用自然光的明亮清爽夏日质感。肌肤平滑却不过度修饰，细致描绘衣物布料的张力和裙子的轻透感。墙面的粗糙纹理、颜料的晕染、色彩的重叠也一一呈现。整体干净清爽，流行可爱的涂鸦与轻盈的人物摄影和谐共存的完成度。

不自然的五官、过于幼稚的脸庞、过度美肌修正、塑料般的肌肤、多余或缺失的手指、手脚变形、不自然的关节、重力失真、衣物拉扯方式的不自然、裙子展开的不自然、墙上角色立体化的表现、从墙上跃出的角色、可怕表情的涂鸦、过度艳丽的色差、多余人物、可读文字、标志、水印。

prompts.text:
Ultra-realistic candid smartphone photograph, 9:16 vertical.

Use the attached image only as a strong visual inspiration for the subject's hairstyle, overall facial proportions, natural beauty, and general aesthetic,
while ensuring the generated subject remains fully original, non-identifiable, and not a face copy.

Scene
Nighttime on a quiet Tokyo city sidewalk beside a building with white ceramic tile walls.
The subject is walking past the camera, partially side-on, captured mid-step in a natural, spontaneous moment.

Appearance
A young woman with long chestnut-brown layered hair, soft curtain bangs, fair natural skin, hazel-green eyes, subtle natural makeup, and delicate European facial features inspired by the reference image while remaining an original, non-identifiable person.
She is wearing a plain fitted white T-shirt with short sleeves, no logos, no graphics, no accessories or outerwear.

Pose & Expression
The subject casually turns her head slightly toward the camera while continuing to walk forward.
She wears a relaxed, genuine, natural smile with a warm and friendly expression.
Her body remains angled in half-profile as she continues walking.
The framing is slightly imperfect, as if captured quickly while passing by.

Camera & Motion
Shot on a modern smartphone, handheld, rushed capture. Strong uncontrolled camera shake. Heavy directional motion blur across the hair, face, and body. Facial features appear naturally softened by motion blur without becoming unrecognizable. Partial ghosting around the moving body. Imperfect framing, subject nearly leaving the frame.

Lighting
Flash-only lighting fired mid-motion. Harsh flash highlights on the face and white T-shirt. Deep surrounding darkness. Uneven exposure, blown highlights, hard shadows typical of hurried night smartphone photography.

Background
White ceramic tile wall stretches into streaked light bands due to motion blur. Street surroundings fade into darkness with minimal readable detail.

Mood
Natural, candid, friendly, relaxed, authentic. Feels like a genuine spontaneous smartphone snapshot captured while passing by.

Image Quality
Extremely noisy. Heavily blurred. Raw smartphone look. Not cinematic. Not editorial. Not polished.

场景
夜晚在东京安静的城市人行道上，旁边是一栋贴着白色瓷砖墙的建筑。拍摄对象正走过镜头，部分侧身，在自然、自发的瞬间被抓拍到迈步的动作。

一位留着栗棕色长分层发型、柔和法式刘海、皮肤白皙自然、淡绿色眼睛、淡雅自然妆容、受参考图启发但保持原创且不可识别的具有精致欧洲面部特征的年轻女性。她穿着一件纯色合身的白色短袖 T 恤，没有徽标，没有图案，没有配饰或外套。

姿势与表情
拍摄对象在继续向前走的同时，漫不经心地微微转头看向镜头。她带着轻松、真实、自然的微笑，表情温暖友好。当她继续行走时，她的身体保持半侧面。构图略显不完美，就像在路过时快速捕捉到的一样。

相机与动作
使用现代智能手机拍摄，手持，匆忙捕捉。强烈的、无法控制的相机抖动。头发、脸部和身体都有沉重的定向运动模糊。面部特征在运动模糊的作用下自然柔化，但并非无法辨认。移动的身体周围有部分重影。构图不完美，拍摄对象几乎要离开画面。

运动中触发的纯闪光灯照明。脸部和白色 T 恤上有刺眼的闪光高光。周围深邃的黑暗。曝光不均匀，高光溢出，硬阴影，这是匆忙的夜晚手机摄影的典型特征。

背景
由于运动模糊，白瓷砖墙延伸成条纹状的光带。街道周围环境退入黑暗，细节极少。

氛围
自然、真实、友好、轻松、地道。感觉像是一个真正的、在路过时捕捉到的自发手机快照。

图像质量
极其多噪点。严重模糊。原始手机外观。非电影感。非编辑感。未经磨皮。

动漫，插画，绘画，风格化，影棚灯光，美容灯光，柔和肖像，焦点清晰，干净的面部，完美解剖，光滑的皮肤，时尚编辑，摆拍肖像，电影级调色，电影剧照，三脚架拍摄，专业摄影，连帽衫，夹克，外套，毛衣，衬衫，连衣裙，印花服装，徽标，配饰，身份匹配，面部复制，真实人物复制

items.title: 涂鸦小人举起漂浮女孩超写实摄影

prompts.text:
In the clean and simple studio, use a soft light gray seamless background to create ultra-realistic editing lifestyle photos.

The protagonist of the picture is a young girl with a fresh, kind and charming appearance. She looked like she was floating lightly in the air, with a happy and slightly surprised expression on her face, as if she was being supported by the forces below. She showed a bright smile, her eyes were agile, and the overall atmosphere was playful and pleasing. The body posture should present a natural sense of weightlessness, with a slightly rising feeling and relaxed and elegant lines.

Posture:

The posture of floating in mid-air.

Feet are completely off the ground.

The body can be tilted slightly to present a sense of natural balance of being held up or suspended.

The hands are naturally relaxed, and you can open them slightly or lift them gently to maintain balance.

The legs are naturally slightly bent or gently extended downwards to enhance the feeling of floating.

Hair and clothing should have some light dynamics that slightly violate gravity.

Appearance:

A beautiful Taiwanese girl.

The skin is naturally clear.

The facial features are soft and flexible.

The expression is youthful and warm.

Dark long hair or soft medium long hair, and the hair ribbon is slightly floating.

Wear and match:

Wearing soft pink or light-colored clothes, with a sense of fashion editing.

For example: cream-colored loose knitted top or light-colored top, with elegant long skirt or loose trousers.

The whole is clean, tasteful and modern.

It can be matched with white socks and simple sneakers/loafers.

There are several cute black hand-painted graffiti villains below, in a minimalist style, as if they really work together to lift her up from below.

Every graffiti villain should have:

Round head,

Small dot-shaped eyes,

Simple little mouth,

Thick black microphone pen lines,

Posture with a small expression and a sense of movement.

These graffiti villains should gather at her feet, under her legs or under her body, all holding their hands high, as if to support her weight together. Some villains can seem to stretch their arms hard, some tremble slightly, and some show a serious and cute feeling.

Add tiny motion lines around the doodle characters' arms, bodies, and legs to emphasize effort, wobb Ling, and teamwork.

Add small dynamic lines around the arms, body and legs of the graffiti villain, emphasizing the feeling of hard support, trembling and joint lifting.

Add playful graffiti dynamic lines around the body, hair and feet of the floating girl, emphasizing the feeling of lightness, bounce and upward support.

Interaction and physical sense:

The girl's body must remain completely realistic, while the graffiti villain creates the humorous illusion of "really lifting her up".

Her floating posture should be credible, as if she was really supported by the bottom.

The overall interaction should be childish, pleasing and humorous, while maintaining a reasonable center of gravity of the human body, clothing fabric performance and hair dynamics.

Hand and anatomy:

The structure of the hands and limbs is correct.

The proportion of fingers is natural.

The body posture and balance are real and credible.

The fabric of clothing is naturally drooping, but at the same time, there is a slight sense of floating.

Light and style:

Bright high-profile studio lights.

Soft and natural shadow.

Extremely concise minimalist composition.

Magazine-style life photography.

Humorous visual narrative.

High-quality modern aesthetics.

Playful, warm and lovely atmosphere.

Super realistic.

The details are clear.

8K image quality.

Vertical 4:5 proportional composition.

杂志风格的生活摄影。

俏皮、温暖且可爱的氛围。

items.title: 梦幻感海洋艺术设计海报生成

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 artistic poster; it must be a finished poster with typography already completed.

The theme is [Fill in Theme]. The overall style is not ordinary ocean photography or ordinary fish illustrations, but a conceptual poster with strong emotional temperament, a sense of dreams, atmosphere, and a sense of design.

[Core Visuals]
The image features [schools of fish / jellyfish / tropical fish / glowing fish / translucent marine life / floating objects / sea surface light and shadow] as the main subject, but they must undergo significant modification. Do not replicate realistically; transform them into visuals with more visual impact and artistic sense.
Can include:
Hazy mist, gradient seawater, floating particles, soft focus, halo, slight grain, blurred edges, dreamcore atmosphere, low-contrast background, ethereal negative space, floating composition, poetic visual narrative.

[Composition Requirements]
The image must have a clear visual focus. You can use:
Large areas of negative space, offset composition, floating layout, poster-like cropping, distinct top and bottom layers, rhythmic density of the subject, local magnification, contrast between near and far, single-side title typography, corner information typography.
Do not make it like an ordinary wallpaper; make it like a real design poster.

[Color and Atmosphere]
The overall color scheme revolves around [Fill in Main Color, e.g., coral orange, mist pink, sea salt blue, deep sea black, neon purple, grey-green, amber gold].
The tones should be unified, soft, and have a sense of air. It can have a bit of film grain, matte texture, and a slight printing feel.
Atmosphere keywords: quiet, ethereal, sentimental, healing, blurred, dreamy, surreal, poetic.

[Typography]
Add complete Chinese typography to the image.
The main title says: [Fill in Chinese Main Title]
The subtitle says: [Fill in a short copy sentence]
Auxiliary small text says:
[Fill in small text 1]
[Fill in small text 2]
[Fill in small text 3]

Typography should be restrained and high-end. No advertising feel, no clutter, no long manual-style text.
Can be paired with a small amount of English small text as auxiliary information, but primarily in Chinese.
No real brand names, no watermarks, no garbled text, no expired dates.
If a date is needed, do not automatically write the year; leave it blank or weaken it.

[Visual Texture]
High-end artistic poster texture, soft focus photography feel, dreamy ocean atmosphere, with printing grain and modern design sense.
The subject should be clear but edges can be softened. Avoid clutter, deformity, low quality, and cheap special effects.

Output as: A complete finished poster, clear Chinese, typography finished.

prompts.text:
生成一张竖版 3:4 的艺术海报，必须是一张已经完成排版的成品海报。

主题为【填写主题】，整体不是普通海洋摄影，也不是普通鱼类插画，而是一张带有强烈情绪气质、梦境感、氛围感和设计感的概念海报。

【核心画面】
画面以【鱼群 / 水母 / 热带鱼 / 发光鱼 / 半透明海洋生物 / 漂浮物 / 海面光影】为主体，但必须进行大幅度魔改，不要写实复刻，要转化成更有视觉冲击力和艺术感的画面。
可以加入：
朦胧雾气、渐变色海水、漂浮微粒、柔焦、光晕、轻微颗粒、模糊边缘、梦核氛围、低对比背景、空灵留白、漂浮感构图、诗性画面叙事。

【构图要求】
画面要有明确的视觉重心，可以采用：
大面积留白、偏置构图、漂浮式布局、海报感裁切、上下层次分明、主体疏密有节奏、局部放大、远近对比、单侧标题排版、角落信息排版。
不要做成普通壁纸，要像真正的设计海报。

【色彩与氛围】
整体配色围绕【填写主色，例如珊瑚橙、雾粉、海盐蓝、深海黑、霓虹紫、灰绿色、琥珀金】展开。
色调统一、柔和、有空气感，可以带一点胶片颗粒、雾面质感和轻微印刷感。
氛围关键词：安静、空灵、伤感、治愈、迷离、梦幻、超现实、诗意。

【文字排版】
画面中加入完整中文排版。
主标题写：【填写中文主标题】
副标题写：【填写一句短文案】
辅助小字写：
【填写小字1】
【填写小字2】
【填写小字3】

文字排版要克制高级，不要广告感，不要杂乱，不要大段说明书式文本。
可搭配少量英文小字作为辅助信息，但中文为主。
不要出现真实品牌名，不要出现水印，不要出现错误乱码，不要出现过期日期。
如果需要日期，不要自动写年份，留空或弱化处理。

【画面质感】
高级艺术海报质感，柔焦摄影感，梦幻海洋氛围，带印刷颗粒和现代设计感。
主体清晰但边缘可柔化，避免脏乱、畸形、低质感、廉价特效感。

输出为：完整成品海报，中文清晰，排版完成。
