items.title: 纸上成真戏韵妆造设定稿实景视觉

prompts.text:
Generate a "Paper Comes True · Opera Makeup and Costume Design" style image, 4:5 vertical version.

The theme is [Beijing Opera Huadan / Daomadan / Kunqu Water Sleeves / Drunken Concubine]. The scene is an off-white opera makeup design manuscript paper clipped to a wooden drawing board, placed on a warm wood-colored workbench. A realistic adult Chinese female naturally rises from the paper, forming a "Paper Comes True" visual effect.

The character is in a mostly half-body composition, with a clear face and large proportions, looking directly at the camera, with natural highlights and a sense of interaction. Overall realistic, the skin has natural texture, do not use anime faces, silicone feel, or excessive skin smoothing. The makeup carries the charm of opera but leans towards a high-fashion portrait style, not heavy stage faces or mask-like styles.

The clothing is an Oriental opera haute couture design, emphasizing "heavy and light": headwear, pearls and emeralds, embroidery, back flags, or palace dress structures are exquisite and heavy; water sleeves, silk ribbons, and gauze layers are light and ethereal. The overall look is not overly wrapped, preserving the character's tension.

The upper body of the character is significantly higher than the paper surface, with real volume and shadows. One hand lightly supports the paper surface, and the other hand naturally touches elements like headwear or water sleeves, with a natural posture.

Visual transition: The main body of the character is completely realistic; water sleeves, silk ribbons, and back flags can have a small amount of light-colored hand-painted texture; only the ends of the water sleeves, the tails of the silk ribbons, a corner of the skirt, and the bottom right corner retain unfinished pencil line drawings.

In the bottom right corner, there is a real hand holding a pencil continuing to draw. The text and annotations on the paper are all in a pencil-handwritten draft style (such as headwear structure, water sleeve flow, embroidery instructions, etc.), not printed fonts.

The desktop can include elements such as color cards, pearls and emeralds, flower hairpins, fabric samples, pencils, needle pens, and tea cups. The overall style is realistic, clear, and high-end, with Oriental opera aesthetics and a "Paper Comes True" visual effect.

Avoid problems such as cartoonishness, plastic feel, cheap opera costumes, characters being too small or improper composition, hand deformities, and low image resolution.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
生成一张《纸上成真 · 戏韵妆造稿》风格图片，4:5 竖版。

主题为【京剧花旦 / 刀马旦 / 昆曲水袖 / 贵妃醉酒】。画面是一张米白色戏曲妆造设定稿纸夹在木质画板上，置于温暖木色工作台。一位写实成年中国女性从纸上自然立起，形成“纸上成真”的视觉效果。

人物为半身偏多构图，脸部清晰、比例较大，直视镜头，有自然高光与互动感。整体写实，皮肤自然有纹理，不要动漫脸、硅胶感或过度磨皮。妆面带戏曲神韵，但偏高定写真风，不要厚重舞台脸或脸谱化。

服饰为东方戏曲高定设计，强调“重与轻”：头饰、珠翠、刺绣、靠旗或宫装结构偏精致厚重；水袖、披帛、纱层偏轻盈飘逸。整体不过度包裹，保留人物张力。

人物上半身明显高于纸面，有真实体积与投影。一只手轻撑纸面，另一只手自然触碰头饰或水袖等元素，姿态自然。

画面过渡：人物主体为完整写实；水袖、披帛、靠旗等可带少量淡彩手绘质感；仅在水袖末端、披帛尾端、裙边一角及右下角保留未完成铅笔线稿。

右下角有一只真实手持铅笔继续绘制。纸面文字与标注均为铅笔手写草稿风（如头饰结构、水袖走势、刺绣说明等），不要印刷体。

桌面可加入色卡、珠翠、花簪、布样、铅笔、针管笔、茶杯等元素。整体风格写实、清晰、高级，具有东方戏曲审美与“纸上成真”的视觉效果。

避免卡通感、塑料感、廉价戏服、人物过小或构图不当、手部畸形、画面低清晰度等问题。

prompts.text:
Generate a high-key graphic poster based on any subject: The upper half of the image establishes a dense and orderly array of line-drawn group portraits or similar symbols. All elements are repeatedly arranged with thin black lines, simplified facial features, or geometric outlines, forming a rhythm similar to a wall of people; in this homogeneous repetition, set a clear thematic focus. The focus does not win by complex realism but is recognized at a glance through small-area theme-derived accent colors, slight contrast, local blank space, or morphological differences, creating a visual moment of "suddenly being seen among many similar individuals." Below, a large quiet information area is reserved. The main title uses heavy, compact, low-center-of-gravity black block characters. The typeface has a poster printing feel and strong weight. Auxiliary text forms a rational explanatory layer with small font sizes, neat line spacing, and clear alignment. Image density and text white space form an upper-lower contrast. Colors are extracted from the material, emotion, and semantics of the subject itself, without copying fixed color numbers: a large area of background serves as a bright and clean structural base color, occupying the main visual area; black or dark lines bear the order, text, and information skeleton; a small amount of high-saturation theme accent color falls only on key focal points or necessary details, with a restrained area but striking position. The overall style remains transparent, light, and clean with a high-key temperament, clear edges, uniform lines, and simple color levels, avoiding stacked shadows, dirty textures, and realistic impurities, so that the subject is quickly remembered through repetitive arrays, single-point differences, and steady text weight.

prompts.text:
Design an elegant minimalist destination illustration in a contemporary flat-vector editorial style with a calm, sophisticated atmosphere. Capture a sweeping coastal panorama of Santorini, showcasing sunlit whitewashed villages perched on rugged cliffs, iconic azure domed chapels, winding stone pathways, cascading terraces, blooming bougainvillea, crystal-clear Mediterranean waters, graceful sailing boats, and striking volcanic coastlines stretching into the distance. Small groups of visitors wander peaceful alleyways, relax at open-air cafés, paint scenic views, capture photographs, and quietly enjoy the seaside landscape.

Use a harmonious palette of warm ivory, soft azure, pale sand, muted sage, dusty terracotta, and gentle seafoam tones. Build the scene with simplified geometric forms, fine illustrated details, soft tonal transitions, layered atmospheric perspective, and generous negative space to create a refined, airy composition. Arrange the artwork in a vertical poster layout with balanced foreground, middle distance, and horizon, emphasizing tranquility, openness, and timeless Mediterranean charm. Ensure the artwork contains no text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, signage, or watermarks anywhere in the image.

The male has black natural curly short hair, slightly messy hair strands, a natural profile contour, real skin, wearing a loose white short-sleeved T-shirt, with a light-colored canvas bag or strap on his shoulder, the clothes are slightly yellowish and whitish from the sunlight. The male occupies a large space on the left side of the frame, with his shoulder and back close to the lens, creating a sense of foreground blocking.

At the rear right is an adult East Asian female in her 20s, sitting behind the male, her body close to his shoulder and back, her head slightly close to the front male's back. She is located in the center-right of the frame, her face is clearly visible, looking directly at the phone lens, with a natural and quiet expression, a very slight smile at the corners of her mouth, and soft eyes. The overall image is like a real selfie taken casually by friends or a couple during a trip, not a staged shot, not a photo shoot. Realistic, natural, life-like, intimate but restrained, summer outdoors, shadow under the umbrella, back seat of a moving vehicle, close-up selfie, low contrast overexposure, soft grey fog, real iPhone snapshot texture.

prompts.text:
Create a 3:4 vertical watercolor urban sketch travel poster on textured handmade watercolor paper.

City input:
[CITY NAME]

Create a romantic everyday scene reflecting the real architecture, landmarks, street life, climate, and cultural mood of [CITY NAME]. Use recognizable city-specific elements such as local buildings, cafes, balconies, canals, bridges, trams, towers, rooftops, tiles, waterfronts, street furniture, plants, or signs. Avoid generic European scenery or incorrect landmarks.

Main scene:
Show two lovers as the main subjects, placed slightly below center. They may be walking, sitting at an outdoor cafe, sharing iced coffee, standing near the water, looking at a view, or gently holding hands. Their pose should feel natural, affectionate, quiet, and unposed. Do not show a single person.

Characters:
Dress the couple in stylish casual summer clothing suited to [CITY NAME]: linen shirts, light cardigans, relaxed trousers, summer dresses, sneakers, sandals, sunglasses, crossbody bags, tote bags, cameras, pastries, or iced drinks. Use mostly white, pale blue, aqua, and soft gray-blue clothing with one or two small lemon-yellow accents. Add gentle wind movement to hair and loose fabric.

Composition:
Use a clean vertical poster layout with large negative space and an airy editorial feel. Keep the couple small to medium in scale, framed by city-specific architecture or scenery. Place buildings and landmarks in the background or along the sides, softly blended into the paper texture. Keep the upper half bright and open, with the upper right reserved for typography.

Typography:
In the upper right corner, add the city name in elegant italic English lettering:
"[CITY NAME]"

Directly below, add one short poetic English sentence matching the city's fresh summer mood. Use delicate soft cobalt, gray-blue, or muted navy lettering. Keep it minimal, readable, and naturally integrated into the paper.

Color direction:
Use a refreshing blue-and-yellow summer palette:

75% cool blues and blue-grays: sky blue, cyan, pale aqua, powder blue, faded turquoise, soft blue-gray, selective cobalt.

15% clean white and warm off-white paper highlights.

10% pale lemon yellow, soft butter yellow, sunlit cream, or light golden accents.

Blue should dominate while yellow adds warmth and visual rhythm. Use yellow only as accents in awnings, window light, flowers, umbrellas, pastries, signs, clothing details, drink labels, or sunlit building edges. Avoid an all-blue flat background.

Watercolor technique:
Use translucent washes, soft blue bleeding, subtle pigment granulation, wet-on-dry textures, gentle brush blooms, pale shadows, visible handmade paper texture, minimal splashes, and delicate reflections where appropriate. Yellow washes should feel like light touching paper.

Drawing detail:
Use delicate thin ink line art with slightly imperfect hand-drawn lines. Add refined urban sketch details: windows, shutters, balconies, streetlamps, cafe chairs, paving stones, railings, plants, clothing folds, hair strands, hands, shoes, bags, cups, signs, and soft ground marks. Keep faces softly suggested, not realistic.

Mood and quality:
Minimalist watercolor urban sketch, romantic summer travel poster, quiet love story, city-specific atmosphere, breezy blue palette with lemon-yellow highlights, elegant fashion illustration, cozy slice-of-life, Japanese-inspired softness, premium editorial look, calm pastel mood, soft natural lighting, clean background, poster-ready, 8K.

Negative prompt:
single person, generic city, incorrect landmarks, all-blue background, monochrome blue, lifeless colors, yellow-dominant, orange-heavy, brown-dominant, dark vintage, muddy beige, neon colors, oversaturated colors, photorealistic, 3D render, heavy outlines, harsh shadows, crowded street, cluttered background, realistic faces, stiff pose, awkward anatomy, glossy texture, bold typography.

prompts.text:
在具有纹理的手工水彩纸上创作一张 3:4 垂直比例的水彩都市素描旅行海报。

城市输入：
[城市名称]

创造一个反映 [城市名称] 真实建筑、地标、街道生活、气候和文化氛围的浪漫日常场景。使用可辨认的特定城市元素，如当地建筑、咖啡馆、阳台、运河、桥梁、电车、塔楼、屋顶、瓷砖、滨水区、街道设施、植物或标志。避免通用的欧洲风景或错误的地标。

主场景：
展示两个恋人为主要主体，位置略低于中心。他们可能在散步、坐在室外咖啡馆、分享冰咖啡、站在水边、观赏风景或轻轻牵手。他们的姿势应该感觉自然、深情、安静且非摆拍。不要只展示一个人。

角色：
给这对情侣穿上适合 [城市名称] 的时尚休闲夏装：亚麻衬衫、轻便开衫、休闲裤、夏装连衣裙、运动鞋、凉鞋、太阳镜、斜挎包、手提包、相机、糕点或冰镇饮料。服装颜色以白色、浅蓝色、水蓝色和柔和的灰蓝色为主，点缀一两个柠檬黄。在头发和宽松的织物上添加柔和的风感。

构图：
采用简洁的垂直海报布局，留有大量负空间和通透的社论感。将情侣的比例保持在小到中等，由特定城市的建筑或风景环绕。将建筑和地标放置在背景或侧边，柔和地融入纸张纹理。上半部分保持明亮开阔，右上方留给排版。

排版：
在右上角，用优雅的斜体英文添加城市名称：
"[CITY NAME]"

紧随其下，添加一句简短的、符合城市清新夏日氛围的诗意英文句子。使用精致柔和的钴蓝、灰蓝或静谧的海军蓝字体。保持极简、清晰，并自然地融入纸张。

色彩方向：
使用清新的蓝黄夏日色调：

75% 的冷蓝色和蓝灰色：天蓝色、青色、淡水色、粉蓝色、褪色的绿松石色、柔和的蓝灰色、局部的钴蓝色。

15% 的洁净白色和暖白色纸张高光。

10% 的淡柠檬黄、柔和的奶油黄、阳光下的乳白色或轻盈的金色点缀。

蓝色应占主导地位，而黄色则增加温暖感和视觉节奏。仅在遮阳篷、窗光、花卉、雨伞、糕点、招牌、服装细节、饮料标签或阳光照射的建筑边缘使用黄色。避免全蓝色的平面背景。

水彩技法：
使用半透明的晕染、柔和的蓝色渗色、细微的颜料颗粒、湿画法纹理、柔和的笔触渲染、浅色阴影、清晰可见的手工纸纹理、少许溅痕以及适当的微妙反射。黄色晕染应感觉像光线触碰纸张。

绘画细节：
使用精致的细墨线线条，带有略微不完美的手绘线条感。添加精致的都市素描细节：窗户、百叶窗、阳台、路灯、咖啡椅、铺路石、栏杆、植物、衣褶、发丝、手部、鞋子、包袋、杯子、标志和柔和的地面痕迹。面部保持柔和的示意感，不追求写实。

氛围与质量：
极简水彩都市素描，浪漫夏日旅行海报，安静的爱情故事，特定城市的氛围，带有柠檬黄亮点的清爽蓝色调，优雅的时尚插画，温馨的生活片段，日系风格的柔和感，高级社论外观，平静的粉彩氛围，柔和的自然光，洁净的背景，海报就绪，8K。

负向提示词：
单人，通用的城市，错误的地标，全蓝色背景，单色蓝色，死气沉沉的颜色，黄色主导，橙色沉重，棕色主导，深色复古，浑浊的米色，霓虹色，过度饱和的颜色，照片写实，3D 渲染，粗重的轮廓，生硬的阴影，拥挤的街道，凌乱的背景，写实的面部，僵硬的姿势，别扭的解剖结构，光滑的质感，粗大的字体。

画面主体是一位明确成年的年轻东方女性，视觉年龄约 20–28 岁，闺阁贵女气质，柔美、含羞、娇养、清贵耐看，带一点不自知的妩媚与细腻情绪。五官保持精致东方淡颜，小巧柔和鹅蛋脸，清亮杏眼，眼神湿润含情，鼻梁秀气，鼻尖微红，唇形柔软饱满，整体不幼态，不欧美化，不网红脸。
妆容为花影微醺水光妆，第一视觉重点是脸部妆容与水润肤质。底妆瓷白通透，带细腻奶油水光，面中有柔和高光但不油腻。眼妆为桃粉、杏粉与浅玫瑰棕渐层，眼下与面中腮红比普通妆更明显，眼下微红，鼻尖微红，形成微醺但高级的娇嫩气色。高光集中在鼻梁、鼻尖、眼下三角区、唇峰与面中，细腻可见。唇釉为浅樱桃或蜜桃粉水光质感，唇面清透饱满，有玻璃唇釉反光，嘴唇微微张开，不是烈焰红唇，不是厚涂红唇。
发型为黑色长发半披半挽，头发不要盘太高，发髻位置自然偏中低，保留长发垂落与轻微碎发，发丝柔顺，有自然风感。头饰为珍珠流苏、小步摇、白玉发簪、浅金细发钗、玉石耳坠，点缀少量浅青玉石与珍珠，精致但不压脸，不使用大型宫廷头冠。
服装为清贵精致的古风贵女襦裙，珍珠白、杏白、浅青、浅金组合，轻纱外袍，刺绣内层，柔软披帛，浅青腰封，浅金绣纹与珍珠腰饰点缀。服装要有层次与贵女质感，面料轻薄通透但不廉价，突出自然身体曲线，胸部饱满自然，腰线清晰，肩颈线柔美，整体含蓄高级，不低俗。
场景为午后庭院回廊，花影斑驳，纱帘微动，自然绿植与浅色花枝虚化在背景中，木质回廊与庭院栏杆形成古风生活感。光线为午后柔和自然光，轻微侧逆光与花影落在人物肩颈和服装上，面部保持干净通透，不被绿色环境色污染肤色。背景浅景深虚化，花影和自然绿只作为氛围衬托，不喧宾夺主。整体画面高级、柔美、通透、精修感强，有古风贵女日常水光写真质感。

items.title: 万物拟人化实物成装角色设计

prompts.text:
Generate a 'Humanization of Everything · Physical Object to Outfit' style image, 4:5 vertical composition. 

Place a physical reference object with a realistic photographic feel on the left side: [{{Object Name}}]. The object should look like a photographic picture or a product sample, with materials, structure, color, metallic reflections, transparent parts, textures, and functional details clearly visible. The physical object on the left can be placed in a circular reference frame, a design drawing frame, or a white background display area, and includes a small amount of handwritten annotations, such as: Reference, material, shape, texture, key detail.

On the right side of the screen is an adult 3D anime-style female character humanized from the object, with slender and natural proportions, approximately 7–7.5 heads tall, in an elegant and design-oriented pose, like a high-quality 3D character setting sheet. The character is not simply wearing ordinary clothes; instead, the shape, structure, material, and function of the object on the left are translated into clothing, hair accessories, weapons, accessories, and silhouette language.

Humanized design requirements:
1. The character's outfit must clearly echo the core characteristics of the physical object on the left.
2. Transform the primary shapes of the object into the main silhouette of the clothing, such as hat brims, shoulder armor, capes, skirt hems, back accessories, umbrella-like structures, ring structures, streamlined shells, etc.
3. Transform the material of the physical object into the clothing material, such as metallic silver, ceramic white, transparent glass, crystal, rubber, plastic, wood grain, fabric, fluid, glossy coatings, etc.
4. Transform the function of the object into imaginative elements, such as water flow, light beams, wind, flames, mechanical structures, plant growth, star orbits, energy lines, charms, wings, streamers, etc.
5. The character's hair accessories, earrings, brooches, waist seals, canes, footwear, and skirt details should all exhibit design logic derived from the physical object.
6. The color system should be unified, with the main color palette coming from the object on the left; avoid mottled or messy colors.

Visual style:
High-end 3D anime character design, exquisite modeling feel, delicate materials, soft studio lighting, clean white or light gray background, with a clear design association between the character and the physical object. The overall look is like an 'Object Humanization Character Design Draft,' with the reality reference on the left and the fantasy-generated character on the right.

Composition requirements:
The physical object on the left occupies 25%–35% of the frame, and the character on the right occupies 60%–70%. The left side is more realistic, while the right side is a 3D anime character. Faint design connecting lines, structural sketches, material annotations, and color sampling points can be added between the two, allowing the audience to immediately see that the character's outfit originates from the physical object on the left.

Character requirements:
Adult character, delicate features but not excessively juvenile, eyes have a sense of interaction, looking toward the camera, toward the object on the left, or as if showcasing their own costume design. Skin has an exquisite 3D anime texture, avoiding a plastic feel or low resolution. Body proportions are natural, with correct hand, leg, and foot structures; clothing coverage is complete, avoiding excessive exposure.

Clothing requirements:
High-end fantasy couture, blending Oriental mythology, futurism, mechanical aesthetics, or elven vibes. Clothing layers are rich but not chaotic, with clear primary silhouettes, secondary decorations, and detailed textures. Emphasis on: headpieces, shoulder structures, chest decorations, waist structures, skirt hems, silk wraps, streamers, footwear, and iconic elements corresponding to the physical object.

A small amount of design annotations can be included in the image:
LOOK 01, object reference, silhouette, material sample, ornament detail, function motif, color palette, structural translation, material sampling, silhouette source, decorative details.

High quality, high definition, exquisite, imaginative, strong design sense, physical humanization, 3D anime character design, fantasy couture, object-inspired costume design, clean composition, soft studio lighting.

Avoid: ordinary cosplay, simply copying and pasting the object onto the body, clothing unrelated to the object, low-quality modeling, incorrect proportions, deformed fingers, deformed legs, collapsed faces, excessive juvenility, excessive exposure, garbled text, messy colors, dirty backgrounds, unclear objects, overly flat characters, 2D draft feel, low resolution.

prompts.text:
生成一张《万物拟人化 · 实物成装》风格图片，4:5 竖版构图。

画面左侧放置一个真实拍摄感的实物参考物：【{{实物名称}}】。实物要像摄影照片或产品样品，材质、结构、颜色、金属反光、透明件、纹理和功能细节清晰可见。左侧实物可放在圆形参考框、设计图框或白底展示区中，并带有少量手写标注，例如：Reference、material、shape、texture、key detail。

画面右侧是一位由该实物拟人化而成的成年 3D 动漫风格女性角色，比例修长自然，约 7–7.5 头身，姿态优雅、有设计感，像高质量 3D 角色设定图。角色不是简单穿普通衣服，而是把左侧实物的造型、结构、材质和功能转化成服饰、发饰、武器、配件和轮廓语言。

拟人化设计要求：
1. 角色服饰必须明显呼应左侧实物的核心特征。
2. 将实物的主要形状转化为服装大轮廓，例如帽檐、肩甲、披风、裙摆、背饰、伞状结构、环形结构、流线型外壳等。
3. 将实物的材质转化为服装材质，例如金属银、陶瓷白、透明玻璃、水晶、橡胶、塑料、木纹、布料、流体、光泽涂层等。
4. 将实物的功能转化为想象力元素，例如水流、光束、风、火焰、机械结构、植物生长、星轨、能量线、符咒、羽翼、飘带等。
5. 角色的发饰、耳饰、胸针、腰封、手杖、鞋履和裙摆细节都要能看出来自实物的设计逻辑。
6. 颜色系统统一，主色调来自左侧实物，不要颜色斑驳杂乱。

画面风格：
高级 3D 动漫角色设计，精致建模感，细腻材质，柔和棚拍光，干净白色或浅灰背景，角色与实物之间有清晰的设计关联。整体像“实物拟人化角色设定稿”，左侧是现实物品参考，右侧是由它幻想生成的角色。

构图要求：
左侧实物占画面 25%–35%，右侧角色占画面 60%–70%。左侧偏实拍，右侧偏 3D 动漫角色。两者之间可加入淡淡的设计连线、结构草图、材质标注、颜色取样点，让观众一眼看出角色服饰来源于左侧实物。

角色要求：
成年角色，五官精致但不过度幼态，眼神有互动感，可以看向镜头、看向左侧实物，或像正在展示自己的服装设计。皮肤为精致 3D 动漫质感，不要塑料感，不要低清晰度。身体比例自然，手部、腿部、脚部结构正确，服装覆盖完整，避免过度暴露。

服装要求：
高级幻想高定服饰，兼具东方神话、未来感、机械美学或精灵感。服饰层次丰富但不混乱，有清晰主轮廓、次级装饰和细节纹理。重点表现：头饰、肩部结构、胸前装饰、腰部结构、裙摆、披帛、飘带、鞋履，以及与实物对应的标志性元素。

画面中可加入少量设计标注：
LOOK 01、object reference、silhouette、material sample、ornament detail、function motif、color palette、结构转译、材质取样、轮廓来源、装饰细节。

高质量，高清，精致，富有想象力，设计感强，实物拟人化，3D anime character design，fantasy couture，object-inspired costume design，clean composition，soft studio lighting。

避免：普通 cosplay、简单复制实物贴在身上、服装和实物无关、低质建模、比例错误、手指畸形、腿部畸形、脸部崩坏、过度幼态、过度暴露、文字乱码、颜色杂乱、背景脏乱、实物不清晰、角色过于平面、2D 草稿感、低清晰度。

prompts.text:
2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 fortune 500 brands: class Liquid_chrome_DNA:
    def __init__(self):
        self.subject = "[input]" 

        self.parents = {
            "composition_parent": "Exploded sculptural hero, mirror-metal forms floating in mid-morph",
            "material_parent":    "Liquid chromium, mercury droplets, mirror-polished steel, rippling reflections",
            "graphic_parent":     "Y2K tech-brand poster with reflective gradient overlays",
            "atmosphere_parent":  "Infinite white-to-iridescent studio with sharp reflections"
        }

        self.mutations = {
            "semantic_mutation":    "Within the chrome, a tiny world reflects the idea, brand, or meaning it represents",
            "information_mutation": "Surface-curvature callouts, reflectance legend, form-flow arrows, geometry markers",
            "medium_mutation":      "Holo-foil brand catalog with mirror-finish stock",
            "scale_mutation":       "Macro of the chrome with microscopic reflection-ripple detail"
        }

        self.color_dna = {
            "base": "# 0A0B10",   "primary":   "# C9D6FF",
            "secondary": "# FF36C8",   "accent": "# 36FFE0",
            "glow": "# B86CFF"
        }

        # composition · material · graphic · atmosphere · mutation
        self. style_mix = [0.24, 0.36, 0.20, 0.10, 0.10]

    def generate_subject(self):
        subject = """
        [LOGO] as a premium hero object, partially exploded into
        components. Reveal materials, internal mechanisms, construction
        traces, surface finish, signature features, and a miniature world
        inside showing its origin, use, and meaning. If details are
        missing, infer plausible premium materials, construction logic,
        and visually distinctive components.
        """
        return render(
            subject,
            format="vertical chrome brand poster",
            title="LIQUID_CHROME_DNA",
            subtitle="REFLECTS EVERYTHING",
            palette=self.color_dna,
            constraints="premium, precise, bold saturated color, "
                        "minimal clutter, sharp focus, no watermark"
        )

prompts.text:
Buatlah potret hyper realistis seorang wanita cantik berkulit putih cerah porselain.
Buatlah tanpa merubah fitur wajahnya, 9:16. HD.

Outfit: Mengenakan pakaian dengan detail mewah, termasuk sarung tangan berbahan tulle transparan yang dihiasi taburan manik-manik atau rhinestone berkilau, serta aksesori kalung mutiara yang elegan di leher.

Rambut: Rambut tampak ditata dengan gaya yang teratur dan halus, namun sebagian besar tertutup oleh efek cahaya dan fokus pada wajah.

Riasan: Menggunakan riasan wajah yang glamor dan detail. Terdapat aksen eyeliner bergaya grafis yang tajam di sudut mata, serta kuku yang panjang dengan desain nail art yang mewah dan rumit.

Pose: Subjek berpose sangat ekspresif dengan tangan berada di depan wajah, menutupi sebagian wajah dengan jari-jarinya yang mengenakan cincin besar berbentuk kupu-kupu yang sangat mencolok dan artistik.

Ekspresi: Menampilkan ekspresi yang intens, misterius, dan dreamy, dengan tatapan mata yang tajam namun lembut menembus sela-sela jari.

Latar: Latar belakang tampak kabur dan terfokus pada efek cahaya artistik, memberikan kesan suasana yang sangat sinematik, ethereal, dan mewah.

Pencahayaan: Pencahayaan yang digunakan sangat dramatis dengan efek flare dan soft glow, menciptakan suasana yang magis serta menonjolkan tekstur manik-manik dan detail perhiasan kupu-kupu dengan kilau yang memukau.

Embed the title text as the second protagonist within the structure, using extremely large high-contrast main character groups and narrow auxiliary character strings to create scale conflict. The text can be rotated, interspersed, aligned to the edge, or obscured by the structure. The reading experience first perceives the huge weight of information, then the dense explanatory layers. The font temperament is slender, restrained, and solemn, with a layout having clear axes and wide-to-narrow rhythms. Colors are extracted from the material, cultural temperament, and emotions of the subject, maintaining a large area of bright and clean background color, a medium area of subject structural color, a small amount of high-brightness information color, and deeper transparent shadow textures, maintaining clear color steps, controlled saturation, and a warm, ritualistic emotional feel. Even if the subject requires darker colors, maintain optical cleanliness, a sense of ventilation, and transparent layers, avoiding muddiness, staleness, or a dusty feel. The overall result should be like a rigorously orchestrated cultural information system, with the image having strong layered memory points, a clear reading path, and a fine printing finish.

The material is light as if containing air, with a large amount of afternoon light passing through, giving it a translucent feel. The fabric is soft, with long thin pleats falling from the chest to the hem, the hem length reaching the upper thigh. 纵向构图，3:4。人物置于画面中央偏右位置，包含从头高举的手臂的中长全身像。从大腿上部到头顶指尖自然纳入。窗户置于左侧，床铺置于右侧，营造纵深感。镜头位于人物胸部至肩部高度附近，略微不高不低的自然视线，从侧面拍摄。侧面轮廓美观，同时脸部稍稍朝向镜头角度。窗户一侧明亮，背景床铺略微柔和虚化。焦点对准侧脸、肩膀、手臂、透光的布料褶皱，采用不过于浅的自然景深。

逼真的照片风格。带有午后宁静生活感的日系肖像。皮肤保留自然的毛孔感和柔和血色，不过度美肌修饰。头发描绘细碎散落发丝和受光时的细腻高光。服装的雪纺材质薄而轻盈，细致表现布料的重叠、缝合、下摆线条、透光 nuance。色调以象牙白、米色、木质棕色为主的温暖中性色系。干净平滑的色阶，无噪点的自然高精细照片。整体呈现宁静柔和、午后余韵的质感。

prompts.text:

The background remains high-brightness, clear, clean, with a sense of ventilation and soft paper grain, with texture like fine printing noise covering the entire frame, but without creating a dirty, aged, or grayish-yellow feel. Colors are extracted from the theme's own material, season, brand, or emotion, mapped as a bright base color, emotional main color, auxiliary warm/cold colors, a small amount of clear emphasis colors, and dark information text; maintain the relationship of large areas of light base, small amounts of high-saturation luminous colors, soft transitions, and clean color scales, so the overall presentation has a bright, light, dreamlike but orderly temperament. The composition avoids filling the elements, retaining obvious blank pauses, edge-cropped color mists, tiny symbols or markers as beats, making the thematic content like an abstract memory illuminated by soft light, rather than an ordinary decorative background.

items.title: 东方空间长卷中式建筑叙事海报

prompts.text:
Generate a horizontal 16:9 Eastern architectural scene poster, which must be a finished poster with completed Chinese layout. 

The overall style is: Eastern spatial long scroll, Chinese architectural conceptual design, architectural model feel, landscape mood, modern architectural section, scene narrative poster, high-end white space, vertical Chinese typography, museum exhibition board texture. 

The main subject of the picture is a Chinese architectural space centered on [Theme Direction]. The building is not an ordinary house, but a horizontally unfolding spatial long scroll, with continuous undulating curved roofs, the roof extending like mountain ridges, zither strings, paper rolls, herb slopes, book pages, crescent moons, boat awnings, or loom curves. Below or inside the building, a glass section structure is used, showing different rooms, human activities, furniture, and spatial functions. 

The picture adopts a horizontal composition with a large area of white space, and the background is off-white, rice paper color, light ink gray, misty white, or deep night black. In the distance, there can be faint mountain shadows, clouds and mist, water surfaces, courtyards, slopes, trees, steps, ponds, or deserts, but the overall look must be restrained and not crowded. 

The interior of the building needs to have miniature human activities, with characters wearing ancient or new Chinese-style clothing, performing theme-related actions, such as:
Consultation, decocting medicine, massage, playing the zither, tasting tea, reading, copying scriptures, making incense, dyeing cloth, weaving, soaking in hot springs, viewing the moon, restoring murals, conducting experiments, organizing artifacts.
The characters should be small and exquisite, like life scenes in an architectural model, and should not overshadow the main subject. 

The poster must include a vertical Chinese title:
「【Main Title】」

One or two sets of vertical sub-copy can be added:
「【Subtitle】」
「【Short Sentence】」

The Chinese layout should be like Eastern exhibition posters, ancient book title tags, architectural exhibition boards, or literati painting colophons. The text should be restrained, placed in the white space on the left or right side of the frame, and must not clutter the architectural subject. Small seals, small-sized footnotes, thin lines, and museum-style markers can be added, but no real brand logos. 

Image texture:
Paper texture, slight grain, soft mist, low saturation colors, architectural model-level detail, cinematic light and shadow, restrained and high-end, quiet narrative. 

Composition requirements:
The building unfolds horizontally, occupying the lower half or middle-lower part of the frame; the upper part retains a large amount of airy white space; water surface, platforms, or slopes serve as the foreground; distant mountains or mist serve as the background; the vertical Chinese text forms a balance with the building.

Do not:
No ordinary real estate renderings, no modern commercial sales offices, no messy Guochao style, no bright red and gold, no e-commerce posters, no watermarks, no real logos, no English dominance, do not draw people too large, no complex and crowded backgrounds.

prompts.text:
生成一张横版 16:9 的东方建筑场景海报，必须是一张已经完成中文排版的成品海报。

整体风格为：东方空间长卷、中式建筑概念设计、建筑模型感、山水意境、现代建筑剖面、场景叙事海报、高级留白、中文竖排排版、博物馆展板质感。

画面主体是一座以【主题方向】为核心的中式建筑空间。建筑不是普通房子，而是一条横向展开的空间长卷，拥有连续起伏的曲线屋顶，屋顶像山脊、琴弦、纸卷、药草坡、书页、月牙、船篷或织机曲线一样延展。建筑下方或内部采用玻璃剖面结构，可以看到不同房间、人物活动、家具陈设与空间功能。

画面采用横向构图，大面积留白，背景为米白、宣纸色、淡墨灰、雾白或夜色深黑。远处可以有淡淡山影、云雾、水面、庭院、坡地、树木、台阶、池塘或荒漠，但整体必须克制，不要拥挤。

建筑内部需要有微型人物活动，人物穿着古代或新中式服饰，正在进行与主题相关的行为，例如：
问诊、煎药、按摩、抚琴、品茶、读书、抄经、制香、染布、织造、泡汤、观月、修复壁画、做实验、整理器物。
人物要小而精致，像建筑模型中的生活场景，不要抢主体。

海报必须包含中文竖排标题：
「【主标题】」

可加入一到两组竖排副文案：
「【副标题】」
「【短句】」

中文排版要像东方展览海报、古籍题签、建筑展板或文人画题跋。文字要克制，放在画面左侧或右侧留白处，不能压乱建筑主体。可以加入小印章、小号题注、细线、馆藏式标识，但不要真实品牌 Logo。

画面质感：
纸张纹理、轻微颗粒、柔和雾气、低饱和色彩、建筑模型级细节、电影感光影、克制高级、安静叙事。

构图要求：
建筑横向展开，占画面下半部分或中下部；上半部分保留大量空气感留白；水面、台地或坡地作为前景；远山或雾气作为背景；中文竖排文字与建筑形成平衡。

不要：
不要普通房地产效果图，不要现代商业售楼处，不要杂乱国潮，不要大红大金，不要电商海报，不要水印，不要真实 Logo，不要英文主导，不要把人画得太大，不要复杂拥挤背景。

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium lifestyle beverage campaign titled:

TASTE THE SUN.

This is not a conventional canned drink advertisement.

It should feel like the visual embodiment of endless summer—carefree, vibrant, stylish, and effortlessly aspirational.

The composition captures a confident young woman standing knee-deep in the crystal-clear shallows of a secluded Mediterranean cove during peak golden afternoon. She is dressed in a modern resort look: a flowing linen shirt loosely draped over a minimalist swimsuit, layered gold jewelry catching the sunlight, oversized sunglasses, and windswept hair glowing against the sea breeze.

She isn't posing.

She's laughing naturally after taking a refreshing sip from an elegantly designed fruit-infused sparkling beverage can, held dramatically close to the camera through cinematic forced perspective so the product becomes the unmistakable hero of the image.

The instant the can is tilted, the beverage transforms into an explosion of liquid summer.

Instead of ordinary splashes, vibrant streams of sparkling fruit essence spiral around her—bursting citrus slices, suspended berries, translucent mango cubes, mint leaves, edible flowers, crushed ice crystals, shimmering droplets, and sunlit bubbles floating weightlessly through the air. Everything feels energetic yet refined, like a luxury fragrance campaign interpreted through fresh fruit.

The turquoise sea stretches endlessly into the horizon while sailboats drift in soft focus. Palm shadows dance across pale limestone cliffs, woven beach umbrellas, and polished wooden decking. The atmosphere radiates warmth, freedom, and effortless sophistication.

---

TYPOGRAPHY

Typography is expressive, playful, and fashion-forward—integrated into the composition rather than sitting on top of it.

The dominant headline spans the upper portion of the campaign in oversized hand-painted brush lettering:

SIP INTO SUMMER.

Supporting campaign copy:

Sunshine, bottled.

Highly saturated yet elegant color grading.

PHOTOGRAPHY & ART DIRECTION

Every droplet should sparkle with realism. Every fruit element should feel freshly sliced. The product should command immediate attention while the overall image communicates joy, warmth, and aspirational summer living.

The final campaign should feel like a flagship global launch seen across beach clubs in Ibiza, rooftop billboards in Miami, luxury resorts in Santorini, and premium retail displays worldwide—vibrant, sophisticated, and irresistibly refreshing.

items.title: 未来主义赛博数字艺术展海报

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese digital art exhibition poster.
Overall style: Futurism, cyber vision, digital identity, data personality, neon light streams, pixel particles, code matrix, speed motion blur, black background high contrast, Chinese exhibition poster design.

The main subject of the picture is a profile or half-body character silhouette. The character is not a realistic portrait, but is composed of countless tiny data points, digital codes, pixel particles, glowing grids, and information fragments. The character's outline is clear but the edges are dissipating, as if consciousness is being read, uploaded, reorganized, or split. Blue, purple, magenta, cyan, and warm gold data light points are visible inside the character's face and body.

Multiple neon light streams crossing horizontally from the character's body or face are added to the scene, like high-speed data streams, light-speed motion blurs, memory tracks, and signal beams. The colors of the light streams are mainly blue, pink, purple, cyan, and orange-gold, with a sense of speed and energy. Around the character are code waterfalls, digital matrices, particle diffusion, lattice dissipation, and weak glowing noise.

The background is deep black or near-pure black, leaving enough dark space to make the character's light streams and text layout more prominent. The overall image should have the feel of an art exhibition poster, rather than an ordinary sci-fi wallpaper.

The layout must be complete, including:
Main Title "[Main Title]"
Subtitle "[Subtitle]"
A paragraph of Chinese description text
Date "[Date]"
Exhibition Location "[Location]"
Hashtags / info bars / small caption text
Credits can be written as "Visuals: Yang Ge", "Planning: Yang Ge", "Generated by: Yang Ge"

The main title can use a large Chinese font with a slight glitch effect, scanlines, neon gradients, or light-speed motion blur. The body text and information bars should be clear, restrained, like a real exhibition poster. The overall Chinese text must be clear and accurate, not garbled. Small amounts of English can be added as support, but English should not dominate.

Digital identity, data skin, light-speed personality, memory motion blur, signal confession, electronic soul, cyber avatar, future consciousness, pixel body, sea of data, consciousness reconstruction, identity upload.

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium luxury fragrance campaign titled:

AFTER MIDNIGHT.

This is not a typical cologne advertisement.

It should feel like a cinematic character study—where presence speaks louder than words and elegance is measured through restraint.

The composition captures a sharply dressed man seated alone in an exclusive rooftop lounge overlooking a city illuminated by thousands of distant lights. Rather than looking toward the camera, his attention is drawn elsewhere—as though someone has just entered the room. The expression is subtle: curiosity, confidence, and complete composure.

The environment tells the story.

A crystal tumbler catches warm amber reflections. Soft candlelight dances across polished marble, dark walnut wood, brushed brass, and smoked glass. A tailored charcoal overcoat rests casually over the chair while a luxury mechanical watch, understated rings, and refined leather accessories reinforce quiet sophistication.

The fragrance bottle sits prominently in the foreground on a sculpted block of black volcanic stone, dramatically closer to the lens through cinematic forced perspective. Tiny droplets of condensation and flawless reflections make it the visual centerpiece without overwhelming the scene. Thin ribbons of aromatic smoke curl around the bottle, dissolving into the surrounding atmosphere like memories.

Instead of obvious luxury clichés, the image celebrates stillness.

Nothing feels staged.

Nothing competes for attention.

Every object appears intentionally placed, allowing negative space and atmosphere to communicate exclusivity.

---

TYPOGRAPHY

Typography should behave like the layout of an award-winning luxury fashion campaign.

The dominant headline:

LEAVE AN IMPRESSION.

Supporting editorial copy:

Elegance never announces itself.

PHOTOGRAPHY & ART DIRECTION

prompts.text:
创建一个名为“午夜之后”（AFTER MIDNIGHT）的超高端奢华香水活动。这并非典型的古龙水广告。它应该感觉像是一场电影般的角色研究——气场胜过言语，优雅通过克制来衡量。构图捕捉了一位穿着考究的男士独自坐在高级屋顶酒廊，俯瞰着被千万点远方灯火点亮的城市。他的注意力被引向别处，而不是看向镜头——仿佛有人刚刚进入房间。表情微妙：好奇、自信且完全沉着。环境讲述着故事。一个水晶杯捕捉着温暖的琥珀色倒影。柔和的烛光在抛光大理石、深色胡桃木、拉丝黄铜和烟熏玻璃上跳跃。一件剪裁精良的深灰色大衣随意地搭在椅子上，而奢华机械表、低调的戒指和精细的皮革配件则增强了静谧的精致感。香水瓶显眼地放置在前景的一块雕刻过的黑色火山岩上，通过电影般的强制透视效果极大地拉近了与镜头的距离。细小的冷凝水滴和完美的倒影使其成为视觉中心，且不喧宾夺主。一缕缕芳香的烟雾绕着瓶子卷曲，像记忆一样消散在周围的氛围中。图像赞美寂静，而非显而易见的奢华陈词滥调。没有任何刻意布置感。没有任何东西在争夺注意力。每个物品的摆放都显得别有用心，让留白和氛围传递出排他性。---

调色板
深黑曜石色、浓缩咖啡棕、温暖琥珀高光、香槟金、深胡桃木、烟熏炭色、柔和象牙白排版、丰富的电影感对比。---

prompts.text:
A premium-quality poster in a highly detailed Knitted Wool / Stop-Motion Fabric artistic style, where every element within the composition appears meticulously handcrafted from thick knitted wool yarn with rich woven textures and realistic fiber details. The main subject should not replicate the exact pose from the reference image. The posture should resemble the refined confidence commonly seen in international fashion editorials while maintaining a relaxed and approachable appearance.

The outfit should feature stylish contemporary casual fashion with thoughtfully combined colors, patterns, textures, and clothing layers to create a fashionable yet balanced look. Avoid plain, repetitive, or overly simplistic wardrobe choices. The styling should feel current, youthful, and visually appealing without becoming excessive.

Typography should be a major visual highlight of the poster. Every text element should use bold, creative, eye-catching typography with strong visual personality, premium editorial styling, and dynamic layout placement. Avoid generic fonts or standard-looking text treatments. The typography should integrate harmoniously with the knitted aesthetic while remaining clean, modern, and highly readable.

The overall poster should feel premium, artistic, and visually distinctive, avoiding any appearance of being generic, mediocre, repetitive, or template-based. prompts.text:
A portrait-oriented cinematic poster in the Graffiti Come to Life (Optical Illusion) style, where the cartoon character is not portrayed as a separate 3D figure standing beside the real person. Instead, the character exists as a highly detailed graffiti mural painted on a textured brick wall, while one or both of its hands appear to break through the wall as if coming to life, naturally wrapping around or interacting with the real subject standing in front of it. The illusion should feel seamless, convincing, and visually striking, blending realistic perspective, shadows, lighting, and depth to create the impression that the graffiti has become partially alive.

The overall composition should feature a modern cinematic atmosphere with dynamic lighting, rich color contrast, and carefully balanced depth. Enhance the poster with stylish graffiti-inspired decorative elements such as spray paint splashes, urban textures, paint drips, stencil patterns, geometric accents, subtle wall cracks, layered graphic shapes, and contemporary street-art details that strengthen the visual identity without making the design feel overcrowded.

The subject's pose must be completely different from the reference photo, appearing expressive, confident, and naturally dynamic rather than stiff or flat. The body language should resemble that of an international fashion model, conveying elegance, confidence, and effortless movement with a refined editorial aesthetic. The facial expression should feel lively, engaging, and full of personality, creating a stronger emotional connection with the viewer.

The outfit should reflect modern casual fashion with a stylish, contemporary look. Combine clothing pieces with varied colors, textures, materials, and subtle patterns to avoid a repetitive or monotonous appearance. The styling should feel fashionable, youthful, and visually balanced while remaining realistic and naturally wearable.

Every typography element within the poster should feature bold, premium, and eye-catching font styles that complement the graffiti concept. Use creative font treatments, layered text compositions, dynamic sizing, and modern graphic placement to ensure the typography becomes an integral part of the artwork rather than looking plain or generic.

The overall poster should deliver a premium, high-end visual experience with a fresh contemporary aesthetic. Avoid ordinary layouts, repetitive compositions, mediocre design choices, or generic visual treatments. Every element should contribute to a vibrant, visually rich, and modern street-art inspired masterpiece rendered in ultra-high-definition 8K quality with exceptional sharpness, realistic textures, and professional cinematic finishing.

prompts.text:
一张竖屏比例的电影感海报，采用“涂鸦成真（错觉）”风格，其中的卡通角色并非被刻画为一个站在真人身旁的独立3D形象。相反，该角色是以高度细节化的涂鸦壁画形式存在于有纹理的砖墙上，而它的一只或两只手看起来像是冲破墙壁化为现实，自然地环绕或与站在墙前的真实主体互动。这种错觉应当感觉无缝、具有说服力且视觉冲击力强，融合了写实的透视、阴影、光影和深度，营造出涂鸦已部分活过来的印象。

整体构图应具备现代电影氛围，拥有动态光影、丰富的色彩对比和平衡的景深。海报中加入时尚的涂鸦灵感装饰元素，如喷漆溅痕、城市纹理、油漆滴落、模板图案、几何点缀、细微的墙壁裂缝、分层的图形形状，以及增强视觉特性的当代街头艺术细节，同时不让设计显得过于拥挤。

主体的姿势必须与参考照片完全不同，表现出表现力、自信和自然的动态感，而非僵硬或平淡。肢体语言应类似于国际时尚模特，通过精致的社论美学传达优雅、自信和轻盈的动作。面部表情应感觉生动、迷人且充满个性，与观众建立更强的情感联系。

服装应反映现代休闲时尚，展现时尚、当代的风貌。结合不同颜色、纹理、材质和微妙图案的衣物单品，避免重复或单调。造型应感觉时尚、年轻且视觉平衡，同时保持写实和自然的实穿性。

海报中的每个字体元素都应采用大胆、高级且引人注目的字体风格，以补充涂鸦概念。使用创意字体处理、分层文字排版、动态大小调节和现代图形布局，确保文字成为艺术作品不可或缺的一部分，而非显得平庸或通用。

整体海报应提供高级、高端的视觉体验，具备新鲜的当代美学。避免普通的布局、重复的构图、平庸的设计选择或通用的视觉处理。每一个元素都应为一个充满活力、视觉丰富且具有现代街头艺术灵感的杰作做出贡献，以超高清8K画质呈现，具有卓越的锐度、逼真的纹理和专业的电影感后期处理。

items.title: 红牛释放高度全球高端广告大片

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium global advertising campaign for Red Bull titled:

UNLEASH THE ALTITUDE

This is not a traditional beverage advertisement.

It should feel like the official launch campaign for a new generation of ambition—where energy isn't consumed, it's embodied.

The composition centers on a fearless young athlete captured in an extreme low-angle perspective, standing confidently on the edge of a towering industrial rooftop overlooking a futuristic metropolis just before sunrise. They extend a chilled Red Bull can toward the camera so close that it dominates the foreground through dramatic forced perspective. Tiny droplets of condensation glisten across the aluminum surface, making the product the undeniable hero of the composition.

The instant the can is opened, reality reacts.

Instead of ordinary liquid splashes, two colossal translucent streams of liquid energy erupt from either side of the can, twisting into the shape of charging bulls made entirely from electric blue plasma, sparkling water particles, compressed air currents, and crystalline ice fragments. Their forms remain abstract and premium rather than cartoonish, creating an unforgettable visual metaphor for unleashed potential.

The athlete's jacket ripples violently in the shockwave. Hair, fabric, and loose debris are pulled into the energy flow, creating a sense of explosive momentum frozen in time.

Behind them, the skyline glows with thousands of city lights fading into dawn, while subtle contrails, distant aircraft, and illuminated skyscrapers reinforce the feeling of limitless possibility.

---

TYPOGRAPHY

Typography is treated as architectural design, integrated seamlessly into the environment.

The dominant headline occupies nearly one-third of the composition:

BORN TO FLY.

Supporting editorial typography appears throughout the poster:

ENERGY WITHOUT LIMITS

EVERY SUNRISE IS A STARTING LINE

FOCUS. SPEED. EXECUTION.

WHEN OTHERS STOP, YOU LIFT OFF.

Small premium interface graphics include:

• altitude indicator

• reaction-time metrics

• acceleration diagrams

• heartbeat monitor

• vertical climb graph

• wind speed

• mission coordinates

• product engineering sketches

• premium campaign numbering

• minimalist technical annotations

Everything should feel like a luxury aerospace brand rather than a standard energy drink advertisement.

---

COLOR PALETTE

Deep midnight navy

Electric cobalt blue

Brushed aluminum silver

Frozen white highlights

Warm sunrise amber

Subtle crimson Red Bull accents

High contrast with luminous reflections and crisp cinematic lighting.

---

PHOTOGRAPHY & ART DIRECTION

Luxury commercial photography

Blockbuster advertising aesthetics

IMAX-scale realism

Extreme forced perspective

Ultra-detailed product rendering

Hyper-realistic liquid simulations

Natural skin texture

Premium fashion styling

Dynamic volumetric lighting

Micro-condensation details

Museum-quality composition

Editorial-grade typography

Photorealistic, 8K resolution

Every surface should feel tangible, every droplet physically believable, every design element intentional.

The final image should resemble a Cannes Lions Grand Prix-winning campaign—a bold, cinematic, high-fashion advertisement that speaks directly to Gen Z's obsession with ambition, momentum, and individuality while making the Red Bull can the unmistakable centerpiece.

prompts.text:
为红牛创作一个名为“释放高度”（UNLEASH THE ALTITUDE）的全球顶级广告大片：

这不是一个传统的饮料广告。

它应该感觉像是新一代雄心的官方发布活动——在这里，能量不是被消耗的，而是被体现的。

构图中心是一位无畏的年轻运动员，采用极低角度透视捕捉，自信地站在俯瞰日出前未来主义大都市的高大工业屋顶边缘。他们向镜头伸出一罐冰镇红牛，距离之近以至于通过戏剧性的强制透视主导了前景。铝罐表面闪烁着细小的冷凝水滴，使产品成为构图中不可否认的主角。

罐子打开的瞬间，现实产生了反应。

从罐子两侧喷涌而出的不是普通的液体飞溅，而是两股巨大的半透明液体能量流，扭曲成冲锋公牛的形状，完全由电光蓝等离子体、闪烁的水粒子、压缩空气流和晶莹的冰块碎片组成。它们的形态保持抽象和高端，而非卡通化，为释放的潜力创造了一个令人难忘的视觉隐喻。

运动员的外套在冲击波中剧烈起伏。头发、织物和松散的碎片被卷入能量流中，营造出一种冻结在时间中的爆炸动量感。

在他们身后，天际线闪烁着数千个消散在黎明中的城市灯光，而微妙的飞机云、远处的飞行器和亮灯的摩天大楼增强了无限可能性的感觉。

---

排版

排版被视为建筑设计，无缝集成到环境中。

占据构图近三分之一的主标题：

天生飞行 (BORN TO FLY)。

辅助性的编辑排版出现在整张海报中：

能量无极限 (ENERGY WITHOUT LIMITS)

每一个日出都是起跑线 (EVERY SUNRISE IS A STARTING LINE)

专注。速度。执行。(FOCUS. SPEED. EXECUTION.)

当他人停止时，你起飞。(WHEN OTHERS STOP, YOU LIFT OFF.)

小型高端界面图形包括：

• 高度指示器

• 反应时间指标

• 加速度图表

• 心跳监测器

• 垂直攀升图

• 风速

• 任务坐标

• 产品工程草图

• 高端活动编号

• 极简技术注释

一切都应该感觉像是一个奢华的航空航天品牌，而不是标准的能量饮料广告。

---

色调

深午夜蓝

电光钴蓝

拉丝铝银

冰白色高光

温暖的日出琥珀色

微妙的红牛深红点缀

高对比度，带有发光的反射和清脆的电影照明。

---

摄影与艺术指导

奢侈商业摄影

大片广告美学

IMAX 规模的现实主义

极端强制透视

超精细产品渲染

超写实液体模拟

自然皮肤纹理

高端时尚造型

动态体积光

微冷凝细节

博物馆级构图

编辑级排版

照片级真实感，8K 分辨率

每一个表面都应该感觉触手可及，每一滴水珠都物理上可信，每一个设计元素都富有深意。

最终图像应该类似于戛纳金狮奖大奖作品——一个大胆、电影化、高时尚感的广告，直接回应 Z 世代对雄心、动量和个性的痴迷，同时让红牛罐头成为不容置疑的核心。

发型：黑色短波波卷发，空气刘海，发尾微翘，戴白色女仆头饰和小黑丝带，发型干净，不遮住双眼。

穿搭：黑色长袖连衣裙，白色大翻领，白色蓬松围裙，围裙有柔软褶皱和真实布料受光，黑色圆头厚底鞋。服装像成年 editorial 女仆咖啡店主题造型，不要廉价 cosplay。

饰品与道具：白色隔热手套、黑色细丝带、珍珠小耳饰。主道具只保留一个陶瓷咖啡杯或小面包托盘，靠近胸前或身体下方；辅助元素为可颂贴纸、咖啡杯贴纸、复古纸张、条码、漫画气泡。不要堆满画面。

版式：连续海报，不切格。加入咖啡棕手写标题、黑白漫画音效字、圆形气泡、复古纸张纹理、条码、短标签和少量星星贴纸。文字围绕人物，不压脸、手和主道具。可读短词只保留 “COFFEE SHOP”, “CUDDLE BUG”, “STYLE FILE”, “SWEET MENU”。其他小字作为排版纹理，尽量少出现长句假字。

镜头与构图：35mm editorial poster photography，近距离 direct flash + softbox。人物坐在画面中心偏右，双手戴隔热手套捧住咖啡杯或小面包托盘，头肩方向自然一致，正面看镜头。

光线与质感：柔化棚拍光从正前方和侧前方落在脸颊、鼻梁、白围裙、咖啡杯、面包和发丝上，形成奶油高光、轻微直闪阴影、soft bloom、maga

prompts.text:
Create a premium fashion editorial poster inspired by Japanese streetwear and anime culture, featuring a side-by-side comparison between an iconic anime character and their live-action actor counterpart.

Layout: Clean white background with bold oversized typography at the top displaying each name in large uppercase letters separated by a large "×". Add subtle Japanese calligraphy, futuristic UI elements, technical labels, barcode, symbols, decorative lines, and magazine-style editorial graphics. Use Japanese-inspired typography for aesthetic only (not necessarily readable).

Both characters stand full-body, facing forward in confident poses with hands in pockets, wearing coordinated high-fashion techwear inspired by the character's signature colors.

Outfit details:
• Oversized tactical bomber jacket with anime-inspired patches and embroidered kanji
• Multiple straps, buckles, utility pockets, hanging tags, webbing, belts
• Layered oversized hoodie or graphic shirt
• Cargo pants with utility accessories
• Premium sneakers or combat boots matching the color palette
• Character-inspired accessories (hat, swords, necklaces, gloves, ropes, etc.)
• Highly detailed fabrics with embroidery, printed graphics, and stitched logos

Color palette:
Primary character color dominates the outfit (red for Luffy, green for Zoro, blue for Sanji, orange for Nami, etc.), balanced with black, white, and metallic accents.

Lighting:
Soft studio lighting, ultra-clean shadows, luxury fashion campaign look, glossy editorial finish.

Style:
Japanese streetwear, cyber-techwear, luxury fashion editorial, anime x live-action crossover, Hypebeast magazine, premium clothing campaign, futuristic graphic design, highly detailed textiles, ultra-realistic fabric rendering, symmetrical composition, minimalist white background, crisp typography, 8K, masterpiece, ultra sharp, premium poster aesthetic.

布局：纯白背景，顶部有粗体超大排版，以大写字母显示每个名字，中间由一个大的“×”分隔。添加细微的日本书法、未来感UI元素、技术标签、条形码、符号、装饰线和杂志风格的编辑图形。使用日式排版仅用于美学目的（不一定可读）。

两个角色都全身站立，面朝前方，姿势自信，双手插兜，穿着受角色代表色启发的协调高级时尚机能服。

• 带有动漫启发补丁和刺绣汉字的超大战术轰炸机夹克
• 多条肩带、带扣、多功能口袋、挂牌、织带、皮带
• 分层超大连帽衫或图形衬衫
• 带有实用配件的工装裤
• 匹配配色方案的高级运动鞋或战斗靴
• 角色启发配件（帽子、剑、项链、手套、绳索等）
• 带有刺绣、印花图形和缝制标志的高细节面料

配色方案：
主角色色彩主导服装（路飞为红色，索隆为绿色，山治为蓝色，娜美为橙色等），与黑色、白色和金属色调相平衡。

灯光：

prompts.text:
You are a prompt writer for a stylized visual development engine.

Your task is to take the user’s text prompt, uploaded image, or both, then rewrite the idea as one finished image prompt in a specific painterly editorial animation style.

The subject can be anything: a person, animal, creature, object, machine, building, landscape, vehicle, costume, symbol, or abstract scene. Do not lock the style to the reference subject. Lock the style to the visual grammar.

If the user provides text only, preserve the subject, action, setting, mood, and stated constraints. Translate those ideas into the target style without adding unrelated story, props, genre elements, or decorative noise.

If the user provides an image only, study its silhouette, palette, lighting, texture, edge treatment, composition, surface behavior, and emotional tone. If the user asks for style, extract only the style and do not copy the subject. If the user asks for a prompt based on the image, describe both the subject and the style.

If the user provides both text and image, the text controls the subject and explicit instructions. The image controls only the requested visual reference, such as style, palette, shape language, pose, mood, lighting, surface, edge quality, or composition.

Write the final output as one polished image prompt. Do not explain your reasoning. Do not include headings unless the user asks for them. Do not include model names, parameter syntax, negative prompt sections, or technical camera metadata unless the user explicitly requests them.

Target style:

The image should feel like a hand painted animation development plate pulled from an old studio archive: graphic, sharp, expressive, weathered, and shaped by visible judgment.

Build the picture around one dominant silhouette. The subject must read instantly as a black and white shape before color or detail matters. Use exaggerated proportion as design logic: long narrow supports, swollen primary masses, sharp peaks, sagging curves, compressed joints, pinched transitions, awkward imbalance, and weight that feels slightly wrong but deliberately chosen. Every distortion must reveal character, function, mood, motion, or age.

Favor vertical shape rhythm. Let the subject rise, slump, bend, lean, stretch, perch, or collapse through the frame. Preserve strong negative space around it. Avoid crowded staging. The image should feel like a poster, a character plate, a printed theatre card, or a page torn from a production sketchbook.

Use a limited, weathered palette. Build the image from desaturated blue gray, green gray, smoke teal, bone white, ink black, dirty cream, and cold shadow. Keep color quiet and controlled. Let black carry the structure. Let white carry the strike of light. Let the blue gray ground hold the silence around the subject. Use a single accent only when it has a clear visual purpose.

Organize the image into three hard value families: pale light, muted atmospheric midtone, and heavy ink shadow. Do not model every form smoothly. Use bold shadow shapes under forms, inside openings, beneath overlaps, behind joints, and at weight bearing points. Place highlights sparingly. Make them small, sharp, and decisive.

Render with ink, dry brush, digital gouache, and worn print texture. The surface must show drag, pressure, scrape, grain, rubbed edges, broken coverage, scuffed corners, faded corners, and uneven pigment. Keep brush marks visible. Make the background feel stained, rolled, scratched, and aged rather than clean.

Use line as character. Outer contours should change weight constantly: thick at weight, thin at tension, broken at lost edges, sharp at points of attitude. Internal lines should be sparse and nervous, like quick construction marks left inside the final painting. Avoid clean comic outlines and uniform vector lines.

Let edges carry emotion. Use knife sharp protrusions, corners, folds, branches, spires, claws, tools, panels, or torn shapes when the subject needs bite. Use drooping curves, soft bags, bent limbs, warped panels, sagging fabric, hunched forms, or collapsed geometry when the subject needs fatigue, age, comedy, or defeat. Balance elegance with ugliness. Balance charm with unease.

Keep backgrounds restrained. Use a flat painted field with distressed borders, scratched ink residue, dry brush noise, paper grain, darkened upper corners, worn margins, and subtle tonal stains. The background should frame the subject like an old printed plate, not describe a full environment unless the user requests one.

Detail belongs only at the focal point. Eyes, hands, mouth, joints, hinges, openings, tools, symbols, labels, fractures, or key material breaks may receive sharper treatment. Everything else should simplify into shape, value, and texture. Leave some forms unfinished. Let absence hold space.

The final prompt should produce an image that reads clearly from far away, rewards close inspection with tactile surface marks, and feels shaped by deliberate visual decisions rather than automatic description.

Avoid photorealism, glossy fantasy polish, smooth airbrushing, plastic 3D rendering, realistic camera effects, clean vector flatness, soft beauty gradients, decorative clutter, symmetrical stiffness, random detail, random texture overlays, neon spectacle, sterile polish, stock prompt phrases, empty adjectives, and automatic filler language.

prompts.text:
你是一个风格化视觉开发引擎的提示词撰写者。

你的任务是获取用户的文本提示词、上传的图像或两者，然后将该想法重写为一段特定绘画社论动画风格的成品图像提示词。

主体可以是任何东西：人、动物、生物、物体、机器、建筑、景观、车辆、服装、符号或抽象场景。不要将风格锁定在参考主体上。将风格锁定在视觉语法上。

如果用户仅提供文本，请保留主体、动作、设置、氛围和既定的约束条件。将这些想法转化为目标风格，不要添加无关的故事、道具、类型元素或装饰性噪点。

如果用户仅提供图像，请研究其剪影、调色板、光照、纹理、边缘处理、构图、表面表现和情感基调。如果用户要求风格，则仅提取风格，不要复制主体。如果用户要求基于图像的提示词，则同时描述主体和风格。

如果用户同时提供文本和图像，则由文本控制主体和明确的指令。图像仅控制所要求的视觉参考，如风格、调色板、形状语言、姿势、氛围、光照、表面、边缘质量或构图。

将最终输出写成一段精炼的图像提示词。不要解释你的推理。除非用户要求，否则不要包含标题。除非用户明确要求，否则不要包含模型名称、参数语法、负面提示词部分或技术性相机元数据。

目标风格：

图像应该感觉像是从旧工作室档案中提取的手绘动画开发底片：图形化、锐利、富有表现力、经风蚀处理，并由明显的判断力塑造。

围绕一个主导剪影构建画面。在色彩或细节显现之前，主体必须立刻被解读为一个黑白形状。使用夸张的比例作为设计逻辑：细长的支撑、肿大的主体、尖锐的高峰、下垂的曲线、压缩的关节、狭窄的过渡、尴尬的不平衡，以及感觉稍微不对劲但经过刻意选择的重量感。每一次扭曲都必须揭示性格、功能、情绪、动作或年龄。

偏好垂直的形状韵律。让主体在画面中上升、跌落、弯曲、倾斜、拉伸、栖息或崩溃。在其周围保留强烈的负空间。避免拥挤的布局。图像应该感觉像海报、角色底片、印刷的剧院卡片或从制作速写本中撕下的一页。

使用有限的、经风蚀处理的调色板。用去饱和的蓝灰色、绿灰色、烟草蓝、骨白色、墨黑色、脏奶油色和冷阴影构建图像。保持色彩安静且受控。让黑色承载结构。让白色承载光线的冲击。让蓝灰色地面保持主体周围的沉寂。仅在具有明确视觉目的时使用单一强调色。

将图像组织成三个硬调值系列：苍白的光线、柔和的大气中间色调和沉重的墨色阴影。不要平滑地模拟每一个形状。在形状下方、开口内部、重叠下方、关节后方和承重点处使用大胆的阴影形状。克制地放置高光。使它们小巧、锐利且果断。

使用水墨、干刷、数字水粉和磨损的印刷纹理进行渲染。表面必须显示出拖动、压力、刮擦、颗粒、摩擦边缘、破碎的覆盖面、擦伤的角落、褪色的角落和不均匀的颜料。保持笔触可见。让背景感觉是被污染的、滚动的、刮擦的和老化的，而不是干净的。

将线条视为性格。外轮廓应不断变化权重：重处厚，张力处薄，丢失边缘处断开，态度点处锐利。内部线条应稀疏且神经质，就像最终画作中留下的快速构造标记。避免干净的漫画轮廓和统一的矢量线条。

让边缘承载情感。当主体需要锐气时，使用刀锋般锐利的突起、角落、折叠、分支、塔尖、爪子、工具、面板或撕裂的形状。当主体需要疲惫、衰老、喜剧或挫败时，使用下垂的曲线、柔软的袋状物、弯曲的肢体、翘曲的面板、下垂的织物、蜷缩的形状或崩溃的几何结构。在优雅与丑陋之间寻找平衡。在魅力与不安之间寻找平衡。

保持背景克制。使用带有磨损边界、刮擦墨迹残留、干刷噪点、纸张纹理、变暗的上角、磨损的边缘和微妙色调污渍的扁平绘画场。背景应像旧的印刷底片一样框住主体，除非用户要求，否则不要描述完整的环境。

细节仅属于焦点。眼睛、手、嘴巴、关节、铰链、开口、工具、符号、标签、裂缝或关键材料断裂处可以得到更锐利的处理。其他一切都应简化为形状、调值和纹理。让一些形状保持未完成状态。让缺失占据空间。

最终的提示词应产生一张图像，它在远处清晰可读，在近处观察时能以触感的表面痕迹给予回报，并让人感觉是由刻意的视觉决策而非自动描述塑造的。

避免摄影写实主义、光滑的幻想润饰、平滑的喷枪处理、塑料感的 3D 渲染、真实的相机效果、干净的矢量扁平感、柔和的美感渐变、装饰性的杂乱、对称的呆板、随机的细节、随机的纹理叠加、霓虹奇观、无菌的抛光、陈词滥调的提示词短语、空洞的形容词和自动填充语言。

prompts.text:
Generate a bright and clear curtain call greeting image based on specific thematic content, making the eye first read the short centered greeting text layer at the top, then following a large amount of airy white space down to the dual-subject action at the bottom. The upper half of the image remains quiet, empty, and soft-bright; the text uses a gentle and polite hierarchy: a larger core theme word or symbol as an emotional anchor, with a thin line of auxiliary text in the middle, and ending with a weightier short word below, with spaced-out kerning, rounded lines, and colors from clear accent colors in the theme's mood. Two core theme characters or dual-subject symbols are arranged side-by-side at the bottom, bodies or forms leaning deeply forward, forming a joint action of a sincere curtain call, with the visual center of gravity pressed at the bottom; edges of the action can be pulled into a sense of flow by light materials, hemlines, ribbons, or theme-derived structures, giving the solemn greeting a light release. The background is a high-brightness clean light field, retaining soft shadows and transparent layers, without complex scenes; extracting colors from the theme's own materials, seasons, cultural signals, and emotions, large areas of background color remain bright and clean, the main subject uses clear light and shadow to establish a sense of etiquette, text uses a small amount of warm or bright theme accent colors, and scattered elements use small, high-saturation dot colors, creating rhythm and celebration only in the blank spaces. Overall mood is warm, light, clean, and ceremonial; confetti or small theme-derived fragments float down naturally from all sides of the frame and above the subjects, with varying densities, making the blank space feel airy and the ending moment look frozen in time; avoid dirty backgrounds, grayish color steps, overcrowded elements, or weakening the dual-subject action into a common group photo.

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese concept poster, which must be a finished poster with completed Chinese typography.

The overall style is: hazy out-of-focus portrait, glowing text trails, visualization of emotions, soft mist atmosphere, low-clarity edges, grainy texture, surreal light-feeling poster, quiet but impactful Chinese design poster.

The main subject of the picture is a blurred out-of-focus silhouette of a person's upper body or full body. The person does not need clear facial features and is wrapped in mist, frosted glass, long exposure, or emotional halos. The person's color can be red-orange, blue-purple, magenta, fluorescent green, warm white, etc. The background is a soft gradient of low-saturation misty gray, gray-green, gray-blue, deep blue-black, etc.

The picture must contain one or more "glowing Chinese text trails / light waves / waveforms / heartbeat lines / signal lines". These glowing lines should pass through the person's chest, shoulders, neck, head, or in front of the body, as if emotions are converted into visible signals. The light must have a hand-drawn feel, ECG feel, noise waveform feel, and signal extension feel, with small light particles and weak sparks in some parts.

The poster text must be mainly in Chinese, including:
1. A clear Chinese main title
2. A Chinese subtitle
3. A short paragraph of descriptive copy
4. A small amount of corner explanatory text / version information / series markings

The overall layout should be modern, restrained, and have a sense of breathing. The text and the image should be integrated. Do not make it look like an ordinary commercial advertisement. The main title can be large text overlapping the image, while the subtitle and body text use smaller Chinese typography. A small amount of English or symbols can be added as auxiliary, but English must not dominate. The Chinese must be clear and accurate, without garbled characters.

Atmosphere keywords:
Hazy, inner, emotion, signal, waveform, connection, echo, noise, light feeling, silence, section, night, body temperature, distortion, inner activity, poetic expression.

Do not:
No e-commerce feel, no real brand logos, no watermarks, no realistic sharp portraits, no complex scenes, no cheap cyber effects, no garbled characters, no old dates.

Replaceable variables:
【Main Title】
【Subtitle】
【Main Image Color】
【Character Posture】
【Light Trail Form】
【Descriptive Copy Theme】

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 9:16 Oriental instrumental culture poster.

Theme: [Theme Name]
Type: [Concert / Exhibition / Gathering / Recital]
Instrument: [Guqin / Chimes / Flute / Erhu / Pipa / Guzheng / Sheng]
Main Title: [Main Title Text]
Main Color Tone: [Deep Black Gold / Bronze Black Gold / Deep Dark Green Gold / Deep Wine Red Black Gold]
Time: [Date in the second half of 2026]
Location: [Location]
Person / Institution: [Performer / Curator / Organizer]

Overall Style: High-end Oriental cultural performance poster, dark-toned light and shadow, realistic object photography, giant Chinese calligraphy title, delicate background texture, mature information layout.

The background cannot be a solid color; it must have low-contrast textures of Xuan paper, cloth, wood grain, bronze inscriptions, blurred calligraphy, wind marks, water marks, or musical score textures. Rich in detail but not cluttered.

The instrument serves as the main visual, with realistic material details: wood grain, metal, bamboo nodes, strings, holes, lacquer reflections, and carved patterns. Use dark-field side lighting and rim lighting to make the instrument appear as if emerging from the darkness.

The main title uses large-sized Chinese calligraphy characters, in gold / old gold / dark copper gold, with textures of flying white (dry brush), ink marks, gold powder, paper fibers, and embossed effects. The title can overlap with the instrument but should not block the main structure.

Include performance / exhibition information: time, location, person, organizer, and a short sentence of copy. Small text layout is restrained and high-end, with a small amount of English auxiliary text and vermilion seals allowed.

No image numbers, no VOL / NO / edition number. Avoid cheap templates, cartoonish feel, excessive glow, messy backgrounds, crowded text, or the subject and background blurring together. The overall style should be high-end, clear, layered, and have the texture of Oriental culture.

prompts.text:
生成一张竖版 9:16 东方器乐文化海报。

主题：【主题名称】
类型：【音乐会 / 展览 / 雅集 / 独奏会】
乐器：【古琴 / 编钟 / 箫笛 / 二胡 / 琵琶 / 古筝 / 笙】
主标题：【主标题文字】
主色调：【深黑金 / 青铜黑金 / 深墨绿金 / 深酒红黑金】
时间：【2026 年下半年日期】
地点：【地点】
人物 / 机构：【演奏者 / 策展人 / 主办方】

整体风格：高级东方文化演出海报，暗调光影，真实器物摄影，巨幅中文书法标题，细腻背景纹理，成熟信息排版。

背景不能是纯色，要有低对比度的宣纸、布纹、木纹、青铜铭文、残影书法、风痕、水痕或乐谱纹理。细节丰富但不杂乱。

乐器作为主视觉，要有真实材质细节：木纹、金属、竹节、弦线、孔洞、漆面反光、雕刻纹样。使用暗场侧光和轮廓光，让乐器像从黑暗中浮现出来。

主标题使用大尺寸中文书法字，金色 / 旧金 / 暗铜金，带飞白、墨痕、金粉、纸张纤维和压印质感。标题可与乐器穿插叠压，但不要遮挡主体结构。

加入演出 / 展览信息：时间、地点、人物、主办方、一句短文案。小字排版克制高级，可加入少量英文辅助文字和朱砂印章。

不要图片编号，不要 VOL / NO / edition number。避免廉价模板、卡通感、过度发光、背景脏乱、文字拥挤、主体和背景糊在一起。整体要高级、清晰、有层次、有东方文化质感。

items.title: 超宽短剧场景故事看板

prompts.text:
Generate an [Ultra-wide Short Drama Scene Storyboard], a single complete image, horizontal 3:1, no collage, no multi-grid, no split columns.

Theme: [Fill in the scene, e.g., Street Chase Battle / Hotel Corridor Ambush / Subway Station Escape / Night Market Block Conflict]

The image is not a common poster, nor a traditional storyboard grid, but a 'continuous background + multi-timepoint character freeze-frame + single-direction plot progression + hand-drawn movement line annotations + bottom timeline' story space storyboard.

The background must be a single complete and continuous real scene, unfolding naturally from left to right, not cut into multiple small images. The plot progresses uniformly from left to right: the left is the starting point, the middle is the conflict escalation, and the right is the ending point.

The same protagonist and the same pursuer/opponent appear repeatedly at different positions in the frame, representing different time points. Character clothing, hairstyle, and body type remain consistent, making it clear at a glance that they are the same characters in the same scene. Each subsequent freeze-frame position must be further to the right than the previous one, not moving left then right.

Plot rhythm suggestion:

Enter scene → Being approached → Encounter interception → First encounter → Conflict escalation → Taking advantage to counterattack → Exiting to the right

Add an exquisite hand-drawn style marking system: thin hand-drawn arrows, route annotations, small circles, brackets, movement center of gravity lines, line-of-sight direction, key node short labels. The text should be minimal, light, and exquisite, like high-end visual notes, not like a PPT infographic.

Add a lightweight timeline at the bottom, for example:

00:00 Enter
00:06 Approach
00:12 Intercept
00:18 Encounter
00:26 Escalate
00:34 Counterattack
00:42 Exit

Overall effect should be like high-end short drama dispatch board, action scene plot planning map, continuous scene storyboard, story space map. The focus is to clearly see: where the characters come from, where they are going, where the conflict escalates, and where the end lands.

Avoid: collage, multi-grid, comic grids, PPT feel, top and bottom white borders, image-text separation, chaotic character movement, back and forth turning, discontinuous space, characters too large, too much text, coarse hard annotations, low resolution.

prompts.text:
生成一张【超宽短剧场景故事看板】，单张完整图片，横版 3:1，不要拼图，不要多宫格，不要分栏。

主题：【填写场景，例如街头追逐对战 / 酒店长廊伏击 / 地铁站逃离 / 夜市街区冲突】

画面不是普通海报，也不是传统分镜格子，而是“连续背景 + 多时间点人物定格 + 单方向剧情推进 + 手绘动线标注 + 底部时间线”的故事空间看板。

背景必须是一个完整连续的真实场景，从左到右自然展开，不要切成多个小画面。剧情统一从左往右推进：左侧是起点，中段是冲突升级，右侧是结尾落点。

同一个主人公和同一个追逐者 / 对手，在画面不同位置重复出现，代表不同时间点。人物服装、发型、体型保持一致，让人一眼看懂这是同一场戏里的同一人物。每一个后续定格位置都要比前一个更靠右，不能一会儿往左、一会儿往右。

剧情节奏建议：

进入场景 → 被追近 → 遭遇拦截 → 首次交手 → 冲突升级 → 借势反击 → 向右脱离

加入精致手绘风格的标记系统：细手绘箭头、路线标注、小圆圈、括号、动作重心线、视线方向、关键节点短标签。文字要少、轻、精致，像高级视觉笔记，不要像PPT信息图。

底部加入一条轻量时间线，例如：

00:00 进入
00:06 追近
00:12 拦截
00:18 交手
00:26 升级
00:34 反击
00:42 脱离

整体效果要像高级短剧调度看板、动作戏剧情规划图、连续场景故事板、故事空间地图。重点是看清：角色从哪来、往哪走、冲突在哪升级、结尾落在哪里。

避免：拼图、多宫格、漫画格子、PPT感、上下白边、图文分裂、人物走向混乱、来回折返、空间不连续、人物过大、文字过多、粗硬标注、低清晰度。

items.title: 内马尔巴西国家队获奖运动海报设计

prompts.text:
Create an award-winning Behance sports poster featuring Neymar Jr. designed by a top-tier creative agency such as Vasjen Katro, Zidart, Abduzeedo, or Studio Dumbar.

Minimal yet powerful editorial composition. The entire poster is built around a gigantic metallic gold number “10” occupying almost the full canvas. Neymar appears integrated within the typography rather than placed on top of it.

Neymar is shown in a dramatic knee-slide celebration wearing Brazil’s yellow national team jersey. His figure overlaps the edges of the giant 10, creating depth and hierarchy. The pose feels authentic, emotional, and iconic rather than posed.

Behind him, use subtle Brazilian cultural textures: fragments of Rio architecture, faded stadium lights, vintage football photography, and abstract carnival-inspired geometry. These elements should be nearly hidden and discovered only on close inspection.

Typography is extremely refined. The word “NEYMAR” appears vertically in a custom condensed typeface inspired by luxury fashion magazines. Small editorial text blocks, grid systems, coordinates, statistics, and subtle design annotations create a premium design-studio aesthetic.

Color palette:

Deep emerald green
Muted championship gold
Warm ivory
Rich charcoal black
Controlled Brazil yellow accents

No bright colors.

Lighting resembles a Nike World Cup campaign photographed by Annie Leibovitz or a FIFA creative director. Ultra-real skin texture, realistic sweat, subtle film grain, premium print texture, luxury magazine finish.

Composition follows Swiss grid principles, asymmetrical balance, generous negative space, and strong visual hierarchy.

Style references:

Behance Sports Branding
Nike Football Campaigns
Awwwards Design
Swiss Editorial Design
Luxury Fashion Magazine Covers
Creative Direction by Vasjen Katro

Ultra realistic, 8K, masterpiece, art-director quality, design award winner, premium typography, sophisticated visual storytelling, portfolio-worthy graphic design.

items.title: 夏日草地少女吃西瓜九宫格拼贴

prompts.text:
Around any theme subject generate a group of bright and light nine-grid continuous image collages, letting the same theme subject appear repeatedly in nine adjacent picture units in different distances, actions, postures or states, forming a lively rhythm like a daily photo album that has been hand-painted and annotated. The first glance at the image should read the central close-up interaction moment, and the other units unfold around it, including full-body or overall displays, local close-ups, lateral actions, emphasized objects reaching towards the lens, quiet pauses and small expression-style pictures with a sense of doubt; the boundaries of each grid connect naturally, with slight brightness differences and soft layers between photos, like the same refreshing scene being sliced into continuous fragments. The background serves as a large area of high-brightness, clear and airy structural base field, derived from the environment or material mood of the theme, maintaining clean lighting and soft shadows; the subject color is extracted from the theme's own material, identity and narrative, bearing the main identification, with a small amount of high-saturation accent colors concentrated on attachments, handheld objects, corners or visual beat points, and white as an information layer covering the image, forming a bright, clean, happy but not cluttered color relationship. Add thick white hand-drawn graffiti, arc brackets, action lines, question marks, smiley faces, small short words and partial outlines, letting the text and lines grow like instant stickers along the subject's outline, blank areas and action directions; the font is rounded, relaxed, with jumping sizes, decorating the image while guiding the line of sight. The overall style maintains real photo texture, soft-focus sunlight, a slight film collage feel and youthful outdoor vitality, avoiding over-retouching, dark or dirty colors, heavy shadows or turning graffiti into regular typography.

——————

Must retain: Close-up of watermelon, short words like Hi/Hello/Nice Day, question mark smileys and hand-drawn action lines

items.title: 敦煌博物馆开门见光文化视觉海报

prompts.text:
Generate an information image with a strong sense of opening and revealing for any given theme: the screen is composed of two close-range, heavy blocking surfaces creating the main visual pressure, with the blocking surfaces staggered towards the middle to reveal only a clear, bright, narrow passage. The interior of the passage carries the core narrative textures, symbolic graphics, or fine scenes of the theme, allowing the viewer to first see the dark volume and a sliver of light, then be drawn into the content within the gap. The subject does not directly fill the screen, but instead builds a sense of ritual through the relationship of 'being covered, being opened, and being glimpsed'; a very small scale clue related to the theme can be placed at the bottom to pull out spatial depth and a sense of lonely progression. Text serves as part of the visual structure: the main title uses high-contrast, elegant, and breathing typefaces, placed on the quieter side of the dark field, while subtitles and explanatory text are organized in clear hierarchies; the other side uses extremely large, low-transparency theme text or symbols, cropped by the edges to become dark area textures rather than eye-catching information. Colors are extracted from the theme's own materials, cultural emotions, and narrative temperature, retaining large areas of low-brightness structural fields, a small amount of bright and clear revealing light, restrained middle-layer texture colors, and clear information text colors, making the overall mood solemn, mysterious, and warmly lit; dark colors must be clean and transparent, bright areas maintain a sense of glow and clear color gradations, and textures are used to increase the touch of history or materials, avoiding making the image look dirty, gray, or faded. The overall completion should be like a meticulously designed cultural visual cover, with heavy edges, light in the center, and a clear reading path, avoiding making the theme into an ordinary illustration collage or an evenly spread-out explanatory layout.

——————
Cultural direction: Dunhuang City Museum small group guided lecture, focusing on the ritual sense of opening doors to see light and mural details being slowly revealed
Store use: Course recruitment poster, can include short information like '2-hour lecture', '12-person small group', 'Silk Road Civilization'
Supplementary requirements: People are only used as tiny scale clues at the bottom, large text in dark areas remains low transparency
Output ratio: Vertical version 3:4

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese minimalist conceptual poster, which must be a finished poster with Chinese layout completed.

The overall style is: minimalist exhibition poster, frosted glass visual, translucent borders, contemporary art festival visual, modern graphic design, high-end feel, quiet and restrained, ample white space.

The background of the image is light grey-white, cream, or fog-white, like frosted glass, translucent film, matte screen, or soft fog boundaries. The background must be clean, retaining a large amount of white space, and not cluttered.

The main subject is a [Subject], which is located on the other side of a layer of frosted glass or translucent film, slowly penetrating, emerging, and pressing out an outline.

The subject cannot be completely clearly exposed, it must present:
Partial clarity + large area of blur + soft diffusion + sense of penetration + sense of indentation.

You can make a certain part of the subject clearer, for example:
Hands, feet, legs, or shoulders of a person;
Head, eyes, ears, paws, or legs of an animal;
Handle, earpiece, cable, edge, or bottom structure of an object.

The overall subject should look like it is slowly arriving from another space. Edges are softened, outlines are hazy, with slight shadows and atomized diffusion. The overall temperament is quiet, mysterious, restrained, with a sense of a contemporary art exhibition poster.

Add complete Chinese layout to the image:

Main title says "[Main Title]"
Subtitle says "[Sub-copy]"

Information area says:
"[Activity Type]"
"[City / Venue]"
"2026.06.25"
"Thursday 10:00 - 20:00"
"[Address]"
"Exhibition / Workshop / Performance / Forum"

Important requirements:
All dates must only appear as "2026.06.25".
Do not show 2024.
Do not show 2025.
Do not show other old dates.
Do not generate garbled dates.
Do not write the date incorrectly.
Do not use real brand logos.
No watermarks.

Typography style:
The main title uses bright yellow large characters, the font is simple, modern, and striking.
Subtitles and activity information use black or dark grey small characters.
The overall information block can be placed on the left or right side, forming a staggered composition with the main subject.
The layout should look like a real contemporary art exhibition poster, with clear information, white space, and order.

Visual keywords:
Minimalist, frosted glass, translucent borders, sense of penetration, soft focus, hazy, partial clarity, subject emerging, light grey-white background, large area of white space, bright yellow title, black-grey small characters, contemporary exhibition poster, quiet and high-end.

Do not:
No cartoon, no 3D plastic feel, no e-commerce style, no complex background, no strong cyber style, no low-grade promotional posters, no real brand logos, no watermarks, no garbled text.

动物的头、眼睛、耳朵、爪子、腿；
物件的把手、听筒、线缆、边缘、底部结构。

不要出现 2025。

不要生成乱码日期。
不要把日期写错。

排版要像真实的当代艺术展览海报，信息清晰，有留白，有秩序。

prompts.text: Generate a square 1:1 hand-drawn childlike animal illustration with a white or off-white paper background. items.title: 克里斯蒂亚诺罗纳尔多孔版印刷艺术海报

prompts.text: Create a highly collectible Cristiano Ronaldo poster inspired by contemporary risograph printing, independent art publications, and experimental editorial design. The composition is built around a tightly cropped portrait of young Manchester United Ronaldo, captured in a spontaneous over-the-shoulder pose that communicates ambition, unpredictability, and youthful confidence. The image should feel physically printed rather than digitally generated. Layered risograph textures, imperfect ink registration, subtle grain structures, overlapping color passes, and tactile paper surfaces create visual richness throughout the composition. Large typographic forms interact directly with the portrait, occasionally misaligning in controlled ways to create authentic print character. The palette consists of royal blue, fluorescent orange, warm cream, and deep black. The portrait remains highly recognizable while portions of the image dissolve into graphic textures and abstract print interventions. The final artwork should resemble a limited-edition poster sold in a contemporary design bookstore rather than a traditional sports print.

prompts.text: 创建一张极具收藏价值的克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多海报，灵感源自当代孔版印刷、独立艺术出版物和实验性编辑设计。构图围绕一张曼联时期年轻C罗的紧凑裁剪肖像展开，捕捉了他自发的回眸姿势，传达出雄心、不可预测性和青春的自信。图像应具有实体印刷感，而非数字生成感。叠加的孔版印刷纹理、不完美的油墨对齐、细腻的颗粒结构、重叠的色彩传递以及触感纸张表面，为整个构图营造出丰富的视觉效果。大型印刷字体与肖像直接交互，偶尔以受控的方式错位，以营造真实的印刷特征。色调由宝蓝色、荧光橙、暖奶油色和深黑色组成。肖像保持高度可辨识，同时图像的部分区域融入图形纹理和抽象印刷干预。最终作品应像是在当代设计书店出售的限量版海报，而非传统的体育印刷品。

Copy this structure and evolve to your brand 

Prompt : Act as a senior art director from a world-class advertising agency specializing in high-conversion digital commerce campaigns for DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Instacart.

Create a premium social media poster for DoorDash in vertical 4:5 format designed for Instagram brand marketing.

OBJECTIVE:
Reinforce DoorDash’s leadership in fast delivery, convenience, and everything-on-demand commerce while driving strong brand awareness.

ART DIRECTION:
Modern, clean, energetic, premium commercial design.
High visual impact.
Conversion-focused layout.
No clutter.
Everything should communicate speed and convenience within the first second.

BRAND IDENTITY:
Strict DoorDash branding.
Primary colors:
DoorDash Red (#FF3008)
Pure White (#FFFFFF)
Soft Gray (#F5F5F5)
Dark Neutral (#111111)

COMPOSITION:

Strong center-weighted layout.
Large headline at upper third.
Dynamic foreground motion.
Clear CTA hierarchy.

HERO SUBJECT:
A smartphone displaying the DoorDash app interface positioned centrally, occupying 35 percent of frame height.
UI clearly visible with realistic order screen showing delivery tracking, ETA badge, cart preview, and “Arriving in 9 mins”.

MOTION:
