Directional motion blur around products.
Energy trails and subtle particles emphasizing instant delivery.
Visual momentum should feel fast and exciting.

LIGHTING:

Soft frontal lighting for product clarity.
Strong red rim lighting reflecting DoorDash brand color.
Subtle glow around smartphone.
Clean high-contrast shadows.

TYPOGRAPHY:

DELIVERED IN MINUTES.

Secondary copy:
FOOD, GROCERIES & MORE — RIGHT TO YOUR DOOR.

Typography should be bold modern sans serif, crisp, clean, conversion-focused.

CTA:

prompts.text:
Generate a set of nine-grid image collages with a sense of life record around any subject: the image is composed of multiple closely adjacent realistic moments, with clear boundaries but no decorative frames. Each grid serves a different reading function, there are close-up backward glances or action moments of the main subject, as well as environmental scale, detail close-ups, a sense of path, and negative space, forming a rhythm like a reshuffled snapshot diary. The strongest graphic mechanism is a hand-drawn white graffiti layer overlaid on the images: using handwritten lines of varying thickness, contour circling, wavy lines, star points, arrows, dashes, heart shapes, cloud-like blocks, and a small number of theme-derived handwritten phrases, the subject is "marked out" from the real scene. Some lines cross the grid boundaries, while others only stick to the edges of the subject to create an immediate sense of being marked, tracked, and emphasized. The graffiti should be like a marker or digital pen drawn directly on the photo, with clean edges and slight hand tremors. Partial large white shapes can block information, creating playful white space pressure, but still keep the image narrative readable. Colors are extracted from the theme's own environment, materials, and emotions: large areas of the underlying image use medium-to-low brightness real environmental colors with clear light and shadow. The main subject color carries the narrative weight, structural dark parts stabilize the space, and a small amount of theme-derived accent colors fall on local markings, objects, or detail nodes. The topmost hand-drawn markings remain high-brightness, clean, clear, and not gray, activating the whole with small areas of high contrast. The overall mood is on-site, light, intimate, and immediate, with a bit of youthfulness and a sense of roaming records. The composition should have a density of alternating crowding and breathing; local parts can be strongly cropped, the subject can be surrounded by lines, and the background exists only as scene evidence and rhythmic underlay. The final effect is like a page of a privately scribbled visual handbook, where realistic photo textures and free hand-drawn symbols exist simultaneously.

——————

For social media use: A nine-grid photo handbook like a day of city walk, relaxed and with a sense of presence
Needs to appear: White hand-drawn circles, arrows, star points, and a small number of English handwritten phrases, size vertical 9:16

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese surrealist concept poster; it must be a finished poster with completed Chinese typography.

The overall style is: minimalist white space, surrealism, quiet and restrained, cinematic, concept poster, Chinese typography design. The overall image is high-end, clean, and ethereal, with large areas of light grey-white negative space and a small amount of cool-toned or neutral-colored atmosphere; no clutter, no commercial advertising feel.

【Visual Structure】
The main subject of the image is a "misplaced realistic scene," which means placing familiar natural or urban elements in abnormal positions to form a clear surreal contrast. For example:
The ocean hanging overhead,
Tree roots growing toward the sky,
The city inverted,
A door floating in the clouds,
A clock shattering and flowing back in the air,
The horizon starting to drift.

The lower part of the image retains a large amount of blank or misty ground; the ground is clean, minimalist, and has a slight sense of reflection. Arrange a very small independent figure in the image, standing in the center or lower part of the open space, looking up at the misplaced world above. The figure is quiet, lonely, and restrained, used to form a strong scale contrast.

【Composition Requirements】
The top is a huge surreal subject, and the bottom is minimalist negative space and a small figure. The overall composition has a clear sense of "pressure / questioning / observation," making the audience feel at a glance that reality has been rearranged. Typography allows for bold adjustments; it can be heavy on the left and light on the right, vertical main titles, horizontal main titles at the bottom, auxiliary copy on the edges, and multi-block white space; no need for a fixed template.

【Text Typography】
Main title write "【主标题】"
Subtitle write "【副文案】"
Auxiliary small text can include a concept description or a questioning sentence.
The text must be clear, accurate Chinese, no gibberish. The overall font is high-end and restrained, can include a small amount of English auxiliary information, but English should not dominate.

【Visual Temperament】
The atmosphere is: quiet, ethereal, lonely, doubting reality, philosophical, observational, slight pressure, modern art museum poster feel.

【Do Not】
No cartoons, no cheap sci-fi, no e-commerce feel, no complex collages, no gaudy high saturation, no watermarks, no real brand logos.

prompts.text:
生成一张竖版 3:4 的中文超现实概念海报，必须是一张已经完成中文排版的成品海报。

整体风格为：极简留白、超现实主义、安静克制、电影感、概念海报、中文排版设计。画面整体高级、干净、空灵，有大面积浅灰白留白和少量冷色调或中性色氛围，不要杂乱，不要商业广告感。

【画面结构】
画面主体是一个“被错位的现实场景”，即把我们熟悉的自然或城市元素放到不正常的位置，形成明显的超现实反差。例如：
海洋悬在头顶、
树根朝天空生长、
城市倒悬、
门漂浮在云层里、
钟表在空中破碎回流、
地平线开始漂移。

画面下方保留大量空白或雾面地面，地面干净、极简、带轻微反射感。画面中安排一个很小的独立人物，站在空旷空间中央或偏下方，仰望上方错位的世界。人物是安静的、孤独的、克制的，用来形成强烈尺度对比。

【构图要求】
上方是巨大的超现实主体，下方是极简留白与小人物。整体构图具有明显的“压迫感 / 提问感 / 观看感”，让观众一眼感受到现实被重新排列。排版允许大胆调整，可左重右轻、竖排主标题、底部横排主标题、边缘辅助文案、多区块留白，不需要固定套版。

【文字排版】
主标题写「【主标题】」
副标题写「【副文案】」
辅助小字可以加入一句概念说明或提问句。
文字必须是清晰、准确的中文，不要乱码。整体字体高级、克制，可带少量英文辅助信息，但不要英文主导。

【视觉气质】
氛围为：安静、空灵、孤独、怀疑现实、哲学感、观察感、微压迫、现代美术馆海报感。

【不要】
不要卡通，不要廉价科幻，不要电商感，不要复杂拼贴，不要艳俗高饱和，不要水印，不要真实品牌 Logo。

items.title: 莫斯科瑞士风格极简海报设计

prompts.text:
Design a contemporary Swiss Style editorial poster for Moscow, Russia. Use a large bold sans-serif capital letter “M” as the main typographic structure. The “M” must be very clear, clean, geometric, solid, and dominant, with no stroke outline, no border, no shadow outline, and no decorative treatment. The silhouette of the letter “M” must remain easy to read at first glance. Do not let the illustration obscure or distort the shape of the letter. The poster should follow a precise left-aligned Swiss grid system with generous negative space.

Inside the “M”, create a simple, logical, and restrained flat illustration of Moscow’s city landscape character. Use only a few essential visual elements: simplified modern skyscrapers inspired by Moscow City business district, the calm curve of the Moscow River, a subtle silhouette of the Kremlin walls and towers, onion domes of Saint Basil’s Cathedral in a simplified geometric form, a soft green park landscape inspired by Gorky Park or Zaryadye Park, and two pedestrians on a clean riverside walkway. Keep the composition minimal, spacious, and easy to understand. Do not add too many landmarks, people, signs, vehicles, monuments, statues, fountains, trains, buses, or small decorative objects.

The illustration should suggest Moscow’s identity as a capital city where imperial history, Soviet monumental scale, modern glass skyscrapers, riverfront public spaces, and vast urban rhythm coexist in a clean contemporary way. Use flat vector shapes, clean silhouettes, minimal linework, simplified architecture, and believable scale relationships. Keep the scene lightly lively but not busy. The illustration should support the letter “M”, not compete with it.

Allow only extremely subtle overlap outside the “M” frame using simple organic or atmospheric elements only: a few leaves from riverside trees or soft atmospheric mist over the river may slightly extend beyond the letter edge. Keep 97% of the illustration inside the “M”. Do not let people, buildings, domes, towers, vehicles, faces, paths, signage, or complex objects overlap outside the letter. The “M” must remain clearly readable and visually dominant.

Place the headline “Moscow” below the letter in bold sans-serif type, title case, not all caps, left aligned to the same grid. Under the headline, add this short body paragraph in small regular sans-serif text, also left aligned, with clean spacing and refined editorial hierarchy:

“Moscow moves through grand historic layers, monumental architecture, river bends, and a dense modern skyline. Between imperial heritage, Soviet scale, and contemporary urban energy, the city holds a character that is powerful, structured, and constantly evolving.”

No icons, no badges, no decorative symbols. The overall design should feel Swiss minimalist: strong grid, precise alignment, asymmetrical balance, clean typography, generous negative space, restrained composition, and modern cultural city poster aesthetics.

Color palette: warm ivory background, deep navy or charcoal typography, concrete gray, glass blue, pine green, Kremlin red accents, river blue-gray, pale beige, and soft black accents. Matte paper finish, subtle paper grain, crisp edges, flat contemporary illustration, modern Moscow metropolitan mood, calm but strong, sophisticated, balanced, and print-ready.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, glossy, maximalist, overcrowded city, complex illustration, too many details, too many landmarks

prompts.text:
为俄罗斯莫斯科设计一张当代瑞士风格的编辑海报。使用一个巨大的加粗无衬线大写字母“M”作为主要排版结构。“M”必须非常清晰、干净、几何化、厚实且占据主导地位，没有描边轮廓、没有边框、没有投影轮廓，也没有装饰处理。字母“M”的剪影必须在一眼望去时保持易读。不要让插图遮挡或扭曲字母的形状。海报应遵循精确的左对齐瑞士网格系统，并留有大量的负空间。

在“M”内部，创作一个简单、逻辑清晰且克制的莫斯科城市景观特征的扁平插图。仅使用几个基本的视觉元素：受莫斯科城商业区启发的简化现代摩天大楼、莫斯科河平静的曲线、克里姆林宫围墙和塔楼的微妙剪影、简化几何形状的圣瓦西里大教堂洋葱圆顶、受高尔基公园或扎里亚季耶公园启发的柔和绿色公园景观，以及在干净的河滨步道上的两名行人。保持构图极简、开阔且易于理解。不要添加过多的地标、人物、标志、车辆、纪念碑、雕像、喷泉、火车、巴士或小型装饰物。

插图应暗示莫斯科作为首都的身份，在这里，帝国历史、苏联宏伟规模、现代玻璃摩天大楼、河滨公共空间和广阔的城市韵律以一种干净的现代方式并存。使用扁平矢量形状、干净的剪影、极简的线条、简化的建筑和可信的比例关系。保持场景轻微生动但不忙碌。插图应支持字母“M”，而不是与其竞争。

仅允许极细微的重叠超出“M”框架，且仅使用简单的有机或大气元素：河边树木的几片叶子或河流上方的柔和大气雾气可以略微延伸到字母边缘以外。保持97%的插图在“M”内部。不要让人物、建筑物、圆顶、塔楼、车辆、面孔、路径、标牌或复杂物体在字母外部重叠。“M”必须保持清晰可读并具有视觉主导地位。

在字母下方放置标题“Moscow”，使用加粗无衬线字体，标题大小写，而非全大写，与同一网格左对齐。在标题下方，添加这段简短的正文段落，使用细小的常规无衬线文本，同样左对齐，具有干净的间距和精致的编辑层级：

“Moscow moves through grand historic layers, monumental architecture, river bends, and a dense modern skyline. Between imperial heritage, Soviet scale, and contemporary urban energy, the city holds a character that is powerful, structured, and constantly evolving.”

没有图标、没有徽章、没有装饰符号。整体设计应具有瑞士极简主义感：强大的网格、精确的对齐、不对称的平衡、干净的排版、大量的负空间、克制的构图以及现代文化城市海报的美学。

调色板：暖象牙色背景、深海军蓝或木炭色排版、水泥灰、玻璃蓝、松绿色、克里姆林红点缀、河流蓝灰色、淡米色和柔和的黑色点缀。哑光纸张效果、细微纸张纹理、锐利边缘、扁平当代插图、现代莫斯科大都市氛围、冷静但强大、精致、平衡且印刷就绪。

负向提示词：写实照片、3D渲染、光泽、极繁主义、拥挤的城市、复杂的插图、过多的细节、过多的地标。

items.title: 细线现代东方极简中文字体设计Logo

prompts.text:
【Brand Name】:
【Pinyin Assistant】:
【Brand Direction】: Tea room / Flower vessels / Ceramics / Bookstore / Fragrance / Artifacts / B&B / Oriental lifestyle brand
【Layout Structure】: 2×2 matrix / Vertical / Horizontal / Staggered intercalation
【Temperament Keywords】: Cold / Restrained / Elegant / White space / Modern Oriental / Thin line font

Please generate a "Thin Line Oriental Typeface Logo".

The overall style is a minimalist Chinese font-based Logo, with a white or very light gray-white background and a large amount of white space. The main subject of the picture is not an illustration, nor a graphic, but the Chinese brand name itself designed as a visual identity.

The main Chinese characters use a black thin line typeface, with long, lightweight, restrained, and cold strokes, possessing a modern Oriental feel. Slight geometric reconstruction, elongation, broken strokes, staggering, or negative space treatment can be applied to some strokes, but the overall readability and unity must be maintained, and it should not become garbled.

The overall focus is "Typeface is the Logo": the Chinese brand name itself is the main visual, with Pinyin or English serving only as auxiliary layout. Pinyin can be placed below, on the side, vertically, or interspersed next to the main characters, with wide character spacing to maintain a high-end, quiet, and restrained feel.

Add a small vermillion seal with an engraving feel. The content of the seal can be a single character in ancient style or an abstract ancient seal symbol. The seal only serves as a finishing touch, should not be too large, and must not overshadow the main visual.

The overall effect should look like a real brand's modern Chinese font Logo, clean, flat, with a sense of design and series, suitable for brand proposals, storefront signs, packaging, social media avatars, and visual system extensions.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:

请生成一张《细线东方字形 Logo》。

整体为极简中文字体型 Logo，白色或极浅灰白背景，大量留白。画面主体不是插画，也不是图形，而是把中文品牌名本身设计成视觉标识。

中文主字使用黑色细线字形，笔画修长、轻盈、克制、清冷，有现代东方感。可以对部分笔画做轻微几何化重构、拉长、断笔、错位或留白处理，但整体必须保持可读性和统一性，不要变成乱码。

整体重点是“字体即 Logo”：中文品牌名本身就是主视觉，拼音或英文只作为辅助排版。拼音可以放在下方、侧边、竖排或穿插在主字旁边，字距要拉开，保持高级、安静、克制。

加入一个小型朱红色篆刻感印章，印章内容可以是古意风格单字，也可以是抽象古印符号。印章只做点睛，不能太大，不能抢主视觉。

prompts.text:
Generate a clean and attitude-filled image around any subject: the main form of the subject occupies the visual center, presented with a real or near-real tactile texture; the posture, outline, or structure remains stable, calm, with a slight rebellious temperament; the background uses a high-brightness, highly airy pure light-colored field, leaving a large area of quiet space, making the subject appear as if gently supported by soft stage light. Arrange handwritten declaration-style text, short keywords, directional marks, speed lines, loop lines, and energy symbols around the sides and top of the subject; all graphics look as if they were just casually drawn in the air with a marker, with inconsistent thickness, slightly tilted and jumping, forming a reading rhythm from the information on one side to the subject and then to the information on the other side; the text carries the attitude and beat, not overshadowing the subject, and must maintain a breathing distance from the subject. Colors are extracted from the subject's own material, emotion, and narrative: the background remains bright and clear, the subject uses clear light and dark layers to establish structure, text information is carried by clean, high-contrast colors, and emphasis symbols only use a small amount of high-saturation bright colors derived from the subject, concentrated in positions that can drive the gaze, forming a bright, brisk, sharp, and action-oriented mood. The overall completion is like fashion editorial photography overlaid with a hand-drawn graphic language, edges are clear, shadows are light, the screen is clean, no cluttered collages, and graffiti is not allowed to obscure the key outlines of the subject.

——————

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 vertical dreamy slow shutter garden portrait image, titled "Dreamy Her". A beautiful young woman is running, looking back, or gently spinning in a spring garden/flower field/grassy path, wearing a light white dress/soft pink tulle dress/cream long dress/pale green flowy long dress, holding a bouquet of colorful flowers. Her hair is naturally blown by the wind, with loose strands and a sense of movement on the skirt.

Use slow shutter photography, panning motion blur, and intentional camera movement. The background and foreground should be stretched into soft horizontal blurs, while the subject remains semi-sharp and semi-blurred. Maintain a recognizable visual anchor point, such as facial profile, bouquet, hair, or dress edge, to make the image feel dreamy but not unrecognizable.

The scene should include soft grass, blooming flowers, tree shadows, falling petals in the air, glowing natural light, and a light film atmosphere. Color palette: cream white, soft green, blush pink, sky blue, warm golden light. Add subtle film grain, soft focus, ethereal depth of field, and slight highlight bloom. The final image should feel like a half-remembered dream—not a sharp portrait, but a fleeting moment.

Avoid: commercial studio style, overly sharp faces, plastic skin, influencer poses, CGI effects, cartoon style, stiff bodies, anatomical errors, deformed hands, distorted bouquets, distorted dresses, text, watermarks, logos.

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese conceptual literary poster, it must be a finished poster with Chinese typography already completed.

The image has a light grey-blue or pale fog-blue paper background, overall low saturation, restrained, quiet, with fine paper texture, slight noise, and old printing grain.

The main subject is not an ordinary landscape, but a surreal landscape composed of 'text content'. A large amount of tiny text, paragraphs, sentences, typography fragments, blocks of characters, and text textures form [landform types], such as rivers, waterfalls, deep wells, cliffs, sea surfaces, vortices, mountains, and echo tunnels. The text merges with the landscape, creating a visual effect of 'language is flowing / falling / echoing / dissipating'.

Include a very small figure or a lonely boat in the scene, located on one side or in a corner, creating a strong scale contrast to evoke a lonely, thoughtful, calm, and literary atmosphere.

Composition requires obvious negative space, the main title uses clear, accurate, and readable Chinese typography. The title can be vertical or horizontal, naturally arranged according to the structure of the image. Subtitles or a short copy must also be clearly presented, no gibberish. The overall layout is like a high-quality literary magazine poster or an experimental Chinese book cover.

Image keywords include:
light blue paper, black and white woodcut, woodcut texture, text landscape, surreal river, waterfall light band, lonely boat, small figure, paper grain, Chinese typography, negative space, poetic, literary sense, quiet restraint.

items.title: 社区花园赏花会流光清透视觉海报

prompts.text:
Generate a visual poster based on any theme object featuring a clear information layer and streaming color ribbon mechanism. The image first establishes a lighthearted mood with a large area of bright, clean, and highly airy light-colored background. The main subject is not presented with complete realistic outlines, but is instead abstracted into soft-focus diffused color blocks, slender motion blurs, and translucent light trails, as if stretched by speed, wind, or glass refraction, forming a rhythm from dense to light and from clear to atomized. The material, season, cultural signals, or emotions of the theme itself determine the final hue, maintaining a high-brightness base color, the main theme color occupying the largest visual weight, a small amount of clear accent colors lighting up local areas, and informational text using clear white; this defines the relationship between elements. The color steps should be clear, the saturation light, the warm and cold tones breathing, overall maintaining a bright, light, clear, and clean feel, avoiding muddiness or aging. Text is an important graphic layer, using high-contrast, elegant, and sharp large serif characters as the primary reading point; the theme title is pressed into the top or the edge of the main visual in a very large font size, and Chinese information is organized into text groups of varying density with a formal Songti temperament; some small text forms narrow columns or thin-line rhythms along the edges, with text and color ribbons interlacing but not making each other look dirty. Extremely thin white arcs, elliptical frames, or tiny symbols can be added as light markers, making the information appear to float above the transparent color mist. The overall completion should be like a mix between a high-end event poster and an art book page, with ample white space, a clear visual center of gravity, breathing edges, very light grain texture, and all graphics serving the first-glance memory of "stretched theme color mist in a clear bright field supporting white typography."

items.title: 清透克制艺术杂志风春日白花海报

prompts.text:
Generate a clear and restrained visual around any theme: the image uses a large area of light and bright background to support the subject, with subtle paper fibers, light indentations, and soft grain, while maintaining brightness, cleanliness, and an airy feel. The core graphic mechanism is to have an oversized main title spanning the upper edge of the thematic image; the font itself is filled by the thematic image, as if the text and the main visual below were cut from the same layer, creating a dual viewing experience where one first reads the huge letterforms and then the internal theme texture and subject details. The main visual enters the frame with a close-up crop; the linear structures, textures, or attached elements derived from the theme spread across a large block of imagery, with a soft-focus foreground detail closer to the lens pressing against the edge to create depth and tactility. Three sets of short information columns are reserved at the top, using compact sans-serif fonts, distributed left, center, and right; the text blocks are narrow, line spacing is dense, and blackness is light, providing rhythm like editorial notes. A small amount of numbering or signature-style micro-information can be placed near the main visual, with a heavier main sentence and a lighter explanatory text at the bottom, forming a clear reading path. Colors are extracted from the theme's own materials, environment, and mood, not copied from fixed color codes: the background carries the maximum brightness and quiet negative space, the thematic image carries the primary emotional color while maintaining high brightness, clear color levels, and transparent light, structural lines or shadows provide clean contrast, and a small amount of theme-derived accent color falls only on local focal points and details; the overall mood is bright and breezy, clear and quiet, with textures having paper-like warmth but not becoming dirty, gray, old, or muddy. The image finish is like a typeset art magazine cover, with low but precise information density, ample margins, sharp image boundaries, and text and imagery interlocking rather than simply overlapping.

Theme: Spring white flower branches and blue sky, retaining the feeling of a giant English title integrated into the flower branch image.
Use: Create a clear and natural floral poster suitable for sharing spring walks and flower viewing.
Text: Main title can be 'bloom', a bilingual short sentence at the bottom, overall vertical 3:4.

items.title: 花店初夏芍药海报柔焦虚实排版设计

prompts.text:
Generate an image-style poster centered around specific theme content. The core visual mechanism is the contrast between a "translucent soft-focus information curtain" and a "clear subject breaking through the boundary": one side lays out a theme image enlarged to near abstraction, processed with heavy soft focus and a translucent mask, forming a hazy color field that can carry text; the other side reserves a deep and clean negative space field, letting the theme subject cut in from near the central axis with real photographic texture, partially cropped, with clear edges and sharp details, where the main form and the soft-focus background echo each other on the same visual axis. The title uses extremely large font sizes, light and narrow sans-serif, calm typography with all caps or equidistant line breaks, with restrained letter spacing, forming a strong top-to-bottom reading rhythm; dates or key information are placed below, using a smaller font size and a quieter hierarchy to hold the image, and a short sentence can be placed at the bottom, maintaining low density, precise alignment, and sufficient breathing room. prompts.text: Generate a bright, child-like hand-drawn collage invitation screen. At first glance, a super large hand-painted symbol or theme glyph (a large '囍' character) occupies the central visual weight, looking like thick-coated crayons with grainy edges, blunt strokes, and a slight hand-shaking feel, serving as the emotional backplane of the entire screen. The main subject is a childhood photo of the couple, appearing as foreground material pasted in front of the large symbol, enclosed by an irregular thick doodle outline like a protective frame hand-drawn by a child, which partially bypasses the subject's edges and overlaps with the large glyph behind; the outline around the people should be a yellow hand-drawn frame. At the top, arrange a relaxed, rounded, slightly tilted handwritten title and a smaller subtitle. At the bottom, keep a row of more casual handwritten explanatory text, which looks like colored markers written on paper, with naturally uneven spacing but clear readability. The text includes 'Welcome to our wedding' and '欢迎参加我们的婚礼'. The background maintains a large area of high-brightness, clear and clean paper white space, with slight paper fiber and tiny colored confetti textures. A small amount of hand-drawn hearts, short lines, dots, and paper-like colorful scraps are scattered around to create a sense of celebration without overshadowing the main subject. Colors are extracted from the theme's own material, emotion, and sense of ritual, maintaining the relationship between the bright base color, vivid central structural color, warm handwritten information color, and a small amount of crisp warm and cold accent colors. The overall style should be high-brightness, saturated but clean, with clear boundaries, presenting a light, close, naive, and commemorative handmade visual, avoiding a refined commercial poster feel, dirty/old filters, and overly neat layout. Aspect ratio: 16:9.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
围绕具体主题内容生成一张明亮童趣的手绘拼贴邀请画面，第一眼读到一个占据中部视觉重心的超大手刷符号或主题字形，它像厚涂蜡笔一样带颗粒边缘、圆钝笔触和轻微手抖感，作为整张画面的情绪背板；主题主体以前景真实素材或具象主形体出现，贴在大符号前方，被一圈不规则的粗线涂鸦轮廓包住，轮廓要像孩子随手描出的保护框，局部绕开主体边缘并与背后的大字形产生叠压。上方安排松弛、圆润、略歪的手写标题和较小副标题，底部保留一行更随性的手写说明文字，文字像彩笔写在纸面上，字距自然不齐但阅读清楚。背景保持大面积高明度、清透干净的纸面留白，带轻微纸纤维与细小彩屑质感；四周散落少量手绘爱心、短线、圆点和纸片状彩色碎屑，形成庆祝感但不抢主体。色彩从主题自身的材质、情绪和仪式感中提取，保留明亮底色、鲜明中心结构色、温暖手写信息色、少量清脆冷暖点缀色的角色关系；整体要高明度、饱和但干净、边界清晰，呈现轻快、亲近、稚拙又有纪念感的手作视觉，避免精致商业海报感、脏旧滤镜和过度整齐的排版。


——————
画面想换成：新人小时候双人合照，保留大喜字、彩色爱心和童趣手绘邀请感
发朋友圈用：婚礼邀请预告，文字保留 welcome to our wedding 和欢迎参加我们的婚礼
成图尺寸：横版 16:9，背景干净明亮，人物外圈用黄色手绘框包住

items.title: 海边婚礼仪式感手写体邀请函设计

prompts.text:
Generate a ceremonial invitation visual based on specific theme content: The visual weight is first occupied by a giant handwritten main title at the top, with thick white strokes, slightly rough edges, and a sense of speed in the writing; long horizontal and downward strokes cross the background space, as if writing emotion directly into the scene. Below it, an open, quiet, and breathable theme field is reserved, with clear horizontal levels in the distance and a path or visual guide line leading to the depths on the central axis. A rectangular image layer with clean boundaries is embedded in the middle, its content forming a temporal or memory look-back with the main narrative of the theme, like a frame placed in a real-world scene. Below, smaller theme characters, objects, or symbolic roles are arranged to enter the frame from the back, becoming the scale and narrative entry. Information text remains restrained: the top right uses fine characters to list time and location information, establishing reading pauses with short lines or arrows; the bottom uses elegant serifs or thin fonts, fine horizontal lines, and names/theme names to create a sense of ceremony; the text is not an instruction board but forms a rhythm together with the image. Colors are extracted from the theme's own environment, materials, season, and emotions, retaining large areas of clear, low-saturation backgrounds, a small amount of high-brightness white written information, clear dark structures, and local temperature differences; the overall feel is clear, quiet, and has a cool, airy sense; even if the theme requires deeper colors, clean color scales, clear edges, and transparent layers must be maintained to avoid muddy aging. The final texture should be like real photography superimposed with handwritten calligraphy, with distinct layers, breathable white space, and a strong sense of ceremony, where the first glance reads the giant handwritten emotion and the second glance enters the middle image and the narrative below.

——————
Visual direction: Seaside wedding invitation, retaining the sense of ceremony of the distant sea, the embankment leading to the depths, and handwritten welcome words.
Use for WeChat Moments: Wedding preview for the couple and guest invitation; information should only include time, location, and names.
Size: Vertical 3:4, the middle photo layer is replaced with a memory scene of the couple holding hands walking towards the sea.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
围绕具体主题内容生成一张仪式邀请视觉：画面先由超大手写主标题占据上方视觉重量，笔触厚白、边缘微糙、行笔有速度感，长横与下坠笔画跨过背景空间，像把情绪直接写进场景；其下保留一片开阔、安静、可呼吸的主题场域，远处水平层次清楚，中轴有一条通向深处的路径或视觉引导线。中部嵌入一块边界干净的矩形影像层，内容与主题主叙事形成时间或记忆的回看，像一帧被放置在现实场景中的片段；下方安排较小的主题人物、物件或象征角色从背面进入画面，成为尺度与叙事入口。信息文字保持克制：右上用细字排出时间地点类信息并以短线或箭头建立阅读停顿，底部用优雅衬线或细体字、细横线和姓名/主题名形成典礼感，文字不是说明牌，而是和影像共同构成节奏。色彩从主题自身的环境、材质、季节与情绪中提取，保留大面积清透低饱和背景、少量高明度白色书写信息、清晰深色结构和局部温度差，整体清透安静、带冷静通风感；即使主题需要更深颜色，也要保持干净色阶、清晰边缘和透明层次，避免浑浊旧化。最终质感应像真实摄影与手写书法叠合，层次分明、留白有呼吸、仪式感强，第一眼读到巨大手写情绪，第二眼进入中部影像和下方叙事。


——————
画面方向: 海边婚礼邀请函，保留远海、堤岸通向深处和手写欢迎语的仪式感
发朋友圈用: 新人婚礼预告和宾客邀请，信息保持时间、地点、姓名三类即可
尺寸: 竖版 3:4，中部照片层换成新人牵手走向海边的回忆画面

items.title: 电影感婚宴邀请视觉设计 柔焦影像背景加中心囍字

prompts.text:
Generate a cinematic invitation visual based on specific theme content: use a real, soft-focus theme image with environmental depth as a large-area background. The background should not steal the show, only providing hazy space, natural texture, and a quiet atmosphere; the main character or theme subject is placed in the lower-center part of the frame, remaining clear, intimate, and carrying a sense of commemoration, as if captured in a live moment. Overlap a theme symbol or calligraphic mark with the greatest visual weight on the central axis of the frame, significantly larger than other information, with heavy strokes and handwritten power, slightly pressing into the space between the background and the subject, becoming the ritual core remembered at first glance; above or around it, intersperse slender, elegant English italics, smaller explanatory text, and a line of relaxed handwritten short sentences. The text should look as if floating in the air, mainly in white or a bright informational color derived from the theme, with relaxed letter spacing and a clear hierarchy. Place a compact date and location information block in a bottom corner, forming a reading path from the top invitation, central symbol, emotional short sentence, to the signature information. Extract colors from the emotions, scenes, and cultural semantics of the theme itself: use large areas of low-saturation, medium-low brightness environmental colors for the background/base field; the subject retains clean light and dark contrast; text uses clear high-brightness informational colors; the central symbol uses a small area of high-saturation emotional emphasis color; the overall feel remains transparent, soft, solemn yet festive, with clean light and dark layers and concentrated emphasis colors, avoiding muddy or aged effects. The final texture is a real photo overlaid with exquisite graphic typography, with fine grain, shallow depth of field, soft light, and restrained information density, possessing both a sense of live memory and a sense of order for a formal invitation.

——————
Invitation scenario: Wedding photo under tree shade or by the lakeside, still with a soft-focus image background plus a central large "Xi" (Double Happiness) character.
For guests: A wedding invitation image for private WeChat messages or group chats, the atmosphere is formal but intimate.
Requirements to keep: Names of the couple, wedding date, and hotel hall information must be clearly readable, vertical version 9:16
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
围绕具体主题内容生成一张影像式邀请视觉：以一张真实、柔焦、带环境纵深的主题影像作为大面积背景，背景不抢戏，只提供朦胧空间、自然纹理和安静气氛；主要人物或主题对象放在画面下半部偏中心，保持清晰、亲近、带纪念感，像被现场瞬间捕捉到。画面中轴叠加一个最大视觉权重的主题符号或书法化标记，尺寸明显大于其他信息，笔画厚重、有手写力道，轻微压住背景和主体之间的空间，成为第一眼记住的仪式核心；其上或周围穿插细长优雅的英文斜体、较小字号的说明文字和一行松弛的手写短句，文字像漂浮在空气里，白色或主题派生的明亮信息色为主，字距舒展，层级清楚，底部一角放置紧凑日期地点信息块，形成从顶部邀请语、中心符号、情绪短句到落款信息的阅读路径。色彩从主题自身的情绪、场景和文化语义中提取：背景/base field 使用大面积低饱和、中低明度的环境色，主体保留干净的明暗对比，文字使用清晰高明度信息色，中心符号使用小面积但高饱和的情绪强调色；整体保持清透、柔和、庄重而有喜气，明暗层次干净，强调色集中，不做浑浊旧化。最终质感为真实照片叠加精致平面排版，微颗粒、浅景深、柔和光线、信息密度克制，既有现场记忆感，也有正式邀请的秩序感。


——————
邀请场景：树荫下或湖边的婚纱照，仍是柔焦影像背景加中心大囍字
给宾客看：用于微信私发或群发的婚礼邀请图，氛围正式但亲近
保留要求：新人姓名、婚礼日期、酒店全厅信息清晰可读，竖版 9:16

items.title: 手绘线描婚礼预告请柬设计

prompts.text:
Generate a personal, commemorative, and ritualistic informational image around any theme: The composition uses a large area of bright, clear, and clean light-colored background as a breathing space, retaining subtle paper fibers and soft grains, but the overall look must not appear old or muddy; the center consists of simple monochromatic hand-drawn lines forming two main supporting characters, whose bodies remain as light line drawings, making the high-held photo frames, cards, or theme containers the visual focus, with real image fragments directly related to the theme embedded inside the frames, making the images look like solemnly displayed memory faces; a smaller theme symbol carrier is added below, lifting a secondary image or symbol, forming an intimate, humorous, and layered three-point relationship. The periphery is wrapped with a continuous, slightly irregular hand-drawn line to create a relaxed border, with small loops, bends, and theme-derived small icons in parts, making the border look like a casually drawn celebration clue rather than a hard decoration. Text is the core of the structure, using a stable and clear main title and a soft cursive subtitle at the top, a ritualistic phrase in the largest font size in the lower-middle part, and then smaller text to carry descriptions and date information; the font rhythm switches between formal and handwritten styles, with loose character spacing and ample white space, the reading path entering from the top information to the central image, then landing on the key text below. Colors are extracted from the theme's own material, emotion, and cultural signals, mapped to a high-brightness background color, a single clear structural line color, a small amount of theme emphasis color, and low-interference texture color; maintain the area relationship of a large light-bright background, a small amount of saturated lines and image color blocks, the overall feel is warm, intimate, bright, brisk, clean, and airy, with emphasis colors only serving line frames, text, and small icons. The final product should look like a carefully typeset hand-drawn commemorative invitation, with both the private evidence of real images and the relaxed sense of ritual brought by illustration lines, avoiding complex backgrounds, heavy shadows, cluttered decorations, and over-realistic figures.

——————
Want to replace with: A wedding preview invitation for a new couple, retaining the intimate structure of the two newlyweds holding a photo frame and a pet holding a small photo.
For posting on Moments: To notify friends and family to save the date for the wedding, text can include Save the Date, the names of the two newlyweds, and the wedding date.
Layout requirements: Vertical version 9:16, light and bright white space background, reddish-brown monochromatic line drawing, photo areas are clear as if solemnly displayed.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
围绕任意主题对象生成一张带私人纪念感与仪式感的信息图像：画面以大面积明亮、清透、干净的轻质底色作为呼吸场，保留细微纸面纤维和柔和颗粒，但整体不能显旧或浑浊；中心由简洁单色手绘线条构成两个主要承托角色，角色身体保持轻盈线描，只让他们高举的相框、卡片或主题容器成为视觉焦点，框内嵌入与主题直接相关的真实影像片段，使影像像被郑重展示的记忆面孔；下方加入一个更小的主题符号承托者，托起次级影像或象征物，形成亲密、幽默、层次分明的三点关系。外围用一根连续、略不规则的手绘线绕出松弛边界，局部带小环、小弯和主题派生的小图标，让边框像随手画出的庆祝线索而不是硬质装饰。文字是结构核心，上方使用稳重清晰的主标题和轻柔连笔副标题，中下部放最大字号的仪式性短语，再用较小文字承接说明与日期信息；字体节奏在端正与手写感之间切换，字距宽松，留白充足，阅读路径从顶部信息进入中心影像，再落到下方关键文字。色彩从主题自身的材质、情绪和文化信号中提取，映射为高明度底色、单一清晰结构线色、少量主题强调色和低干扰纹理色；保持大面积浅亮底、少量饱和线条与影像色块的面积关系，整体温暖亲近、明亮轻快、洁净通风，强调色只服务于线框、文字和小图标。成品应像一张被精心排版的手绘纪念请柬，既有真实影像的私人证据，又有插画线条带来的轻松仪式感，避免复杂背景、厚重阴影、杂乱装饰和过度写实人物。


——————
想替换成：一张新人婚礼预告请柬，保留两位新人举相框和宠物托小照片的亲密结构
发朋友圈用：通知亲友预留婚礼日期，文字可以写 Save the Date、两位新人姓名和婚期
版式要求：竖版 9:16，浅亮留白背景，红棕单色线描，照片区域清晰像被郑重展示

items.title: 九宫格清爽手账涂鸦摄影拼贴

prompts.text: Generate a 9-grid photo collage around any subject or theme, featuring the same main protagonist in nine equidistant cells appearing in continuous different states. The first impression of the image should be light, bright, and like life moments 're-lit' like scrapbook doodles. Each cell retains a realistic photographic feel and natural light, with the subject occupying a clear visual center, and rhythmic changes in posture, angle, and distance. The background remains wide, clean, and airy, with thin white borders forming a refreshing order between cells. Use high-brightness white hand-drawn lines as the core graphic mechanism running through the entire image: lines grow around the subject's outline, gestures, action trajectories, and empty background spaces, forming hearts, arcs, glints, ripples, short lines, bubbles, short onomatopoeic words, or theme-derived symbols; these doodles should look as if drawn on the spot, yet accurately interact with the subject's movements, emphasizing both expressions and action peaks while filling blanks and creating a reading rhythm. Colors are extracted from the theme's own textures, environment, and emotions, maintaining the role relationship of a large-area bright and airy base color, medium-brightness color blocks for the subject, and a small amount of clear accent colors with white information lines; the overall high brightness, refreshing saturation, clean warm-cold relationships, and bright, light, transparent, and energetic mood, avoiding muddiness, vintage gray-yellow, or dull dark tones. The final effect should be like a set of themed memory slices connected by unified white line graffiti, authentic, close, and lively, with nine cells standing on their own while together forming a continuous visual rhythm.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text: 围绕任意主题对象生成一组九宫格照片式拼贴，让同一主题主角在九个等距分格中以不同状态连续出现，画面第一眼读到的是轻快、明亮、像手账涂鸦一样被重新“点亮”的生活瞬间。每一格都保留真实摄影感与自然光，主体占据清晰视觉中心，姿态、角度和远近有节奏变化，背景保持开阔、干净、空气感强，分格之间用细白边形成清爽秩序。用高明度白色手绘线条作为贯穿全图的核心图形机制：线条围绕主体轮廓、手势、动作轨迹和背景空处生长，形成爱心、弧线、闪光、波纹、短线、气泡、简短拟声字或主题派生符号；这些涂鸦要像现场随手画上去，却与主体动作准确互动，既强调表情和动作峰值，也填补空白并制造阅读节奏。色彩从主题自身的材质、环境和情绪中提取，保持大面积明亮通风底色、主体中等明度色块、少量清晰强调色与白色信息线条的角色关系；整体高明度、饱和度清爽、冷暖关系干净，情绪明亮轻快、清透有活力，避免浑浊、复古灰黄或沉闷暗调。最终效果应像一组被统一白线涂鸦串联起来的主题记忆切片，真实、亲近、活泼，九格各自成立又共同形成连续的视觉节奏。
prompts.label: 中文提示词

items.title: 极简东方水彩水果幻想概念海报

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese concept poster, which must be a finished poster with Chinese typography already completed.

The scene is a minimalist white background with a large area of white space. The main subject is a giant [Fruit Slice], occupying the bottom and right side of the frame, like a walkable fantasy terrain. The fruit texture should be translucent, soft, clear, with watercolor diffusion, glassiness, juice-like feel, fine pulp texture, soft highlights, and slight grain.

Place a very small Eastern ink-style figure on the edge of the fruit, wearing light-colored robes and holding a red paper umbrella, standing on the curved edge of the fruit slice, as if roaming in a giant fruit world. The character should be very small to create a scale contrast and not distract from the main subject.

Add floating transparent bubbles, water droplets, and a thin red curve stretching from the fruit edge towards the top of the frame, creating a light, ascending, dreamlike visual movement.

Add the Chinese title "[Main Title]" at the bottom of the frame, using an elegant, restrained, and Eastern-style Chinese font. Add a small subtitle "[Subtitle]" below the title. Add small descriptive text at the very bottom: "Concept Poster / Fruit Fantasy Series".

Overall style: minimalist, clean, white space, watercolor feel, transparent pulp, Eastern miniature figures, fantasy poster, light, poetic, high-end, suitable for social media distribution.

No cartoon, no 3D, no e-commerce ads, no complex backgrounds, no English dominance, no watermarks, no real logos, no gibberish.

Replaceable variables:

[Fruit Slice]: Grapefruit / Pomegranate / Peach / Blood Orange / Watermelon / Lychee / Pomelo / Dragon Fruit

[Main Title]: Grapefruit Light Roaming / Seed Fantasy / Soft Peach Distance / Light Walk on Fruit / Watermelon Sunny Day / Lychee Path / Pulp Dreamscape

[Subtitle]: Let imagination bloom in the soft pulp. / Every pomegranate seed is a glowing dream. / Some sweetness is meant to be gently dreamed of. / Walking softly, the world begins to flower.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
生成一张竖版 3:4 的中文概念海报，必须是一张已经完成中文排版的成品海报。

画面为极简白色背景，大面积留白。主体是一片巨大的【水果切面】，占据画面下方和右侧，像一个可以行走的幻想地形。水果质感要半透明、柔软、清透，有水彩扩散、玻璃感、果汁感、细腻果肉纹理、柔和高光和轻微颗粒。

在水果边缘放置一个很小的东方水墨风人物，人物穿浅色长袍，撑一把红色纸伞，站在水果切面的弧形边缘上，像在一个巨大的水果世界里漫游。人物要很小，用来形成尺度对比，不要抢主体。

prompts.text:
Premium minimal flat-vector travel poster for [CITY_NAME], 3:4 vertical.

[CITY_NAME]
[Short elegant English caption matching the city mood]

Create a soft premium stationery-style city travel poster with a clean, airy, high-end postcard mood.

BACKGROUND RULE:
Use a clean white or near-white background.
Keep the upper-left typography area mostly pure white and spacious.
Do not use peach, beige, cream, warm tinted background wash, or paper-like background color.
Warm tones may appear only in architecture, flowers, clothing, café details, and small objects.

CITY ADAPTATION:
Automatically adapt the scene to [CITY_NAME].
Use one iconic primary landmark as the main visual anchor in the middle or background.
Add local architecture, a small café or street-side shop, a local transport sign, a slim street lamp, trees, flower pots, and a few refined city-specific details.
Optional secondary landmark may appear very small and subtle in the far background, but it must not compete with the primary landmark.
Avoid landmark collage or overly dense city elements.

PEOPLE:
Use only 3–5 people.
Show small natural daily-life moments:
two people talking at a café table,
one person walking quietly,
one person taking a photo,
and optionally one person sketching or jogging.
Avoid crowds.
Avoid a single hero character.

COMPOSITION:
Keep large clean white negative space in the upper-left.
Place the main landmark clearly in the middle-to-background.
Place the café or local shop on one side.
Keep the scene simple, balanced, spacious, and uncluttered.
Avoid filling the top area with too many branches, clouds, birds, flowers, or decorative elements.

Soft stationery illustration aesthetic,
premium sticker illustration,
minimal flat-vector poster,

flat colors only,
rounded forms,
tiny dot eyes,
simple facial features,
elegant graphic balance.

calm,
refined,
romantic,
clean,
premium travel postcard,
greeting card,
wall art,
book-cover,
lifestyle branding.

It should feel elegant, poetic, simple, and city-specific.
Avoid clichés, exclamation marks, and tourist brochure language.

No realism.

No painterly effects.
No gradients.
No shading.

prompts.text:
Create a delicate contemporary Japanese lifestyle illustration with a cozy slice-of-life atmosphere.

ART STYLE
Hand-drawn pen-and-ink sketch illustration, thin expressive linework, loose imperfect contours, minimalist editorial artwork, soft watercolor washes, subtle paper texture, elegant negative space, sketchbook aesthetic, modern Japanese indie illustration, light and airy composition, contemporary café-art style, emotionally warm and intimate.

CHARACTERS
Two young adults with soft, simplified facial features and natural expressions. Casual oversized clothing, relaxed body language, authentic interaction, candid everyday moment. Faces are minimally rendered with delicate linework rather than detailed realism.

ENVIRONMENT
A cozy indoor setting such as a café, coffee shop, apartment, studio, bookstore, kitchen corner, or creative workspace. Include wooden furniture, coffee mugs, indoor plants, shelves, books, windows, soft decorative details, and small everyday objects. The environment should feel lived-in yet uncluttered.

COMPOSITION
Full-body or three-quarter-body view. Characters seated naturally and facing one another. Balanced asymmetrical layout. Large areas of clean negative space. Storytelling through posture and atmosphere rather than action. Editorial illustration framing. Eye-level perspective.

COLOR PALETTE
Muted and desaturated colors only:
• Dusty blue
• Warm cream
• Soft beige
• Light gray
• Sage green
• Warm brown
• Off-white

Add only one small accent color element such as red socks, red shoes, a red mug, or a small red object.

LIGHTING
Soft natural daylight entering through windows. Gentle ambient illumination. No dramatic shadows. Warm, peaceful, calming mood.

RENDERING
Minimal shading. Sparse details. Watercolor-style color fills inside delicate ink outlines. Slightly unfinished sketch quality. High-quality illustration with visible hand-drawn imperfections. Soft edges and subtle texture.

MOOD
Comfortable, quiet, nostalgic, peaceful, intimate, cozy, everyday happiness, slow living, café culture, thoughtful conversation, gentle human connection.

AVOID
Anime screenshots, manga panels, cel shading, digital painting, hyperrealism, photorealism, 3D rendering, glossy surfaces, vibrant saturated colors, cinematic effects, dramatic lighting, excessive details, sharp outlines, heavy shadows, complex backgrounds.

SCENE:
[INSERT YOUR SCENE DESCRIPTION HERE]

The final image should feel like a premium Japanese lifestyle illustration found in an art book, café magazine, design journal, or independent sketchbook collection.

prompts.text:
创建一个细腻的现代日系生活方式插画，带有温馨的生活片段氛围。

艺术风格
手绘钢笔素描插画，细腻且富有表现力的线条，松散不完美的轮廓，极简社论艺术作品，柔和的水彩晕染，细微的纸张纹理，优雅的负空间，写生簿美学，现代日本独立插画，轻盈通透的构图，现代咖啡馆艺术风格，情感温暖且亲密。

人物
两名具有柔和、简化面部特征和自然表情的年轻人。穿着休闲的廓形服装，放松的身体语言，真实的互动，真实的日常生活瞬间。面部以细腻的线条进行极简渲染，而非详细的写实。

环境
一个舒适的室内环境，如咖啡馆、咖啡店、公寓、工作室、书店、厨房角落或创意工作空间。包括木制家具、咖啡杯、室内植物、书架、书籍、窗户、柔软的装饰细节和日常小物件。环境应该感觉有生活气息但又不杂乱。

构图
全身或四分之三全身视角。人物自然坐着，面对面。平衡的不对称布局。大面积干净的负空间。通过姿势和氛围而非动作进行叙事。社论插画构图。平视透视。

调色板
仅限柔和且低饱和度的颜色：
• 灰蓝色
• 暖奶油色
• 柔和米色
• 浅灰色
• 鼠尾草绿

光影

极简阴影。稀疏细节。细腻墨水轮廓内的水彩风格填充。略带未完成感的素描质感。带有可见手绘不完美感的高质量插画。柔和的边缘和细微的纹理。

情绪
舒适、安静、怀旧、和平、亲密、温馨、日常幸福、慢生活、咖啡馆文化、深思熟虑的交谈、温柔的人际连接。

避免
动漫截图、漫画画格、赛璐璐阴影、数码绘画、超写实、照片写实、3D渲染、光泽表面、鲜艳饱和的颜色、电影效果、戏剧性光影、过度细节、锋利轮廓、沉重阴影、复杂背景。

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 vertical minimalist white background watercolor character art poster, the theme character is [Raiden Shogun]. 

Overall, it is a high-end artistic character collection poster, with a clean, transparent style and ample white space, but the colors must have obvious tension. The background is pure white or warm white, with a delicate and realistic watercolor paper texture, like high-quality art print works. The picture should not have complex scenes, no real-life backgrounds, no multiple characters, and the focus is on the character, watercolor, color splashes, white space, and bottom typography.

The subject is a highly recognizable anime art redraw version of [Raiden Shogun]. Please automatically identify and retain the character's most representative visual features, including the iconic hairstyle, hair color, eyes, main clothing colors, classic accessories, representative weapons or props, as well as the character's own identity and temperament. The character must be instantly recognizable. 

The character is located in the center of the picture, displayed as a single person, using a full-body or near full-body composition, with the character occupying about 60%~75% of the frame height. The focus is on a watercolor character poster with a sense of design, rather than a complete character setting diagram. The character does not need to stand completely on the ground, nor is it required to draw the feet completely. The face, facial features, hairstyle, upper body, key clothing structures, core accessories, and representative props remain clear and exquisite; the lower body, skirt hem, cloak, clothing hem, leg ends, shoes, hair ends, weapon ends, and character outer contours can naturally dissolve, be missing, blur, and merge into watercolor smudging, pigment diffusion, ink splashing, wet edge effects, and the sense of white space breaking.

Watercolor must participate in the character modeling itself, rather than just being an external special effect. Local structures can be completed through transparent color stacking, white space, omission, edge dissipation, irregular ink splashing, wet painting marks, dry brush textures, and pigment deposition. Let the character be shaped from the white paper by watercolor, ink, and pigment blocks together.

Color rules:

Do not limit the screen to the character's own inherent colors. Please automatically analyze the representative colors of [Raiden Shogun] and establish a more contrasting artistic poster color scheme. Use a three-layer color structure overall: 

First layer: Character main color, about 50%. Used to ensure character recognition, from the character's most representative hair color, clothing color, weapon color, and identity color.

Second layer: Dark pressure color, about 15%. Automatically choose dark colors suitable for the character's temperament, such as deep indigo, Prussian blue, ink black, deep purple, wine red, dark brown, grey-blue, dark cyan. Dark colors are used for the inside of the character's body, clothing shadows, weapon edges, lower body dissipation areas, and large ink splash areas, so that the screen has thickness and weight, and is not too light or pale.

Third layer: High-saturation jump colors, about 35%. Obvious high-saturation jump colors that do not completely belong to the character itself must be added to create the strong watercolor art sense of the original reference image. Jump colors can be bolder, but cannot destroy character recognition. Jump colors preferentially choose colors that form a beautiful contrast with the character's main color.

Jump color selection logic:
If the character's main color is cool, such as blue, white, silver, black, purple, the jump colors can include magenta, rose red, coral red, warm orange, champagne gold, and a small amount of yellow-green.
If the character's main color is warm, such as red, orange, gold, brown, pink, the jump colors can include cobalt blue, cyan-blue, blue-purple, mint green, cold cyan, and a small amount of bright purple.
If the character's main color is green or natural, the jump colors can include lavender, rose pink, warm yellow, champagne gold, and a small amount of lake blue or coral.
If the character's main color is dark, the jump colors can include bright blue, magenta, gold, turquoise, pale pink, or orange-red.
If the character's main color is relatively single, at least two jump colors must be added to form a richer watercolor rhythm.

Ways to use jump colors:
Jump colors should not just be small scattered dots, nor should they be spread evenly. They need to appear with a sense of design as:
1. 2~4 medium-sized transparent color blocks or pigment smudges;
2. Several small-area high-saturation splash points;
3. Local color stacking in character edges, clothing hems, hair tails, weapon edges, and lower body dissipation areas;
4. One or two obvious color burst points used to break the monotony.

Jump colors are mainly placed on the periphery of the character, the lower body watercolorized area, the ends of hair strands, clothing edges, weapon edges, the ends of cloaks or skirts, and ink dot splashes around the body. The face, eyes, and core identification features remain clean and clear, and do not let jump colors pollute the facial features.

Watercolor texture:
Transparent watercolor, ink splashing, gouache-like thick color blocks, pigment deposition, wet edge smudging, dry brush texture, paper surface particles, local high-saturation staining, dark ink blocks, and colored splashes. The screen should have the transparency of watercolor, and also have a small amount of gouache / ink wash thick color blocks, forming a texture similar to art mixed media illustration. Do not make the whole too light, do not be too monochromatic, do not only do soft watercolor.

Composition requirements:
The character is centered and slightly upward, with sufficient typesetting space reserved at the bottom. The character's posture is automatically selected by the model according to the character's personality, which can be standing quietly, slightly sideways, staring with head down, holding a weapon, preparing for battle, looking back elegantly, bowing head gently, or a micro-dynamic freeze-frame. The posture should conform to the character's temperament and serve the direction of the watercolor splashes. Splashes should form a rhythm around the character's movements: some close to the body, some scattering outward, and some naturally dripping or dissipating below.

Bottom layout:
Automatically write the most common and standard English name of the character in the bottom center of the picture, using an elegant and high-end serif font, with a generous weight and stretched letter spacing, and the color extracted from the character's main color, dark pressure color, and jump colors, with a slight watercolor gradient texture.
Below the English name, automatically generate a short line of English subtitle that fits the character's identity and temperament, using a one-size-smaller italic serif font, literary, restrained, and high-end.
Below that, add an extremely thin horizontal line with a small decorative symbol in the middle.
Near the horizontal line, fixedly add a small text watermark: "X.com/@0xkyne".
In the bottom right corner, add a very small handwritten artistic signature: "0xkyne".

Overall effect:
Minimalist white background, high-end watercolor paper texture, strong character recognition, character partially watercolorized and dissipated, colors with obvious contrast and jump colors, both the lightness of transparent watercolor and the sense of weight of ink and gouache thick color blocks. The screen should be bolder than ordinary monochromatic watercolor, have a stronger sense of artistic poster design, and be closer to a collection-grade character art printing work.

prompts.text:
制作一张 9:16 竖版极简白底水彩角色艺术海报，主题角色为【雷电将军】。 

整体是一张高级艺术感角色收藏海报，风格干净、通透、留白充足，但色彩必须有明显张力。背景为纯白或暖白色，带细腻真实的水彩纸纹理，像高质量艺术印刷作品。画面不要复杂场景，不要实景背景，不要多人物，重点集中在角色、水彩、色彩飞溅、留白和底部排版。

主体为【雷电将军】的高辨识度动漫艺术重绘版本。请自动识别并保留该角色最具代表性的视觉特征，包括标志性发型、发色、眼睛、服装主色、经典配饰、代表性武器或道具，以及角色本身的身份感和气质。角色必须一眼可辨。 

人物位于画面中央，单人展示，采用全身感或接近全身感构图，人物占画面高度约 60%~75%。重点是具有设计感的水彩人物海报，而不是完整角色设定图。人物不需要完整落地站立，也不要求完整画出双脚。脸部、五官、发型、上半身、关键服装结构、核心配饰和代表性道具保持清晰精致；下半身、裙摆、披风、衣摆、腿部末端、鞋子、头发末端、武器末端和人物外轮廓，可以自然溶解、缺失、虚化，融入水彩晕染、颜料扩散、泼墨飞溅、湿边效果和留白断裂感之中。

水彩必须参与人物造型本身，而不是只作为外部特效。局部结构可以通过透明叠色、留白、省略、边缘消散、不规则泼墨、湿画法痕迹、干刷纹理和颜料沉积来完成。让角色像从白纸上被水彩、墨彩和颜料块共同塑造出来。

色彩规则：

不要把画面限制在角色本身的固有配色里。请自动分析【雷电将军】的代表性色彩，并建立更有反差的艺术海报配色。整体使用三层色彩结构： 

第一层：角色主色，约 50%。 
用于保证角色辨识度，来自角色本身最具代表性的发色、服装色、武器色和身份色。

第二层：深色压色，约 15%。 
自动选择适合角色气质的深色，例如深靛蓝、普鲁士蓝、墨黑、深紫、酒红、暗棕、灰蓝、暗青。深色用于人物身体内部、服装阴影、武器边缘、下半身消散区和大块泼墨区域，让画面有厚度、有重量，不要过于浅淡。

第三层：高饱和跳色，约 35%。 
必须加入明显不完全属于角色本身的高饱和跳色，用来制造原版参考图那种强烈水彩艺术感。跳色可以更大胆，但不能破坏角色识别。跳色优先选择与角色主色形成漂亮反差的颜色。

跳色选择逻辑：
如果角色主色偏冷，例如蓝、白、银、黑、紫，跳色可加入洋红、玫红、珊瑚红、暖橙、香槟金、少量黄绿。
如果角色主色偏暖，例如红、橙、金、棕、粉，跳色可加入钴蓝、青蓝、蓝紫、薄荷绿、冷青色、少量亮紫。
如果角色主色偏绿或自然系，跳色可加入淡紫、玫粉、暖黄、香槟金、少量湖蓝或珊瑚色。
如果角色主色偏暗，跳色可加入亮蓝、洋红、金色、青绿、淡粉或橙红。
如果角色主色较单一，必须加入至少两种跳色，形成更丰富的水彩节奏。

跳色使用方式：
跳色不要只做很小的零星点缀，也不要平均撒满。需要有设计感地出现为：
1. 2~4 处中等大小的透明色块或颜料晕染；
2. 若干小面积高饱和飞溅点；
3. 人物边缘、衣摆、发尾、武器边缘、下半身消散区里的局部叠色；
4. 一两处明显的色彩爆点，用来打破单调。

跳色主要放在人物外围、下半身水彩化区域、发丝末端、服装边缘、武器边缘、披风或裙摆尾端、身体周围的墨点飞溅中。脸部、眼睛、核心识别特征附近保持干净清晰，不要让跳色污染五官。

水彩质感：
透明水彩、墨彩泼溅、水粉感厚色块、颜料沉积、湿边晕染、干刷纹理、纸面颗粒、局部高饱和染色、深色墨块、彩色飞溅。画面要有水彩的通透感，也要有少量 gouache / ink wash 的厚重色块，形成类似艺术混合媒介插画的质感。不要整体太淡，不要过于单色，不要只做柔和水彩。

构图要求：
人物居中偏上，底部保留足够排版空间。角色姿态由模型根据角色性格自动选择，可以是安静站立、轻微侧身、低头凝视、持武器、战斗准备、优雅回眸、温柔垂首或微动态定格。姿态要符合角色气质，并服务于水彩飞溅方向。飞溅要围绕人物动作形成节奏：一部分贴近身体，一部分向外散开，一部分在下方自然滴落或消散。

底部排版：
在画面底部中央自动写出该角色最常见、最标准的英文名，使用优雅高级的 serif 字体，字重大方，字距舒展，颜色从角色主色、深色压色和跳色中提取，带轻微水彩渐变质感。
英文名下方自动生成一行简短、贴合角色身份与气质的英文副标题，使用小一号斜体 serif 字体，文艺、克制、高级。
再下方加入一条极细横线，中间配一个小型装饰符号。
横线附近固定加入小号文字水印：“
http://
X.com/@0xkyne”。
右下角加入一个很小的手写感艺术签名：“0xkyne”。

整体效果：
极简白底，高级水彩纸质感，角色辨识度强，人物局部水彩化消散，色彩有明显反差和跳色，既有透明水彩的轻盈，也有墨彩和水粉厚色块的重量感。画面要比普通单色水彩更大胆、更有艺术海报设计感、更接近收藏级角色艺术印刷作品。

prompts.text: Create a high-quality **flat vector illustration in a modern kawaii/chibi anime style**, faithfully recreating the composition, perspective, and warm color palette of a reference portrait. Depict a young woman in a close-up, slightly low-angle view, gently tilting her head downward toward the viewer while resting her chin on her left hand in a relaxed, thoughtful pose. She has large expressive dark brown eyes with long eyelashes, subtle winged eyeliner, neatly shaped brows, soft rosy blush across her cheeks and nose, and glossy pink lips with a slight pout. She wears thick oval tortoiseshell prescription glasses featuring a brown-and-gold mottled pattern with small metallic accents on the frame corners. Her dark brown hair is sleek, center-parted, and pulled back neatly, revealing a small gold hoop earring. Dress her in a cozy taupe-brown ribbed V-neck knit sweater with visible vertical knit texture and a light brown leather bag strap crossing diagonally over one shoulder. Place her in a simplified indoor setting with warm olive-green and beige walls, cream ceiling molding, a window with subtle grid panes, a soft brown curtain, and a dark doorway frame. Enhance the scene with whimsical white doodle overlays including sparkles, tiny hearts, floral vines, leaves, musical notes, and playful motion lines, creating a charming scrapbook aesthetic. Use warm earthy tones such as terracotta, taupe, sage green, cream, and soft brown, illuminated by gentle ambient indoor lighting. The artwork should feature crisp clean vector linework, smooth color fills, subtle shading, polished digital illustration quality, cute anime-inspired proportions, and a cozy, dreamy, aesthetically pleasing atmosphere.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text: 创建一个高质量的平面矢量插画，采用现代卡哇伊/Q版二次元风格，忠实地再现参考肖像的构图、透视和温暖色调。描绘一名年轻女性的特写、略带低角度的视图，她轻轻地向观众低头，同时将下巴靠在左手上，呈现出放松、沉思的姿势。她拥有富有表现力的大深褐色眼睛，长睫毛，微妙的翼状眼线，整齐的眉毛，脸颊和鼻子上涂着柔软的玫瑰色腮红，以及微微嘟起的亮粉色嘴唇。她戴着厚厚的椭圆形玳瑁色近视眼镜，镜框呈现棕色和金色的斑驳图案，镜框角落有微小的金属点缀。她的深褐色头发光滑、中分并整齐地向后梳，露出一个小金环耳环。让她穿着一件舒适的灰褐色罗纹V领针织毛衣，带有可见的垂直针织纹理，一条浅褐色皮革包带斜跨在一个肩膀上。将她置于一个简化的室内环境中，墙壁为温暖的橄榄绿和米色，带有奶油色的天花板装饰线条，一扇带有微妙格子窗格的窗户，一个柔软的棕色窗帘，以及一个深色的门框。使用奇妙的白色涂鸦叠加层来增强场景，包括闪光、小爱心、花藤、叶子、音符和俏皮的动作线条，营造出迷人的剪贴簿美感。使用温暖的土色调，如赤陶色、灰褐色、鼠草绿、奶油色和柔和的棕色，由柔和的室内环境照明照亮。艺术作品应具有清晰干净的矢量线条、平滑的色彩填充、微妙的阴影、精致的数字插画质量、可爱的动漫风格比例，以及舒适、梦幻、审美愉悦的氛围。

prompts.text:
Generate a bright and clear Oriental print-style image based on any subject: translate the core form of the subject into several soft, circular petal-like main shapes of varying sizes, the main shapes like transparent rubbings lightly pressed onto the paper surface, edges with subtle grains and printing white gaps, the interior opening with a radial white negative shape, forming a visual moment of first reading the glowing center and then the colored outline. The screen uses a large area of clean light background as a structural field, the subject naturally spreads from one side to the center of the screen, leaving plenty of breathing space; derived twigs, leaves, linear connectors, or attached symbols of the theme travel between the main shapes, bearing rhythm and direction without seizing the glowing negative shapes. Colors are extracted from the theme's own material, season, cultural mood, or narrative semantics, mapped as high-brightness base color, light transparent main color, small amount of clear support color, slender information color, and minimal area emphasis color, maintaining a relationship of bright and light, clean and airy, and clear color gradients; colors can change with the theme, but always maintain a large area of light background, moderate saturation main body, clear warm-cool contrast, local clear emphasis, and a sense of cleanliness without muddy coverage. If adding text, use slender, orderly Oriental text layout as a quiet information layer close to the white space area, keeping distance from the main body, text color comes from the theme's emphasis role, restrained rhythm, stretched character spacing. The whole presents the texture of handmade screen printing and paper rubbing, light grain, soft light feeling, non-rigid borders, the focus is on the white starlight negative shape in the transparent color blocks and the light growth rhythm unfolding around it.

——————
Screen changed to: A summer greeting poster composed of morning glory flowers and vines, maintaining a bright floral shadow print feel. For WeChat Moments: suitable for sending a refreshing summer blessing picture, no complex copywriting. Retain text: write "Summer Peace", small characters can write "Breeze and Flower Shadows". Size: Vertical 9:10.

prompts.text:
围绕任意主题对象生成一张明亮清透的东方版画感图像：把主题的核心形态转译为数个大小错落的柔软圆瓣状主形体，主形体像轻压在纸面上的透明拓印，边缘带细微颗粒和印刷漏白，内部以放射状白色负形打开，形成先读到发光中心、再读到彩色轮廓的视觉瞬间。画面以大面积洁净浅底作为结构场，主体从一侧向画面中心自然蔓延，留下充足呼吸空间；主题派生的细枝、叶片、线性连接物或附着符号在主形体之间穿行，承担节奏与方向，不抢占发光负形。色彩从主题自身的材质、季节、文化情绪或叙事语义中提取，映射为高明度底色、轻透明主体色、少量清晰支撑色、纤细信息色和极小面积强调色，保持明亮轻快、干净通风、色阶清楚的关系；颜色可随主题变化，但始终维持大面积浅亮背景、适中饱和主体、清透冷暖对照、局部清晰强调与无浑浊覆盖的洁净感。若加入文字，使用细长、有秩序的东方文字排布，作为安静的信息层贴近留白区域，与主体保持距离，文字颜色来自主题的强调角色，节奏克制、字距舒展。整体呈现手工丝网印刷与纸面拓印质感，颗粒轻微、光感柔和、边界不僵硬，重点是透明色块中的白色星芒负形和围绕它展开的轻盈生长节奏。


——————
画面想换成：朝颜花与藤蔓组成的夏日问候海报，保持明亮花影版画感
发朋友圈用：适合发一张清爽的夏季祝福图，不要复杂文案
保留文字：写“夏日安好”，小字可写“清风与花影”
尺寸：竖版 9:10

prompts.text: Pixar-style 3D CGI caricature poster celebrating [NATION]'s World Cup 2026 national football team. Feature 3-4 of the team's most iconic current players as charming, exaggerated 3D caricature characters wearing the official nation home kit, big expressive eyes, warm glossy Pixar-quality rendering, dynamic hero poses radiating excitement and team pride. Background uses the nation’s flag colors with a stadium atmosphere, confetti, and subtle World Cup 2026 branding elements. Bold, energetic title text reading '[NATION] WORLD CUP 2026' at the top in a font style matching the team's national colors. Cinematic lighting, vibrant colors, professional sports poster composition, high detail, glossy finish.

prompts.text: 皮克斯风格的 3D CGI 漫画海报，庆祝 [国家] 的 2026 年世界杯国家足球队。以该队 3-4 名最具标志性的现役球员为特色，他们被塑造为迷人的、夸张的 3D 漫画角色，穿着国家队官方主场球衣，大而富有表现力的眼睛，温暖的光泽皮克斯品质渲染，充满活力且散发着兴奋和团队自豪感的英雄姿势。背景使用国家队的国旗颜色，带有体育场氛围、五彩纸屑和微妙的 2026 年世界杯品牌元素。顶部有醒目、充满活力的标题文字，读作“[国家] WORLD CUP 2026”，字体风格与球队的国家颜色相匹配。电影级光效，鲜艳的色彩，专业的运动海报构图，高细节，光泽表面。

prompts.text:
Create a distinctive mascot-style logo that blends modern charm with a touch of nostalgic bakery branding. Display a single logo centered on a clean white background, with no additional graphics or layout elements.
Feature a lovable handcrafted bread loaf character with a soft rounded shape, gentle sleepy eyes, a relaxed smile, subtle baked-texture accents, and miniature baker mitts. The character should communicate warmth, comfort, and homemade quality while maintaining a clean, iconic silhouette that is easy to recognize at any size.
Illustrate the mascot using bold black contour lines, simplified vector-style shapes, and solid color fills. Incorporate a cozy bakery-inspired palette consisting of creamy beige, rich caramel brown, blush pink, and warm golden orange. Include custom lettering that feels playful, rounded, and seamlessly connected to the mascot design rather than appearing separate.
The final logo should balance premium branding with friendly accessibility, offering strong scalability and versatility for bakery packaging, shop signage, labels, social media, uniforms, and merchandise. Aim for a polished, memorable identity with timeless appeal and a subtle retro artisan-bakery atmosphere.

items.title: 超宽横版游戏关卡设定图

prompts.text:
Please generate a [Super Wide Horizontal Game Level Design Map], a single complete image, no puzzles, no multi-grid, no split columns.

Size: Horizontal 3:1.

[Level Theme]: Cyber City / Fantasy Forest / Wasteland Subway Station / Oriental Ancient City / Your own theme
[Scene Style]: Sci-fi / Fantasy / Wasteland / Ancient Style / Steampunk / Urban Adventure
[Gameplay Type]: Parkour / Platform Jumping / Action Adventure / Puzzle Exploration / Side-scrolling Level
[Main Scene Elements]: Fill in platforms, buildings, mechanisms, props, obstacles, background elements
[Tone and Atmosphere]: Fill in main colors and overall atmosphere
[Additional Requirements]: Fill in gameplay or visual focuses you want to emphasize

The overall picture must be a complete horizontal scrolling game level long image, using a horizontally unfolding game level perspective, not a top-down view, not a regular poster, and not just a simple landscape illustration. The focus is to show a truly "playable" horizontal level scene: unfolding continuously from left to right, clearly showing the progression route, platform structure, height differences, jumping points, obstacle areas, mechanism areas, prop points, and visual rhythm.

There must be clear level logic in the picture:
It can include platforms of different heights, bridges, rooftops, tree roots, ruins, carriages, city walls, eaves, ropes, lifting platforms, broken areas, dangerous zones, collectable props, hidden areas, enemy activity zones, mechanical devices, etc.
These elements should form a natural progression relationship rather than being piled up randomly.

Visual layers must be clear:
Foreground is playable platforms and mechanism structures,
Midground is the main scene architecture and routes,
Background is the distant environment used to enhance the world-view and atmosphere.
The whole image should look like a high-quality game concept design map, horizontal platform level map, 2.5D game scene display map.

If it's a Cyber City theme, you can add high-rise roofs, neon signs, air conditioner units, metal platforms, drones, laser obstacles, energy items.
If it's a Fantasy Forest theme, you can add giant trees, tree root platforms, mushroom jump platforms, vine bridges, glowing crystals, ruins, and traps.
If it's a Wasteland Subway theme, you can add abandoned platforms, damaged trains, broken tracks, maintenance channels, electric leaking puddles, supply boxes, and collapsed areas.
If it's an Oriental Ancient City theme, you can add blue tile roofs, flying eaves, city walls, archways, lanterns, bridges, rope points, scroll treasure chests, and mechanical traps.

The overall effect should highlight one core:
The super-wide horizontal image is particularly suitable for carrying a complete horizontal level structure, explaining the path, gameplay, scene, and world-view all in one picture.

Avoid: Top-down view, poster collage feel, multi-grid, lack of route logic, ordinary landscape illustration feel, pure wallpaper feel, messy element stacking, unclear platform relationships, too much irrelevant text, low resolution.

prompts.text:
请生成一张【超宽横版游戏关卡设定图】，单张完整图片，不要拼图，不要多宫格，不要分栏。

尺寸：横版 3:1。

【关卡主题】：赛博都市 / 奇幻森林 / 废土地铁站 / 东方古城 / 你自己的主题
【场景风格】：科幻 / 奇幻 / 废土 / 古风 / 蒸汽朋克 / 城市冒险
【玩法类型】：跑酷 / 平台跳跃 / 动作冒险 / 解谜探索 / 横版卷轴闯关
【主要场景元素】：填写平台、建筑、机关、道具、障碍、背景元素
【色调氛围】：填写主色调和整体氛围
【补充要求】：填写你想强调的玩法或视觉重点

整体画面必须是一张完整的横版卷轴游戏关卡长图，采用横向展开的游戏关卡视角，不是俯视图，不是普通海报，也不是单纯风景插画。重点是表现一个真正“可玩”的横版关卡场景：从左到右连续展开，能够清晰看出推进路线、平台结构、高低差、跳跃点、障碍区、机关区、道具点和视觉节奏。

画面中要有清晰的关卡逻辑：
可以包含不同高度的平台、桥梁、楼顶、树根、遗迹、车厢、城墙、屋檐、绳索、升降平台、断裂区域、危险地带、可收集道具、隐藏区域、敌人活动区、机关装置等。
这些元素要形成自然的推进关系，而不是随意堆砌。

视觉层次要清晰：
前景是可玩的平台和机关结构，
中景是主要场景建筑与路线，
背景是用来增强世界观和氛围的远景环境。
整张图要像高质量游戏概念设定图、横版平台关卡地图、2.5D 游戏场景展示图。

如果是赛博都市主题，可以加入高楼屋顶、霓虹灯牌、空调外机、金属平台、无人机、激光障碍、能量道具。
如果是奇幻森林主题，可以加入巨树、树根平台、蘑菇跳台、藤蔓桥、发光水晶、遗迹和陷阱。
如果是废土地铁主题，可以加入废弃月台、破损列车、轨道断裂、维修通道、漏电水坑、补给箱和坍塌区域。
如果是东方古城主题，可以加入青瓦屋顶、飞檐、城墙、牌楼、灯笼、桥梁、绳索点、卷轴宝箱和机关陷阱。

整体效果要突出一个核心：
超宽横图特别适合承载完整的横版关卡结构，一张图就能把路径、玩法、场景和世界观同时讲清楚。

避免：俯视图、海报拼贴感、多宫格、无路线逻辑、普通风景插画感、纯壁纸感、元素堆砌混乱、平台关系不清、过多无关文字、低清晰度。

prompts.text:
Premium minimal flat-vector travel poster for [CITY_NAME], 3:4 vertical.

Top-left typography:
[CITY_NAME]
[Short elegant English caption matching the city mood]

Create a soft premium stationery-style city travel poster with a clean, airy, high-end postcard mood.

BACKGROUND RULE:
Use a clean white or near-white background.
Keep the upper-left typography area mostly pure white and spacious.
Do not use peach, beige, cream, warm tinted background wash, or paper-like background color.
Warm tones may appear only in architecture, flowers, clothing, café details, and small objects.

CITY ADAPTATION:
Automatically adapt the scene to [CITY_NAME].
Use one iconic primary landmark as the main visual anchor in the middle or background.
Add local architecture, a small café or street-side shop, a local transport sign, a slim street lamp, trees, flower pots, and a few refined city-specific details.
Optional secondary landmark may appear very small and subtle in the far background, but it must not compete with the primary landmark.
Avoid landmark collage or overly dense city elements.

PEOPLE:
Use only 3–5 people.
Show small natural daily-life moments:
two people talking at a café table,
one person walking quietly,
one person taking a photo,
and optionally one person sketching or jogging.
Avoid crowds.
Avoid a single hero character.

COMPOSITION:
Keep large clean white negative space in the upper-left.
Place the main landmark clearly in the middle-to-background.
Place the café or local shop on one side.
Keep the scene simple, balanced, spacious, and uncluttered.
Avoid filling the top area with too many branches, clouds, birds, flowers, or decorative elements.

STYLE:
Soft stationery illustration aesthetic,
premium sticker illustration,
minimal flat-vector poster,
clean thin outlines,
consistent line weight,
flat colors only,
rounded forms,
tiny dot eyes,
simple facial features,
elegant graphic balance.

COLOR PALETTE:
blush pink,
dusty rose,
sage green,
warm cream,
soft beige,
muted gray-green.

Use these colors softly on objects only.
Do not use them as a full background wash.

MOOD:
minimal,
elegant,
calm,
refined,
romantic,
clean,
premium travel postcard,
greeting card,
wall art,
book-cover,
lifestyle branding.

CAPTION RULE:
Generate one short English caption, 3–7 words.
It should feel elegant, poetic, simple, and city-specific.
Avoid clichés, exclamation marks, and tourist brochure language.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
No realism.
No photorealism.
No watercolor.
No painterly effects.
No gradients.
No shading.
No texture.
No peach background.
No beige background wash.
No dense background.
No crowded streets.
No excessive landmark collage.
No overly detailed architecture.

prompts.text:

左上角排版：
[CITY_NAME]
[匹配城市氛围的简短优雅英文标题]

创作一张具有干净、通透、高端明信片氛围的柔和高端文具风格城市旅行海报。

背景规则：
使用干净的白色或近乎白色的背景。
保持左上角的排版区域大部分为纯白色且宽敞。
请勿使用桃红色、米色、奶油色、暖色调背景晕染或类纸质背景色。
暖色调仅可出现在建筑、花卉、服装、咖啡馆细节和小型物品中。

城市适配：
自动将场景适配至 [CITY_NAME]。
使用一个标志性的主要地标作为中部或背景的主要视觉锚点。
加入当地建筑、一家小咖啡馆或路边小店、一个当地交通标志、一盏纤细的路灯、树木、花盆以及一些精致的特定城市细节。
可选的次要地标可以非常微小且微妙地出现在远景中，但绝不能与主要地标竞争。
避免地标堆砌或过于密集的城市元素。

人物：
仅使用 3–5 人。
展示自然的小型日常生活瞬间：
两人在咖啡馆桌旁交谈，
一人静静地行走，
一人正在拍照，
以及可选的一人正在写生或慢跑。
避免拥挤的人群。
避免出现单一的主角人物。

构图：
在左上角保留大量干净的白色留白空间。
将主要地标清晰地放置在中景到背景位置。
将咖啡馆或当地商店放置在侧面。
保持场景简洁、平衡、宽敞且整齐。
避免在顶部区域填充过多的树枝、云朵、鸟类、花卉或装饰元素。

风格：
柔和的文具插画美学，
高端贴纸插画，
极简扁平矢量海报，
干净的细轮廓，
一致的线条粗细，
仅限扁平色，
圆润的形状，
微小的圆点眼睛，
简单的面部特征，
优雅的图形平衡。

配色方案：
腮红粉，
灰粉色，
鼠尾草绿，
暖奶油色，
柔和米色，
柔和的灰绿色。
仅在物体上柔和地使用这些颜色。
请勿将其用作整体背景晕染。

氛围：
极简、优雅、冷静、精致、浪漫、干净、高端旅行明信片、贺卡、墙面艺术、书籍封面、生活方式品牌。

标题规则：
生成一个短小的英文标题，3-7 个单词。
它应该感觉优雅、富有诗意、简洁且具有城市特色。
避免陈词滥调、感叹号和旅游手册用语。

负面提示词：
无写实。无照片写实。无水彩。无绘画效果。无渐变。无阴影。无纹理。无桃红色背景。无米色背景晕染。无密集背景。无拥挤街道。无过度的地标堆砌。无过于复杂的建筑。

She has a black bob haircut, her head is slightly tilted toward her right shoulder, her eyes are closed, and her expression is calm and natural, without any sense of deliberate performance. She is wearing a light blue-gray off-the-shoulder knitted top and an off-white short skirt. Her arms are naturally crossed in front of her, and her legs are naturally together and slightly slanted. Her overall posture is relaxed, as if she has inadvertently fallen asleep due to exhaustion during the train journey. The character's state should be real and restrained, with skin retaining natural texture and real quality, without excessive beautification or skin smoothing, presenting the sense of life of an ordinary mobile phone snapshot. [Second Character and Background Characters] In the middle ground on the left side of the frame, another adult East Asian woman in a window seat is also in a state of sleep. She has long black hair, her head is tilted against the window, her eyes are closed, and she is wearing a white shirt and a dark gray short skirt, sitting quietly in a blue window seat. A black bag is placed beside her as an everyday travel item to enhance realism. An empty seat is kept between the two people, allowing the blue seats to form a clear depth-of-field relationship. A few ordinary passengers are scattered in the back row of the carriage, some partially blocked by seats, existing only as background elements, not overshadowing the main visual center. [Appearance and Outfit] The foreground subject is an adult East Asian woman with an ordinary and real temperament, with a natural appearance, without exaggerated influencer-style modification. Her cold brown bob hairstyle has a slightly natural fluffy feel of daily life. The outfit is simple and daily, a light blue-gray off-the-shoulder knitted top paired with an off-white short skirt, the overall atmosphere is a relaxed, daily, and real travel outfit. The woman in the left middle ground has long black hair, wearing a white shirt and a dark gray short skirt, also maintaining the natural image of an ordinary passenger, without deliberate sexualized presentation. Both characters should reflect the state of tired rest of real East Asian women during a journey, rather than a sense of a posing model. [Environment] The scene is set inside a Chinese high-speed rail second-class carriage. The interior features typical blue fabric seats, each equipped with a white headrest cloth, and real and reasonable seat number text is visible on the wall above. The overall space should be clean, bright, and tidy, with the structure and atmosphere of a real high-speed rail carriage. A blurred platform and urban tracks are visible outside the window as external hints of the high-speed train environment, but they should not be too clear or eye-catching. The entire environment should convey the sense of order and life of a real public transportation space, and no wrong carriage structures or chaotic backgrounds should appear. [Composition Requirements] Adopt a vertical composition, 3:4 ratio, the overall look is like a mobile phone lifestyle photo captured unintentionally during a journey. The sleeping woman in the right foreground is the main visual focus, and the sleeping woman by the window in the left middle ground forms a resonance. The empty seat in the middle and the rows of blue seats together constitute a clear spatial depth, allowing the internal structure of the high-speed rail carriage to unfold naturally. The texture of the blue seats, white headrest cloths, windows, seat numbers, characters' sleeping postures, and scattered passengers in the back row should be naturally presented in the frame. The composition can have a slight sense of snapshot and slight imperfection, without being too neat, to strengthen the documentary atmosphere of "unintentionally captured during a real journey." The visual focus is suggested to fall in order: the sleeping woman in the right foreground -> the sleeping woman by the window in the left middle ground -> the depth formed by the blue seats and empty seats -> the white headrest cloths and seat numbers -> the blurry window exterior and back row passengers. [Camera/Technical Parameters] The overall look should present a hyper-realistic mobile phone photography quality, as if naturally taken with an ordinary mobile phone, rather than a professional studio shoot. Use a slight wide-angle perspective to retain the sense of carriage space and the longitudinal extension of the seats. The optical performance should be close to daily mobile phone imaging: the subject is clear, the background and the window exterior can have a slight natural blur, with a bit of slight noise and the sense of daily image compression. The frame retains real skin details, clothing folds, seat fabric texture, headrest cloth texture, and carriage structure details, avoiding over-sharpening, over-smoothing, or a fake high-definition feel. [Atmosphere/Light] Adopt real natural indoor light, mainly the ambient light inside the high-speed rail carriage, without using cinematic lighting or studio-style light effects. The overall light should be naturally soft, bright, and restrained, like the real light sense formed by the outside of the window and the carriage lighting when the train is moving or stopped during the day. The area outside the window can be slightly brighter but not overexposed; the characters' faces and clothing should be naturally lit, retaining a quiet, tired, and life-like atmosphere. The overall color tone should be realistically neutral, without strong filter processing, to strengthen the "unintentional snapshot during a quiet journey" temperament. [Style] The overall style is realistic documentary photography, mobile phone snapshot, and lifestyle snapshot style. Emphasize the sense of real moments in public transportation scenes, rather than fashion photography, posed blockbusters, or movie stills. The image should have a clear realistic photography tendency, retaining the simplicity, restraint, and daily sense of ordinary mobile phone photos, avoiding a heavy sense of AI generation. The final effect should make people feel that this is a lifestyle photo accidentally taken during a real high-speed rail journey. [Detail Emphasis] Focus on the following details: The real spatial sense and structure of a Chinese high-speed rail second-class carriage; The material details of blue fabric seats and white headrest cloths; Reasonable and real seat number text on the wall overhead; Blurred platform and urban tracks outside the train window; The tired sleeping posture of the woman in the right foreground with her head slightly tilted, eyes closed, arms naturally crossed, and legs naturally together and slanted; The posture of the woman in the left middle ground sleeping by the window and the black bag beside her; The presence of passengers in the back row as background elements should be low, used only to enhance the real atmosphere of the carriage; The overall performance should be a quiet, tired, restrained, and natural state of life during a journey; The photo must look like a real capture, not a deliberately designed, over-modified, or image with obvious AI traces. [Avoid] Low quality, poor clarity, blurry face, deformed face, deformed hands, deformed legs, extra fingers, missing fingers, hand errors, body proportion errors, facial distortion, eyes open, fake skin, plastic texture, over-smoothing, over-beautification, influencer photo sense, deliberate posing sense, studio sense, movie lighting, strong filters, over-sharpening, over-saturation, sexualization, nudity, minors, school uniforms, suggestive poses, provocative expressions, exaggerated body figures, low-cut emphasis, anime style, illustration style, CG feel, 3D rendering, oil painting style, garbled text, wrong seat numbers, wrong carriage structure, duplicate characters, multiple heads, multiple legs, multiple hands, chaotic background.
