items.title: 现代手冲咖啡信息图

prompts.text: Ultra-clean modern editorial infographic on the topic of a [POUR-OVER COFFEE BREWING] routine. Hero visual: a stylized flat-lay or floating arrangement of 3–4 objects (a ceramic V60 dripper, a matte black gooseneck kettle, and scattered roasted coffee beans) — slightly angled or in soft perspective, glowing subtly. Ingredients Section: Label it ‘What You Need’ — include 6–8 items with small icons next to each (e.g., '15g single-origin beans', '250ml water at 93°C'). Arranged in a cluster connected visually to the hero. Steps Section: 5–6 numbered panels with arrows or connecting lines forming a logical flow. Each step has a short action label and a small relevant icon. Panels use glassmorphism or frosted card styling. Stats Badges: 4–5 floating pill-shaped badges showing relevant metadata — total brew time, extraction yield, flavor profile, caffeine hit — displayed as clean minimal bubbles. Visual Style: Artisan, warm editorial background — roasted brown, oat cream, or soft copper tones. Rich espresso accent colors. Bold modern sans-serif typography. Clean vector icons. Subtle grain or filter-paper texture. Composition: Hero object cluster centered or slightly offset. Ingredients on one side. Steps flow opposite or below with connecting lines. Stat badges scattered as floating pills. Generous negative space. Lighting: Soft, warm morning cafe light feel emanating from the hero cluster. Premium lifestyle editorial aesthetic, social-feed optimized. Ultra-crisp. No watermark.

items.title: 海贼王双重曝光情感电影海报

prompts.text:
Create a cinematic character poster using a double exposure composition as the foundation, with the visual quality of AAA game key art, and the emotional soul of “One Piece” centered around friendship, journey, and destiny.

The poster must feel deeply emotional—capturing the spirit of “nakama” (crew bonds), freedom, sacrifice, and dreams.

Feature a large, elegant silhouette of [CHARACTER NAME]’s face (slightly looking upward or sideways with a soft, determined expression) dominating the composition. His expression should feel emotional yet strong—hopeful, nostalgic, and full of resolve.

Inside and around this silhouette, create layered scenes that represent his journey with his crew:
- The Straw Hat crew standing together on the Thousand Sunny
- Moments of laughter, adventure, and struggle
- Subtle references to past arcs (islands, battles, sunsets, ocean horizons)
- [CHARACTER NAME] reaching forward or standing at the front of the ship
- A symbolic path toward the horizon (his dream)

Use a near-large, far-small composition with slight ultra-wide perspective for depth.

Character Design:
- [CHARACTER NAME] reimagined in hyper-realistic 3D human form
- Adult version with an athletic, lean but powerful physique
- Retain iconic features: straw hat, scar under eye, open shirt, shorts
- Skin: highly detailed, natural texture
- Clothing: cinematic realism with subtle wear from adventure

Emotion & Pose:
- Calm but powerful stance
- Slight smile or emotional gaze
- Body language showing leadership and connection
- One hand holding the straw hat or reaching forward

Story Integration:
- Ocean waves blending into the silhouette
- Warm sunset sky symbolizing hope and journey
- Soft glowing light around crew members
- Subtle Haki aura (not aggressive, more spiritual)
- Wind flowing through clothing and environment

Lighting & Color:
- Golden hour / sunset lighting (warm orange, soft blue contrast)
- Soft cinematic glow
- Gentle highlights and shadows for emotional depth
- Slight haze or atmospheric fog for dreamlike effect

Style:
- Cinematic
- Emotional
- Epic but intimate
- Hyper-realistic 3D with soft artistic blending

Final Output:
- Vertical 3:4 movie-style poster
- Ultra high detail, 4K–8K resolution
- Clean, dramatic composition that tells a story at a glance

items.title: 东方玄学命理深度解析图

prompts.text:
Please based on the [hand photo / face photo / hand and face combination photo] I uploaded, create a high-completion, well-designed, shareable "Oriental Metaphysics Analysis Report Image".

This is not an ordinary photo description, nor is it simple entertainment fortune-telling, but a visual analysis image combining [traditional Chinese palmistry, physiognomy, I Ching Five Elements, and Traditional Chinese Medicine observation of Qi and complexion theories]. The overall image should present a feeling of "fortune teller analysis report + ancient metaphysics annotations + high-end visual poster", allowing users to intuitively see key features, corresponding explanations, and trend warnings.

[Recognition and Analysis Requirements]

Please first determine what is contained in the image:
1. Hand: Focus on analyzing palm prints, palm mounts, hand shape, finger shape, finger joints, fingerprint trends, life line, wisdom line, emotion line, career line, wealth line, and other visible features.
2. Face: Focus on analyzing forehead, eyebrows and eyes, bridge of the nose, cheekbones, nasolabial folds, mouth shape, chin, facial contours, Qi and complexion, facial feature proportions, and overall demeanor.
3. If both hand and face are included, please analyze comprehensively, do not pile up repetitively, and form a unified judgment.

Please extract at least [10 key analysis points], each analysis point must include:
- Visible features: Point out the specific location or shape that can be seen in the photo.
- Metaphysical explanation: Analyze combining palmistry, physiognomy, I Ching Five Elements, or traditional fate language.
- Trend prompt: Express using "tends to, easily, needs attention, suitable for, may in the near future" and other ways.
- Action suggestion: Give a practically executable reminder, such as emotion management, work and rest, career rhythm, interpersonal relationships, financial planning, etc.

[Annotation Requirements]

Please use clear lines, arrows, circles, or numbered labels in the image to indicate each key position:
- Palmistry charts can annotate: life line, wisdom line, emotion line, career line, palm mounts, finger joints, base of the thumb, index finger length, ring finger proportion, palm line intersection points, etc.
- Physiognomy charts can annotate: forehead, eyebrows and eyes, bridge of the nose, cheekbones, nasolabial folds, corners of the mouth, chin, ear shape, facial middle third, Qi and complexion areas, etc.
- Each annotation point is numbered with 01, 02, 03..., corresponding to the analysis explanation on the right or below.
- Lines should be delicate, elegant, not messy, and not block the main subject.

[Visual Style]

The overall style should conform to the tone of Oriental metaphysics, fate reading, palmistry, and physiognomy:
- Main color tone: off-white, Xuan paper color, with accents: deep ink black, mystic cyan, antique bronze gold, dark red.
- Style temperament: mysterious, restrained, high-end, ancient book feel, fate report feel.
- Light elements can be added: Bagua patterns, compass scales, Five Elements symbols, ancient book borders, astrological chart thin lines, cinnabar seals, Xuan paper textures.
- Do not make it horror style, vulgar fortune-telling stall style, and do not make it overly cyberpunk.
- The layout should be like a high-end magazine infographic, not a messy screenshot.

[Layout Design]
Make the aspect ratio 3:4

Layout structure suggestions:
1. Top: Title area
   The title can be "Palmistry and Physiognomy Metaphysics Analysis Report", "Oriental Fate Feature Interpretation", "Palm Print and Physiognomy Trend Observation", etc., which should match the content of the photo uploaded by the user.
2. Middle: Main photo analysis area
   Keep the hand or face as the main subject, adding numbers, arrows, and key line annotations.
3. Side or bottom: Ten-point analysis area
   Each point uses a short title + 2-3 lines of explanation, do not make the text too small.
4. Bottom: Comprehensive conclusion area
   Summarize this person's personality tendencies, career and wealth, interpersonal emotions, health and work-rest, and recent reminders.

[Content Tone]

The analysis language should have a traditional metaphysical flavor, but not be absolute, do not say "definitely", "will definitely get rich", "will definitely have a disaster".
Can use:
- "This line pattern shows that the person mostly..."
- "From the perspective of the Five Elements weather, it leans towards..."
- "If the lines here are obvious, it usually represents..."
- "Recently need to pay attention to..."
- "Suitable to go in the... direction"
- "Suggest making adjustments in... aspects"

[Output Goal]

Please finally generate a complete visual analysis image, containing at least 10 numbered analysis points.
The overall image should let people see at a glance "where has been analyzed, what meaning it corresponds to, what reminders there are", having both a metaphysical atmosphere and professional layout and high-end design sense.

Note:
- Only analyze based on visible features in the image, do not fabricate invisible information.
- Do not make medical diagnoses, do not give disease conclusions; Traditional Chinese Medicine Qi and complexion content is only used as a life reminder from the perspective of traditional culture.
- Do not appear too many small characters, ensure it can be read clearly on a mobile phone.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请根据我上传的【手部照片 / 面部照片 / 手脸组合照片】，创作一张高完成度、有设计感、适合分享的「东方玄学分析报告图」。

这不是普通的照片说明，也不是简单的娱乐占卜，而是一张结合【中国传统手相、面相、易经五行、中医望诊气色理论】的视觉化分析图。整体应呈现出“命理师分析报告 + 古籍玄学注解 + 高级视觉海报”的感觉，让用户能直观看到关键特征、对应解释和趋势预警。

【识别与分析要求】

请先判断图片中包含的是：
1. 手部：重点分析掌纹、掌丘、手型、指形、指节、指纹走势、生命线、智慧线、感情线、事业线、财运线等可见特征。
2. 面部：重点分析额头、眉眼、鼻梁、颧骨、法令、嘴型、下巴、面部轮廓、气色、五官比例与整体神态。
3. 如果同时包含手和脸，请综合分析，不要重复堆砌，要形成统一判断。

请至少提炼【10个关键分析点】，每个分析点都要包括：
- 可见特征：指出照片中能看到的具体位置或形态。
- 玄学解释：结合手相、面相、易经五行或传统命理语言进行分析。
- 趋势提示：用“倾向于、容易、需要注意、适合、未来一段时间可能”等方式表达。
- 行动建议：给出一句现实可执行的提醒，例如情绪管理、作息、事业节奏、人际关系、财务规划等。

【标注要求】

请在图片中使用清晰的线条、箭头、圆圈或编号标签，标明每个关键位置：
- 手相图可标注：生命线、智慧线、感情线、事业线、掌丘、指节、拇指根部、食指长度、无名指比例、掌心纹路交汇点等。
- 面相图可标注：额头、眉眼、鼻梁、颧骨、法令纹、嘴角、下巴、耳形、面部中庭、气色区域等。
- 每个标注点用 01、02、03……编号，对应右侧或下方的分析说明。
- 线条要细致、优雅，不要杂乱，不要遮挡主体。

【视觉风格】

整体风格要符合东方玄学、命理、手相、面相的调性：
- 主色调：米白、宣纸色，点缀：深墨黑、玄青、古铜金、暗红
- 风格气质：神秘、克制、高级、古籍感、命理报告感。
- 可加入轻微元素：八卦纹、罗盘刻度、五行符号、古籍边框、星盘细线、朱砂印章、宣纸纹理。
- 不要做成恐怖风、低俗算命摊风，也不要过度赛博朋克。
- 排版要像高级杂志信息图，而不是杂乱截图。

【版式设计】
Make the aspect ratio 3:4

版面结构建议：
1. 顶部：标题区  
   标题可为「手相面相玄学分析报告」「东方命理特征解读」「掌纹与面相趋势观察」等，要符合用户上传的图片内容。
2. 中间：主体照片分析区  
   保留手部或脸部主体，加入编号、箭头和关键线条标注。
3. 侧边或下方：十点分析区  
   每一点用简短标题 + 2-3行说明，不要文字太小。
4. 底部：综合结论区  
   总结此人的性格倾向、事业财运、人际情感、健康作息和近期提醒。

【内容语气】

分析语言要有传统玄学味道，但不要绝对化，不要说“必定”“一定会发财”“一定有灾”。  
可以使用：
- “此纹路显示其人多半……”
- “从五行气象看，偏向……”
- “此处若纹路明显，通常代表……”
- “近期需要留意……”
- “适合走……方向”
- “建议在……方面做调整”

【输出目标】

请最终生成一张完整的视觉分析图，至少包含10个编号分析点。  
整体要让人一眼看出“哪里被分析了、对应什么含义、有什么提醒”，既有玄学氛围，又有专业排版和高级设计感。

注意：
- 只基于图片中可见特征分析，不要编造看不见的信息。
- 不做医学诊断，不给出疾病结论；中医气色内容只作为传统文化角度的生活提醒。
- 不要出现过多小字，确保手机上也能清楚阅读。

prompts.text:
Create a high-quality visual work with an **architectural designer's hand-drawn style**, showcasing **architectural details**, **structure**, **technical measurements**, and **cultural background**. The work should be a perfect combination full of **artistry** and **knowledgeability**. The overall style should retain the **sense of freedom of hand-drawn sketches**, while focusing on details and measurements, similar to the **original manuscripts of architectural masters**, such as the works of Lin Huiyin or internationally renowned architects.

### I. Overall Style:
- The overall work is **hand-drawn style + architectural measurement and technical annotation**, full of freehand lines and artistic sense. Through **rough lines**, **imperfect details**, and **measurement numbers and units**, the work reflects the structural beauty and design intent of the architecture.
- The picture needs to reflect the **randomness of hand-drawn sketches**, without being too refined, but must retain the authenticity and technicality of architectural design. Every architectural detail (such as roofs, pillars, carvings, etc.) should have clear measurements and technical annotations, presenting both the exterior appearance of the architecture and revealing the internal structure and design concepts.

### II. Core Composition Logic:
- The **core visual subject** of the work should unfold in a **diagonal way**, ensuring the composition has **fluidity and tension**. The structure of the architecture, every angle, dimensional proportions, and other content should unfold naturally, constructing a visual long scroll of **information flow**.
- It is necessary to use details such as **dimension rulers** and **units** for annotation, making the proportions, spatial relationships, and design details of each part of the architecture clear at a glance.
- **Architectural details**, **structural design**, **material application**, etc., should be presented through freehand brushstrokes, while adding **precise technical annotations**, forming a perfect fusion of art and technology.

### III. Measurement and Technical Details:
- Every **architectural detail** should have clear measurement annotations, and **dimensions**, **units**, **proportions**, etc., should be annotated in detail at the key parts of the architecture.
- **Technical details** such as the diameter of pillars, the length of beams, the angle of the roof, etc., should be clearly displayed, accompanied by annotations of **building materials**, so that every architectural part has detailed **technical descriptions**.
- In the picture, use **ruler lines** to ensure the accuracy of the architecture, while maintaining the freedom of hand-drawing.

### IV. Background and Negative Space:
- The background should be a **simple off-white** or **light gray tone**, with a slight **handmade paper texture**, presenting the texture of **high-end handmade paper**, without interfering with the main architectural body. The background tone should have a **rough feel**, but ensure a good **contrast ratio** with the text, making the text clear and readable.
- It is necessary to retain a large area of **negative space**, which not only provides a sense of space but also helps to highlight every detail of the architecture, focusing the audience's attention on the architecture itself. The use of negative space should have a sense of rhythm and visual hierarchy.

### V. Text and Typography:
- The text information must be naturally integrated with the architectural elements in the picture, and the text such as annotations, rulers, and technical instructions should be **clear and readable**.
- **Language adaptation**: Automatically select Chinese or English as the explanatory text according to the user's input language. For example, if the input is Chinese, all annotations and knowledge points should be presented in Chinese, and vice versa.
- **Annotation content** needs to include the **historical background**, **cultural symbolism**, **technical features**, **design concepts**, etc., of the architecture, and be presented through **clear typography**. The text typography should echo the architectural graphics, avoiding interference with the main content.

### VI. Material and Color Scheme of Pinyin/English Large Text:
- **Pinyin or English large text title** serves as the core text of the picture, displaying the name of the architecture.
- The large text title should have a **hot stamping texture**, **metal material sense**, or **relief effect**, displaying a **sense of high class** and **exquisite printing effect**.
- **Color tone** can adopt **metallic colors**, **champagne gold**, **platinum**, etc., displaying the high-end sense and exquisite sense of the architecture.

### VII. Surrounding Information and Knowledge Points:
- The surroundings of the picture should contain **relevant knowledge points** of the architecture, including the **historical background**, **cultural value**, **technical innovation**, **design philosophy**, etc., of the architecture.
- This information should be presented in an **artistic typography method**, **avoiding lengthy text stacking**, but rather being **concise and valuable**, providing an in-depth understanding of the architecture.
- The **integration of information and architectural details** should have a sense of rhythm, with text and architectural graphics naturally intertwining to form an organic whole.

### VIII. Overall Temperament Goal:
- The picture should present a fusion of **architectural artistry** and **technicality**, ensuring that the hand-drawn style does not lose the accuracy of the architecture, while simultaneously displaying the spirit and structural beauty of the architecture.
- The work should have a strong **academic and cultural nature**, capable of serving as a **classic display** of architectural design, while also possessing the collection value of an artwork.
- The overall atmosphere should be warm, free, and full of creativity, without losing the rigor of structure and the richness of details, suitable for **teaching and display use**.

### IX. Problems to Avoid:
- Avoid **overly refined drawing**, maintaining the natural and rough feel of hand-drawing.
- Do not let the text interfere with the visual expression of the architecture; the **text should be concise and precise**, without stacking too much information.
- **Measurement annotations** and **annotation text** must ensure **clear and easy readability**, and cannot be blurred.

### X. Final Goal:
Create an architectural hand-drawn work combining **artistry and technicality**, through detailed **measurement annotations**, **technical annotations**, and **cultural descriptions**, presenting all aspects of the architecture, making it both possess high-end artistry and capable of serving as **professional materials for teaching use**.
This work will display the history, structure, and design philosophy of the architecture, with a **freehand drawing style**, while ensuring the **clear display** of knowledge points.

prompts.text:
创作一张具有**建筑设计师手绘风格**的高质量视觉作品，展现**建筑细节**、**结构**、**技术测量**以及**文化背景**，作品应充满**艺术性**与**知识性**的完美结合。整体风格应保留**手绘草图的自由感**，同时注重细节和测量，类似**建筑大师原稿**，如林徽因或国际知名建筑师的作品。

### 一、整体风格：
- 整体作品为**手绘风格 + 建筑测量与技术标注**，充满自由的手绘线条和艺术感。通过**粗犷的线条**、**不完美的细节**以及**测量数字与单位**，让作品体现建筑的结构美感和设计意图。  
- 画面中需体现出**手绘草图的随机感**，不必过于精细，但必须保留建筑设计的真实性与技术性。每个建筑细节（如屋顶、柱子、雕刻等）都应该有清晰的测量和技术注释，既呈现建筑外观，又揭示内部结构与设计理念。

### 二、核心构图逻辑：
- 作品的**核心视觉主体**应通过**对角线的方式**展开，确保构图具有**流动性和张力**。建筑的结构、每个角度、尺寸比例等内容都应该自然展开，构建起**信息流动**的视觉长卷。  
- 需要用**尺寸标尺**、**单位**等细节标注，使得建筑的各部分比例、空间关系、设计细节一目了然。  
- **建筑的细节**、**结构设计**、**材料运用**等要通过自由的手绘笔触呈现，同时加上**精确的技术标注**，形成艺术与技术的完美融合。

### 三、测量与技术细节：
- 每个**建筑细节**都应该有明确的测量标注，**尺寸**、**单位**、**比例**等要详细标注在建筑的关键部分。  
- **技术性细节**如柱子的直径、梁的长度、屋顶的角度等要清晰显示，配合**建筑材料**的标注，使得每个建筑部分都有详细的**技术描述**。  
- 在画面中，使用**标尺线条**来确保建筑的精确性，同时保持手绘的自由感。

### 四、背景与留白：
- 背景应为**简约的米白色**或**浅灰色调**，带有轻微的**手工纸纹理**，呈现**高档手工纸的质感**，不干扰建筑主体。背景色调应具有**粗糙感**，但保证与文字之间有良好的**对比度**，使文字清晰可读。  
- 需要保留大面积**留白**，这种留白既提供空间感，也帮助突出建筑的每个细节，使观众的注意力聚焦在建筑本身。留白的使用应富有节奏感和视觉层次感。

### 五、文字与排版：
- 文字信息必须与画面中的建筑元素自然融合，注释、标尺、技术说明等文字要**清晰可读**。  
- **语言适配**：根据用户的输入语言，自动选择中文或英文作为解释文字。例如，若输入为中文，则所有注释和知识点都应呈现为中文，反之则为英文。  
- **注释内容**需包括建筑的**历史背景**、**文化象征**、**技术特色**、**设计理念**等，并通过**清晰的排版**呈现。文字排版要与建筑图形呼应，避免干扰主体内容。

### 六、拼音/英文大字的材质与配色：
- **拼音或英文大字标题**作为画面的核心文字，展现建筑名称。  
- 大字标题应具有**烫印质感**、**金属材质感**或**浮雕效果**，展现**高级感**和**精致的印刷效果**。  
- **色调**可以采用**金属色**、**香槟金**、**铂金**等色调，展现建筑的高端感和精致感。

### 七、四周信息与知识点：
- 画面四周应包含建筑的**相关知识点**，包括建筑的**历史背景**、**文化价值**、**技术创新**、**设计哲学**等。  
- 这些信息要通过**艺术化的排版方式**呈现，**避免冗长的文字堆砌**，而是要**简洁而富有价值**，提供建筑的深度理解。  
- **信息与建筑细节的融合**应富有节奏感，文字与建筑图形自然交织，形成有机的整体。

### 八、整体气质目标：
- 画面应呈现**建筑艺术性**与**技术性**的融合，确保手绘风格不失建筑的精确度，同时展现建筑的精神与结构之美。  
- 作品应具有强烈的**学术性与文化性**，能够作为建筑设计的**经典展示**，同时具备艺术品的收藏价值。  
- 整体氛围应温暖、自由、充满创意，又不失结构的严谨和细节的丰富，适合**教学与展示使用**。

### 九、避免的问题：
- 避免**过于精细的绘制**，保持手绘的自然感和粗糙感。  
- 不要让文字干扰建筑的视觉表达，**文字应简洁而精确**，不堆砌过多信息。  
- **测量标注**和**注释文字**要保证**清晰易读**，不能模糊不清。

### 十、最终目标：
创作一张结合**艺术性与技术性的建筑手绘作品**，通过精细的**测量标注**、**技术注释**和**文化说明**，呈现建筑的各个方面，使其既具备高端艺术性，又能够作为**教学使用的专业资料**。  
这幅作品将展示建筑的历史、结构和设计哲学，带有**自由的手绘风格**，同时保证知识点的**清晰展示**。

prompts.text:
Generate a photo of steak and dessert in a British steakhouse style. Like a photo taken with a smartphone, suitable for posting on Instagram. No people. Then, observe the elements appearing in the photo and add meaningful hand-drawn annotations to each element. 
【Drawing Rules】

【Text Rules】
・English handwritten text

・Tone is "diary, one-liner, emotional outlet"
【Comment Generation Rules】
・Beverage → Taste, temperature, mood (Example: refreshing, gentle sweetness)
・Food → Texture, deliciousness (Example: moist, the best)
・Space → Atmosphere (Example: relaxing, wonderful time)
・Overall → One-line summary (Example: too happy~)
【Decorations】
・Moderately add steam, sparkles, hearts, small emojis, etc.
・Not excessive, leave "white space"
【Final Style】
・Instagram story style, rough note style of a magazine, stylish and relaxed atmosphere

items.title: 地景档案立体沙盘模型图

prompts.text:
Please create a high-completion, high-texture, suitable-for-series-release "Landscape Archive Model" visual image based on the 【Theme】.

This is not an ordinary map, nor an ordinary landscape illustration or city rendering, but a high-end archival visual image combining "2D map drawing + 3D regional model + professional explanation system + museum exhibition sense". The image needs to look like a real geographical research model, urban planning sandbox, architectural proposal model, or worldview setting exhibit, possessing a professional, restrained, precise, touchable high-end texture.

【Basic Settings】
Theme: 【Theme, for example Crater Lake / Guangzhou / Chongqing Mountain City / Island City / Ancient City Ruins / Post-Apocalyptic Ruins / Fantasy Continent / Game Main City】
Theme Type: 【Natural Landform / Urban Space / Mixed Landscape】
Core Subject: 【Core Subject, for example crater, canyon, mountain range, lake, CBD, old city district, landmark cluster, island city, ruins cluster, main city area】
Content Focus: 【Content Focus, for example terrain elevation difference / urban landmarks / road network structure / water system relationship / nature and city relationship / setting collection display】
Style Direction: 【Style Direction, for example geographic mapping style, paper carving model style, architectural proposal style, museum archive style, urban planning style, game setting collection style】
Main Color Tone: 【Main Color Tone, for example off-white, light gray, parchment white, sand color, snow white】
Auxiliary Color: 【Auxiliary Color, for example earth brown, rock gray, cold gray, light blue, moss green】
Accent Color: 【Accent Color, for example black thin lines, red routes, blue hydrological lines, yellow numbered markers】
Aspect Ratio: 【Aspect Ratio, for example 16:9 horizontal / 3:4 vertical / 4:5 vertical / 1:1 square】

【Image Structure】
The main body of the image is a rectangular map model board placed on a clean desktop or white cloth. The baseboard has real thickness, with cross-section structure visible at the edges, like an exquisite map slice or model base. The map surface is covered with clear but restrained information layers, including contour lines, road networks, hydrological lines, zoning boundaries, geographic textures, coordinate sense, slight annotations, and drawing borders.

In the center or off-center area of the map, a three-dimensional main model "grows" three-dimensionally from the two-dimensional map, becoming the visual core of the entire image.

If the 【Theme Type】 is Natural Landform:
The subject can be composed of mountains, canyons, craters, lakes, basins, islands, glaciers, faults, coastlines, emphasizing terrain elevation differences, stacked contour line structures, rock wall textures, and natural landform undulations.

If the 【Theme Type】 is Urban Space:
The subject can be composed of core urban areas, CBDs, old city blocks, landmark building clusters, waterfront areas, road network nodes, bridges, water systems, park green spaces, emphasizing building volumes, city recognition, spatial layers, and planning structures.

If the 【Theme Type】 is Mixed Landscape:
It needs to simultaneously integrate natural terrain and artificially built environments, such as mountain cities, island cities, ancient city ruins, post-apocalyptic ruins, fantasy main cities, sci-fi bases, allowing natural landforms and urban structures to jointly form the core visual.

【Detail Requirements】
- The model surface retains the sense of map drawing and professional information
- Terrain areas should have contour lines, slope layers, depression and undulation relationships
- Building areas should have a sense of volume, block relationships, and clear layers
- Water areas are represented using low-saturation light blue
- Green spaces, forests, parks, and mountains can be represented using moss green or low-saturation green
- Road networks, paths, transportation axes, or exploration routes can be represented with thin lines, but must not overshadow the main subject
- If there are landmark buildings or key structures, they should have clear recognition
- If there are fantasy, sci-fi, or game setting elements, the archive model and drawing display sense must be retained, rather than making them into pure scene illustrations

【Explanation System】
The edges of the map board need to be designed with complete and restrained explanation modules, including:
- Outer frame line and inner frame line
- Scale bar
- Legend area
- Title area
- Archive number
- Index markers
- Annotation labels
- Concise symbol explanations
The text does not need to be fully readable, but the overall must present a real, clear, precise, orderly archival typographic structure.

【Composition and Camera】
Adopt an oblique overhead isometric or sandbox-style composition, with the camera observing the entire model board from about 30 to 45 degrees above, allowing the audience to simultaneously see the map plane, the three-dimensional main subject height, the edge thickness, and the explanation area. The visual center of gravity is concentrated on the central main model, and the reading path is: first look at the core subject, then look at the surrounding terrain/road network/water system/block information, and finally look at the legend, scale bar, and explanation area.

【Material and Lighting】
The overall needs to have a real model photography texture:
- Paper texture
- Map printing texture
- Paper carving or sandbox model sense
- Architectural model or terrain slice texture
- Soft natural light
- Delicate real shadows
- Clean background
- Low saturation, high-end, restrained
Avoid cartoonization, cheap game UI sense, excessive clutter, excessive showing off, focusing on highlighting the unified visual of "map baseboard + three-dimensional main subject + professional explanation system".

The final effect should look like a landscape archive model image that can be used for geography science popularization, urban research, architectural proposals, cultural tourism visual features, worldview setting collections, or high-end series covers.

prompts.text:
请根据【主题】创作一张高完成度、高质感、适合系列化发布的「地景档案模型 / Landscape Archive Model」视觉图。

这不是普通地图，也不是普通风景插画或城市效果图，而是一张结合“二维地图图纸 + 三维立体区域模型 + 专业说明系统 + 博物馆展陈感”的高端档案式视觉图。画面需要像一件被真实制作出来的地理研究模型、城市规划沙盘、建筑提案模型或世界观设定展品，具有专业、克制、精密、可触摸的高级质感。

【基础设定】
主题：【主题，例如火山口湖 / 广州 / 重庆山城 / 海岛城市 / 古城遗址 / 末日废墟 / 幻想大陆 / 游戏主城】
主题类型：【自然地貌 / 城市空间 / 混合景观】
核心主体：【核心主体，例如火山口、峡谷、山脉、湖泊、CBD、老城区、地标群、岛屿城市、遗址群、主城区域】
内容重点：【内容重点，例如地形高差 / 城市地标 / 路网结构 / 水系关系 / 自然与城市关系 / 设定集展示】
风格方向：【风格方向，例如地理测绘风、纸雕模型风、建筑提案风、博物馆档案风、城市规划风、游戏设定集风】
主色调：【主色调，例如米白、浅灰、羊皮纸白、沙色、雪白】
辅助色：【辅助色，例如土褐、岩灰、冷灰、淡蓝、苔绿】
点缀色：【点缀色，例如黑色细线、红色路线、蓝色水文线、黄色编号标记】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，例如16:9横版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 1:1方图】

【画面结构】
画面主体是一块放置在干净桌面或白色布面上的矩形地图模型板。底板具有真实厚度，边缘可见剖面结构，像一块精致的地图切片或模型底座。地图表面覆盖清晰但克制的信息层，包括等高线、道路网络、水文线、分区边界、地理纹理、坐标感、轻微标注和图纸边框。

在地图中央或偏中心区域，从二维地图中立体“生长”出一个三维主体模型，成为整张图的视觉核心。

如果【主题类型】为自然地貌：
主体可由山体、峡谷、火山口、湖泊、盆地、岛屿、冰川、断层、海岸线等构成，强调地形高差、层叠等高线结构、岩壁纹理和自然地貌起伏。

如果【主题类型】为城市空间：
主体可由核心城区、CBD、老城街区、地标建筑群、滨水区、路网节点、桥梁、水系、公园绿地等构成，强调建筑体块、城市识别度、空间层次与规划结构。

如果【主题类型】为混合景观：
需同时整合自然地形与人工建成环境，例如山城、海岛城市、古城遗址、末日废墟、幻想主城、科幻基地等，让自然地貌与城市结构共同构成核心视觉。

【细节要求】
- 模型表面保留地图图纸感与专业信息感
- 地形区域应有等高线、坡面层次、凹陷与起伏关系
- 建筑区域应有体块感、街区关系和清晰层次
- 水域使用低饱和淡蓝色表现
- 绿地、森林、公园、山体可用苔绿色或低饱和绿色表现
- 路网、路径、交通轴线或探索线路可用细线表现，但不要喧宾夺主
- 若有地标建筑或重点结构，应具备明确识别度
- 若有幻想、科幻或游戏设定元素，应保留档案模型和图纸展示感，而不是做成纯场景插画

【说明系统】
地图板边缘需要设计完整而克制的说明模块，包括：
- 外框线和内框线
- 比例尺
- 图例区
- 标题区
- 档案编号
- 索引标记
- 注释标签
- 简洁的符号说明
文字不必全部可读，但整体必须呈现真实、清晰、精密、有秩序的档案式排版结构。

【构图与镜头】
采用斜俯视等轴测或沙盘式构图，镜头从上方约30到45度观察整块模型板，让观众同时看到地图平面、立体主体高度、边缘厚度和说明区。视觉重心集中在中央主体模型，阅读路径为：先看核心主体，再看周边地形/路网/水系/街区信息，最后看图例、比例尺和说明区。

【材质与光影】
整体需要具有真实模型摄影质感：
- 纸张纹理
- 地图印刷质感
- 纸雕或沙盘模型感
- 建筑模型或地形切片质感
- 柔和自然光
- 细腻真实阴影
- 干净背景
- 低饱和、高级、克制
避免卡通化、廉价游戏UI感、过度杂乱、过度炫技，重点突出“地图底板 + 立体主体 + 专业说明系统”的统一视觉。

最终效果应像一张可以用于地理科普、城市研究、建筑提案、文旅视觉专题、世界观设定集或高端系列封面的地景档案模型图。

items.title: 一张具有收藏价值设计师海报

prompts.text:
创作一张具有收藏价值、设计师海报气质与作者性审美的高完成度视觉作品。

整体风格为：油画风格 + 大师级排版文字设计。
画面需具有明显的厚涂技法质感，通过厚薄差异塑造立体感、材料感、节奏感与视觉层次，既有绘画肌理，又有现代设计感与展览级海报气质。

一、核心构图逻辑
采用居中偏斜的对角线主构图。
整张海报的核心视觉主体，不是缩在中间的一小团，而是由一条沿对角线方向大幅展开的不规则综合色带 / 图示承载区构成。
这条综合色带必须从画面一个对角方向自然延伸至另一个对角方向，形成近似贯穿全版的斜向视觉骨架，具备足够的长度、面积、张力与版面统摄力。
它必须舒展、大气、完整，不可局促，不可收缩成中间一坨，不可导致版面显得逼仄、狭窄、拘谨。

这条综合色带既像厚涂油彩横扫而成的一道主笔触，又像被提炼后的主题地貌、信息地带、文化切片或视觉载体。
综合色带的配色不能写死，必须根据用户最后输入的【城市 / 主题 / 对象 / 灵感】自动判断。
可以从该主题最典型的印象色、文化色、环境色、建筑色、情绪色中提炼出 2-3 种主色，形成高级且有层次的综合色关系。
例如可以呈现类似“紫金蓝”“赭红青”“墨绿金”“灰粉褐”等综合色逻辑，但具体色彩必须智能适配输入内容本身，而不是固定模板。

二、主体内容生成逻辑
在这条沿对角线展开的综合色带之上，承载与用户输入强相关的核心视觉内容。

如果输入的是城市：
自动提炼该城市最具辨识度的地标、建筑、名胜、水系、人文空间、历史象征、城市记忆、代表性文化元素等。

如果输入的是对象、主题或灵感：
自动提炼最有代表性的核心元素、关键场景、象征物、结构信息、文化线索、概念意象或视觉母题。

这些内容不要做成写实堆砌，不要像旅游宣传页素材拼贴，不要杂乱罗列。
必须以“极简俯视图 / 高度概括的图形化俯瞰景观 / 设计化地图感构成 / 信息化景观”的方式进行整合。
让它们像被压缩、提炼、嵌入在这条对角线综合色带之中，形成统一、克制、连续、有秩序的主图示系统。
图示区域内部必须具有连续性、流动性与整体性，让不同元素沿对角线方向自然展开、串联、过渡、呼应，形成类似视觉长卷般的观感。
不要中间挤、两头空，不要让主体断裂，不要把视觉重点缩在局部。

三、背景与留白
背景统一为米白色、暖白色或带轻微旧纸质感的纹理纸质背景。
纸面要有自然纸张纤维感、细腻颗粒感、轻微手工纸或高档印刷纸肌理。
整体背景必须干净、克制、安静，不要过度装饰，不要复杂花纹干扰主体。
必须保留大面积留白，但这种留白不是空洞无力，而是服务于对角线主结构的高级留白。
留白应让主体更突出，也让文字排版拥有足够的呼吸感、空间感、展览感与版式张力。

四、文字系统与版式逻辑
文字系统必须是整张海报的重要组成部分，而不是后贴上的说明文字。
整体文字原则上采用衬线体系统，体现高级、克制、经典、文化感、设计感兼具的大师级排版效果。
标题、主文案、副文案、知识点信息、小标注、注释性小字之间必须有清晰层级，并通过字号、疏密、错落、对齐、留白、聚散、呼应来形成真正的版式节奏。

必须明确版式优先级：
沿对角线大幅展开的综合色带 / 图示主体，是整张海报的第一视觉骨架与主叙事通道，优先级高于普通文字排版。
这条对角线主体必须保持连续、完整、舒展、不断裂。

所有大标题、拼音 / 英文大字、知识点模块、装饰文案、说明性文字，都必须服从这条对角线主体的完整性。
不得从中间横向切断主体，不得把主体拦腰打断，不得在主体最关键的连续区形成明显遮挡或割裂。
必须为对角线主体预留一条完整、清晰、连续的视觉通道。

文字系统应主要分布在主体两侧的留白区、四角留白区、边缘排版区，或沿主体边缘顺势排布，而不是粗暴压在主体中段中心。
若主体内部确实需要少量文字，只能是极少量、低干扰、嵌入式的小标注，例如局部名称、地标注释、小型标签等，并且必须顺应主体内部结构自然嵌入，不可形成大面积横截式排版。

五、拼音 / 英文大字的材质与配色
海报中必须加入一个“拼音 / 英文大字标题”，作为核心视觉文字之一。
如果用户输入的是中文城市、中文主题或中文对象，则自动提炼其拼音作为大字标题；
如果输入内容更适合英文表达，也可自动生成对应英文大字标题。

这个大字标题必须具有明显的烫印质感、金属材质感、箔印感或压印感，呈现高级、细腻、克制、具有印刷工艺美感的材质效果。
它可以带有轻微反光、压痕感、浮雕感、箔面质感、纸面烫印质感，但不能俗气，不能廉价，不能过度炫光，不能显得商业化过强。

这个材质大字的颜色方案不能被锁死为单一纯金色。
它必须根据用户输入的【城市 / 主题 / 对象 / 灵感】自动判断，灵活选择更适合的材质色彩方案，以避免画面在这部分显得死板、僵硬、单调。

可采用以下两种灵活方案之一：

方案一：统一单色
选择一种最能代表该城市 / 主题气质的材质色。
这个颜色可以是金、古金、铜金、香槟金、玫瑰金、银、铂金、墨金等金属色；
也可以是带有金属材质感的其他颜色，例如金属蓝、金属绿、金属紫、金属红、灰银蓝、青铜绿、暖棕金、墨黑金属感等。
重点不是“必须金色”，而是“具有高级材质语言”。

方案二：综合色综合搭配
使用 2-3 种彼此协调的颜色进行综合色搭配。
这些颜色可来自该城市 / 主题的主色调、印象色、建筑色、自然色、文化色或情绪色，并通过彩色箔印、异色箔印、局部异色、综合色金属层次等方式呈现。
这种综合色方案必须高级、克制、有设计感，不要做成廉价渐变，不要花哨，不要破坏整体气质。

无论采用单色还是综合色方案，都必须让拼音 / 英文大字在材质上有“烫印感”，在颜色上有“主题感”，在视觉上有“灵活性”，并与对角线主体及整体版面形成统一关系。

这个拼音 / 英文大字不能孤立存在，也不能横插进对角线主体中央把主体切断。
它应作为整张海报的版式支点，布置在留白区、主体外缘、边缘排版区，或顺应整体版面气流展开，与主体形成呼应关系和排版张力。
如果同时出现中文标题与拼音 / 英文大字，则要形成清晰而高级的层级关系：
拼音 / 英文大字可作为主要视觉标题；
中文标题可作为呼应性标题、副标题或辅助排版元素；
两者需经过精心编排，绝不能简单上下堆叠。

六、四周信息与知识点
四周内容不能空泛，必须围绕主题自动补充“有亮点、有知识点、有阅读价值”的信息。
这些内容由模型根据用户最后输入自动决定，不需要用户额外提供。

如果是城市方向：
自动补充该城市相关的别称、历史定位、文化标签、地理特征、代表性建筑、名胜注释、人文亮点、城市精神、典型符号、简明知识点等。

如果是对象方向：
自动补充其功能、材料、结构、来源、用途、文化背景、代表性特征、技术点等。

如果是抽象主题或灵感方向：
自动补充其概念提炼、风格关键词、象征含义、背景知识、延展性亮点、联想线索等。

这些知识点不要机械罗列成说明书，不要一股脑堆满边角。
必须以设计性的方式拆分、分组、穿插、整合、排布，成为画面的一部分。
它们应围绕对角线主体自然分布在四周留白区中，形成既有信息性、又有装饰性的版式结构。
四周信息应采用“避让式排版”，围绕主体边缘自然展开，形成环绕、陪衬、补充关系，而不是侵入主体中心通道。
信息块之间要有疏密变化和呼吸感，做到丰富但不挤。

七、署名
在画面右下角保留一个极小号署名字样：
“NAICHA DESIGN”
署名字体要克制、干净、低调，不喧宾夺主。

八、整体气质目标
整张海报应呈现以下综合观感：
主体舒展、版面开阔、对角线主结构完整铺开；
留白高级且有呼吸感；
信息丰富但不杂乱；
远看有鲜明主视觉与强烈记忆点；
近看有丰富的知识点与排版细节；
兼具绘画性、设计性、信息性、阅读性与收藏感；
像一张高端展览海报、城市视觉海报、设计年鉴封面或艺术书籍内页级别的作品。

九、避免的问题
不要把中间图示区域缩成一坨；
不要让主体面积过小；
不要让对角线主图示被大字或信息模块拦腰切断；
不要让主体中段被标题横插打断；
不要让拼音 / 英文大字像路障一样压断主体；
不要让版面显得狭隘、逼仄、拘谨；
不要模板化旅游宣传页感；
不要低级拼贴感；
不要普通地图截图感；
不要说明书式排版；
不要廉价插画感；
不要满版塞满元素；
不要让文字沦为附属说明；
不要让材质大字显得俗气、死板、单调或商业化过强。

十、最终目标
要让“沿对角线大幅展开的综合色带主体 + 极简俯视元素 / 图示系统 + 具有烫印 / 金属材质感且颜色灵活的拼音 / 英文大字 + 四周知识信息 + 高级衬线排版 + 大面积留白”共同形成一张完整而高级的作品。

最终让整张图：
远看有强烈主视觉冲击，
近看有丰富阅读内容与设计细节，
主体不断，文字不截流，版面大气，排版高级，
整体具有收藏价值、作者性与大师级审美完成度。

用户最终输入：
【城市 / 主题 / 对象 / 灵感】：_____
尺寸要求：_____ （比如3:4）

items.title: 游戏角色设定档案总览

prompts.text:
Please create a high-completion, high-consistency "Character Archive Board" suitable for serialized release based on the [Theme / Worldview / Character Setting].

This is not an ordinary character illustration or a single character poster, but an official character setting overview combining "main character display + skill action display + expression setting + three-view drawing description + weapon and equipment display + color palette description + brand title system". The overall image should look like a standard display page in a game art book, character data page, project proposal board, or IP visual development document, possessing both character charm and a clear sense of information organization and setting description.

【Basic Settings】
- Theme / Worldview: 【Theme】
- Project Name / Brand Name: 【Brand Name】
- Character Name: 【Character Name】
- Identity / Profession / Faction: 【Character Identity】
- Core Temperament: 【Character Temperament, e.g., cold, elegant, heroic, wild, mysterious, fierce】
- Combat Position: 【Combat Position, e.g., warrior, knight, mage, assassin, gunman, guardian】
- Weapon Type: 【Weapon Type】
- Elemental Attribute / Ability Direction: 【Ability Direction】
- Main Color: 【Main Color】
- Auxiliary Color: 【Auxiliary Color】
- Accent Color: 【Accent Color】
- Style Direction: 【Style Direction, e.g., anime game original art, light impasto character setting, fantasy epic, future sci-fi, oriental fantasy】
- Aspect Ratio: 【Aspect Ratio, recommended 3:2 landscape】

【Auto-Completion Rules】
If the user has not filled in the complete basic character settings, or if some fields are empty, please do not stop generating, but instead automatically deduce and complete a set of complete, reasonable, and unified character settings based on the 【Theme】【Worldview】【Character Identity】【Combat Position】【Weapon Type】【Ability Direction】【Main Color】【Style Direction】.

During auto-completion, you should prioritize generating the following content and ensure logical consistency among them:
- Character gender tendency
- Age sense (youth / young adult / adult / mature)
- Body type characteristics (slender, muscular, light, burly)
- Facial temperament (calm, sharp, gentle, wild, noble, mysterious)
- Hairstyle and hair color
- Clothing structure (robe, armor, cloak, light outfit, uniform, formal dress, techwear)
- Armor and accessory ratio
- Weapon appearance style
- Skill effect form
- Expression tendency
- Clothing and equipment details in the three-view drawing

Auto-completion is not a random patchwork, but forming a unified scheme around the same character positioning. The final character must have clear recognizability and highly match the worldview, profession, color scheme, and combat style.

【Auto-Combination Suggestion Logic】
When the user has not explicitly filled in character details, please prioritize combining the basic character settings according to the following logic:
1. Determine the general direction of the character based on the 【Worldview】, such as fantasy, sci-fi, oriental fantasy, steampunk, future city, mythological epic;
2. Determine the character's body type, clothing structure, armor degree, and weapon temperament based on the 【Character Identity / Combat Position】;
3. Determine the skill action form, effect trajectory, combat posture, and equipment details based on the 【Weapon Type / Ability Direction】;
4. Determine the clothing color scheme, weapon material, energy color, and overall visual recognition based on the 【Main Color / Auxiliary Color / Accent Color】;
5. Unify the character's facial shaping, clothing language, light and shadow processing, and module expression based on the 【Style Direction】.

If the user only provides a small number of keywords, a complete character setting should also be automatically generated. For example:
- Only given "Flame Female Knight" -> Automatically complete the age sense, cloak, red-gold-black color scheme, spear or greatsword, flame skill effects, heroic expression;
- Only given "Ice Prince" -> Automatically complete the blue-silver-white color scheme, light armor or ceremonial armor, longsword or scepter, ice crystal skills, calm demeanor.

【Image Structure Requirements】
The entire image uses a landscape character setting description board layout, organizing the image with a "left main, right auxiliary" structure:

1. Left main visual area:
- Place a high-completion large-size main character standing illustration as the visual core of the entire image
- The character's posture is complete, with strong recognizability and character charm
- Details of clothing, armor, cloak, patterns, accessories, weapons are clear
- The character should reflect clear professional attributes and worldview affiliation
- Can include a small amount of faded character virtual shadows or background auxiliary outlines to enhance layering, but must not overshadow the main subject

2. Top-left title and introduction area:
- Display a large English title or series title, such as the series name / brand name the character belongs to
- Paired with the character's Chinese name, subtitle, faction, profession, or identity tags
- Add a brief character background introduction text to create a data page feel
- Title typography is concise and powerful, with a brand visual system feel

3. Top-right skill display area:
- Display a set of small character skill action images, numbering about 4~6
- Including action moments such as dash, slash, casting, burst, ultimate skill, area attack
- Each action should retain character recognition features and skill effect styles
- The skill module should look like an action breakdown display or combat illustration

4. Middle-right expression display area:
- Display about 4 character head expressions
- Such as calm, angry, surprised, contemplative, sneering, eyes closed
- The expression images should be unified in style with the main standing illustration, used to supplement the layers of the character's personality

5. Bottom three-view drawing area:
- Display the character's front, side, and back three-view drawings
- Used to clearly explain the clothing structure, cloak outline, armor design, back of the hairstyle, shoe and boot design
- The three-view drawings should be relatively neat, clear, and unified, like a formal setting draft

6. Right-side weapon and additional settings area:
- Display the character's main weapon separately, adding partial breakdowns or multiple angles when necessary
- Paired with a brief weapon name and descriptive text
- Can include small supplementary elements such as faction emblems, element icons, character crests

7. Color palette area:
- Use 3~5 color blocks to display the character's main color scheme system
- The color palette should be consistent with the character's clothing, weapon, and effect colors
- Strengthen the character's visual recognizability

【Visual Style Requirements】
- The overall background is mainly light gray-white, fog white, and cool white, clean and restrained, with ample white space
- The page has the temperament of an official art book, game data page, and character specification board
- The image has both a exquisite illustration feel and a rational typography and manual feel
- Module boundaries are clear, layout alignment is explicit, and information zoning is reasonable
- The main subject is finely drawn, and the styles of expressions, actions, weapons, and three-view drawings are unified
- Light and shadow are clean, do not be overly realistic or overly heavy
- Maintain a light UI feel, modern feel, brand feel, and proposal feel
- Do not make it into a messy collage, nor an overly flashy poster

【Output Target】
Generate a character setting archive board suitable for serialized reuse, allowing viewers to see at a glance the character's image, professional positioning, skill style, equipment characteristics, and worldview affiliation. The overall work must simultaneously possess "strong visual appeal" and "high information organization".

【Execution Principles】
- If the user fills in completely, prioritize faithful execution of the user's settings;
- If the user only fills in partial content, complete the missing fields;
- If the user fills in very little, automatically combine a complete set of basic character settings;
- Whether manually set or automatically completed, the final character must have a unified, complete, and serially expandable visual logic.

prompts.text:
请根据【主题 / 世界观 / 角色设定】，创作一张高完成度、高统一性、适合系列化发布的「角色设定档案板 / Character Archive Board」。

这不是普通角色插画，也不是单张立绘海报，而是一张结合“主立绘展示 + 技能动作展示 + 表情设定 + 三视图说明 + 武器装备展示 + 色板说明 + 品牌标题系统”的官方角色设定总览图。整体画面应像游戏设定集、角色资料页、项目提案板或IP视觉开发文档中的标准展示页，既有角色魅力，又有清晰的信息组织与设定说明感。

【基础设定】
- 主题 / 世界观：【主题】
- 项目名 / 品牌名：【品牌名】
- 角色名：【角色名】
- 身份 / 职业 / 阵营：【角色身份】
- 核心气质：【角色气质，例如冷峻、优雅、英勇、野性、神秘、暴烈】
- 战斗定位：【战斗定位，例如战士、骑士、法师、刺客、枪手、守护者】
- 武器类型：【武器类型】
- 元素属性 / 能力方向：【能力方向】
- 主色调：【主色调】
- 辅助色：【辅助色】
- 点缀色：【点缀色】
- 风格方向：【风格方向，例如二次元游戏原画、轻厚涂角色设定、奇幻史诗、未来科幻、东方幻想】
- 画幅比例：【画幅比例，建议 3:2 横版】

【自动补全规则】
如果用户没有填写完整的角色基础设定，或部分字段为空，请不要停止生成，而是根据【主题】【世界观】【角色身份】【战斗定位】【武器类型】【能力方向】【主色调】【风格方向】自动推导并补全一套完整、合理、统一的角色设定。

自动补全时，应优先生成以下内容，并确保彼此逻辑一致：
- 角色性别倾向
- 年龄感（少年 / 青年 / 成年 / 成熟）
- 体型特征（修长、健壮、轻盈、魁梧等）
- 面部气质（冷静、锐利、温柔、狂野、高贵、神秘等）
- 发型与发色
- 服装结构（长袍、战甲、披风、轻装、制服、礼装、机能装等）
- 盔甲与配饰比例
- 武器外观风格
- 技能特效形态
- 表情倾向
- 三视图中的服装和装备细节

自动补全不是随机拼凑，而是要围绕同一个角色定位形成统一方案。最终角色必须具备明确辨识度，并与世界观、职业、配色和战斗方式高度匹配。

【自动组合建议逻辑】
当用户未明确填写角色细节时，请优先依据以下逻辑组合角色基础设定：
1. 根据【世界观】确定角色的大方向，例如奇幻、科幻、东方幻想、蒸汽朋克、未来都市、神话史诗等；
2. 根据【角色身份 / 战斗定位】决定角色的体型、服装结构、盔甲程度和武器气质；
3. 根据【武器类型 / 能力方向】决定技能动作形式、特效走向、战斗姿态和装备细节；
4. 根据【主色调 / 辅助色 / 点缀色】决定服装配色、武器材质、能量颜色与整体视觉识别；
5. 根据【风格方向】统一角色脸部塑造、服饰语言、光影处理和模块表现方式。

如果用户只提供了少量关键词，也应自动生成完整角色设定。例如：
- 只给“火焰女骑士” → 自动补出年龄感、披风、红金黑配色、长枪或大剑、火焰技能特效、英气表情等；
- 只给“冰系王子” → 自动补出蓝白银配色、轻甲或礼甲、长剑或权杖、冰晶技能、冷静神态等。

【画面结构要求】
整张图采用横版角色设定说明板式布局，以“左主右辅”的结构组织画面：

1. 左侧主视觉区：
- 放置一张高完成度的大尺寸角色主立绘，作为整张图的视觉核心
- 角色姿态完整，具有强烈识别度和人物魅力
- 服装、盔甲、披风、纹样、配饰、武器等细节清晰
- 角色应体现明确的职业属性和世界观归属
- 可以带有少量淡化的角色虚影或背景辅助轮廓，以增强层次，但不能抢主体

2. 左上标题与简介区：
- 显示大号英文标题或系列标题，例如角色所属系列名 / 品牌名
- 搭配角色中文名、副标题、阵营、职业或身份标签
- 添加一段简洁的角色背景介绍文字，形成资料页感
- 标题排版简洁有力，具有品牌视觉系统感

3. 右上技能展示区：
- 展示一组角色技能动作小图，数量约 4~6 个
- 包括突进、挥击、施法、爆发、大招、范围攻击等动作瞬间
- 每个动作都应保留角色识别特征和技能特效风格
- 技能模块像动作分解展示或战斗说明图

4. 中右表情展示区：
- 展示约 4 个角色头像表情
- 如平静、愤怒、惊讶、沉思、冷笑、闭眼等
- 表情图应与主立绘风格统一，用于补充角色性格层次

5. 下方三视图区：
- 展示角色正面、侧面、背面三视图
- 用于清晰说明服装结构、披风轮廓、盔甲设计、发型背面、鞋靴造型等
- 三视图相对规整、清晰、统一，像正式设定稿

6. 右侧武器与附加设定区：
- 单独展示角色主武器，必要时可增加局部拆分或多个角度
- 搭配简短武器名称与说明文案
- 可加入阵营徽记、元素图标、角色纹章等小型补充元素

7. 色板区：
- 使用 3~5 个色块展示角色主配色体系
- 色板应与角色服装、武器、特效颜色保持一致
- 强化角色的视觉识别度

【视觉风格要求】
- 整体背景以浅灰白、雾白、冷白为主，干净克制，留白充足
- 页面具有官方设定集、游戏资料页、角色规格说明板的气质
- 画面既有精美插画感，也有理性排版和说明书感
- 模块边界清晰，版式对齐明确，信息分区合理
- 主体绘制精细，表情、动作、武器、三视图风格统一
- 光影干净，不要过度写实或过度厚重
- 保持轻UI化、现代感、品牌感、提案感
- 不要做成杂乱拼贴，也不要做成过度花哨的海报

【输出目标】
生成一张适合系列化复用的角色设定档案板，让观者一眼就能看出角色形象、职业定位、技能风格、装备特点和世界观归属。整体必须同时具备“强视觉吸引力”和“高信息组织度”。

【执行原则】
- 如果用户填写完整，则优先忠实执行用户设定；
- 如果用户只填写部分内容，则补全缺失字段；
- 如果用户填写非常少，则自动组合出一套完整角色基础设定；
- 无论是手动设定还是自动补全，最终角色都必须具备统一、完整、可系列化扩展的视觉逻辑。

She looks directly at the camera with a radiant, genuine Duchenne smile — her eyes crinkle warmly at the corners, teeth showing, eyes bright and happy, as if someone she loves just called her name. Her gaze is warm and inviting with a subtle   playful spark. Her left hand is raised, fingers gently touching the floating veil near her face, an effortless gesture that's both elegant and natural. Her right hand rests at her side near the slit of the dress.   The backlight is powerful and golden — the low-angle sun at about 10-15 degrees directly behind her creates:   1. A bright golden halo through her veil that wraps around her head and upper body   2. Strong rim light outlining her hair, bare shoulders, and back in warm gold   3. An angelic ring of light in her wind-blown hair   4. Subtle subsurface scattering on her ear edges and fingers   5. Her hair is wind-swept, dark brown strands flying freely, each one outlined in gold   by the backlight. prompts.text: 9:16，日系胶片摄影，富士美学，在ISO 800下迫冲富士Pro 400H拍摄，全画面具有明显的可见胶片颗粒，温暖而亲密。一位迷人的韩国女偶像穿着性感的现代象牙白婚纱，在黄金时刻于户外开阔的野花草地中被拍摄，身后落日形成强烈的逆光。   她以自信的身体扭转姿势站立——上半身面向镜头，重心移至右臀，左膝微曲。她的连衣裙是贴合身材的鱼尾轮廓，深V领露出锁骨，极细的   细吊带，戏剧性的露背设计露出整个背部，右侧有开到大腿根部的开叉，随着裙摆分开露出她修长的腿。这件连衣裙由象牙色丝绸缎面制成，带有捕捉   逆光的透明薄纱覆盖层，创造出明亮的光辉。一条精致的珍珠腰链位于她纤细的腰部。一层教堂长度的半透明薄纱头纱从她脑后延伸，被风吹起像白帆一样向上鼓起——阳光    穿透头纱，在她头部和肩部周围形成一个巨大的、梦幻的漫射光晕。   她直视镜头，露出灿烂、真诚的杜兴微笑——她的眼角温暖地弯曲，露出牙齿，眼神明亮而快乐，仿佛她爱的人刚刚呼唤了她的名字。她的目光温暖而诱人，带着一丝微妙   俏皮的光芒。她的左手抬起，手指轻轻触碰脸旁漂浮的头纱，这是一个毫不费力、既优雅又自然的姿态。她的右手放在身侧靠近裙子开叉的地方。   逆光强烈而金黄——位于她正后方约10-15度低角度的太阳产生了：   1. 透过她头纱的明亮金色光晕，环绕着她的头部和上半身   2. 强烈的轮廓光，用温暖的金色勾勒出她的头发、裸露的肩膀和背部   3. 在她被风吹动的头发中形成天使般的光环   4. 耳朵边缘和手指上微妙的次表面散射   5. 阳光穿过的地方，她裙子的薄纱覆盖层发出半透明的金色光芒   6. 自然的温暖镜头眩光，带有进入画面的柔和金色光线   她的脸部由来自环境反射的柔和自然补光照亮——冷粉调的富士肤色散发出健康和温暖的光泽，没有生硬的阴影。她的头发随风飘动，深棕色的发丝自由飞舞，每一根都被逆光   勾勒出金色的边缘。   背景：在f/1.4光圈下完全融化为奶油般的散景——金黄色草地的柔和渲染、模糊的野花、远处的树木剪影，以及温暖过曝的天空。她身后的一切都融化成印象派的色块。   富士Pro 400H迫冲至ISO 800的色彩科学——明显的可见胶片颗粒（0.4-0.5）覆盖整个图像，在阴影区域尤为明显。冷粉肤色（富士标志性特征），绿色呈现为清新的青蓝色，高光   为温暖的蜜桃金（来自逆光），阴影偏向紫蓝色。低对比度（0.8），稍微提升黑位以营造柔和的雾面胶片感。颗粒增加了质感和温度——感觉就像你在日本   时尚杂志上能看到的一张真实照片。   强烈的自然暗角（0.35）将视线吸引到她明亮的脸庞和周围的光晕上。35mm镜头在f/1.4光圈下，浅景深具有典型的圆形富士龙散景，边缘有轻微温暖的桶形畸变。一阵微风吹起她的头纱和裙子。她正在对着相机后面的某个人大笑。整个画面散发着欢乐、温暖和自信的美——一个阳光沐浴、充满颗粒感、不完美的完美瞬间。   杰作，最佳质量，杂志大片级新娘摄影，日系胶片美学，富士迫冲颗粒感外观，8K超高清，照片级真实，准确的黄金逆光渲染，半透明头纱的光线透射，逆光下的独立发丝，带有眼角弯曲的自然杜兴微笑，全画面可见胶片颗粒。

prompts.text:
Cinematic sports poster, double exposure style, ultra-detailed, high-end editorial design.

A vertical 9:16 cinematic poster featuring a professional elite athlete [character name] from reference image.

The composition shows a powerful full-body athlete standing in the foreground, wearing a modern professional sports uniform designed in team-appropriate colors, with realistic athletic fabric, subtle branding details, and performance wear aesthetics. The athlete is standing confidently on a [SPORT](e.g. football, basketball, or relevant equipment depending on the sport), placed inside a dramatic professional stadium environment at night.

Behind the athlete is a large, cinematic close-up portrait of the same character, seamlessly blended into a double exposure composition. The portrait layer enhances emotional depth, identity, and intensity, creating a powerful visual hierarchy between body and spirit.

---

## 🌍 Background & Environment

The background is a highly stylized sports environment featuring:
- Abstract national or team identity symbolism inspired by the athlete’s country or club (flag shapes, emblems, or cultural motifs)
- Dynamic motion paint splashes that match the team’s primary and secondary color palette
- Energetic light streaks and particle effects to emphasize motion and speed
- A realistic stadium filled with soft crowd bokeh, depth, and atmospheric haze

---

## 💡 Lighting & Atmosphere

The lighting is cinematic and highly dramatic:
- Strong stadium floodlights with high contrast shadows  
- Volumetric lighting beams cutting through mist and rain  
- Atmosphere enriched with moisture particles, rain droplets, or dust in the air  
- Color grading automatically adapted to the team identity (cool, warm, neon, or high-contrast cinematic tone)  
- Ultra-realistic rendering of skin, sweat, fabric texture, and environmental reflections  

---

## 🎨 Visual Style Direction

The overall design follows a premium global sports campaign aesthetic:
- Inspired by high-end athletic branding such as Adidas, Nike, Y-3, and Olympic visual identity systems  
- Editorial magazine cover quality composition  
- Strong emphasis on identity, performance, and emotional intensity  
- Balanced fusion of realism and stylized cinematic enhancement  

---

## 🧩 Typography & Graphic System

Integrated but subtle sports branding elements:
- Visible jersey number on the athlete’s uniform  
- Authentic-looking team or national badge placed on the chest area  
- Bold headline typography integrated into composition (sports editorial style)  
- Subtle multilingual or culturally relevant typographic accents depending on athlete background  
- Minimal sponsor-style branding elements for realism  

---

## 🔥 Mood & Emotion

The overall mood is:
**powerful, elite, focused, emotionally intense, heroic, and representative of national or team pride**

The athlete feels like a global sports icon at the peak of performance, captured in a decisive cinematic moment.

---

## 📸 Final Output Quality

Ultra realistic, 8K resolution, sharp focus, cinematic depth of field, professional sports photography composition, motion energy design, high-end advertising poster quality, globally broadcast sports campaign aesthetic.

这位运动员感觉像是一位处于表现巅峰的全球体育偶像，被捕捉在一个决定性的电影时刻。

prompts.text:
Please create a high-completion, high-narrative-tension, series-suitable "Shadow Ensemble Cover" based on [Theme: Write Character Name].

This is not an ordinary character illustration, nor a simple battle poster, but a "ensemble action cover" with a sense of novel cover, comic main visual, game promotional, and dark fantasy illustration. The image needs to combine a giant spiritual core character, multiple mid-ground action characters, background threat elements, local energy light effects, and a blank title area to form a complete character faction and worldview cover.

【Basic Settings】
Theme: [Theme, e.g., Jujutsu Battle / Dark Journey to the West / Cyber Hunter / Shanhai Jing Monster Hunting Squad / Doomsday Survivors / Magic Academy Combat Team]
Work Name: [Work Name]
Series Name / Brand Name: [Brand Name or Series Name]
Subtitle: [Subtitle]
Style Direction: [Style Direction, e.g., Dark Fantasy, Retro Comic Cover, Hand-painted Impasto, Fantasy Novel Cover, Game Main Visual]
Main Color Tone: [Main Color Tone, e.g., Ink Green Black Gray / Deep Blue Neon / Dark Brown Gold Red / Sand Yellow Rust / Deep Purple Gold]
Accent Color: [Accent Color, e.g., Blood Red Energy, Cyan-Green Magic Light, Golden Divine Light, Blue Lightning]
Aspect Ratio: [Aspect Ratio, e.g., 2:3 Vertical / 3:4 Vertical / 4:5 Vertical / 9:16 Vertical]

【Image Structure】
Adopt a vertical cover composition. There must be a massive main visual character in the image, serving as the spiritual core and atmospheric dominant element of the entire image. This character can be a side face, half-body portrait, back view, front gaze, or giant silhouette, occupying the right side, upper side, or main background area of the image, with a calm, mysterious, and oppressive expression, not necessarily participating in combat, but must dominate the atmosphere of the entire image.

Arrange 3 to 6 action characters in the mid-ground to form a combat faction ensemble. There needs to be a clear division of labor and posture differences among the characters, such as charging, holding a knife, casting spells, defending, summoning, jumping, standing guard, ranged attacking, etc. Avoid all characters standing still; a strong action rhythm and visual dynamic line must be formed.

Add enemy threats or worldview elements to the background, such as monsters, giant beasts, villain shadows, mechanical legions, demons, ruins, forests, alien spaces, battlefield smoke, or city disasters. The background threat should not overshadow the main subjects, but should wrap around the characters like shadows, enhancing the sense of crisis and narrative depth.

The image needs to set 1 to 2 high-saturation energy burst points, such as red flame fists, blue lightning, green curse aura, purple magic, golden divine light, or white blade light. Energy light effects should be concentrated on key characters or key weapons to form visual focal points, do not make the entire image glow evenly.

【Composition Method】
The overall structure adopts "Large Spiritual Core Character + Mid-ground Action Ensemble + Background Threat Shadow + Bottom or Side Blank Title Area". The image can use diagonal dynamic lines to organize characters, allowing the character ensemble to move from upper left to lower right, or rush from the bottom to the center, forming a strong sense of propulsion.

Retain an obvious blank title area, recommended to be located at the lower left, bottom, or side of the image. The blank area uses off-white, gray-white, light paper color, or low-saturation background color for placing [Brand Name / Work Name / Subtitle]. The title typography should have a sense of publication cover, using elegant serif fonts, retro title fonts, comic cover titles, or high-end magazine-style layouts. The text area must be clear and not completely obscured by characters and the background.

The edges of the illustration should not be a completely filled rectangle; irregular brush edges, ink diffusion, torn paper blank areas, or natural dissipation can be used, making the characters and background seem to grow out of the paper, enhancing the hand-drawn cover feel and artistic texture.

【Visual Style】
The overall style should be a combination of hand-painted impasto and comic covers, with paper texture, brushstroke feel, dark layer depth, and retro publication temperament. Light and shadow should be mainly low-key dark light, with the background darkened, character outlines clear, and local energy light providing high-contrast focal points. The image should not be overly clean, nor like ordinary smooth AI illustrations; it should retain hand-drawn textures, paper grains, edge brushstrokes, and dark fog.

Color-wise, adopt mainly low-saturation dark tones, supplemented by a small amount of high-saturation energy colors. The overall atmosphere should have a sense of oppression, mystery, combat, and worldview thickness.

【Image Goal】
The final image should look like a mature fantasy novel cover, comic special edition cover, game character faction main visual, or IP promotional poster. It needs to simultaneously possess:
1. A clear main visual character;
2. A character ensemble with action rhythm;
3. Clear enemy threats or worldview background;
4. Strong but restrained energy light effects;
5. A readable title text area;
6. The overall texture of a retro hand-drawn cover.

Please ensure the image information is rich but not chaotic, character hierarchy is clear, visual center of gravity is clear, reading path is natural, and it is suitable for subsequently replacing themes to continue generating works of the same series.

prompts.text:
请根据【主题：写人物名字】创作一张高完成度、高叙事张力、适合系列化发布的「暗潮群像封面 / Shadow Ensemble Cover」。

这不是普通角色插画，也不是简单的战斗海报，而是一张具有小说封面感、漫画主视觉感、游戏宣传感和暗黑奇幻插画感的“群像式动作封面”。画面需要通过一个巨大的精神核心人物、多个中景动作角色、背景威胁元素、局部能量光效和留白标题区，共同构成一个完整的角色阵营与世界观封面。

【基础设定】
主题：【主题，例如咒术战斗 / 暗黑西游 / 赛博猎人 / 山海经猎妖队 / 末日幸存者 / 魔法学院战斗团】
作品名：【作品名】
系列名 / 品牌名：【品牌名或系列名】
副标题：【副标题】
风格方向：【风格方向，例如暗黑奇幻、复古漫画封面、手绘厚涂、奇幻小说封面、游戏主视觉】
主色调：【主色调，例如墨绿黑灰 / 深蓝霓虹 / 暗棕金红 / 沙黄铁锈 / 深紫金色】
点缀色：【点缀色，例如血红能量、青绿色法术光、金色神光、蓝色雷电】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，例如2:3竖版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 9:16竖版】

【画面结构】
采用竖版封面构图。画面中必须有一个体量巨大的主视觉人物，作为整张图的精神核心和气质压场元素。这个人物可以是侧脸、半身像、背影、正面凝视或巨大轮廓，占据画面右侧、上方或背景主区域，表情冷静、神秘、有压迫感，不一定参与战斗，但必须统领整张图的气质。

在中景安排3到6个动作角色，形成一个战斗阵营群像。角色之间需要有明确分工和姿态差异，例如冲锋、持刀、施法、防御、召唤、跳跃、警戒、远程攻击等。避免所有人物站桩，必须形成强烈的动作节奏和视觉动线。

背景中加入敌方威胁或世界观元素，例如怪物、巨兽、反派阴影、机械军团、妖魔、废墟、森林、异空间、战场烟雾或城市灾难。背景威胁不应喧宾夺主，而应像阴影一样包裹角色，增强危机感和叙事深度。

画面需要设置1到2个高饱和能量爆点，例如红色火焰拳、蓝色雷电、绿色诅咒气息、紫色魔法、金色神光或白色刀光。能量光效应集中在关键角色或关键武器上，形成视觉焦点，不要全画面平均发光。

【构图方式】
整体采用“大型精神核心人物 + 中景动作群像 + 背景威胁阴影 + 底部或侧边留白标题区”的结构。画面可以使用斜向动线组织角色，让角色群像从左上到右下、或从下方冲向中央，形成强烈推进感。

保留一块明显的留白标题区，建议位于左下、底部或画面侧边。留白区域使用米白、灰白、浅纸色或低饱和背景色，用于放置【品牌名 / 作品名 / 副标题】。标题排版应具有出版物封面感，可以使用优雅衬线字体、复古标题字、漫画封面标题或高级杂志式排版。文字区要清晰，不要被角色和背景完全遮挡。

插画边缘不要做成完整矩形铺满，可以使用不规则笔刷边缘、墨迹扩散、撕纸式留白或自然消散的方式，让角色和背景像从纸面中生长出来，增强手绘封面感和艺术质感。

【视觉风格】
整体风格应为手绘厚涂与漫画封面结合，具有纸张质感、笔触感、暗部层次和复古出版物气质。光影以低调暗光为主，背景压暗，人物轮廓清晰，局部能量光提供高对比焦点。画面不要过度干净，不要像普通AI光滑插画，应保留手绘纹理、纸张颗粒、边缘笔触和暗色雾气。

色彩上采用低饱和暗调为主，辅以少量高饱和能量色。整体氛围应具有压迫感、神秘感、战斗感和世界观厚度。

【画面目标】
最终画面应像一张成熟的奇幻小说封面、漫画特别篇封面、游戏角色阵营主视觉或IP宣传海报。它需要同时具备：
1. 清晰的主视觉人物；
2. 有动作节奏的角色群像；
3. 明确的敌方威胁或世界观背景；
4. 强烈但克制的能量光效；
5. 可阅读的标题文字区；
6. 复古手绘封面的整体质感。

请确保画面信息丰富但不混乱，角色层级清晰，视觉重心明确，阅读路径自然，适合后续替换主题继续生成同系列作品。

prompts.text:
Please generate a high-energy storyboard image in [xx style], featuring [Character A] vs [Character B].

The overall style should have a high-energy anime feel, cinematic camera tension, intense action design, and an epic battle atmosphere, like a collection of key frames from an already edited passionate anime trailer. The entire set of images must strictly advance according to the following rhythm:

Panel 1 environment establishment, Panel 2 Character A close-up, Panel 3 Character B close-up, Panel 4 confrontation between both sides, Panel 5 Character A attacks first, Panel 6 Character B counterattacks, Panel 7 close-quarters clash, Panel 8 power escalation, Panel 9 both sides' ultimate moves manifest, Panel 10 final sprint, Panel 11 decisive blow, Panel 12 aftermath of the battle. Each panel must have a clear large white number 1~12 in the top left corner, and each panel must have a white timecode and a concise Chinese description in the bottom left corner. Character A and Character B must maintain a unified appearance, unified clothing, unified abilities, and unified temperament throughout the entire set of 12 panels; if they are well-known characters, their highly recognizable classic images and ability characteristics must be retained; if they are original characters, a distinct design must be automatically generated based on the name and maintained consistently throughout.

The overall must emphasize character contrast, ability contrast, color contrast, and aura contrast, strengthen the sense of speed, sense of burst, sense of impact, energy fission, smoke, debris, and ultimate move special effects, ultimately forming a high-energy anime storyboard image where one can see at a glance the "complete battle process".

coffee
a drink you can have in the morning
Example: I drink coffee every day.

bread

* Words should be more prominent, explanations and example sentences slightly smaller

[Overall Vibe]

* Like handwritten English learning annotations on daily photos
* Clean, natural, with white space
* Like light learning content on social media
* Not too complex, not too full, not too decorative

Only select 5 objects → label English words → pair with simple usage explanations → make the whole picture look relaxed and natural.

prompts.text:
Please create an original Chinese art curation poster with the theme "Chongqing Chaotianmen Under the Brushes of Different Painters".

Content setting: Taking 18 Chinese painters as sources of inspiration, using different art styles to express the same theme of "Chongqing Chaotianmen". Each small picture revolves around Chongqing Chaotianmen, reflecting the characteristics of the confluence of two rivers, docks, riverside cities, stacked buildings of the mountain city, boats, water mist, city skylines. Note: It must be Chongqing Chaotianmen, do not show Shanghai Oriental Pearl Tower.

The 18 painters are as follows: Gu Kaizhi, Wu Daozi, Wang Ximeng, Ni Zan, Shen Zhou, Qiu Ying, Qi Baishi, Zhang Daqian, Xu Beihong, Lin Fengmian, Fu Baoshi, Li Keran, Wu Guanzhong, Huang Yongyu, Fan Zeng, Zhou Chunya, Zeng Fanzhi, Liu Xiaodong.

Style directions:
- Gu Kaizhi: Flowing line drawing, elegant coloring, combination of ancient figures and landscapes
- Wu Daozi: Bold ink lines, strong momentum, strong sense of dynamics
- Wang Ximeng: Blue-green landscape, grand and exquisite, magnificent mineral colors
- Ni Zan: Sparse and ethereal, literati landscape, obvious blank space
- Shen Zhou: Gentle literati brush and ink, rich layers
- Qiu Ying: Fine brushwork and heavy color, exquisite and gorgeous, strong sense of narrative
- Qi Baishi: Concise brush and ink, vivid colors, naive and lively
- Zhang Daqian: Splashed ink and splashed color, broad atmosphere
- Xu Beihong: Integration of Chinese and Western, rigorous modeling
- Lin Fengmian: Modern Chinese painting, summarized color blocks, poetic haziness
- Fu Baoshi: Bold brush and ink, misty and thick
- Li Keran: Deep accumulated ink, calm layers
- Wu Guanzhong: Strong sense of form, distinct composition of points, lines, and planes
- Huang Yongyu: Agile and bright, jumping colors
- Fan Zeng: Literati spirit, strong calligraphic quality, strong figure flavor
- Zhou Chunya: Strong expressiveness, intense colors, with flower imagery
- Zeng Fanzhi: Strong emotional tension, thick brushstrokes, urban sense
- Liu Xiaodong: Realistic oil painting, sense of being on the scene, combination of figures and riverside life

Layout requirements: Do not imitate the layout of any existing images, do not use a table comparison structure, do not replicate sample posters.
Please design it in the form of an "original curation poster", and you can adopt a more free and advanced art gallery exhibition layout:
- The picture is horizontally large

- Within each chapter, several small works and text labels are freely arranged

items.title: 敦煌神女残金壁画

prompts.text:
Please take [Theme] as the core to create a high-end artwork in the style of Dunhuang murals. The picture adopts [Composition Method] composition method, taking the main character as the only main visual core, expressing the sacred moment of its core action / situation. The overall atmosphere should be [Overall Atmosphere], possessing museum-level aesthetics, cultural thickness, and collectible artistic sense.

Main character image requirements:
The main character should present an elegant and solemn, slender and luxurious, strongly divine temperament, with stretched posture, having the distinct sacredness and ritual sense of Dunhuang murals. The face needs to be serene, holy, subtle, and inviolable, carrying the solemn temperament of goddesses / bodhisattvas / flying apsaras in Dunhuang murals, rather than ordinary ancient style beauties.
Hair styled in a high bun, wearing complex and exquisite gold hair crowns, beaded chain buyao, earrings, yingluo (necklaces), armlets, waist ornaments, with gorgeous clothing, smooth clothing lines, fine and vigorous lines, full of flying apsara rhythm and court-level mural texture. The hem of the garment, flowing ribbons, skirt hem, and cuffs should form rhythmic flowing curves, strengthening the sense of sacred ascension and picture rhythm.

Gold structure requirements:
The picture needs to strengthen structural use of gold, not scattered gold dots, but forming a clear luxurious order:
The main character's hair crown, jewelry, clothing edges, cuffs, waist seal, ribbon edge lines, and skirt patterns adopt gold tracing, mud gold, gilded gold, gold thread embroidery, damaged gold foil traces;
Core sacred elements, such as moon wheel / buddha light / dharma wheel / precious canopy / lotus seat, cloud patterns, lotus petals, baoxiang flowers, caisson decorations, tuanhua patterns, border decorations should also have clearly visible but restrained and high-end golden decorations;
The overall presentation should have a resplendent but not vulgar, gorgeously crafted but not cheap effect, expressing the damaged luxury sense that still retains the lingering charm of resplendence after thousands of years of weathering.

Color requirements:
Colors are mainly ochre red, cinnabar, cyan-green, azurite, mineral green, earth yellow, ivory white, supplemented by restrained and exquisite earth gold, gilded gold.
The overall tone should be rich, mellow, antique, and noble, avoiding light and floating syrupy colors.
The background can adopt [Background Main Color Atmosphere], such as a deep azurite sky curtain / warm ancient wall base color / dark gold mineral base color combined with ancient wall texture, setting off the sacredness and nobility of the main body.

Decorative element requirements:
The picture can integrate typical Dunhuang visual languages such as flying apsaras, lotus flowers, baoxiang flowers, caissons, auspicious clouds, musicians, tuanhua patterns, pavilions and palaces, dharma instruments, holy light round wheels, and classical border decorations, but they must be centrally distributed around the main body with clear hierarchy, avoiding evenly spreading across the whole picture.
Supporting characters should be controlled to [Number of Supporting Characters] positions, serving as praise and foil, distributed around or below the main body, forming a ritualistic momentum facing the main body. They can have supporting actions, such as holding a lotus / playing a pipa / blowing a flute / offering flowers / holding a lamp / holding a banner, with light and flowing lines, echoing the main body, but must not overshadow the main subject.

Space and composition requirements:
The composition should retain moderate cloud space, holy light blank space, moonlight or sky curtain blank space, giving the picture a sense of breathing.
Core sacred elements need to be eye-catching, solemn, and complete, surrounded by gilded halos, holy light round wheels, and dense gold line trajectories, strengthening the sacredness of the theme.
Distant view elements can be embellished in the distance, such as moon palace pavilions / pavilions in the clouds / buddhist realm architecture / fairy realm sky curtain, but not too many, to enhance the spatial hierarchy and fairy realm atmosphere.

Material expression requirements:
Need to emphasize ancient grotto murals and mineral pigment textures:
Visible mottling, cracks, weathering, slight peeling, historical patina, pulverized edges, ancient wall textures;
At the same time, retain local gold tracing, damaged gold foil, and abraded gilded luster, forming a high-end artistic texture of "old but noble, damaged but gorgeous, ancient but sacred".

Overall requirements: gorgeous, delicate, mysterious, solemn, unified, collectible, artistic, extremely strong sense of high-end.

Negative constraint words:
Avoid modern national trend style, avoid commercial illustration sense, avoid ordinary ancient style beauty illustration, avoid anime sense, avoid internet celebrity aesthetics, avoid plastic texture, avoid cheap nouveau riche gold, avoid gold being too bright and too vulgar, avoid fluorescent colors, avoid over-saturation, avoid too many characters, avoid background elements being too full, avoid decorations evenly spreading across the whole picture, avoid overly heavy floral sense, avoid unclear visual primary and secondary, avoid unhighlighted main body, avoid low-level stacking sense, avoid mediocrity sense, avoid frivolity sense, avoid modern clothing sense, avoid photography sense, avoid 3D modeling plastic sense.

prompts.text:
请以 【主题】 为核心，创作一幅 敦煌壁画风的高端艺术画作。画面采用 构图方式，以主体角色为唯一主视觉核心，表现其核心动作 / 情境的神圣瞬间。整体氛围应为 整体氛围，具有博物馆级审美、文化厚度与收藏级艺术感。

主体形象要求：
主体角色应呈现出优雅庄严、修长华贵、神性强烈的气质，姿态舒展，具有鲜明的敦煌壁画式神圣性与仪式感。面容需静穆、圣洁、含蓄、不可侵犯，带有敦煌壁画中神女 / 菩萨 / 飞天式的庄严气质，而不是普通古风美女。
发髻高挽，佩戴复杂精美的 金饰发冠、珠链步摇、耳饰、璎珞、臂钏、腰饰，服饰华丽，衣纹流畅，线条细劲有力，富有飞天韵律与宫廷级壁画质感。衣袂、飘带、裙摆与袖口应形成富有节奏感的流动曲线，强化神圣升腾感与画面韵律。

用金结构要求：
画面需强化 结构性用金，不是零散点金，而是形成明确的奢华秩序：
主体角色的发冠、首饰、衣缘、袖口、腰封、飘带边线、裙摆纹样采用 描金、泥金、鎏金、金线刺绣、残损金箔痕迹；
核心神圣元素，如月轮 / 佛光 / 法轮 / 宝盖 / 莲台、云纹、莲花花瓣、宝相花、藻井纹饰、团花纹、边框装饰也应带有 清晰可见但克制高级的金色装饰；
整体呈现 金碧辉煌但不俗艳、富丽精工但不廉价 的效果，表现出历经千年风化后仍保有金碧辉煌余韵的 残损奢华感。

色彩要求：
色彩以 赭红、朱砂、青绿、石青、石绿、土黄、象牙白 为主，辅以克制精致的 土金、鎏金。
整体色调要 浓郁、浑厚、古雅、贵气，避免轻飘糖水色。
背景可采用 背景主色氛围，如深邃石青天幕 / 温润古壁底色 / 暗金矿物底色与古壁肌理结合，衬托出主体的神圣与尊贵。

装饰元素要求：
画面可融入 飞天、莲花、宝相花、藻井、祥云、伎乐、团花纹、楼阁宫阙、法器、圣光圆轮、古典边框装饰 等典型敦煌视觉语言，但必须围绕主体集中分布，层级清晰，避免平均铺满全画面。
陪衬人物控制在 陪衬人数位即可，作为礼赞与陪衬，分布在主体周围或下方，形成朝向主体的仪式感动势。她们可陪衬动作，如持莲花 / 奏琵琶 / 吹笛 / 奉花 / 托灯 / 执幡，线条轻盈流动，与主体形成呼应，但不可喧宾夺主。

空间与构图要求：
构图中应保留适度的 云气空间、圣光留白、月光或天幕留白，让画面有呼吸感。
核心神圣元素需醒目、庄严、圆满，周围可有 鎏金光晕、圣光圆轮、细密金线轨迹，强化主题的神圣性。
远处可点缀远景元素，如月宫楼阁 / 云中宫阙 / 佛国建筑 / 仙界天幕，但不可过多，以增强空间层次与仙界气息。

材质表现要求：
需强调古老石窟壁画与矿物颜料肌理：
可见 斑驳、裂纹、风化、轻微剥落、历史包浆、粉化边缘、古壁肌理；
同时保留局部 描金、残损金箔、磨蚀后的鎏金光泽，形成 “旧而贵、残而华、古而神圣” 的高级艺术质感。
整体要求：华丽、细腻、神秘、庄严、统一、收藏级、艺术化、高级感极强。

负面约束词：
避免现代国潮风，避免商业插画感，避免普通古风美女插画，避免动漫感，避免网红审美，避免塑料质感，避免廉价土豪金，避免金色过亮过俗，避免荧光色，避免过度饱和，避免人物过多，避免背景元素过满，避免装饰平均铺满全画面，避免碎花感过重，避免视觉主次不清，避免主体不突出，避免低级堆砌感，避免平庸感，避免轻浮感，避免现代服装感，避免摄影感，避免3D建模塑料感。

prompts.text:
Please create a "minimalist geometric installation style product poster" for the [Theme Product].
If I provide a product image, please use this image as the main reference, retain the product's core appearance features, packaging form, color, material, brand identity, and overall temperament, and prioritize adopting the main tone and color matching relationship from the product image for the design.
If I do not provide a product image, please automatically generate product appearance and packaging design that fits the positioning of the [Theme Product], and automatically match natural and reasonable main colors, auxiliary colors, prop shapes, and display methods based on the product attributes, category characteristics, and temperament.
Overall poster style requirements:
The image uses a high-key white or warm white photography studio background, overall clean, transparent, soft, and bright, with a premium commercial feel and modern brand visual temperament. The composition is not an ordinary e-commerce studio shot, but a conceptual poster combining brand visual proposals, artistic still life photography, and 3D product display.
The main subjects of the image should include:
1. The [Theme Product] itself
2. Product packaging
3. Raw materials, slices, components, functional elements, or material details related to the product
The three together form a complete visual chain, allowing viewers to understand at a glance "what this product is, what the content is, what the selling point or source is".
Add simple and design-sense geometric installation props to the scene, for example: cylinders, squares, long strips, rings, spheres, semicircles, platforms, stacked building blocks, acrylic stands, toy-like structures, used to support, suspend, surround, or set off the main product body, forming an artistic display composition rich in order, rhythm, and layering.
The overall color matching should naturally unfold around the product itself, with the product-related color as the main visual core, paired with neutral colors such as white, cream, and light gray, adding a small amount of auxiliary accent colors when necessary, making the picture colors unified, restrained, comfortable, and refreshing, not cluttered or flashy. Different products should automatically adapt to different color schemes, without fixedly using a certain background color.
The material expression should be delicate and realistic, with a high-quality commercial rendering texture. Transparent plastic, acrylic, frosted material, paper labels, glass, metal, smooth plastic, fruit flesh texture, food ingredient texture, or product surface details should all be natural and credible. There can be slight reflections and soft shadows, but they should not be too heavy or dirty and messy.
The composition requires sufficient white space, clear main subject, balanced picture, clean visuals, with a relaxed, gentle, modern, exquisite, approachable, slightly playful but not childish brand temperament. The overall feeling is like a high-aesthetic brand product KV poster, very suitable for e-commerce main visuals, social media seeding pictures, and product display pictures.
Output requirements:
- Vertical composition
-  Proportion
- Single poster
- Premium feel, simple feel, strong brand feel

prompts.text:
请为【主题产品】创作一张“极简几何装置风产品海报”。

如果我提供了产品图片，请以该图片为主要参考，保留产品的核心外观特征、包装形态、颜色、材质、品牌识别和整体气质，并优先沿用产品图中的主色调与配色关系进行设计。
如果我没有提供产品图片，请根据【主题产品】自动生成符合该产品定位的产品外观与包装设计，并根据产品属性、品类特征和气质，自动匹配自然合理的主色、辅助色、道具造型与展示方式。

海报整体风格要求：
画面采用高键白色或暖白色摄影棚背景，整体干净、通透、柔和、明亮，具有高级商业感与现代品牌视觉气质。构图不是普通电商棚拍，而是像品牌视觉提案、艺术静物摄影与3D产品陈列结合的概念海报。

画面主体应包含：
1. 【主题产品】本体
2. 产品包装
3. 与产品相关的原料、切片、部件、功能元素或材质细节

三者共同构成完整的视觉链路，使观者一眼就能理解“这是什么产品、内容是什么、卖点或来源是什么”。

场景中加入简洁且具有设计感的几何装置道具，例如：圆柱、方块、长条块、圆环、球体、半圆、平台、堆叠积木、亚克力支架、玩具感结构体等，用于承托、悬置、围绕或衬托产品主体，形成富有秩序感、节奏感和层次感的艺术陈列构图。

整体配色应围绕产品本身自然展开，以产品关联色为主视觉核心，搭配白色、奶油色、浅灰色等中性色，必要时加入少量辅助点缀色，使画面颜色统一、克制、舒适、清爽，不杂乱、不花哨。不同产品应自动适配不同配色，不固定使用某一种背景色。

材质表现要细腻真实，具有高质量商业渲染质感。透明塑料、亚克力、磨砂材质、纸质标签、玻璃、金属、光滑塑胶、果肉纹理、食材纹理或产品表面细节都应自然可信。可以有轻微反射与柔和阴影，但不要过重、不要脏乱。

构图要求留白充足，主体明确，画面平衡，视觉整洁，具有轻松、温和、现代、精致、亲和、带一点童趣但不幼稚的品牌气质。整体感觉像一张高审美的品牌产品KV海报，非常适合电商主视觉、社交媒体种草图、产品展示图。

输出要求：
- 竖版构图
-  比例
- 单张海报
- 高级感、简洁感、品牌感强

prompts.text:
A breathtakingly intricate masterpiece technical infographic of [SUBJECT / 例如: Ancient Chinese Naval Warfare], strictly designed based on the following first-principle visual parameters.

[CANVAS & COLOR DICTATORSHIP]  
BASE CANVAS (L0): Aged military parchment texture, warm #E8DCC4, with subtle weathered stains and historical map fiber textures.  
SYSTEMIC COLOR (L1, ~60%): Traditional heavy charcoal ink #2B2B2B for structural technical lines, soldier silhouettes, and mechanical joinery.  
CONTENT TIER COLOR (L2, ~30%): Weathered bronze, dark lacquer red, and iron gray #555555 to distinguish between different units and materials.  
ACCENT COLOR (L3, ~5-10%): High-visibility Vermillion #E62B1E reserved ONLY for tactical arrows, fire/explosions, and commanding general banners.

[SPATIAL GRAVITY & TOPOLOGY]  
COMPOSITION: [选择一个: 主从卫星布局 / 45度等轴测全景]. Information gravity flows in a logical tactical sequence.  
BOUNDARIES: Professional editorial layout with clean margins; negative space serves as “tactical breathing room” to separate different combat phases.  
MODULE TOPOLOGY: [N] distinct information modules depicting different scales (e.g., individual weapon detail vs. macro formation).

[DIMENSIONALITY & GRAPHIC PHYSICS]  
STYLE: Fusion of Traditional Chinese Gongbi (meticulous line-art) and modern military tactical blueprints (like “Osprey Publishing” style).  
LINE LANGUAGE: 0.8pt sharp technical outlines / 0.3pt faint background grid lines / 2pt bold borders for the main title seal.  
SURFACE EFFECTS: Realistic material rendering — wood grain on ballistas, metallic sheen on lamellar armor, and subtle ink-wash shading for terrain.

[TYPOGRAPHY ECOSYSTEM — ADAPTIVE DENSITY]  
TYPOGRAPHY DENSITY: Map-dominant (65% visual / 35% text).  
T1 MACRO HEADER: Massive, ultra-bold Traditional Songti characters for the main title “[主题中文名]”. MUST be strictly pure Chinese Hanzi with an ink-pressed texture.  
T2 MODULE HEADERS: Kaiti font enclosed in dark rectangular “military rank” badges, labeling different tactical zones.  
T3 BODY TEXT: Clean, medium-weight Heiti (sans-serif) for weapon specifications and tactical roles. Every character must be razor-sharp.  
T4 ANNOTATIONS: Micro-text with ultra-crisp technical lines pointing directly to components (e.g., trigger mechanism, fletching, armor joints).

[NARRATIVE FLOW]  
NARRATIVE MODE: [选择一个: 流程顺序型 / 核心辐射型].   
VISUAL ENTRY POINT: The most significant tactical unit (e.g., the command chariot or the primary siege engine).  
PATH MECHANISM: Numerical sequence (1, 2, 3…) or bold cinnabar-red arrows guiding the viewer through the battle logic.

[ICONOGRAPHY & METAPHOR]  
ICON STYLE: Highly detailed historical pictograms for units (infantry, cavalry, archers).  
CORE METAPHOR: Military order as a precise clockwork mechanism.  
CONSISTENCY: All symbols must adhere to the [时期/王朝, 如: Tang Dynasty] military aesthetic.

[MODULE STRUCTURE — SUGGESTED BLOCKS]  
[MOD 1: CENTER-PIECE] — The primary [Weapons/Formation] with an exploded-view detail showing internal mechanics.  
[MOD 2: TACTICAL MAP] — Top-down schematic showing unit movement and line-of-fire.  
[MOD 3: SOLDIER EQUIPMENT] — Close-up side-by-side comparison of offensive vs. defensive gear.  
[MOD 4: LOGISTICS/STATISTICS] — Small icon-based charts showing range, weight, or troop density.

[FINAL EXECUTION LOCK]  
Render as a single, ultra-detailed educational plate. All visual systems must be internally consistent with a professional museum archive aesthetic. Every pixel must serve the purpose of clarifying complex military history.  
Resolution target: Maximum information density, print-ready encyclopedia quality.

prompts.text:
一幅令人叹为观止的错综复杂的技术信息图杰作，主题为[SUBJECT / 例如: 中国古代海战]，严格基于以下第一性原理视觉参数进行设计。

[画布与色彩专制]  
基础画布 (L0): 老化军事羊皮纸纹理，温暖的 #E8DCC4，带有微妙的岁月污渍和历史地图纤维纹理。  
系统性色彩 (L1, ~60%): 传统的浓重炭墨 #2B2B2B，用于结构技术线条、士兵剪影和机械连接处。  
内容层级色彩 (L2, ~30%): 风化青铜色、深漆红色和铁灰色 #555555，用于区分不同兵种和材料。  
强调色 (L3, ~5-10%): 高可视度朱红色 #E62B1E，仅保留用于战术箭头、火/爆炸以及主将旗帜。

[空间重力与拓扑学]  
构图: [选择一个: 主从卫星布局 / 45度等轴测全景]。信息重力以符合逻辑的战术顺序流动。  
边界: 专业的编辑排版布局，带有干净的页边距；负空间作为“战术呼吸空间”以分隔不同的战斗阶段。  
模块拓扑: [N] 个不同的信息模块，描绘不同的尺度（例如，单个武器细节与宏观阵型）。

[维度与图形物理学]  
风格: 传统中国工笔（精细线稿）与现代军事战术蓝图的融合（类似“Osprey Publishing”风格）。  
线条语言: 0.8pt 锐利的技术轮廓线 / 0.3pt 淡雅的背景网格线 / 2pt 粗边框用于主标题印章。  
表面效果: 写实材料渲染——弩炮上的木纹、鳞甲上的金属光泽，以及地形的微妙水墨晕染阴影。

[排版生态系统 — 自适应密度]  
排版密度: 地图主导（65% 视觉 / 35% 文本）。  
T1 宏观标题: 巨大、极粗的传统宋体字符，用于主标题“[主题中文名]”。必须是严格纯中文汉字，带有压墨纹理。  
T2 模块标题: 楷体字体，包含在深色矩形的“军衔”徽章中，标记不同的战术区域。  
T3 正文文本: 干净、中等粗细的黑体（无衬线体），用于武器规格和战术角色。每个字符必须如刀割般锐利。  
T4 注释: 微型文本，带有超清晰的技术线条，直接指向组件（例如，扳机机构、箭羽、盔甲接缝）。

[叙事流]  
叙事模式: [选择一个: 流程顺序型 / 核心辐射型]。   
视觉入口点: 最重要的战术单位（例如，指挥战车或主攻城器械）。  
路径机制: 数字序列（1, 2, 3…）或粗体朱红色箭头，引导观者了解战斗逻辑。

[图像学与隐喻]  
图标风格: 高度详细的历史象形图，用于各个兵种（步兵、骑兵、弓箭手）。  
核心隐喻: 军事秩序如同精密的钟表发条机制。  
一致性: 所有符号必须遵循[时期/王朝, 如: Tang Dynasty]的军事美学。

[模块结构 — 建议区块]  
[MOD 1: 核心展品] — 主要的[武器/阵型]，带有展示内部机械结构的爆炸视图细节。  
[MOD 2: 战术地图] — 俯视图示意图，显示单位移动和火力线。  
[MOD 3: 士兵装备] — 攻击与防御装备的特写并排对比。  
[MOD 4: 后勤/统计数据] — 基于小图标的图表，显示射程、重量或部队密度。

[最终执行锁定]  
渲染为单个、超细节的教育图版。所有视觉系统必须在内部保持一致，具有专业的博物馆档案美学。每一个像素都必须服务于阐明复杂军事历史的目的。  
分辨率目标: 最大信息密度，达到印刷级百科全书质量。

items.title: 复古电影票根海报

prompts.text:
设计一张[电影名称]的复古电影票根海报，风格为黑白木刻版画/油印版画。  
画布：竖版3:4比例，纯黑色背景。

━━━━━━━━ 整体布局 ━━━━━━━━

左侧（占宽20%）：垂直排列3张完全相同的缩小版票根，  
像胶片负片一样上下叠放，每张之间用圆形打孔分隔。  
右侧（占宽80%）：1张大幅主票根，竖向排列，填满画布全高。  
左侧与右侧内容100%一致，左侧仅为等比缩小3倍的重复，不得变形。  
票根内所有文字元素全部左对齐，无任何居中排列。

━━━━━━━━ 票根内容（从上到下）━━━━━━━━

【主插图区】占票根高度45%  
该电影最具代表性的木刻版画场景，纯黑白，  
密集排线质感，零灰色，极高对比度，无任何中间色调

四边锯齿形打孔撕边边框贯穿全票

【标题区】全部左对齐  
中文片名[中文片名](%E5%B9%B4%E4%BB%BD) ← 最大字号，粗黑体，视觉重量最重  
英文片名 [English Title] ← 次大字号，衬线体，紧跟中文下方

- 虚线分隔

【信息区】全部左对齐

以下所有行：导演、类型、日期、HALL/SEAT/PRICE、DATE/TIME，  
必须使用完全相同的字号、完全相同的字重、完全相同的字体，  
视觉效果如同一台老式针式打印机从头到尾连续打印，  
中途从未换过字号或字体，每一行文字高度像素级一致。

字体规格：

- 字号：极小，约9px等效，不得超过这个尺寸
    
- 字重：极细，笔画纤细如针，类似 Courier New Regular
    
- 字形：等宽字体，每个字符占格相同
    
- 质感：轻微色块不均，模拟色带油墨印迹，  
    部分笔画边缘略有锯齿或断点，非完美矢量

排版节奏严格还原如下（全部顶格左对齐）：

[国家] 导演中文姓名 Director English Name  
Genre1/Genre2  
首映日期(节展名称) / 上映日期(地区) / XXX分钟

---

HALL : SEAT : PRICE :  
[XX] [XX-XX] [XX.X]  
DATE : TIME :  
[DD/Mon/YYYY] [HH:MM-HH:MM]

---

此信息区每一行在视觉上拥有完全相同的存在感，  
如同一张连续打印的收据，无任何行拥有视觉特权，  
无加粗，无字号差异，无例外。

【台词装饰区】全部左对齐  
台词外围仅用一根细线单框围合，四角无花纹无装饰，  
线条纤细均匀，类似钢笔划出的简单矩形边框，  
留有适当内边距，边框与票根左右边距对齐，  
框内文字左对齐排列：

“[该电影最经典的英文台词]”  
手写草书字体或打字机字体，字号略大于信息区

━━━━━━━━ 强制执行规则 ━━━━━━━━

【字号层级 · 全局唯一标准】  
第1级：中文片名 → 最大，粗黑体  
第2级：英文片名 → 次大，衬线体  
第3级：台词 → 中等，手写草书或打字机体  
第4级：信息区全部内容 → 最小，等宽极细体，  
导演/类型/日期/HALL/SEAT/PRICE/DATE/TIME  
所有行严格等高等重，像素级一致

【绝对禁止】  
✗ 画面中出现任何序号标记（①②③等符号一律不得渲染）  
✗ 任何区域出现居中对齐，全局统一左对齐  
✗ 台词边框出现花纹、角饰、藤蔓等复杂装饰  
✗ 信息区任意两行出现字号差异  
✗ HALL / SEAT / PRICE 三列出现高低错位  
✗ DATE / TIME 两列字号不一致  
✗ 信息区出现任何加粗或加重笔画  
✗ 左右票根出现非等比变形  
✗ 任何字段保留占位符，必须填写真实内容
